comments: We had a very plesant stay at Domingo's appartment and he was very helpful with findings good value restaurants. I would reccomend this place to goups up to 6 persons because there are two rooms with doublebeds.

This is a great apartment in a wonderful location! Domingo and his wife were very good hosts. Always very attentive to our needs and very flexible with our check-in and check-out times. I would not hesitate to return here in my next trip to Madrid.

Very nice host, he waited for us at the arrival, and was very welcoming. And we were free to choose the check-out time and leave during the afternoon.The appartment is really great, clean and ideally situated. Really easy to live in! See you soon Madrid. Gracias Domingo.

I highly recommend this apartment. It is wonderful, really equipped and well located. Domingo and his wife are really nice and helpful persons. They were really comprehensive to arrange a time suitable for us to make the check-in and the check-out. They even brought a baby cot and all the necessary laundry as they knew we were travelling with a baby. If we are traveling again to Madrid, we’ll definitely come back to this apartment.

We stayed at Domingo's fabulous apartment for 4 nights. Everything  was perfect; the location, the accomodations, the views from the balconies and the apartment is stunning. If you are looking for a spot that is close to everything, this is the place!

We loved our stay in Madrid. The apartment is gorgeous and the hosts were fantastic. They went out of their  way to help us. The apartment is in a great location and is so homely. Our favourite accommodation in Spain.

We had really good time in Domingo's apartment! Really good located, in the heart of Madrid, and so nice and clean! Domingo is a very nice person, and helped us with trip suggestions. Thanks for this great time!

I stayed in Domingo's apartment with friends and had a brilliant time. The apartment was fantastic and in a great location. There were lots of tapas bars on the street and surrounding streets and it is in walking distance of the main squares, markets and other attractions. The hosts were lovely and made us feel really welcome. I would highly recommend this apartment.

I LOVED this place.  It is situated in a neighborhood so you have local bars and cafes and grocery.  But also close to hotel, nightlife and Plaza Mayor (I know I misspelled that).  There were 3 of us, we each had our own room, 2 bathrooms, so girls had one to them selves.   The place is super clean.

Domingo and Carmen were absolutely wonderful. They met us at the apartment and gave us a full run down of not only the apartment, but the neighborhood, local restaurants, maps, everything you could need.
The apartment is fantastic, with a warm feeling that made us instantly feel at home.
The neighborhood is so central and convenient to all galleries and transport. I would definitely recommend staying here and will be staying here again on our next visit to Madrid.
Thank you Domingo and Carmen for making a holiday extra special, and we look forward to coming back.

Out family of 5 had a wonderful experience staying at Domingo and Carmen's apartment in Madrid for 4 nights! It is in a superb location - within walking distance to the Prado and restaurants. The apartment is clean, well appointed, and has a lovely personal decorating touch from the owners. We would absolutely recommend staying there and will again if/when we visit Madrid in the future.

Domingo and Carmen met us when we arrived and showed us everything we needed to know, and also came by when we were leaving for the next leg of our trip.

Domingo's apartment was beautiful and had plenty of room for all 6 of us. We were so happy looking out the huge front windows to the streets. The location was perfect and we were able to walk everywhere. There are thousands of amazing places to eat, but the host's recommendations were our favorites. Everything was clean and comfortable.  If you visit Madrid this is the best place to stay!

Great location. There are plenty of choices in the area, you don't need to venture too far to have a good time. Mercado San Miguel was close by and the flea market on Sunday is a must. The place was very comfortable and Domingo was the perfect host. We were very happy and would love to come back again.

Domingo's apartment is very great! Quite spacious and artful. We stayed there for four days and enjoyed being there very much! Domingo and his wife are very welcoming and recommended a lot of places to us and the key points to remember in Madrid. Thanks!

Domingo and his wife are fantastic host very friendly and Service oriented.the Location is perfectly located e.g for all the big museums. Furthermore you have a lot of nice Tapas Bars around and locations for breakfast . We can fully recommend the Location . We have been 4 adults and we had enough space. The apartment is well equiped, so in total a very nice experience.
Would definitely recommend Domingo's place. Perfect location, great apartment. Very friendly and responsive couple. Very punctual with check-ins and check out. We had a lovely time.

Fantastic place. What a great location. Almost everything you need within 20m of the front door. Spacious and a bit quirky - just right for a Madrid experience. Domingo and his wife couldn't have been more friendly and helpful.

Domingo and his wife are very kind and explain you all what you need to know in the district of the appartment (restaurants, best place for mojito, and a bit of history ) The appartment was clean and fresh ( highly appreciated in summer) and spacious. Everything perfect for several couples coming to visit the great city of Madrid.

This location is wonderful! We had two 15 year old girls with us and felt very comfortable in the neighborhood.  The biggest problem we had was picking bedrooms as we traveled with two adult couples and the girls - there is a master bedroom and two secondary bedrooms so it was hard to figure out where to go- but the place is as beautiful as it looks in the photographs and our hosts were so nice! Perfect place!

The location is absolutely perfect: on a charming street with much to do and see.  It's a beautiful apartment that is decorated so well.  FYI: three flights of stairs leading up to it for good exercise! Domingo is very personable and helpful. We appreciated all his recommendations. Loved the whole experience.

Domingo's house was very well located in the center of Madrid...walking distance to the must things to see and do as well as to good restaurants and shops! Also, thanks to Domingo's advice we enjoyed good and typical spanish food! A very charming house to look for if you want to spend some days in Madrid.

Lovely apartment with a homely feel about it. Perfect for a city break or longer.
Comfortable and clean and set centrally so easy to get to The Metro and to local tourist areas and restaurants
The only downside is that there are 70 stairs up to the apartment and no lift so may not be great for the elderly or anyone with mobility issues
The hosts are very welcoming. Would highly recommend this property.
Great location. Excellent hosts. Apartment needs a little updating but perfect for a few, perfectly placed, days in Madrid.

Domingo's place is in a fabulous location. Easy to get anywhere in Madrid and get food. Things to note: The apartment layout means that one bedroom is a thoroughfare to others. Floors are creaky - not great if you're getting up for children during the night.
It’s a great and beautiful place, excellent location. A lot of restaurants and bars. Hosts were very welcome and nice.

It was a great experience
DOmingo and his wife were extremely helpful
They opened the apartment a 630 am
First time a host was so kind and woke up so early to receive us
The apartment was ver big , clean , quiet but centric
It had everything we needed. It was like living in your own house
The neighbourhood was fantástic
We walked everywhere
Excellent experience
We are going back
We highly recommend this apartment
Wonderful communication, very easy and flexible check in. We were 4 adults and 2 teenage boys and had lots of room in this beautiful apartment. The location is the best!.

This apartment is perfect.  It's roomy and clean and very Spanish but best of all it's in the best area ever.  Everything on your door step but unbelievably quiet inside the apartment.  All of the city is very walkable and plenty of restaurants etc on your doorstep.  To get the most out of the city purchase a 2 day hop on/off tour bus ticket it's such a great way to get a good feel of the whole area.  Fabulous holiday
I definitely recommend to stay at Domingo's place ! Warm welcome, nice tips to enjoy the stay and the places in the neighbourhood, a flat clean and well equiped ! Do not miss it!
The flat is comfortable and in a great location to see Madrid. Domingo is a very responsive host.

The location of the apartments, the conveniences in them, the opportunity to live in the past thanks to the things that are present in them, Domingo and his wife, who are always ready to help, maked our stay in Madrid unforgettable
During our stay we felt like we are at home. Domingo and Carmen are very nice and kind persons) The apartment is clear and cozy. Our stay was great!

Our group had a wonderful time staying at Domingo's apartment! The apartments location is perfect, you can easily walk to many places to eat, shop or explore Madrid. Domingo was a wonderful host, helped us check in early, provided maps and recommendations for the area and made sure we had everything we needed to enjoy our stay. Would stay here again next time I am in Madrid!
This is a wonderful location and Domingo and Mari-Carmen were lovely hosts! We found the apartment to be large for a European flat and perfect for our family of 5.

Domingo is a wonderful host. The apartament is very well located. It is perfect for a family.
Everything works, except the wi fi inside bedroons.
We loved Madri and the apartment.

Domingo treated us very well. He was always available when needed.  The location is fantastic...in the heart of everything. So many food choices within a few minutes walk.  We would stay here again no problem.

The accommodation was perfect. The place is huge, with amazing decoration and not too warm for the summer. I was hesitant at first because it did not have airco but the place was very fresh inside. The communication with the hosts was excellent and they were very helpful and warm. Lastly, the location could not be better. It is one of the best (or the best!) parts of Madrid. We would love to return!
This Airbnb is homey and charming. In a great part of the city that is walkable to every thing. The owners are very nice as well. We will definitely stay here again.
Great location, lots of character, very cozy… I wouldn’t recommend for smaller children as the neighbor below complained about our kids. We had 6 kids and think that was too much for the neighbors.

The flat is stunning and really centrally located! Domingo was a fantastic host, super communicative and everything was very smooth. Would recommend this flat for anyone looking to be in the centre of Madrid in a lovely flat.

Domingo was amazing, very helpful, and communicative the whole time, with great tips and recommendations around the apartment and Madrid.  The location of their apartment is perfect, close to El Prado, El Retiro, Plaza Mayor, and the train station, and it even has a market right across from the front door where you can get last-minute groceries.

I wish we could give more than five stars for this apartment. Domingo and MariCarmen were incredibly friendly. They met us at the door to show us around the apartment, and they gave us a homemade map with various recommendations for places to eat in the neighborhood. They really cared about making us feel at home. The apartment is not one of those antiseptic, un-lived-in places that feels like a hotel. It is a home with books, art, and eclectic furniture, as well as beautiful balconies overlooking the street. Our kids loved it!
The apartment is in a wonderful neighborhood that is just a few minutes walk to art museums, Plaza, Mayor, restaurants, buses, the metro,…everything. It was the perfect spot.
The apartment was very nice and charming. Location was excellent! Domingo and MariCarmen were very friendly and it was easy to communicate with them. We can highly recommend this apartment!

Domingo and MariCarmen were wonderful hosts. Very communicative and helpful. The location is amazing, right in the heart of tons of restaurants and next to Retiro with easy access to el centro. Would definitely stay again.

Domingo and his wife met us at the apartment and gave us a quick little tour. They are very nice and friendly. The apartment is very spacious and has a nice kitchen, dining room, and living room area. The location is really nice as well.
Madrid is very hot in August, though. I think the next time we go to Spain, it will be not be in summer!

Domingo and MariCarmen are great hosts. They are flexible and friendly, and they shared a lot of good recommendations with us. The apartment is at a central location, close to major attractions in Madrid. We walked everywhere except Toledo and Santiago Bernabeu. It was a pleasant stay overall, and we believe we have experienced Madrid to its fullest this time.
An incredibly charming and great place for the family to branch out and see Madrid. Perfect location and convenient to shops, bars and restaurants. Thanks, Domingo, for letting us stay at your place.
Very artsy, roomy, and convenient apartment. Central location.  Very responsive host. We really enjoyed our stay in their apartment and would highly recommend.

Absolutely fantastic, authentic, cosy apartment in a perfect location.  Wonderfully friendly and helpful hosts. We had a magnificent time in Madrid and this outstanding apartment was a big part of it.  Easy walk to anywhere we needed to go.  Highly highly recommend it.  Hopefully we will return again soon.

Such lovely hosts - so welcoming & helpful. Fantastic location in the centre of Madrid so easy to walk to attractions & an abundance of restaurants. Very comfortable for our family of 5. Would easily stay here again if we returned to Madrid.

We stayed at this lovely apartment for 3 nights with 5 adults. We had plenty of space and there is every amenity you need for your stay in a great location in the city centre.
The hosts were very welcoming, accommodating and very helpful to us which we really appreciated.
Domingos place is so well located absolute walking distance to main attractions such as plaza mayor prado museum etc.

Domingo stayed in contact with us the whole time and even arranged our taxi for departure.  The apartment was very authentically Spanish, which is what we were wanting.  The lack of air conditioner was not a problem, due to the cross breeze and the many fans.  Street noise was a bit of an issue, with a bar nearby, but easily solved with ear plugs.  The stairs are no joke, though, for this overweight near-60 woman!  All in all, great experience!

Look no further, this place has all you need:
-Excellent location (less than 10 minutes walk to Prado, Thyssen and Reina Sofia museums, in the middle of funky, cosy and charming Huertas neighborhood).
-Comfortable apartment, with all equipment needed.
-Very nice and truly reliable host.
This is all you need to make your stay in Madrid a perfect experience! Thank you for everything Miguel!

This apartment was excellent for our stay. It was clean, in a perfect location, safe and the directions from the airport made Metro travel super easy. I would recommend this apartment to any couple travelling to Madrid. Miguel was extremely helpful and checked to make sure we had everything we needed.

Apartment is very well equipped, and was a perfect location near Prado and Sofia. Little pub right next door for tapas and a pint. Grocer very close too. Miguel was most helpful and patient.  It's small, but very clean, nice sheets and comfortable beds (loft for the agile). Would definitely recommend!

Miguel is a fantastic host. After greeting us at his fantastic apartment he took time out to help us plan our itinerary and mark up a map with all the must see places in Madrid. The apartment was also fantastic..well equiped, comfortable and a great location.

The apartment is just the same as the pictures. It is small but very cozy and convenient. All the major spots are in walking distance. Less than five minutes walk to Anton Martin metro and ten minutes walk to Atocha Renfe. Furthermore, Miguel is very nice. He waited for us for check-in until 11:40pm due to our late flight, which is really appreciated. Will definitely stay here again.
Nice accommodations in great location! Everything reachable by foot. Miguel is a great and helpful host and I would recommend the place!
Miguel was great at communication & very friendly. The apartment was clean & a great location. Easy walk to everything.

The apartment is very close to the Prado and downtown, a good place to visit for a few days if you plan to be out for most of the time. The apartment was a bit smaller than my boyfriend and I were anticipating and it was not the most inviting. It is an okay value for the money and is close to public transit.
Good location, Miguel stayed in contact with us all the time. Shower is a little bit small but besides that everything was good. Thanks Miguel.
Great area and location, the flat is also very quiet for something in the centre. I found the place lacking in natural light, but that’s a personal preference, and a little smaller than expected.

No Ac No Ac No Ac,lower price and lower experience.
Firstly,the apartment is clean,and nice location.
Secondly,I didn’t know there is no Ac before i checked in.later,i reconfirmed that there was no Ac written on Airbnb,so I took some responsibilities.however,when I was unable to check in because it was too hot and told the house owner that I need to checkout in advance and refund part of the room fee which I will not live in,the house owner refused to refund the last day’s fee with a summer discount.
Thirdly,communicate with the house owner ,unless the phone call,the message replying is too slowly

very nice, unbeatable location.  kitchen was nice and the combo washer dryer was a plus.  Migel was very communicative so when we had an issue with the bed being uncomfortable, he offered to get a new one.  Great restaurants everywhere, and super close to the train station and metro.  biggest complaint - the bathroom had trouble venting which ended up smelling pretty bad and spreading to the kitchen area.
Miguel was super helpful with instructions on how to get in and get to the airport! They let us drop our stuff early which was super nice!
place is well onnected, in the center, decent size to spend a few days, be aware of the lack of the windows, the neighborhood is quite chill

Everything during my stay at Miguel's was great. The apartment is really good located, very close both to the museums and the city center in a walking distance. Moreover, Miguel was really kind and helpful as host. I strgonly suggest his place for someone to stay

Miguel's flat was in a fantastic location.
The apartment is looking very tired with shower door difficult to open or close. No lights in entrance or front door so black when coming up stairs. No elevator for 2,ND floor flat and a/c can't use. We didn't need a/c but would be hot in Summer.
Miguel was great to communicate with and we enjoyed our stay.

Great apartment. I spent a week there, and it was perfect. Exactly as described-- clean, well-located small but completely well-appointed. I really enjoyed the neighborhood too-- it is very convenient, with lots of shops and restaurants.

I have stayed at Ignacio's place from August 2023 to end of July 2024. Ignacio is a great host, responsive and informative. His apartment is charming with nice view, air conditioning and it is furnished with everything that someone might need.  Building has elevator and is located in a very nice area with plenty of small restaurants and stores. Check in was easy and apartment was spotless. I warmly recommend Ignacio's place for either short or long term rental.

Had an amazing time! Perfect location in the center of Madrid and yet, at night you did not hear the noise from outside. Ruben was amazing from start to finish, very attentive and easy to communicate with. The place was clean, had everything necessary to enjoy my time. Definitely recommend staying there!

I wholeheartedly recommend Óscar's place. It is comfy and clean. The apartment is in a killer location - tons of shops and nightlife within a few blocks. Óscar was an incredibly warm gracious host. He was eager to ensure that all of our needs were met and even had a friend come with him to help translate the apartment introduction.

Very nice and functional flat ! Clean, quiet and air-conditioned. Downtown, from there, you can reach any area in Madrid !! Two steps from mercado san miguel, plaza del sol, la latna... Best place for tourists like us !!!
Furthermore, Rut & Oscar are the perfect guests ! Welcomed with a great smile, soda & water (by 38°C, it was more than fine), they were kind, caring. and reactive for each of our request !
Spent 2 nights here this week. Was in Madrid for work. Great location, Oscar was very helpful. Would stay here again.
Nice people, very helpsome, no problems. Even cool coke in the freezer, definitely recommended.

Cute little apartment right in the heart of Madrid. Clean and well-organized. Perfect for a stay when you spend most of your time exploring the city. The hosts are very kind and provides valuable information.

Very cute place in the BEST location possible.  Small and LOTS of stairs, if you have heavy luggage or weak legs it could be a problem.  We had a great experience and they left us cookies and coffee.  Thank you!!!

Best location in Madrid!  My adult daughter and I were delighted with our stay in this tiny apartment with exceptional decor.  As other guests have noted, there are several flights of stairs.  But the advantages more than compensate for this inconvenience.

The apartment was very cute and modern and great for a small intimate group friends that are traveling. It's close by to many of the attractions, clubs, plazas and shops. You're right in the middle of the hustle and bustle! The metro is very easy to get to and the attractions were very close by. The area is pretty safe and the hosts were extremely nice and accommodating! They gave us many recommendations on must see sites and some restaurants that are popular among locals since my friends and I didn't want to just go venture around the tourist sites. All their recommendations were great!

Only con is that the apartment is on the last floor and there are no elevators so if you plan on carrying light during your travel, you're good to go! But I highly recommend staying here, if I ever go back I would return to this apartment!

Madrid was a fabulous experience, most especially because of the location of Rut and Oscar's apartment. Both Rut and Oscar were excellent communicators, easy to get in touch with and very quick to respond. They even provided a little breakfast with fruit and chocolate milk powder and coffee. Very sweet of them.
We needed a hair dryer, they got it to us right away. The location is so perfect, walking distance to metro, shopping, Plaza Mayor, and a really fancy market. The apartment is perfect for four people, any bigger it'd be a little too cozy.

I would definitely use their place again :)

One thing to note is that there are no elevators...pack lightly.

The apartment was very nice and clean, as well as modern, both in style and recency.  Amenities were all great, and Oscar left snacks and offered us may recommendations for things to do in madrid.  Would definitely recommend his apartment to anyone looking to stay in a fantastically-located spot in the city, on a budget or otherwise.

Thank u for a really nice and perfect stay at your place! I would strongly recommand Osacrs home to everyone, the apartment is located in the centre of the city, Oscar and his nice wife are really helpful and warm people! They know the city well and give u all sort of informations! The apartment was absolutely lovable and clean! Only if u have troubles to manage getting up 4 floors without elevator the apartment would not be the one u should rent. Definitly would stay here again! best regards, eva, norbert + christina

We had a really nice stay at Rut's and Oscar's apartment in the middle of Madrid. Perfect location, modern interior design and no problems at all receiving and delivering the keys. We would defiantly recommend this apartment - unless you don't want to climb up to the fifth floor. Lovely place!
Very nice little place! Easy to get in touch with the hosts, and they were very helpful in getting to know the local area and what to see and do.

Great location, great hosts, and great apartment with just enough space you need, especially if you are going to be out and enjoying Madrid.  Rut and Oscar were great hosts.  Between our limited Spanish and their limited English - we did just fine!

Staying at Ruth and Oscars was really great.  The apartment was 1/2 a block from the Plaza Mayor but quiet and comfortable.  They were great hosts, very easy to reach with questions etc which helped make us feel at home quickly.  Was nice to have a few basics (like coffee) waiting for us in the apartment too!

We were able to check in and start our adventure thanks to Rut and Oscar. Rut was incredibly nice and helpful and it was great knowing that because she lived right next door, if we needed anything she would be able to help out. She was so sweet that she even provided simple
Breakfast foods for the following morning which proved to be wonderful!
The place was incredibly clean, and we loved it, it was so easy to feel comfortable on the apartment because it was kept to such high standards. Definitely recommend it!

The apartment is perfectly located in the heart of Madrid, few steps away from Plaza Mayor and Mercado de San Miguel. Everything worth visiting is in walking distance.
The place was exactly as advertised: cozy, confortable, clean...a very nice and recently remodeled apartment.
Rut y Oscar were fantastic hosts and they're very friendly: they live next door so it is very easy to contact them (even to ask Rut to lend us her hair -drier!). Furthermore there were water, apples, and cookies when we arrived.
An absolutely perfect location for a wonderful trip. I totally recommend this place!
Thank you Rut y Oscar! :)
Amazing location, steps from Plaza Mayor. Our hosts were very welcoming even though we came late. The apartment was spotless and fit our needs exactly (there were four of us). Would recommend!
Rut is a very good person, I really liked the apartment. clean and very good location, close to all attractions on foot can visit Madrid. recommended.

Hosts were kind and very accommodating. They were easy to communicate with and responded quickly to our requests. The apartment was in a very central location, and was very clean. The apartment can comfortably sleep 5-6 people.

The house is perfect and the hosts are very kind and they like to give suggestions about Madrid! The flat is how it appears in pictures, small but very very nice and very very clean!!!!Good job Rut and Oscar..see you next time in Madrid! :)
Great little apartment and in a fantastic location. It was easy to find. The space is small but very well used and friendly. It is on 5th floor and no elevator. I loved it
We were greeted warmly and shown the apartment, which was exactly as illustrated.  Great shower and clean and abundant linens.  Location could not have been better.
Nice modern flat right in the center of Madrid, 5 minute walk from the palace and right next to all the great restaurants.

Location, location and location
We were within walking distance to everything, cafés , food markets, plaza's and shops. Stayed there with my two teenagers, for five nights end of October , we really only used the apartment to sleep and freshen up , Rut Y Oscar very kindly kept our luggage for few hours cause we arrived early the first day and had a lovely little welcome basket of food for us. Yes, there is 100 steps plus to climb but no real hassle because there was always a comfortable bed or good shower to greet us so don't get too worried about staying on the fifth floor.

The apartment is in the fifth floor but do not have lift, which is the only inconvenience. Beside this it is a really nice apartment. It's clean, quiet and in a really good location, easy access to food, attractions and tube station. The neighbor is nice too!
Beautiful apartment, beautiful location. Perfect for my 3 friends and I's trip to Madrid. Rut and Oscar were super helpful and friendly, I would stay here again in a heartbeat.
Our host was very friendly. She allowed us to store our luggage in her apartment until check in time. The place was spotless. Location could not be better!

Everything as described!
Communication before and during stay was easy.
Not the biggest apartment and at the 5th floor with no elevators, but location is perfect, right beside Mercado de San Miguel.
Highly recommended.

Rut was a wonderful host.  The flat was perfect for 5 ladies.  The accommodations were lovely and it was a nice, quiet building.  We loved the neighbourhood.  Being across the street from the San Miguel  market was AMAZING!  We were able to walk everywhere we wanted to see.  I would definitely recommend staying at Rut and Oscar's flat while in Madrid.

This was the 2nd time in 'Sol. Your home in Madrid´s Heart.' Also this time it was great. This is the best place to visit madrid. Rut and Oscar are very nice and helpful and the apartment is clean and fully equipped.
I will definitely go back!

We had a blast in Madrid, the apartment was exactly like the description .
But most important, the location was excellent .
Gracias Rut y Oscar...
I that this is a great place to stay. Just make sure to recongize that there isn't a lift and it's on the 5th floor.

Great little apartment in a wonderful location. My family of four were very comfortable in Rut Y Óscars apartment for the four days we were in Madrid. We were able to walk to some great restaurants, catch the Metro with ease and visit the market across the road for fresh food and tasty tapas.

Great place at great location, very central close to metro. Rut was very attentive and available. Be prepared if you have luggage as it's in the 5th floor  with no elevator. Thank you Rut for your hospitality!

Great location right next to Plaza Mayor and plenty of space for my family to be comfortable. Oscar was a great host and it was very helpful how his apartment was right next door if we had any questions.

Very nice place; great location, spotlessly clean, air conditioning managed the 104+ F temperatures. As others note, be prepared for the climb to the 5th floor. It's close quarters  for 5 people--but all worked out fine, and hosts made connections easy.

Rut was a fantastic host, great friendly communication. The apartment, was clean, comfortable, and very cleverly designed. Very well equipped, we did cook once and found everything in great order.
The apartment is very central so perfect for sightseeing, but also quiet enough to relax. Thank you for being a wonderful host! Highly recommend.

Oscar's apartment was a lovely space! The only downside was the stairs on the way up to the apartment especially with luggage. Other than that, Oscar was easy to communicate with and the apartment was in a great location, very clean and updated!

This is absolute best location you could ask for in Madrid. Fits 4 people comfortably and is very clean. Great shower. AC decent. It is right next to Plaza Mayor and Mercado di San Miguel. Host is extremely responsive and flexible! We had a really great stay would highly recommend.
Very clean and well hosted space located in Madrid’s central area near great restaurants and historic buildings and parks.
If you are staying in Madrid stay here! Perfect location and a great apartment with all the necessities.
Great Hosts! Loved the coffee, wasn’t sure how to use the HVAC but that was our only issue. So clean, perfect location and really nice hosts!

The apartment was nice, quite small but was a perfectly sufficient home base for our stay in Madrid. The hot water can be an issue for 4 people showering but if you keep showers brief, you’ll be all set! Thanks Rut and Oscar!

Beautiful place in the heart of Madrid. The location is super convenient, and the house is really cute. Rut came to great us, gave us some good tips on where to go and left us coffee, fruits and tea. We really enjoyed our stay. Thank you!
Apartment is in a superb location, can’t be bettered. It is quite small however, much smaller than the photos suggest. There were 4 of us and it was very tight, would maybe come back as a couple.

We had a wonderful time I’m
Madrid. The apartment is small, but for a family of 5 had everything we needed and is located in the best area of Madrid. It’s quiet but in walking distance to a lot of the nice places in Madrid. I would highly recommend staying there!

Me and 2 of my sisters went for holiday in Madrid for 3 days. Rut greeted us when we arrived. She is a warm and friendly person. The apartment is same as advertised. Location was perfect.. the best place to stay if you want to see Madrid tourist attractions. We really enjoyed staying there.
Rut and Oscar were very accommodating to my friends and quick to respond to any questions I had! Very cute place and good location too.

Super clean, quaint and practical mini-flat.  Outstanding location as well. Oscar was very helpful and very nice to chat with as we checked in and would definitely stay here again and strongly recommend to anybody visiting Madrid. Thank you, Oscar!

Oscar's apartment is in a great location right next to Plaza Mayor and 5 minutes walk to Puerta de Sol.  It's also a manageable walking distance between the Prado and the Royal Palace.  The apartment is equipped with a small lift which is an absolute necessity given its location on the 7th floor. This is a great budget option, especially for a small family or group of 4 or less. It's small and efficient but manages to make use of all of its limited space. We didn't use the stove, but the washing machine in the bathroom was great for last minute laundry needs. And there's a clothesline out the bathroom window.  It's nice and quiet too, at least it was during our brief stay. The apartment isn't fancy, but if you're looking for a clean, efficient place with a great location at a budget price, this apartment is a nice option. We enjoyed our stay.

This airbnb was very clean and well-located. We were 3 people staying there and we had enough room. Also, they put kitchen utensils, soap and shampoo, towels and bed sheets that we can use which is very nice.
We had a great stay and we will definitely use this airbnb again if we go back to Madrid.
Excellent apartment, the best location and host! I would recommend to stay with your family, we had a great time!!
The location is really great, it was clean and nice, though we did have some problems with the ladder for the upper bunk.
Oscar was very helpful, despite the difficulties we faced during our arrival. The accommodation was amazing and centered in the heart of Madrid. Everything was perfectamente. thank you!
this space is in a perfect location. it was very clean and makes great use of a small space. highly recommend!!

Apartment located in the center of Madrid, in a walking distance of everything. The location was perfect!
The apartment is clean with everything you need for a stay in the city.
The hosts are very nice and we really apreciate the information about the restaurants and cafés to taste the best "tapas", that they explained to us at check-in!
I would recommend it to everyone!

We enjoyed our stay here. The best feature of this apartment is location, for sure. Other details that made us happy: nespresso machine with capsules, easy check in and check out, and plenty of shower gel/shampoo. Suggestions for improvement: adding air conditioners to the bedrooms and doing some touch ups (paint, silicon) around the apartment to make it look newer.

Great location, room slightly small for 4 people but not an issue for our short 3 night stay.
Only not given 5 stars as shower went cold quite quickly and ladder to top bunk bed wasn’t secured and wobbled around quite a lot when going up, I would definitely recommend staying here though.
Thanks Óscar, great host!

Ideal location for first time Madrid visitors. It was the perfect amount of space for my two friends and I, and had everything we needed. Beds were comfy, and shower is a rain shower. Thank you Óscar, i will recommend to friends!
Oscar was very kind and attentive. Right in the center of Madrid so lots to do around there. Will definitely try to stay here if I return.
Fantastic apartment in the heart of Sol! We loved the apartment and the neighborhood. Had absolutely everything we needed, and how gracious the hosts were. Thank you! We hope to visit again.
Comfortable stay in great location. Apartment felt homely with plenty of space for the three of us. Walkable to all the main tourist sites and close to the metro, but still quiet.
Rut was very responsive and kind to be flexible about our check in time. The space was just what we needed for a couple days in Madrid.

Oscar and Rut communicated with us before and throughout our stay and answered any questions. The home was centrally located with all the amenities we needed in addition to basic items such as complimentary coffee and tea to get through our mornings. The kids loved it and we plan to come back and stay again. Thank you!
Rut was a great host! The apartment was very clean and had everything we needed. It was in a great location with lots of places to eat at. Would highly recommend!

Lovely place in the heart of Madrid. You won’t be bored with lots to do around you. You come back to a little peaceful apartment that has all you need. The host is very responsive and helpful recommendations. helpful books “Madrid” and “Spain” were a nice touch to introduce you to the area with lots of suggestions. Main bed is a bit high if you have mobility problems, it wasn’t a problem for us. Highly recommend.
The place was great. Rut was very good with customer service and the value for the location was fantastic.

Perfect location, very central. The apartment was small however it was perfect as a base, fitted 2 adults, 1 teen & child and had everything we needed for our stay.
Lots of stairs to the apartment however small lift for luggage and 1 person if needed.
Rut Y Oscar was very responsive when I messaged about a couple of things - check in etc.

The location of the airbnb is summed into one word: epic. It was a walking distance to all the places you must see while in Madrid. The beds were cozy. The space was cute and functional for us to rest, do some office work and get ready to explore the city.
Right in the heart of Madrid, right beside major attractions yet quiet at night. Truly a gem!

Very convenient location to explore Madrid. Close to palace, market, plaza mayor, temple Debi’s, Malasana and Granvia.
It’s good for two people to stay in the center of the city. It’s congested for 4 people to stay. Rut responses in a timely manner. Over all we like the place for the location and accessibility to the city. I would highly recommend this place.

Great location and excellent host.
Apartment is located in the center of Madrid, good restaurants around and very clean property.

This place was great! If you don't mind getting off and on the trains to go to the center, it is just perfect. It's only about ten minutes to the center so it's super close and convenient. The pictures are just what they look like as well. The apartment is perfect and the area is safe. It's in a very quiet building and community and just about everything that you need is in this small little town.

Elena really is a great host. She made me feel very welcome and was very informative on so many things. Anything that I needed help with she was very helpful. She helped with the arrival and departure of my stay and I would definitely come back to this place!

This is a beautiful apartment away from the hustle and bustle of the centre but has bus stops and a train station right on it's doorstep for easy access to the city. We were staying primarily to go to the Download festival which was a 40 minute walk from the apartment so quite well situated. The best thing about the apartment is the terrace which gets the sun all day. Everything you could need is provided and there are 2 really good supermarkets just 5 minutes from the property. Elena and her mum also provide lots of useful information about Madrid and getting around. I would not hesitate to recommend a stay here and hope to return.

Lovely, clean apartment with everything you need. Ideal location for getting to centre of Madrid, just two stops away from Atocha with the station right across the road.
We will definitely stay here again and would highly recommend Elena and Luisa as perfect hosts.
Thanks again !

Elena's place is cozy and nicely decorated. It made us feel like we were staying in a close friend's house.  The building is safe and also very clean, close to supermarkets. The location is conveniently located, a block from Puente Alcocer train station that will take us to Atocha station, close to the main attractions in Madrid.

Definitely a great place to stay—very cozy and tranquil, and very close to the train station. Elena was very friendly and helpful from before my arrival through my stay, providing many instructions on how to use things around the house and offering recommendations for restaurants, clubs, etc. She even went as far as letting guests borrow train and metro cards. It was definitely worth the money. I enjoyed my stay and would definitely book again when I come back to Madrid.

We had a lovely week in Elena's place. Elena was waiting to greet us when we got to the apartment and showed us everything we needed to know. Everything was as described in the listing. The apartment has plenty of space and the outside terrace is a great are to chill out on. The travel into Madrid centre is very easy, with the train station just across the road or a bus stop just by the apartment block. There are a few Gastro Bars nearby, we went to a couple of them. There are a few supermarkets near as well. I would definitely recommend Elena's apartment to others and we would definitely stay there again.
A luxurious flat in Madrid's heart. Marga made everything super easy and we really enjoyed our stay there. Highly recommended!!

We had a wonderful stay at the GOYA Boutique Suite. The apartment is beautifully decorated, clean, comfortable and right in the centre of Madrid. We would recommend both the apartment and Marga's hospitality to everyone. Marga was so very helpful and went out of her way to make our stay perfect. Nothing was too much trouble for her. It you want a great stay in a wonderful city then dont look any further than here. Thank you Marga for everything , it was a pleasure meeting you and we hope we will return some day.
Caroline and Carlo

Great experience, the location is superb, you are right in the center of the city with easy access to everything. The flat is beautiful, with very nice details and the hosts were super nice and helpful. I would recommend and I would stay there again.

Marga had her assistant Alicia meet us at the apartment for check in. The apartment was as advertised with a fantastic location in the heart of Sol. Marga was also very helpful in extending our check out time and working with us to store our luggage since we weren't catching a train until later in the day after our check out.

The Goya appartement was a great place for a trip to madrid. Its has the best location you can imagine and marga was a very helpfull and welcoming host. The appartement is spacious and tastefully decorated. Would definately come back next time we come to madrid
Very nice location and beautiful decoration. Exactly in the centre of this city and 1 min to the plaza. I put some beautiful flowers in the vase, hope both Marga and next guest like them.

The apartment was very clean and lovely! Since the apartment is perfectly located it was a bit noisy during the Night.
Even though we would definitely rebook the apartment when travelling to Madrid again!
Superfast communication.

Loved our stay in madrid! apartment was accurately displayed in the pictures. Host's assistant was on time waiting for us when we arrived and made us feel welcome. Apartment was clean and considering how busy the area it is, noise was not an issue. This was our first air bnb experience and we would definitely stay here again.

We were greeted by Daniel who helped us locate the apartment.  The location is great!  Centrally located to everything you could possibly need.  The apartment is on a busy street, but noise was not an issue at night.  We found the apartment very comfortable and clean.  I would highly recommend anyone to stay at the Goya Suite apartment!

Well decorated apartment with in the heart of the city, perfect location to get around the city by subway (Sol stop). The apartment is on a busy shopping street, but it's very quiet indoors when the windows are closed. Aircon is nice 2 units, one in the living and one in the bedroom.
Kitchen is pretty much fully stocked with equipment, but no herbs or oil (nobody lives in the apartment, its only used for Airbnb) its not a practical kitchen (sink is in a corner next to the fridge) but good enough to cook a simple meal.
I would definitely recommend it to anyone travelling as a couple or solo, and will go back next time I visit!

What a wonderful stay at a beautiful suite. The apartment was easy to find and conveniently located. Communication with Marga and her assistant was fast, friendly and informative. I definitely felt very welcome. The apartment was clean, comfortable and most definitely the nicest place I stayed during my travel through Europe.

Our apartment on Calle Montero was in a great location and very clean and comfortable. Really in the heard of the city with great light. Dani was not particularily helpful in finding our way or at the apartment - seemed to be in a rush but that was not really important to us. We soon got acclimated and found our way around town.

We spent a very nice stay at Marga's flat, it was very well situated and very clean. Daniel was very nice and he perfectly explained us how everything worked.
We really recommend the flat.
Muchas gracias!

Dani met us exactly on time and was very charming.  The apartment was immaculate, beautifully furnished and very comfortable.  It was equipped with everything that we needed.  It was our first time in Madrid and we were delighted with the location.  We walked everywhere and often popped back to the apartment during the day as it often seemed to be on route to our next stop.

The apartment was in a central location and close to many attractions, making it easy to view by foot. It was also extremely close to the metro, making trips further out quite simple. Beautiful apartment and decor. Highly recommend and I would stay again. Our only issue was with the locks, it was sometimes hard to open the doors.

Great location! Loved Marga's place - cute furniture and balconies that open onto the street. The front entrance was sometimes tough to open/turn key --- feared we might not get in one night but finally got it to work!
All and all it was a great find in Madrid and we would definitely say again :-)

Goya suite is located in the heart of the city. The apartment was clean and nicely designed. The host was helpful and available. The area was noisy at night but the wooden shutters helped us a lot. We enjoyed our stay.

What a wonderful find. The apartment was perfect and the location couldn't be better. You're in the heart of it all. Felt very safe in the area and in the apartment. The host Marga is a great person and very welcoming. You won't go wrong booking this location. Thanks Marga for a great stay.
Paul and Ketty

Beautiful apartment in the best part of Madrid.  Large beautiful windows, nice light, exquisitely decorated!  Perfect for a few days in Madrid.  Beds comfortable,  linens nice.  Kitchen is small but fine for small things.  We loved it!

Perfect location - the best you can imagine. Very nice apartment, and nice people. The two only issues were - the bed is rather small (we are used to a bigger one) and it was kind of cold in the apartment. There were gaps in the windows (not hermetically closed) and there was no radiator, only a small air conditioner which is not 100 % satisfies the whole apartment space. We asked for a radiator and were promised to have one, but they never brought us one. Finally the only solution was to leave the air conditioner on the whole day long, that's how the apartment was warm enough. Other than that - great place.

Excellent location, clean apartment, very responsive host, beautifully decorated. Streets near apartment are very lively with noise from city life but we still managed to sleep without a problem. Would highly recommend to anyone visiting Madrid.
Marga's place is perfectly located, spacious, and extremely clean. The bed was comfortable. As others have mentioned the street outside the apartment can be extremely noisy late into the night.

Perfect location and lovely apartment! You can walk to everything. The area is very lively, so the outside noise is loud but we knew this at the time of booking the apartment. The metro is very close and it is very easy to catch a taxi cab. I definitely would recommend staying here and would not hesitate to stay here again if I return to Madrid.

A beautiful apartment in a wonderful central position. Walking distance to so many interesting sights & surrounded by great places to eat. Balcony was excellent for people-watching, always something to see. Great sound & light insulation for nights.

Marga did an amazing job keeping in touch and made sure we had everything we needed to get to her place. Her place is centrally located and extremely easy to get to as well as in walking distance to so many amazing places!
Perfectly situated just a quick walk from Sol station.  Beautiful apartment with lovely balconies. Definitely occasionally loud late night during the weekend, but earplugs helped.
Highly recommended. Great location, good communication, and easy check in/out. Fairly small kitchen and the street can get noisy at night but ear plugs are provided.
Very comfortable and stylish space in a great location. Not a quiet street, but that's a small price to pay. You will love it!
Great place located in the heart of town and centrally located. Steps from the train station made it easy and convenient to get around!

Apartment is very good located near almost everything you need and visit. But in the other hand it is very noisy at night when you need to rest quietly. For everything else, it is a nice place to stay. I’ll consider returning to it in the future.
Nice place, shower handle was very loose and fell right off for first use, plastic shower curtain. Location on busy walking only street, sometimes loud on weekends

Marga’s flat is about as central as it gets, on a sunny corner that gets great light. There’s a lot of activity right outside, but the windows block the sound at night. It’s only a 15 minute walk to nearly every neighborhood in Madrid.

Goya apartment was fantastic! It is centrally located with everything you could need within walking distance. Marga did an outstanding job communicating with us from the moment we booked, and the check in process was a breeze. We were met at the front door and shown up to the apartment.
Even though the apartment is on the 3rd floor of the building, there’s a small lift to take you and your bags up. The apartment itself was clean, well decorated, and perfect for my girlfriend and me. The highlight was the balconies that overlooked the street below. Loved seeing the hustle and bustle of the city without being in the middle of it.
Thank you Marga for being a wonderful host! We’ll definitely stay again the next time we’re in Madrid.

Great, clean apt and building with elevator. Great communication with host and Natalie, our greeter at the apt was so friendly and helpful! Great location on a pedestrian street. That said, it’s a bit noisy til late at night even with the metal exterior shutters, windows, and wood interior shutters closed. Thought I’d let you light sleepers know.

Marga- your apartment was delightful - decorated very classy- location was perfect - liked having coffee shop a few doors down - washer was a blessing - elevator much appreciated- balconies were delightful- close up windows and sounds gone!!! Thank you..

Great apartment in great location! The apartment is very cozy looking over  busy street of shops and restaurants. We had no issues with noise but ear plugs were provided just in case. Communication was great and owner was very helpful with information.

A nice, comfortable and convenient place on the middle of shopping alley. Marga the host is very responsive, we had her assistant Helena waiting for our arrival at the apartment to show us the place. The apartment itself is clean and trendy. We had a great stay.

Fantastic location, great communication with host and smooth check-in/-out. Everything was as stated in the listing. It is perfect for a short stay. For a longer stay, as it was quite expensive, I'll be a bit fussy: the furniture was hit-or-miss: beautiful antique furniture mixed with an uncomfortable sofa and wobbly dinner table (I used it as a writing desk so the wobbling was quite distracting) and cheap, noisy modern flooring. Wifi was sometimes weak.
Don't let that put you off if you mostly want this place for the location though. For that, it's practically unbeatable, literally a minute's walk to Puerta del Sol. You'll stay for hours watching the people walk by from the balcony or winter garden!

We spent 4 days in Madrid, staying at this apartment. Great and convenient location to navigate around the city, just a little bit noisy since it is on a busy street. Great communication channel with the host. Bright, a lot of windows to open and let air flow.

We very much enjoyed staying at Marga’s apartment, “Goya”. Everything was as described. The location was fantastic and we were able to walk to most everything that interested us. Noise was not an issue, though Marga provided earplugs in the nightstands in case. Thanks, Marga!

I had an amazing experience staying at Marga’s place, the location was really unbeatable, and everything was as described, the apartment had everything I needed and ut was very easy to access, I couldn’t have asked for more, exited to be back soon!

Best place ever !!!
The apartment is a jewel if you're looking to stay in Madrid center.
I found it more spacious that the photos and really beautiful, personal touches and tastefull decoration.
Kitchen really well equipped and even we were in christmas and the street was always full the windows are soundproof and works really great, our 7 years old son slept with no issue.
Totally recommend it, Marga is an excellent host, responsive and ready to help.
Without any doubt, if you want to experience Madrid as a local, this is the place (I'm from Madrid so I know... )

Fantastic location in the middle of the city. The windows do a great job in blocking out the noise. The apartment is architecturally interesting and full of character. Definitely recommend staying here.

Great place! Location is excellent, right in the middle of 24hr activity. Plenty of space, AC works well. A bit difficult to get Into. Need a secondary app which took me a while to navigate to get in. Had a great stay, would be happy to go back.

I loved staying at Marga's apartment, it was very nice and perfectly located. Since I have to work from home for a few days, I struggled with the internet connection because sometimes it would go down for a few minutes and my remote connection would go down. But anyway, I liked the apartment and can definitely recommend it if you want to stay in the center of Madrid

Renan is amazing,I was taken by surprise with a nice
welcome to his place with a bottle of wine,some refreshments.
The flat is very comfortable I really could have a good
time in Madrid and relax in Renan´s place.
The flat is very central and we have all facilities to move
around the city.
I recommend .

My boyfriend and I loved this apartment! The location was perfect-- in a bustling neighborhood not far from the Gran Via. There were excellent restaurants nearby, and we were able to walk to the Prado. The apartment seemed new and was extremely clean and well equipped. The shower was great. Renan was very sweet and responsive, though he did not speak much English. I would highly recommend staying here, and will return if I visit Madrid again!

The apartment is clean, big, very comfortable and beautifully done. The location is good with Gran Vila a short 5 min walk away. So is the metro station.
Although we didn't see Renan he arranged for wine and put beer, soda and water in the fridge which was really nice. I would recommend this place for both a short or a long stay in Madrid.

very good appartment.. clean .. brand new and super central.. i think i took the metro just two times during my stay.. yo can easly walk to all the main attactions.. Renan was super helpful and for any issue after 5 minutes there was somebody to help.. and Renan is super cute! :) raccomended!

Very nice apartment! It is equipped with everything you need for a great stay. The location is great - right in the centre of Madrid!
It can be noisy but that didn't bother us at all as we just wanted to discover the city. We can definitely recommend to stay at Renan's place!

Really lovely place to stay, perfect location being only minutes from Gran via and therefore totally walkable for all the main attractions.  Great price, especially considering the location and how nicely the flat is done up. Nice details with the bottle of wine and cokes in the fridge as a welcome gift too. Would highly recommend to anyone coming to Madrid!

The best thing about Renan ' s apartment is the location. Very close and safe walk to Gran Via, as well as easy walk to Puerta del Sol (center of Madrid) and Plaza Mayor. The apartment has a great amount of space and was very cozy. They also provided a bottle of wine, some beers, and water. Beautiful place!
Beautiful apartment, exactly as advertised. We were so close to everything! Would definitely stay again.
I only stayed one night but the apartment was in a great location and the host was very friendly.
The apartment is in a fantastic area. On the same streets are some great tapas bars. The apartment was clean, well decorated and comfortable. We would certainly recommend it.

This flat was nice. The bed was very comfortable and the location was good as it was walking distance to a lot of things. We didn't spend much time in the flat itself though because we were out most of the day and only came back to sleep and then checked out in the morning.

Melvin y Mario were really sweet - they held on to our bags after check out because as we waited for our train that night.

A couple chocolates and bottle of wine upon arrival, too.

Muchas Gracias,
George
It's bigger than I thought. Very close to downtown area very convenient. It's very comfortable apartment . I will comeback if I'm visiting Madrid again

The apartment is great, looks exactly like the pics, though perhaps a little less spacious (as you might expect). Comfortable bed, great location, kind and attentive host. Easy process for checking in and out. Great experience.

We enjoyed our stay in Madrid. The room was smaller than expected (based off of the pictures) but it still had everything we needed. We met with Melvins friend who showed us to the apartment. Everything was clean and it was in a great location. The only thing that disappointed us was that the shower had a wonderful waterfall spout that didn't work...so you had to use a hand shower and it was very difficult for tall people. Also you can not throw anything (even toilet paper) down the toilet....so that was a little awkward.  And the toilet runs for a good ten minutes after flushing. These were just minor things but i would recommend this apartment for a short stay in Madrid.

The apartment was marvelous. Everything looks like in the pictures. The location was great, very central, with lots of restaurants and shops nearby. It was incredibly close to the Gran Vía, which is great!

Would book again.

The location was absolutely perfect, close to the Gran Via and lots of cool bars and restaurants. When we arrived, Melvin was not around but there was a nice gentlemen already there waiting for us. He didnt speak English but somehow we managed!
Thanks for having us in your lovely apartment.

The location was great it's right in downtown everything is supper close. Melvin and Carolina were great people. Carolina met me right as I arrived and walked me into the room and even gave me some pointers on places to visit. They left us a bottle of wine on the house. The pictures are exactly what it looks like. It's a cozy place everything you need is there. I would consider staying there again.

Superb neigbourhood. Nice appartment.

Also nice that they gave us some drinks when we arrived!

We also had some issues with the key but they fixed it after 30 minutes.

It was good days I spent in Madrid, in Melvins apartment.
Hope everyone who need to get romantic mood in Madrid will choose for stay Melvins apartment

The host was very nice and the apartment was definitely big and comfortable. Unfortunately, whoever had it before us seemed to totally wreck the bathroom and the apartment wasn't ready for us until later in the afternoon. We were staying in Madrid for only a weekend so this was extremely inconvenient for us. Since the apartment owner has 20+ other properties listed on Airbnb, we were hoping they could accommodate us a little better. Oh well. Overall, not a bad experience and the price is good.
Really nice place! Great location! Melvin was super helpful and understanding! They left us some wine and other beverages which was really nice! Recommend for sure!
Really nice host and very nice room !! Smaller than what pictures show, but very comfortable and with several drinks in fridage and Lots of clean towels and extra blanket and pillows

The flat was exactly as described on the listing, in a central location just off Gran Via. The apartment is close to many of the popular tourist areas of Madrid so we did not need to use the metro other than to get to/from the airport. Melvin was a good host, leaving a bottle of wine on the table for when we arrived.
The apartment was very nice and in a central location! Everything was clean and comfortable. I recommend it for all visitors!

Great location and great communication from the host! Easy to get keys! However thin walls so can hear the neighbors and not hot water in the shower some mornings/evening (must be connected to the other apartments). Overall great apartment with everything you need and reasonably priced! Would recommend.
Really cozy and comfortable apartment. Clean and well cared. Melvin was a great guest providing everything we needed! For sure we will come back!

Our check in was a breeze. I did not meet Melvin because of the time of our arrival was very late, but we have been communicating prior to our arrival. I did meet his colleague who was also very pleasant, helpful and gifted us with wine.
The apartment is exactly where you need to be. In the center of it all.
Melvin is a great host! Thank you for everything.
Great overall experience. Very happy that we were able to drop off bags prior to check-in time. Let us enjoy Madrid for as long as we could!

The good and the bad. The good: excellent customer service. Melvin and his team were fantastic, attentive, easily accessible. Location is in one of Madrid's best areas.
The bad. You cannot flush toilet paper down the toilet. The toilet is electric. We were not notified of this prior to booking. It would have changed our minds. Also, the photos are a bit misleading. They don't represent the true disrepair of the place.
Bottom line: good place for solo traveler. Bed small for two people, bad toilet, but great customer service in a great neighborhood with great bars and restaurants. If you are someone who normally stays in hostels and pensiones in Madrid, this is a step up. After traveling Spain for almost 20 years, this was a bit disappointing.

Great place. In the centre of almost everything. Melvin accommodates us for delayed check in. In-fact he was very helpful through the stay. Apartment is big and comfortable with all the necessary amenities. Really enjoyed our stay in Madrid. Highly recommended.

The location was amazing, very central to everything.
Overall the place was very clean and looked like the photos, however, the bathroom did not work properly (shower/toilet). The wifi barely worked, and the locks are super old so it was very hard to get in the front door of the building.
Melvin himself was great- very reliable and friendly and super quick to respond to messages.
Was comfortable for a one night stay, but longer would not have suited our needs/comfort level.
Clean place in the centre of a fantastic area. Maybe a little more "normal" than it looks on the photos but great apartment for a few days in Madrid. Melvin was super helpful!

The apartment was like in the pictures we have really nice staying there. All the communication was very efficient and the location was great. All in all good value for money. We recommend that place!

The apartment is nice size and tidy. It is also in a central location, however it is loud with noise from street and the neighbours, the electricity also continuously cut out and the wifi was slow. I would not recommend this place due to the electricity issue.

Lovely place to stay. The apartment was in a great location, was very clean and comfortable. Melvin was great at getting back to us very quickly. Would definitely recommend for a group of friends travelling to Madrid.
This is a great location and easy to find! The apartment is super and spacious! A home away from home!

Our stay at Melvin Enrique's apartment was great.  It is in an ideal location in the center of Madrid.  Melvin was very accommodating with our check-in and check-out.  If you arrive before check-in time Melvin will store your luggage in his office close to the apartment until you check-in.  All in all it was a great stay and I would recommend the apartment to anyone visiting Madrid.
Great value, great communication and a lovely host.  Much bigger than I expected.  Facilities and cleanliness were perfect.  Location couldn't be much better if you want to be central.
Great apartment and Melvin was very punctual. The location is perfect with lots of bars and restaurants nearby. Highly recommend.
Amazing location right in the heart of the city. So easy to get everywhere. Easy check in with great assistance in minding bags of you arrive early.

Overall the place was clean and quite big. We stayed 3 girls for 2 nights. However, the first night the power cut off which somehow caused the toilet to overflow (according to the owner). The real issue was with the responsiveness of the owner. After texting him about the issue, he said it was resolved and the mess was cleaned. However, it had not been cleaned what so ever. We texted the owner a few more times and he stated that he would be over to fix it but never came. Finally, we decided to call, and he finally came over to deal with the issue. It was quite an inconvenience.

me and three more friends stayed in this place. personally, i find it a bit too small for 4 ppl, i’d recommend it if you are a group of 3. everything was there when we arrived, the check-in went very smoothly, communication with the host was always fast, no complaints. the best thing about this airbnb was definitely the location. in less than 2min walking, you were in gran via!!

We loved our stay in Madrid! The location was top notch and we were able to make the most of our short stay. The apartment had everything necessary to enjoy our time.
Heather
Great location and the staff was extremely friendly and helpful. The room itself was quite beat up from previous guests and didn’t seem the cleanest.

great value for money
alberto was great with communication
and meeting his mother, she was lovely
Very nice apartment as described in the center of Madrid. Check-in was very simple, everything inside the apartment was clean when we arrived, the hosts were helpful and responsive.

We had a great time despite the thin of the walls, the difficulties with electric switches, hot water, elevator and noisy neighbors. Not exactly nice but well located to do tourism and walks. Safe, close to everything.
I would look for a different place in the same area.
Great location, nice space for 3 guests, sofa was really comfy. Bathroom did smell a little weird though

Great location where there is a lot to do and see as soon as you go outside! Really enjoyed the sound of all the foot traffic and how nice the place is. Also located in front of a metro station so moving around the city was easy

The location was excellent, close to everything. The check-in went smoothly. On the day of our arrival there was no toilet paper in the apartment, and the coffee maker was rusty, but after communication  they brought a new coffee maker and a bottle of Champaign as an apology. All in all, our stay in Almaty’s apartment was great.
Amazing hosts and a great place. Perfect for a cozy and nice stay in Madrid.  100% recommended.

I am so happy that I chose to stay at this apartment while in Madrid! It was clean, spacious and more beautiful in person than the photos. Begoña and Alejo were prompt at responding to any inquires prior to my arrival. Alejo gave great recommendations of restaurants/bars in the city and was very helpful with any information I needed. I will definitely recommend this apartment to others and will use them again the next time I'm in Madrid!

We have had a great weekend in Madrid! Staying in this apartment was pleasant and beneficial due to welcoming and taking care host and perfect location. The apartment is nice, clean and has everything a traveller might require. The well-equiped kitchen guarantees great breakfasts. Nearby there is a small market for locals where you can buy all you desire for a perfect breakfast. It was our first experience with AirBnB and it was good! Thank you Begona Y Alejo!

Amazing! Possibly the best AirBnb I've experienced. The flat is gorgeous and Alex and Begoña left it full of nice surprises - food for breakfast, wine etc. Everything was impeccably clean and had such a lovely atmosphere - I could have stayed forever.  And the location  is perfect for exploring all madrid, from arty barrios to the galleries. Check in was super smooth even though I arrived early, and Alex and Begoña were on hand if necessary,without being invasive. So great, stay here if you can!

I enjoyed my stay here--the apartment was bright, airy, clean, and comfortable. The location is unbeatable. I did not meet Begoñia or Alejo in person, but Begoñia was responsive when I called her up because I couldn't connect to the internet. (It ended up not working for me at all, but I'm still not sure why that happened, as Begoñia tested it and it worked for her.) They let me stay an extra hour on check-out day. They left a decent amount of food for breakfast--fresh fruit, milk, muesli, bread, jams, coffee.

Room was very sunny, clean. Good location. Pretty much exactly as advertised.

Host was friendly and gave good advice/suggestions.

This was definitely one of the best placed we stayed at using AirBnb.
The pictures were very accurate to how it was. The skylights in the apartment was definitely a bonus! Alex was a great host as well, he gave us some really great tips as to where to go! I will definitely stay here again the next time we visit Madrid :)

I didn't get to meet them but he was really great about meeting my friend to drop off the keys for me before my arrival.
Description of the place is very good and everything was impeccable.
Neighborhood is fine. Anton martin area is sketch sometimes at night but fine over all. Great location bc it's central. Amor de Dios Flamenco studios around the corner as well as Central De Cine.

The apartment was clean, bright and well-located. It has air conditioning, which is almost essential in the summer. It is in a good position, close to the metro and a main train station, the main museums and park. The apartment is on the top floor but there is lift access. I would stay here again.
The space is basic but clean and comfortable. It's very quiet which was great for a light sleeper like myself.  Check in wasn't easy, could do with some improvement there.

This was the perfect place to stay in Madrid. The space was very neat and clean and had all the amenities we needed. By boyfriend and I just stayed one night, but the location was great and we were very pleased with the experience.

Lovely apartment only 5 minutes walk from the wonderful Plaza Santa Ana, and in the other direction the Prada museum. A further walk of just 10 minutes and you are at Plaza Mayor.
What I liked about the apartment was that it was very quiet, with lift access and easy reach of the metro at the top of the road Anton Martin. Very clean, looks like new and with air conditioning which was a bonus as Madrid was 40 degrees during my stay. The apartment is nice and bright to with skylight windows as well as smaller windows running along the lounge. Bed is nice and comfortable and so is the sofa to relax after a long day in the heat. Good sized fridge two rings on the hob and a microwave too, the dishwasher came in handy. Nice big wardrobe to hang things all in all a nice spacious studio, really enjoyed my stay. Met Alejo he's a really nice guy!

The apartment was as described and everything was in working order. Unfortunately, our communication with Alejo left much to be desired. I attempted to contact him the week prior to our arrival to coordinate check in, however he did not respond to any form of contact I attempted. On the morning of our arrival, not having heard from Alejo, I was forced to contact AirBnB customer service to find support. Eventually they must've been in touch with him because he texted me at the very last minute. Having come from another country that morning, this was very stressful and a difficult way to enter Madrid. We almost made another reservation. Upon our arrival, Alejo did not explain his lack of contact whatsoever, just let us into the apartment. He was, however, in contact during our stay to schedule our check out time so he could clean the apartment prior to the next guest's arrival.

The studio is in a great location, about a 10 minute walk to the Museo del Prado and 15-20 min. from the Buen Retiro Park (one of our favorite spots in the city). We took the metro from the airport (45 minutes) and then walked the short distance to the place. Alejo was great, he even met us at a local restaurant to give us the key. The place was comfortable and clean. The shades on the windows and the sky lights made jet-lag more tolerable. The building and the neighborhood feel safe, and there are plenty of restaurants in walking distance. We walked to most things in the city from the studio.

We arrived very late - and were very happy to find that fruit, milk and bread were ready for us in the flat. The flat is situated perfectly in the Latin Quarters charming area - close to everything down town Madrid.
The flat is on the top floor - letting in a lot of nice light from the top windows. The studio flat had all we needed. Thanks for a great stay.
Helle and Jan from Denmark

Our stay here was amazing! Despite having a little bit of a language barrier, he printed off a map for us and circled places he thought were important. The apartment itself is so beautiful and airy, and the streets at night were quiet enough to sleep with the windows open. Great host, great apartment, and great location! He also arranges for a taxi to pick us up early the next morning.

This was a beautiful studio.  The bed was incredibly comfortable.  Exactly how the pictures show.  Alejo was very helpful and made sure to have his friend there,  even though I arrived late in the evening.  I would recommend this to anyone or couples.

Alejo had maps, food, drink and recommendations for us! A wonderful stay at Alejo's place. Incredibly comfortable room and bed!! Located comveniently right by the metro station and anywhere in Madrid. Very good restuarants right around the corner--Stop Madrid was our favorite!
Thank you, Alejo!

The apartment is in a great area and is very nice inside. Everything in the apartment is new and of high quality. The bed is very comfortable and the shower is great too.  We arrived early into Madrid and were able to drop our bags off before the apartment was ready. Be sure to verify with Alejo what time you can get inside the apartment, as the airBnB description says 12:00pm (Noon), however it was 1:30pm before the apartment was actually ready for us to enter. I would highly recommend this apartment to anyone traveling to Madrid.

Overall our stay in Madrid was lovely. There was a bit of an issue in accessing the apartment. I emailed Alejo a day and a half before arrival asking about how to get the key but didn't hear back. Long story short we went the apartment and rang the buzzer but there was no answer so Airbnb got in touch with him while we waited in a cafe down the street with wifi, this was dissappointing after a long travel day. Besides that our stay was great. The apartment is huge in comparison to other places we stayed in Europe and Alejo was so nice to leave fruit, bread, juice for us. He also gave great recommendations on what sites to see in Madrid during our short stay. The apartment is very clean and the bed is super comfy too. Location was a short walk to everything we wanted to do and a couple nice cafe and bars right not the street.
Everything was great here. Quiet, very comfortable bed, great host, good location, no problems.
Efficient host who helped us access the apt which was great in a timely manner.  Nice space in a terrific location.

This studio was cozy, comfortable, and has skylights to enhance the positive impact of the place.  It was spotless, modern, and is close to the metro.  The AC works very well, and we had no issues.  It's great for 1-2 people to stay here comfortably.
Great location, close to Atocha and Puerta del sol and metro station. Room is enough for two person and you can find everything you need in the house. Alejo is a good host. Enjoy :)

We were met by Alejo's freind who spoke little English.  After a small delay we were shown to the apartment and given information we needed for our stay. The apartment was excellent, clean, well appointed and a very good location to explore Madrid. Overall we had a wonderful stay in Madrid and enjoyed Alego's apartment.
