Very nice apartment in a hip part of town. Nicely decorated and very clean. It is a little loud outside at night, but plenty of bars and restaurants around. We loved it!
Excellent studio in the heart of the city. Quiet and clean, easy to find. Fast wifi too. I would definitely recommend the place to anyone.

Alejo was a great host. He let us do the checking prior 12:00 which was very helpful when you are loaded with bags. He also kept the bags for us in a safe room until 2:00, which allowed us to do things until catching the train. The apartment was very clean and had everything we needed. Location was exellent. The only two things I think I should mention was that washing machine was not working and the drain in the tub did not drain properly. Overall our experience was great and I would recommend this place for a couple who wants to spend sometime in an authentic neighborhood of Madrid.

Alejo's place is great.

Central, cozy, and perfect for a single or 2 people with great AC, TV, and internet.

If you are looking for a simple place to stay and go explore the city, this is it. We went walking for 3-4 hours, then came back to the apartment and turned on the AC to relax.

The sunlights in the main room and bathroom make for any awesome experience on the top floor.

Fantastic!
- Superb location
- very kind host
- clean and suitable flat for two
-perfect for a long weekend.

Reviews were right, this was a great apartment!

Perfect space for Madrid visit - great location, great space, great host -
I did not meet Alejo but Julian who waited for me to receive the apartment -vey friendly and accommodating
definitely recommendable !!!! Thank you Alejo and Julian
Its a great place, clean, very well decorated, good location and our host was very kind and attentive. We will love to visit this place again.

The studio apartment is located in a really convinient location. We pretty much walked everywhere. We even walked to the train station. (About 25-minute walk). The apartment itself is nice. The bed is really comfortable. All the bathrooms that we used in AirBnB did not have a fan. Usually there was a window that we could open to let out the steam. This bathroom had a skylight, which was great as hot air moves away faster.

Elevator of the building makes moving luggages up and down the apartment really easy.

Overall, it was a great experience and we would come back again.

This was a lovely and clean apartment in a great neighborhood. The lighting was great and the place was spacious. The places we wanted to visit were all within walking distance (the museums, Retiro Park, puerto del sol....). We really enjoyed our stay at Alejo's place!
It was nice to staying in this apartment, had a great time. Even though we couldn't meet with Alejo in person, he was helpful. the apartment was in good location And condition.
Great apartment in an excellent location. Close to many bars and restaurants. Would recommend to anyone traveling to Madrid.

The apartment was clean, comfortable, and centrally located. Very close to public transportation and attractions. A fifteen minute walk from the Atocha train station and a two minute walk to the Metro station. Check in was easy. He was very fast in responding to our inquiries. Would recommend.

Quiet, clean sanctuary. On the heels of a long trip, we were thankful to stop here last. The studio is bright, clean, and tastefully decorated. The building is secure, with a clean marble entryway and elevator that came in handy after all the miles we walked in the beautiful city of Madrid! Be sure to stop at Alejo's restaurant, Tinto y Tapas. The food is scrumptious and served at a reasonable price!

Great host. He let us check in early and let us keep our bags late when we checked out. He was communicative. The location is Central and ideal for people who want to see a lot of the city and not spend a lot of time in the room. However I would say that it is a nice room and served our needs. I would recommend staying here.

This has by far been our best AirBnB experience so far. The location of this place is perfect and it is easy to get to Gran Via or Plaza de Mayor by walking. There are so many incredible tapas bars around here, and vegan restaurants!
The apartment is very neat, clean and the perfect romantic spot for a couple.
Alejo is an excellent host, he checked on us at the start of our stay and then left us to do our thing.
The next time we are in Madrid (which is hopefully soon) we will most definitely stay here again.
Thank you Alejo for being such a great host.
Nish Mohan.
We had a really nice stay in Madrid. The apartment is clean and quiet, the aircon works well, and it's a in a great location for exploring the city.

The apartment is as shown in the pictures, and everything was clean and tidy. The wifi is very fast and the location is great, really near to everything and on walking distance from the main attractions. The self check-in was great also. This was our 2nd time at Alejo's apartment and we would choose this place again if we have the chance.

Perfect location for visiting Madrid. The apartment is small but has everything you need, and it is very clean. The air conditioning worked well, and although there is street noise, with the shutters closed you can't hear it. The elevator is welcome given how many Airbnb apartments in European cities require climbing narrow flights of stairs. The apartment is easy walking distance from the Prado to the east and the old center and the Palace to the west. Two great flamenco clubs are 5 minutes away. We would stay there again.

Great place and location. It looked like they may have forgotten to clean the shower after the last guest, but other than that, the place was spotless and hosts were really responsive. Elevator was also really convenient to get our suitcases up to the 4th floor.
A fantastic apartment, centrally located, very clean, and comfortable. We would stay there again, without hesitation.
A very cute and cozy apartment. Very close to public transit and it also has air conditioning- we were happy to have it. The bed is extremely comfortable as well!

Nice and extremely clean apartment in a very convenient location, close to public transportation, Atocha Station, city center, Retiro, restaurants, cinemas, etc. We really enjoyed being able to walk everywhere from the apartment.  Ready to go back!

It was a very nice Studio! The bed was a little small for my tall husband (>1.90m) but everything else was perfect! Very central, Studio exactly as in the pictures, clean and cozy! Also our request for the baby-travelbed was met and prepared! I would stay again!

Begona was helpfull and willing to reply you on time! Location was so good! But aircondition and heater was not enough to get warm the flat. We use aircondition but electricty was gone couple of times.

Very clean, compact apartment. Great location for visiting Madrid. Centrally located on a quiet street. Within a few minutes walking distance of many attractions including Sol,   Plaza Mayor, Reina Sofia and Prado museums. Very good communication from the host.
Great location in heart of Madrid.  Check was very easy. Begonia was easy to interact with on the loft.

Great location, very near Anton Martin Metro and outstanding food market.  This loft apartment has a reliable lift and it’s lovely and light with sky view velux windows. It’s central  but quiet. Begona is the perfect host and responded quickly and effectively to our requests.  Access is easy -I loved the photo directions in relation to this.  I’d happily stay there on future visits.
Great place. Super clean, and stylish. The place is also in a great part of Madrid to get to places. The host is super responsive to questions and very helpful!
Begoña is an excellent hostage,  she was so comunicative and helpful , she got laundry soap we needed to use the washer. Don't be disappointed if you come to this place
Begona and her partners are very, very nice people, who were  non stop available, to help with all that I needed and all I asked for. I am really thankful. Highly recommended!

Clean, easy check-in, nice bathroom, comfortable bed. Great value and just a short walk from all the major attractions.
We spent 5 days there and would certainly stay again.

What a perfect little studio apartment in the heart of Madrid! It was a quick walk from Atocha and getting in was super easy. Trifinio and Begona were both communicative about checking in/out. I would definitely stay here again without question... I've already recommended it to some friends!
This was a great place to stay, great location close to the main places, airport, train station and the subway. I loved the small loft and it was clean with linens provided.
Clean, cozy, great location, easy accessible, stable WiFi. Host very responsive. The apartment has all that you need to make you feel like home.
The apartment is extremely comfortable and very well located for exploring some of the best areas of Madrid. We’ll definitely stay here again next time we’re in the city.

This place is insanely close to Anton Martin metro stop! 10 minutes or less from Atocha station. About 2 stops from there and a short walk from the main thoroughfare (Plaza Mayor/Sol).
Quiet at night, the room was perfect for a quick stay in Madrid.
Washer worked great, fyi: line dry your clothes under the sky light. Gets toasty.
Would totally return!

Perfect apt in every way.
Location was great.
I wouldn’t change anything.
Very nice apartment, well equipped, in a very good location. Metro station only a few minutes away. Communication with Begoña was perfect.
The loft is clean and bright, but can be a little warm in the afternoon. Good location, convenient for a short stay.
Great place, great location close to all the big museums in Madrid and the metro just 2 min away. I'd stay here again if I were to visit the city!

Everything was great. The apartment is just like described. Good area, close to restaurants, bars and cafes. The only minimal detail would be the bed linen was not of very good quality and not very comfortable. Everything else was great! Would definitely recommend.

I had an amazing stay at this Airbnb in Madrid! The location was superb, offering easy access to all the must-visit spots in the city. The apartment itself was immaculate, with everything tidily organized and sparkling clean. The host was incredibly responsive and friendly, making sure all our needs were met throughout our stay. I highly recommend this Airbnb to anyone looking for a comfortable and hassle-free experience in Madrid. 5 stars all the way!
Great stay! The location was perfect and the place had everything we needed. Communicate and getting in was also very easy :) Would stay again when visiting the city.

Begoña's place was very easy to check into, very clean, and in a great location. Everything went very smoothly and was well communicated to us. The only downside was construction right across the street, but we only heard it on weekdays during the day.

Begoña and Co. are great management hosts. They are proactive in communicating and check in was seamless. The attic studio I rented was as described, full of light, comfortable, and the building is in a prime location in Las Letras. The linens and bed were perfect. I would definitely rent this apartment again.
Begona was a very communicative host. The place was also exactly as described in the listing. Very spacious, in a great location and easy to get around.
Begoña is a great host. Our stay was perfect, it had everything we needed. Very clean and well organized!
Very comfortable accomadations in a great location. Was able to walk to every spot. Host was friendly and responsive to any questions I had.

I had a wonderful stay at this apartment . The space was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described in the listing. The location was perfect—close to local attractions, restaurants, and public transport, making it easy to explore the city. The host was friendly and responsive, always available to answer any questions and provide helpful recommendations. I would definitely recommend this apartment to anyone visiting Madrid and would be happy to stay here again in the future!
Loved staying here. Great for solo travelers. Clean, cute apartment in a great neighborhood. Would absolutely stay here again. Carmen is helpful and responsive, had no problems at all.

Beautiful apartment with all the amenities. Hosts go the extra mile to make u feel at home in every possible way. Super helpful.
Location is great for any visit to Madrid.
I would highly recommend it, especially the super hosts !!!
Will be back !!
Iryna and Pablo

It was a wonderful experience, place was clean and filled with everything you need to use. Beds are confortable and the host is friendly.
100% that I will return in a further trip.

I must say that the apartment as well as the hist were wonderful! I have never had such an amazing experience. The apartment was extremely nice, very clean, modern, with TV and fast internet. The location couldn't be better, very close to shops, nice bars, restaurants and just a minute walk from the shopping center of Madrid. Our host Renan was very flexible with the time of our arrival, he also let us stay for few more hours before we left Madrid. He also left us a bottle of great red wine and a fridge full of water and beer. If I will go to Madrid again, which I hope will happen quite soon, I will definitely stay at Renan's apartment. I strongly recommend this place to anyone. Fantastic price, beautiful apartment and a perfect location. There isn't anything more anyone could wish for!

We had an excellent stay at Renan's apartment. The location was excellent, right in the middle of the city and very close to the metro system so perfect for tourists. We got to Madrid very early and had our luggage on us but Renan was very accommodating and let us leave our bags at his place whilst they were preparing the apartment. As for the apartment itself, we couldn't have asked for more, very clean, spacious and we were even given a bottle of red on our arrival! Thank you so much would highly recommend Renan to everyone.
host made us feel very welcome, property was very clean, but need to replace used light bulbs, and sinks need plugs, also suggest you make a map as well as directions to find apartment.
Great apartment in the very heart of Madrid. Clean and with all the comfort you need! Highly recommended.

We had a wonderful stay at this apartment. The location is fantastic and the place was clean, charming and well-equipped. Renan left us bottled water and a bottle of wine. Altogether a lovely experience.

The apartment is in a perfect location, close to everything you need: sights, supermarket, metro, restaurants and shops. The apartment is really good, really confortable, and the host left us wine and beer to welcome us :) recomend it.
We found a clean apartment with some soft drinks waiting for us. We really liked the neighbourhood, lots of bars :)

The apartment is very clean and comfortable.  Space is enough for 4 people to fit.  Apartment is convenient to shopping and restaurants.  Close to Gran Via, Del Sol and other main attractions.  Easy access to the metro system.

Me and my friends enjoyed our stay in the flat! The location is great, the flat is clean and has all conveniences. Communication with Melvin was easy and pleasant, on the last day we were leaving later after check out and Melvin kindly agreed to keep our bags at his place. Everything was great, thanks!!

The apartment is clean and organized because it is managed by Melvin and his associates professionally as they run 23 apartments. Its good to have them looking after you. The location is great and there is free water, coke and beer.  Also please try the cheap and delicious Chinese restaurant 50 meters away.  Thank you Melvin!
The place is nice and clean, the neighbourhood is safe and very near city centre, though it is quiet in the apartment area. We have great time there. Thank you for having us.

This apartment is located bang right in the centre of the city and all the locations that are must visits in Madrid are closeby. You get all the amenities that are needed to make your stay super convenient. If you're planning to have hassle free stay in Madrid, book off this place before it runs out
Nice place, really close from the center! You don't need subway or buses to move. Flat was clean and looks like the pictures.
The appartment is very close to the centre of Madrid ,it is very easy to get to many famouse places.We had a good time.

Bathroom was stinking and there was no toilet seat. The Bunk bed was really clumsy and the house is too small for 4 people to accommodate. The couch was not good either. Hope this helps people for choosing the accommodation.
Nice place, really close to the center but still quiet! You don't need subway or buses to move. Flat was clean and looks like the pictures.

Location couldn't have been any better. Service was very friendly throughout our stay. Some noise coming from the stairs, but nothing too big. The bunk bed was a bit of a surprise, not the best with smallest kids.

Small, but very nice and lovely apartement situated very close to the city center. We have enjoyed our stay there in Madrid. There are lots of bars, restaurants and supermarkets around. I will recommend this place to everyone I know travelling to Madrid for sure. Muchas gracias! :)
It was a good stay with Melvin. The beds are a bit small in the living room but the space is good for 4 people max. We had a good time.
The house has perfect location and fully-equiped facility. The host is very generous and leave a bottle of wine as a gift for check in. Thank you again.

Nice apartment close to everything we needed. He arranged for us to get picked up at the airport and taken directly to the apartment and it only costed €40. The apartment was just as listed. Overall great stay.

2 mins walk from Gran Via Street
Metro and Bus Stops are nearby
Check in was smooth
Gave us a bottle of wine as well as a map of madrid
Overall very good

Very nice apartment. The apartment is fully equipped. It is located at the best part of the city, and in a quiet neighborhood. Melvin is really nice and booked a taxi for us at 5 am in the morning. Thanks a lot!

We had a problem with the beds in the apartment but Melvin was very helpful and accommodating in solving the problem. He was great at contact and very helpful. The flats were modern so very nicely done and clean and great location.

Amazing location in a really cool neighborhood and near everything else!
The apt is nice, clean and equipped with everything from towels and soap to wine.
Only minus was the toilet that doesn't flush verywell and very thin walls...
Fantastic area with great cafes and bars and close to all the major attractions. Melvin was very responsive, we had a great time.
Great location.  Air conditioning was a godsend with temperatures over 100F. The washing machine was nice to have as well. Would stay here again when in Madrid.

Apartment Was very central and in a great location meaning everything worth seeing in the city is accessible by foot. Easy to check in and were able to leave bags at the office after check out which was handy. Room was abit dark with small windows and not much light but was fine for the purpose. Would recommend

Great Experience!!!!
This is my first contact with AirBnb. Easy and friendly.
Well located apartment. Clean and spacefull.
I will be back!
Àlx
Great place to stay!!! Right in the center of the city and in a very lively neighborhood. The host was friendly and ready to help us anytime. I definitely recommend Melvin’s place.

Great location, only a few minutes walk to Calle Gran Via. Easy access to multiple metro stations. Great communication from Melvin, and the apartment had everything that my son and I needed for our stay in Madrid.
It’s very nice, house owner answer our questions very patiently. And the location of apt is perfect
This is a very nice and well located place. Good size except shower is super small and i couldnt really shower well. But confortable and clean, definitely worth it

The location of Melvin's place can't be beat.  You are in the middle of all the action.  1 min walk and you are at the Callao station with all the tourists.  I highly recommend that you go the other direction and check out Malasana neighborhood.  Very funky with great food and less tourist.  One thing to note, with city living, expect minor inconveniences with the place but it doesn't detract from the overall value.

The apartment is spacious with very good amenities. We like the kitchen and the laundry a lot! The location of the apartment is perfect. Walkable distance to most tourist’s attractions. We could even have siesta when the weather got too hot in the afternoon and went out again to explore this beautiful city. Location of the apartment is very important if you wanna go back for siesta. Overall, we enjoyed our stay in Madrid a lot and would highly recommend this apartment to all of you.

The photos for the flat were definitely taken at least a few years ago. The place doesn’t look like this anymore, and the furniture is different. The shower didn’t work properly which was frustrating. The host was also late checking us in. I’m guessing that this place has good reviews from a few years ago, but it definitely isn’t worth the price we paid.

This place perfect for a city break. It’s close to Gran Vía meaning shops, bars, restaurants and transport is easily accessible.
The apartment itself was very clean and had all you’d need.
Great price for location. Really responsive hosts. Small size but accurate to description and like any other apartments in the area.

Excellent location, apartment was small but clean. We are a family of four, kids aged 11 and 7. If kids were older the pull out bed would have been too small but worked out fine for us. We didn't spend much time inside honestly, there was so much to do right outside the front door.
Host was very responsive. Breakfast was a nice bonus.

We had a good experience. Great location, very clean, communication was excellent the whole time. The only down fall was that being so close to Plaza Mayor the apt was very loud.
Overall happy with our experience and as a host we were very impressed!!

Thank -you Soraya for renting us your beautiful apartment. Everything about it was as advertised. The location of the apartment is perfect for seeing the main attractions of Madrid. All were of walking distance. There are many shops and restaurants nearby so eating out was easy.
The apartment was very clean and tastefully furnished. The bed was extremely comfortable and high quality linens were provided. The shower was first class as well. The kitchen was very well stocked with everything you would need to cook a meal.
We would return to stay here without doubt.
Thank-you once again, Soraya!

The location is amazing! We expected to use the metro often but this was not necessary once we arrived. Steps from Plaza Mayor.  Despite heavy pedestrian traffic, noise was not an issue for us. We had a nice stay.

The apartment was great. It's a good size, especially for where it is. The kitchen and bathroom were also very nice.
The location is amazing! The pictures in the listing don't do it justice. We were there for three days and never took a taxi or metro. You can walk everywhere. The downside to the location is it can be noisy at night. You're on the second floor just outside Plaza Mayor. Bring earplugs if you're a light sleeper, but it's to be expected in that location.
The host is very friendly and made arriving and leaving very easy.

This was an excellent apartment which ticked every box.
The location was superb, within walking distance of all the city's main sights.
The apartment had a beautiful interior and has a lovely little balcony on which we could enjoy eating our breakfast each morning.
In addition, our host allowed us to leave our luggage in her cafe located just around the corner, which meant we could enjoy our last day without having to carry luggage around.

We had a great time at Soraya's appartment. The apparment is as beautifull as it is on the pictures. The baby cod for our son was already standing in the appartment, so that made our stay even beter. The appartment is clean and the location is perfect.
We were able to leave our bags at a nearby lunchroom so that we could enjoy our last day of Madrid, knowing our bags would be safe before picking them up for our flight.

Thanks for the great stay and the great welcome.

Kind regards,

Milena, Sylvester and Alain

Soraya was a great host and quick to response to my text. Her place is definitely in a central location. Only a few steps away from Plaza Mayor and short distance to Mercado de San Miguel and walking distance to the Metro. Its full of natural light from all the french doors that surrounds her apartment. A few mishaps while we were staying due to washer not working and kitchen sink pipes leaking. Overall, from the pictures posted on her listing is what you get and more =)
Soraya greeted us at her apartment which was just as advertised on the web site. Soraya gave us plenty of local information and also provided a detailed list of places to eat this was most helpful.

The location was absolutely perfect and we enjoyed our visit in Madrid thanks to being in such a central location. Seconds away from Plaza Mayor and everything was within walking distance. Soraya's recommendations were helpful and helped make our visit that much more pleasant. We would definitely return. To this very location upon our next visit to Madrid. Gracias per todos.

Soraya was unable to greet us however she made sure we got everything that we needed prioir to our arrival. We met with another who was most hospitable. The place was perfect, clean and right in the centre of everything. Very happy with our choice and highly recommended for your stay in Madrid.

Soraya's home was wonderful!  It was well appointed with everything we needed, very clean, and a great location for exploring Madrid.  She was fantastic answering the multitude of questions I had prior to and during our stay.  The balcony (and beautiful view) truly offered that special European flavor that we wanted for our stay!

It was our first time in madrid, and this was the prefect location! Right in the middle of everything and with everything in walking distance. The flat also comes with a baloney that is prefect for sitting out and relaxing at the end of the evening! :)

Soraya was a wonderful host, very accessible, warm and responsive to our needs.  She put together a local guide with restaurant and activity suggestions that was totally right on!  The apartment was just as advertised, clean, bright with lots of windows and balconies.  The location is right at the the Plaza Mayor, you even have a view of one of the entrances to the plaza.  It is an exciting and busy location, within walking distance of most of the sights, including the Prado, Parque de Retiro, Reyna Sofia Museum, Plaza del Sol and much more.  Would definitely recommend a stay!
Excellent experience.  The apartment is modern, very well thought out and the location is perfect.

Wow this place is in the center of the center of Madrid. Easy to get anywhere you want to go. The apartment is clean and modern. Soraya was on time and polite.
It is a bit loud at night though.

Fantastic apartment with a great location! Well-equipped, very nice decor and Madrid's many "must-do's" within walking distance. You can hear some noise from the charming and vivid streets below, but that was really not a problem for us (and absolutely nothing an earplug wouldn't fix ;-)). Soraya was very helpful and flexible, and we'd most definitely come back.

Nice place at the heart of Madrid really :) We like the decoration even we will copy the bar part to our kitchen :) Clean apartment and thanks to Soraya that when we reach there she was near to us :) Soraya's business is close to the apartment even if we did not need to ask something to her, it is nice to know that she is close :)
Really nice place. Great location. View of the street and entrance to Plaza Mayor is excellent.

The location is perfect if you want to be downtown. The studio is nice with a beautiful view. We had a water leak issue while there and the hosts were able to fix it in a timely manner. Definitely recommend for any Madrid vacation!

Soraya & husband Zoran were wonderful hosts. Their apartment was clean and perfectly located to walk the streets of Madrid. They even have a small balcony overlooking the plaza below.
Zoran also helped us when we needed to print our plane boarding passes. He was so nice.
We have no hesitation in recommending this lovely apartment.

We had the best time staying at Sorayas air B and B and we loved everything about it. It was actually as the pictures described and it was very clean and decorated with such style. It was in a perfect location and looking out of the Windows everyday was just beautiful. We actually didn't enjoy Madrid as a city overall but staying here made our trip wonderful. I would recommend this place to anybody!!

We loved the place! Right in the center of the hart of old Madrid. You look out the window through the arch to Plaza Mayor. Very clean and comfortable for a couple. Soraya was a great hostess. Soraya gave us an insiders map to Madrid that was invaluable. Only place missing on the map was Mimi's Creperia Madrid. A great place for ice cream and frozen yogurt and I am sure the Crepes are delicious also.
Dan and Terri Gilbert

Soraya was very friendly and welcoming .  She met us promptly when we arrived at the apartment and gave us a thorough intro to the apartment.  She was readily available afterwards for any questions we might have.

Soraya communicated with us before our arrival and throughout our stay.  Her husband met with us to hand over the keys and give us  a quick tour.  They have a crepe/ice cream shop right next to the airbnb and were there in case we needed anything.  The airbnb was in the heart of plaza Mayor, within walking distance to EVERYTHING.  Soraya even left a sheet with all of her recommendations for restaurants to try.    There were plenty of sheets and towels, and everything that we needed.  This was an amazing experience and we would recommend anyone who wants to visit Madrid to definitely stay here.

This was the best place we could have stayed in Madrid. It couldn't get any more central, the view was amazing, and the home was so relaxing! Soraya was an excellent host and I would highly recommend anyone who's looking for a lovely place to stay to stay here!

This listing is excellent! The pictures are very accurate. The apartment is lovely, clean, beautifully decorated! The hosts were lovely and accommodating! If you want the best location in Madrid, this is the space for you! So close to all the action! We would highly recommend this listing!!!!

Location, location, location. Soraya's apartment could not be better situated to see, eat, drink, and do everything in Madrid. You can see plaza Mayor from the window and plaza del Sol is just around the corner. The apartment itself is great and has everything you'd need for a stay—most notably Quick wifi and a good AC (at least for September temps).

We were met by Soraya's husband on arrival and he was very kind and accommodating. The apartment was very clean and in an amazing location. There are plenty of restaurants and shops close by with the nearest metro, Sol, only a couple of minutes walk. Soraya was readily available to answer any queries including booking a taxi for us for our departure. Apartment isn't huge but it is a comfortable and beautiful place to unwind in between seeing the sights and enjoying the local food and wine.

Our flight was delayed by three hours but Sona very kindly waited at the business downstairs until 2:30am to meet us and let us in which was much appreciated.
The location of the property is absolutely perfect and is just a few meters away from Plaza Mayor. The nearest metro stop is just a few minutes away as well. There's a lovely balcony to sit out on and people watch and the bed was super comfy.

The apartment truly was as beautiful as the pictures show.  The location was superb.  The view onto Plaza Mayor was neat. It's within walking distance of every tourist site we went to.  It is a lively and fun location so if you are a light sleeper bring some ear plugs.

Great apartment!  Right in the CENTER of it all.  Was in Madrid for a very short stay but we were really treated right here.  Comfortable bed, coffee maker, and everything necessary.  Loved having tea on the small terrace.  Would definitely stay again.

Beautiful apartment, perfect location, and so clean! The street is noisy, but it did not bother us a bit. Check-in was easy and apartment exceeded expectations! We will definitely recommend to our friends.

The apartment was perfect. The location is in the middle of everything that you will want to see in Madrid. It is within walking distance to mercado san miguel, cathedral, shopping district and you can see the plaza mayor from the balcony. Soraya and her manager are very helpful with every inquiry that we had. She also booked the taxi for us upon check out. The bed was very comfy and warm after a full day of walking in the cold autumn days that we were there. I'll definitely recommend this listing to my friends and will stay here again next time i'm in madrid.

The apartment is in a great location but was very noisy.
It is well equipped and clean.

A beautiful apartment steps from the Plaza Mayor.  Pictures and description are very accurate.  Three small balconies with room for two small chairs each.  Great for people watching and wine sipping.   Highly recommended.
We enjoyed our stay at Sorayas flat very much.Location is perfect,flat is great and communication with Soraya was friendly and very easy.

Thank you so much for allowing us to stay at your place! It was so close to everything. We had a great time! It was so central to every where we needed to go. If we ever make it back to Madrid again we will definitely try and stay here again.
Soraya's place is only feet away from Mayor Plaza and it's surrounded by restaurants and shops. Highly recommended.

If you like people watching, you will love this place! There are three balconies from which you can watch a constant flow of people going into and out of Plaza Mayor and we spent hours we would have otherwise spent in cafes enjoying the scenery from our private retreat. When we did emerge it's centrally located and very walkable to anything you'd want to do in the city.
The apartment was exactly as described and the kitchen made it possible to cook dinner and make coffee! I would highly recommend this place, it enhanced our Madrid visit.

This is the best central location to everything! You can see the square right from the balcony  (my favorite part of the airbnb). It is clean and so beautiful. Soraya was a wonderful host and I hope to go back one day.

This is a true gem. Just the right amount of space. Thoughtfully designed and with everything you need. Right by the Plaza Mayor, one minute walk. If you like the hustle and bustle of busy city centres, this is just he place for you.
Soraya lives up to her superhost status.

Perfect location, with a view of Plaza Mayor and within easy walking distance of Madrid’s major sites.  The apartment is architecturally interesting and quite comfortable.  Excellent communication with host and her husband who recommended an amazing restaurant, Amazonico, located above a fantastic Jazz Club.  I will definitely rebook this apartment when I return to Madrid!
The view of plaza Mayor is incredible, in the heart of the city, really thanks to Soraya !!

Soraya’s apartment was clean and stylish, located very central! We loved being in the city Center so close to everything. The radiator can be a little noisy at night, just a word of caution. Overall we had a great few days!
This place feels like the center of Madrid. it's very lively at all times. You could keep the windows open an take it all in. Or simply close them and turn on the AC for a quite sleep.
Absolutely amazing flat.   Beautifully decorated with all the amenities one could ask for!    Highly recommend!

I loved this place! Immaculate and stylish, with high end finishes! Compact - good for 1-2 people - but beautifully set out. Three tiny balconies to watch the buzz below, lovely authentic shutters and beautiful doors, perfect style for the age, but had been replaced, so shut easily and tightly with double-glazing (keeping most noise out). Wifi, hot water and sheets - excellent, excellent and excellent! Good communication from host Soraya (who was out of the country) and Luka who showed me the apartment and how everything worked. As a female travelling alone I felt completely safe in the apartment and area (of course I am always aware of the ever-present pickpockets).
The delighters for me were the thoughtful extras, like coffee, washing powder and the excellent instructions and recommendations left in the apartment.
Would definitely return. Highly recommended.

Cant get a better location in Madrid. You can see, here and feel the wonderful spanish vibe from the Plaza Mayor. The apartment exceeded all our expectations.
Soroya and her husband were so friendly and welcoming. It was such a great start to our Spanish Holiday. Hope to come back again one day.
Soraya's place is one of my favourite airbnbs I have ever stayed. It has a great location, the flat is beautiful and clean. Soraya is really helpful, she replies quickly.

Soraya's place and hospitality are perfect.  Her apartment is beautiful and clean.  You feel held and taken care of while there.  The apartment is safe and central.  I walked everywhere.    Soraya was available when I had questions and texted.  She also made her Creperie available for me to leave my bags after check out so I could walk around for a few hours before I needed to catch my train.  I had the best experience.

You have to stay at Soraya’s place if you’re headed to Madrid. It’s located right in the heart of old town, which is perfect in this walking city. Everything you need for a beautiful stay. The view is unbelievable, we’ve stayed in dozens of airbnb’s in the past, this one was our absolute favorite of all time. Highly recommend if you’re headed to Madrid, you will not be disappointed
If you want to be in the heart of it all, look no further.  Perfect space for a coupe that wants to explore the heart of Madrid.

Perfect location for a city trip. You can not get closer to the plaza mayor. The interior is exactly as the pictures show. With a great bed and a super shower.
Soraya is quick in responding email and offered the great possibility of storing your luggage after checkout.
Thanks for a great stay Soraya!

Absolutely amazing  location and a wonderful host whose restaurant recommendations were all outstanding. Highly recommend for solo traveler or couple. I will definitely return. I read some reviews about this apartment being a little noisy at night. It’s located in a major & lively city center. If you require absolute silence at night, maybe the center of Madrid is not where you should stay. I loved the energy. Simply fantastic!!!

Soraya’s apartment was the perfect place to stay for a weekend visit to Madrid. Its central location made it easy to walk to many attractions. The amenities were outstanding and just as pictured. I would recommend staying here!

Exceptional location in central Madrid but be ready for ongoing noise during all night ; very clean and new but fairly impersonal, the whole building  is rented to tourists, a bit far from the original idea of AirBnB.

Cannot beat the convenience of a central location.  Plaza Mayor is visible from the the balcony and observing the throngs of tourists flowing by provides endless entertainment.  The apartment is modern and provided enough space for my wife and I.  The Sol metro station is a short walk from the apartment and numerous dining and shopping options are nearby.  The hosts were fantastic and interested in making sure our stay was enjoyable.  The hosts own a cafe a few meters from the apartment that offers great breakfast selections and coffee.  We  had a wonderful stay in Madrid and highly recommend the property.

Great spot by the Plaza Mayor, close to everything, the location is perfect!! Nice for 1 or 2 people, modern and well appointed.
Thanks Soraya!

The apartment is located perfectly in the center (everything in walking distance)
Elevater is very useful fotör the luggage. It was super clean and even had Products like hairspry, shampoo and conditioner which we forgot to bring!
Loved every detail of the apartment,
can’t wait for our next stay there :)!

The location could not be any better. It's near all the plazas and there are so many good places to dine in. The view from the room is also great. Only stayed few days in Madrid, but the apartment made it so convenient.

I wish I could rate Soraya’s apartment higher! Everything was perfect. You literally cannot beat the location- sets away from the center of the city at Plaza Mayor. The room and view is even more beautiful than the pictures. Soraya is so helpful, and her Mimi’s Creperie cafe is delicious. Thank you Soraya for making our stay the Madrid the best it could be!
Great location and very cute space. Really enjoyed staying right in the heart of Madrid. Will be coming back for a second stay!
Sparkling clean space, right in the middle of madrid! Walkable to many major tourist spots. Can get loud at night as it’s right near a bar but I’m not a light sleeper so didn’t bother me.
Perfect place for visiting Madrid with rare cosy balkonies facing the Plaza Mayor. Feels like a dream, would really book again next time!

Soraya’s place was perfect. We had everything we needed in the most ideal location- just steps from Plaza Mayor. We arrived early in the morning and got to sit at her cafe across the street, drinking coffee and sharing stories with her wonderful husband and their cute dog. Soraya was easy to work with and a great host! Would recommend this property to anyone in Madrid.
Super cosy apartment, very functional and well located. A little bit noisy in the evening, but this is due to the location. Soraya is very kind and super responsive!

Soraya’s place is in the best location in Madrid! Her flat was the perfect space! It is surrounded by many tapa restaurants as well as local stores and only a short walk to the main plaza. For the price it is listed for it is a great value for the stay! I would highly recommend her place!

This apartment is the perfect place to stay to visit central Madrid.  It is perfectly located just off the Plaza Mayor, and is walking distance to so many restaurants, cafes, and places to see.  The place is very clean, comfortable, and has everything travelers need.

Soraya's place is very convenient, everything is 10-15 mins walk apart, there's a market that's 6 mins walk away that provide a lot of good food, 10 mins walk from a tapas street.
Soraya is very communicative and responsive, would recommended her place!

Can’t say enough great things about this spot. Soraya was so friendly, gracious and informative. We have never had a better host. The location can’t be beat, and the place itself was so comfortable and equipped. Attention to detail was top notch. Would absolutely come back and can’t wait to. This is a must stay. Thank you Soraya!

Location, location, location! This flat is in the perfect Madrid area- steps away from Plaza Mayor. We loved being centrally located. The flat was perfect for the two of us and was very comfortable. We would absolutely rent this place again. Soraya was easy to communicate with and offered many accommodations for our luggage.

Communication with Soraya was just perfect. The apartment is pure 10. Location really central, well equipped and prepared for hosting a couple. Truly romantic. I cannot explain the feeling seeing the main pedestrian streets through the window. Absolutely recommended.

This place is exactly like the photos. It is beautiful, clean and you can’t beat the location. Soraya was an excellent communicator and very easy to get in touch with. 100 percent would stay here again, highly recommend!

This apartment is in a great location, with a lovely balcony overlooking the arched entry into the Plaza Major. Communication with Soraya the owner was terrific. Not only did she greet us at the apartment, she was super sweet to deal with. The restaurant recommends and map were helpful in finding some great places to eat beyond the tourist traps in the Plaza. Good strong shower, and all the amenities provided made this a very nice place to decompress after a long day exploring all that the city of Madrid has to offer. A+++!

This Airbnb is a MUST stay if you are in Madrid! Absolutely perfect, clean, cozy, comfortable and well-equipped. The balcony is overlooking the entrance of the Plaza Royal, underneath is a lovely tapas bar and next door is Soraya’s breakfast place where we started our days. Soraya is very helpful and the communication is smooth. I only can recommend!!! We loved every minute of our stay.
This is a great situated apartment, walkable to many sites and has great restaurants around. Was safe, bright, clean, and well stocked!!

Ths studio was ina fantastic location, very clena and has a great view, ideal for our first trip to Madrid. The only negative was it gets a bit noisy being so central, so you need the windows shut at night-but I would definetley stay here again, Soraya was very helpful too,

The apartment is beautiful and the location is unbeatable. Soraya is a great host and extremely accommodating. She kindly stored our bags when we went to Granada for a couple days. I definitively recommend Soraya’s apartment.

We rented 2 apartments, on the 1st and 2nd floors, as we were traveling with 2 teens. The location was very central, but as a result it was not very quite. Great host, very good communication. Clean and nice units with everything one needs

THE nicest Airbnb we have  stayed in for multiple reasons.   Location unbeatable, comfortable and host very easy to communicate with.  We would absolutely stay here again and recommend to friends.  Loved everything about it!

This was a perfect studio for my first time in Madrid! Very cute, clean, and comfortable for what we needed. Located in the heart of everything, it was super easy getting around. Soraya was easy to communicate with, which made check-in and out seamless. I appreciate her hospitality!

If you’re looking for the perfect location, this is it. Very comfortable space, right at Plaza Mayor, near all the shops, food, etc. We had a great time here. We had family staying nearby in a very nice hotel and after showing them this space, they preferred ours over theirs! It was so great to be able to shop, conveniently drop stuff off, then hit the restaurants again, and visit the sites.

This is a great location!  Everything was exactly as pictured and well-equipped with everything we needed.  It is noisy overnight as it is a busy area but was generally better with AC on and windows shut.
An absolutely adorable flat, ideally situated near the Plaza Mayor. My only regret was that our stay was so brief.

Absolutely beautiful flat in the heart of Plaza Mayor. The building and views are straight out of a painting. Stunning. Close to everything. Hosts were very responsive and we had everything we needed. I can't imagine a better place to experience Madrid. Fantastic!

Sorayas studio apartment was perfect for 2 people. Since the unit was empty we were allowed an early check-in. Elevator at units door step. Everything was squeaky clean, good nights rest on comfortable bedding. Perfect room temperature in winter, you can control it, and water pressure and temperature perfect for showering. Coffee pods were provided.
The location is perfect for sightseeing, THE VIEW!, Plaza Mayor a few steps away.
Soraya responded quickly and in a friendly manner to any questions. We were allowed to leave our luggage after checkout and pick it up late evening, so we continued to sightsee without it all day.
Would definitely stay at Sorayas place again, wish I could give it more than 5 stars.
Thank you Soraya for a wonderful stay!
We thoroughly enjoyed our stay at Sorays’s flat. Fantastic central location, close to everything. No problem getting in and out of apartment. I would definitely stay there again.

My gosh, this place was perfect for the two of us! The bed was comfortable and the place had everything we needed! We loved going to sleep with the sounds of nightlife and waking to the sound of a new day downtown. We loved how close to city center we were and how so many sights could be reached on foot. There also was a plethora of places nearby to eat and shop - the laminated recommendations and instructions were very helpful. Finally being able to leave our things at the creperie downstairs after checkout was just such icing on the crepe. The convenience of having our accommodations so close made our days here so beautiful!

Lovely apartment for two in the heart of Madrid that is within walking distance to most tourist attractions. We enjoyed having a view of Plaza Mayor and staying on a street that was open to only pedestrians. It was also great having Mimi’s Creperie across the street for coffee and breakfast.
Great little apartment to stay in a fabulous spot in Madrid.  Able to walk to many places, or Metro.  We enjoyed our stay and can recommend to everyone.  Thank you.

What a fabulous place to stay in Madrid! Appreciated being able to drop off our luggage at Mimi’s Creperie  across the road before checking in later. Adored the central location. Perfect to walk in Central Madrid (and we did!) and only 3 minutes walk to the Metro at Sol. Sipping wine whilst watching the buzz of the laneways and Plaza Mayor was priceless!

Great location and wonderful views from all three window balconies. Especially the window that looks out into Plaza Mayor. Fun for people watching. Bonus there is an elevator especially helpful when you have heavy luggage. We accidentally locked our keys in the apartment and Milan was very quick and proactive to help. Quick tip, the door locks on its own and there is no need to lock from the inside which we did. Would highly recommend. Thank you again, Milan!!!!!

My fiancé and I had a great stay in Madrid. Milan was very responsive to our questions and the location was perfect for enjoying great restaurants and sights. Would definitely recommend staying here! Well worth the money!

If you want right in the middle of the action, this is your place. Lots to do, lots to eat, lots to enjoy very close by.  The space is perfect for a couple and very comfortable.  We really enjoyed our stay and Milan was very helpful, even offering to get us an umbrella on a rainy day.  Thank you!
The apartment was in an ideal spot for travelers, and you can see the Plaza Mayor from the balcony. It is small, but it has everything you need. Milan was very nice and helpful.

Beautiful place right in the center of the action! Overlooking one of the entrances to Plaza Mayor, you can’t beat the location. Love all the balconies and the sunshine they let in. Check in was a breeze, which meant a lot after a long day of travel. Appreciated the elevator for toting luggage. The hosts were very helpful and responsive.
It can definitely be loud sometimes but that’s the trade off you make to be in a fabulous location. I would definitely stay again!

Soraya’s apartment was perfect for our 3 nights in Madrid. It is adorable, clean, perfect for our needs, and we enjoyed being right in the hustle and bustle of Plaza Mayor. An added bonus is Mimi’s Creperia just below. The food and coffee are fantastic! We would stay here again!

I arrived by taxi. The taxi driver congratulated me on finding such a central place to stay. The welcome info was most helpful and relevant to me. The apartment is utterly splendid. Right in the heart of the old city and surrounded by cafes, tapas and restaurants. The closest - Mimis - is perfect for healthy eating and brilliant friendly service. The apartment is easy to find, is immaculate, in its simple furnishings, was clean andI slept well on the  comfortable large bed. . Shower was perfect, hot water and powerful. The host proved to be friendly, most helpful and obliging. I received detailed info and photos to assist me. Finally, the kind service additional to that relating to the apartment was the luggage storage facility which allowed me to leave my suitcase safely after checkout & before I needed to depart Madrid. I highly recommend this apartment for an all round 5 star service.

The place was beautiful and in a perfect location! The street noise was present but definitely not an issue and well worth being in the heart of it all. Check in was easy and the hosts were great. I highly recommend booking for your trip to Madrid!
Loved staying at Soraya and Milan’s BnB. The place was centrally located and clean- just as described in the photos. Communication was easy and prompt 😊

Very nice appartement, super location, perfect for a week-end, everithing is very close. Milan is very friendly, the communication passed very good. Tbe appartement very confortable and well decorated. There is everithing you need for your stay. Deffenetly recomended
Lovely stay in Madrid. Soraya & Milan were responsive/ accommodating throughout our stay. 10/10 location & luggage storage helped us immensely. Would highly recommend!
Everything about this rental was 5 stars! It was an incredible find at an incredible price. I highly recommend and would return here on my next visit to Madrid.

This was an amazing experience. The view of Plaza Mayor with the Christmas lights were stunning (stunning enough that my fiancé decided to propose in front of the balcony.. super romantic). Everything else was awesome. Walking distance to almost every place except the airport. One thing though: the shower door does not close all the way and cause flooding in the bathroom area (which was a bit annoying). Overall, it was a great stay. We will definitely come back! :)

Best Airbnb we’ve ever stayed in! Soraya’s place was exactly as described. The location is prime - we walked everywhere. The host even went out of their way to provide recs and find salsa classes for us!

Very beautiful spot and in the center of everything. She gave elaborate instructions and provided different options on how to get to the Airbnb while including the time it took and different pricing for each option. Very clean and overall a great experience. 5/5 recommend!
Rocio is a very nice person. Quiet place not so far of the centro. I really enjoyed my stay here. Would be there again if I get back to Madrid.

Lola was there to receive us and wanted to make sure everything was perfect before she left. She checked on us during the week. She is an excellent Host. Her place is smack dab in the Centre of Madrid and every picture that shows her apartment is spot on. Perfect location! Walking distance to Plaza Mayor and museums. We will definitely stay there again.

Cynthia
Amazing and very comfortable apartment, we recommend! I want to decorate my home like that. Neighborhood is okay but very close to Grand Via, which has all the shops that you'll need!

This is the best we stay in Spain.
A big, nice, modern apartment, we love to stay.
Shower is fantastic & Jacuzzi is good.
Everything is clean and tidy.
Easy to find, near the shopping area, supermarkets.
Lola is kind to help us to find parking.

Lola was a fantastic host from the word 'go'! She was always quick to respond to any questions we had and very hospitable.
We travelled as a group of 4 ladies for 3 nights in Madrid before continuing our travels south to the coast for the remainder. Our flight out of Gatwick was delayed which meant we wouldn't make our arranged check-in time with Lola however without hesitation she re-arranged her schedule to suit out needs. On arrival, Lola helped us with seeking out a supermarket, local restaurants, and bars etc.
The apartment was just splendid! Perfect location (close to Gran via), better than the photos and kept spotless! A wonderful home!
We had a fantastic trip in Madrid and if we return we will be certain to contact Lola again. Thank you Lola for making our trip so perfect! Beth, Katie, Kim & Louise
We were made to feel really welcome. The photos were accurate and a perfect flat for 2 couples. 2 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms.

The flat is beautifully presented and very conveniently located. Lola was very attentive replying to questions promptly. It is in an old building although the flat itself recently decorated. Thus, the noises can be heard from next room or even upstairs.

We were over the moon with Lola's Moon. It is nicely furnished and clean. Located in a great area. Just 5 minutes walk away from Gran Via and Callao metro station. Restaurants, cafes and bakeries surround the apartment building. The place to stay when in Madrid. Highly recommend.

We booked the place about a few days before our arrival and unfortunately could only stay for a couple of days. The apartment is spacious, clean and absolutely charming. Someone met us at the apartment and walked us through all of the potential issues. The place is centrally located and near lots of interesting restaurants. Public transportation is easy as several Metro stops are nearby. My family wants to return next year.

This was a great apartment. Very well located . Just 2 minutes walk to gran via. Several grocery stores & small supermarkets near by
Would definitely stay here and recommend this place
Apartment itself was beautiful clean and very nice.

the toilet was missing a seat, we managed but it was inconvenient.
I was honest by informing the owner that the keys were stolen.
I could have just said they were lost.
I think it was unfair and greedy to charge me for an entire lock change considering that we booked a place to have the benefit of 2 toilets and we really had only one .

We had an absolutely fantastic time at this apartment. There are a few supermarkets within a 5 minute walk and a great bar across the road on the corner which is ideal after a day of sightseeing. The local area is actually better than the generic shops of any large city so check out your immediate surroundings. Great cafes, bars and independent shops selling all sorts. The apartment looks exactly as described and shown in the images. A perfect place to stay. Thanks, Michael.

The place has a old taste to it but very private and quiet at the same time. Whatever you need is a few steps away from restaurants to pharmacy to a bar. I recommend this place to anyone that is visiting Madrid
We had a nice time staying at moon. it is centrally located and all places are within walking distance. have all the basic amenities in the house.

Very nice, luxury apartment in a nice neighbourhood with everything you need just a few steps a way.
Everything was very clean.
An apartment in which we wanna stay forever!
The owner is very friendly, easy reachable, answers e-mails very soon.

Lola was very kind and allowed us to drop our luggage off early and we were able to check in early as well.  The individual room air conditioners are a definite plus as it was 100-103 every day.  The apartment location is great - very close to Metro stop.  Great place to stay!
The apartment is very centrally located. Walking distance to all the shops, restaurants and nightlife. Must consider staying in this apartment.
Apartment as described. Host made everything’s easy for us with no hassles. Great location for that neighborhood (convenience stores and parking nearby)
Location was amazing and the flat was as advertised.   We appreciated the space and easiness of the check-in.
Great place! Central to everything. The beds aren’t the most comfortable and are most like two twin beds pushed together, but overall great place.

We were very happy with our stay. Everything as described in the listing.
Be aware that check-in or luggage drop before 12am is not possible.
A very nice and clean apartment in the center of Madrid. From there You can easily reach a lots of places to visit. Jose Pablo and his team are very kind and helpful. Suggested!

Antonio met us when we arrived earlier from the train station then the posted check in time. They have maps and brochures, condiments, and first aid supplies in the apartment. There is an elevator in the building, but there are a few steps as you wind your way through the cord or to their front door. The front door and living room face and interior hall.
The best thing about this apartment is it's incredible location. It is very easy walking distance to the cathedral, the Alcazar, and many restaurants.

We had a great time in this apartment. Jose was really flexible with us when we had to change our arrival date and then when we got stuck in delays at the airport. The apartment was in a fantastic location and we walked everywhere from here. Would definitely stay here again.

Fantastic location for a short stay apartment is small and compact and well presented but air on caution if you like a comfortable bed as the ones weren’t and the bed linen is a little tired
The kitchen could do with a few more utensils but is adequate

Location is amazing, right around the corner to the beautiful Plaza Mayor and Mercado San Miguel. The apartment was comfortable, with beds for five, and air conditioning in the living room. Upstairs loft bedroom had no air conditioning, and although a fan was provided, it was very hot. Host allowed us to use the washing machine. Kitchen was well-appointed. Fourth floor apartment had a small elevator, which only fit two people at a time. Stairs are polished hardwood, beautiful but slippery, and my son fell and bounced down several steps before stopping. Close to Puerta del Sol and subway entrance. I would recommend this apartment to families of five.
Really enjoyed our stay.  The location was amazing. We were steps away from plaza mayor.  The Juliet balconies are really lovely too.

The location of the appartement is perfect. However, the sofa is completely destroyed, we had to clean the floor every morning and every night because small pieces of the sofa were everywhere and on top of that we didn’t have a vacuum! Then, the kitchen lacks all ustensiles, it’s quite impossible to cook and for a ten day stay this was a problem. Moreover, one of the chairs was completely broken. To finish, the room in the kitchen is not as shown. Overall, our stay coule have been way better… The furniture in the apartment should be renewed

Great Location and smooth check in.
Poor quality of furniture. The bed was not even a proper bed. Torn and broken Sofa.

Luis is so friendly, nice and helpful! He met us early at the apartment, showed us around and gave us helpful tips about the city. The communication was great, always available to help and answer questions. The apartment was very clean and prepared, and it was spacious for the two of us even though it seemed a little bigger in the pictures. I think that even for four it would be fine, since we all come to visit and delight in the city not spend too much time inside :) The location is fantastic, everything is literally on your doorstep, and if you explore the streets, just off the main street, you will find many hidden gems. For us, it was the first experience with AirBNB, and it was a great one! Definitely recommend and definitely will re-book!
The location was amazing! jose Pablo was really friendly and helpful whenever we needed anything. The apartment was lovely and we really enjoyed our stay! Thank you :)

Had a great stay in this apartment. The location is absolutely perfect - literally 50metres to Plaza Mayor, 100metres to Mercado San Miguel. Easy check in, great communication, no problems at all. Will definitely return!

The apartment looks better in the pictures than in reality.  It's irritating  that the apartment is equipped with very cheap things, which fall apart (clothes hanging, wire shelf in the bathroom, toilet paper holder, towel holders, locks on the balcony door...) I didn't manage to turn on the air conditioning (which, maybe, is my fault  ?!) , so it was cold, without the possibility of an additional blanket.  All this is probably secondary to the host considering that the location is selling the place! Communication with the host was ok, except for the initial misunderstanding about the internet (which would have been avoided if the correct information about the network and password was available in the apartment, instead of at  contact with the host). All praise goes to the central location of the apartment from where the sights of Madrid are accessible on foot!!! It was a pleasure to go around Madrid on foot and not use public transport!

Location is great, access easy via lift but note there are a small number of steps to negotiate, not an issue for us. Beware that storage location for clothes etc is very limited, and the shower is quite cramped in case that’s important for you.
Great location, we didn’t need any transportation during our stay because we were able to walk everywhere! Very responsive and accommodating host. My family and I had a wonderful time in Madrid.

excellent price in good location, has everything needed.
Owners are responsive and helpful
The lock on the door sometimes doesn't work and is basically holding the door with tape...the app to enter the building also doesn't work so check in was harder.

Carlos was a great host, although he was not in Madrid at the time, we were able to reach him through email. The apartment is well located and has every basic need, it was also clean and the furniture is in a good condition. It is a good place to stay if you like shopping ( lots of shops around).

It was exactly how I imagined it. Comfortable, clean, pretty and in a great location.
Only a few minutes from the tube.. The closest bar is just across the road.. Restaurants and a lot of shops within 2 minutes walking distance, if not less.
Very spacious bedroom, with a lot of storage space and lovely soft bedding. oh and a nice powerful shower.
I was very happy with my choice and Carlos was easily contactable at all times..

Wow, a great apartment in a great neighborhood. The apartment is surrounded by dozens of amazing restaurants within walking distance. Just a mile walk to the biggest park in the city. We will definitely be staying here again next time we travel to Madrid!
Super nice loft !! Located in a very chic neighborhood !! Carlos is an excellent host who's very helpful and replies to texts promptly !!

Great place in an excellent location.
Small but perfect for couple of nights in Madrid.

Great place if you are looking to stay in the center of Madrid.
I have stayed already couple of times when traveling for business to Madrid and I am planning to stay again.

The apartment was perfect:
1. Studio apt is perfect size
2. Location is amazing
3. perfectly clean
4. it has reception service
5. reality and pics match.
will look to rent again. fabulous

Our host was absolutely incredible- so accommodating for my particular situation, and so easy to communicate with! Location was perfect. Highly recommend and would definitely like to stay here again next time!!!

We had wonderful 5 days in studio of Carlos.
Everything was great , apartment is located pretty close to metro station - 5-8 minutes of walk.
We highly recommend to stay in Carlo’s apartment.

Location is great, restaurants, cafes and shops in walking distance. The apartment is small and cosy and has everything you need. I can recommend this place for a short stay, for a longer stay you may want a bigger space or a separate room.
Carlos is very responsive; the apartment is in great condition and perfect location. We enjoyed our time here and would book again!

Was a great apartment to stay in a very nice location. Beautiful apartment as well. The shower was probably my favorite part, it was always hot and I could control the temp to the degree. It’s a short walk from but the metro and the bus line so it was very easy to get around the city as well. The area is very affluent so I always felt safe walking at any time of the day. There’s also a grocery store next door that’s very convenient. Would definitely stay again.
Really enjoyed my time in this airbnb. Very clean and comfortable inside. It's in a quiet and peaceful area. I enjoyed the bars, restaurants, and shopping all within walking distance.

Frank was a great host! He explained us very clearly the apartment'so functions. The borough was perfect, in the middle of madrid ! It was really clean, as the description. Frank was very free to answer. I recommand this flat. Thanlet you very much !

Our trip to Madrid exceeded our expectations thanks to Carlos!
We unfortunately couldn't be accommodated in the apartment due to unexpected works in it, but Carlos found a wonderful back-up solution and I will never stop thanking him for that.
One word: GO!
You won't regret your choice.
Carlos' airbnb is in a great location and is very spacious for two people. The automated check-in system is easy and very convenient. Recommend
Very well-equipped residence. Very well organized. The only little problem is the drainage in the restroom. Rest all very well.

Great apartment for the price.  Had a great stay in Madrid.  This studio is super clean, has a nice kitchenette, and close to some of the best neighborhoods in Madrid.  Carlos was very helpful and the lines of communication were always open.  Thanks!

Carlos & Victoria were super helpful with giving nearby ATMs, ways of transportation from airport, etc. Really bad wifi / barely any cell reception. However, last day I came down with flu & bronchitis and they allowed me to stay as long as needed for the day past check out which was so kind!
Good position, near all the Madrid attractions !There are two metro station near the flat and a lot of bar, market and restaurants.
Carlos was a wonderful host! Excellent and quick communication. The listing is very accurate. I would stay here again!  Thank you!

The apartment is nice and it is very conveniently located close to the train station and airport bus. I was only there one night so I did not take advantage of any of Mercedes' knowledge of the city. I would recommend staying here.

Even though I was worried because I didn't manage to stamp out and to fill in the forms with our information the whole procedure was easy and quickly, thanks to Victoria who waited our arrival in her office in the same building. There was everything needed in the flat. The place is really close to the main tourist attractions, we never took public transport in 4 days.
Good place in a central location. Automatic check-in instructions were clear and easy to follow, and the room was as expected

Carlos and Victoria's apartment is superb. It is close to the centre of Madrid as mentioned and the proximity of the metro station is simply the most convenient. The place is sparkling clean, comfortable and cosy  live in. There are lots of supermarkets, restaurants of cuisines varying from Spanish to Indian to Peruvian as well. We had a wonderful time here and would love to spend our next Madrid holiday in any of their apartments. A big thanks for hosting us.

Good location away from busy areas, some minor issues with maintenance inside the property. The only window doesn't close entirely and the bathroom floods after every shower but a squeegee is provided for you to clean up. Note that the host is a business that insists on making you send a copy of your passport prior to check in, I guess to save them meeting you and getting a copy in person. At the time I booked the website of the business was down and I could not access their privacy policy.

The appartement is really well situated and really clean.
Maribel and Jose were very accommodating and flexible. They are also very responsive to messages. I recommend this apartment for a stay in Madrid. Thank you very much for your welcome.
Mathilde

The room is very nice and comfy, quiet, perfectly clean and with a great bed. It's a 5min walking distance of the Atocha train station. The Parque del Retiro is 5-10min away.
Mercedes is a very nice host.

Mercedes was a great host. Everything was clean and the room/bathroom was very nice. The house is located very close to the airport and a short bus ride away from the center of Madrid. Definitely recommend this house!
The place was very cool and well decorated, the host was incredibly welcoming and the location was conveniently close to the main train station.  Excellent place!

The communication with Mercedes was effortless and she was very helpful in getting to the apartment and how to get around Madrid! The room was very clean and comfortable, and other facilities were available as well. Mercedes was easy-going and a generous hostess and I had a pleasant stay at her apartment!
Mercedes is a very nice person. I enjoyed a lot my stay in her appartment. She's very flexible and very helpful. Clean and nice bedroom, everything was perfect!

I really loved staying in Mercedes place, such a cosy home with artistic atmosphere. Mercedes was very helpful with information on the places I wanted to go, and it was nice to souk real Spanish atmosphere. The location is very convenient as well. And the best thing I slept like a baby, so rested well. Thank you Mercedes, muchisimas gracias

The Airbnb from Maribel and Jose was nice, clean and well equipped. It’s also very central. Maribel and Jose are sympatic and reliable hosts. The communication worked well, they were easily accessible at all times. It was also great that they helped us to organized the taxi back to the airport. We would spent time there again and can recommend this place.

Great location, very accurate to listing. The shower is the same level as bathroom, so make sure you tilt the shower head towards the wall and it’s fine. Also our bedsheets kept coming off, which was a little annoying. Other than that great for a stay in madrid!

Maribel & Jose's place is in a great location, four minutes from the lavapies subway station and walking distance to many interesting places, including plaza sol.
Very clean, great communication and complete in extra accessories. Would definitely come back. Thanks

Location is ok but the value for the money is not there. Poorly equipped kitchen, bathroom
Needs moping after shower, neighbors’ noise is pretty bad. The area felt unsafe.
great air BnB, I'm disabled and the bathroom was fantastic and made my stay so much easier. Really good restaurants very close, try the caravan cafe for breakfast!! thanks for a great stay

Very close to ¨Parque del Retiro¨ and downtown, which helps a lot if you don`t know Madrid, the place is stlylish and full of designed items, very clean and the builiding represents the madrid Clasico, Mercedes and her friends are willing to help and give a hand if necessary,  with tons of tips, all in all it was more than I expected.

Most beautiful house I've ever been.
The host, Mercedes was kind and sweet. I really loved the place.
We had a great  time in Madrid and we really appreciate the tranquillity in the  flat after a busy day discovering  Madrid.  . Thank you very much Mercedes for your warm hospitality!

My stay at Mercedes’ place was fantastic. Her apartment has really nice design but most of all I had a very comfortable stay and I had everything I needed. The apartment is in a great location to get into the centre, with the metro station being only a few minutes away! Mercedes was also very pleasant to talk with. Highly recommended this place if you are looking for somewhere to stay in Madrid.
The stay was great. The apartment was clean and in a perfect location. Most things were walkable and there was lots of good food and drinks in the neighborhood. We felt really safe and comfortable.
Great neighbourhood, but the apartment was dingy and did not feel like particularly good value. Wouldn't stay there again

Maribel and Jose were very responsive and flexible hosts. They worked with us to accommodate changing plans and went out of their way to provide alternative solutions when needed. Their listings are as-described and great for the price.

Apartment is really near city center, but it has bad sound isolation(you can hear people from above and everybody who enter and leave their apartments) so it was hard to get a good sleep. Also after some time bathroom started to smell bad. Place requires some small repairs as well. Shower has poor design, so be ready that your bathroom will have wet floor al the time. Overall good place for one night stand due to it localization, but bad for longer one.

Perfect location - 5min walking to Sol metro station, plenty of restaurants and nightclubs around (and yet peaceful on the street). The only issue is that even though the apartment can fit 3-4 people, there is barely enough hot water for 3 people to take a shower. In addition, the bathroom floods after a shower so you have to push the water to the hole yourself.

Location was great! It was a good walking distance to the main attractions but the neighbourhood isn’t the cleanest.
The bathroom situation was a bit annoying as it can be very slippery-not me mopping after every shower haha😂. It could use a bit more counter space and the medicine cabinet is in an awkward spot.
Maribel & Jose are very responsive. Check-in/check-out was easy.
Overall, we had a nice decent stay!
Mercedes is a gracious host: kind, friendly, caring and helpful. Staying with her and her beau is one of the nicest experiences I’ve had while traveling. Highly recommended!

The accommodation was exactly as in the offer. The hosts were very nice and helpful. All the famous parts of Madrid were only few minutes away by metro. The price is also excellent. I would definitelly come back!
The flat was in a great location. It was very clean and comfortable. Maribel & Jose left very clear instructions to get into the flat and had great communication.
The best part is that the location is in a quiet community. Walking around Madrid, I could imagine the noise coming from the streets reaching the rooms in upstairs accommodations.

Mercedes,
She makes the stay of her guests very pleasant. Her house is very nice, well located and offers a lot of comfort.
I would definitely repeat.

Place is quiet, clean and convenient (within 10min walk to atocha station and retiro park). Room was small with a ceiling fan and window- but AC was not on.
Expect to share a bathroom with another Airbnb person.
I would highly recommend staying!
A serene space between Atocha Station and El Retiro park.  Mercedes was kind and charming.  I’d highly recommend staying here, but not when I’m in town, please.

Lovely apartment, great host, cute dog, fantastic location.
Mercedes was extremely to me and respected my personal time. I would highly recommend staying at her place 🙏

Mercedes home felt like home away from home. And she is the kindest most hospitable host anyone would wish to stay with. We will definitely stay in touch with Mercedes and stay with her next time. We were over 5 hours delayed to check in and Mercedes waited for us and cancelled all her other appointments for the day waiting for us. This was very gracious and kind of her to do so.
