Also Mercedes dog, Nina is the most gorgeous little dog. Super sweet and friendly as well. Thank you Mercedes for your kindness and hospitality, you are one of the greatest host and we are so happy to have met you.

Short but unforgettable stay in Madrid. Mercedes and Juan Carlos were very hospitable. Nina their dog accompanied us with morning coffee and tea as well as evening conversations. A few days stay in Madrid turned into a friendship for many years. Thank you for everything..
Stay healthy. Katarzyna and Emilia

Our stay in Madrid was great. The apartment was in a great location. Frank was there to greet us, he was very helpful. It's perfect for two people. The wifi wasn't very strong in the apartment and the laundry is in a separate unit. But you have your own key. Frank let us leave our bags in the office after we checked out because we had a late bus, it helped us out a lot. Would highly recommend and would stay again.

You want the best trip in madrid? So stop searching. Carlos and frank are the best choice for you. We had agreat apprtment that give us everything we need and more, the apartment is close to every place you want to see (we didn't use the train at all) and also frank was very helpful and nice. We will defently come back.

It was really nice location, its walking distance to some highlight spot in Madrid, but the area is quiet, so we can sleep very well. The unit is really nice, clean, simple, and completed.
Thanks to Carlos who really punctual to wait for us at midnight in winter time!

We had the privilege to stay in two different flats and top marks from us!!! Very clean, comfortable beds (with fresh pillows and duvets), basic but functional with every thing you need. Lovely area of Madrid, a mixture of traditional, bohemian and migrant. Lively area but quiet flat. Very conviniently positioned to reach all amenities of Madrid easily. Lots of amazing restaurants and takeaways around. The host (not sure whether it was Frank or Carlos) was extremely helpful. Thank you!!!

A very central location with 10 mins walking distances to el centro. Lavapies itself is a vibrant part of the city where you can find many cultures which was a big plus for us. Carlos & Frank explained whatever we have asked them and we would definetly recommend the accomodation.

Carlos was there to me us as we arrived and took us up to our apartment and explained everything we needed to know.  He advised us on places to visit and the best Metro lines to take during our stay.  The apartment was exactly as described and was in a perfect location for getting around Madrid.  I would definitely stay in one of Frank and Carlos's apartments again.  Super stay!
We had such a great Saturday at Madrid! Thankyou again Carlos! Your apartment was so clean and just as in the pictures!

Great place equipped with everything you need for your stay in Madrid.The flat is central located in walk distance to the main attractions.Nearby there are grocery stores, cafes and many restaurants.Atocha train station is 10 min. away so you can easily arrange your journey to the airport or other spanish cities.Carlos is a great host,he was always available for questions and directions and we really appreciate his hospitality.Definitely we will visit Carlos's apartment again in our next visit to Madrid!!!
We had a great weekend break at Carlos's apartment! Perfect location, we didn't realise we were in walking distance to almost everything. He's a great host, happy to help with very prompt replies.
We spend nice week in Madrid. Apartment is very well located, about 15 minutes from centre.
We haven’t stay in this place, we cancel a soon as we get there because insecurity and bad location.

Carlos & Victoria's apartment was great, cosy, clean and had all the amenities we needed for a comfortable stay. The shower was hot & strong pressure, TV with lots of channels, wi-fi with great coverage, cooktop and small fridge. We didn't miss anything during our stay, which is wonderful considering we have 2 small kids.
Carlos and Victoria are great hosts, always available and respond to messages quickly. Very flexible and open to do arrangements you need according to your time requirements. We met Victoria personally, who is a very sweet and helpful lady.
The building is located walking distance from the main touristic attractions of the city and near many metro stations. You can go anywhere easily, at any time. The neighbourhood may seem strange at first, but it's very laid back with people from different cultures minding their own business. Safe and fun to walk around.
We will be staying there in our next trip to Madrid for sure!
Good central location for sightseeing. Very helpful hosts who were flexible around our check in and check out times

The location was great. The place was as expected. We didn’t see the hosts but they were available through text. We were able to walk to every important point in the city. Very closed to a Metro station and to supermarkets. The only problem was that we didn’t feel safe walking through the park next to the building, but overall, a great experience.
Carlos' property was in a great spot. Walking distance to all of Madrid's major tourist spots. He was quick to respond to any questions we had and was flexible with his check in time
We loved our stay here! It was perfect for us. It was very clean, the heater worked, it was easy to check in and it was in a great central location. We would stay here again.
A really nice apartment. Clean, comfortable, you can reach everything by foot. The only downside is the noise issolation. You can hear the neighbours quite well.

I highly recommend the place. Clean, cozy, perfect for a couple. The location is just amazing- quiet, yet very central. We walked absolutely everywhere since it was so well located. Thumbs up all the way!

Great value for money. Location is just perfect, walking distance to many atractions as well as metro station. If you have big luggage taxi to Atocha railway station is just a couple of euro. We stay 3 nights.

Had an amazing stay in Madrid. The apartment was spacious, clean and very central. Communication was clear and quick and Maribel and Jose were fantastic hosts.
We loved how central the apartment was to everything and close to the metro for getting in from the airport.
I would definitely stay here again if I came back to Madrid.

Great accommodation in a spacious studio, very clean and equipped. The communication was easy and the procedure well organized. The area is alternative and multicultural, very close to many places of interest. Recommended.
Lovely good value apartment a short walk from all the main tourist locations☺️ And with amazing help and communication from Maribel and Jose☺️

the location is great, easy and close to some places around. host very helpful. any time u want just text her and she will help. the studio is clean and tidy. easy to move from airport by bus or train. only 1 thing is the wall inside the room is very thin we guessed, u can hear everything in next room.
I had very nice stay in this airbnb. It’s the perfect getaway for a couple of days and the location is great.
Check in was very quick and simple. Unfortunately no wifi, and there was a questionable stain on couch that we avoided

Fantastic location, so close to Sol and the center and very quiet street which is close to playground for kids so no noise at night at all  and easy to sleep. Instructions were very clear about how to get there and how to enter in the house. I recommend it if you want to be in the center of the city, very handy. I know Madrid from the past and the area of this apartment it is quite renovated and very safe with many tourist. We were very happy with our choice :).
I felt very well in this house. Everything was as it was described. The area is quiet, close to the metro and the center. I will definitely come back!
Maribel & Jose’s listing was right in the heart of Madrid! It was very clean, easy to get in, and they were very communicative hosts. We would stay here again!

Thanks to Maribel & Jose for creating a cosy and functional space.
The area is very handy for access to the sites. I would say that it does feel like a somewhat deprived area, and I understand some comments. However, we had absolutely no trouble and enjoyed our stay.
I would recommend this place to anyone looking for a base to explore Madrid all day and be in walking distance of excellent food and bars.
Beautiful apartment! Great for two/three people. Located near the city center, clean and complete with everything you need for your stay. The hosts was very friendly and helpful

This apartment is so cute and in a quiet street which was perfect. The beds were comfortable and there was washer dryer in the building for free. The only thing I’ll mention is the shower head was broken so you have to hold it but that was really it. Definitely recommend staying here

Instructions were clear and the host is flexible for check in.
The appartement is close to all touristic attractions, I recommend it !
We really enjoyed our stay at this apartment, it was very central and we were able to see alot of the city!

My family and I really felt like home!
Nereo was very helpful, the appartement is very quiet, well located (metro station at 5mins walk) and most of all its very clean and tidy!! This is definitely the place to stay in Madrid.

Elena and Nereo was waiting for us when we arrived. They gave us the key and show us the apartment. It was nice and very clean. They are very accommodating, the building has an elevator which makes us easier to bring our luggage to their unit. The area was very close to market, where we bought meat and veggies.

Place was as described.  Location was fantastic and we attended several local celebrations during our stay.  Bus stop just outside got us to Del Padro fast, Line 1 is a 3min walk, though under repair until late 2016, so we took the bus to Pacifico Metro Stop and got Line 6 to get around.  Markets, lots of restaurants & shops nearby.  Quiet area, even at night.  Answered all questions and reliable communication.  Would stay there again!  Thanks!

The apartment is as advertised - clean, airy, and light. We were very comfortable during our stay. The location is very good, only a few minutes walking to the nearest metro station, with an array of shops nearby. Communication with the hosts was seamless, they replied to any questions and queries we had and were very responsive and proactive when the internet wasn't working on our arrival (it was an external fault!) We would definitely recommend this place for a long stay in Madrid.
Spent a week in the apartment. It’s very quiet and next to supermarket and metro. Easy to get to downtown Madrid. Hosta were super helpful and responsive! Would recommend anytime!

It was a spontaneous trip planned only a few days before departure, I contacted Barbara on rather short notice and she responded fast and so was the booking done quick. Communication was easy and straight-forward, and Barbara was friendly and happy to share trips near the apartment and around Madrid. The apartment is very well located just 100m from metro station and minutes walk to Reina Sofia Museum. Though we were only two, the apartment is great to accomodate at least 2 more persons. Despite being down with a cold, It was a great time in Madrid!
We went to Barbara's place for a weekend, it looks like in the pictures. Communication with Barbara was really easy and everything went great!

Location great location, very warm welcome, we were greatly advised. A follow-up of Barbara impeccable. Would recommend without hesitation. Besides if I return there will be going through Barbara. Success to her
The flat is beautiful, cozy and very well located, 10 minutes by walk from Puerta del Sol. The apartment looks like in the pictures. I recommend a stay here even for business reasons.

It was a great experience! Place has the best location. It’s small but worth it. Depending on how many people go. We didn’t have any issues with 3 people. Only one bathroom could make it chaotic if we are on a rush. Will Deff go there again for the location.

The house was as the photos show. Very cozy, clean and nicely equipped. The owner was just the best there is and very kind in all aspects. She even put some fresh flowers for us. The house is surrounded by shops that can be used to buy groceries and stuff for the house. I highly recommend the house and would come back if I had to.

I enjoyed staying at Raquel's place. She is a super nice person and her dog is the politest dog ever.
Moreover, there's an atmosphere of trust in the apartment which makes you feel at home. It also has everything you need and the terrace and the room are bigger than I expected them to be based on the photos. It's located close to Madrid's river which makes for amazing surroundings if you enjoy walking, the neighborhood offers several good restaurants but there's also a metro station with connection to the centre very close by. Next time I'm going to Madrid I'll definitely check availability.

Raquel was a great host, always responsive and friendly to make sure we could easily get there and feel at home. Her dog Trufa is adorable. We happened to forget a jacket after checkout and Raquel was so nice to contact us and wait for us to go pick it up before leaving Madrid.
Her appartment is located in a very peaceful neighbourhood next to San Isidro Park, so we could go for a nice walk, and even enjoy San Isidro's holiday which was happening those days.
There are many good restaurants around and the subway station and bus stop is at walking distance (5 min) from her house, which makes it very convenient even though it is a bit outside the center area.
Really worth and recommended!

Raquel’s place was beautiful. Exactly as described, great view from the terrace, comfortable, clean, and close to the metro. Her flatmate Chauncey was very helpful and friendly. It was a great place to spend 2 nights in beautiful Madrid.

Raquel is very nice person and answer the messages quickly. The room was neat. Because of the winter we didn't really used the terrace, althouh I bet it's a big plus in the summer. It was one of the cheaper options, and it's not the fancy if someone looks for one, but I think if someone looks just for a place to sleep, it's a good option, also because very convenient location - not far from the city center, metro station near, and the free paring around.
Host is very friendly and responsible and love the place it's beautiful and near so many sightseeing place and restaurants i would recommend this place to stay .

Birgit is wery kind.
She help you for everything. The apartment is very clean and tidy.
A very good experience.

Great location with Plaza Mayor right across the street and walking distance to many great sights in Madrid.  Reception was friendly upon arrival with great suggestions on things to see/do.  I'd definitely recommend staying here.

We had a great stay. Close to Metro, airport and lots of good restaurants, the flat was very comfortable and convenient. Our hosts thought of everything, providing us with maps, drinks, breakfast foods and even candies for our kids.

We had a great time in Madrid, Rodrigo came and met us at the apartment when we arrived even though it was late evening. He was very helpful and kept in good communication before our arrival. The apartment is in a great location, you can get to all the galleries very easily as well Puerta del Sol and Plaza Mayor. We had everything we needed for a short stay in Madrid.
Rodrigo was amazing! Our flight was late and he was very patient and waited for us. The place was gorgeous and perfect. We wanted to stay much longer!

We were met at the door by a friend of our host who took the time to explain us everything and give us some tips. The appartment fit the description, although it was quite dark. It was clean, but only one bed was made up and there were only two towels made available for a 5-night stay. The neighbourhood was very lively, but girls should be prepared for some cat-calling (nothing really threatening, just annoying). Close by the appartment is a great coffee-shop and a metro stop, and it's only a short walk to the city centre.

The apartment is just likes the photos. It was clean and had everything we needed for our stay. The Internet worked great and Rodrigo was quick to respond to any messages.
I would say that the location was questionable in regards to safety but once outside the inner location it was fine.
Everyone in the building was cordial when coming in or out.

Things were great!  Love the apartment, the layout worked well for the 3 of us who wanted to catch up and comfortable sharing a studio loft.  The neighborhood was edgy and interesting, great restaurants, art galleries and an international flare.

The flat was located exactly as it was described and is the same as in the photos. Rodrigo was there to meet me and was very friendly and helpful showing me how to work everything.

The flat has everything you need for a short time away, it's in a great location with all the amenities of Madrid at your doorstep. Beds were comfortable and the kitchen facilities were all that we needed. Thank you for a nice base to stay in :)

My husband and I and our two kids stayed at Rodrigo's apartment in Lavapies for three nights over half-term in February 2016. The location was great - within walking distance of pretty much everything we wanted to see, and a stone's throw from Lavapies Metro. Very quiet place to stay too.
Beautiful apartment near the city centre of gorgeous Madrid! Rodrigo and his mother were very nice and the apartment was identical to the pictures on the site. Would definitely visit them again!
Rodrigo was very responsive. The apartment was in a good location. The beds were the most comfortable beds of our entire trip!
The neighborhood was seedy. Good location for metro. Host was there once. He did not fix shower problem and denied there was one.

Meeting Rodrigo's mother was great, she helped us understand the neighbourhood we were in and really gave us a great description or what to expect while we were in Madrid. The flat was as advertised, everything was well appointed and perfect for what we needed, the only drawback was understanding the hot water heater, but once we got it we were fine. The main selling point of this flat is the location and the wonderful patio, which we used for breakfast along with the kitchenette which we used for breakfast preparation. The beds were wonderful, as wonderful as being within walking distance of a metro and the Reina Sofia museum. Overall, nothing but positive things to say about Rodrigo's flat, I'd stay in another of his listings anytime.
Rodrigo and his mother were very helpful. They gave us great advice regarding things to see. I felt very comfortable knowing that I could contact them at any time for anything.

We got a lovely welcome and the studio is very centrally located so we could walk everywhere, but we were a bit disappointed with the neighbourhood and the studio was smaller and darker than we expected.
Everything was great! A very "local" neighborhood, away from tourists like us. Place is exactly as described, perfect for the six of us

A very convinient flat! Next to all the main places to visit! Rodrigo was very helpfull!
Thank u for this stay :)
We enjoyed our stay at Rodrigo's place. It was clean,comfortable and centrally located. We would do it again. Thanks Rodrigo.
Everthing was good. The Appartment is good located. We just spent one Night at Rodrigo's Place. Thank you!

Very clean property and thoughtful preparations. The location of the apartment is about 5 minutes walk to a metro station and close to many restaurants and shops. The Mayor plaza and Sol area are within walking distance.  A good value.
The apartment was just what we needed for a weekend trip to Madrid. Rodrigo was very helpful with pointing out the best places to go. Great city, great apartment.
The location is very central and it is easy to reach all the most important monuments and museums. The loft is really amazing and it is perfect for 3-4 people.
This apartment is adorable and walkable to everywhere, with the metro station nearby. Hostess who checked us in was very kind and helpful about the apartment and the area.
The hostess was very nice.  The apartment was above our expectations.  We would highly recommend this booking.

All in all this place is great value for money. Perfect location, easy walking distance from everything. Rodrigo's mum was lovely. They could do with fixing the shower up to the wall and it would also be great if they could provide an extra set of keys for groups. Thanks for having us!

This apartment was exactly as described and only a short 10-20 mins walk to almost all of the major central attractions of Madrid.
The room and beds were comfortable with lots of extra space for 2-4 people.
We enjoyed it!

Great place, great location, we walked almost everywhere and there is a metro stop 200m away ,there’s a taxi rank 150m away and a 24hour supermarket.
Would recommend this place and would happily stay here Again 😀👍
Rodrigo was a great host. The apartment was close to the metro and many local restaurants in the area.

The location is great. Most of the things you want to see or do are within walking distance. And if not, then the subway is very close by. Rodrigo was very helpful. The apartment is comfortable and well equipped. Unfortunately it does not receive much daylight.

The location was in a vibrant, diverse area, and it was easy to walk to beautiful sites in the city. Rodrigo was friendly and professional and gave great tips for our stay. The apartment is modern, well air-conditioned, and comfortable. I recommend staying here!

The place is great. Very cool neighborhood - getting gentrified, but still has a great Afro-Spanish flavor. Some of the best times were at a block party down the street. Rodrigo was great and the place was as advertised. A/C worked great, stocked with dishes and utensils. Would highly recommend to the Airbnb community.
Beautiful stay, you won’t be disappointed. Rodrigo makes you feel right at home, and responds quick to give you the best stay.
Nice place. Has everything you need. Shower great. Hot water. Although parking is awful in the area. Very hard to find a space and when you do it’s very expensive. We spent the most money on parking.

We had an excellent stay at Rodrigo’s place. It’s in a great location a short walk from the city center with easy access to the metro. It is such a cute place and spacious for the city. There are many plugs in convenient places. The kitchen was great but, do note that there aren’t any sharp knives in the kitchen. Rodrigo gave quick responses and helped us with options for navigating from the airport. Very good experience.
Cute place for a few nights! Walking distance to lots of things and well connected to the metro. As with many apartments in the city, was a bit noisy. But overall very comfortable and pleasant!
We liked very much to stay in this house. Good location. We want to come back, for sure.
We stayed at the apartment over the Champions league Final and the apartment location was great. Supermarket nearby and also Metro!
A lovely, stylish space. If you’re traveling in a group, I would definitely recommend this loft for your stay in Madrid.
Very pleasant place to stay, close to the centre, spacious and comfortable. Rodrigo was very helpful with me and provided great service. Would recommend.
Comfortable, clean, good location. Easy check-in and out. Note that the property is on the ground floor
We loved staying at Rodrigos, great central location in Madrid. Best place we stayed in our 10 days between Portugal and Spain. Would return in a heartbeat. Thank you !

The layout of the place works for a group confortable. But the apartment is in a complex, the smell of food from the other apartment bothered us a lot. Then dogs barking all night long and door slamming.
Maybe if you are young ones perhaps the place would work.
I loved the location of the apartment- very authentic and close to the metro. Supermarket very handy with lots of places to eat and have coffee. The apartment was very comfortable for 3 of us.

This apartment is exactly like the photos. It’s amazing. So close to the centre and the beds are so comfortable, amazing location, shop right around the corner. The only bad thing is the walls are a little thin so you can hear your neighbours and they can hear you if you’re anyway loud. But all in all 10/10
Rodrigo’s BnB is wonderful. Excellent location so we could walk everywhere. We felt safe there. Café was very close. We highly recommend it.
We had a great time here! Mariví was very accessible by phone once we arrived and gave us a great explanation of the place and Madrid as well as lots of things to see

Awesome service!!!  The host gave us so much great information.  Loved the place!!  By far, for being my first time in Madrid this place made it feel like home!!  I totally recommend staying here!  The best of all was walking distance to all the best places you must visit when in Madrid.
Convenient location. Comfortable beds. Good for a short stay. Host was very helpful and communicative. Only problem: one key for the whole apartment. Besides that, our stay was great.

The apartment is in a great location in centro to explore the city, especially at night with plenty of bars and restraunts close by. All the streets felt very safe.
The apartment itself was set back in the building so very quite and it has a nice finish. Made an excellent base for exploring Madrid.

Lovely little place and very nice and helpful hosts.
Very clean, apart from a couple of cockroaches in the flat, but that might be just a thing in Spain.
Great location!

Excellent hosts, always so responsive and friendly. The place was just as listed. We really enjoyed our stay here, very close to local amenities, accessible and super cute. Would absolutely stay here again!

Great place, would be great for any group of lads or a family.
Rodrigo was an absolutely amazing host in terms of communication and providing information about Madrid

Amazing place to stay in Madrid. Lavapiés is such a vibrant neighborhood. The house itself is very well located, close to the metro and to the Puerta de Atocha train station.
The house is quite functional and can easily fit a whole family. Very good deal.
Everything was nice, the house was beautiful as well as comfortable, it is near the city centre as well as the Museo Reina Sofia, the host was helpful and polite!
Enjoyed meeting Victoria. She let us in and gave us good tips about the area and our next journey.
Great location to get away from the city center: Sol. Place is tidy and clean. Meeting with the host was straight forward. They provided us with lots of info about Madrid!

3 of us had a comfortable stay in the Lavapiés apartment- with good air conditioning! Maria Victoria met us at the door when we arrived and showed us around the apartment. The location, although not the smartest area, is very convenient for the price. The kitchen area is small - we did not attempt to cook there, but it had most of the items we wanted for preparing cold foods.
It was awesome ! We recommend this place if you’re going to spend a few days in Madrid 😊

Perfect location within 10/15 min walk to Plaza Mayor and central shopping and restaurants.
Apartment was lovely so chilled and peaceful with so much character and charm
We loved our stay and having Rosa meet us at the location on check in was so reassuring and welcoming
Thank you so much

I had a great time in madrid, Love it! Claudia was really helpful, although we had a bit of language barrier but with google translate everything was ok and fun, she was always responsive. the room was clean and its really close to city centre.
It was not a 5 star HOTEL but it indeed was a comfortable place to have a great time for few nights. I recommend it ;)
It's a great place which makes me feel like home.Claudia is very nice and her lovely pets are very adorable.I can't wait to go agin

Claudia was excellent. She was very kind, welcoming, and helpful. I had taken a few years of Spanish in high school, but I wasn't as good as I thought I was. There was a little bit of a language barrier, but Claudia was ready to go with a translator on her phone! The keys were a bit tricky, so make sure you pay attention when she shows you. There were 3 metro stops in a 4 minute radius which was super convienent. Claudia showed me around Lista (the neighborhood) and even took me to lunch. She made my Madrid trip special and I would recommend her room to anyone looking for the real deal.

Claudia made me very welcome to her place. Although it was a small flat with a tiny bathroom, she was respectful of my space. She was very warm, friendly and helpful. It was like sharing a flat with a friend.
The location was central with an access to two metro lines within 2 minutes of walk. It was in a quite residential area but still had a few local tapas bars. I would recommend Claudia's place.

Claudia is an amazing host, a kind, gentle soul who makes you feel right at home. The room and the whole apartment is very clean and her home in general has a very zen feel to it. I found the location suited me as it was very close to metro stations, but definitely not in a touristy area. Would stay again.

Claudia is a wonderful host! She is very welcoming, relaxed and open, and things couldn't run more smoothly.  Her apartment is in a very nice area of Madrid and is situated within a few minutes walk of Diego de Leon Metro station. Recommended for a Madrid stopover!

Claudia was very nice and very hospitable (even giving me tea in the evenings), and the room was very nice, although not very private.  Comfortable bed. Great location, near lots of shops, restaurants, etc.
Very nice place and very nice host. Claudia has been very helpful and caring and made sure to provide me with an amazing stay

Claudia is a very gentle, friendly and warm lady, she has been really helpful, flexible with checkin and checkout times and we had some small nice conversations that made my stay nicely personal.
Her place is nicely decorated, colourful and well located (easy access to many metro stops and walkable distance from park Retiro). Thank you Claudia for having me in your house!
Claudia's place is between 3 metro stations for easy access to the city.  Great pizzeria just downstairs.  Kitchen that guests can use, and good internet.
Claudia is a great host! She is supernice! The room is comfortable and clean! The house is really well located!
A pretty place close to metro station, lovely environment. Claudia is such a nice and warmhearted person, she made me a wonderful breakfast in the morning. Strongly recommend this place.

Claudia is a very friendly and welcoming host who does her best to make sure her guest is settling in comfortably. She is flexible in the check-in/out arrangement, and easy to reach in case of questions or emergency.
A very convenient place. Very easy to find. On top of that Claudia is super friendly. Amazing hospitality- vitamin drinks, good tips on where to go. Recommendation 10/10.

The room is great to stay and worth the money. Claudia and her friend Maria are very nice hosts and friendly. However, the bathroom is a bit small and I have suggested Claudia to improve only on this aspect. Otherwise, the location is great and convenient.

I had a great stay. The neighbourhood is very authentic Madirdian and friendly. It is close to Metro and buses. From here you can explore all of Madrid quite easily.  When I arrived my luggage was lost for 3 days. Maria, was very understanding and helpful during this time and helped me to get my luggage back by talking to the airline. I had a great week at Padilla. If you speak Spanish communication would be easier but for us Google translation worked just fine.

Very well placed apartment and very kind host.
The room was quite basic, small common bathroom, but clean and Claudia is very kind and helpful.

Staying at Claudia's place was a great experience!! Everything was clean, she was very friendly and supportive. The location of the flat is really good, quite central with very easy access to the metro and tons of quality places to eat nearby. I can definitely recommend it!!!

I had a wonderful stay. The place is walking distance to many places. And the host is very kind and considerate. I had a late flight so they allowed me to do a very late check out because there were no immediate guests. I recommend it and I would come back again if I find myself back in madrid! ☺️

I recently stayed at Claudia's place and had a wonderful experience. Although I was informed a day before my stay that Claudia would be away, her niece Tatiana was in touch with me and made sure that everything was taken care of.
Despite being late for check-in due to my flight, Tatiana was very flexible and accommodating in helping me with the check-in process. Everything went smoothly and I had a good stay. The only downside was that the toilet was a bit small, but it wasn't a major issue for me.
Overall, I had a great experience at Claudia's place. Tatiana was an excellent host and made sure that my stay was comfortable and enjoyable. The apartment is also in a great location for exploring the city and is a good option for a short stay. I would highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a welcoming and comfortable Airbnb experience.

My best Airbnb experience to-date! Claudia was very friendly and helped me out a lot with navigating Madrid. The neighborhood is conveniently located next to numerous metro stations making it easy to travel. There is also an endless supply of restaurants, bars, and shopping centers close by to her house. Claudia does an extremely good job of keeping everything clean and tidy. She's there to answer any questions that you have, especially as it relates to art and culture. I can't recommend her enough!!

Claudia was very nice. She would contact me in advance to confirm my arrival time and recommend the route to my accommodation based on my mode of transportation. The home is also very clean. Even though I don't speak Spanish, Claudia also actively communicated with me using translation software. She is really very friendly. recommend!

Claudia was amazing! Super friendly and  such a nice person to talk to! Very courteous and willing to help! Offer various recommendations and place was super clean! Everything you need for a short stay!

Great location! The flat is comfortable but basic commodities were not provided: for example there were not any cutleries in the flat.
The welcome bar was very much appreciated.

Photos showed at the web site are deceiving. This place is a dump. WIFI does not work, shower too small for a regular size person, high risk of burning yourself. Sofa bed unfit to allow person to sleep comfortably. Poor ventilation, AC is a device placed on top of a drawer and noisy.  Suitable for somebody to crash overnight and not asking for too much. Not suitable for a family. On the positive side the location is perfect, walking distance to La Gran Via.

Great Location,
close to most attractions and the Metro,the flat did what we needed ie a place to put our heads down.
had everything we needed.
no problems checking in or out .
Basically very good place! Clean and good location. But the ground floor is a little bit damp and bleak. And sometimes the internet runs slow and badly. Also the signal is bad.

great location.  Can walk to everything,  very near the city center, plazas and great shops and restaurants.  In a residential neighborhood with a lot of convenient stores for groceries and fruit as well as local spots to eat at, which were better priced than the ones in the plazas.  Metro stop conveniently nearby.
Such a good location, very central! Building difficult to enter as lock not the easiest to operate, this may be a common thing in Madrid though with old doors.

Melvin's place is very well located, we basically walked everywhere. The apartment is nice and has everything you need. Check in and check out was very easy and communication was very clear. Thanks for everything Melvin, we had a great time.

The place was really close to the heart of Madrid.  There are a lot of markets (that close late) and places to eat. Also a lot of pubs and bars nearby. The only problem of the apartment is that it has one window in the living room and the bathroom had mold on the ceiling so there was a unpleasant smell.
This was a great place to stay for the price! Amazing location very close to the center of the city. Comfortable stay and safe location. We felt very safe and happy with our stay
Cozy place with a good location, it's close to everything in the city specially Grand Via with historic places and stores. I will recommend or stay in this place again.
Patricia was super welcoming and helpful. She accommodated our time schedule both for check in and for check out. Very spacious apartment, with all sorts of amenities. Fantastic location, too!

Great stay at Patrícia's house, it's everything brand new and there's plenty of space.
Its location is really central, in a very pleasing area.
I'll surely come back and recomend it to everyone!
Muchas gracias, Patrícia!
Patricia and Jose were very helpful, we had a couple of problems with hot water and electricity but the apartment was amazing and very comfortable!

We had 3 fulfilled days in Madrid staying at this absolutely lovely apartment!   Patricia was a fantastic host and the apartment was spotless, spacious and wonderfully located.   We lived at the Mercado de la Paz everyday!  A must if you stay with Patricia!!   Thanks again for having us!  We will be back again soon...

Patricia and Juan are perfect hosts. The house is in a wonderful location, close to everything and well appointed. Juan and Patricia were available to help with our needs - from airport transfer, local guides and everything else.

Patricia's apartment was as described. We were a group of 4 adults and 4 kids and we all had plenty of space to move around comfortably. The location was the best part, a fun, lively, neighborhood within walking distance to the metro, parks, restaurants and markets.

Patricia is a fantastic host.    I can't say enough about this apartment.. the location is great, close to a wonderful market, shops, boutiques...etc.    You really feel like you are mixing in with the locals, but just around the corner you have all the tourist sights.    A perfect blend.
Excellent place to stay in the beautiful city of Madrid !! Great host, superb central location and a lovely neighbourhood makes this place an ideal one to explore the city.

Thanks a lot to Jose and Patricia for being lovely hosts... place was clean and comfortable... Well-equipped kitchen, location was very convenient to good bars, restaurants and public transport..Jose was so friendly and hospitable..Would absolutely recommend this place..
Everything was great, great location and the apartment was very clean and has everything you need. The hosts were great to.
Great apartment in a nice neighborhood.  Lots of bedrooms and bathrooms.  Comfortable beds. Fun locations.  Would stay there again.
Patri&Jose are great hosts. The place and area are amazing. We would definitely come again. Best recommendation!

The apartment has an excellent location.  It has 2 grocery stores nearby and close to all major shopping and restaurants.  We were walking home very late at night some nights and felt very safe in neighborhood.  Apartment is very comfortable and well stocked!
The place is great, big and perfectly well located. The place was clean and the host was responsive and helpful. We had a great stay.

Excellent property. Accurately described. Patricia is great communicator.
We stayed here for the marathon and the location was perfect.
Patricia was very helpful and replied to all my questions very fast. She is a great host.

Place was spacious and clean and Patricia was kind enough to let us change our dates without penalty. Very conveniently located across from a market and many luxury shops. 3 bathrooms which was a bonus for us and quite clean.
Unfortunately the air conditioning did not working properly throughout the duration of our stay and being 40 degrees outside meant this was an issue . The unit seemed to be minimally working and this meant it wasn’t super hot rather warm without any air circulation … I did request repair but after some initial back and forth never heard back about this and no one attended during our time there. Water pressure in the showers was very low barely above a dribble at times . Lastly the wifi password provided was incorrect thus we were unable to access during our stay.

The Apartment is good, good location but IT DOES NOT HAVE WIFI. The ad says it has WIFI but it is not true. The host is a liar and after you arrive they make you believe that the is going to fix it. Which is also a lie. I asked Airbnb a refund and they gave me a minimal part despite the damage caused by not having Wifi in those days to work.

If you're planning a trip to Madrid and want to stay in a central location within walking distance to all the main attractions, I highly recommend Antonio’s Airbnb. The apartment is perfectly situated, with supermarkets right across the street and charming bakeries nearby. It's a comfortable and convenient place to stay, making it easy to enjoy everything Madrid has to offer.
If I will come back to Madrid I will be staying at Antonio's Airbnb again.

WOW we had such an amazing stay at Gorete's apartment!! 5 stars all the way around!!!! Gorete is such a gracious and amazing host and she goes out of her way to make you feel at home. The apartment is spotless, spacious, comfortable, and in a great central location. Close walking distance to shopping, restaurants, bars etc. We will definitely be staying here again!!!

The apartment is situated in a great area. Everything is well reachable by foot or metro, also Atocha train station is not far. The apartment is in a safe and clean building, and stylishly decorated. Bed is very good. Gorete welcomed us with a bottle of delicious wine. We didn’t get to meet Gorete, but communication was very good.
Only minor was the noise in the street in the weekend at night.
Very recommendable!!

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay in Goretes apartment.
The apartment was comprehensively equipped.
We especially enjoyed the coffee percolator!
The location in Madrid was perfect close to all museums,sites & excellent restaurants & tapas bars
Great apartment in a very central location. Comfy bed, spotless and quiet building. would def go back and recommend!

Gorete's apartment was incredible. It has a great location, and is near all the touristic and historical spots. The street is full of supermarkets, restaurants, and is very close to metro stations (about 5-minutes walk), including the famous Puerta del Sol. The apartment is as stylisih as in the pictures, spotless clean, with everything you need to cook, rest, bathe, everything. The building has roomy elevators for easy access especially with luggage. We had an amazing time and Gorete and Alicia are very kind and attentive to details and beyond. We hope we can come back and stay again here!

We loved our stay in Madrid. This was our third time in Madrid and our favorite location! Lots of tapas bars in a cute little neighborhood! Be sure to check out Feliz coffee our favorite coffee shop! Close to the Prado, Retiro, and Plaza Mayor! Easy check in and communication with the host! AC works  great! Thank you for hosting!

This place is wonderful and the two terraces provide fresh air and great natural light. All of the amenities were great and the bed was very comfortable. The bathroom is very spacious. It is  in a wonderful location with access to restaurants, plazas, and metro. Communication was excellent.  We will definitely be staying here again.

10/10 would stay here again! The Airbnb was clean, spacious, and had everything we needed. Gorete was very accommodating with check in and check out. The location is great for jumping on the metro or walking around exploring.
Gorete went above and beyond with each and every detail of the place- would stay again!
Don’t rely too much on your phone for mapping. Tall buildings interfere with GPS. Make a paper map or take a screenshot and knowing enough Spanish to ask directions helps.

Great place to stay while visiting Madrid. Right in the center of the city, easy access and near of a lot of attractions.
Bed is very comfortable! Spacious apartment overall, very clean.
Gorete was a great communicator and very helpful. Would stay here again!

Great location - everything is walking distance… we stayed a month and I went to Spanish language school - able to walk from Gorete’s place every day… everything you need is in the suite… cleaning service is awesome…Gorete is a fabulous host…we would definitely stay there again 😀
This location is magic. It’s in the heart of Madrid and within walking distance of so many sites! The host was communicative and responsive.
Clean apartment, excellent location walkable go most attractions, we really enjoyed our stay! The street can be noisy at night FYI.

Gorete’s place is in a perfect location to discover Madrid via foot. The interior is so tastefully decorated, it is a great space to relax back in the evening if you want to stay in. There is a plethora of restaurants nearby to try including the restaurant Vi Cool in the same building which we loved. If we return to Madrid we would definitely stay again. There is a cab rank a short walk from the building which is handy if you have large suitcases.

Fantastic location. Very functional studio. Well thought out for every comfort and convenience. Nothing was disappointing. The street was a bit noisy late at night but nothing too bad given the location. You truly could walk to everything!
This is the place to stay in Madrid. Gorete’s place is so chic and stylish and has all the amenities you need. A fantastic neighbourhood in the heart of Madrid without feeling touristy.
This is out place to go in Madrid, we have stayed in Gorette’s apartments four times already. You can’t beat the price to quality ratio.

Cannot say enough great things about this apartment! The location, the decor, so comfortable and the light from the balconies is amazing. Bed is so comfortable and wonderful shower, one of the most enjoyable stays we’ve had (and we’ve been traveling for more than a year so that is saying a lot!). Highly recommend!

Amazing stay. Lots of restaurants around. It feels like any place you walk in, there will be great food. Good coffe shops and walking distance from main attractions. The apartment is really nice and comfortable. Beautiful balcony.
I only stayed two nights, but I’m already planning to go back and I would love to stay at Gorete’s place again.

My wife and two daughters stayed at this location for our first 2 days in Madrid. This space had everything we needed and the location is perfect. Alicia greeted us and allowed us to drop our bags off since we were a bit early for the check in time. It’s within walking distance of everything. Right around the corner is the Santa Anna plaza that has a variety of outdoor restaurants. We loved this space and location so much we tried to book it again on our last leg of our family vacation in Spain before we flew back to Orlando but it was all booked up. I checked the Airbnb calendar and this place books up well in advance. If this space is available and you are planning a trip to Madrid, book it asap.

The apartment was very beautifully styled and comfortably furnished. Was located conveniently close to the metro station and was situated in a cute little passage with very little traffic. The amenities suited us perfectly and the availability of a washing machine was helpful. Much recommended

Beautiful unit and centrally located in Madrid.  The neighborhood was great and easily walkable with lots of good restaurants within a 5-10 minute walk.  The unit was clean and well-appointed.  The washer and dryer worked well, which was a plus, since it allowed us to pack lighter.  Our host Gorete was super responsive and helpful.  We loved this place.  Can't wait to come back and would highly recommend it to others.

Staying at Gorete’s apartment was perfect for us! We loved the location - how easy it was to get around, and the cute balcony! The accommodations were comfortable and relaxing! Gorete was an incredible host and Nisbeth was also amazing.
We would not only recommend this apartment but also hope to come back!

Place was a gem.  Gorette was great with info ahead of visit and check in and support by Alicia made it all easy.  Great location walkable to Plaza Mayor and Museo Prado and other sites.  Would definitely recommend and return if back in Madrid.

Wonderful location and well equipped Bnb with very responsive host.  Let us drop our bags before going exploring, as our plane arrived in the morning.  Safe and walkable neighborhood with lots to do!  Highly recommend!

During my trip to Madrid, I was able to walk to almost all places except for the Santiago Bernabéu Stadium. Gorete was really kind and responded quickly. If I visit Madrid again, I would love to stay here again.😀
The place was perfect for my husband and me. It had everything we needed!  Great location and comfy!  Highly recommended!

Ricardo is really a nice guy and his home is so so sweet&beautiful with many antique decorations & paintings which are amazing. Ricardo gave us so many good tips for our trip and the location of his home is perfect. You can go every famous place on feet( what we really did)! Thank you Ricardo and hope to see you again! I love Madrid:)

Very nice appartment, very sweet spanish place and verry central!
We didnt see Ricardo but he was very nice and helpful and recomended us very good restaurants and places to visit!
Ricardo knows his city well very, gave stellar recommendations and also gave us reminds of certain events going on in the city.
Really nice appartement close to everything by walking. The neighrood in itself is really nice too. Ricardo made us really easy to go there and our stay.

Best airbnb experience ever! Ricardo is a wonderful host- polite, thoughtful, positive, helpful tips to make your stay in Madrid unforgettable. Location: La Latina is my favorite barrio in Madrid- super central, interesting, a true residential  neighborhood, lots of bars and local shops- no tacky souvenir shops to be seen anywhere. You can easily walk to all the sights but if you're feeling lazy the metro stop is super close. The apartment- Wonderful! Cleanest airbnb I've stayed in, loved the design and details. Really comfortable bed and quiet at night. All in all a dream experience I didn't want to leave and I can't wait to come back another time. Thank you Ricardo for sharing your beautiful apartment- and making my stay so enjoyable eres genial!!

Ricardo was an incredible host! The apartment is beautiful, exactly like in photos and description and even better. The location is great, exactly in the heart of the city and all main attractions are in walking distance. Our experience in Madrid was amazing not only because of the location but also due to wonderful hospitality of Ricardo. He told us all about the best bars, restaurants and even tango parties. And he even helped me with fixing my earrings! Dear Ricardo, we hope to see you one day in Vladivostok! Many many thanks!

Ricardo hosts one of the best places I’ve stayed in. Perfect location, clean and stylish! Ricardo was a really quick communicator and extremely friendly. Made me and my girlfriend feel really at home. Would absolutely recommend!

We loved staying at Ricardo's place! He was very friendly, thoughtful and gave us lots of tips on what to do in Madrid. Everything went smoothly during our 5 night stay. The location of the flat is very central - a couple of minutes walk away from metro station, and the Sunday market was right below our window! Would definitely recommend :)

The host (Ricardo) is great. He maintained communicationw us allthe time, gave us information and tips that were accurate all of thetime. The place was very clean and the location is excellent. Ricardo is very friendly. We plan to return. Highly recommended

Ricardo is a very friendly and helpful host. He did everything for us to feel welcome and provided lots of tips and recommendations for restaurants and places to visit. His apartment was perfectly cleen, nicely decorated and the bed was comfortable. The apartment also has a very central location -a perfect starting point to explore the city by foot. Thank you Ricardo, we highly recommend your Airbnb to other travelers!

Ricardo's home places you next to terrific tapas bars, shopping, late night hangouts, subways, buses and walking distance to most major sites. On Sunday you step outside the apartment and enjoy the flea market that is so famous. There are many well-known bars on his street so you can end your evenings in your own neighborhood (but it is not noisy).
The apartment is nicely laid out. The bed is extremely comfortable, plenty of closet space, comfortable living room to relax in at the end of the day. If you enjoy a designer apartment you will be happy here.
Ricardo has prepared a solid list of eateries near him that are at comfortable prices. He is a very nice host, helpful but not in your way. This house is a great find.

Hands down the best Airbnb experience we have ever had! Ricardo was a very thoughtful and helpful host and did not not hesitate to help us. He also put a load of washing on for us and borrowed a drying rack to get it dry. Ricardos place is also very stylish and comfortable, we had the best sleep there.
We would not hesitate to book Ricardo's place again! Thank you, Ricardo!
ricardo is one amazing person as a host. we experienced lovely hospitality from him and kind attitude. would love to stay again when in madrid

Ricardo was a great host. He stayed up late for check in as we had a late flight. Great hospitality with helping us with suggested things to do in the city, help with trains and generally very caring.

Amazing host and great place! I recommend it for everyone!
Ricardo was very helpful and gave us good advice.
Ricardo’s place was spotless, beautiful, comfortable and convenient in all aspects. I genuinely recommend this place!

Ricardo is a transparent and personable host. Absolutely warm and trustworthy. He didnt spend much time in the apartment. It was a walk up with air conditioning in the bedroom. His living room was comfortable. The bathroom is on the small side but manageable. The building old and the walls thin. It is best for quiet, more mature people.

Ricardo’s home is spotlessly clean and very well decorated - almost like living in a museum, except that there are personal touches everywhere too. Ricardo himself was a great host, very communicative and helped us out with laundry and with suggestions about the area. We had a great stay in Madrid at the end of a long trip - thank you Ricardo!

Ricardo is great host - it was a pleasure to be his guest! His kindness and help as well as the beautiful and spotless apartment made our visit in Madrid awesome! my next time in Madrid will be in Ricardo's home and I will recommend him to my friends. Ania

It was a pleasure to stay in Ricardos flat! Everything was very clean and the flat in general and the neighborhood La Latina are so nice! Ricardo gives us a lot of advices where to go in Madrid! Thank you Ricardo!

For the second time in half a year we visited Ricardo's place. A great house, on a perfect location. All of Madrid finest places are on walking distance. Ricardo is the perfect host, allways very friendly. The room is nice and very clean. The same goes for the bathroom. It's like a five star hotel.
Ricardo is a very nice host. His home is neat and has everything. Highly recommend!

Ricardo is a fantastic host, and made us feel at home from the get-go. His recommendations for food and sightseeing are thoughtful and tasteful, allowing you to see Madrid from a local’s perspective.
Stay for El Rastro, because you’ll wake up to the sight of the market happening right outside.

Ricardo is a great host, friendly,  has helpful advises for exploring Madrid and has a super nice flat in the center of the city. His apartment is very clean and tasteful furnished with some antiques details.  It was amazing experience to stay at his home! Highly recommend!

Very clean and spacious for 2. Even though we had to share a bathroom, we never had to wait our turn or anything. It was practically ours because the host had a different schedule from us. Communication was amazing and he always responded before and during our stay. He provided many great local recommendations that made our stay very memorable. Very convenient location in walking distance to everything.

Ricardo is the best host that I’ve encounter. His home is super clean and nicely decorated. And it is located in the centre of the city. Thanks for being our host and it gives us a good memory. Highly recommended!

If you looking for places to stay in Madrid, Ricardo’s place is the best. Especially He has Air conditioner.
“Cheaper than hotel, Better than Hotel”

Santiago is a Super friendly host, the apartment is well located and cozy, also the restaurant tips are useful.
we had a great time there, highly recommended!!!
We recommend! The place has incredibly good location, it was clean. Ricardo is very friendly and carreful, helped us a lot

The house is amazing! Everything is clean,and there are many interesting  collections in the room and put in good order. It's a really tidy and  romantic place, and so is the host Ricardo. He is very warm-hearted to tell us  how to take metro,where to eat,to shop ，a very nice and good person. He was a surprise of my journey in Madrid.
Ricardo is an amazing host. He takes care of the guests with great interest. Also, the condition of the room is perfect and is decorated wonderfully. Thanks to Ricardo, i could have a great holiday.

Ricardo is a wonderful host, very attentive, friendly and accurate, actually the best host I’ve ever stayed with. His apartment is very unique and charming, the room is cosy and really comfortable. If I ever come back to Madrid, that’s where I’d like to stay.
Great location right in central Madrid, hard to beat the price. Ricardo was very friendly and accomodating, I loved the place!

100000% recommended.
The best host ever!
Ricardo is kind and the apartment is great. The location is fantastic, you can find good transportation and food very close. I highly recommend it.
Beautiful room in the center of Madrid. The area is perfect, central but quiet. Ricardo is very kind, always available and ready to help. Really enjoyed the staying!
Everything perfect. Ricardo is an excellent host, very friendly and attentive. He gave us a lot of tips what to do and we really enjoyed our stay at his place. Highly recommended.

We had an amazing time while staying at Ricardo’s house. He was a very kind and helpful host. The location was also very great, within 5 minutes or so you can walk to Plaza Mayor. We really recommend staying at his apartment!

The location of the apartment is convenient, walking distance to various attractions, and it happened to be a Sunday, which also let us see the lively market downstairs. Thanks for his helpful tips and suggestions on city experience. You can see his good living habits from every detail. In short, I highly recommend this apartment!
Ricardo was a great guest, the room was nice, had a lot of facilities and Ricardo was very caring for his guests! very recommended, and thanks once more!
Ricardo is one of the kindest people I have met. The place was clean and very central. I can highly recommend it.

Subway is the way we came to subway la Latina from airport. We left by the other subway Tirso de moline as we left by train at Atoche. They are both 3-5 minutes walk.   The streets are short blocks so walked to most attractions. Patio dining outside with locals good prices. Ricardo great host.  Answered all our questions and gave recommendations for places to eat. Laundry worked well. Comfortable bed.  Would stay again great host.
Ricardo is amazing! Super friendly and that will be my go to place whenever in Madrid!  Thank you and warm hugs from Costa Rica

Macarena was hands down the best host I've had. She was helpful, communicative, and more welcoming than most of my friends. She made sure I got to her place efficiently from the airport and upon arrival I was greeted with food and drinks. The room is sunny and had everything you need. The apartment is close to the metro and in a safe neighborhood. I will miss Macarena. I consider her a friend now. Highly recommend a stay at her home.

Macarena’s place is lovely, quiet and cosy - so I got a great nights sleep in busy Madrid.  It's walking distance to centre (30 mins) or 10 minutes by subway to centre.  Had great inspiring conversations with Macarena during complimentary breakfast as we both, coincidentally, work in the same fields! - theatre!
Breakfast is served, all areas of the house is neat and clean, very welcoming atmosphere in the house.
Macarena is a great host and a lovely person. The flat was very clean and quiet! Great place to stay when you are in Madrid!!!
This was my second time staying at Macarena’s on this trip so I could catch an early fight. Just as welcoming and hospitable as the time before. It’s a great spot for single travelers.

I had an awesome experience. Macarena is a wonderful host who took care of me like an old friend. Right from coming till the nearest train station to accompany me to the apartment - to taking time everyday to discuss how my day went, giving valuable suggestions on things to do. The place is 10 mins walk from the nearest metro station in a quiet residential neighborhood. Highly recommended for any single traveler.

Ask Macarena to take you out for Tapas! There is a very non-descript place quite close to her house that serves delicious tapas! Macarena is a very nice hostess and is very attentive and maintains good communication during/around your visit. She is also a delight when it comes to sharing and talking about music! The place is close to Atocha Renfe and perfect if you want to get to the airport fairly easily.
Macarena was very accommodating and I enjoyed my stay with her. Close to bus/metro. Macarena provided many suggestions for my brief stay in Madrid. Very friendly and helpful.

Staying with Macarena was like visiting a favorite relative. I felt very comfortable in the living space. She is a great host and I was able to learn more about Spain and the culture. She always had breakfast ready for me and my coffee. Such good coffee! I would recommend staying here if you are visiting and she has so much knowledge of the city!

Macarena was very friendly and such a hospitable host! She was always having me try yummy Spanish treats. She gives you your space and it is nice. The bed is small and not very comfortable but it does the trick. It’s about a 7 minute walk to the Metro (Nueva Numancia) which quickly brings you anywhere you want to go to in the city. My only complaint was that their were bugs in the bathroom and sometimes throughout the apartment.

On top of being a great person, Macarena is a wonderful host. She always try her best to accommodate and make you feel at home.
Overall Macarena's place is a great place to stay, both for short and long periods.

Macarena was so kind and helpful with my first few days in Madrid. She welcomed me with open arms and showed me around the neighborhood. She gave me many recommendations around Madrid, it felt like I was visiting a family member. Macarena was kind enough to even take me to a cell phone store to set up a new sim card. I definitely suggest you to stay with Macarena!

Macarena is a friendly and helpful host, she is available to help if needed
The location was perfect and the balacony was amazing
I recommend this place
Thank you
The apartment is so nice. Macarena is so lovely and friendly. The place os located in a very nice area close to the downtown and so many nice places.

I was very warmly welcomed by Macarena and she was never short of good travelling advices and appropriate, caring attention. We had great conversations on various topics and I trul felt like having a home in this beautiful, vast city. High recommendation!

Macarena was so friendly and interesting, I really enjoyed our talks, she is super wise, feel lucky to have met her. She received me with juice and cookies even when I arrived late at night. Definitely homey vibes and felt really safe. Thanks a lot!
trizie's place was not only all they described, great location, quite inspite been right by main strip, beds where very comfortable most definitely the place stay

Clean, spacious apartment in modernized apartment complex with elevataor.. Picked up the key from the parking attendant. Wifi was not working well. The parking attendant tried to help us but all we could establish was that it worked in some places and not so well in others. Also, we couldn't find the laundry washing machine at first, but later realized it was sitting outside on the balcony. Questions to host on Airbnb app were not always answered or answers were a bit confusing - maybe a language-translation issue. Aside from these peculiarities,  it's a great apartment for the two of us.  The location is fantastic - being so central, close to Gran Via station and all of its restaurants/shops. You could begin a nice city walk in any direction from the apartment.

My family and I have just returned from a wonderful 3 night stay at Alfonso & Guillermo's apartment. Guillermo was very helpful and accommodating with our changes in travel arrangements. We found the apartment to be very comfortable, clean and well equipped with everything we needed. It was also exceptionally well located for exploring Gran Via and surrounds.
Great stay. The apartment is very central, spacious and beautifully furnished. Hosts were very kind as well
Great stay here, apartment exactly as pictures show beautiful and the location is AMAZZZING!! Guillermo was very helpful, would definitely recommend a stay here :)
The apartment was central, very spacious and comfortable, everything you'd want for a visit to Madrid. I'd definitely recommend to others!
Great place, great location, welcoming and flexible. Very nice place to stay in and the AC worked very well.
Spacious, bright and stylish apartment. And also very well location. It was perfect for our family and our crawling baby could test the cleaning of the apartment. Excelent!

We enjoyed our time in Madrid at Guillermo's apartment. The place was very spacious and comfortable as well as clean. Guillermo was flexible with check-in and check-out which was very kind, and communication was excellent.

This apartment is fantastic! It's very nice, clean and near the city centre.
Guillermo was a great host! He made our stay very comfortable and was always available when needed!
Highly recommendable!

The landlord is very friendly,also arranged for us to pick up the airport , thoughtful; The location is good and the transportation is convenient. The only disadvantage is that the two beds in the other bedroom are smaller.

This place was perfect for our stay in Madrid! The location was EXCELLENT - a short walk to everything and some amazing restaurants a few doors down. My sister and her family also stayed with us for the weekend and the apartment was perfect for children. There was good space for playing in the main room and there were even a few baskets of toys in one of the rooms that my nephew loved! I was able to wash clothes and had a full kitchen with everything I needed to cook (although I usually ate out because the food was so delicious and inexpensive right around us). All of the other residents in the building were very polite and kind. Alfonso and Guillermo were very quick to respond and communicative if I had any questions regarding the apartment. They were great hosts and very helpful in getting to and from the airport. Overall a wonderful two weeks in Madrid and I would definitely stay here again when I return.

The apartment is convenient to Gran Via. It was very easy to get around Madrid from the apartment.  My daughters and I enjoyed our stay. We felt safe in the apartment complex and the surrounding area.

Great apartment for families and small groups of 4-6 people!
It is located in a great location near the Gran via, close to several Metro stations.
The check in was smooth and easy, and the owners did everything they can to make our stay fun and convenience, snd even contacted us with a taxi driver who took us to the airport.
Definitely will come back next time.
Alfonso & Guillermo’s place was really impressive! Very spacious and great value for money! Would heavily recommend to anyone looking to stay in Madrid.
Spacious and clean apartment in a central location. Friendly and responsive hosts. The flat has everything you need for an enjoyable stay in Madrid - would recommend!

STAY AWAY! Listing is advertised as "Gran Via" living when in actuality there is major construction that is blocking the direct path to Gran Via! It had so much construction that right outside the building there are lines of large commercial trash dumpsters blocking the roadway and cement being mixed within 10 feet of the door! Taxis cannot come to the street. Street was completely unusable and covered in dust. As a family traveling with a stroller it was impossible to get through. While I'm sure after construction location would be ok, the host was rude and not apologetic for failing to mention the construction in listing or in direct communication prior to arrival. In addition, we booked the place because it had a crib but after booking, we were informed we need to pay 20 euros. We felt totally misled and felt even dangerous being in such a construction area with no car access that we went through Airbnb to cancel booking and find a new place.

Very nice apartment, lots of space and clean. The area is good and it's a very short  to walk to a lot of attractions, the metro and bus stops. Supermarket is only 2 minutes walk. the double bed mattress is smaller than a normal double and is smaller than the bed frame and not very comfortable. The single beds in the second bedroom are very comfortable.
Beautiful apartment with tons of space. Location in the city center made it very easy to get around. Friendly and helpful host!!

Location, location, location! This apartment's location can not be beat. Walkable to everything we wanted to see and do. Fabulous restaurants are just around the corner. The beds are comfortable, and the two bathrooms worked perfectly for our group. The kitchen has everything you need! I would absolutely stay here again. Thank you for a wonderful stay!

Such a beautiful apartment in the best location. Very easy to get around by metro and bus. We stayed with our three children who loved the toys and books. There’s also a fantastic playground five minutes down the road. We wish we could have stayed longer!
Oscar was very kind to us. He did not bother us at all. The area was marvellous and the flat was ok and clean! Thank you!
Apartment was fine for a short stay but there are visible signs of wear. Shower in the upstairs bathroom was broken so it made it difficult to use. Location was a bit far from central Madrid.
Great place to explore Madrid from, close to 2 metro stations and with good amenities. Very easy check-in and check-out. Definitely recommend it!

Great stay overall! The host was very kind, communication was easy, the house was warm, and the terrace was fantastic. However, parking was challenging, and clearer instructions about paid zones (e.g., green stripes are paid, white are free) would have been helpful. Unfortunately, we didn’t find any white zones nearby and ended up with a ticket.

Incredible Location, my girlfriend and I walked most of the city and when we ended up on the other side of town, the metro was super easy to use and access from this apartment is 3 min walk. Very clean and wonderful communication. Would stay again!

Daniele was a great host. His instructions for checking were perfect.  The location can not be beat for being quiet but easily walkable to all attractions.  Daniele went beyond expectations when I asked him to help us out during an unexpected problem.  I would always recommend.
Excellent location for all of Madrid and for transport connections. Daniele gave really clear instructions for check in and was super helpful throughout. Would definitely recommend!
Great location, close to the station and major attractions.  Also supermarkets close by for self catering.  Would thoroughly recommend for extended stays.

A great loft in the centre of Madrid- we'd definitely stay here again! Minty host was very responsive leading up to our arrival. They provided us with a guidebook and met up at the address with the keys as soon as we arrived from the airport. It was exactly as shown in the pictures and was perfect for us. Thanks Verónica and Minty host- we had a wonderful stay!
Beautiful flat, cosy with a great location right in the heart of Madrid.  Booking process and arrangements for arrival were excellent.  Highly recommend!
Assistance through the Mintyhost agency very kind and always available. The apartment is perfectly located for roaming the city and we enjoyed our stay very much.

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay at Veronica's. After being in hotels in Barcelona and Ibiza it was great to be in a very comfortable home environment, close to a ton of great places in Madrid.  Veronica's place is clean, well appointed, aesthetically pleasing, and a great place to stay during your time in Madrid.

This place is great. It's literally on the other side of Plaza Mayor. But don't worry, you don't get any noise from that area. It's about a 1 minute walk to Mercado San Miguel. The apartment itself is just like you see in the photos. Veronica and her team were amazing with communication. The best I've ever experienced with Airbnb. Would absolutely recommend staying here!

The place was exactly as pictured. It was quiet and also very central. The apartment is smartly designed and the hosts were very communicative. We only stayed two nights but if we wanted to stay longer we had everything we needed in the apartment.
I would recommend this place to anyone who wants to have a great Madrid experience.

Location!Location!Location!this apartment has a unique and competitive location which is only 30 seconds to plaza Mayor and St.Miguel Market.Prado museum in 10min away.it's very convenient to take metro from Opera or Sol station(walk in 2-3min)to every places of attractions.of course there are many good restaurants around apartment.Veronica helped me a lot before I arrived,her gave me accurate information about everything I need in Madrid. Her lovely apartment is the same as described on airbnb,well equipped, clean,and quiet in the evening(although it is in the very center of Madrid,many bars around)if u want to have a good sleep.there is a balcony with street view beside Plaza Mayor.by the way,Minty host is in charge of managing Veronica's apartment,the girl Claudia is very nice and prepared everything well for us.all in all, my husband and I has unforgettable experience of Madrid in this lovely apartment(loft).

Central location and great host. The surround sound speaker system is a nice touch and the shower is terrific. One minor warning, as others have mentioned, the bed is up a narrow flight of stairs and the bedroom ceiling is quite low. It was no issue for us, but I can see how it could be for some.
beautiful spot, truly perfect center location.... great host and team.... very cool style...  great value... book this apartment w confidence.
This super sleek designer home is fully equipped and the perfect perch to enjoy a stay in the most convenient 'hood in Madrid. Every detail has been considered.

Loved every second. Literally perfect location with main square 20 seconds away and best food market in Madrid 30 seconds. Communication with side company looking after is exceptional. Perfect for a couple or in our case 3 guys for a music festival. 4 would be a bit of a squeeze. Stunning apartment and can’t rate it highly enough. Thank you.
This loft is incredible and very beautiful. Caution with the low ceiling when going back up to bed, but other than that it is an amazing place truly at the heart of everything.

Location cannot be beaten, close to great restaurants, shopping and tourist attractions. Metro station a few hundred yards away for exploring further afield. Apartment itself is stunning, exactly as is in the pictures. Communication with regards to arrival and help throughout was very good and appreciated. Would definitely recommend.
Great place, great location and great check in. We arrived at 1 am, but it wasn’t a problem at all.

The location is absolute awesome. It is easy to access to many interesting points by walking. Our main complaint is that after checking in we no longer got response from the host for any of our requests.

Veronica's place is very centrally located so easy to pop out, see a few things and be back for a quiet siesta. The apartment worked well for my wife and me but I would be cautious to bring children as the stairs to the loft bed are narrow with low railings. Otherwise, we enjoyed all aspects - we even caught a Stranger Things episode on Netflix before bed one night :)

Cool apartment, nice location.
Be careful: Veronica accused us to have broken the vitroceramic cooktop which we have not used for our whole stay... Don't know how honest this accusation is, but well...

Perfect loft in the heart of Madrid really enjoyed my stay here for the Easter break. Everything is within walking distance and the restaurants are amazing. Check in and check out we’re seamless and the communication was perfect with quick responses to all my questions. Will definitely book again in the future cheers !

This place is amazing - just like the pics and even better. Location is ideal and the building is so safe and secure. Veronica was super quick to respond to queries and really helpful, would 100% stay again.

We traveled to Madrid from the US. Veronica’s place is beautiful. We were able to walk everywhere we wanted to go. We had an unexpected late check in and Veronica was very accommodating and able to let us in remotely. She offered great suggestions on local restaurants and checked in to make sure our stay was perfect. Would definitely stay here again!
The location of the loft is absolutely perfect. You are close to everything and I can’t wait to go back!
Amazing place to stay, close to everything, very clean and love the vibe of the night city. 10/10 recommend.

Verónica was very friendly and easy to work with. She gave wonderful recommendations of places to go around town. The location was perfect for not having a vehicle while we visited. We were able to walk to every food and tourist location we wanted to visit.
The apartment has areas that are very small (aka the loft). If you are tall I wouldn’t recommend this place as the shower has low clearance as well.
