Our only issue was they had us wait when we arrived to finish cleaning/mopping the upstairs. But besides that we had a good stay.

Great place! My first time to Spain for an important trip and I decided to stay at this place instead of an hotel. The loft has a great location next to Plaza Mayor, near restaurants, stores and Metro stations. The loft itself is greatly decorated with a good layout. The stairs to the bed are not for everyone but I was more comfortable on the bed than expected and I am a little over 6’ tall. The place has great lighting and the host has definitely thought of everything. Great memories of my stay and would certainly return.

Veronica’s flat was just like described ,  the place is in a Greta location and very safe.  Veronica was attending and responsive . We will recommend her apartment, as a matter of fact I would stay here again.  We had an amazing stay at Veronica’s place.

Great location.  We walked to everything we wanted to see for the three days we were in Madrid.  The metro went by many of the places we were going to but we chose to walk in order to see more of Madrid.

I couldn’t have chosen a better place for our stay in Madrid. Truly a stunning loft with a great balcony view that is minutes away from the Sol train station, the Royal Palace of Madrid, and a few steps from the Plaza Mayor. The host was easy to reach with clear instructions on how to check in and even offered great recommendations. We loved the cold refrigerator, clean kitchen, cold air conditioning, and especially the washer! The bathroom was also very clean. You will have to hunch over when going to the bed upstairs but that was a very small inconvenience. I would definitely stay here again!

We were very pleased with our stay in Madrid. We were walking distance from everything, especially Plaza Mayor and Puerta del Sol. My husband and I loved the apartment and we felt right at home. Veronica was very responsive throughout check-in and provided local recommendations. Thank you for your hospitality, Veronica.
Very hard to open the front door to get into the apartment. Neighbors bang on the wall at 6pm if you’re playing music slightly loud. But overall I very nice stay.

It's a fantastic apartment located perfectly for everything to explore Madrid. The kitchen is perfectly sized and equipped if you do want to cook. the shower was great, good pressure and was always hot when we wanted it. The mezzanine bed was fun as well and made the whole space open plan. There are blinds so at night you can make it feel like your enclosed.
Verónica sorted a taxi for us at the arrival of the airport which made it incredibly easy for us. We got the metro for the return journey which is also very straight forward.
She also kindly forwarded some recommendations for restaurants, wine bars etc which made it easier than going through review sites.
Couldn't recommend this place enough, had a fantastic stay here!

I’ve couldn’t be happier with the experience. The location was perfect, offering easy access to all the attractions. It was ideal for a couple, with a cozy and homey atmosphere that made us feel right at ease. The loft was very clean and had modern features, including fans and AC, so we were always comfortable. We enjoyed it so much that we often preferred staying in rather than going out. The host was incredibly helpful, responsive, and kind. This Airbnb was truly the best choice we could have made for our trip!
great location in the center, everything is close. the apartment is nice and tidy. everything was great!
Great place located central to everything I wanted to get to! Neat apartment with a beautiful view from the balcony.
Beautiful place and is in the PERFECT location. Will definitely be coming back to this BNB when I visit Madrid again! Very friendly people who are willing to help all hours of the day.

Excellent apartments.
Near the metro, 8-10 minutes walk to the main attractions.
The apartment is very comfortable, warm, three comfortable beds for 5 people.
Very large living room, large terrace with good views.
Kitchen with all equipment.
All amenities.
The hosts helped very quickly.
I recommend the apartments.

The apartment is cool, clean, and located as central as it gets.
Be aware though that the check-in process requires Spanish skills.
Also, expect management closer to that of a hotel (group "AparSol" to be precise) than a person living in that space else.

Amazing location, and clean apartment that looked just like the photos. We spent most of our time outside exploring but this was a great place to crash. Jose was kind and responded quickly. I highly recommend!

Amazing location, walkable to major sites near Puerta del Sol. Unit is quite small, and need to bend down to walk on the upper level. Suggestions such as cleanliness made to host. Good for short stays.
Great location, easy walk to restaurants, coffee shops, shopping and the metro.  My family of 4 enjoyed our stay here for a week.

It was a nice stay. Everything was clean and organized when we got there, they had all the amenities and dishes to use when we got there. Only thing that was bad was the response time but other than that good location and stay
The apartment was just as described.  Great location and clean.  I would not hesitate to recommend or stay there again.
Unbeatable location and attentive host. Would recommend to anyone and will definitely stay again next time I am in Madrid.
Great location, close to the subway station, a small supermarket next to the main entrance is helpful. We were provided with a fan to get through the Madrid hot weather.

We were very lucky to stay at Luis's place in Aravaca. We loved the location: Great Cafe's, great variety of shops, amazing old village and more. The apartment was clean and inviting and the air condition added extra value.
Luis is a very kind and attentive host. He even made an exceptional effort and brought the keys to us when we have had unexpected changes on our arrival time. We recommend this apartment very warmly. Muchas gracias Luis

We stayed at Luis’s apartment for the 2nd time and again… Luis was so kind and brought the keys to us. The apartment was nice and cozy as we remembered and we used the heaters this time! Our favorite coffee shop/bar, El Nuevo Zagua̔n, had been welcoming and festively lit. Aravaca’s boutiques and shops proved to be the best again! We shall return ASAP.

Luis is an amazing host, very friendly and helpful. The apartment is very clean and has everything you need for your stay. Luis was so nice, he even left welcoming 'refrescos' in the fridge. The place is located in Aravaca (which is just 15 min from Moncloa by bus), which is a lovely peaceful place with a church, little shops and cafes. If you wanna stay a bit on the distance from the crowded centre it's the perfect place for you.

The apartment was spacious, well furnished, with a very modern bathroom and kitchen, with all utensils needed for cooking a full meal. Great heating, clothes washer and all amenities to make for a pleasant and comfortable stay. Worth remembering for future trips to the area.

It was okay, decent but that was exatly what we vere looking for! just a calm place to stay after our long travel days and nights so we were more than satisfied.
The quarter where the house is located is part of the modern Madrid so it's like round 45 minut walk from the Madrid busy center, or much much more faster with metro (wich is just marvelously perfect at Madrid!!! totally worth a ride!) would be round 10 minutes or even less i think.
I really enjoyed Andre's appartement, the room was very clean and well organized, it's also well located and close to public transport. Andre is a nice and very helpful guy. I highly recommend.

Perfect Place to get a rest after busy days in Madrid. Everything is clean and cool, andre let us use everything he had which was extremely nice and didn't have a problem with us checking us out later than we planed. A really calm and relaxed and open minded host and a lovely little flat in the suburb of Madrid.

Andre was easy to arrange with. We parked our car in a basement down the street - a bit inconvenient, but on the other hand free of charge. Staircase is tiny which meant that our huge Danish pram didn't fit - but the room was clean and Andre provided breakfast :)
The street lamp was very bright at night, but the apartment is situated in a quiet neighborhood.
With three rooms rented out it seemed a bit like a small hotel, thus not a homely feel to it.
But a cheap and good option 10min from the metro to stay in the outer Madrid.

Andre is a kind, caring and helpful host. The room is just as presented (photos, descriptions, location). Very conveniently located near the metro which connects both Chamartin and Atocha train stations.
Andre was a really helpful host, it was a nice stay there. The room was quiet and clean except that it was tiny. It’s about 6 min by walk to metro Line 9.
I was there only one night and away early next morning so didn't get a chance really to experience the accommodation but adequate for my needs.
Communication was very easy going and Andre helped me whenever I had questions. Room clean and tidy, which was really appreciated! Very friendly and helpful host! Highly recommended!
Tidy place, nice room,  good location and great value, Andre is a nice friendly host.

Perfect location as central as possible. Hosts were very responsive and helpful. Only issue was finding location at first, as Maps apps take you to the wrong location, but the hosts guided me along the way very well.
Prefect location in the center of Madrid. Big place and even if your are in the center, we don’t hear any noise from outside. Recommended!

Though the area was in the main tourist area, it was so centrally located we could walk everywhere.  There were so many people down on the street, but it was quiet and peaceful up in our place on the 4th floor.

Great accommodation. We were 6 people and it fit all of us. The place was clean, but some of the dishes were dirty. The place is located in the city center so everything is extremely walkable and it is right by the metro station. Needed to buy toilet paper as little was provided. Thank you for having us!
The apartment is cute and a great location.  The only downfall was a strong odor of sewage.

Really nice stay in Gius’ appartment, well located ! A bit noisy at night as it’s in a vivid street but managed to had a good night of sleep !
I recommend !!
The place is central Madrid. There are many restaurants close by. Location wise, this is perfect for vacation. Only down side is due to its location, it's a bit noisy during Nights.

The hosts were very professional, communication was good and the place is as described in the listing. It is very bright and it's good for a few days for up to 4 people (sharing 2 rooms). The shower was particularly good (high pressure). Location is right in the centre of Madrid, 2-minute walk from Sol. For this reason it was quite noisy mainly during the weekends (until 4am). There are basic things to cook, like salt, pepper, sugar. There is also a Nescafe coffee machine but no pods.
We loved our stay at Guys and Liener’s place!  Only complaint is that the hot water for showers drained very quickly and we needed to give it time to rejuvenate. Besides that, our stay was perfect

A very nice apartment . The host was very helpful and polite. Great location. Everything we needed in the apartment .
We had a lovely time in Madrid! Thanks!

Gius’s apartment is in the heart of Madrid! It’s comfortable and has all the things you need to live independently or if you’d rather, it’s next to some incredible restaurants where you’ll enjoy Spanish cuisine or even the flavors of other countries. Our family loved staying there, and when we go back to Madrid, we’ll check first with Guis to see if his apartment is available.

The apartment is very centrally located and is in walking distance to many restaurants and sightseeing. It gets however very noisy at night specially with a club located right under. You cannot hear the music but lot of people hanging around the club and talking loudly. The windows helped the reduce the noise significantly though.

Great place right in the middle of Madrid, a 15 min walk from almost anything you’d want to see. Had a washing machine right in the kitchen if that’s something you need. The beds were very comfortable and the place was clean. Gius was a great host who responded promptly to questions and concerns
Great place in the middle of Madrid! The owner was there when we arrived and informed us about the apartment. We had a very good experience.

Really appreciate that Gius provided us a very warm and clean house which was so closed to the center of Madrid. With around 15mins walk we can reach the sights that we were going to visit. Thanks for Gius’ help during the days we were in Madrid.

Highly recommended!. The place is amazing, sparkly clean, and with the best location to stay in Madrid!.
The customer service is unbeatable, they treated us like family, we felt very welcome.
We keep communication with the host. Our flight was cancelled and they were very understanding about to do a different time check in. Best host ever!.

Nice house and very good location, the host has been really nice and kind to us.
I would recommend it.
This is a great apartment to stay at if you are wanting to be out and about. It is in a great location walking distance from everything. Would stay here again!
The location was fantastic- very close to everything we wanted to see and do in the city. Guis was very accommodating and it was the perfect spot for our stay in Madrid.

Enjoyed our stay very much! It is a great location to be near to most everything in central Madrid.  There is a lot of street noise at night due to the location, but the building itself is secure and quiet.
Awesome location, can walk to all the locations. If you like having fun, food and sight seeing

Perfect for us, right in the thick of Puerta del Sol which is exactly what we wanted.  Apartment is roomy and comfortable.  Hosts accommodated our early arrival and were helpful throughout the entire stay!
We only stayed for a night but the location was great and we really enjoyed it! Place was comfortable and nice and check in was very smooth!
Location very good, close to everything and amazing restaurant nearby. However washer is broken which needs replace.
Great location right in the centre of Madrid, in the theatre district.   Great facilities in the apartment.  Only negative for us was the street noise due to the local nightclub at night.
Lovely apartment, exactly as described.  Really good location with lots of choices for bars and restaurants
Great place in good location. It is rather noisy at night though with a music bar next door,till the early hours.

On third floor. much smaller than suggested from pictures. In poor state need total revamp.
Beds are sofa very uncomfortable.
Bed Bedroom 2 takes whole room
Bathroom needs revamp. Furniture poor. Not clear where rubbish goes
Whole place needs work.
I would Not stay again
Nice place in Madrid,  the only problem was that is in a busy street and it was noisy. The host was responsive.

We had a wonderful stay. Close to everything we wanted to see. Amazing restaurants nearby. A club right downstairs. Such a beautiful city. The hosts were quick at responding to any questions. Highly recommend this location!!

The apartment is very central, trendy and modern inside, however, has a decor of a uniquely old Spanish building. It is extremely central and is a shopping haven. The departmental stores are close by, eating joints, and public transport is very closeby. It is a very posh locality and is very safe.
Fernando has been a perfect host, waiting for us and helping us even though we reached quite late at night. He was always there to help us on any query and help.
I strongly recommend this place with a very hospitable host for all to stay. I would like to stay again, in case I get an opportunity to visit Madrid.
The stay in the apartment made my stay in Madrid an extra fillip....thank you, Fernando!

This apartment is definitely beautiful with an unbeatable location. The location is upscale and much calmer than the busy street of gran via which was something i wanted. Fernando was very helpful and responsive if you had any questions and was willing to help, he gave us great recommendations for restaurants too!

A very nice apartment in a great location. My wife enjoyed this oasis and would be willing to stay again. We were able to visit all of the sites and enjoyed the quiet that this apartment afforded in a quality building.

Grand, stylish apartment in a beautiful building in the heart of the Salamanca district of Madrid. We chose this very established, ritzy part of town because we were attending an event there.
The apartment has high ceilings, a living / dining room with parquet floor and two comfortable double bedrooms plus a room with a sofa bed, two shower rooms and to WCs, and a large fully equipped kitchen.
We celebrated the wedding of our son in Madrid and the apartment was the perfect stage for it!
Fernando of Swindontravelers communicated very well with us and made sure all went smoothly.

Friendly host and great location!
Main bedroom and communal area is lovely. Second bedroom and kitchen could use some work but overall good experience.
Absolutely loved our stay in this amazing apartment. Will definitely stay there again, next time I visit my son in Madrid. It’s a truly genuine lovely Madrid experience!

Great location, lovely host that communicates well and is responsive. We had a problem with the AC in the room it was leaking water but FER immediately said that he could send someone. I would recommend.

Nice apartment in the center of Madrid. Never needed to buy metro tickets because everything was in walking distance. The flat is quite dark, but you're not in Madrid to spend much time inside anyway. We enjoyed our stay!

Had a fantastic weekend in Madrid. The apartment was beautiful, clean, comfortable and so well located. Our check in was seamless and we were given a handy self-written guide to Madrid by Cristina which enabled us to plan an awesome stay. I would definitely stay here again. Can't rate it highly enough. 🙂

Great location, clean, comfortable, prrfect for 1 or 2 guests.  Christina was responsive and lovely to work with.  One note for renters at any location, there is renovation work going on in every city.  You might want to ask ahead if there is any near the rental.  We had one underneath this apartment, which was noisy and dusty.
The place was as great as described and clean. Great location near the most interesting places of Madrid. Thanks for all the very good advices we got the first day, our weekend has been a success.

Perfect stay for Madrid! Loved the area, the apartment and Cristina made checking in and out so simple. Highly recommend if you are staying in Madrid and like having everything walking distance and like clean places to stay!
Great location and very comfortable apartment even if it is rather small. Cristina was easy to contact and very helpful.

Lovely apartment in central neighbourhood close to station, in walking distance to most major sites and and adjacent to cafes/bars/restaurants. Host was prompt to reply and very helpful. Thoroughly enjoyed our stay

Gracias Cristina! We had a great time! Location was perfect! Pictures did the place justice, clean, comfortable and great location! Recomend this place for sure!!
Also, Agustin, who met us to check in, was friendly, provided us with a map and gave us some direcctions. He was very friendly and helpful!
Really enjoyed our stay in Madrid!!
Sylvia & Julio

Had a great time at Cristina's place. I used to live in La Latina and love the area. This place is very well located, especially for bar hopping on Cava Baja and exploring the city center. Walkable to everything!
Cristina kept in communication with me and was patient when my flight was delayed and I had to check in late. The apartment is small but perfect for what we needed. Very true to the photos. Might not be the best fit if you're planning to do heavy cooking as the kitchen is tiny, but we were planning to eat every meal out so it wasn't an issue at all!
Very cozy and nice place to stay for the weekend. Just what we were looking for. Very accommodating, responsive, and affordable.
Great location in the middle of Madrid. Cris was extremely helpful and was always offering help if needed and very nice apartment.

Wonderful flat in a fantastic location in La Latina, close to many bars and restaurants, metro stops, and walking distance to must see sites like Plaza Mayor. The flat itself is exactly as pictured and actually seemed a bit bigger in person. Fully equipped kitchen and thoughtful toiletries in bathroom. AC worked perfectly which was much appreciated during our stay. Communication with Cris was quick and easy, and we even received a very thorough guide to Madrid with extensive local tips and recommendations. Would stay here again in a second! Thank you for a wonderful experience.
Me and my boyfriend stayed here for only one night and it was the perfect place. Clean good communication and cris always made sure we had everything we needed!

Cris’s flat in La Latina was a great place to stay in Madrid. The location was unbeatable: very close to many great places to eat and within walking distance of a lot of the tourist attractions. We loved the guide that Cris sent with things to do, see, and eat in the city. The apartment itself was very nice and had all of the amenities that we needed. The AC was a plus and the apartment was more spacious than we expected. We highly recommend staying here!

Beautiful flat in great location. The flat was clean and the air con was appreciated! Cris really easy to get hold of to answer any questions. Would definitely stay here again if back in Madrid.
Thanks Cris :)

Our stay was spectacular. The apartment was very clean, cool wood details and furniture, and was in an AMAZING location. Everywhere we went and that you may want to go is maximum 15 min walk. We also loved the guide Cris provided.

The fotos really ARE a work of art but do not have anything to do with the real apartment which is run down and uncomfortable for its price! But the location in La Latina is great!  Can not recommend though, sorry!

Edu & Cris' place is perfectly located in the heart of La Latina, steps away from the bars and restaurants on Calle Cava Baja and el Mercado de la Cebada. Check-in was easy and Edu was very communicative. The place was clean, the bed was cozy, and a balcony in the center of Madrid is always a nice thing to have. I'd stay there again.

What a superbly located apartment! Small, as advertised, but perfect for two on a city break. Surrounded by bars and restaurants (noisy at night but sound is muted with the balcony doors closed and bedroom at the back). Easy walking distance to many of the sights and underground station very close by.
Edu is a great host with excellent communication 👌🏻

Beautiful safe and lovely location. The bedroom is able to be pitch black and totally removed from the noise outside so if you're jet lagged and want to sleep until noon, you can. it happened to me without even trying :) the washing machine was a big bonus as well

Cris and team were extremely accommodating and attentive to our needs . We had an emergency with the door that it got locked and they came right away to resolve the issue . The location is amazing, the plaza mayor, plaza del sol , la gram via, cebada mércato , San Miguel Mercato All is within walking distance.  The metro station “La Latina “ is 2 minutes away . Excellent place .

We loved our stay here! Such an excellent location to explore Madrid. We walked almost everywhere. The flat is surrounded by excellent tapas places, bars and restaurants, right round the corner from Calle Cava Baja and Calle Cava Alta. The flat itself was beautiful and very peaceful. We particularly enjoyed using the balcony!

This was a great location to walk to nearly everywhere we wanted to visit in Madrid. There are lively bars close by which makes for a fun vibe. However the bedroom is at the rear and you can’t hear the bars when you go to bed. Great host who was very responsive prior to arriving and fortunately we didn’t need to contact them during our stay. Check in easy. Looks exactly like the pictures. Would stay again.

This apartment is in the perfect location in Madrid, near amazing shops, restaurants and attractions, but also quiet and serene. I would highly recommend for any individual or group of two people visiting the city!

This place is just fantastic! The location is amazing and the apartment is just beautiful. We stayed for 4 nights and loved every minute. Would highly highly recommend! One thing to mention: previous reviews have mentioned the couch being old - the couch has obviously been replaced as it was perfect and very new when we stayed.
Nice flat in one of the nicest areas of Madrid. Perfect for a couple or solo-trip. Thanks!
Fantastic location in La Latina!!  So much to do and see within easy walking  distance. Apt was clean and roomy with wonderful bed and linens!  We would love to stay here again!!

This is my second time staying here. I love its location and amenities. Very close to great restaurants, bars, tourist sites, and local transportations, yet quiet and secluded enough where I could rest after a long day of walking around Madrid. I definitely recommend this place!

This small apartment is in a great location and you can walk anywhere downtown Madrid. However, if the neighbours flush their toilet you will hear the noise very clear and hard at anytime. Another thing to be aware of is that Angel may ask you to check in late (after 3pm) but will be extremely inflexible if you ask for additional time to check out. This is unfair to tenants because if you ask for a favor you should reciprocate. Everything else is ok!
We had a fantastic stay. Stayed for 5 nights and the place was really comfortable for staying that long, would really recommend
Lovely small apartment in a brilliant location. Communication was good and check in was easy. Would definitely stay here again

We loved our stay here - location was great there’s a lot within walking distance, a very beautiful lively neighbourhood; the apartment was comfortable and overall quiet when we went to sleep at night so that was a bonus. we had a minor issue with the lock for the main door upon arrival but they responded quickly and found a solution right away and it didn’t take away from how great our stay was overall! We would 100% stay here again and definitely recommend; the host was very nice and the location was absolutely perfect
A very lovely stay and the host was kind and sweet, made my first experience in Madrid really great ☺️

This is our first time we rent an apartment, we received a nice apartment clean and good energies and in the center of the Grand Via
It is important to note that Sandra has an amazing owner
We had a great pleasure to stay at the apartment
highly recommend

Amazing location! Close to Plaza Mayor and Plaza Del Sol and all other major sites. Everything is walkable. The description to the apartment is accurate. Hosts were extremely accommodating and kind! Loved our stay in Madrid!

The apartment is modern, spacious and clean. The location was everything we could've asked for and more. Close to the local tourist spots as well as great neighborhoods such as Chueca. The apartment was spacious and so clean! Would definitely recommend to anyone looking for a great place to stay in Madrid!
The place is perfect for a weekend in Madrid. It’s close to center and if has everything you need :)

Absolutely amazing location! Right in the city center, with touristy locations to one side of you, and lively more local streets to the other. Beautiful view from the balconies and very modern, yet cozy apartment.
Great and clean location that has just what you need for a traveling couple. Right between the Palace and the Retiro park.
Very lovely apartment which is located directly in the city. We enjoyed our trip at Sandra’s place!

Sandra is a great host, very kind, very helpful. The place is really great, well equipped, very comfortable bed, very quiet, ideal for sightseeing-very close to all the sights and to the metro, too. I will definitely come back and I strongly recommend the place and Sandra to anyone who wants to find a quiet, cozy place at an ideal location.
Thanks, Sandra!
Place is in a great location, very clean, small bathroom, and zero issues with the water pressure and temperature. Thanks for hosting us!

The apartment was great and in an awesome area. The air conditioning in the summer was a lifesaver. Everything was clean and we had everything we needed. Check in was easy and Sandra even organized to allow us to hold our luggage while the room was cleaned. Overall, nice stay.

Apartment is in a very central location, ideal if you are staying for a short while. Sandra provided thoughtful touches like breakfast pastries and coffee and the apartment was sparkling clean. Unfortunately there seemed to have been a miscommunication between Elstead/Sandra and their cleaner about which day i arrived, which meant i was woken up at 23:30 by the cleaner unlocking and entering the flat in the middle of the night... which was quite alarming as a woman staying by herself. But otherwise the apartment was an ideal place for a short stay and a very reasonable price.

*10 stars!!!* Sandra’s apartment had the best of everything! Great location right off Gran Via, the most comfortable bed, cool aircon, updated bathroom/kitchen/elevator, and everything was so fresh & clean . She even had coffee maker, muffins, washer, umbrellas for us to use. Great place, best host. Thank you again Sandra, we loved everything!
Nice, clean, quite and comfortable apartment with perfect location.  Very well equipped and comfortable beds.  Close to city center and also neighbourhoods with a lot of restaurants and bars,

This is the perfect place where to stay in Madrid. Good transportation and clean house. Totally recommendable!
Thank you for everthing it was very nice to stay at your place :)

Great experience. High quality flat, building and appliances, the flat doesn’t feel “cheap”. Well insulated refurbished flat, zero noise from the neighbours in the building. Professional management by Maria. Would return.

A compact studio well located and handy to central Madrid.
Kitchen user friendly and washer/dryer a big plus.

This apartment is centrally located off Gran Via and conveniently located near the Callou metro stop. It has a lovely balcony that overlooks the street and is fully equipped with a dishwasher, washer, and kitchenette. I would note that this location would be best suited for one or two people, or short term stays, because it appears larger in the photos. I spent most of my time exploring the city and it was a quiet refuge  at the end of the day. The neighborhood was very safe and easy to get around, and there are lots of cafes and restaurants nearby. Elstead was an excellent host and recommended some great local tapas restaurants to try. Thank you for having us.

Perfect location to visit Madrid, very close to several tube stops, shops and amenities. The flat is quite small and suits well 2 people. We travelled with an infant and the host provided us with a cot.  Bear in mind that there is a lift but also a few steps to reach the flat.

Good location, small space, but host was communicative. Only issue was, there was a very small amount of toilet paper when we came in and it took them 24 hours to send more. But I appreciate the responsiveness of her communication. Would come back.

Brilliant location to walk around, close to many tourist locations, easy access to public transport.
Spotless clean with everything you need if you want to cook your own meals but with so many places nearby where to eat at very reasonable prices didn’t use it once.
The apartment it’s well lit with a balcony where you can sit and enjoy the good weather.
Will recommend.
If ever back in Madrid will definitely stay at Elstead’s place.
The stay in the apartment was good, the location of the apartment is good close to the main street.
Thank you for the great stay. Everything was amazing. From location, to quietness, cleanliness, and WiFi. Thank you very much for everything.

Great apartment in a very centric area. Not only is there plenty right outside your door but your 20 min walking to any of the important sites, parks museums etc. Felt very safe at any hour and there are plenty of taxis and buses right on Gran Villa.

I was impressed of the cleanliness and decoration of the apartment. Antonio waited for us when we arrived and gave us all the information necessary about the surroundings and the city. One of my best airbnb ever!
amazing stay! this was the perfect location! will definitely stay next time i’m in madrid!! hospitality was amazing when we checked in. so welcoming and kind!
The apartment was great and exactly as described, the host met us on time and was very helpful and open for communication if needed. Would recommend this apartment to anyone visiting Madrid.
This is a great place to spend time and relax. Close to the city center, but located in a very quiet zone. Antonio is a very gentle host. I recommend this place.
Antonio was great! He met us right as we arrived from the airport. The space is very clean and cute. We had a great time here

Very comfortable and stylish 3-bedroom flat in Madrid.  Even though located a little further from the city center, there is a huge and modern mall with supermarket, shops, restaurants and terraces which proves to be extremely convenient.  Also, flat is close to the river which was great for runs, bikes and strolls.  Metro stop was literally a 5-min walk away.  The flat is spacious, well-decorated and clean as seen in the pictures - quiet and cozy with all the amenities you need.  I felt like home during my stay, highly recommended, thank you so much for everything!

Antonios place was perfect. We were a group of 6 and we had more than enough space, with room to spare. The kitchen was just enough for to make a great breakfast before heading out to explore and night in dinner as well. The location was central to everything we plan ed on doing and the place was very clean and comfortable.
Very nice place to stay in Madrid. Apartment is sunny and has all you need. Neighborhood is fantastic. Exceptional value!

Apartment is exactly as showed on the pictures. Communication with the hosts was easy. Very central location and great balcony. Subway station is only 4 min walk as well as a big supermarket with all you need. Neighborhood feels a little unsafe at night.

We had a very nice trip, the appartment was very easy to find and really well located.
There were clean towels for every guest, and hot water.
I definitly recommend it.
You can’t beat this location! The main attractions in are all within a 20 minute walk. The neighborhood  is very cute and felt safe. Lots of good restaurants nearby too!
Superb.....and only a few mins from Sol. I have to say, some of the best ethnic food you could eat, within walking distance..
Stay here! It is such good value for the money. Everything is in walking distance,  and the host is so nice. The instructions are clear and it was a wonderful stay
I like it, no issues at all,  around 9pm kids start playing around so may be loud a bit outside but for me was ok
Great place! Bed was comfortable, shower was great, and the space was super clean. The balcony was a great feature! We would stay here again.
Perfect place to stay a while! My friend and I worked remote for a month here and loved it. Super close to a metro and walking distance to tons of food and a gym.
This apartment is special… has all you need, Carmen is very kind and the location is amazing… I will never forget our stay in Madrid! Thank you Carmen!

Staying here was perfect as it was close to the sights and great food places around. The lift didn’t work at the time of staying but Carmen had let me know well ahead of my stay giving me the opportunity to cancel if I wish. I didn’t cancel as the place was still extremely nice and worth it. Thanks!

Never had contact with Carmen, but Jose was exceptional. Flat had all necessary amenities, not the right word, necessaties. Not all units provide the housekeeping tools, detergents towels sponges.
More than pleased with our stay.
A perfect location for first time in Madrid,  great for walking to all major places of interest.  Helena very helpful in many ways.  Safe apartment with terrific shower water pressure!

Amazing. Wonderful stay…. Great service great apartment great location. Will definitely be back. Thank you so much for your wonderful hospitality and all your recommendations in helping making our trip very memorable!

In a quiet area just outside the city center (easy 15-min train ride into the city), Mercedes's place was cozy and perfectly furnished. She waited for us for a late check-in and left snacks and fruits for us and was a wonderful host!

Me and my family had a great stay in Mercedes apartment. The place is as beautiful as seen in the pics. Close to bus stop, metro and supermarket. We needed an early check-in and it wasn't a problem to Mercedes. If im back to Madrid, im definitely staying there again.
A very convenient place to stay especially as a tourist like me. Near the train station and other emenities. The host is very helpful.

We had a wonderful stay at Mercedes apartment. The location was great, conveniently located near the train station and other amenities. The neighborhood was quiet and neighbors were friendly. Mercedes was very responsive with any questions we had and very accommodating. I highly recommend staying here if you come to Madrid, we enjoyed being a little farther out of the city as it was so peaceful.
Loved staying at Mercede's place!  She was super helpful and the beds were nice and comfy after a long day of walking all over the city!

Very nice flat in a great location - easy access to the main attractions in West Madrid. Living area is spacious and bedrooms are comfortable. We had a great weekend in Madrid and the apartment was exactly what we hoped it would be. Good communication with hosts throughout.

Great, modern, spacious lux apartment in Madrid's most upscale neighborhood. It's like staying in an apartment above Rodeo Drive in Beverly Hills! Very safe area, of course.
Located in the heart of upscale shopping and 2 blocks from Parque de Buen Retiro; 5 to 10 minute taxi or metro ride from everything else.
Easy check-in and check-out and host is very responsive.
In the apartment you have solid wifi; buit no wifi in the back master bedroom. Lots of natural light (and lights), a/c works great (once you figure it out) as well as a great entertainment system to "Netflix and chill."
Kitchen is well appointed and having a washer/dryer is awesome while traveling.
Bottom line... we would stay here again when visiting Madrid.

The apartment is beautiful, even better than the pictures and very well situated. We were a family of 6 with 4 young adults and were very confortable.   The apartment was very clean and well equipped.  For our next trip to Madrid this would be our first choice to stay in.
Excellent apartment in a great location. Large spaces with very pleasing minimalistic decor. A real gem of a place
Amazing location, very clean apartment with all the amenities you need. My family and I enjoyed our stay. Johnathan helped with check in and took care of all issues. Will be back again!
Fantastic location and very comfortable 3 bedroom, 3 bath apartment. I would stay there again.

Very central yet quiet location, close to plenty of restaurants and walking distance from the historical center. The accomodati matched with the pictures listed. The Luxa Home was very friendly and helpful with recommendations for the city; they also provided clear instructions for check in and check out and where quiete flexible in accommodating our arrival.

We had a wonderful stay in one of the best locations in the city of Madrid. The apartment was extremely well accompanied, and furnished beautifully. The property looked like it was the first day somebody was staying there. I mean brand new. The young man that took care of us was extremely attentive, and you could tell he really enjoyed making our trip. Perfect. Thank you again, The Walsh.
Great location, very clean, easy access, large rooms and on and on. Would definitely stay again.
Central location, ideal apartment for a group of people, good place in Madrid for a group!
The flat is nice as showed on the pictures, everything new and the kitchen well equipped but the size of the apartment is smaller. It was quite noisy with the traffic and metro.
The Apt is very well located, within walking distance of all major tourist locations. There is a medium sized Lidl supermarket located within 30 meters from the apartment.

Loved this Airbnb experience. The apartment was steps away from the metro station - Tirso de Molina, which was perfect. It was also walking distance to many sites and neighborhoods. About a 10min walk to Gran Via, for example.
The neighborhood is both quiet and lively, if you can believe it. Many great bakeries and shops around - as well as a grocery store down the street.
The apartment itself was quite spacious. There were three of us - and the space had everything we needed. AC, washer, dishwasher, blow dryer, etc...
Beyond all, Milagros was a super kind host and always responsive via WhatsApp immediately!
Would definitely recommend it.
Nice apartment- very noisy at night outside our windows we protests and police activity both nights we were there. Floors were not clean.

This apartment is ideally located. It's a minutes walk from the closest supermarket or metro station. And a few minutes walk away from the main playa major, cava baja and other Great eating places. The apartment is also very well equpped  and comfortable, with air conditioning in all the rooms. The metro causes a bit of vibration and initially takes a bit of getting  used to . But I would so recommend this place and stay here again, due to its fantastic location and the comfortable apartment. Thank you.

We enjoyed our stay at Milagros and Raul's place very much.  The apartment was very clean and comfortable.   If we go back, we will definitely stay here again and will recommend it to our friends and family.

The apartment was ideally situated in the centre of Madrid: close to the metro, supermarket and Plaza Mayor/Puerta del Sol. We did a lot by foot.
Quick communication.
We had a wonderful stay in Madrid!

We had a lovely time here. It is in such a great location and is walking distance to many of the city's main attractions. The place itself is nice and modern, with great facilities. Very clean apartment and we would love to come back.

Eduardo was very helpful and sympathetic to our situation with an ill toddler in the middle of a heat wave... all rooms air conditioned which was very nice. Perfect location to see the sights... Recommended.

The communication and check-in was great, because we arrived really early and could leave our luggage in Eduardo and Raul's offices, which was nearby. The location is perfect: not at the Plaza Mayor (which tends to get loud), but two streets from it. Great flat for our city-trip!
Brilliant location and communication. can be a bit noisy during the twilight hours but I think that's because it's so central.
Apartment is in the best location. Cafe, grocery stores and metros right outside. Communication was great. Easy check in. Great building and a great apartment.

Really great value in the heart of the city.  It’s location across the street from Tirso de Molina metro station makes all of Madrid accessible with no need for a car or cab.  We took Metro to the apartment from the airport, transferred lines and arrived at the doorstep, pulling our bags only a few steps across the street.  My daughters and I walked everywhere, from the grocery store on the corner, to restaurants on Calle Cava Baja, to Plaza Mayor, Plaza del Sol, Mercado San Miguel, and all the great eateries.  We toured the Prado and Reina Sofia museums via Metro connection to Estación del Arte.  We connected to Atocha station for a train to Toledo.  You can’t get a better location.  The apartment is clean and uncluttered.  Bathroom is nice, and bedrooms are clean and comfortable.  Netflix is a plus, and the a/c works great.

This was a great centralized location. It was walking distance to many great restaurants, bars, and other amenities. The host was great, he showed us the apartment and was very responsive/flexible to our late arrival. Id recommend this place.

The location is great close to the heart of the city. The space was clean and comfortable. The apartment had A/C for the cold nights with a nice bathroom. It is closed to super markets and cafe. Thank you Eduardo !!

Terrific apartment in a great location. We walked everywhere, but the Metro was really convenient when needed. Great restaurants nearby and a market as well. We never met our hosts, but communication was fantastic and very quick. Thank you so much for everything!
Raul was very friendly, the place is bit small but for us it wad enough. The location is  amazing, right next to supermarket that is open 24/7, which made our stay even better 😊

Initially we arrived at the incorrect property, the Airbnb listing has incorrect address. The apartment was well equipped and nicely styled. Location was great, would recommend this property.

Miguel was a very good host who had fast replies and provided us with recommendations about the area. The house also has a very good location. The only downside was that there is limited hot water so it might be a consideration for those that take long hot showers.

The Airbnb was modern and clean, I also really enjoyed waking up to natural light. Raul is a great host. He is flexible, amicable and reactive.
The location of the airbnb is also very good as it is at a walkable distance to many famous places in Madrid.
Overall this was a great experience!

The apartment was comfortable and as described.   The location was an easy walk to everything.   Raul is very responsive and helpful.  The only issue with the apartment is the noise at night.  There are a lot of people out on the street until 2ish every night and that made it hard to sleep.

An excellent location for easy access to all of Madrid! Walkable, safe, and beautiful surroundings. Be aware that you are located near a main road so it tends to get a little loud in the evenings. My family and I didn’t mind as it reminded us we were in the heart of the town. Raul was always responsive and super helpful. Thank you for a great stay!!
Great place to stay near the city center in Madrid, definitely recommend. Host was always responsive and attentive. Would stay again.
Perfect location and very clean. It can be a bit noisy because it's near a busy street, but overall a great stay. Highly recommend!

We had a great stay in Raul's apartment. it was spacious and clean in a brilliant location.
We would definitely recommend the apartment.

Apartment was clean and spacious in great location. Communication with Raul and check in was excellent and easy ! Would definitely recommend it !
Thank you!

The apartment was functional and located near a metro stop in a walkable neighborhood with a few restaurants and a 24/7 carrefour supermarket.
However, the neighborhood is currently under construction and the supermarket has nightly deliveries right under the window of the apartment. Bring earplugs to make sure to have a good night’s sleep.

The location was excellent, literally around the corner from Plaza Mayor. The apartment had everything we needed in terms of amenities. Supermarket was across the street. The only downside was the noise, unless you are a very deep sleeper having an uninterrupted sleep was impossible.

Had to wait 30 minutes on the street for someone to let us in.
The square is under reconstruction, it is a bit noisy.

Susana's apartment is exactly as it is shown on Airbnb, it's clean, comfortable and in a great location, you can walk to all the main tourist areas within 20 minutes. It's also only 15 minutes walk from the Atocha train station which has a direct link to the airport.
Just behind the apartment is an area full of restaurants and bars.
During our stay my wife became ill and had to be admitted to hospital, Susana and her husband were really nice and both offered their support, we were very grateful to know there was someone there to call if needed.
I would certainly recommend a stay at this apartment.

The apartment is newly renovated and is well decorated and has all you need - including a dishwasher and washing machine. We felt immediately at home on entering the apartment and enjoyed sitting quietly on the balcony watching the world go by.
The location is really fantastic. All the main sights are within walking distance and there are numerous restaurants and bars nearby.
I would highly recommend this apartment to visitors to Madrid.

Had a great stay in this central location with our family of 3 kids. Very easy flat & comfortable to have as a base while exploring our old neighbourhood in Madrid. Round the corner from soo many great bars.

Apartment was clean and furnished nicely. The location was very convenient. It was walking distance to Prado museum, main train station, other sight seeing and shopping areas. It was near the Anton Martin metro station.

This apartment has an outstanding location, we could walk to all sites/neighborhoods and only used the metro on one rainy day.  The apartment was safe and very comfortable, and all furnishings and appliances were top of the line.  Many good restaurants nearby.
Susana’s place has a great location, easy accessible to the city center and is surrounded with great cafes

The location was perfect for us and we walked every place we needed to go. The metro and main train station are also available. There are several small markets nearby for groceries, as well. The apartment had everything we needed and was modern and clean. The hosts even had a nice bottle of Spanish wine waiting for us!
The location was perfect, it was close to everything. The apartment was clean and quiet. The communication was good.

Clean and spacious apartment in a very central location. Despite being located on a busy street, the bedrooms were very quiet. Light and bright living area, we (myself, my wife and our four year old daughter) enjoyed staying here and my daughter loved the bunk beds!
Fantastic location, and a beautiful apartment. Susana was very helpful and would definitely recommend to anyone wanting to visit Madrid!!
Susana’s flat has a great location with all necessary stores and cosy restaurants round the corner. The flat is modern but in a traditional building. Would really recommend!

Susanna’s place was awesome! The location was perfect as it was close to all the tourist/ busy parts of the city, but was still in a quiet more local area. The apartment itself was clean and the check in process was really easy. Would definitely recommend!

A lovely, lively space!
We came with a family of 4 and were very comfortable. There is a good market just steps away with all the basics for cooking or snacks if you desire. If not, there are lots of great shops and restaurants nearby. It’s up in the 4th floor (with an elevator!) so we really enjoyed hanging out on the little balcony and watching the world go by. Definitely would recommend!
Very nice and clean apartment in a beautiful and convenient part of town. We were so grateful they could get us two cribs for our twin babies too. Would recommend!

This was our first time in Madrid and this location was in the perfect neighborhood to walk to the main city attractions. Plenty of good food options close by and was quiet at night when you needed to rest. It had all the right amenities and felt very safe coming in late in the evening. Would recommend staying again if coming for a quick few nights to see the city.
Susana and the place are very nice! Just response time could’ve been better… other than that, it was a great experience:)

Susana's place was in a fabulous location, walking distance to many galleries, museum's, shops, and restaurants.
On a busy street which was easy to get taxis but incredibly quiet inside with double glazed windows.
Effective air conditioner in all rooms.
With a separate dining/ lounge / kitchen area away from the rooms, made more spacious than what you'd expect in a city apartment.
Definately recommend this apartment.
Susana’s place was very clean and the location was in the center of Madrid, Amazing spot, She was also very accommodating with an early check-in for us, Thanks for hosting us!

Would highly recommend this Air BnB! Very clean and spacious apartment in a very smart building in a great area, brilliant food market a few minutes walk from the apartment and close to all the sites of Madrid. Susa was a brilliant host and sent lots of recommendations.

Susana was a great host and very accommodating. I've asked her for an early check in and I was able to check in a 1:00 pm. The place is in a great location 10 minutes' walk to La Puerta del Sol and Plaza Mayor. Overall great experience.

This is a great place, very central right by metro, but still quiet. As a place to explore Madrid you would be hard pressed to find a better location. We were four adults (2 couples) and the second bedroom with bunk beds was totally fine.  Susana is a very friendly and responsive host, very pro-active, and very flexible to our check in needs. Recommended highly.

Susana’s apartment was as described: and better. High standard of fittings and spacious. All in a characterful central area where we could walk out in the morning to a choice of bakeries and cafes and walk in any direction to the sites we wanted to visit. Easy to walk to the 3 main galleries. Metro just a short walk away. We hope to return!

We enjoyed the apt. very much and love the location. It was very quiet for such a busy neighborhood, which had everything you could possibly need. Susana was very prompt, friendly and attentive and gave us great restaurant recommendations. Thank you Susana!

We loved Susana and the place. My only issue is with the hot water situation. I understand the need to take quick showers, but it was difficult to enjoy a show when you knew you had to make it very fast and your other guests had to wait several hours to use the show after you.
Other than that the place was very comfortable and quite quiet considering the central, busy location. I would recommend Susana's place to anyone traveling to Madrid.
Thank you for hosting me and my family.
The location and quality of property is very good.  We visited at a very busy, hot time of year.  All considered, we had a very good stay!

We had a wonderful stay here in Madrid! The apartment is quiet, yet still centrally located and perfectly accessible on foot to restaurants, museums, and markets. The AC was stellar during a heat wave and the kitchen had everything we needed for some simple meals at home.
This is a very nice appartment from which you can easily explore the Madrid city centre with its famous attractions such as the plaza mayor or the palace. It is close to restaurants and pubs.

It is a very good equipped apartment, clean and comfortable for 2 ~4 persons.
The neighborhood is nice and even the subway is near we have use it rarely.

The location is great! It is a very short walk to Plaza Mayor. The 4 floors is a bit of a struggle because the stair case is spiraled and slippery, but it wasn't terrible. Alfonso was easy to reach. I would recommend his place if you are staying in Madrid!
We had a lovely time in this cute apartment.It was perfect and great location.We would definitely stay here again
I super recommend. Location's great, it's very clean and the bed's very comfortable! Thanks Alfonso your efforts!

We had a great time at Alfonso’s place. It is really good located - near to all the fantastic tapas bars, main tourist places and metro station. The communication and check-in were easy. The air conditioner worked perfectly and the apartment is well equipped.
We can highly recommend to stay at this location!
Alfonso is always very helpful. The location is great! Close to restaurants, metros and walking distance to central. I had a great stay!

This was a great trip. The living accommodations made it so much better. Very clean and comfortable living space. Fantastic restaurants located on the next street over. We were able to comfortably walk the neighborhood as well as visit every place we planned without the extra expense of catching a cab or Uber. We are so appreciative of having such a great host!!! Thanks again Alfonzo!
I stayed for a month and would highly recommend the apartment! It’s in a great location, was very well equipped and Alfonso was a wonderful host.
This apartment was very cute, clean and quiet - and in a great location, close to great restaurants and quiet little parks.  I was very happy with my stay, and would recommend it!

We had a great time, starting with wine and cheese for a welcome gift from Alfonso. Couldn’t beat the location for all attractions in Madrid. He answered all our questions and had perfect recommendations. We were able to get our daily exercise climbing the 78 steps to the apartment. Would rent again!
Alfonso is a very attentive host. One of the best hosts I’ve had on Airbnb. Thanks so much, it was such a beautiful place.
This apartment is modern and spacious. Very easy to get to and is centrally located. The elevator was clutch and made our stay in Madrid a breeze
This was was perfect situated in my favorite part of Madrid - right on Pierry del Sol - very central to everything Madrid has to offer.  I’ll be staying again!
The host and his cousin are very nice people and we really enjoy our stay at this fantasitic place！

This apartment was perfect what you see in the picture is what you get or even better. I recommend this place 100% no need to take transportation and the train station is right In front of the building this place is a must.
This is a very cozy and yet elegant place to stay in beautiful Madrid, close to all what this spectacular city offers.  The profesional manners of the host and his team made a BIG difference.

An amazing apartment in the centre of Madrid with everything you could want a few steps away. The apartment is lovely, spacious and very clean. Madrid is a super place and this apartment is the ideal base to explore it.
Amazing location in central Madrid, ideal for base. Slightly noisy due to location. Melvin’s communication was brilliant.
Excellent location. The apartment was accurately described and had everything we needed for our stay.  Lovely comfy bed. Would definitely recommend when in Madrid.
Great host!  The apartment was perfect for our family of 5, very clean and in a great location!
Great location. Loud at night but not much. It is after all right at plazal del sol. Perfecto location

This apartment has a unique location, the facilities are comfortable and very clean, the hosts are attentive to any questions and explain you exactly how to get in .

It was very nice to communicate with Melvin. Location of the apartment is perfect I would definitely recommend it.

This apartment was great. It was the ideal location, so easy to get around everywhere! It was honestly even more spacious in person and very clean. Melvin was a great host, but a little bit slow on communication! I would definitely recommend staying here.
Spacious and clean, wonderful location! in 6 we had enough place, if you're ok to sleep on the couch (as we were) it's great!

Melvin is truly one of the best hosts we have dealt with in Airbnb. He is very attentive, quick, and accommodating. Everything we needed or asked, an immediate response came regardless of time.
The accommodation is excellent, spacious and clean. And the location is prime. We will defined book the same unit the next time we are in Madrid.
Thanks Melvin for everything.
Good central location with comfortable beds. Larger than expected. Only downside was building was loud during the night. Great value!!
Best location!! It was super easy getting around from the apartment. The owners communicated very well. Great stay overall

Great location and responsive hosts who were very helpful and provided instructions and recommendations. Apartment was clean and well kept. Privacy, clean and a good space. Perfect for travelling and visiting the city for some days or in my case for staying in Madrid for work. Carolina is without a doubt a great host and very nice. Will rebook for sure!
As expected.  Very clean and private.  Carolina is a great communicator.  Great stay.

Carolina's place is just as described. She is an exceptional host and was very responsive with communication. The space is very private and the location is very convenient with easy access to the metro, shops, and a nice park with trails for walking or jogging.

Carolina is an excelente host, giving to guests a lot of freedom to enjoy the apt. She is always concern about the details and the private bathroom is a plus. I had a very nice stay at this appartement which is a duplex with the lower floor as the guests space with bedroom and bathroom.  Close to the subway and bus stops. Superfriendly and enthusiastic host Carolina always ready to make your stay as nice as possible.

The convenience of the location to the metro is on point. I highly recommend this Airbnb, great value for the money. Carolina was a fantastic host

Great experience. You basically have your own apartment.

Great apartment, awesome communication beforehand & throughout our stay. Location is perfect, super-easy to get around by bus & subway. Really loved the modern kitchen appliances & having a washing machine in the apartment, which worked great. Thanks so much to Mariola for her hospitality.

Mariola could not have been more responsive before and during our stay which was beyond appreciated. Mariola’s place is perfect! It is gorgeous and in a very central location. We walked everywhere from it. Very clean and Maroila is a great host. She was available if we needed her, very hospitable and helpful and gave us some great tips on where to eat.
Cozy and small flat with a partial view of an alley.  close to restaurants and metro.  Small shower, but decent water pressure.  Mariola was very helpful and responsive

This place is great!

This was such a lovely stay in a great neighbourhood. Communication with Mariola was easy and welcoming. I will definitely be back to Madrid and look up this apt for a stay again. Thank you!

Awesome apartment in a location that is not only fun but convenient, with metro stations just a quick walk away. My girlfriend and I had a truly comfortable and pleasant stay. Highly recommend!

The bed was comfortable, ensuring a good night's sleep after a day of sightseeing. While the neighborhood might not be the most charming in Madrid, it is affordable. The highlight of our culinary experience in this neighborhood was definitely Hermanos Vinagre, located nearby. Their unique dishes, such as the anchovy and Russian salad, were a delightful departure from what we're used to in the US. We highly recommend trying everything on the menu. Although the view from the window in the apartment didn't quite match the advertised picture due to a larger tree blocking it, the place itself was cute and clean. Overall, a solid choice for those looking for a comfortable and affordable stay in Madrid.

Mariola's apartment was exactly what I need for the couple of days in Madrid. The apartment was easy to find and very close to the metro station. The soundround area is full of restaurantes, cafes, and near to Quevedo (a lot of restaurants, supermarkets, shops, etc).
The apartment was spotless and have everything you need to stay comfortable and relaxed. Mariola and Lorena (the cleaner) was very polite, understanding and kind. Definitely, I will stay in Mariola's apartment the next time I come back to Madrid.
Thank you Mariola and Lorena for everything! It was a pleasure meeting you!
Kind regards, Mariana

I really enjoyed staying at Mariola's place. The metro was very close so it was easy to get to other parts of the city. Mariola was very responsive and gave plenty of instructions and recommendations. Any issues I had were quickly resolved and she was very helpful.

We've stayed in a lot of places and this one stood out for being really well equipped with everything you might one. Charming decor, cozy, comfy bed, remodelled bathroom and coffee for your morning. Great location close to everything. Loved it!

We had the absolute best stay at Mariola’s. She allowed us to drop off our bags before check in and had easy directions to get to the airbnb. It’s in the nicest area and right next to a metro stop. She was super helpful and had lots of great reccomendations.
The place was absolutely spotless and beautiful when we got in. We had such a great stay and wished we had more time in Madrid than we did. Felt right at home and will definetly be returning.

Mariola was a great host and very proactive about giving information ! The apartment is just like on pictures: beautiful, cozy and clean and also well equiped ! we loved our stay and would love to come back !

It was our first time in Madrid, and Mariola’s apartment was in the best spot for exploring the city. Lively part of town, there is always something to do, eat, drink. The apartment is nicely decorated, cozy, perfect for a couple. Mariola was so generous and helpful in letting us leave the luggage in a designated spot after check out,  so we could comfortably explore the city until the very last hour.

I had a wonderful stay at Mariola's apartment! The check-in process was seamless with the convenient lock box, and the place had all the amenities I needed for my short solo trip. It's within walking distance to many great spots, and the metro is nearby, making it super easy to get around. Mariola was very friendly and communicative throughout my stay, sharing excellent recommendations for things to do and places to eat. The apartment is beautifully decorated and very comfortable. I would definitely stay here again!

Small apartment in great Madrid neighborhood... a 5 minute walk to the Bilboa metro stop. Marilola was a proactive communicator, fully and quickly answering all our questions. Lots of security...  although na it was a very safe neighborhood there were a total of three locked doors to get into the apartment :)
We really enjoyed exploring the neighborhood. Very walkable to everything. There was a lot of noise with some construction, but other than that, perfect!

Had a good stay. There was an unfortunate plumbing issue during my stay, but Mariola was very responsive in getting back to me. It wasn’t her fault and could have happened to anyone but I appreciate her willingness to correct the situation. She gave great recommendations in the area. Not centrally located but many of the main sites were a 15-20 minute walk.

Mariola’s place was perfect for our short stay in Madrid. The flat was clean, beautifully decorated and centrally located. The neighborhood was very hip and was close to all manner of restaurants and shopping. Mariola herself was a lovely host who let us drop our luggage early and gave us the option of sorting our luggage after. We would definitely recommend!

Mariola's apartment was an absolute gem in the heart of Madrid! The location couldn't be better - perfectly situated in the city center, making it easy to explore the main attractions. The apartment was spotlessly clean and beautifully decorated with great attention to detail. I particularly appreciated the coffee machine with complimentary podsy! The interior design showed excellent taste, creating a welcoming and stylish atmosphere. Even though I only stayed for one night, I would highly recommend this place to anyone visiting Madrid.

Nice clean and well located place. Easy to move around and walkable.
The only negative feedback is that it gets a little noise at night , other that that excellent .
Mariola gave great instructions to get into the apartment. The space was perfect for us. And the later checkout was very nice. Definitely recommend.
Nice little apartment in Malasaña/Chamberi area. Well located and has what you need. The suggestions and info from host was great. Recommended.

So happy we stayed here. The place is perfect like all the reviews say, not one problem.
Right by the metro, close to center and everything in the city, easy to get to from airport, easy to get to train station.
It's absolutely quiet (no bars below).
This is the place to choose if you're looking for a quiet stay, that's still fifteen minutes from the very center.

Mariola’s apartment is in a great location with lots to do and great restaurants nearby. It was a little tricky for us to find the keys. However, mariola was super helpful and very quick at responding. She addressed all concerns and even allowed us to drop off our bags early. I would highly recommend staying here.

Mariola’s place was great! Clean, quiet and comfortable. Location is in a great neighborhood with a lot nearby. Mariola left a great guidebook and was very communicative. We would definitely stay again!

We had such a great stay! The apartment is beautiful and clean. It has a big and comfortable living room and bathroom, and it is great for 4 people. The host is really nice and welcoming. It was a perfect experience, Thank you!!

The place itself is beautiful, very clean, well decorated, quite spacious and in a really lively neighbourhood. Plus, Laren and Lucas are great hosts! Lucas checked us in and gave us all the information needed, and was able to accomadate our need to check out late even when there were other guests coming. This bnb will definitely make your Madrid experience AMAZING!!

Laren is a very nice and beautiful host. The day we arrived, our flight had a couple changes and  delays. We should have arrived in the afternoon, but were postponed to the evening, and finally got to the apartment after midnight. Laren had so much patience with us. Even though it was already midnight, she still showed us around the apartment in detail. Beautiful, bright and newly renovated tall ceiling apartment. It was very convenient and lots of good night life. The day we left, Laren was very kind, and allowed us to leave our luggage with her. We had a great experience with this host.

The appartement is very good, has everything you need and is close the shops, bars and restaurants.
Laren is very sweet and helpfull.

We had amazing 2-night stay at this adorable apt in La Latina. The location is perfect! Very close to the Mercado de San Miguel, and Madrid's famous landmarks. There are bars and restaurants around the area, yet the apt is perfectly quiet. Laren was an amazing host. Very easy to reach and very accommodating. The apt itself was very clean and modern- nice beds, sheets, towels, and even an espresso maker (milk provided!). Would stay here again without a doubt! Thank you Laren!
Everything was perfect. The location is great very close to a lot of restaurants and Plaza Mayor. Definitely would stay there again.

Great experience! Thank s to Laren for a comfortable stay. She made us feel welcome and helped us handle a few situations. It was nice having someone who speaks both English and Spanish as well. The neighbourhood is wonderful too for kids. There is a playground next door and 4 min walk to Plaza Mayor. Great place!!

Laren's place was fantastic! Clean and centrally located for exploring by day. It is also in a great area for eating, drinking and enjoying the evening! That said it was still quiet in the apartment at night. I totally recommend Laren as a host and her apartments! I would definitely stay here again if I come back to Madrid!!

Lauren’s place is lovely, bright and airy, and central to most touristy locations in Madrid. Lauren was easy to communicate with and a really kind and cheery host. She was also kind enough to let us check in early, which we really appreciated. The apartment is equipped with everything you could possibly need, nicely decorated, and roomy with plenty of space for 3 people. We really enjoyed our stay and would stay again next visit to Spain. Thanks Lauren!

This was our first time in Madrid.
It makes such a difference to be warmly welcomed, and find that we were in a home which is so tastefully designed, yet comfortable and practical to live in.
We felt at home in Laren's, flat and found, too, that she has thought of all the details that allow you to walk in and start living.
It is very well situated for the centre of Madrid, and is in a street with restaurants that Laren is happy to recommend.
Laren, thank you.

My friend and I had an amazing stay at Laren's airbnb. The location is perfect, surrounded by tapas bars and restaurants. It is 5-15 minutes walking distance from most of the top tourist sites. Laren was very helpful and provided us with a lot of good recommendations for the area. I would definitely recommend this place to anyone visiting Madrid.
As exected, very nice and comfortable apartment. Living room is a little bit noisy in the evening as there is a garage entrance right outside thd front door.

If you are coming to enjoy Tapas and visit all of Madrid's scenic locations, this is the perfect place to stay. The apartment is perfectly located on tapas row and easy walking distance to all the sights including the Palace Real and Prado Museum to name a few. We loved the space and Laren is a great host!!! She answered any questions we had and made great recommendations for food. I would highly recommend Laren's place as a home away from home and would definitely stay there again.

We loved Laren's place, very central and the street was fun, full of lovely bars and restaurants.  We would recommend Tempranillo up the road (recommended by our host) and La Perejilla over the road (recommended by a food tour guide who we met in Tempranillo!).  The apartment is small but has everything you need for a few nights in Madrid.  Laren was very helpful with local recommendations and provided bread, milk and wine for our arrival.  Highly recommended.

First of all Madrid is a great city to spend a weekend or even a full week. We really liked the atmosphere in the city and Madrid is not overcrowded with tourist (yet?). We arrived one hour too early, but this was not a proble at all. Joaquin showed us the appartement and explained some details. The appartement is as shown on the pictures maybe even better. We were surprised by the fact that we got a bottle of red wine, milk and breath. The wifi connection (more and more important) was excellent. The location of the appartment is really great; it's quiet, but in the middle of the city. In the neighbourhood there are plenty restaurants, pubs, shops and all the highlights are within walking distance. Communication was good (with Lena). All with all the appartment is very recommendable.
A very stylish apartment and very clean.    It is close to major attractions and the neighbourhood is very lively in the evening.    A lot of locals seem to hang out here which is a good sign.

Great place with good light and positive vibes. On a perfect street within walking distance to anything you'd like to see in Madrid. Even though the entrance is on a busy street, the apartment is very quiet. Highly recommend!

Hosts were really wonderful. Met us on the property and offered local tips. Responded quickly, and provided great directions.
Many thoughtful touches; fresh milk, coffee, wine, bread, local maps, and favorite spots.
Shower was lovely, and location perfect. Close to lots of great food and attractions.
Highly recommended- thank you both!

Our host was really friendly and reactive. The flat is really nice and above all really well located. The area is very good, full of restaurants/tapas bars and close to the main things to see in Madrid.
Don't hesitate if you want to have a nice city trip in Madrid, which is the perfect city for food lovers !
This place is beautiful and in a great location! Lina was very quick to communicate and help, and when we didn’t get our luggage, her husband helped us know where to get necessities. A great stay!

Pros: Laren is a great host and was responsive. The kitchen was well stocked and had extras like tea, coffee, and wine. The towels were nice and soft and the apartment had a good amount of space. The apartment was also clean.
Cons: While you cannot hear noise from the busy street below, it is possible to hear quite a bit of noise coming from neighbors opening and closing doors and running water.

The location can't be beat. The apartment is very spacious and clean. Lina was super helpful with local tips. We tried the recommendations and really enjoyed them. She left is a bottle of local wine with we really appreciated. Definitely recommended.

Laren's apartment couldn't have been any better. We were on our last leg of our Europe trip and the apartment was spacious, comfortable, and the location couldn't be beat. All the big money tourist locations were all within a 10 to 15 walk (so save your money on that metro tourist pass, and use that saved money for extra tapas!).
The apartment building is close to tons of restaurants but is tucked away nicely so its quiet. Best if both worlds.
They were quick to respond to messages and were flexible with my check in, as our plane got delayed for some sort of emergency.
I am grateful we booked this location. I would happily stay here again and recommend!

The location is excellent - located on a street filled with incredible tapas bars. This area of the city is full of history and life, and a perfect location to base your stay.
A hidden gem, the apartment is clean and quiet, set back from the street but filled with natural light.
As a bonus, a section of the medieval city wall is part of the building...so cool!

This place was a total gem!! The best location in Madrid, the most thoughtful and responsive hosts we have ever had in an Air BnB experience and the apartment was perfect! Laren and Marta were fantastic! La Latina is a must when visiting Madrid! And the restaurant next door, Casa Lucas - best oxtail EVER!!! You can’t go wrong staying at this lovely spot in the heart of Madrid!

It was an amazing time! The apartment was in a great location; just outside was multiple restaurants and bars! Highly recommend Laren and Lina’s place if you’re visiting Madrid as it is walking distance to pretty much everything we wanted to see and experience in Madrid. Also, Lina was super responsive and amazing; would constantly check in with us on our stay. She was also willing to go out of her way for our Eurail passes. I would give her a 10 start rating! If we ever go back to Madrid, this is definitely the place we would stay at again!
Place was clean and just like the pictures. Location was great and would stay again! Thank you!!

Nice apartment, perfectly located in the heart of Madrid. Although there are many restaurants, pubs and shops in the surrounding and many people on the street at night, it is very quiet because the apartment is located in the backyard.
