It was a good stay in the apartment . The hosts are very welcoming and flexible. The flat is clean and well located. We spend a perfect time in madrid thanks to Laren
I booked this place for my friends. A family of 4. They only stayed a night but loved the apartment and specifically its location. Highly recommend place.

So many restaurants .. so little time !! Fabulous location, Metro stations within easy walk.
First time booking with Air B&B but very helpful, prompt communication with hosts and apartment
and was exactly as advertised - as well as being spotlessly clean and thoughtful welcome extras.
A very sincere "thank you" !!
Great location, in the heart of La Latina.  Responsive and helpful host.  We really enjoyed our stay. Would consider the apartment for our next trip to Madrid.
Laren was super responsive and flexible with check-in! The area is great and super convenient if you're looking to walk to the some of the main tourist attractions :)

Great location. One thing was a surprise for us was that it was not 1.5 bath but just 1 bath. Future guest please take note. We were looking for that half bath to speed up the morning chores. Lucas explained that is because the bath is large and Airbnb categories that way. In any case, would have good to know before booking.
Otherwise host were great.

Fantastic long weekend in Madrid. The apartment was in an excellent location, we walked everywhere! Fantastic range of restaurants, right on our doorstep. Felt like a safe neighbourhood. The apartment was clean and had everything we needed. Communication with Laren was excellent and check in and out was very straight forward.
Everything, from cleanliness to comfort, was brilliant! Definitely recommend for any young couple visiting, who is looking for a cost effective, cosy place!
The flat was small but clean. And very centrally located to where we wanted to go. Viviana was very friendly and nice.

Viviana was an exceptional host — communicative, friendly, and very accommodating to my various requests during my reservation. The unit itself is a great value — you can’t beat the price for how centrally located, comfortable and clean it is. The surrounding neighborhood is the best that the city has to offer. I will be sure to book with Viviana when I return to Madrid!

Viviana was a gracious host! She was very welcoming, responsive, and so kind. Her place was comfortable and clean. The location was great as it was close to many points of interest in the city and was within walking distance.

My stay in Madrid was great thanks to the perfect location of the apartment. The house is perfect since it has everything you need for a short or long stay. Viviana is very nice and friendly, she also answer very fast!
Beautiful apartment in an excellent location. All city center is walkable from there. The apartment was very clean and tidy. I would definitely book it again.
Fantastic place right by many great tourist attractions! Lots of supplies, very clean, and very homey. Viviana is a great communicator and the process was very easy.

We stayed at Viviana’s Airbnb over the Easter holidays and had a wonderful experience. My cousin and I can highly recommend this accommodation. We explored Madrid entirely on foot. It’s only about a 15 minute walk to Gran Vía, making it the perfect location for sightseeing. The apartment was clean and the bed was very comfortable. Both air conditioning and heating were available and the bathroom was a great size and very pleasant to use. Communication with Viviana was excellent. She was always reachable and very helpful. On our departure day she kindly allowed us to check out later which made our journey to the airport very convenient. There is a supermarket nearby as well as many great restaurants within walking distance. All in all, it was a fantastic stay. A huge thank you again to Viviana!

We really enjoyed our stay. The apartment was clean and well set up for what we needed. The host was very welcoming and helpful. Also the people in the cafe at the end of the street were very friendly. Would defiantly stay again, great location for the Mad Cool Festival. Thankyou

Loved staying at Angel's apartment. The apartment is beautiful, central located and very updated and very clean. You are very close to the subway station. Angel and his son are wondeful, carring  people and helped us a lot with the places to visit and all information we needed. They also have a private , undeground parking in a closeby building, where we felt that our car was very secure. There is nothing I did not like there. Greatly recommend this place . Thak you Angel for having us.
Angel is a really good host. The flat is located just 1 min from the metro station, is fully equipped and very clean.  I truly recommend it! :-)

Angel's place was great! We were pleasantly surprised since it was so well equipped with coffee, towels, spices, oils, washing machine, soaps and detergents.
Access to parking and the salt water pool just a 2 minute walk away were greatly appreciated.
Very comfortable beds, clean house and linens. Very responsive and helpful host. Great location near metro, the river walk, the matadero cultural center, bars, and a 20 minute walk to downtown Madrid.
Perfect for our 3 day stay, we highly recommend this place!

Angel was an amazing host, great local tips, the place was perfect, with great amenities and super clean. I would strongly recommend him. He went above and beyond to make my friend and I feel comfortable.

Legazpi is a great local area so if you don't mind jumping on the metro or walking to the centre, it's perfect. It is very close to Rio park, where there's lots to do, especially with kids. The flat was clean and welcoming. It isn't a massive place but has everything you need. We had enough space for us and our 2 young kids, as well as all ameneties we needed. We got very settled there! Angel was especially helpful to us and we're pleased to be returning after a few days away in Segovia.
Great location, amenities and flat. The flat isn't big but it has everything you need. We have stayed there twice and had a great time. Thanks a lot, Angel!

This a very good and ample apartment very well equipped. It is located in a quiet area in Madrid. Although not directly in in a touristic hot spot it is well connected by metro (about 100m from a station) and bus. The host is very attentive, friendly and helpful.

The location is very convenient. One minute’s walk from building to metro station. Angel explained everything to us. We understood him correctly even we speak different languages. The apartment is nice for family stay.
The house is in a good location to the metro. And you can any tourist attractions by metro in 30mins. Also, the parking lot is very safe. It’s quiet in the night.

Very good value. You’ll meet the host in person to go over the basics. If your Spanish is limited like mine, it pays to have a translate app handy. There is a parking space included - no space wasted down there so stay alert. It’s a short walk from the metro - and driving in downtown Madrid is very stressful - so skip the car if you can. Overall a very good experience.
Perfect location, easy to get into the centre and to Mad Cool festival. Also located closely to main train station. Lovely apartment

Angel's place is small, but in a great location. 5 minute walk to the metro connecting to the city, close to restaurants and grocery stores.
Angel was very helpful, and responded quickly when I had questions.
It is a small flat, however, so be prepared for a tight squeeze in the bathroom. But considering this was near the heart of Madrid, it's definitely worth it. And Angel is a lovely host.

Smaller than anticipated and was pretty cramped for 4 adults, but overall a great place to stay! Angel was very helpful and accommodating and made sure we were familiar with the space upon arrival. The proximity to the Legazpi metro station was very nice as well.
Beautiful place! We really enjoyed our stay. Our host is super nice and helpful. The stay is right next to metro and easy to get to

Good place to stay, located close to some attractions and walking distance to the rest, close to public transportation. Just consider that it is in a building that tends to transmit sound, not an issue for us, but the neighbors might complain if you make noise after hours.
Super helpful, met us at the door. Recommended a mall and some local spots to check out. Everything was easy.
Great place, nice area with everything you need within walking distance. Even tourist attractions and city centre not longer than 10 minutes on the metro. 10/10

Jeanne's flat is even better than described. It is absolutely clean, bright and is just in the middle of everything. Close to Gran Vía, Sol, El Retiro, El Prado, El Reina Sofía...anything you want you got it. Furthermore, nightlife is great in the are, it is just the place to be to enjoy some days in the capital.
Hope ti stay there soon again!

I had an outstanding stay at this Airbnb apartment!
The location was perfect, and the apartment itself was incredibly practical, it’s small yet it iffers ample cupboard space.
The host was exceptional—superb communication and efficiency. I highly recommend this place for a fantastic experience!
A wonderful way to get settled into the beautiful city of Madrid as this apartment is a little gem in the middle of the heart of the city, with a super efficient and responsible host.
Thank you!!!

Jeanne’s place was perfect for solo travel and extended stay. She had everything you could need for a longer stay and the apartment had excellent storage space, even for luggage. The location is perfect, next to all the cafes and restaurants and close walking distance to all of the main sights in Madrid. I would love to come back in the future!

Cozy flat located close to Gran Via Chueca and Tribunal. 15 minutes walking until Plaza Mayor and Sol.
Maria is very friendly and pleasant person, always looking for your confort. I would recomment this flat for the ones who would like to spent sometime in Madrid.

Very nice place, you have everything you need in the appartment and its perfectly located in a great part of Madrid. Maria Jesus and her husbond were very flexible when we got delayed and greeted us with helpfulness and no problems at all.
Her apartment is very good,it's better than what it looks like in the photos.next time if I travel in Madrid again I would like to live there again.

We spent 6 nights in Maria's apartment. The location is fantastic, very central and we felt very safe as Maria lives and works next door.  The apartment was clean and cosy and Maria is a warm and generous host. We would definately stay here again when we return to Madrid!

Maria's place is well situated in Madrid. The metro stop is just 2minutes away and this is also very near to the shopping areas. Maria is a very friendly host and was available for us for a smooth check in. She does not speak English but had a handy note ready for us with answers to usual check in questions. I would recommend a stay here.

The apartment is located in the city center. In few minutes you can reach most of the main touristic points of interest. Also many public transport stops are closed to the house. By few minutes walking are placed markets, pharmacy and restaurants.
The apartment is made by a pretty bathroom with shower, a small but complete kitchen in a living room with a sofa bed and the bedroom. We were in three and we found it very comfortable and extremely clean.
The host, Maria, was very kind and respectful and we strongly suggest to have a stay in Madrid at her apartment.

We had a lovely stay here, and our host was very gracious and welcoming. The rooms were bright and cheerful, and the kitchen was adequate for our needs. The location was close to subway stations and within walking distance of several things we wanted to see. One further note is that, if you are a light sleeper, there is some street noise you might notice.

Maria Jesus's place has two rooms and an apartment. I stayed in the apartment. It was very attractive---spacious, high ceilings, polished wood, clean. The kitchen could've been better equipped with some additional odds and ends but Maria Jesus (who lives next door) was most responsive when I brought this up.
Maria Jesus herself is a wonderful person---warm, welcoming and very hospitable. She made me feel very much at ease. When there were some issues with the hot water in my apartment, she offered that I shower in her apartment and even invited me to have tea, which I felt was a very nice gesture.
The apartment is also very well-located. All put together, a wonderful stay!

Not only this place has an amazing location (close to everything that matters in Madrid) and not only that Maria was an amazing host (everything was pristine) but this place actually has cultural significance as it is a former home of feminist Spanish writer, Emilia Bazan.  Truly special place! Highly recommend it!!

Maria Jesus’s apartment is very clean and comfortable. It is in a good walkable location in Madrid; we walked to El Prado, Plaza Mayor, Puerta del Sol, and many great restaurants and shopping places. Maria Jesus was very friendly and responsive. Her place is a great deal for the comfort and location, and I highly recommend it!

Great place and fantastic location .
The owner is charming and so helpful .
We had a great stay in Madrid .

The home was beautiful and it was perfect for two adults and a toddler. The sofa bed is not the most comfortable but it wasn’t a deal breaker either.
Just remember there is no elevator, so carefully consider how much luggage you would like to carry.
The place is very centrally located with great food and coffee options in walking distance
She was so kind host and she always try to give us whenever we need help🥹 I strongly recommend this place!

Nice and clean 1 bedroom 1 bed condo with street view. Great location, 2 blocks away from Gran Vía Ave. Surrounded by stores of all kinds.
The only downside was that the sofá cama placed in the kitchen-dinning room, was broken, so third guest had to sleep on the floor for the length of our stay.

Maria Jesus has been fantastic.
Its appartement is beatiful, close to the main Madrid activiry, for example Grand Via, Mayor Square, Royal Palace, Prado and more.
I suggest everyone to be a guest of Maria Jesus.
We'll back !
Beautiful apartment, safe location and walkable.   Good communication.    2 flights of stairs, on the 3rd floor, in case mobility is an issue.   We had a wonderful stay!

We loved our stay in Maria's apartment and would highly recommend it for a stay in Madrid. It was perfect for us and our son, extremely clean, comfy beds and beautiful decor. The area felt safe and was the perfect location for exploring Madrid. Thank you so much for our stay! Laura x

We had a great stay at this apartment in Madrid! We were three adults. The space was decent and the beds were comfy. The location is excellent, just a short walk to Plaza de España metro and close to Gran Vía. Having coffee available was a nice bonus to start our mornings.

Excellent, central location in Madrid! Was a lovely place for an overnight stay and exploration of the city. Extremely walkable, lots of shops, grocery stores, coffee places and sites to see. Thank you, Maria Jesus!
Great apt and centrally located near Malasaña. Despite being on a big street it was very quiet at night. We had a great stay.

We had a great stay at Catalina's property in Madrid. It's a beautiful flat in a lively area of Madrid. It was easy to get around, within walking distance of many of the main attractions and close several metro stations. The flat wad spacious and clean.  We would highly recommend staying here.
Great apartment in a great part of the city. Had a great time. Wouls stay there again.
The apartment is exactly what we expected and asked for. We were contacted and kept in the loop at all times. Great value for money in the center of a beautiful city.
The apartment is fabulous! Great location, very clean and modern. We regretted leaving so soon. It looks bigger in the pictures, but you won’t be disappointed.
This apartment was beautiful, it was so clean, comfortable and bright  and the location could not have been better, I would recommend this to anyone.

All went very smoothly. Not a ‘traditional ‘ Airbnb, as no actual communications with Catalina after booking. But all was handle smoothly by a medium sized company with offices in the dirty where we were able to leave our bags on last day.
Highly recommend the lovely spacious apartment and great district

Great location, exceptionally clean & great space!
Only negative is that it is a little noisy at night, but we knew that and opted to stay as location so good!
Tremendous rental.  The apartment and Amenities were just as expected.  The hospitality at check in made me feel as though I was visiting with a friend rather than renting an apartment.  Lovely time!

The apartment was as shown and in a quiet area. Because we are walkers, the location was ideal... we would walk to our destination early in the day and head back later in the day by taxi, which was relatively inexpensive.  The management personnel were certainly helpful, including allowing us to check in early.  We do recommend this apartment 😊

We were 4 happy friends in this cozy apartment! It was really clean and perfectly maintained! It is perfect for 4 persons. The host is reliable - Right on time,  trustworthy and all the information provided by him was precise and precious. The apartment is in the most artistic area, walking distance from the very center of Madrid. Everything you need is less than 5 min walk from the front door. Definitely is booked for our next visit in Madrid!

The second bedroom is very small. We had to push the beds against the wall in orderto open the closets. No place and open your suitcase in the second bedroom.
Pros: very close to restaurants and the metro.

Catalina's place was absolutely perfect for our trip. Location was amazing. Walkable to restaurant, metro, parks etc. The home alwas comfortable and clean. We stayed during the begining of july and the heat in Madrid was no joke but the AC units kept us extremely comfortable throughout our stay. We only had one minor issue which they responded to immediately and had someone come and correct the issue within a matter of hours. I would definitely stay again.
I spent two nights at this place. It was comfortable and a great location. Walking distance to many places. I felt safe in the neighborhood and would definitely recommend to anyone.
Really lovely, brand new apartment, with an amazing terrace. Really relaxing. About a 5 min walk to nearest metro which takes you to the Centre. Ines is a very helpful host.
we had a very nice living experience. The house has a very nice big balcony. The landlord Ines was very warm and friendly.
I liked the Balcony.The place is located in a very quiet area. The owner is very welcoming.
Clean, quiet, lovely space. Metro is a couple minutes walk. The girls felt safe on the streets also at nights.

Very clean and comfortable apartment, which is located in nice place near to both metro and cercania stations, and surrounded by storks!!! (The storks were really unexpected marvelous surprise!!!) Ana - the host is very friendly person and she had organized everything perfectly so that we could stay comfortable and feel as we were at home.  Highly recommended!!!
Ana's apartment is in a small suburb outside the city centre. It was clean and comfortable and well equipped with extras which was nice. Thank you Ana!
Ana's apartment was very clean.  The kitchen was well stocked and there were toys for kids The air conditioning was very much appreciated in the middle of August!

Ana’s place was nice inside with a few good touches for the kids. Neighborhood is a little rough round the edges but handy to the Metro and motorways. Overall it was good value for what we paid and would be happy to stay again.

Ana's place is one of the few places that I have found close to perfect. The available amenities in kitchen and toilet were more than enough. Sparkling clean place. Super comfortable beds. Ana's communication was super fast  and she went out of the way to research a few places that we inquired about. A place I would love to stay whenever I am in Madrid.

Ana's place is located in Villa de Vallecas, about 30 minutes by metro to the center of Madrid. It's like a small village, with lots of bakeries, supermarkets, and restaurants.
The house itself is fully equipped: kitchen with everything you need, nice bed, and the best shower we had in Spain! The neighbor Jenny gave us a warm welcome and communication with Ana was really smooth.
Only thing to note it's that the walls are thin. It's quiet at night, but during the day and in the evening people walking up and down the stairs and the neighbors watching tv.
All in all: the place is well worth it's money and perfect for a short stay. Thank you, Ana and Jenny!
Located a bit outside of city center but with easy access to train and metro. Great place, would recommend.
Check in was smooth. The metro station was walking distance away, however, the neighborhood would get a little noisy at night.
This was a great place to stay in a calm neighborhood. Easy access to public transportation. The place was clean and very well equipped. Definitely recommend

A great host with a great place in a great location which are the three things that make this a great value. Stay in a neighborhood that is a real neighborhood in Madrid but also close metro ride to all the things you want to do while in Madrid.
The location is close to the airport. Easy to find, with streetside parking. The litchen was well stocked and there were electric heaters. All was good overall.
Good apartment, a bit outside crowded Madrid. We stayed with a child, so had everything what we needed: clean baby crib, kitchen chair, toys etc. Responsive and friendly host. Recommended.

Great place! The aparment is lovely, the subway to the city center is very close and there is a huge park nearby, just a short walk away. The neighbors are a little loud, but that is normal in Spanish cities. I hope to come back one day!

I stayed in the room #3 which had its own bathroom inside, that was great for privacy. All the amenities were provided, WIFI is really fast, and the location was right by SOL metro station, and the whole neighborhood is very central and surrounded by lots of shops, cafes, bars, and restaurants in all directions. Mercado de San Miguel is 7 min walking distance, and that place is amazing to try all the delicious tapas. Mario is super kind and communicative, and very accommodating. Highly recommended. :-)
The place was a room in a shared flat, which was not clear from the listing. And the room was also smaller than expected. No locks in bathroom.

Carmen place is very clean, the room bathroom is sparkling, the house near bus stop so its really easy to go to the plaza majora or other destination, Carmen is very nice and helpfull you’ll enjoy staying with her
Carmen is very friendly, always willing to help . The room is tidy and the bed is cozy .
Carmen is a very sweet lady with a great sense of humor. Her house is clean, cozy and well localized. We had fun during our stay, our personal space was not disturbed and we felt at home. :)

Carmen was an amazing host! Her place is very lovely and close to restaurants, shops, markets, and cafes. Plus, only one bus to get to the center of Madrid! She made us feel at home and will definitely be staying with her in the future!

We stayed at Carmens place for 19 days, as we were moving to Madrid ;
First of all, Carmen was very flexible with the check-in, as she received us before the formal time;
The room as the house itself was squeaky clean, for whole duration of our stay;
The house is located in a very nice neighbourhood, well connected with the city center;
We could not have imagined more helpfull, kind and loveable person to host us!
Thank you again Carmen ❤️

We really enjoyed staying with Carmen. She is a kind, friendly and helpful person. The house is located in quiet and safe neighbourhood and is easy to reach by bus. The neighbourhood has a few cafes, a market, small shops and a supermarket. I can recommend this place and would be happy to come back.
Carmen is a gracious and wonderful hostess. She goes out of her way to make guests feel at home and comfortable. Highly recommend!

Expect a clean, lovely home in the suburbs of Madrid with a bus stop just around the corner that will take you into the heart of Madrid for just 2:50€.
A taxi from the centre back to Carmens cost around 13€

Our stay at Carmen's was way better than we expected. She was truly an amazing host during our whole stay as she helped us find good places to shop, best transposition and even recommendations of places to visit. She was respectful and always with a smile on her face, we had great laughs together and if she doesn't speak your language she'll try her best to find a way to communicate, she's also a very good and patience Spanish teacher! The house was impeccable, she cleans it everyday and warm during chilly times. We definitely recommend staying with her. Gracias por tudo, Carmen!

Carmen is a truly warm and welcoming host. From the moment we arrived, she made us feel completely at home. The house is spotless, and the room we stayed in was cozy, comfortable, and thoughtfully arranged. The bathroom and toilet were also very clean and convenient to use.
Carmen went out of her way to help us with transport information and local tips, which we really appreciated. Her kindness and hospitality made our stay even more special. We felt very much at home and would highly recommend staying at her place to anyone. Thank you, Carmen!

This is an amazing place, clean, centrally located, and walking distance to a 24HR supermarket. I did not meet naza directly but communication was perfect. She is a really good host and will do anything to accommodate you during your stay. I really recommend this place.

This is a really cute little flat tucked away on a quiet street, very close to the bustle of Lavapies. Naza was very communicative and helpful and accommodated my check-in and check-out requests without any issues.
Thanks for a great stay in Madrid!

Great location, walking distance to Prado museum and Retiro Park, near metro station and train station. But be careful if driving: better to study beforehand the access and parking restrictions. We drove into a zone which was off limit to non-residents and we expect to have to pay a fine. There's a covered parking lot close by. You pay €20 per day.
The apartment can sleep six if you use the sofa bed and the double bunk bed. Apartment was really clean. Sleeping on the sofa bed, we could hear the sound of passers-by.
Very clean, everything worked.

Lovely apartment with excellent location, plenty of great restaurants and cafes nearby. And only 10 min away from Atocha Station. The beds were comfortable, and the bathroom was nice with good water pressure. Although I didn’t cook any meals, the small kitchen was well equipped. Check in/out were both smooth. I highly recommend this apartment.

Flat as described . The sofa in the front room is not the most comfortable to sleep on , but useable .
Location is good , but a bit noisy at night . Near to most attractions . Naza's response to messages was fast .

The appartment was super clean, the kitchen and dishes are nice for cooking and the location is surrounded by a nice neighborhood with little bars and it's also very close to the amazing architecture of Herzog de Meuron, Jean Novel,...

Naza’s apartment was great. The location a 10/10 close to everything in Lavapies. The apartment was decent size, the wifi was quick, and everything worked. The only problem was the floor, some of the tiles made sounds and moved when stepped on. Besides that everything was great!
Cute place in a good area that is very walkable. No washcloths or conditioner so bring your own.

Lovely place, in a great location. You can walk or get the metro to most of the love areas of the old town. If you like art you’re so close to some beautiful galleries. The local food spots are fab.
The flat was comfortable and well stocked. We had a great stay!
I stayed 2 nights here, my first time in Madrid. I loved the location. The space was comfortable and spacious for me and 1 friend. I had a wonderful time and would stay here again!

Very nice appartment in a very vivid neighbourhood very near Msdtro and interetsing sites in walking distance. Also fantastic restaurants and a good Parking nearby. A very nice landlord. What more do you weant? Perfect!
The listing was exactly as described, very clean and comfortable. Naza is very responsive and helpful with questions about the apartment and the local neighborhood.

Stayed at Naza's place twice during my trip to Madrid.  Naza was always willing to help and promptly answered all of my questions.  Our stay happened during the countries power outage and Naza made sure to check in to see if everything was ok.  I would definitely stay at Naza's when I return to Madrid.

Juan’s apartment is perfect to explore Madrid. The location is next to the beautiful river and Matadero and a short walk or metro into town. Juan was very helpful and friendly and made sure we had everything we needed!

A great place to stay for anyone visiting Madrid, with great facilities within the apartment along with lots of shops locally. The apartment is in a great location, being only a short walk from the local train station which will bring you into the centre of Madrid within 20 minutes. Juan was a great host who was very welcoming and always on hand, this is a perfect place for a trip to Madrid.
The place is comfy and has a tons of different appliances, and even a dishwasher! It could use some more attention to detail though: some utensils were not washed well, for example
He was very kind, he let us to make the check out at 15.30, because we had the plane in the evening. In the apartament we had everything we needed. Thank you!
This is a very well equipped apartment located at a great location near to sight seeing options. Host is very supportive and helpful. Value for money and a comfortable stay.

Lovely simple apartment that was easy to explore Madrid from. Hot Tub was a single person bath tub with jacuzzi jets. Low ceilings which worked fine for us but folks above 6’ might have a harder time. Host was fantastic and responsive. Stay was lovely.

Nice apartment, well equipped with everything needed. The location is good as well - public transport and supermarket nearby. Juan is great host!
Highly recommend

We loved staying here. The host met us at the front of the apartment block and showed us around , he was super friendly and welcoming. The apartment had everything we needed - from a washing machine to food seasonings.
We weren’t sure if it would take a long time to get into the centre of Madrid but it only took about 20/30 minutes to get there as it was about a 10 minute walk to the closest metro and metros come every 5 minutes.
The apartment was also super clean- not a spec of dust or dirt to be seen !
We would definitely stay here again if we came back to Madrid !
10/10 experience

.
This spacious apartment is close to the metro.
There is a problem of noise at night from neighbors
We enjoyed ourselves

The apartment is located in a great part of the city; 10 minutes walk to Plaza Mayor and within walking distance to most major attractions, close to various metro stops too.
The apartment itself is beautifully finished and to a really high standard. The apartment is bright and airy and incredibly spacious. The bath and shower in the master bedroom are excellent. Edouardo and Raul responded very quickly to messages/queries. They have a lovely place here and I would definitely stay here again when visiting Madrid. Highly recommend 😀

The apartment was lovely - clean, comfortable, well decorated with great amenities and in a great location. The apartment door was a bit difficult to unlock at first, but we ended up getting the hang of it. I would stay here again when I come back to Madrid!
Great appartment at a great location. Bigger than expected. Everything is within walkingn distance, including a 24/7 supermarket. Fast communication and very flexible.
Such a beautiful space. The flat is gorgeous, has everything you need and the location is fab. Great communication and host super helpful. Would stay again.

FANTASTIC! The place is exactly like the photos. They went the extra mile to make sure that my party and I were taken care of. Highly recommend. Especially because it is in the center (and within walking distance) of so many great landmarks. I would come back and stay here again!
The apartment was beautiful. Very modern and lots of sunlight. Location was great for visiting all the main attractions in Madrid. The hosts were very responsive.

A beautiful apartment that was very true to the images, extremely spacious and well air-conditioned. Really great location, we walked everywhere we wanted to visit and didn’t need to get a taxi once, had a wonderful stay!

A fantastic apartment in central Madrid. The location is perfect and easy to walk to many of the city sights. The apartment was cleaned to the highest standard, and had the facilities we would except. Raul kept in contact since I booked and was easily contactable throughout our stay. I would certainly stay again and recommend this apartment.
Nicely decorated apartment in the best location! Great floor plan and cool kitchen.The bedrooms were really quiet.

Great apartment, very spacious, stylish and clean. An elevator is not available in the house. There are construction works at the nearest building, so you will hear construction sounds in the daytime.
Second time staying here and it didn't disappoint. Such a great apartment in an amazing location. Thanks Raul!

A fantastic apartment from which to explore Madrid. Very central and excellently appointed with loads of space and comfort. Raul is a brilliant host. So helpful and responded promptly to our queries.  We feel so lucky we found this place and can definitely recommend it. We have to family and friends and can’t wait to return!

Great apartment, very clean. 3 minutes walk from the metro and less than 10 minutes walk from Puerta del sol.
Raul is really nice and reactive when you ask him a question!
Fantastic apartment with stylish interior and in a great location. We loved our stay and highly recommend this place, especially for Autumn / Winter / Spring!

This apartment makes me dream of having one just like it! It was chic, well-maintained, cozy, and very well-located. Raul as a host was also very kind, responsive, and even funny! I'll definitely be looking to stay here again in the future!
This place has a great location relative to most touristic hot spots and food. The apartment itself is nice, but has some “rough edges”; needing some work on the bathrooms.

Spacious apartment. Nice kitchen. Location okay. Front door was old and didn't feel totally secure though (could see gaps through it when shut). Nice looking apartment. I had to clean a little when I arrived - especially in the bedroom.
Check in with a key pad was ok except it was very difficult to see the numbers without a magnifying phone or glass and the landing light went off every few seconds so it took me 30 minutes to get the key. I recommend you bring a magnifying glass to see the numbers.
I liked the apartment and the location was ok. However, the cleaning was an issue and the check in.
Place was warm and the heating was good.
Kitchen had a nice style to it and it was a nice looking apartment overall.

Fantastic stay at Raul’s apartment. Very central location for our stay in Madrid. Plenty of local amenities close by and apartment very well equipped. Would definitely stay again when I next visit Madrid. Thanks Again Raul.
This Airbnb was EXACTLY as described! We did not want our stay to end. Not only the Airbnb, but the city was truly amazing. We highly recommend this place for anyone visiting Madrid.

Raul's place was amazing! It was spacious and large enough for 3 adults to stay. Raul's fast response was very helpful when we went to the wrong address on the checkin day😂 The shower was a little tricky to keep the bathroom dry, but other than that, the location, air conditioning, double sinks in the master bathroom, everything was perfecto!

Wow!! An amazing place to stay with family or friends. We were so close to everything, restaurants, bars, shops and more. The metro was a 1 minute walk away as well as a supermarket. The apartment we super clean and tidy on arrival it was perfect for us 3 girls, the WiFi was very good too. The only trouble we had was the door, we did find it difficult to open at fist due to the style of lock but after a few attempts we got the hang of it. But not off putting as I would definitely stay here again. The host Raul was super helpful and very quick to respond to any questions we had.
Raul’s place was a pleasure to stay in. Very spacious and clean and in a perfect location. It was a great stay

This apartment is located walking distance from most of the Madrid attractions, and good restaurants.
Raul (host) responded to my messages very quickly.
I highly recommend this apartment.

The location was good, walking distance to restaurants and nightlife. The bldg had a newly installed elevator but it was not functional at the time. And although it was 3 flights of stairs which doesn’t seem like much but the hallway stairs were very old, original to the bldg, very uneven and awkward to walk on with suitcases esp for older people like my parents. The apt matched the listing photos. Would have preferred some more basic items like paper towel in the kitchen and more toilet paper.
Wonderful stay and Raul was very easy to communicate with.  He was a great host - would definitely recommend!
This was an amazing place! I really like the location and Raúl was an incredible host, everything super clean. I’d definitely come back again

This apartment is lovely, and in a perfect location. As many homes it is older, with what appear to be original windows, etc.  A little noisy but that's to be expected in the middle of the city and aside from roadworks was not an issue (the roadworks happened during the day).

The furniture was different than the picture and one of the showers was not cleaned properly (had hair all over). Pros were the kitchen was great for cooking at home and great location. Responsive host

Great stay at Raul's place.
He was very responsive by message, I structions were clear
and the apartment is very well located

We (family of 3) had a great stay at Raul’s place. Easy to walk everywhere, but on a quiet street so good for sleeping! Apartment is private, spacious, tastefully appointed, and with good AC (which we were grateful to use at night). We would definitely stay here again.
Beautiful place clean and quiet just found the 2nd room for 1 person because of Small bed other than that great stay will definitely recommend

We had such an amazing time there !
What a beautiful place and the location is just perfect for few days.
very nice apartment, very well located. nice and quiet, it offers the necessary comfort for 4 people. we were very well received. thanks for all.

Javier’s apartment is in a brilliant location and is fantastic value for money. It’s on the top floor (with lift), so very quiet and private. It’s a really unique space and had all the amenities we needed for our stay. Communication was excellent and quick. Check in was a breeze! Highly recommended - we’ll definitely stay there again if we have the chance.

The place was in a great location.  Would definitely stay there again however the spiral staircase and low ceilings could be problematic for those who struggle carrying their bags or are taller than 5' 10"

Javier's place is a great deal for visting Madrid. The location is great, the apartment is fully equipped with very good WiFi connection. We coordinated our arrival with Julia, who was very attentive with everything needed. I totally recommend this places.

The attic apt. is in a great location, charming building and quiet. The ceiling is a bit low in spots. The widow looks out at rooftops and sky. Coffee is provided! Nice elevator goes to small spiral staircase which might be difficult with heavy suitcase if lifting is a problem.
We had a wonderful stay!! Great location, clean place, fast wifi, and we were able to do laundry - everything went perfect!

We had a great 10 days in this apartment. The location is incredible (near to shops and restaurants) and communication beforehand with Javier was great. The space is really cute and clean, we did find that we had to sleep in separate locations as the bed is quite narrow (we are reasonably tall). However the sofa bed is exceptionally comfortable. Definitely would stay here again.

Amazing place! I would stay here again if I come back to Madrid. It was super clean, cozy, and convenient. The host responded very quickly and was very helpful. It was also such a great price especially with the location. Definitely would recommend this to anyone.
The apartment is very lovely, it got everything that we need. It’s right in the city centre and convenient to most public transportations. The host is very friendly and helped us a lot.

The apartment needs some TLC as we had a few minor issues which was solved on the same day
The location however could not be better or centrical for Madrid. Shops, bars, restaurants and metro all in walking distance.
However would not recommend for anyone with mobility issues because of a spiral staircase you need to climb to get access to the main floor and anyone over 6 feet tall as this apartment has been converted from an attic and the wooden beams from the ceiling are to low especially in the bedroom.
We had a great stay - the apartment is super convenient and comfortable. Would definitely stay again, thank you!
Apartment is very nice, however the ceiling in the bedroom is low. Great location and beautiful buildings around. Recommended for girls trips!

Cosy, clean and very well located. No window blind on the living room for those sleeping in the couch.
Javier is helpful. I recommend !

The location of the apartment is just perfect. Three different subway stations just around the corner. 2 minutes walk to Gran Via, 5 min walk to Sol, 10 min walk to Plaza Mayor. Lots of bars, pubs, restaurants just everywhere around. All types of stores for any kind of shopping also around. Apartment is very cosy and has this special vibe to it. Javier was very friendly and very helpful. We'll definitely rent Javier's apartment if in Madrid again.

Everything was perfect at Moncho’s. 2 Comfortable twin beds, fast working WiFi, hot shower. Perfect for a couple nights for two people. Just a few minutes walk to Lavapies, and only 3-5 minutes walk to Atocha Train station. I will definitely stay again.
I really liked this place. The appartment was clean and in a good area close to everything. Would definetly come back!
Moncho was very nice host and everything went well. The apartment is just like it looks like in the pictures. Very good location.

The studio was really clean and modern. Had air conditioning,which was a huge plus as it was so warm.  We were accommodated with an early checkin which was great. The lady who checked us in was very friendly and helpful with telling us how to get around the area 😊
Really enjoyed my stay here. The apartment was very clean and is in a great location. Stayed here for a week and would definitely recommend it.

Great location and the apartment looks just like it's photos. Felt clean and safe and had everything we needed for a short stay. Great quick communication from host.
Unlocking the building door confused us at first but we quickly figured it out. It is a steep narrow staircase into the flat, only mentioning it as maybe not everyone would find that easy.
Great location, very responsive host! We really liked the place! Lots of coffee places and restaurants around!

We loved the place!! It was in a brilliant location especially as we wanted to visit the three main art galleries of Madrid. The flat was really clean, the beds were very comfortable, it was quiet and it felt a secure place to stay. Thank you too for all of your speedy replies to any questions asked.

We enjoyed our stay very much.  The apartment is in a great location, convenient especially to several museums, but also walkable to most local sightseeing areas.  It is also walkable from the train station, which is handy.  The host communicated quickly and was very helpful!

We stayed in the apartment for 3 nights and we were really satisfied. Location of the flat is in the very centre and close to the nearest metro station. Nearby are also grocery shops, pharamacy, fast foods. Absolutly recommend for all the travelers into Madrid. Owner of the flat was answering almost immediately and he was flexible and helpful about our arrival. Thank you!
A clean, modern and compact apartment really near to Atocha station in a quiet residential building. Great value for money.

We were two people staying in the apartment and it was a good amount of space. It was very convenient to Atocha train station and the metro station which made traveling around Madrid and to other day trips very convenient. It was also a short walk to all the monuments and sites to see which was great. The place itself was very clean and comfortable. The check in and check out process was very easy and Moncho was very easy to get into contact with. Would definitely recommend!

Accommodation was very clean and modern. Location was brilliant, all main attractions were within walking distance. Host was very quick with responses and check in was straight forward. No faults to mention.
This apartment is in a good location, close to train and metro station. Room is clean and host is nice.

Very cosy and quiet place. Close to the big train/bus station Atocha. Center of a few metro stations. Great convenience to commute between different scenic spots of Madrid.
The host was nice and respond quickly to our every requests.

Everything was amazing, until I received a message to write only a 5 stars review. We need to understand that collect reviews is a way to be transparent, to improve and to show publicly that you as a host have nothing to hide. Actually the place is exactly as in the pictures. The AC could work better, the checkout hours should be more flexible. But in general it was a great place to stay. To the host: there’s no need to ask for only 5 stars reviews when your service is all about quality; do not be afraid of feedback.

Moncho' s apartment is at a very good location, very cozy and clean.
Moncho is very kind and nice, always willing to help us with our problems.
Moncho’s place is in a great location and was super easy to get to. Great for the weekend!

The apartment is located in a strategic place for visiting the museums and "el parquet del buen retiro", an is well connected by pubblic transport to the city centre, which can be anyway also reached with a nice walk through Lavapies.
It is made a single room equipped with the minimum. Good for a young couple wishing to spend most of his time outside. Nevertheless is well heated in winter and very silent.
My sister-in-law stayed here for a night to check out Madrid while we were in Spain. Great location, spotless and checkin/checkout was a breeze. Perfect for a stopover in Madrid!
Stayed here for a day and one night. The studio apartment was very clean and tidy. The hosts are very responsive/communicative !

Nice trip in Madrid! The flat was very cosy and clean with a good location closed to the museums and retiro Park. Arnaldo is really reactive and he made our arrival very easy with clear indications.
Thank you
Great spot in Madrid not far from all focal points. Host was great to us and responded very quickly. I had no problems staying here and I would love to do it again!
On this first trip to Madrid, we felt like we were home immediately. The apartment was clean and cozy and was in a great location for our sight seeing!
Perfect place to stay! Everything looked just like the pictures, was very clean, and in a great location. Would definitely stay here again and would recommend.

Beautiful apartment! Very easy to access and is located nearby everything. I walked everywhere and didn’t use public transportation as it’s a 25min walk to Plaza Mayor. The train station is less than 10 mins away. Place was clean and the air conditioner worked perfectly!
Great place to stay in Madrid. So convenient to get into the centre (only a walk away) and great communication from both hosts.

The place was clean and nice, location was also good. The host didn't wrote a word of english (even after we asked) so communication and check in was hard. The bathroom door also made a terrible noise and didn't give privacy with three of us traveling.

We enjoyed our stay at Moncho’s place. It is comfortable and clean. It is also convenient since it is close to most of the places we want to go in Madrid. Check in was a breeze as well. Highly recommend staying here for a couple of days.
Great communication & instructions.  Apartment is perfect for a short stay and then travelling on from Atocha station.  Recommended.

We had a very nice and quiet time in the apartment. It was very clean and neat. We had some trouble getting in since we were very tired and the  translation had some words that didn’t make sense. But other than that, we are very grateful to have the chance to stay that night in Madrid.

The apartment is perfect for two people. It's small but gives you everything that you need. The location very close to the metro stations and the large train station is great for getting around. It is also only 20-30 minutes from the airport with a taxi. The check-in process was very easy to understand.
great location. comfortble beds. Great shower pressure. Place is a tad more tired than the photos, but super clean and good value.

We stayed at Moncho’s place for three nights.
The apartment is close to Atocha train station with a bakery and restaurants nearby.
The beds are comfortable, the shower good and the room is quiet.

Good location. Easy checkin. Hard to communicate clearly because you get so many automatic responses. Certain furniture pieces were a bit broken but nothing too bad. You could still use it. The bathroom door doesn’t slide very well. But all in all a great deal.
Beautiful place though small.  We only needed it for a night so it was perfect.  The AC was the best part of all!!    We appreciated the stay!

The flat is located in the city centre of Madrid making it within walking distance of a lot of parts of Madrid. The metro and train station is also really close if you don’t like to walk. It was well equipped and had everything that we needed during our time there.

Great place for a few days in Madrid.  It's small, but cozy... good for one or two people. Clean and as described. The self-check in system was really easy, which was especially helpful in the case of a delayed flight and late-night arrival to the apartment. I will echo other reviews: the frosted class door to the bathroom doesn't provide much privacy (this is the door to the bathroom itself, not the shower door), but it's manageable. Overall great place, good price. Walkable to local points of interest. Would recommend!
Nice location, close to train station and metro stops.  Easy check in.  Responsive host.

We had a great stay in Madrid. Moncho's apartment was perfect for us. The location is fantastic. Right by the Atocha train station with public transportation and the airport right around the corner. The apartment is like the pictures, clean and has everything you need. It is very central and at the same time very quiet, being on the back of the building. Moncho was very responsive for everything we needed.
Highly recommend Moncho's apartment.
This was a great and roomy Airbnb.  It was located a few blocks from a subway stop.  I  wish I had another week to explore Madrid and stay in this room.

muchas gracias, we stayed only one night but it was really nice to stay at Carmen's house. it was really helped us when you pick us up at house in 6;30 in the morning to catch the early train. thank you!!!
Very helpful, place was spotless. Good shower and nice tv. Very well located with all mod cons

Thank you Lola for being an amazing host! We couldn’t have asked for a better and thoughtful person to stay with. Lola is very friendly and fun to talk to! She made us breakfast and offered us traditional Spanish food and drink.
Lola’s apartment is very central and in walking distance to public transport, shops and restaurants. She has the cutest dog named Lolo! The room was spacious, warm and comfortable to sleep in.
Great host, great apartment! I would highly recommend stay there. Gracias Lola!
Lola is so wonderful and welcoming! The room was very spacious and has everything you need. Her dog is also so sweet and adorable!
We had great time in Madrid! Lola is a very friendly Person and we got good tipps to the city. Lolas flat is in the heart of Madrid, so you could see every thing on foot 😁
This was a great location with a wonderful host. She gave lots of tips. The house was clean. The beds were comfy. The location is great and quiet. Loved this place.

Lola is a great hostess, not only the place is in a great location and clean, but she always offers her delicious and typical food from Spain. She is also very friendly and helpful. I would highly recommend this place.

The place is located in a very convenient location, being just 2 stops on the Metro away from the major attractions. The rooms are spacious and very cooling even in the summer heat. Best of all was the host's hospitality; while the host couldn't receive us personally, her sister welcomed us very warmly, and even brought breakfast into our room in the morning! Their hospitality alone is a good enough reason to stay here, and you will definitely not have any worries.
Lola was a very nice and friendly host...the room was clean and silent, her little dog is cute and not loud.

Fantastic location, Lola is a great host, so welcoming and helpful.  She very kindly made me a delicious breakfast and it was a pleasure to meet and stay with her.  The bed was very comfy, she provided towels.  I will definitely stay again.  Thank you Lola!
Super great host and the location is within a 20 min walk from most of the major sites!

Lola's place is perfect - close to the metro, walkable to the cool spots in the centre. Good size bedroom, comfy with thoughtful touches. Lola is a super nice host, super nice and warm hospitality. she made super tasty jam and was kind enough to offer me some. She also has nice suggestions in her recommended places. Highly recommended.
Her place was great and she was very nice and helpful! Her dog was very friendly and cute too! I would definitely stay again!

Lola is a very warm, affable host. I liked staying at her apartment because it felt like staying at home. Lola is often at home, working, cooking, hanging out with her little dog Lolo and her teenaged son Mario, so she is available for help and suggestions about things to do in the city. The apartment is located in the awesome Lavapies neighborhood, which is close to Reina Sofia, the Prado, and many other sites. It's close to Calle Argumentosa, which has many fun bars/restaurants to stop at in the evening.

Lola is a super host. Her apartment is incredibly clean and has a perfect location in the center of Madrid. Her dog Mr. Lolo is really sweet and intelligent.
I was in Madrid at the time the Corona epidemic began. Lola helped me with the food. We also had interesting conversations, which helped me not to panic in Madrid.
Recommend 100%!

Great location, everything is within walking distance.
The apartment is very clean and Lola is a charming host. She is so welcoming and has a motherly attitude towards her guests. Her tortilla with tomatos tost is fantastic!
Abrazos, Lola! 🤗

Lola was so nice and certainly made her home feel like a home. It was also just really nice staying in a real bed after a few weeks of backpacking! I’ll definitely consider her place in the future as it was very affordable and the neighborhood is very accessible when it comes to getting around the center of Madrid.

Lola is a special person to know! She's great company and I  had wonderful time getting to know her and her dog, Lolo. The location is wonderful (close to various metro stops and walking distance from major sites) and Lola has someone cleaning the apartment everyday.

The room is nice, you have full privacy! Lola is really helpful and uncomplicated and if you need something, she is there.. the room is perfect for one person. Recommended for someone who is looking for a nice and not expensive place to sleep in Madrid.
Lola is a wonderful woman and her home is precious.  The apartment is at a good walkable location and she makes a hell of a Spanish omelette. I had a great stay.

Lola is like a super Tía (aunt), she’s very welcoming and clear with the amenities, and everything related. If you are coming here to study at a amor de Dios, you are a 5 minute walk from there so it’s super convenient. All of the spaces are clean and clutter free. She also is a living encyclopedia of Flamenco in Madrid and for all of Spain so talking with her is just a treat <3

I had a great stay at Lola’s, she was very friendly and welcoming. The apartment felt very safe, the room was sizeable and clean, and the location was perfect for getting around Madrid. Would recommend to any solo traveller!

Lola was very welcoming and the room was a great size though a little dark in the daytime. Everything was very clean and I loved it that make your own breakfast was included. I would recommend Lola’s place
Really noisy, first night there is a home party to 3am. The other night, some moron speak overnight at around 2 to 5 am. Not recommend at all.
Excellent place in the center of Madrid. Lola is a wonderful host. I fully recommend Lola's place.

Lola was the absolute BEST for our stay! She was flexible with check in and even let us keep our luggage there so we didn’t have to carry them around before our flight. We felt right at home with Lola’s hospitality and generosity, thank you Lola!

Affordable airbnb in a great location in Madrid. We were able to walk to all of the main attractions. The bed was super comfy and Lola was a kind host.
Our room was next to the shared bathroom, which was a bit noisy in the middle of the night for a light sleeper. Otherwise, we had a wonderful experience.

This is a beautiful apartment and looks exactly like it does in the photos! Check in was super easy. The friendly lady who met us there showed us around and explained everything. A Mercadona is about 5 minutes walk away. Around 20 mins to the nearest metro station into the city, but it's a lovely walk! Would recommend an eye mask if you're sleeping on the sofa bed, as the sun peaks through the blinds. Overall, the area is very peaceful and chill, will definitely return!
It was a really nice Place, with a very quite neighborhood. Easy access. Supermarket 5 min walk.

My absolute favorite place to stay in Madrid! This flat is wonderful. Barrio Salamanca is a great neighborhood. Beatriz was so nice and hospitable. The flat was clean and very stylish. Will definitely stay here again.

Everything was great, the apartment is wonderful and comfortable. Great location. The hospitality was awesome, we had pastries and fruit for breakfast. The communication with the host was also super easy.  Overall, we had a lovely time!
Cozy, home-like apartment in a great location. Everything was as the pictures showed. Plenty of space for 3 people visiting Madrid!

Great place to stay in Madrid. Very comfortable, photos are accurate, location is great; best neighbourhood in Madrid close to lots of shops and restaurants.
Communication was impeccable, and we were greeted with a stocked kitchen with coffee, drinks, and even fresh fruits and croissants! Highly recommended.

Loved our stay here!
Beatriz was super kind and welcoming and helpful.
His place is lovely and clean and in a great spot.
Highly reccomend :)

Beatriz the cohost was friendly and helpful. She responded quickly to our requests such as helping us book transportation. The apartment is located in a very nice and convenient part of town. The appliances worked well. All together a very pleasant stay.
Everything was perfect, the communication with Beatriz was excellent, alway they were taking care about every detail that we need

We were very comfortable at Marianna's place. She left us lovely bread, croissants and some beverages in the fridge. Such a lovely welcome. The flat is clean and very livable, and in a fantastic location for walking anywhere in Madrid. We had everything we needed and our host was so proactive and responsive. Would definitely stay here again while in Madrid!

This was the perfect apartment for our 2 days in Madrid!  The Metro was very user friendly and a short walk from the apartment.  There was an elevator that was a great bonus.  And the doorman, Eduardo, was so nice!  Will definitely stay again if we come to Madrid in the future!
Great location in heart of Salamanca.  Hosts met us upon arrival and showed us everything.  Very responsive to texts.   Would stay here again.
Beatriz was very flexible in allowing us to check in early which was greatly appreciated! The neighborhood was lovely & I’d certainly would stay there again.
Wonderful location, very helpful and responsive hosts!  Thank you, Beatriz, for your flexibility and help!  Appreciated the morning treats and early check-in!  Lovely apartment!

The apartment was cozy and felt like home. It is located in the best neighborhood of Madrid - lots of fashion stores within 10-15 mins walk and very quite / peaceful surroundings. The hosts were hospitable and super friendly - she offered us breakfast. Would love to stay here next time we visit Madrid.

Mariana's place was great. The location is excellent and the apartment has all you need.  Someone was waiting for us for check in and they even had some essentials like bread and coffee available, which is a great touch when you arrive tired from traveling. Highly recommended.
We really enjoyed our time in Madrid, the appartment was on a perfect location and very clean.

In the middle of everything. Such a nice experience for my first stay in Madrid!! Apartment is 2 blocks away from Puerta del Sol and 1/2 block from Gran Via. Walking distance to most attractions. I didn't meet Pablo, but he always responded to all of my needs, gently and quickly. Patricia, helped providing early check in accommodation for an extra guest. I strongly recommend this apt for either a couple or a family up to 4 people. Gracias chicos por la atencion, nos vemos pronto!
Luis, Alberto & Lucas!!!

Very cool apartment equipped with everything you need. You can't find a better location in Madrid for sightseeing. Pablo is super nice, communicates fast, gives top recommendations & helps you with everything you need. Furthermore, we could drop our bags before the check-in & when we checked in later, the apartment was cleaner than a hotel room. 10/10 recommend!
Thank you Pablo & Patricia!
Very nice apartment, highly recommend it when you want to be right in the center of the city.

Great location. Central to everything!!! We had a great time in Madrid thanks to being so close to everything. The place was clean, had AC which was nice in the summer heat, and decent WiFi.
Thank you Pablo and Patricia! I would definitely book your place again.

Modern clean apartment in the centre of town, 2 minutes walk from Callao. Central, busy bustling city centre right outside your door!
Apartment itself is comfortable with everything you need, had a lift, safe and secure. Nice bathroom with shower.
Easy to get around using Metro. We did a trip to Segovia & Àvila which I'd highly recommend, a nice day out. We used Express Tours, €40. Lots of souvenir shops offering their trips.
For the best churros, visit San Ginés, 5 minute walk from apartment. Also Mercado de San Miguel for an amazing selection of tapas.

Excellent support from Pablo. A clean, neat, spacious, well organized and greatly located apartment. His guidance, tips and communication are on the top ranking. We strongly recommend Pablo and his place; as well as Patricia (his assistance). He represents Airbnb to it's best standard. Thank you very very much.

This place is fantastic. Location could not be better. Walking distance to literally everything. Just a minute walk to Callao metro and 2 min to Sol.
Apartment was exactly how described even better. Very clean, spacious. It has everything one needs. I stayed with 2 friends and had a lovely time.
Pablo was lovely host. He provided lots of information, maps and advised us where to eat and what to see and we tried everything he suggested and it was great.
He was the best host I had experienced so far.
Apartment was very clean and has all amenities we needed. Really lovely place in the heart of Madrid. Very good value for the money.
I highly recommend this place. I will definitely will return here.
Many thanks to Pablo and Patricia.

The apartment is fantastic and in an amazing place.
Super clean and confortable.
Pablo and Andrea are super hosts.
I hightly recomend this apartment. You will be at the heart of Madrid and can walk everywere.
Thank you Pablo and Andrea, I will return.
This is my favorite place in Madrid. :)

The apartment is very nice, well located, close to the city center.
Tobias was very welcoming and gave us advises all along our stay.
Thank you for everything ! It's was perfect !
Marion

Host:
Tobias was very friendly and helpful and tried to accomodate all our needs. He gave us some great tips regarding restaurants, public transportation and sightseeing and even welcomed us with a bottle of wine on the rooftop terrace.
The check-in was very easy and Tobias took time to explain and show us everything we needed to know. He replied very fast and was easy to communicate with.
Flat:
The flat couldn't be more central! It is very close to all the important sightseeing spots, restaurants, public transportation etc. The rooftop terrace is very welcoming if you want to have a break from the busy life in the city.
Thank you for the great stay :)

Great stay in Tobias' place - location is superb, right in the center of the city. Everything is just in the walking distance from the apartment. Metro is also very near and if you're taking the hop on hop off tour bus, the stop is just a few minutes away.
Apartment is spacious with complete amneties. Especially love hanging out outside the balcony and relaxing after a long day. Communication with Tobias is also very easy and he accomodated our early check in and late check out requests. Definitely recommended!!

Great communication with Toby prior to visit. Late night check-in was arranged (12:30 am) at no extra cost.
Location is absolutely fabulous and served our needs for being in the centre of Madrid perfectly.
Wonderful space with lots of light and fantastic views from the enormous terrace over the rooftops of Madrid. Host was very communicative and helpful. Highly recommend!

Tobias was a great host and made us feel right at home! He went out of his way to send a video of his apartment prior to check in with helpful instructions about where to find everything and even arranged for his friend to greet us when we arrived as Tobias was out of town. We loved staying right in the city center as there were lots of excellent restaurants and shops all within walking distance. Definitely would stay here again!

We had a great time staying at Tobias’s apartment. The location is extremely central which is amazing. If you are easily disturbed by noise the center is pretty loud with lots of bars so I’d advice to pick a different place. The terrace was clearly a highlight with great tapas evenings enjoying the views and sunset.

We had a lovely stay in Tobias his apartment. Just like everyone said the location is 10/10, very central and all the big highlights within walking distance. The apartment is spacious with a big terrace which we enjoyed. :) Communication with Tobias was also very pleasant. We would recommend others to book this apartment when going to Madrid.
great place to stay, Tobias is very friendly and helpful. it's near Gran Via (main street) where you can find restaurants and everything. Five Guys is 8 minutes away
Tobias was a fab host. went above and beyond to help us with our needs for our stay. Great central location for walks and to metro lines to all the tourist attractions. Thanks Tobias!
Incredible location, lovely classic Madrid building. Warm and cosy for our early Feb stay. Would definitely recommend.
Great location. Tobias was easy to work with and extremely responsive. His housekeeper checked us in and was super helpful. The terrace was so nice. Very clean and quiet.

Tobias was very responsive and helpful as was his co-host Carlos who checked is in.
The accommodation had a wonderful rooftop balcony that provided great views during the day and at night. The air conditioning was good for staying cool, and beds were very comfortable.
We had an outstanding location for seeing the art museums, Retiro, Royal palace and much more. The proximity to the Sol plaza made getting to one farther-away tour pickup easy.

Couldn't recommend this flat enough. Our favorite thing was the roof terrace, it's even better than in the photos. Beautiful old building with high ceilings and all the facilities you could need in the flat. Couldn't ask for a better location, everything you could want to do and see in Madrid is walking distance. Tobias is a very kind and helpful host, extremely responsive and couldn't do enough for us. We felt so lucky to have found this place.

This is a great place.  The location is perfect .  It is roomy and comfortable and well stocked.  Tobias frequently contacted me to make sure everything was working for us (it was) and to offer whatever we might want.  Highly recommend.

Great apartment in a lively area of Madrid. lots of bars and restaurants in the surrounding streets.
The apartment is comfortable and has a decent balcony.
Great location and great hosts. Were very accommodating and communicated from the very start. Would love to stay here again on our return to Madrid.

The whole experience at Carlos and Maria Eugenias apartment was great. Fully equipped, super clean, great location and very friendly hosts. Like a hotel but with the advantages of an apartment. Highly recommended.

Even knowing how to give you thanks! Thank you so much!
It was very cool! It was the best apartment we have ever rented and the best owners of this apartment. They are people who realy love children, and very polite to their guests. With great respect to you, good luck to you in everything!

The accommodation was excellent, it was in a great location and about 10 minutes from Retiro Park which is a must to visit. There are restaurants, cafes and shops nearby and handy for the subway. The flat is on the 2nd floor but there is a lift. It was quiet and felt safe.   The accommodation was a home from home and the host provided all you need to start off your visit. We had a warm welcome from Maria and she explained how everything worked. I’ve stayed in lots of four/five hotels but this was even better. When I’m back in Madrid I will book this accommodation, it was clean and fresh looking and air conditioning in all rooms. I was staying with my wife and older daughter and we all agreed it helped make our stay in Madrid great. Deserves to be a super host.

Absolutely the best AirBnB experience we’ve had. Spectacular apartment with all the amenities and special touches. They ever had a fridge full of food, welcome wine, and gifts for our kids.
Carlos reached out every day to see how we were doing. Great local recommendations as well. Will recommend them to all our friends.

This was a wonderful experience, beginning to end. The apartment is lovely - tastefully decorated, with a quirky charm. It's also newly finished, clean, very quiet, comfortable, in an excellent location. It's impossible to think of any amenities that Carlos didn't provide. Everything (and more) was included. Most of all, the genuine warmth of the welcome and the prompt response to questions made us feel at home and well cared for. I recommend this place - and Carlos as a host - without reservation.

Exceptional place and location. Carlos was a great host and was able to provide thoughtful gifts and items that we would need for our 2 year old that traveled with us. Would definitely stay there again.

It has been the best Airbnb experience of mine. Carlos is great, he has thought of every single detail. House cant get nicer and cleaner. The fridge was full for breakfast, nibbles. Communication is perfect. Location is great. Carlos himself doesn't speak much English but he has friends/family coming over so no need to worry about that at all. If you are 2-4 people this is your house in Madrid.

The apartment was just perfect! Great location, very clean, and super kind host! Carlos was always ready to help us and give us recommendations about places to visit. He really cared about making our stay  pleasant.

The apartment is fantastic!  It is in a great location, is very comfortable for a family, and Carlos is super helpful and very available at all times. The apartment is thoughtfully decorated and the hosts cater to their guests to make everyone as comfortable as possible, providing details and accommodations such as food, presents, and options for entertainment. Would definitely return the next time in Madrid!

Fantastic place to stay! Even better hosts! Carlos and Maria have thought of literally everything you will need. From a fully stocked refrigerator to built-in Bluetooth speakers in the bathroom, this apartment takes the cake in the Airbnb plus selection! I’d definitely recommend Carlos and Maria’s place to anyone traveling to Madrid!

Carlos is a great host and the apartment couldn’t be better! It was really well decorated, full of details, spectacular location and 2 comfortable bedrooms and 2 cozy bathrooms. Thanks Carlos for everything! We enjoy our stay a lot.

My stay was perfect. The apartment is great and in a fantastic location. Communication was easy and Carlos and Maria did their best to let me check-in early and check-out late. The apartment is fully stocked with toiletries, food, and drinks of all sorts. It's a great choice!

This has been my best airbnb experience so far! Carlos was a wonderful, helpful, and very welcoming host. He thought of all the details we could have possibly needed, and more. We felt so at home at the apartment that it was sad having to leave. Everything was spotless, new, and well thought of;  from the amenities to the decor. The location was perfect, in a quiet neighborhood just a short walk from Parque del Retiro and the other areas we like to visit during our stays in Madrid. 10/10!

This home was perfect! The location is ideal, a short walk to retiró park where you can spend the whole day!! Nextdoor is a super market with great prices (especially compared to the US).  Carlos made it feel like you are staying at a relative’s home the way he thoughtfully provides everything you could need. The house was spotless and very comfortable for a family of 4. The tv is awesome! And I was even able to print a form that we needed from the computer. The ac worked well!  The washer has a drying function but it worked well to line dry. There are more than enough towels. We definitely will recommend and plan on staying here again when we return!

Five-star host!!
Carlos was a brilliant host – always getting back to our emails within minutes. The flat was spotlessly clean, contemporary and yet felt homely. It is in the central location of Madrid yet very quiet, within walking distance to lots of the main attractions and 2 metro stations. It is well equipped with everything we need, including hair dryers, tea coffees.
The kitchen was excellent equipped, with all utilities required, there were even spices should you wish a quiet dining. Carlos kindly left some breakfast supplies for us. Welcoming with a Bottle of red wine, chocolates. There were special touches such as toiletries situated in the bathroom with a plenty of fresh towels as well.
The place exceeded my expectations and my family and I had a lovely time.
We are definitely returning as soon as possible, and will be recommending this place to friends/ family! Thanks Carlos for such a lovely stay.

We had such a nice experience in this apartment! Carlos and Maria are the ultimate hosts— they provide everything you could need. The apartment was stocked with food and drinks and local maps and information, and they even bought presents for our girls, which was such a lovely gesture. The apartment location is great, and the apartment itself is very comfortable. We loved our stay!

We had a wonderful stay. The apartment was very well prepared, with all the necessities you will need and more, with a fully stocked fridge and all the comforts possible. Carlos was an extremely attentive and helpful host throughout our stay. The location of the apartment is excellent, in a very good neighborhood, a stone’s throw from Retiro park and all the great restaurants and boutiques of barrio Salamanca. The beds are very comfortable and the apartment is very cozy. We were three adults and one baby and never felt crowded. Highly recommended.
Great host. Great location near Parc Retiro in a good neighborhood. If we return to Madrid 100% chance we stay at this apartment!

Carlos and Maria are top-notch hosts!  Their apartment was well appointed and comfortable, the best we have stayed at from all our travels.  Food and beverage and toiletries were provided, to name a few! They have thought of everything!  Communication was easy and fast!  The location is excellent.  Nice and quiet, yet close to restaurants and metro! We had an  excellent stay in Madrid 😀

What can I say that already hasn’t been said. This is a very unique Airbnb experience. I heard it was well stocked but couldn’t believe my eyes. Full refrigerator stocked with enough groceries to last a week. Cupboard full of food and plenty of coffee. Fresh fruit, wine, chocolates and fully stocked bathrooms. I had the opportunity to meet both Carlos and Maria and they are very warm and friendly. The location is amazing especially to Retiro Park. 10/10 stay.

Do not hesitate to book this place! One of the best Airbnb experiences I’ve ever had! The location is in a safe, convenient area, close to shopping, restaurants and the metro. Carlos and Maria were amazing hosts and went above and beyond to make sure we had everything we needed. The apartment itself was spacious, clean, and beautifully decorated, with all the amenities we could ask for. Overall, I would highly recommend this Airbnb to anyone looking for a comfortable, convenient, and enjoyable stay in Madrid.

Carlos and Maria could not have been more wonderful!  We loved staying in their apartment and their attentiveness made our trip so much easier!
