We loved the treats they left for us on arrival and could't have been more responsive.  This was by far the best airbnb I have ever stayed at and would come back again! Thank you Carlos and Maria!

Carlos and Maria newly renovated their place to be like a 5-star hotel with luxury service to match. Thoughtful detail and hospitality from pre arrival until the moment we left where they made sure we got into the taxi they had reserved for us.  30 second walk to carrefour express,  11-15 min walk to Retiro and it’s central location makes it convenient to cab or metro to all the major destinations in Madrid.  We are SO glad we didn’t stay in a hotel this trip.  If  we ever return to Madrid, we hope their home is available! Gracias!!

Wow!! My family was just blown away by Carlos’ hospitality, generosity and attention to detail. He made everything SO easy for us from accommodating our check in time, welcoming and helping us on the street into the apartment, having a fully stocked fridge and pantry (this was the most amazing treat arriving with two little hungry kids!) and also products in the bathroom! He even left our kids little toys and treats!
I’ve used Airbnb for 10 years, extensively in Spain, and Carlos’ home is hands down THE best experience I have ever had. We actually felt like we were in our own home, and we knew that if we needed anything, Carlos would be there for us. Thank you SO much Carlos! You will see us again!!

Carlos is the best Airbnb host we’ve ever had! He was very accommodating and generous with his time and thoughtfulness before and during our stay. He was proactive with his communication and he was quick to reply to my questions. The apartment was equipped with everything we needed (and more!). I can’t wait to come back to Madrid and stay at Carlos’ home.

We feel so lucky to have found Carlos and his home. This is the 2nd time our family has stayed with him. We feel like Carlos’ home is our home in Madrid. We have two kids under 10 and we feel so safe and well taken care of that we won’t stay anywhere else when we visit Madrid. You simply can’t ask for a more thorough and sincere host, and such a well appointed, comfortable and clean apartment. Thank you so much Carlos, can’t wait to be back!!

The best and cleanest Airbnb my family and I have ever stayed in! Carlos and Maria were wonderful hosts! They answered every question we had and were always attentive if we needed anything. The apartment itself is clean/spotless and stocked with everything you need! They truly go above and beyond to make your stay the best. We will be back!

Our stay in Madrid was perfect! This flat is amazing! Quiet, best location and just simply beautiful.  They offered so many amenities we didn’t have to worry about anything. We had all we needed and more! Super comfortable if I could give 100 stars I would! Just perfect! If ever in Madrid again this will be the place to stay for sure.

I rarely rave in these reviews, but Carlos is another level. I have never stayed anywhere that’s been so meticulous, caring and generous in every way.
The apartment itself is lovely, well appointed and amazing attention to all details.
The place was stocked with everything I could ever imagine! From every type of milk and alternative, every nespresso capsule you could want, food for us to eat, even a nice bottle of wine to greet us and gifts for my daughters (who were not even staying with us!). 5 star hotels rarely are as generous and thoughtful as Carlos. Anything I can say about this apartment, location, etc is only secondary to the amazing host!

This was definitely a 5-start stay. The apartment was very comfortable and had all the amenities of home. On top of that Carlos left a full fridge and pantry full of food that we might need while we were there. Carlos was very welcoming and responded quickly. The location was great too — close enough to the Retiro for a nice walk and a very short walk from the metro. It was also very comofortable for working. The wifi worked well and there were plenty of tables to sit and do work.

What a fabulous apartment! We had a wonderful stay in Carlos’ apartment. The apartment was wonderfully furnished, spotlessly clean and superbly stocked with everything you could possibly need!
It is Located in a lovely, peaceful part of Madrid with easy access to all the sights, with local restaurants and a supermarket nearby.
Carlos was very helpful providing useful tourist information and local restaurant recommendations.
We would highly recommend this apartment and hope to visit again!

We had a wonderful stay! Carlos was seriously the best host. Very responsive, above and beyond, flexible, proactive, all of it! The place had everything you could ever think of wanting and then more. Perfect location near retiro, great for walking. Can’t say enough!

I highly recommend rafael's place , we had and excellent time here in his place, very clean , great location , excellent host and Eliza help us a lot ..
Thanks Rafael

Rafael’s place was jut as described. The location was perfect and easy to get to. The building was quiet and only one short flight of stairs to the apartment. I would recommend Rafael’s place again and again!

A great space in a central location! The apartment was very comfortable for two people, right around the corner from grocery stores & bars and a short walk to Palacio Real or Sol. Very clean, a great value for the price. Would stay here again!

Great apartment, great location!
Very nice, cozy and clean flat just next to the Plaza Mayor. Few minutes away from the metro station, close to bars, restaurants and shops.
Apartment has everything you need or even more. Excellent stay in Madrid!

This place was excellent in many ways: location, space (for 1-3 people is good), spacious bathroom, kitchen available, comfortable bed. I would have liked to find more towels and more coffee capsules without having to ask as well as a broom or some more basic cleaning supplies given that I stayed for 4 nights. I texted the owner and did not respond, however the housekeeper is wonderful, available, kind and accommodating. She made the trip better!
The flat is centrally located - very convenient. Check in is very easy with a lockbox and code. Close to transport from the airport and around town.
It was a great stay with a great location and the airbnb also being one of the cleanest and there is nothing i can complain of 10/10
Location was perfect, the Place was a little bit small and sofa bed not really comfortable but overall a nice stay
the place was clean and very accessible! beautiful neighbourhood, and instructions from the host were quick and easy to understand.

The place looks like the photos and in a great location as it is a few minutes away from the cathedral and Royal Palace. Felt like a safe area besides a sketchy dude standing on the corner hissing at us in the middle of the night while coming home from a bar. The stairs to the loft have a very odd design but wasn’t a big issue for us. If you are budget traveling and don’t need to be in the apartment very much this is a good spot.

We really liked our stay. The apartment is perfect for 3 and has everything you need. The location for us was perfect and right in the city centre so everything was walkable which is great!
The checkin instructions were good and the apartment easy to find.
Just one thing you should consider is if you have allergies I wouldn’t recommend this place because two of us were coughing the whole night only in the apartment and we are not sure what is was.
Other than that everything was good.

Thanks you so much to Luiza and Cristina for this stay in this beautiful loft. They were very accommodating with us and we had a nice welcome!
The location of the loft is very convenient, just 2 minutes to the Métro Station.
See you soon :)

It was a five-star standard fashion apartment. We enjoyed our stay there. Close to all the sightseeing places and opposite the train station. My wife loves the design of the apartment and it was well equipped with all you want in the apartment. Definitely will come back again.

My fiancé and I loved this loft. We were staying in Madrid for a few days and decided to stay somewhere fairly local. The host Cristina is very knowledgeable and knows English,Spanish, and French (possibly more). She met us outside and recognized us almost instantly.. which was a huge bonus since we weren’t familiar with the area. There’s access to the elevator for convenience and the building is secured and quiet. The loft is absolutely ideal for 1 person or a couple. However, it would probably be a little tight if there is more guests. Its very clean, minimalistic, and cozy. The location was pretty central and was next to the metro station which is ideal here in Madrid. There’s also lots of restaurants and cafes to choose from. This place felt like home.
A perfect place to stay in Madrid. Excellent conditions, location and communication with the owner. It was a experience to repeat.
The place is great! The shower and the bed were comfortable. Just in front of the subway and train station! I would stay there again!

The location is superb. And check in super easy! They even let us put our luggage first before the exact check in time!:) Super hospitality and everything was the same as shown in the picture:) Definitely recommended it!
The perfect AirBnb for a short stay. Clean, stylish and everything you need close to the city centre.. We will certainly stay again.
We really enjoyed Cristina’s place. Very close to the train station and Metro and a small store right next door.  Would stay there again

The Loft was absolutely amazing, beautifully decorated with lots of eye for detail. We felt at home right away and were in love with the place. It smelled so good when we walked in and was very clean. It is located right by the metro station with the city centres main metro line, which means you are in city centre within 15 min. I highly recommend staying in one of Cristinas places, it really made our stay in Madrid so much more special.
Excellent location on musuem mile and so convenient to Atocha. We even loved the local bar and restaurant below for a coffee each morning before we started our day.

The studio apartment Is perfect for Two people. It Is clean and newly renovated. The position Is perfect to visit the centre of Madrid and its museums.
Simple, clean space - nice area near some great locations but tucked away on a more residential street. Our first time in Madrid was a success and we really appreciated the great hospitality!
Thank you for accurate & practical ways to hosting. I truly appreciate it your responsiveness & friendliness. I look forward to staying in your place again.
Wonderful apartment, lovely seating area, so central to all the galleries and things to see, really enjoyed our stay!

Host is very responsive and willing to help.
Worth it for a few days in the city.

This apartment was in an amazing location with incredible shopping and nightlife. A few minutes away from the metro. Grocery store literally next to the apartment and SO many restaurants. The apartment itself had a nice bedroom and sofa bed. I really enjoyed my stay!

Excellent value. Great location. very clean and well equipped unit. The
A/C was a treat with heat this year.

We really enjoyed our stay in Madrid in Gius’s apartment. The communication and Check-in instructions were perfect. Although, the apartment is not suitable for a group of 4 people (smaller than what it looked like on the photos). The apartment is perfect for 2 people.
Samira

Excellent location, fast response from the owner; the only issue was that it doesn’t have a lot of space for storage so for 04 people with their suitcases it can become too crowded. Also, it has a supermarket right down stairs that’s very convenient. And the orientation of the place makes it very quiet even when there are parties outside, for me that’s excellent

The apartment is located in a superb place, totally central, you can walk to all important touristic places easily. The hosts are nice, responsive and helpful. Everything in the flat was as listed in the information about the place. The bathroom was clean and had all the essentials.
nice home, good communications and easy automated check in. We were 4 people and for spending most of the time outside (exploring Madrid) it was excellent value for money!

Absolutely gorgeous apartment!  Stylish decor, very comfortable and spacious.  Very clean. Amazing location with tons of restaurants and shopping.  Right at Puerta del Sol and 15 minutes walk to Royal Palace and Parque Retiro.  Host was great at communicating and super helpful setting up ground transportation and providing local tips.
Very spacious house set right in the heart of downtown! The hosts kept the house clean and very modern. The hosts were available for everything we needed. Would recommend this apartment 10/10
Very nice place right in the heart of Madrid. Very welcoming host and responsive. Coordinated stay very well. Great experience overall!

Our stay was even better than expected. Really amazing and stylish  appartment. Communication went smoothly. Very convenient location as you can walk to almost anything in the city centre. We would definitely be happy to come back or recommend to any of our friends staying in Madrid.
Wonderful spacious place right in the heart of the city.  I would recommend this place to anyone traveling here.  We very comfortable and big.

This beautiful space is perfect for a larger group (we had 7) in the heart of downtown Madrid. The living room and dining room were great to relax in and plan our adventure for the day. Great space to stay in.

communication was easy, great location as it is walking distance to all major attractions in the centre, loved the accommodation layout and the cleanliness. highly recommend especially for families and group of friends.

This is the place! Close to everything. We walked in all directions and saw the beautiful town, then at night we’d come back to the apartment, clean up and saunter out for dinner. The apartment itself is very big and our group of five had plenty of space. Three bathrooms made our large group seem like luxury instead of dormitory. Washer and dryer always make travel easier (yes it was chocolate sauce!) And I love having the fridge. Mornings were coffee and tea in the apartment, yoga (the living room is that big) then off to buy a pastry.
We loved Mercado San Miguel and had a great tapas dinner there. That’s a five minute walk.

This place is absolutely fantastic!
Was pleasantly surprised on my arrival. Clean well looked after and decor was amazing.
Definitely a great place to stay with family or friends and location is great too.

Pros: very central location (pedestrian area only - keep in mind if taking taxi to/from apartment - you’ll need to walk 300-400m), huge, plenty of bedrooms, beautiful living room, decorated as advertised, check in easy after midnight for small fee with someone from the property mgmt company waiting out front when we arrived, quick communication over WhatsApp. Good for a big group who all prefer their own bedroom bathroom.
Cons: the heat and hot water went out 3x during our 4 night stay. Company was attentive, but it was still inconvenient to deal with late at night after returning from dinner. The building doesn’t really seem to be an apartment building — there were offices on the floors below the apartment and the main door at street level was wide open which made it feel a little less secure.
This is a great place.  We found it clean, well furnished, with beautiful art, great air conditioning and a great location right off Sol.  I would highly recommend it.

Great space, perfect position in the city centre. Very clean, well equipped and made easy by the management company. Madrid is a great city and
we will definitely be back staying at Jose Maria’s great apartment
Large & beautiful apartment - well located in Sol area of Madrid.  We enjoyed watching the theatre goers when we were home late.

We stayed for a week. The location couldn’t be better. The dining area was great for gathering. The living room is large and comfortable. The bedrooms are large and relaxing. The bathrooms are modern and the showers were outstanding.
This apartment felt like home and made our week in Madrid that much more special.

Bottom line: a perfect location for an amazing apartment, to go back to.
I never go back to places I’ve been even if they were amazing, but this one is a special one I’ll miss so I will definitely go back.
Highly recommended!
Well appointed apartment in a great location.  Very close to shops and restaurants. Can easily walk to Puerta del Sol and Plaza Mayor.  Would love to stay here again when in the area.

The apartment location is fantastic! Easy to walk to many shops, metro, restaurants. Love the Coffee Roasters cafe right out the door!
The apartment is well appointed and feels like home. We would definitely stay here again.
It's clean and comfortable. All the spots that I wanted to visit are within walking distance. Recommendable house!!!

Beautiful luxurious apartment, very walkable to many places like plaza del sol and metro. So nice having three bathrooms, each with double sinks.  Large fully equipped kitchen with dishwasher.  Large living room and dining room.  Our group of 6 relaxed there in comfort!
Great location.  Everything within walking distance.   Comfortable space for 6.   Modern decor was pleasing.  Very clean and well kept. Would recommend to travelers considering a trip to Madrid.

Our family had a wonderful stay at this Airbnb right in the center Madrid! The apartment was very spacious, spotlessly clean, and had everything I needed for a comfortable visit. The location is fantastic—right in the heart of the city, making it easy to walk to many attractions, restaurants, and shops. The elevator was a plus for my elderly mom and aunt.  Communication with the host was smooth and check-in was simple, Carla met us the door as soon as we arrived and always responded within a few minutes.  We highly recommend this place to anyone visiting Madrid and would happily stay here again when we visit Madrid next time.
Fran’s place was spacious, clean and well equipped. The location was ideal to get to the airport the next day. Would highly recommend for accommodation in Madrid.
This is a newly renovated apartment in a great spot. Highly recommend this for a Madrid short stay. Tony & Lisa K

What a beautiful apartment! We felt so special staying here. Not only were the accommodations top notch - the location was fantastic! Close to the train station and within walking distance of everything we wanted to see and do. Plus, the tapas restuarant recommended by Luke during our check-in was the BEST of the trip! Many thanks!

Perfect big apartment, in case you are staying with a group. We were with 6 and the apartment was defintely big enough. 3 sleeping rooms, one sofa to sleep on, 2 bathrooms. Also the location is great, no issues with traffic sound, and a metrostop around the corner. Also the disco El Kapital is just crossing the street ;) I can definitely recommand to book this apartment if you are searching one in Madrid.

Monica's apartment is very stylish and comfortable.  It is a quick walk to the Atocha train station and to lots of eating places of varied cuisines.  Highly recommended for a family or a group of friends

Lovely modern apartment with plenty of room for three people. Great kitchen and fully equipped with nice touches like an automatic espresso maker. Roque was a fantastic host; he made us feel so welcomed! Thank you for a great stay.
Monica’s apartment is wonderful. Spacious, clean, and plentiful in amenities. Prepare for this to be your home away from home while in Madrid - it truly has all that you need!
Beautiful place, great location, nice and reactive hosts. Everything was perfect for a fun week end in Madrid!

Wow!  What an amazing find.  This apartment is stunning.  Very warm, cosy and homely.  It is in a fantastic location, very close to Atocha train station, La Reina Sofia, Prado etc. The apartment has been very tastefully decorated and has everything you need for your stay in Madrid.  The hosts were very responsive and friendly and facilitated us with any queries.  We would definitely stay here again.  Thank you Roque, Monica and Petra!

My family and I enjoyed the place and had a good time. Just we had to experience one simple thing and it’s that there was no elevator and with many luggage it could be difficult. I would recommend it for friends.

This apartment was beautiful. We felt like home, very nice decorated, with everything you need. Was very clean and had lot of light. Check in and out was easy and host were super nice accommodating. Location was perfect too. I will stay here again.

A beautiful, well-designed apartment on the footsteps of the Reina Sofia museum. The design of this apartment is well thought out and catches the eye. The apartment is around the corner from any amenity needed, including a metro stop and the Atocha station.
And the hosts were so helpful, answering any question, providing local advice and even providing wine and other goodies as welcome gifts. Could not have asked for more responsive, accommodating and helpful hosts!
I would definitely stay in this apartment again without hesitation!
Superb, quiet and comfortable apartment next to the train station. We could easily walk to our areas of interest. Very nice!!

The apartment was ideal.  The location was convenient and interesting.  It was also clean and well-equipped.  The kitchen and dining room had all the utensils, dishes, and glassware necessary for a large family.  Bathrooms were clean and in good working order.  Beds were comfortable.  Plenty of lighting and outlets.  The hosts were very responsive to all questions.  We would definitely stay here again.

We enjoyed our stay at this Airbnb. It is in a great location and the apartment was comfortable and had plenty of space. The host had coffee available, a washer and drying rack, and other thoughtful details to make our stay more comfortable.

HOT! Temperature hot! This space is absolutely stunning with architectural detail however the thermostat is programmed so you cannot change it. I was sweating at night and found it unbearable. The host was kind and has put a lot of attention to the details but IMO if the climate is uncomfortable than all those details are for nothing.
Great location with all the amenities!!! We will definitely come back if in Madrid again. Easy check in and out. Loved the place!! Great for families or small group.

We loved our stay at Monica’s place. The location is perfectly close to sooo many things. The apartment has everything we needed and was beautiful.
Clean, bright, airy, spacious, modern decor. We had a great stay. Thank you!

The apartment was spacious and welcoming. We arrived in a heat wave and the apartment remained comfortable throughout our visit. The location couldn’t have been better- near museums and parks and walkable everywhere else!

The apartment is amazing and the owner is on top of anything we had a question about. It is spacious, well designed, and it’s a great location a block from Madrid’s main train station. It’s a few steps from the Reina Sofia art gallery and 5 minutes from the Prada. Downstairs there are local stores and restaurants. It’s a great place, and we wouldn’t hesitate to stay again.

Wow, what an incredible place!
The apartment was warm and inviting. Very stylish and modern. The hosts were extremely welcoming and we wish we could have stayed longer. Thank you so much, we enjoyed everything!

The house was immaculate and she even had water, wine and milk for us ready when we checked in.
The location is perfect and makes walking places very easy! I would stay here again!!

This place was very good. The hosts were very attentive and even offered to help us with our luggage since we are traveling with kids. The location is SUPERB and their recommendations were spot on. Even though the heater was not accessible for us to change (only dislike) they went personally to set it up. Roque and Rosa made our welcome to Madrid very enjoyable. It was clean, comfortable, and had everything we needed.

Spectacular location.  Very good cleaning. Communication with the owner of the apartment was excellent.  I recommend it 100% and more if you travel with your family like me.  Very close to the Atocha train terminal.

The perfect place to stay in Madrid. It has a great location. I stayed with my family, including a 2 year old and we walked everywhere. They provided everything to make our stay the best stay. Communication was amazing. There is a starbucks right outside the door of the building. Definitely recommend this host and place, we will be back!

We stayed here for two nights and immediately wished we were staying longer - the apartment is gorgeous, super comfortable and very well appointed. It’s location is walking distance to the train station and numerous museums, parks, restaurants - perfect.  The hosts are fantastic, hugely helpful and their local guide was a perfect introduction to the neighborhood and Madrid.  It was our first time staying in Madrid which is an amazing city, and the apartment certainly contributed to the wonderful experience we had there.  We will definitely look to stay here again when we come back to Madrid.

Excellent location, walkable to all attractions.  No lockbox, so plan to meet for key exchange. Host very easy to reach. Apartment just as listed, nice treats in fridge. Easy to use laundry, which was important to my family! Lots of local suggestions.  Luggage storage nearby if you need it. Would definitely recommend and would stay again!
Monica’s place was beautiful and walking distance from many things. We were a family of 5 and had a great stay.

Had a great experience at the Airbnb and the host was super helpful. The apartment was tastefully designed and built. The only sore point was that the apartment is located on the second floor and there is no elevator in the building.

The location of the Airbnb was superb, right in the heart of Madrid, making it incredibly convenient for exploring the city's many attractions. We were within walking distance of major landmarks, great restaurants, and vibrant nightlife.
The apartment itself was clean and well-maintained but also beautifully decorated. It had a cozy, modern design that instantly made us feel at home. We appreciated the attention to detail in providing everything we needed for a comfortable stay.
The host was outstanding in their communication and hospitality. They provided us with valuable local tips, including recommendations for nearby. I would definitely recommend.

The apartment has a great location and is quite clean and comfortable.  We had some problems controlling the thermostat/temperature but Monica sent someone over right away to fix it.  We would definitely stay there again.

monica's place is beautiful. it is concise, appointed with everything you need and nothing you do not. the space is climate controlled with cold water under the floors. this worked perfectly and made a very pleasant respite from the heat. highly recommend to the highest level. it is just a great place.

We experienced an excellent stay and appreciated the centralized location. The place more than adequately accommodated our group of five. Well done interior and very suitable living area and kitchen. It was a little hot at night without  central AC or way to stay cool.

I stayed at Monica’s for a little over week with my family. It was our first time in Madrid. There were 5 of us and even with that many people the place was still very comfortable to stay in. It’s in a fabulous location close to many restaurants, museums and city sites. All within a short walking distance.
Monica was very accommodating and responsive to any of our requests. I would highly recommend staying there for any trip to Madrid
Excellent in every way! The apartment is very cool and located right in the middle of everything! The hosts were awesome and very responsive to all our needs. Highly recommend!
Roque, the apartment contact was extremely helpful, responsive and friendly. The location was great, close to parks, restaurants and the metro line. Would recommend a stay there whilst in Madrid.

The place was very close to the Atocha train station which was our number one priority since we were doing day trips on some days we were in Madrid. It was a plus that the property had a 3 bedroom perfect for my family of 4; huge living room and kitchen/dining area and lots of restaurants downstairs and nearby. Museums and top Madrid attractions are very much walkable. Just make sure you communicate with them when you are on the way to the property. We had a great stay.

We had a great time.
There was an issue with condensation on the bathroom floor but Monica is taking care of it.
The place was super clean and comfortable and the hosts were responsive and accommodating. There was even a bottle of wine in the fridge when we arrived.
Very nice. I would stay again.

My three siblings and I stayed 3 nights at Miguel‘s top located, modern and very clean apartment in the middle of madrid.
The terrace is definitely the gem of the apartment with a great view. A fully equipped kitchen and bathroom make it feel like home.
Communication was great and we would definitely stay again in his amazing, air conditioned apartment.
Thank you again Miguel
This is the most beautiful and comfortable Airbnb in our trip. Everything is so good. The room is big and clean. We are really happy to live here. And Miguel reply the message quickly and helpful.

Really nice apartment - excellent location.  Highly recommend for 1 or 2-3 people.  Shower and kitchen were awesome.  Everything you need is nearby.  Bedroom comfortable and large.  Very quiet.  I would come back if staying in Madrid again!
My girlfriend and I had a great one day mini stay at this cute penthouse, can only recommend to anyone for a getaway. Surprisingly quite and beautiful balcony!

Great location, easy and hasslefree check-in (although I arrived around midnight). All that you need in Madrid is just around the corner. Only thing to note is that the flat is on the 4th floor without an elevator

One of the better airbnbs I've stayed at. Daniel met us right on time to check in, and the place was as described. Very clean, and had everything we needed. (Also, does have a washer in unit.) Enjoyed the patio and having the AC, and the location is super convenient. Thanks for a great stay

The stay was great !
We couldn't have hoped for a better apartment location, right next to Gran Via and every great spot in the city is within walking distance.
The apartment is in accordance with its photos, spacious and clean, it's also always great to have a terrace.
Thanks for everything and best wishes !

Perfect place for Madrid. Great location, with the bars, shops and restaurants of Malasaña on the doorstep and only a couple of minutes to Gran Via. Easy check in and we were kindly offered late check out by Miguel. Will definitely be back!
Great location; loved the balcony! Miguel was also super responsive via the AirBnB app whenever we had questions.
The apartment is very nice and well located. On a Sunny day  to kick a start of a day off on the terrace is amazing
Beautiful apartment, located at the center of the gran via and the host is very nice offered us a late leaving in order to help us out
The location was perfect! we liked it a lot. We habe been 3 girls, and had a lot of space.

thank you for the hospitality
We had a great time at Miguel's apartment,
Comfortable, clean, well-equipped, and in an excellent location.

This Madrid apartment, a block from Grand Via, was great. It boasts a fantastic location, tucked away in a quieter street yet close to the city's vibrant heart. The interior was stylish and clean with modern amenities.  The  intimate terrace is perfect for evening chats. The hosts were responsive and helpful, making the experience even better. Highly recommended for a perfect Madrid stay.
Very nice apartment close to Gran Vía, but still peaceful at night, even on the weekend. Nice balcony and modern apartment. Would definitely come again.

The host is very friendly and responsive, the apartment is very nice.
The downside is that is located in a sketchy street, a lot of prostitutes standing outside the building and coming in and out of the building. Not recommended if you are traveling with kids.
Had a superb stay at this apartment in the heart of Madrid. Central to everything in Madrid. Very comfortable and a good size. Highly recommend.

Great apartment in a great location. Immaculate and as described. Good instructions to gain entry and how to get from the airport. The host responded quickly and allowed a late check out which was great. A great location to explore Madrid

This was such a great place. From fast communication with Pedro, Leo, Diego & Antonio to an amazing home that exceeded my expectations. This home is truly in a wonderful location that I felt safe walking home alone at 3am after befriending locals at a near by restaurant. Close to attractions, grocery stores, bars and clubs I’m already planning more trips to Madrid and wouldn’t think of staying anywhere else except for the homes of Pedro and Leo. Thanks for everything guys!

The location of the apartment was excellent !    In a pleasant neighborhood, near the center, and across the most lovely bar (excellent for breakfast in the morning !).  We felt that we could not have stayed at a better place !!  The apartment has very recently been renovated and has all the comfort !  Even though we arrived past midnight, we were welcomed and shown into the apartment.  We had a magnificent long weekend at Madrid and this apartment and it's location did contribute to that !!

The place was very clean and modern, nice surroundings, close to main points of attraction. The host was very quick to respond to messages, even at 12am when we were checking in! Overall a wonderful stay!

The flat is super stylish and spacious. The kitchen is well equipped even though it is a touristic apartment. I really enjoyed how big the shower is. The only “but” for me is the noise outside, but I guess that’s the price to pay when you are so central. The hosts were helpful, communicative and super nice!

Very nice apartment, beautifully furnished and handy with 2 bedrooms.
Location is great to, walking distance to all the important places of Madrid. Highly recommended !
The apartment and its location are perfect for a long weekend in Madrid. Everything was very short distance and the apartment brings everything you need and is spotless!
Wonderful balconies, nice to have AC and a washing machine during a hot week in Madrid. Would 100% stay here again!
The apartment was amazing, very clean and had everything we needed. It is also perfectly located in the heart of Malasaña. I definitely recommend it!

Great place to stay in Madrid, super centric , clean and comfortable apartment ! It’s just like the pictures and the communication with the hosts was great. Would recommend it to anyone going to Madrid.

This Air bnb was modern, clean, and very comfortable. The air conditioning was welcome in the 35+ degree summer. Having two bathrooms was amazing while travelling with two teenage daughters! The location couldn’t have been any better!! One of our family’s favourite air bnbs … we would definitely return!
A WONDERFUL PLACE TO STAY IN MADRID! it’s very well located. The host is super kind and very helpful. The apartment is so beautiful and chic! WE REALLY LOVE OUT TIME HERE! :)

amazing apartment and location.
has everything you need.
hosts were super responsive and very helpful.
will stay here again

Beautifully appointed home, exceptionally clean and centrally located. If you’re planning to visit and it happens to be a Friday or Saturday to bring ear plugs to dampen the lively bustling night life/early morning adventurers. Otherwise it’s mostly quiet on the other days. If I were to come visit again, this was a great place and recommend it. The host was also prompt in communicating.

Really beautiful apartment in a really cool neighbourhood in Madrid, you can walk everywhere to see all the sights and also lots of restaurants/ bars around.
The place was perfect for two couples.
Easy to check and and check out and also there is a place to store bags down the road if you have a late evening departure.

The accommodation was nice and within walking distance of restaurants as well as the well known El Retiro park. The only thing that we did not realize is that there is no elevator, may be an issue  if you have heavy luggage.

This location was very convenient but do note that there are a lot of bars in this neighborhood.  In the morning, I saw vomit a few times on the streets.  On our last night, it was scary because I woke to the wall shaking and shouting at 6 am from the unit next door. I wasn’t sure what was happening but I realized it was probably drunk people.  Not that it’s the owners fault but this was really scary.
The hosts were nice and were prompt in responses. We enjoyed the stay as it was close to everything. Cheers!
Lovely modern apartment. The location is perfect as it’s situated near the Gran Via. The place was clean and tidy, with good amenities. Check-in was straight forward. Would definitely recommend.
We had a great time in this apartment. It’s small but we’ll equipped and in walking distance to all the best spots in Madrid. A little loud at night but can’t complain about that in a city centre!

Fantastic location! Perfectly setup room with everything you could possibly need. Beautifully decorated and incredibly comfortable beds. Definitely bring earplugs if you are a light sleeper because of the active nightlife.
Great location and beautiful apartment! Lovely host and responsiveness. Street can get loud throughout night but that just comes with the central location.
Amazing place Leo and Victor helped with check in flexibility with no problem, clean space, very well located in the big city of Madrid.
The apartment was in a great location with great little coffee shops and restaurants. The beds were very comfortable. The place is spotless. The host was very responsive.

Fantastic air b&b for a few days with friends in Madrid 😊
It’s a really stylish pad & in a fun area which actually isn’t too noisy at night. Would highly recommend!
Great location, spacious apartment, very clean, autonomous check-in, not noisy at night. We enjoyed our stay

Central, modern, easy to access. We were able to drop our bags at the location before check-in which was great!
We would definitely stay there again!
Nice place clean and tide very well equipped and easy to check in and very nice beds the only con was no elvator other than that I had a nice time staying there
Very clean flat at the best possible location in Madrid (but still not noisy at all). María Luisa always responded very fast and check-in / check-out was very easy.

Maria Luis was a very good host. The apartment really nice , clean, quiet and the top in the cherry is that is very close to everything. Even though you are at the downtown area and Chueca , the apartment is really quiet.

This apartment is highly recommended as it is very quiet yet on one of the busiest shopping streets in Madrid.  A well-equipped kitchen was available in addition to a good size bedroom.  Maria Luisa is a kind, helpful and patient host.
The apartment is very comfortable and clean, and the location could not be better. María Luisa was very responsive and welcoming.
Location is very central and can walk to a lot of nearby places such as shops and great places to eat. We came in the summertime and lack of AC was a bit difficult.

The apartment is clear and greatly located. However, it is very small and quite dark. Also, there are construction works going on in the building, of which we were not informed. During weekdays, they start at 8:30 right in front of the apartment window
Very clean appartment located in the centre of Madrid ! Everything is at walking distance. Would definitely go back.

The place fell apart .. and flooded during a night of rain . water was coming in through the closed windows , walls and ceiling ( specifically through the lights ) which caused the lights to short circuit making it an overall safety hazard due to electrocution.

Great location! You will be right in the middle of the shopping area close to Gran Via and Sol. The apartment is also very spacious and the building has an elevator. Maria Luisa is a great communicator!
Location and cleanliness make this the type of place I could recommend to any person wanting the most out of the central of Madrid!

The apartment is a lovely spacious one-bedroom, with a good-size galley kitchen (not a converted cupboard as they can sometimes be -- you could comfortably cook here!) bedroom, bathroom and living room. Despite its central location with all the advantages that brings, it was also quiet.
I had a great time staying here and would highly recommend it! Maria was also very helpful in meeting me to check in and even met me at the train station to give me a charger I had foolishly left behind. Thanks!
Amazing location, very friendly and accommodating host, very clean and tidy unit! We only stayed for one night but we will definitely stay here again next time we’re in Madrid.

The place is very confortable for a solo traveler. Thin walls and unfortunately the neighbors were a little too loud. It’s in a great location you can walk anywhere and the apartment it’s clean. Overall I would stay there again.

Location is great, most things are walking distance. Maria is an amazing host - she greeted us with a warm welcome upon arrival, answered all of our questions and recommended nearby places. Our return flight was very early and she was kind enough to call a taxi to take us to the airport. Would definitely book Maria’s place again if I come back to visit Madrid!
perfect location. right in the middle of everything and was able to walk everywhere. Maria was so helpful and made sure we were comfortable.
The modern flat in a historical building in a trendy area has every amenity you can imagine. Plus, it’s very quiet at night. Highly recommended.

María Luisa was very attentive and very helpful in knowing how to get to the accommodation!
The place is well located, very central to everywhere.
A cozy and neat studio in the heart of Madrid! Loved the location, cleanliness and decoration of the apartment. Hosts were very reactive and helpful! :) A recommended studio in Madrid.
Location was great as I expected, the studio was clean, also the Nelson who was contacted me was very friendly and let me to leave my suitcase before check in time, I recommend this place
Loredana's Airbnb is in a great location.  It is compact, comfortable and has a washing machine, unexpected, and a hair dryer.  Great hosts.  A very nice stay.

This studio is all about location! You are right in the center where you can walk to all the major sites . The unit is clean and quiet.
It's a very small studio but this is normal for most major European cities, it's minimal and impersonal.
Loredana was nice and allowed for a flexible check out .

Incredibly quiet! Even though the appartement is in the middle of bustling Chueca, if the neighbours are out there is almost absolute silence, even on a Saturday night with people all around the street. I hope to go here again when I visit Madrid again.
Everything else was fine too, but location plus quietness is the big selling point.

The location of the apartment is excellent, with shops and tourist attractions in walking distance. It is however located on the ground floor and windows give out to a small courtyard, which means the apart does not really get much sunlight, and if curtains are opened, reduced privacy.
The small apartment is convenient and suitable for a short stay for 2 people. Communication and key handover was smooth.
The apartment is very central for tourists. It is easy walking distance to Gran Via, hop on hop off bus and attractions
The apartment was in a good condition, clean and cosy. Nelson was really helpful. Also, its location is perfect! I highly recommend it!

Loredana and Nelson were great hosts, and their apartment was clean, stylish, and perfectly situated just steps from Chueca and Gran Via. Nelson met us personally at the door and made check in extremely easy. The space was ideal for our overnight layover, providing a convenient space to explore downtown Madrid while still having a restful night’s sleep. We would stay here again in a heartbeat!
Loredana's place was very clean and in an awesome location.  You're close to everything including the metro and great shopping!
Everything was great! Its incredibly clean which is #1 on my list! The location is great and will definitely recommend and stay here again next time we're in Madrid

Place is well located, very central but quite and clean, hosts are friendly, but i found that the place to luck of natural light even though it has windows. There is a building right in front and very little light gets in. It s ok to stay to just sleep in but not to spend time inside unfortunately. Otherwise it has all the basic amities for a stay.

Loredana’s apartment is located in the center of Madrid, closer to the main attractions and in a really dynamic neighbourhood. We had a fantastic time. However, the apartment really lacks of sunlight but this is not a big deal for short journeys. Price/quality is very high.

The location is bang in the middle of madrid! Anything we planned on doing was maximum 20 minutes stroll! This was the perfect stay! We arrive before check in but there was no issue with us leaving our bags in which was a great help to let us begin our adventure around Madrid! the area felt very safe and welcoming with amenities just on the door step! Thank you for such a clean and comfortable stay 😁
I really enjoyed staying in the small flat. It is very pleasantly quiet and it is very easy to sleep. Everything was there for a short stay. Thank you very much and I would like to come back:)

The location of this home is fantastic. Right in the busy city center but tucked far enough back into the building that it was very quiet, albeit some noise from upstairs neighbors (which can’t be avoided in any apartment of course). But not bothersome. The bathroom is very comfortable and the kitchen had what we needed for a long weekend.
Nelson/Loredana were very responsive and proactive, and even allowed us to adjust our date by a month out without creating an issue at all.

everything is perfect, host is friendly, great location and clean house. the only downside is that there’s not really enough hot water to shower, will have to wait a while to get hot water for the next person.

Great stay, great hosts. The best location you can want, everything is walking distance. If you are looking for a place to be as close to the action as possible without needing a place for more than 2 people, this is your place.
anto is a kindness and available guy .really good quality price and the 2 garages are very convenients best regards
A beautifully clean and stylish apartment reflective of Madrid overall. A great location with easy parking and easy reach of most sights. Check when booking if the pool is open during your stay. 😀

Thank you to Antonio! Such a modern and clean place. Location is wonderful, super close to El Corte Ingles. This is also a great location for being close to the city center but not too busy! Great host, Antonio made everything very easy and welcoming. Great stay!

Antonio’s loft was very peaceful, a nice place to unwind. The pool is beautiful and all amenities included were great. There was nothing missing. Shopping and restaurants very near. I would recommend.
Love 60 Buenos Aires.   I had beautiful morning runs at the park just a short 5 minutes away.  The B and B is perfect for two.  Clean, modern, and quiet.   We will be back.

We've truly enjoyed our stay at José's, the apartment is super cosy, stylish, clean, well-equipped and spacious! We were able to find everything there, even HDMI cabel. The location is also good, the subway station is pretty close. Many thanks to Josè who has been very friendly and available for any questions if such arose. I do highly recommend:)
Great stay! The apartment is cozy and fully equipped. Fast and reliable wifi. The host is very friendly, helpful, and fast to reply. Quiet neighborhood. Recommended!

I recently had the pleasure of staying at Jose's Airbnb, and I must say it was a good experience from start to finish. The listing was exactly as described—beautiful, clean, and well-equipped with all the amenities one could need.
The apartment itself was cozy and comfortable, with charming decor. The location was situated in a quiet neighborhood but still close to shops, restaurants, and public transportation.
What truly set this stay apart was Jose's responsiveness and hospitality. From the moment I booked, he was incredibly communicative. Any question or request I had was answered almost immediately, making me feel supported throughout my visit.
I highly recommend this Airbnb to anyone looking for a hassle-free, comfortable, and delightful stay.
Marcelo was a very helpful host and went out of his way to makes us feel comfortable. The location was also very good with everything you need on your doorstep. We enjoyed it, thank you Marcelo.

Javier’s studio is one of the nicest AirBNBs I have ever stayed at. It is well designed, located very close to main sites, shopping, and delicious restaurants, and Javier is a great host. He was communicative & even gave me personalized recommendations for my time in Madrid. Absolutely recommend.
Javier's place was very convenient as it was located close to the train station and main historical area. The apartment is very stylish. I'd definitely recommend his place to anyone visiting Madrid.

Lovely apart with a elegant little garden inside. Enough rooms for three girls.
Host is so warm and provides a lot of suggestions for Madrid.Thx so much.😊
Javier’s studio is in a great location and Javier himself went absolutely above and beyond as a host. His recommendations helped us navigate and enjoy Madrid like locals.

A beautiful flat in a wonderful area - it feels like a real neighbourhood while also being very close to the museums. Javier was extremely kind and helpful. We are already thinking of when we can return, and would definitely book again.

Javier's place is amazing! Situated in the heart of Madrid, walking distance basically to everywhere with tons of little restaurants, bars, shops, squares where you can enjoy the great vibe of the city.
The apartment is a little gem!Very clean, with all the amenities we needed and even if something would be missing no worries, there's a supermarket only a block away.
Javier is a great host, very welcoming and helpful. He told us about all the best places to visit and where to go for the best food in the area. This made our stay even better.
I would definitely go back!
Javier is the best host, going above and beyond in communication and helpful tips! The apartment is in a great location and has everything you need!
Javier was so helpful in teaching us about all the wonderful things to do in Madrid and was extremely friendly and welcoming. We felt right at home!
Apartment was super quaint, had everything we needed, was about a 10/15 minute walk to Plaza Mayor/Sol. Javier was really nice and provided us with lots of local restaurants and shops!
Really great located apartment, close to the city center and subway, neighbourhood was lovely. Can only recommend :)
The flat was absolutely beautiful, in an amazing location and Marcelo was an incredible host. Would highly recommend to other guests and would love to stay here again.

We had an amazing stay and highly recommend this place. Spot on location in the center of Lavapies, clean apartment with two well-sized comfy bedrooms. Marcelo was a superb host, flexible and a pleasure to communicate with.

This apartment is in a perfect central location and in a fun and beautiful neighborhood, easy to walk to all museums, to the park, and the metro is just down the road. It is very quiet, clean, and the kitchen is well-equipped.
Communications with Marcelo were quick, smooth, and very easy.
Check-in very easy. Great restaurants/cafes on the street.
We loved it!!

Marcelo's place was perfectly placed to explore Madrid. The local neighbourhood was full of colour, atmosphere and amazing food. Marcelo's communication was was amazing. check-in and out was super easy. We absolutely loved Madrid and would stay at Marcelo's again and will recommend it to family and friends aswell
Beautiful place in the city center. Near bars and supermarkets. Very kind and helpful host. Garden was closed because is winter, it's little bit sad but not critical. Strongly recommend!
We had a great stay here, the apartment is in a fantastic location and Javier is a great host. He made us feel really welcome and gave us lots of tips for places to eat and drink.
Everything was beyond excellent... Javier went the extra mile in every aspect. super helpful and super friendly. we'll book with him again!!!

This is the best location in Madrid. Walking distance to El Prado, El Parque Retiro, and many more beautiful sights. Lots of great restaurants and bars nearby, and the apartment has everything you need for a stay in Madrid. Javier is a wonderful host, who gave us lots of recommendations and made check-in and check-out very comfortable, and made us feel right at home. Highly recommend!
Good place to stay, well located, central and close to public transport. However, can be a bit noisy as you’re on the ground floor. Keep in mind that the terrace isn’t accessible.

I had a wonderful stay for a month at Javier’s apartment. It is located right in the heart of Barrio de Las Letras, a very hip neighborhood. Javier was excellent with communicating with me and the whole process of moving in was smooth. I look forward to coming back soon!

This is a perfect choice! Just don’t choose it when I want to stay in Madrid. It’s a super location for the downtown, El Prado, El Retiro and so much more. It’s stylish and well furnished with lots of extra features to make it super comfortable. Superb communication with the host. A most favourite place. First class on all fronts!!

Really lovely place to stay. Perfect location close to Prado and the very old centre of Madrid. Quiet and not hot! We hardly had to use air con mid August! The hosts are very easily to reach and respond quickly - Javier provided us with plenty of tips with places to go to in the local area. The flat was well equipped and comfortable. And a very good Michelin listed restaurant literally round the corner.

Javier’s place was fantastic! It was centrally located within walking distance of everything we wanted to see and beautiful. Javier himself was so welcoming and even more helpful. It made my first time in Madrid truly special.

A nice apartment at a very central location! Everything is within walking distance and there are plenty nice restaurants nearby.
Javier is very helpful and fast in his communication.
I would definitely recommend this place to other people :)

Location was great. Check-in and check-out was super easy. Javier is extremely helpful and very willing to assist you with anything at a moment's notice, even offering restaurant recommendations and offering to arrange transportation if we needed.

We absolutely loved our stay here. Javier and Emiliano were wonderful hosts providing a warm welcome, plenty of tips about the local area and ensuring that we had everything we needed. The apartment itself was spotlessly clean and we loved having the patio area too – it felt very special. We couldn't have hoped for a better location either – the home is close to so many incredible sights, including the Golden Triangle of Art and El Retiro Park. If we're ever in Madrid again, I hope to stay at this fabulous apartment once more!

Perfect location
The apartment was clean and very nice
Javier is a great host
He send me a lot of cool places around that he recommended
Javier is amazing! The appartment is very well located. It is spacious and has everything you need! Would definitely come back

This is a wonderful place, definitely a 10/10! It's a 15 minute stroll from Madrid's main train station and about the same distance to Puerta del Sol, the main square in the city centre. Lot's of good restaurants and bars nearby and when you wake up in the morning the only sound you will hear are the birds singing, it seems incredible how quiet it is inside the flat. WiFi worked great, everything was totally clean and nice, kitchen fully furnished, washing machine, etc. Everything perfect.
And last but not least: Contact with Marcelo was always very easy and quick, he is very friendly and helpful and made really everything to make my stay as nice as possible: There was fresh milk and two bottles of wine in the fridge! Great suggestions for restaurants and cafés nearby and I was received by a human being who showed me around the flat, a thing that unfortunately has become very rare at airbnb.
Marcelo is a great host, and his place is a terrific base for a stay in Madrid. Highly recommended.

This was one of my best airbnb experiences in Madrid (out of 10 over time).  The location is fantastic, right near Lavapíes Metro.  The apartment was very clean, spacious, well ventilated, and comfortable.  Marcelo was incredibly thoughtful in terms of amenities, some food items, and recommendations for museums, restaurants, and cultural site.  It was a real pleasure to stay there.

We loved our stay at Marcelo’s place! His generous hospitality and comfortable apartment made us feel right at home in Madrid. The location is perfect for experiencing all types of restaurants and is walkable to many sights. If we come back to Madrid this is exactly where we want to stay again. Highly recommend!
Marcelo's place was in a great location near the Metro.  Easily walkable to all the beautiful sights in Madrid.  Very convenient!

The apartment is in a very good location. It is very close to all attractions. A metro station is nearby. The apartment is large and spacious. There are restaurants, bars and shops nearby. Marcelo is very nice, communicative and helpful.

Very nice apartment, great host! Everything you need for a good time in Madrid. Also very good located, just a walk to the Plaza Mayor. Metro station just around the corner. The apartment is fully equipped and clean. Javier and Emiliano are very friendly and helpful. Highly recommended!

Javier was a wonderful host that was in constant communication to make sure our stay was pleasant. Javier’s place is conveniently located close to Atocha station and is surrounded by vibrant restaurants and cafes. We were only here for a short time but we’ll be back to stay again!
A charming spot in an ideal location. Javier was a wonderful host and offered great suggestions for Madrid.

Perfect studio apartment in a fantastic location in Madrid! Javi is a wonderful host - communication was easy and we felt very welcomed. He also had some truly wonderful recommendations in the city and I felt I could ask him any questions/doubts with no hesitation.
The apartment is located in a wonderful (and quiet) street in downtown, close enough to the bustle of the night but far enough to be able to get a wonderful sleep. The apartment had everything that we needed: towels, amenities, coffee machine and a cute outdoor terrace as well.
We would definitely stay here again :) Gracias Javi por todas las atenciones y por tu flexibilidad.

This is a lovely little flat perfect for a couple that wants to explore Madrid. The location is amazingly central! We could easily walk, in all directions, out to the main monuments. Plus, the neighborhood that it’s in is very cool and for character. The hosts were very warm, including greediness when we arrived and staying in contact to make sure we have everything we need. We can highly recommend this spot.

Javier was really helpful and friendly and we were really stoked to find his place available for our stay.
It’s a super central location with great transport access and easy to walk around the city / get metro or trains / get to the airport with the shuttle etc.
As it is very central there was some noise on a night but this shouldn’t deter you from booking as it’s really well placed and serviced apartment. You couldn’t get more central so if you’re a light sleeper take some ear plugs as it’s definitely worth booking this spot.
We’ll look to book again when we come back to Madrid.
Great place to stay, located in a quiet neighborhood but a short walk from everything you will need. Clean and spacious, exactly as advertised!
Perfect stay at Javier's place. He could not have been more helpful. Can't fault it, thank you 👍
Javier is an exemplary host. Very helpful and friendly. The space is comfortable and very well placed for central Madrid. The area has great character.

This was a fabulous place to stay in Lavapies.  You can see the metro stop from the front door of the apartment building.  Marcelo had lots of great local recommendations which we utilized.  He was very responsive and easy to work with.  Would 100% stay there again in Madrid.

Marcelo's place was great.  Two large bedrooms with comfortable beds and both with heating/a-c.  Very clean bathroom with super hot shower and small but functional kitchen - with dishwasher and washing machine.   Marcelo was super thoughtful and kind.  He waited for us to arrive despite our train being late, and had bought us some beer and coffee.  The flat is up one flight of stairs but it is at the back of the building so it was super quiet.  The neighbourhood was great with a metro stop a 3 minute walk away and lots of cafes and bars around.  Easy walking distance to Atocha station and Reina Sofia museum.  Marcelo recommended lots of local places to eat at / visit, and we ended up eating at his favourite breakfast place all three days we were there!!  I highly recommend Marcelo's flat and I would gladly stay there again. Good value for size and location!!

Marcelo's place is in the heart of Madrid, in many ways. It's in the middle of a thriving community with a lot of activity, restaurants, shops, bakeries, grocery and steps away from a metro station. You can walk everywhere from Marcelo's. The unit itself is peaceful, well laid out and full of all the conveniences you need to feel at home. Marcelo met us at the apartment, gave us the keys and a full rundown on how everything worked as well as many recommendations that we used and enjoyed. Marcelo is a great host and I look forward to returning!

This apartment is in a great location in Las Letras - close to a lot of restaurants, the Prado, the Reina Sofia, Retiro Park, the metro, and long-distance trains from Atocha station (e.g., for day-trips to Toledo). Javier was extremely communicative, met us at the apartment a bit before our official checkin, and was so friendly. A great spot!
The studio is nice and Javier is a great host. Since you are on the ground floor facing the street, you need to draw curtains for privacy, but I didn’t mind that. Excellent neighborhood!

We loved this place, the location was fantastic, central yet on a quiet street and close to lots of museums, tapas bars and cafes. The apartment itself was perfect for a couple, had all the facilities you could want, especially a good air conditioning unit which is critical in the Madrid heat. Javier was very easy to communicate with and very responsive. Would definitely recommend this place.

Immersed in a neighborhood of magic, delicious food and impressive culture, the place is very cozy, everything in the apartment well prepared to receive the guests and to spend the most comfortable vacation days and full of discovery.
The host is very approachable and always friendly and helpful to recommend nice places.
For sure 💯 recommended
We love Spain 🇪🇸

Javier and Emiliano was super hosts! We were in Madrid for only a very short time and had some timed events that were scheduled and Javier met us earlier than check-in so that could get to them! So appreciated! They also followed  up to make sure everything was good when we returned. Lots of great recommendations with additional notes on them if applicable. The kitchen was well equipped and although the weather was not ideal to take advantage of the sitting area to the outside within the apt …it was inviting!  I highly recommend these hosts and setting!

I can't say enough good things about this place.  Very walkable to all the museums and other places of interest in Madrid.  The apartment is very nice also.  Great air conditioning and very hot water.  It's on the first floor, so no walking up stairs.  Great Madrid.

Javier and Emiliano were fantastic hosts! The apartment was nice and clean and the AC actually saved me on some of these summer night. The location was amazing and Javier provided some great recommendations during my trip which were extremely useful.
Amazing place and host, the flat is super clean, very with a great location and beautiful energy.
Lovely,  comfortable apartment.  Spotlessly clean.  Javier was a great host, very friendly and helpful. Always responded. Was also in a great location, lovely neighbourhood.

Very nice loft, exactly as listed. Javier is a great host, he is very attentive and kind. Emiliano is a great co-host. I felt very safe during my stay. Lots to do in the area. I highly recommend staying here. Thank you Javier!

We stayed in Madrid for 3 nights and spent 2 days exploring the city. The apartment is centrally located - we were easily able to walk to several museums, the city center, a grocery store, and several metro stops. The space is small but well laid out with delineations of functional space with furniture so we never felt crowded. Coffee was provided and we used the kitchen to cook during our stay. It was very hot in Madrid when we visited and the AC worked great, as did the WiFi. Javier was very responsive, provided great local recommendations, and quickly addressed our questions. We recommend Javier’s place and would stay here again!

The apartment is beautifully styled and clean! Has everything that you need and is located central to everything so can walk everywhere or if you need, it is right near the metro station. Leeway’s were great with communicating and made our stay very enjoyable, couldn’t recommend this apartment any more!

Great design, around the corner from the Lavapies metro or a 10-15 minute walk to Atocha. The hosts were very responsive and the washing machine was greatly appreciated. Be aware that the front door key can be a little tricky to turn, and the wall in the bedroom is a little thin, but nothing earplugs can’t fix.

Very clean and fairly good value.
Check in process was slightly impersonal since it was a « self check-in » process.
That aside, we had a great stay and would come back here again!

The apartment is fine . The area is a little noisy from the street, and it’s in an area that’s not
Great ...it’s okay ....just its not the most sophisticated area .
A good 24 h Supermarket is very close.
This apartment is located very close to a metro station, and has a supermarket nearby. The apartment is modern with all amenities available. We enjoyed our stay here!
Beautiful apartment in a very convenient location, not far from the bus station for the Airport Express and a 24/7 supermarket a 2 minute walk away.
Beautiful space, central location, spotless upon arrival and exceptional communication from the host throughout our stay!

The apartment is really nice, cosy and spacious. It was all clean and the communication smooth.
The only I thing I would improve are the amenities. It would be easy to provide the guests with the necesseties for the kitchen such as salt and pepper, oil, coffee capsules and tabs for the dish washer. For a short stay, nobody will buy this so it would be an even better service to have it at disposal. There wasn’t any cutting board but upon request it was provided immediately :-)
All in all we had a great stay, the location is central and very convenient. Close to the train station Atocha and super close to the metro stop Lavapies. I can recommend it and would come again. Thanks :)
Really nice apartment in a nice area. Super central to everything and close to the metro. Host was super helpful as well.

Clean, beautiful and calm place.
However, they charged a 20€ fee for late check-in which we found a bit excessive for a 10 min delay. No big deal eventually - worth a stay.

Was a very nice stay. Street was a bit loud especially on Saturday night, but very convenient location as it is close to the metro station. Had a problem with the shower but hosts were very helpful and got a maintenance guy in ASAP! :D

Everything was amazing. The place is right in the city center, close to cool places, bars and restaurants.
Just small note, when you take a shower hot water can sometimes end, so you could have to wait a bit for hot water refilling.
Overall amazing place, I recommend!

We had a great stay in this apartment! It was very clean, nicely situated in the heart of Lavapiés (tons of bars/restaurants/food stores), and it is located on a beautiful, hilly street. The balcony view is a major plus!
The host was very responsive and attended to our needs. Lavapies is a bit loud at night so just keep that in mind - get some ear plugs if you’re not a heavy sleeper!

The apartment matches perfectly the description : super clean, with all amenities, in a lovely neighborhood and within walking distance to touristic areas of Madrid.
Everything was perfect from the logistic perspective : Leeways are super responsive
I highly recommend both the place and the host
I truly enjoyed our stay, it was a lovely apartment. Very well decorated, practical and very close to the city center. People always around, restaurants and bars are close.

Had a fantastic stay! The location is perfect, with plenty of popular restaurants and exciting activities nearby. It did get a bit uncomfortable at night, with some people lingering around the entrance until the early hours, but overall, I really enjoyed my time and would definitely book again.

Everything you need to explore Madrid and have a nice, comfortable place to return to and have a nice breakfast or lunch, "at home" - we even left a wine opener, for you to enjoy their inexpensive selections!  Everything else is there to prepare a nice simple meal.

Visiting Madrid with my parents, we had a fantastic time and a wonderful stay in Isabel’s apartment. The location itself was amazing, situated perfectly in the middle of life, a few steps from Plaza Mayor in one direction and a few steps from Puerta del Sol in the other direction. Everything you could possibly need was provided including soaps and shampoo, coffees and teas. Susana especially was very helpful, giving us a very thorough orientation of the apartment and neighborhood, including many suggestions. There are a few steps in the apartment you have to be wary of, but the apartment was extremely clean, warm and comfortable. The elevator also was a huge plus! I highly recommend staying in this beautiful home away from home!

If you are looking for a central location close to everything, then Isabel's place is just for you! The apartment was perfect for a small family and it was very clean. Check-in was very easy and they were very understanding even though we arrived later than we estimated. Just note that there are steps between kitchen, living room and bedroom and it was a little bit challenging for my 2 year-old daughter but she got used to it 2nd day. Overall, it was a great stay!
This was a great stay. Everything was as depicted and we enjoyed our visit very much. We can recommend staying here on your visit ti Madrid.

Best location- never took a taxi except to and from the airport. Absolutely recommend and will be back. We were two girls and the sofa was comfy. The different floor levels in the apartment took a little getting used to and not much sound proofing (we didn’t know the futbol finals were happening), but overall a great apartment with a fantastic location. Gracias a Isabel y Minty.

Brilliant location and lovely flat, there are different levels with steps that can be hard to see at first because the tiles are all the same, bed a little short, so not recommended if you are 6 ft or over! but very comfortable and lovely flat. We would go back. Minty hosts were really helpful.
Our stay was wonderful! Not only was the apartment beautiful and accommodating but the location was great as well.

The location of this place is incredible! So close to many bars, restaurants and sights we wanted to see. The bed wasn’t the most comfortable for two people but definitely not bad! We would recommended this place to others!

Overall, this apartment is in a great central location and is extremely walkable to many attractions, bars/restaurants, museums, etc. in Madrid. We were able to comfortably walk to all of our desired destinations during our stay. The representative that we worked with was also very friendly, accommodating, and responded promptly to our messages.
Our main issue with this unit was the smell and cleanliness. The apartment has a noticeable scent of smoke and the bed linens did not seem thoroughly clean. It's also worth noting that the shower will leak onto the bathroom floor if the shower head is not significantly angled towards the wall. We needed to plug the shower door with an extra towel to avoid large water puddles.
If an excellent location and friendly customer service are your main focus, this apartment is a good choice!

Centrally located. We walked to all sights. Lively area full of restaurants and shops. Everything is open until late!! Puerta del Sol is literally 2 minutes away!
The flat was great, full of light. The only negative remark is the split level floor! We recommend it and would return, if visiting Madrid again!
Place was great, very well located with easy access to transportation, restaurants and attractions. The apartment was clean and with all the amenities as described.
Carmen was an exceptional host!! Next time I am in Madrid, I will definitely be rebooking with her. Thank you so much Carmen!
Host was hospitable and nice.  Place was clean.  A/C was a nice reprieve from the Madrid Summer heat.  I would recommend.

The apartment was spotless. Right out the door go anywhere in any direction and you are there. Hundreds of Tapas restaurants. 5 minutes or less to Plaza Mayor. You are in the beautiful part of town with all the action. The best thing is the street of the apartment is absolutely quiet! The amenities were excellent and Carmen is wonderful!!! She was so helpful with restaurant, shopping, and site seeing advice. GREAT PLACE in Madrid!!
Perfect place close to Plaza Mayor. Clean, contemporary and quiet. Carmen was helpful and very responsive. We would stay here again and highly recommend this apartment.

I strongly recommend this place. The host was so attentive to my messages and needs by the prompt responses and pointing out the places to see and things to do. This listing is conveniently located close to bars, restaurants, historic places, monuments, etc. I cannot wait to book it again.

"A very nice space" - high praise from my husband.  Great location, well appointed, and a fantastic shower.   Clean, contemporary and quiet. Carmen was helpful and very responsive, especially as we were arriving on a red eye from the states the night before. The welcome bags were a classy touch, and the kitchen had everything we needed.  We would stay here again and highly recommend this apartment.
Excellent location with all the landmarks and tourist locations only walking distance away! Home was very clean, modern, and spacious! Would definitely stay here again!
Beautiful apartment in a superb location. We stayed here for a week and thoroughly enjoyed renting this quiet apartment which provided an excellent base for exploring Madrid and beyond.

It was a very good staying! Location is great - right in the heart of the so called "la vida mandrillena"
The host was very flexible and solved our questions at once! Marvelous balcony and lots of space to every of our 11 person group
I would recommend it defiantly
Highly recommended. We stayed in 11 the apartment and everything was pristine in an outstanding central location. Highly recommended for big groups

Great apartment for families or groups to stay in Madrid for a long week end or a short holiday . Latina is a great neighbourhood, very close to plaza Mayor and other interesting areas of Madrid . Miguel is a great host , quick response , very accommodating for check in and check out . Apartment is large and was very clean .. beds are very comfortable .. overall a great experience .
Super conveniently located near shops and restaurants and short walks to sights.  The beds were very comfortable. Miguel gave wonderful tourism tips.  13 people... no problem (but bathroom schedules)
Lovely location and very kind and helpful host. Kitchen not as big as it looks, but the rooms and beds were fine. Would book again.

Great location with a lot of markets and bars around. We had an issue with the lock in the beginning but the hosts were proactive about fixing this issue. My group agreed that we would stay here again if we had the chance.

We had to book this place on the same day because our previous booking at a different location had no working ac. There was a major heat wave so we needed ac and Grand Latina was super flexible and understanding. The only negative I have about this place is that the pillows are very hard. Other than that it was a great place to explore Madrid.

This apartment was a fantastic place to stay. It is close to a lot of activities and it was impeccably clean and fresh looking. Esther was very helpful and communication was superb. You can’t go wrong by staying here! 👍👍
A lovely apartment in a perfect location, all the sights are within easy walking distance. I would recommend it - thank you!

We couldn't have chosen a better apartment to stay. In the heart of Madrid, Esther's place was convenient and cozy. With all the amenities you need, and a great host that is available for any recommendations you want. Highly recommended.

This apartment is the perfect choice for a stay in Madrid.  Everything you may want or need is literally steps away. You are right in the middle of all the shops and great food. The apartment itself is clean, modern and fully stocked with all the amenities you may need. Esther responds immediately if you ever need her for anything. I would highly recommend this home to anyone traveling to Madrid and I would stay there again if I ever return.
Attentive, very swift responses to questions and needs. I had a computer malfunction and they directed me to assistance.
This rental was in a truly excellent central location.   It was everything that we hoped for and needed for our vacation in Spain.

Great location in central madrid. Lovely apartment. It is newly refurbished. Super clean. Very comfortable and much larger than the pictures suggest. Esther was great.
