Very fast to respond and very helpful. The bedrooms are at the back of the apartment so very quiet at night. We would definately stay again. Thanks esther.
Location is top notch! it is close to everything metro/shops/restaurants. Place is very clean and well designed, extra plus for the air conditioning! Stay here, you wont be disappointed. :)

You could not ask for a better location than this modernly decorated apartment on a busy pedestrian street in Madrid's centre.  There are hundreds of restaurants within walking distance.  We were able to walk to all the museums and city highlights.  The street traffic can be a little noisy but the bedrooms are all at the back of the apartment and the street noise cannot be heard from there.  The beds were super comfortable.  Although there are always lots of people on the street, we found the area very safe and were not worried about wandering out at night late.  Thanks Esther, Juan and Marina for sharing this fabulous place with us.
Beautiful area. Nice apartment.  Very Clean. Suggestions for the area and local information would have been helpful.

The apartment is great with plenty of room and space with a view to a pedestrian street. Delegation could not be better – central, between the opera and the palace on one side and Plaza del Sol on the other. It is very modern, clean, we highly recommend it.

It was a wonderful trip. The hospitality of the Ester is beyond praise. Quick response to any question. The apartment is fully consistent with photos, very spacious and comfortable. The location is perfect, all attractions are within walking distance.

The apartment is super centrally located and nice and spacious, the ideal base to explore Madrid. We had wonderful communication with the owner and found everything we needed. The en-suite bathrooms are a plus, plus there is a separate bathroom with shower in the living room. We enjoyed our stay very much and would recommend the apartment to others.

We had a perfect stay at this apartment. Check in and check out was seamless and we had great communication with Penta throughout.
The apartment itself is perfectly located for visiting the Madrid sights and shops; it was very spacious and provided everything we needed/wanted for an amazing first trip to Madrid. I would recommend this apartment and Penta to all visiting Madrid.

This place is amazing!!! Super clean, amazing location, Petra is super communicative. Couldn’t ask for a better stay. Just perfect for us as a family of 5. We flew with only a carry on and just washed clothing each night in the combination washer/dryer. The place is even bigger than the pictures would suggest with a balcony overlooking a beautiful pedestrian street. The bedrooms are super quiet as they face the courtyard. All in all A++++ stay. Thank you!!

This apartment is in the heart of old Madrid’s city center, walkable to Puerta del Sol, Plaza Mayor, the Opera area and the Royal Palace. Bedrooms and baths were functional, and the living area was spacious.
Penta’s communication and help during our stay were excellent: she is a wonderful, responsive host.
Great location, super clean, easy access and above all wonderfull host. difinitely going back.
Very nice apartments. Everything is nearby. We enjoyed our stay in Madrid immensely. I recommend everything!

We had a wonderful stay at Penta’s place. It was spacious, modern, clean, comfortable, quiet, and was a short walk to everything we wanted (food, shopping, sights, subway)
She was a great communicator, and made everything easy. Would totally stay here again, and would recommend to others.

We loved the location of this apartment! Everything we wanted to see in Madrid was walking distance. All the restaurants are right outside the doorstep and it was super convenient! The place is very clean and looked exactly like the pictures. Definitely would recommend!

This rating of 2 for “worth what I paid”, is not indicative of the home. The place is beautiful, perfect location and it was very clean. My issue is that I paid for a 2 bedroom, 3 bathroom place, and I got a 2 bedroom, 1 working shower place. One shower would flood the bathroom if used, the 2nd only had the small handheld shower portion, but no large head. The only usable shower was off the living room.
Penta was responsive, had additional towels delivered when we used some for water flood, but was unable to resolve the issue while I was under the impression that someone was coming to fix it.
I would rent this place in a heartbeat provided I had at least two working showers, but only one was unacceptable.
Seems like location has ongoing plumbing problems.  We did not have hot water during our entire stay. Penta did offer a discount but was with my family and cold showers were inconvenient.

We love Madrid. This apartment was everything described and so much more for the 4 of us. 3 full baths was awesome. Location, restaurants, shopping, night life and of course the vibe that is Madrid . Penta our host was super helpful and answered all our questions. Excellent 🥰
We have been to madrid 4/5 times and have always been impressed by the standard of apartments for the price but this one was the best 100%, very impressed and very reasonable price too.
Had a great stay at Penta’s. Excellent location and a beautiful apartment with big space.  Pentas response time was very very short for every question or help I needed.

We could bot believe the location of this stay, it was in the middle of central area where you can walk at any direction for famous places in Madrid! Ms.Penta was very kind and fast at response at anything we encountered and the house was gorgeous that we really wanted to live there. I hope we get to visit here agian🤗

Penta's home was exactly what we wanted for our trip to Madrid. It is a spacious and clean apartment with a good kitchen (we even cooked one night!) and fantastic community space (large dining room table, cozy living room). With three full bathrooms and two bedrooms with lots of storage there is ample room for our family of four to have a comfortable and relaxing trip to Madrid.

Wonderful apartment right in the heart of Madrid, but so quiet as the bifold doors and windows are triple glazed. Newly renovated with three bathrooms, two bedrooms and a kitchen with a dishwasher and washing machine, it was perfect for our week long stay. The kids loved the added bonus of a gelato store being opposite. Plenty of bars, restaurants around. Highly recommend shopping for groceries at El Corte Ingles basement, which is a 3 minute walk. Metro is a 3 minute walk and plenty of taxis on Uber or by the Opera house 3 minutes away.

The apartment was even better then we expected.  Super cozy, very clean and few minutes from metro station. Big kitchen with all facilities for cooking or making breakfast. Coffee machine with coffee beans, juice press, big fridge and also dishwasher. We felt like home and enjoyed the stay there very much. The flat equipment was excellent, shower with massage jets, good bed and TV. Susana gave us like a gift a bottle of Spanish red wine and chocolate, which was very welcoming from her. We would love to come back one day. Highly recommend!

Cute place in safe neighborhood, there are super markets, restaurants and other stores close by. Metro and bus stop walking distance as well. There is no vacuum if you’re gonna stay for long period, and the coffee machine could do better. Otherwise it was an amazing stay 🙏🏽
She accepted me last minute which was very good! But the toilet was not very clean, maybe they forgot to clean because of last minute request

spent 3 weeks here, wonderful apartment! plenty of restaurants and supermarkets in walking distance and the metro is very close by. perfect host, responds quickly, was flexible on check-in time, and is very helpful when problems happen. would absolutely stay again, highly recommended

Really good place to go.
Flat is Well located and clean.
Flavia is really nice host
Top !!
Such a great flat right in the centre of Madrid. Very specious with two amazing roof top terraces, great for soaking up the sun and enjoying a few drinks. Would definitely recommend to other groups.

Great space for a large group. We are a group of 15 and we had plenty of space. It was super hot in Madrid and thankfully all the ACs worked great and our time inside the house was very comfortable. Location is perfect, would stay again.

The apartment was very central, however the air con did not work for the duration of our holiday, which was almost unbearable in the hot summer temperatures. We had very little help and the issue was not resolved/ they seem uninterested to help which was very disappointing.
Great stay - good value for money if you are a large group. Great location! Simple check in. 5/5

The apartment was fantastic. Spotlessly clean and loads of space. Loved there was so many showers too. Great for a group getting ready. The terrace was a sun trap too and great to sit out on. Couldn’t recommend the place more
Fantastic location. Appreciated the clear communication and the multiple keys - this is always helpful if you have a group.

This was an excellent experience, my only criticism (and it is very small) was difficulty finding the entrance. Once Ramona sent me a photo and the building number I was able to locate it. Ramona was very friendly and explained everything perfectly, including helping us locate parking for 7 motorcycles. The apartment is in an excellent location and is highly recommended for a Madrid stay.

located within walking distance to EVERYTHING. Never had to take a train or uber. A/C was amazing in 100F/ 37C weather. HUGE space that could fit lots of people. All appliances worked no issues. BEST airbnb and wonderful host. would 10000% stay here again and recommend to others.

This stunning property only exceeded expectations. What a beautiful apartment with fantastic, proactive and helpful hosts and everything we could possibly hope for and more. This really was a highlight of our trip to Madrid with 18 friends and family.
Thank you SO much!

This double terrace apartment was exactly what we needed for our large family trip to Spain.  There were plenty of rooms, beds, bathrooms and towels for everyone.  The place was beautiful with the old charms only Europe can bring - tall ceilings, beautiful moldings, rounded windows, wood floors, two outdoor terraces and a turret with floor to ceiling windows you can open and step out onto a small balcony.  Flavia was great and put us in touch with Ramona is who is so nice and helpful!  It was a great trip and the Gran Via was amazing!  Shopping, dining, events and people right at your fingertips.  We even got into the bar on the top floor of WOW and waved to our family in the apartment - cheesy but it was fun!

We booked the apartment for a group retreat with several colleagues and we were very happy with the place. It is very spacious and there is definitely enough space for more than 10 people to sit comfortably. It is also very convenient to have so many bedrooms and bathrooms. The are was very central, with easy access to many sights in Madrid as well as to plenty of good restaurants and shops. Definitely a recommendation for bigger groups!

This is a great place to stay if you are a large group of single people looking for a vacation. The location is amazing, and Ramona was extremely helpful. Everything in Madrid is walking distance from the apartment. But if you are a large group of couples, there is only one room with one double bed. The other bedrooms all have 2+ beds. However, it is in the description. The price was very reasonable. However, the furniture and furnishings are very basic. It's more like a hostel. Some doors did not close properly, the towel hook in my bathroom came out of the wall, etc. It is not hotel quality. But if you don't care, and you have a lot of single friends, and want to be in the middle of everything, it is definitely your place.
Flavia’s place was lovely — a perfect place for our group of 6 to do some work and hang out. Beds were comfortable and there were ample bedrooms and bathrooms. Would stay here with a group again!

Flavia’s place was outstanding and perfectly accommodating to our family of 12. It was clean, comfortable, well maintained and well appointed. Ramona, the on site manager of the apartment, was very nice and although there were some issues from the prior tenants which delayed our check in time by a few hours, Ramona did her best to make sure the apartment was spotless for us!  She was very apologetic and truly wanted us to have a great time during our stay. Definitely would stay at Flavia’s place again!

The apartment is very cozy and with a very good location. There are lots of cheap restaurants around for breakfast fast and dinner.
Luz Maria is also a very good host who received us with a bottle of wine and some chocolates. Deeply recommend it!

We thought the location was great and the flat has a great size for a weekend! Maria's mum welcomed us and was super friendly and even showed us around in the neighborhood to find restaurants and supermarkets. Check in was flexible and we were even able to leave our luggage all day in the apartment, because there weren't any guests coming after us! The beds (1 coach, 1 bed) weren't too comfortable sadly - it was fine for a weekend though! Thanks for having us and we definitely recommend the apartment!

The apartment is about 30 mins from the centre both by public transport and walking. The area is very safe and residential however there are a lack of pubs, restaurants etc. The apartment is in perfect condition, the size is great for two people. The patio at the back is lovely for sitting out and enjoying the sun!

We enjoyed very much our stay at Luz Maria's place. It was very clean, the location is very good with metro and supermarket around the corner, and if you like walking it's close enough to the city center to walk. We definitely recommend it!

We are upset to say that our check-out experience was extremely discerning. We were told by Luz, the host, that check out was at 12 pm (also listed on Airbnb) and two individuals let themselves into the apartment at 10:30 am without knocking. We were both naked and unprepared to leave as we were under the impression we had until 12 pm. Nonetheless we quickly packed our things and were pushed out at 11 am. This not only was invalid information and expectations but an invasion of our privacy.
Other than that the toilet seat was broken and felt the apartment was unequipped for a guest stay (laundry and cooking essentials). We will not be back nor can we recommend this place to future guests.

Great value and location! The apartment is compact but the price reflects that. Overall a great stay! The double bed was super comfy and the apartment is a one minute walk from the 6 Circular metro and a major bus stop. There is also a grocery store and giant, beautiful park less than a 5 minute walk away. Would stay again!

It was a good experience to stay at Luz Maria's apartment. We were close from bus and metro station as well was possible to go till the city center by foot. In the apartment we had everything we needed. For sure, I recommend.

a nice, rather quite appartament, not far from the Espania plaza. Everything is nearby - shops, bus station, subway. In the apartment you can find everything you need. Maria is very friendly, she answered all our questions

We had a wonderful time in Madrid staying in Luz Maria’s apartment. The location was great — within walking distance of a number of Madrid’s attractions and extremely easy to take the bus or metro for others. The apartment is right next to a metro stop which made traveling very easy. The neighborhood also had a number of nice cafes, a local market, and supermarket all within easy walking of the apartment. The apartment itself has everything you would need and the bed was comfortable. It was quiet at night and we had a sound sleep. It was a perfect place to stay for our weekend trip in Madrid. Thank you, Luz Maria!

We had an excellent stay at Luz Maria’s apartment. The place was confortable, clean, great located and peaceful. All amenities functioned as detailed in the listing. It really exceeded our expectations and we were really satisfied with our stay. Thank you Luz Maria!

Honestly such a good place to stay. Bed was so comfy. The place was as described. I was welcomed by Luz Maria’s daughter and son Matheo who can I say was the cutest. It is a min walk from Puerto de Ángel. If you familiar with Madrid it is line 6 on the metro. The little terrace was cute. The place is quite spacious too. Only thing I will say is the space between the toilet and shower is quite tight and I’m pretty skinny so do keep in mind. But I’ll be back for sure. Thanks again muchas gracias por todo 😁

A really great place to base yourself for a visit to Madrid. The place is within easy walking distance of the real palace and I even walked all the way to the Prado. It's also basically on top of the tube station and close to multiple night buses.
Luz Maria and her daughter were great, and very accommodating when I arrived later than expected. The place was clean and the bed comfortable, and there's even a washing line in the little private courtyard if you need to do some laundry!

Excellent place.
A few steps from the Metro.
Very clean
Great host.
Beautifull decorated in a not so busy neighbourhood in Madrid. The metro was a 10 minute walk. The supermarket was 5 minutes away by foot.

We really enjoyed our stay in this apartment! It was very light and stylish apartment filled with everything you need! Location was good - we even walked to city centre as it was very nice walk to see this area. And we found shopping centre very close to this apartment. Superb! We will defenetely use this apartment again if we stay in Madrid! Thank you so much!!!

Great value, clean, and a quite location from the downtown hustle and bustle. All you could want in a home away from home atmosphere. I would stay here again and recommend this place to family and friends.

This apartment was beautiful  and well decorated. Everything looked new and clean. Our hosts were friendly, helpful and worked with us when our arrival time was delayed. There are places to eat nearby and the neighborhood seemed nice.  Many of the things to see and do in Madrid are a short cab/uber or bus ride away.   It was hot (39C/102F) while we were visiting so we stayed out of the afternoon heat as much as possible by visiting some of the great museums around Madrid.

Chic apartment in a good area of Madrid. Within walking distance to all the major sights. Susanna and Nacho made us feel welcome and gave us useful tourist information. Air conditioning would have made sleeping easier, so if you are not used to the heat or humidity this could be a difficulty.
Excellent apartment. Beautifully decorated, clean and with everything needed for our stay. Sandra and Nacho were very thoughtful ! to repeat, no doubt

This was my first experience using Airbnb, and I couldn’t have asked for a better place to stay. Susana’s apartment was simply beautiful. The decor was lovely, and the beds were incredibly comfortable. Our stay was restful and relaxing. Susana and her husband, Nacho, were very helpful and welcoming. The apartment is also well situated, within walking distance to everything we wanted to see. Highly recommended!

The experience at Carlos apartment was awesome.  The apartment looks like the pics.  Carlos show his hospitality even before arriving and he always answer fast.  The apartment is very well located and it has the metro just two blocks away, walking distance.  So I will definitely recomend his place.

I stayed in Isabel’s apartment for a month from September to October. I was so genuinely sad to leave as I has definitely gotten attached to the place during my time there. It’s so homey and cozy, right in the center of La Latina neighborhood which is my absolute favorite part of Madrid. The terrace (especially during the summer months) is such a gem and I spent so much of my time out there, both day and night. I always felt safe in the neighborhood and there was always so much to do. Super convenient Dia grocery store right around the corner too. The apartment is exactly as you see in the pictures. My only regret is that I didn’t stay for longer. I also worked remotely from this apartment and the wifi is excellent and super fast. Never had any issues or lags during my zoom meetings. Thank you and Paloma for your hospitality Isabel! I will definitely be back and can fully say I whole heartedly recommend this place!

Isabel’s apartment was the perfect place to stay when visiting Madrid for a short or long trip. Embajadores neighborhood is so fun and walkable. The apartment has everything you could want - extra bedding, kitchen supplies, heat, 1.5 bathrooms, high quality appliances, an amazing terrace and more. I would stay here again
Big apartment on a quiet street that’s just blocks away from great tapas and cafés. Paloma was very helpful, too. Our flight was delayed and she waited for us.

We stayed for 2 months and love the place. It is very close to most of the tourist spots in Madrid. Restaurants and grocery stores are very close to the apartment. I would certainly love to stay here again when I come back to Madrid in a couple of years
Great apartment to explore Madrid! Fantastic location, really clean and everything you need. Very accommodating and flexible check in also made getting the apartment easy!
Very common apartment very close to the touristic attractions. Clean, comfortable, cosy. Definitely recommend to all traveling to Madrid.
Great place. Owner is fast and accurate in communication. We had fun time in Madrid without any problems.

Perfect location near the center and in the same time quiet. Apartment is as described with everything needed inside (needs some renovation). Still two big minuses: first and most important - bathroom stinks ( probably from the sewage) and it can't be avoided; second is that it is too dark (windows look at the wall and very little day light is coming).
Very central and walkable to the main attractions! Apt. Was very cute and looked just like the pictures

Host had difficulties with English. We got instructions to clean the garbage at the end and bring them outside although they charged us upfront for 100 Euro for cleaning. Equipment was good but very limited for cooking. Furniture is very worn out and replacement is recommended. Double bad is very small (cca120 cm) for two peoplw but luckly we could use the sofa. At leaving we were instructed to leave the keys in the room but front doors we can only open with a key. Host was not able to explain how to exit. Luckly there were 3 of us that we could kept the doors open. Location is very calm and walking distance to major museums.

The place was really good! It was located near the center, but not loud at all. Overall the place was very clean and spacious. The only minor points we had was that there was not much natural light coming through the windows during the day time. And when we were to put open the windows there would be a smokey smell coming from outside. Besides these two things the airbnb was great! The hosts were very friendly and responsive, the location is great, and the airbnb is very cozy and nice. Definitely would recommend!

One pro and con to confirm shared by previous reviewers. Location is great. Many highlights can be covered by walking. The con shared by others is, though there are many big windows but the very little natural lights. Great host who is flexible and responsive.

Juanma's apartment is just as everyone says- perfect location, great for a short stay for a single or couple. It's in close proximity to a few metro stations and it's also easy to walk everywhere around central. Check-in was easy and Juanma was flexible to work around when my flight got in.
Would definitely recommend this flat- central Madrid but with the feeling of a nice neighbourhood area!
The stay at Juanma's place was perfect. They answered quickly and I had a nice welcoming with good explanations. The studio is big enough for 2 people and super well located!

Great stay in Juanma's apartment ! The apartment is cosy, clean, well equiped and really well located. Juanma was a superhost, really caring. He gave us very nice advice on places to visit, restaurants and everything else we needed. I fully recommend.

The apartment is located right in the city centre, you can walk everywhere. I was surprised by how warm and comfy it is. The shower and bed are perfect for relax. It was totally worth it and Juanma is a super host! 5 stars

Great place to stay in terms of location, cleanliness and the host was also very accommodating and friendly!
Only thing that drops my rating unfortunately is that I was woken up on 2 different nights due to some loud neighbouring tourists partying at 4am. The issue seems to be sorted now as they were reported and partying isn’t allowed in the complex, but it was quite annoying in the moment! Regardless, I still think this place is definitely work staying in!!

My stay with Juanma was great! The location is awesome, there are bars and restaurants walking distance in any direction, and it’s in the central part of the city with public transportation only a feee blocks away. The place was clean, comfortable and modern! I loved the simple design, and the bed was very comfy! Juanma is a great host! He was accommodating through the entire stay, providing suggestions and helping with any questions or concerns immediately. All in all I loved it!
Great apartment in the best location in Madrid. Juanma was a very helpful and responsive host. I would return for another stay in Madrid.

This Airbnb was in a very good location, just a few blocks away from shopping, restaurants, bars, lounges and a few more blocks from the most popular street, Gran. Juanma is hands down the MOST responsive and accommodating host I have ever encountered on Airbnb and that's saying a lot since I travel around the world. The space is just what you need if you're a solo or couple traveling. I definitely enjoy staying in places that gives you a local vibe and this spot did it for me. There's a grocery store right down the street as well, also if you want to get around quick there are a bunch of Lime/Bolt scooters to wiz through traffic. I suggest you guys visit Juanma's fragrance store, I purchased 2 bottles and received a bunch of compliments on the plane home. Thank you my friend

Juanma was really nice and helpful to us visiting Madrid for the first time. The apartment was a simple studio in a nice part of the city, and everything was within walking distance, which was perfect for us.
Small cozy and functional space next to everything without being noisy. Juanma is a genuine and helpful host - would stay here again!

Pro: super responsive helpful host, clean and quiet place, easy walk to most of tour attractions and good access to the metro.
Con: The apparent is small and rather dark. If you mostly just sleep, perfectly fine, but staying for longer would be a bit tight.
Incredibly quiet and peaceful for such a central location in a busy neighborhood. Small, but well appointed. Friendly responsive host. Definitely would recommend.
Juanma’s place was very clean and convenient to all of Madrid. It was very easy to communicate with Juanma, and he was very helpful!

Javier was always quick to respond to any queries and a great host.
Location of the apartment is amazing and I highly recommend it to others.

Javier's apartment is comfortable, stylish and could not be better located.  It is located right across the street from the park, with an superb bakery, several excellent tapas restaurants, a brewery and not one but two gelaterias on the same block.  The apartment is very well outfitted, too. But what really stands out is Javier's hospitality and helpfulness; he went above and beyond the call of duty in helping us on various occasions.
Nice apartment. Great location. Can be a little noisy at times. Upstairs neighbors have kids running around and sound from alley. Otherwise great!

Javier’s place is amazing!!! The best location in Madrid, comfortable beds, spacious and private rooms and everything you might need for a perfect stay.
Javier is a great super host and he will help you with anything you might need. I wish I had 6 starts to give to this place!

Had the best summer in Madrid at Javier’s place. Perfect for families with kids, as it’s right across from the incredible El Retiro park. We got up every morning and went straight to the playground! Javier was an A+ host-super responsive and came over right away when we couldn’t figure out the a/c. Thanks so much Javier!

GREAT location! Literally across the park El Retiro and very close to Goya and Serrano for good shopping. Comfortable and spacious accommodations. We enjoyed our stay in Madrid and Javier was very friendly and responsive.

Amazing Airbnb in a beautiful location right across from Retiró Park! Bright, airy, spacious apartment that’s perfect for 3 couples - everything was clean, and we each had our own bathroom. The apartment was very well appointed with plentiful kitchen and bathroom amenities; and even two bikes you could use to explore the park.
The location was also very convenient, chill yet lively at the same time - great restaurants & cafes right downstairs, and there’s a bus right outside to get to the city center.
Javier was a great host - he was proactive & flexible with our check-in, responsive to inquiries and tolerated my horrible Spanish (though he speaks perfect English) :) highly recommend this Airbnb!
Maria’s place was great!  Newly remodeled, awesome location, kind hostess!  Would definitely stay here again and recommend to others traveling to Madrid!!

I wish we could give Maria's apartment a 10 star review.  The apartment was easy to access, spacious, comfortable, sparkling clean with an amazing location.  Maria was prompt with responses to our questions or concerns.  I would recommend her apartment to others and I will stay again in future trips to Madrid.

We loved our stay at Maria’s place. She was quick to communicate and checking In was a breeze. The location is fabulous — walking distance to so much and close to the subways as well! The Plaza de La Villa is just gorgeous. I stayed with my adult son and teenage daughter and we all loved it! Thanks, Maria!

Great location, apartment is clean and nice bathrooms (2) and a/c was great, plenty of room for 4 of us. Beds comfortable, towels and soap provided.  Lift to take you or your luggage up to 4th floor.  Easy access with Maria's directions.  Nicely updated. One of the best AIRBNB's we stayed on this vacation stop in Madrid.  Walking distance to most touristy things, easy to get a taxi.  Shopping near buy and restaurants.  We would for sure stay here again if we ever return to visit Madrid. Maria was super nice and easy to work with and good response time.  10+

Maria is a friendly and responsive host. Great communications and quick response to questions. The rental is extremely beautiful and clean and is in a very good location.  Would not hesitate to rent again if I visit again in the future.
Great apartment in a very beautiful area. Close to many sights and public transit. We enjoyed staying here and would do so again in the future!

This apartment is in an excellent location, near shops, restaurants, metro and walking distance to many of the main attractions of beautiful Madrid.  It is also located in a small historical square which was super cute for pictures because we felt like we had it all to ourselves. Our host Maria was available to answer all of our questions about checkin/checkout and any accommodated any special requests that we had. The apartment is clean,  and having the 2 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms for a party of 4 was perfect.  The beds are comfortable, and the kitchen was great for preparing small quick meals in the morning on the go.  We would not hesitate to book this Airbnb again.  We had a fabulous 6 day vacation in Madrid!
The location is fantastic, close to all tourist places in Madrid. The apartment is clean and accurate to the pictures. I would recommend it.
5 star rating!  This place was close to everything! The inside was exactly as depicted!  Perfect amenities!  Truly enjoyed my stay!  Quick efficient check in and out.

Great stay and very responsive hosts!  The place is clean and as described.  Lots of supermarkets, restaurants, cafes nearby.    Also has super-fast wifi!  It is 15-20 minute walk to most of the attractions or to get into center of Madrid.

Thank you for allowing us to experience your fab apartment. It was ideally located and we enjoyed a beautifully fulfilling experience. It has everything that one could desire.
God bless you. Chao.

We stayed at Eduardo and Raul's apartment in October 2019. The  apartment was impeccable in every way,  clean, stylish, well equipped, very well located between the various central districts, with shopping facilities and parks for outdoor sports nearby. Eduardo and Raul responded within minutes to any request or query. The remote key-less check-in was crucial to us as we arrived very early morning. We highly recommend this apartment.

Really nice and stylish apartment, really close to the city centre.
Highly recommend this place to anyone
A bonus is the great communication with Eduardo and Raul !
We had a great time at the apt and Eduardo was very responsive. The apt was modern and spacious and located in a great place. There was also Netflix on the TV which was great!

The apartment is in the excellent localization, very close to the main attractions. It’s very comfortable for 6 persons. Eduardo is a great host, very helpful and nice. We had a wonderful stay in Madrid.

Eduardo & Raul's apartment was in a perfect location. It was clean, spacious and ideal! I was traveling with my two Male cousins... the 2 bathrooms was a plus. I recommend this place 100%. The beds were extremely comfortable as well! If you're into walking, it's an easy walk to the Royal Palace, Plaza Mayor, etc. I would definitely stay here again!!!!
Raul was a great host. He was great at answering questions. Check-in/out was simple. Place was great for a small family. More space than a hotel. Each room has its own TV.

Nice apartment in a quiet area. Raul is also a great host that replies fast and gives you good answers if you have questions.
Would definitely recommend to others!
Really great apartment. Everything was as described and Raul was very cordial and polite, being always in touch when needed.

Raul’s communication was fantastic during our stay and when he faced a problem he quickly had it fixed. The beds were all very comfy and the showers had great pressure. Not much more to say, the location is good for exploring and with 20 minutes you can be in some great parts of the city

This is a must-rent property for anyone who visits Madrid. It is well located, near anything you'll ever need, from shops, to cafés and historical sites. The Royal Palace, Plaza villa, Plaza Mayor, and Cathedral Santa Maria la Real de la Almudena are all within a 12-minute walk. I fully enjoyed my stay and will surely book this property on my next trip to Madrid.

This place was amazing, the location is central to everything. 12 min walk to the Royal Palace and 4 min walk to one of the hop on hop off tour bus stops.
The apartment itself is up to date, their is plenty of climate control and a washer is a plus. The water pressure was awesome for showering. This is definitely going to be our go to place when we visit Madrid in the future. Raul was an awesome host, very attentive and super fast at responding to all of our questions.
I highly recommend this place if you plan on coming to Madrid.
An added bonus was the great Korean Restaurant, Seoul next door. Great food and service.

We had a pleasant stay. The apartment corresponds to the description. Beds are comfortable !
Also a good localisation in Madrid. We recommend.
spacious and comfortable apartment, lools even better in person. Raul was very pleasent to deal with. Would absolutely recommend.
Nice little place that has everything you need. Not super fancy, but great for a couple of days in Madrid. ☺️
Great stay. Thank you Raul. The apartment was terrific and located well. A short walk to all the local attractions. We enjoyed the stay very much.
Fantastic apartment for the family to stay in at the weekend. Just as described on Airbnb, we would definitely stay here again.

This place is very comfy the price we paid was excellent. There is a Japanese rest across the street that has good food for a good price. There is a little store next to the building that is very convenient . In a few words Raul thank you for taking good care of my family. See you in the near future. Gracias

Nice apartment - clean and pleasant. Sitting room is a bit dark but we were out most of the time so it didn't matter. We were three adults and we stayed for three nights. The instructions to get in were easy to follow and Raul was very responsive to any query. It's located in a good spot - easily walkable to the centre and quiet and peaceful at night. We slept really well here, good beds with firm mattresses. I recommend Seoul, the Korean restaurant round the corner where we went for dinner one night. Most of the rest of the time we ate in Spanish places closer to the city, there are some really great traditional spots. We really enjoyed our stay in Madrid, it's a great city. Thanks Raul.
Spotless, spacious and comfortable we loved staying here. Just a short walk to some great sights and very convenient public transport.
Location is nearby the palace, quiet in night time, car can park on street for overnight. A problem relate to the water during my stay, hope can fix it shortly for the upcoming travellers.

Comfortable and clean apartment with excellent location - really just a few steps from Gran vía. Easy check-in and check-out. The apartment is situated close to the main entrance, so other guests in the building might disturb you by slamming the door. But in general I can highly recommend.
Good location and accomodation! One of our towels seemed to be a bit dirty probably from the cleaning company and he responded immediately. We recommend it for a short stay in the heart of Madrid!
It is a great location and a very simple check in and check out process. It is a cozy studio apartment but their is a bit of problem with the dust.

Great location, very central - right beside gran via. The place is perfect for a couple. They have a couch as well for a third person but it wasn't as comfortable.
Unfortunately the place is not quiet at night time - as you can hear all the people coming in and out of the building.
All my family was happy to stay here, surely if we come back will choose it again. Good host, with clear instructions.
It is a great location easy access to everything, the shops, entertainment. very accomodating host as well.

The place is great and is located in the best and safest neighborhood in Madrid. The host was amazing, he was always available when we needed him. Would definitely consider this place and the host to any guest. Thank you again!
The place was as clean as expected and everything worked out perfectly. I would stay there again, it is perfect for short trips.

Great place and nice location. I came for an in-person period at IE University and it was an easy walk to campus and easy to get around to other areas in Madrid. I had some trouble with the wifi but they were quick to respond and address.
Best communication I have had with a host, absolutely fantastic communication! When there was a doubt or a question, i got instant response! The apartment was super nice, just like a hotel!

Great spot right next to Diego de León metro! It was very easy to travel to Sol or Gran Vía and back home. The neighborhood is also very nice with many grocery stores, food and shopping nearby. The building itself was easy to navigate and has a pool and gym included, the room was the perfect size for two guests and was very comfortable with a beautiful view. Communicating with the host was easy through WhatsApp and they were always around to answer questions I had. Overall great stay!

The perfect location for this ur stay, visiting with family in Salamanca. Having the sofa bed made a great difference. Nice and quiet location in a busy area of the city, easy to walk to locations. Modern, clean with all the amenities we needed. Thank you for the great service.
This was perfect for our four nights in fabulous Madrid and I would recommend  it highly…remembering it’s a serviced apartment so more like a hotel stay, loved it.

My boyfriend and I stayed here for 3 days and 2 nights. Overall our stay was good. However, the apartment lacked some of the basic cooking ingredients that were stated would be provided in the apartment. For a short stay we didn’t want to have to buy cooking ingredients and have them go to waste for a short stay. The location was perfect, close to the metro and bus stations! For travelers with late flights there is a place to store your bags which was helpful with our flight time :)

The place is quite large, with tall ceilings. A/C worked well and discretely making sleeping through Madrid’s torrid nights a breeze. Despite being in the center of Chueca (gay neighborhood), it was remarkably quiet. The bathroom is also quite large and there’s good water pressure. All the hardware appears new. Overall, a great place to stay.

Amazing location, excellent unit, quick responses. Allowed us to check in earlier, only 2 cons are we did not have hot water when we arrived (but it was fixed fast) and there's no storage option upon check-out. I strongly recommend to stay with them for a pleasant visit in Madrid!!!

Lovely place. Great Location, awesome facilities (washing machine, dishwashing machine); overall great experience except for a big thing. We couldn't check in at 23:00 because the card codifier for the rooms didn't work, so we had to stay the first night in a hotel nearby. We were able to stay in the next day and they upgraded us to a better room, so in overall happy for how they solved it but dissapointed with their checkin system (They also refunded us that night).
Great location. Clean enough.Did the job for a 2 night stay for 6 of us 👍

Nice apartment, we were a group of friends and this is what we were looking for, good position: 10 min walking from Plaza del Sol.
Check-in guy very clear and kind!

Excellent location, close to everything. The apartment was very comfortable for our group of four adults and 1 child. It had everything we needed. The apartment is in good condition, but the bathrooms needs a little TLC.

Perfect location! The appartement is simple but convenient near restaurants and walking distance from a lot of nice places.
The bathrooms need some upgrade, one did not have a lock on the door and the other had some issues with flushing the water in the toilet (did not flush good).
We had a nice stay.
Host is friendly and communicates well.
Great location. Plenty of space. The living room runs pretty cold even with the heaters on but bedroom are fine. Kind greeting from the host to pass off the keys and give a rundown of the place.

Very good place and very well located. The host was very friendly and the price was very reasonable. All in all a great place and a good experince.
Many thanks.

A comfortable stay for five friends, with a warm and friendly welcome from Hector - thank you!
Conveniently located in a lively area, but with no street noise inside. No unnecessary frills, but everything you need.

My husband and I just came back from the fabulous Madrid vacation. Bruno's appartment added value to our wonderful experience. Starting with the location just outside bustling city center providing for incredibly quiet nights, yet still very well connected to the city center it self by public transport (metro station and a couple of bus station within 50 meters from the building). There are grocery shops, farmacies, bars...in the building it self and just around it. Bruno's roof top appartment with huge terrace was spacious, clean and well equipped and he as a host was responsive and helpful. Would surely recommend it!

We stayed at Bruno’s place one week, in october. It has a very nice terrace, where we spent quite some time and in one of the nights we made the fire also. It’s very close to Lucero metro station, supermarkets and local cafeteria, where you can take breakfast with the locals.
We also worked there and the internet was very good.
We liked that it was a chill area, although it’s quite close to the city center.
Bruno is a good host and willing to help you.
We definitely recommend his place.
The appartment is well located and super nice. Alvaro was available for any questions and super kind

Myself and two others stayed in this apartment and were delighted with the facilities, building is incredible and the apartment itself has everything which could be asked for. Alvaro is a great host, very helpful from start to finish, suggesting the best places to go and see and was always quick to respond when a question was asked. 10/10 stay, if you are going to Madrid, look no further.
Amazing location, amazing apartment! Had everything that we needed, very clean, quiet neighborhood, and lots of space. First time in Madrid but I’ll be back for sure.

+ The host is very friendly and helpful
+ The apartment is very nice and has the perfect location for shopping, restaurants and clubbing
+ Very clean

Álvaro’s place is in an excellent location; an affluent area of Madrid with a metro stop nearby and plenty of options walking distance from the apartment.
Álvaro was an excellent host, always communicating with promptness and supportive through the entire rental process.
I would highly recommend his place to anyone visiting the city who’s looking for comfort, centrality, and style.

Alvaro was a fantastic host! We had a few issues with temperature regulation in the apartment and he responded immediately and resolved the issue. The apartment was centrally located and made it easy to explore the city. Alvaro provided tons of great recommendations for coffee, dinner, drinks, etc.

We are a regular Airbnb travelers and would rate Alvaro’s place as one of the nicest, best located, and real value of all the places we have stayed. The place was very clean, modern, had everything we needed to feel at home, and was an easy walk to all the sites we wanted to see and a few steps to dozens of restaurants and cafes. Communication was great too. We would highly recommend this wonderful apartment.

Alvaro's place is very well located and in a quite street. The apartment is a bit small (we were two couples), but was as expected based on the pictures. Alvaro's communication before and upon arrival was excellent. He helped us to do the check-in thru the app, since is a bit tricky. The unit is in great shape, very clean, and the beds were comfortable.  Highly recommended.
Alvaro is a great host and very communicative. The place was meticulous and we enjoyed our stay very much. The neighborhood is great as well
Amazing place, Alvaro was lovely and very quick to respond. The house was super well equipped and in what i believe to be the best area in madrid! I had an amazing experience.

We had a nice stay in Alvaro’s apartment and he was a great host as very responsive and kind.
A situation happened at check in and he solved it immediately.
We had a late flight and he was super accommodating with us on that part so we are very thankful to him!
He also provides very interesting recommendations of things around and especially restaurants.
The apartment itself is very stylish and the two bathrooms are a must.
Bravo Alvaro and thank you very much!

I have seen many Airbnbs so far in Madrid since I visit the city on regular basis. Alvaro S Place was by far the best. The completely renovated building is very old from outside but modern from inn side. Alvaro has implement a modern check in and information system via an app. The apartment is spacious with two complete bathrooms and bedrooms. The sourronding area is full of excellent bars and restaurants, rather up scale.
Will definitely stay at Alvaro S place again next time I come to Madrid!

Alvaro is the perfect host. He is super reactive, very helpful and his place is super beautiful and perfectly located. I highly recommend anyone to stay at Alvaro’s.
I will come back for sure.
Thanks a lot Alvaro!
Alvaro’s apartment was great! In a very quiet area but a close walk to amazing shopping, restaurants, and the metro. I will return on my next trip to Madrid.

The apartment is very nice and well equipped. Description is totally in line with the reality. The localisation is perfect (close to subway and city centre), relatively calm and beautiful. The mobile app used for check-in and opening the doors is a great solution. We were very satisfied with our visit and we are recommending this apartment for anyone who would like to visit Madrid.

The unit is wonderful and very good located. The building is in great shape and the sense of arrival is magnificent with its white marble foyer.
The unit was in excelent shape and exactly as in the photos!
Alvaro, it’s host, was very kind and most helpful

Excellent host communication and always followed up with us regarding our stay. Apartment is very well located and close to restaurants, shops and subway. I gave 4/5 stars due to few cosmetic and cleanliness issues which I believe can be easily fix by the host for future visitors.
Very nice apartment. Pretty and clean. Great location. We were a couple with a kid and having a bed in a separate room was good.
Alvaro was very communicative and the apartment was well located. Highly recommended for a weekend trip to Madrid!
Very much enjoyed my stay. Very comfortable and quiet. Has everything I needed and Alvaro assisted me with early check in.

Beautiful and clean apartment in Madrid. Alvaro is friendly, helpful and communicative and the place has everything you could need. Great location, super clean and comfortable. Fantastic place to stay.
This is a beautiful apartment in the heart of Madrid. It's very well equipped and a really chic spot. It's also very quiet. I wish I could have stayed longer!
Great person to deal with!! Super clean apartment and great location, too!  If you haven’t been, go to Spain and try this apartment!

Beautiful room in a beautiful old building. The location is wel connected to the metro and has plenty of places for food and drinks around. Because it's an old building be mindfull of noise you make to your neighbours.
Álvaro is a gracious host and made sure we had everything we needed. Responsive and flexible when we needed him. 5 stars!
Very nice and clean flat. The location is great, and the host is very responsive👍🏻 The only inconvenience is the surface of the floor, which is old and makes noise.

Alvaro's place was beautiful and in a great location! The neighborhood is very nice and feels very safe.  Alvaro provided very helpful instructions on getting into the apartment and how to access the amenities.  We would definitely stay there again next time we visit Madrid!
Staying here was great as it was right next to the metro and there were restaurants nearby as well. The place was very clean and as described. A highlight is how sleek and modern it is!

Simply superb! Great apartment in a beautiful and historic building with one of the best equipped kitchens that we have seen on our Airbnb stays. The downstairs bedroom with large double bed and ensuite was so comfortable, while the area upstairs with a double mattress is ideal for kids who want a bit of their own space! Álvaro himself is so helpful and professional and genuinely tries to ensure guests have the best possible experience.
Alonso Martínez is a great, well connected area of Madrid that is close enough to the centre but has less of the tourist crowds. Nearby Plaza Olavide is a lovely spot to soak up some sun and sample typical tapas with locals on the many terraces and there is a decent playground for young kids!

I would come again tomorrow if I could.
Alvaro is very kind, flexible and reactive.
The apartment is perfectly located on the second floor of a beautiful building.
The second bedroom is more an alcove, perfect for two kids.

I really enjoyed my stay experience. I live in a loft, the location is very good, the street is very quiet. I checked in on a Saturday, but I don't know if it's usually this quiet. The room was very clean, well equipped and the bed was very comfortable. The staff are very friendly and helpful. Thank you for providing me with such a good service. good luck!
Excellent location, a very private & secure location. All you need to feel just at home. Alvaro was an excellent host - on top of everything we needed
The apartment is in great location, walkable to many places and super close to the metro. The apartment is beautiful and very comfortable, we had a great time
Excellent host with great communication, and a charming and well appointed apartment. Access was a little complex at first but easy once you get the hang of it.
Lovely apartment in a gorgeous building. Very well located. Everything was perfect! Thanks Alvaro.
The apartment is spacious. We found everything we needed inside. Supermarkets, bars or restaraunts are really close to the flat.  Highly recommend!

A beautiful apartment in a beautiful part of the city. Alvaro was very easy to communicate with and the amenities in the apartment were fantastic. Would definitely recommend if you are visiting Madrid
It was very clean and modern.  The bathrooms were large and the bedrooms were comfortable. We would stay there again.
I thoroughly enjoyed my stay at Alvaro’s place. I ran into issues during check in and Alvaro was very responsive and helpful. Everything was as described and we had a comfortable stay.

Alvaro was always quick to reply to my queries and able to help remotely when we had a bit of trouble with the door in the beginning. He also gave many suggestions for dining in the area. It was easy to communicate with him. The location was fantastic with the metro just round the corner and many cafes. We could go back to rest in between trips. The apartment is clean,  very modern and furnished with everything we needed. The cost per night is also very reasonable.

This was a spacious apartment, perfectly located close to the metro in an excellent neighborhood. Great for group of 4 and has everything you need like 5 star hotel. Alvaro is a great host, reactive with good recommendations for the neighborhood.

Wondeful Place, very clean and excelente location!
Álvaro is a great host, very helpful and ready to help you! When we come back to Madrid , we will stay again in Alvaro’s place.

Clean, well-appointed apartment in a nice building/quite neighborhood. Comfortable beds and nice shower. Perfect for our family of 4 (kids love their second-level space!) We are able to walk to all main attractions. Highly recommended and we will surely stay again next time in Madrid!
We had an amazing stay. Álvaro was extremely helpful with all our questions and communicative. The accommodations were clean, comfortable, and quiet. Would definitely recommend and stay again!

We had a wonderful stay at Alvaro’s apartment in Madrid! The place was clean, comfortable, and perfectly located for exploring the city. Alvaro was a fantastic host—friendly, responsive, and helpful with local tips. We’d definitely stay here again. Thank you, Alvaro!
Alvaro was an excellent host. The space was clean, well appointed and lovely. Great location, as well. We will stay again the next time we travel to Madrid!!

Alvaro's place was great. All the amenities met the expectations. In the mornings I could smell breakfast being cooked somewhere in the building, not in my apartment. I stayed in one of the units between two others, so at times I could hear some of the other tenant's conversation. I don't hold Alvaro responsible for either of my listed nuisances. The building is historic and I understand there are certain restrictions to the architectural design of the apartments. Alvaro is very responsive and proactive. I enjoyed his place and the ability to get anywhere in Madrid fast and easily.

Great stay at Madrid. Álvaro is a great host. He was really attentive and responsive to all our inquiries. The place is a gem in the city. It is comfortable and modern without loosing its antique charm. Highly recommended.

Antonio was an incredible host! His level of responsiveness and concern for his guest(s) is absolutely unmatched. Every detail of this property was spectacular... from the cleanliness, location, check-in and the various amenities that Antonio provided his guest(s). I certainly recommend this property to anyone! Antonio is beyond a doubt a SUPER HOST!

Great apartment in wonderful area, parking space in city center was very useful as well.
The host was very friendly and eager to answer & help.

Antonio’s place is a great stay for two. It’s about a 30 minute drive into the city but has some shops right nearby. The space is very clean and Antonio went above with providing some snacks for us. We enjoyed our stay and would recommend.
the apartment was beautiful, about 20 minutes and 20 euros in a taxi to centro, the swimming pool was very needed in the heat and the host was very helpful when needed

We had wonderful stay at this apartment for 6 nights. The apartment was so clean and had everything we needed, and they provided more towels and soaps if we needed. They even did a print work for us too, and that was super thanksful!! The Minty Host responded so fastly so we could solve our questions right away. I would like to stay at Minty Host again totally! Thank you so much for all your works and the apartment!!
The apartment of Isabel is very nice, with a lot of spacious for a couple, very well localized, clean and tidy. The furniture is very good, the bed, the couch, everything. Highly recommend!

This location was ideal for my first time in Madrid. It’s located directly in the city-center of the mostly historic part of the city with close and convenient access to the metro. The small balcony outside was an extra special spot to view life bustling through the streets below.
I was welcomed in person by my host who took the time to show me through the details of my stay. I’d highly recommend staying here. Thank you so much!
The apartment was really new, great and comfortable to stay. Location was very near to main Metro station and tourist area. Great host 👍🏻

This place is great, felt like home away from home . Cozy and  comfortable place to stay ,very clean and all the amenities one would need,close to everything, walking distance to main attractions .  Also Taberna los 4 robles right next door for our morning coffee , the market next door also with everything we needed. I would definitely book again when in Madrid .  Cohost myplazza wonderful and attentive . This is a gem in central Madrid! Definitely give it a 5 star and recommended this place 100 percent!

I had a great stay at Isabel’s place! Great location and cute apartment. Apartment was very clean, check-in was easy, great shower as well.  Apt is in a great location and close to public transportation.

We recently had the pleasure of staying here, and I wanted to express our heartfelt gratitude for such a wonderful experience. My wife, our one-year-old son, and I thoroughly enjoyed every moment of our stay.
From the moment we arrived, we were greeted with warmth and hospitality. The attention to detail in the apartment was remarkable. It was not just a place to stay but a true home away from home. The cozy atmosphere and thoughtfully curated amenities made our stay exceptionally comfortable.
The location was ideal, allowing us to explore the vibrant streets of Madrid with ease. We appreciated the proximity to local attractions, restaurants, and shops, which made our daily outings with our little one convenient and enjoyable.
Your responsiveness and helpful suggestions added an extra layer of comfort to our trip. It's evident that you care about your guests' experiences and go above and beyond to ensure they have a memorable stay. Thank you for accommodating us!

Small studio but with all the essentials needed: possibility to cook simple meals and also washing machine at our disposition. Ideal for one person but 2 person is ok too which was my case. Great if you work/tour/study and don't stay much at home and just want privacy and independence at night. Supermarkets nearby. Area is in /near Chinatown of madrid. Ramón is contactable through Airbnb app. Excellent check-in and out process - very easy. Thanks Ramón for the stay.

it's a good and clean space in a fully renovated house. you will have everything that is needed for a long stay. Ramon is very communicative and helping. The surrounding area is colourful and busy, everything is easily reachable. Earplugs might be needed if you are a light sleeper. Overall highly recommended. Many thanks, Ramon
Mar's was very nice and her friend too. The flat modern, clean and quiet. I recommand!
Great facilities and super clean. Good location, just 5 minutes walk to metro. Mar and her friend are friendly. Recommend !!!

Ignacio was very kind, thoughtful, and generous. The whole apartment was super clean, and the bed was comfortable. The space is very small, but it worked well for me, since I was out all day and mainly needed a place to sleep. Ignacio is very welcoming, gentle, and polite. I really appreciated his hospitality and the affordable option of just renting a room from him.
The apartment was well maintained, clean and easily accessible. Ignacio is a great host-- very kind and personable.
The room is well enough for one person to stay, Ignacio is super friendly and nice, I enjoyed my stay in this apartment, it’s very clean and comfortable. Recommend
Ignacio is a great host. His place is tidy and comfortable. I would stay with him and recommend his place

Highly recommend to anyone stopping into Madrid to stay!! Ignacio was so kind and friendly and was very flexible and understanding with arrival time. The stay was very close to a metro stop and in a nice neighborhood. Will surely be coming back to stay at his place again!!!

The apartment was quaint and lovely and within walking distance to the San Bernabeu stadium, several bars and minimarts and a metro station.
The hosts were also lovely. They provided helpful information prior to arrival and on check-in, particularly in reference to getting around. They were also nice enough to leave some breakfast items for our first morning.
If i ever make it back to Madrid, i will definitely stay here again.

Ana was a lovely host, she met us at the apartment to let us in. Gave us a tour and explained how to use everything (TV, AC, washing machine). The place was super clean and had all working amenities. The bed and sofa were comfortable. Wifi worked great and was a 5min walk from a main metro station stop. There is also a grocery store that’s a 1min walk. The area felt very safe and I highly recommend this place. It was perfect for my husband and I.

Lovely, spacious, older apartment. Comfly bed. Wifi works well. Great location....just a 4min walk from the HSLU and UN Tourism university building. Nice restaurants nearby.
Bathroom ceiling had water damage from the apartment above, but that is getting fixed. Host gave info proactively and was solution oriented.
I would stay here next time I am here in Madrid.

We stayed here almost a week as we wanted to stay near Santiago Bernabeu. It was a 10 min walk from this house, nice location, calm environment, has everything for short stay. The air-condition worked perfectly for very hot days/nights. Enrique was fast in responses and understands the needs. Will come back again and 100% recommended.
Absolutely loved the apartment! It was so clean, all the amenities we needed was there & only a few minutes away from the airport!
The landlord is nice and generous. The house is close to the stadium. And the area is nice and quiet.

The location is convenient. The host was awating for us and the explanation very nice. It is fully equipped. The pictures describe the apartment in a very precise way and the comunication was easy and fast.
This place is in a good location - close to tours, shopping, metro, market, etc. Maria showed us the place and was very welcoming. Thanks, Maria!

Apartment is as described. Nice and cosy. In the apartment is everything you need. Location is greate a short walk to all landmarks, near are two metro stations if you need it and a lot of different shops (food, clothes, souvenires etc.).

Lovely studio apartment with all amenities. There’s hot water and heating which was great for the February cold. Basically at Plaza mayor. Close to the metro and a lot of other shops. So so convenient.

Great apartment located in a great location if you intend to cover the usual tourist activities. Apartment is well kept inside a historic building. Host is resposive to our needs and check-in. All essential items are there and bedding is comfortable.
Great apartment in a perfect location for exploring Madrid, couldn't fault a single thing. Maria is a great host
Brilliant location in the heart of Madrid, Maria was also very helpful with recommendations and explaining the bins system
The place is nice and clean. Maria is very amiable and always ready to help you and answer your questions at any time of the day.

long story short we got 3 beds instead of 4, so the description of the place is misleading. the communication was not good. Maria barely speaks english, and the google translator doesn’t do any better. after asking about the fourth bed we got the answer that the fourth bed is “supplementary” and is at the other place at the moment. so, i wouldn’t recommend to stay here.
though, the place is very convenient is you have an early flight, you can get to the airport in 10 minutes.
Maria’s place is HUGE! We had been traveling around Spain for a week and Maria’s interior was the best by far! And she had hot water!
The apartament is very good in regards of space, and the bathroom is fanstastic! It was clean, the only thing is that the metro line is not as easy to take, aside from that is was good!
Cute little air bnb in a neighborhood outside of the main downtown area. The apartment had everything we needed and it was a short Uber ride to downtown Madrid. We would stay again.

Great host who was very fast to respond to any questions and told us everything to get in and made us feel right at home! Great place for a group of friends to go out and enjoy the beauty of Madrid and have a comfortable and clean place to sleep and start each day!
Very convenient to the airport, restaurants and grocery just a  few steps away, clean and spacious. The neighborhood is busy and crowded, but not a touristy place.
Highly recommend. Excellent communication, great location to the airport. The property is actually bigger in reality and super clean. Will definitely visit again. Thank you!

This place was very clean. The check-in process was clear and easy. The Host was very responsive and gave clear instructions. We enjoyed the cleanliness and all the amenities. It was easy to get to and we felt very safe here. Thank you!

I needed a place to stay overnight in between flights. Maria Teresa’s place was perfect. It’s a 10 minute taxi ride from the airport. It’s in a lovely, quiet neighborhood. The place was squeaky clean and very comfortable. I highly recommend her apartment.

Not what expected. Felt more like a hostel. Thin walls and very odd layout. I could hear everything the next unit was saying or doing. The odd bathroom setup with the tub/ shower butted up against another standup shower. They were both connected and only a shower curtain to separate them. The sofa bed mattress had a noticeable huge dips and creaky support frame.  Would not stay here again. Luckily we were there for only one night.

Excellent AirBNB. The host responded promptly, the property was sparkling clean and comfortable. Just FYI, this AirBNB is run by a professional AirBNB management company with multiple properties. So if you're looking for personal interactions with a local host, you won't get it here.
Fantastic Airbnb right in the center of Madrid. The AC worked great and apartment had all the essentials. Very comfortable beds.

This is a great place in a great location! It was clean, good size (we are a family of 5), steps from shops, restaurants, super convenient. The team communicated well, met us at the place for check-in, and was super nice. I’d definitely book again!

Great apartment in a fantastic location, close the shopping, restaurants, and public transportation. Most sites are walkable but the metro is only a five minute walk away.
The apartment was specious, comfortable, generally quite clean, with consistent air conditioning throughout and plenty of hot water.
Our Host kindly reached out prior to our trip to help coordinate check in, met us upon arrival and the process was easy and very speedy.
The apartment was clean and had everything we needed for a short stay. Easy communication with the host and great location in a hip area of Madrid. Good coffee shops and restaurants near by.

The apartment is in a great location, there are shops, bars and restaurants all close by.  The hosts communicate well and check in was very easy. The apartment is as described, comfy beds, air con and everything you need for your stay.

Please, make sure that you have a valid and clear conversation with the host and that everything has been cleared and arranged before arriving the place. Also, be preventive while in the area, as it gets kind of insecure late night.

Amazing apartment with such great value. Was extremely clean and the apartment had a very artsy vibe. Great location too for anyone staying in Madrid, would recommend this spot to anyone and everyone. Only downside was there was not much of balcony to sit on but nonetheless this apartment deserves 5 stars for especially having such easy access. The owner is also very friendly and had no issues whatsoever accessing the apartment. Was probably the most well put together apartment I stayed in during my week long trip in Spain.

Perfect apartment with a very good location in Lavapies. We liked the arrangement with the two bedrooms and the living room. Nice, clean building with a lounge at ground floor. Can absolutely recommend it. Snags; impossible to lock the door from the outside and a couple of tablets for the dishwasher would have been a hit. Will check availability here next time we’re in Madrid.

Great location.
Great for a family of four.
Nice and modern flat in a quiet building.

It was a very Nice, comfortable, and clean place to stay. The two bedrooms are comfortable and the kitchen is very well-equipped. They have flexibility with check-in for affortable extra fee when arriving early, which we appreciate it.
The Location is walking distance to restaurants
and landmarks.
We would stay here again!

Xavier's flat is a great option for a stay in Madrid. It's quite central, next to El Retiro, a great park next to the most well known museums of the city.
The communication with Xavier went really well, getting responses very quickly.
Xavier was extremely helpfull and even allowed us to do a late check out, which was great, considering we had a late flight.
On a next trip to Madrid, I'll definitely check Xavier's place is available.
Thanks for everything Xavier!

Such a great location nearby to Park Retiro, metro stations, museums and the main bus station. The apartment was larger than expected, modern and really clean and perfect for families, with a lovely private outdoor terrace too. The water and cleaning starter pack were lovely touches. Would recommend.

I would highly recommend this apartment . We had a wonderful stay. Miguel Angel was really good and all the time we kept in touch. We had very late check in , and he met us willingly))) we enjoyed our stay.

Appartment was 30 minutes from center by metro. So appartment is too overpriced as for its location.
The rooftop is not private. And it was not possible to access privately, as all the time it was busy with other guests.
When you look at photos you have an impression rooftop is private. It is not true.
Doors in the appartment made a lot of noise, it woke everybody at night.
Bad isolation so you hear neighbours.

Miguel Angel and Oriana were outstanding hosts. They were attentive, provided clear cut instructions on how to access the airbnb and were responsive and very sweet in regards to being available for any questions or concerns. Their apartment was comfortable, clean, and well located in Madrid. They deserve 5/5 and look forward to future stays.

Great location!! Was worried at first about how quiet the street was, if it would be safe at night but the street was nicely lit and we felt safe at all times.
3 floor walk up! Not the end of the world depending on how many bags you have and how heavy they are.
Washer/dryer was awesome and we were given a detergent pod :D
Apt was super clean! AC worked well. Cooled the apt very quickly. All utensils were available. They even had a charger adapter which came in super handy as we forgot ours!
Being that it is an attic, the ceiling in the bathroom is very low. I am 5’6 and I had trouble with it. But my gf is 5’2 and she was fine. Definitely not a deal breaker!
The host was super accommodating and responded quickly. Would definitely recommend!
Perfect apartment for a single traveler or couple. The central location made it ideal for exploring Madrid, with a metro stop nearby. My hosts were also very attentive. Recommended!

The flat is well located, everything is accessible by walk in Central Madrid from the flat.
The ceiling of the bathroom is quite low, so tall people need to be careful, but the flat overall is really good.
Overall a recommended stay, if you want to stay in Madrid for a few days.

We had an amazing time at the apartment, the localisation is amazing and we were close to all the main tourist attractions. The apartment was super clean, well maintained and cozy. Would definitely recommend!

This apartment is in a perfect location. You can go everywhere in few minutes and in this way you can really enjoy the city. Even if it's in a central location the apartment is quiet and not noisy in the night. Clean and with a nice style. Really recommended.
Lovely little flat right in the centre of Madrid. Lovely lady helped check me in and carry bags

It was a very pleasant stay at the nice and cosy accommodation. We were received nicely by Barbara and Hugo and the contact with Sara was also very good. The bathroom has a low ceiling but that wasn’t a problem. The place is nicely located in the city center, definitely recommend!
Great location! Very close to Puerta del Sol and the main Madrid attractions. The apt is small but it has all you need

Sara was bubbly and friendly, and I’m appreciative that she accommodated my request for early check in. The apartment is in a really good location that I didn’t have to take public transport much! Although it’s a relatively small space for 2 pax, the apartment has everything you need and more 😊

A great little spot to stay that is super central! It was very clean, had a nice washer to use, and cozy.
The ceilings are quite low in a couple places (like above the toilet), so this may be a difficult spot to stay if you are very tall. We had a few head bonks haha.
But besides that it was a great place to stay!
Great stay in a great location! The host was very friendly and gave recommendations for the area. It was on the smaller side and up a lot of stairs, but very clean and perfect for 1-2 people

The apartment is perfect for two people, it is small and cosy, but has everything you need for a shorter stay. It is perfectly situated in the city, close to the city center and everything within walking distance. Sara is also very helpful and easy to contact.

The place was wonderful. The location is the best you can have in Madrid. The house was super clean. Sara was very responsive and helped us with a lot rocommendations.
Will come back for sure!

This place was perfect for our stay in Madrid. It is just 2 minutes from the metro and walkable distance to so many great restaurants and shopping areas. The kitchen has everything you would need, the bed was really comfortable. The Bathroom was clean. The AC worked perfectly.  The one thing was the going up the stairs with our luggage but that was on us.  Just something to consider.  Sara was super friendly and gave us great recommendations. She made sure we had everything we needed. I recommend this stay.
The flat was in a perfect location. The area felt very safe and was a short walk to the best of what Madrid has to offer!

Clean apartment that is the perfect size for 2 people who are staying in Madrid for a few nights. The place was very close to the Metro and within easy walking distance of great restaurants and many of Madrid's historic sites and parks. The host also provided an extensive list of recommendations, two of which we tried and were extremely glad we went!! Great washer, hanging space, and locked safe. We would have appreciated more towels, paper products, and soap. The apartment would be inconvenient for people taller than 6 ft due to the ceilings. Overall, we were happy to stay at Sara's place and very satisfied with all of the communication with the host!

Clean and cute apartment with everything you need for a short visit to Madrid. Only one stop to the city center by metro or less than 10 minutes on foot. The host was very kind, as she allowed us to check in before the scheduled time and she also allowed us to leave our suitcases in the apartment until late afternoon, as we had a late evening flight back home.
We highly recommend this place for a short city break in Madrid:)

We loved our stay here! Sara was very responsive and helpful when we had questions. The unit is small, but very cozy, well decorated, and had everything we need. We were within walking distance to central Madrid. The main downside was the noise - once people moved into the unit next door, we could hear their TV and full conversations through the wall. Even so, I would stay here again.

The Aparment is clean and cozy. This place is good for short stays. There is no lift so if you have heavy bags it can be complicated. Highly recommend if you are looking for a place to crash for 1-2 nights.

The apartment is very small but very cute, you have everything that you need if you’ll stay for some days in Madrid. The location could not be better! Everything that you want to see is in a walking distance. Totally recommended for a long weekend in the city b
Great stay in Madrid. Location was great as was tucked away from the city noise but super close walk to all that Madrid has to offer. Super responsive and helpful host as well!
Great location with the metro close by and landmarks within walkable distance. The Airbnb was one of the cleanest I’ve stayed at!
