We had a lovely stay at Sara’s place - great location and super quiet inside. One of the most comfortable beds I’ve ever laid in! Everything was exactly as listed, clean, and the coffee machine was a lovely touch. Thanks for having us :)

We had a great stay at Sara’s listing for the weekend. If you’re looking for a cozy and peaceful place to stay I’d highly recommend. Sara did a great job hosting us, being flexible with check-in hours and responding quickly when we had questions. Overall a great value and truly memorable experience!
Very good place for short stays. The neighborhood is ok but not great. Far from the subway and big commercial centers.
Great apartment. Ideal for 1-2 traveling and visiting Madrid in the center. Would definitely recommend it. Also Alice is a super nice host, who always answered our questions quickly

Our stay at this apartment was nice. The place was really clean and had most of requirement for a comfortable stay.
My only negative feedback would be the stay didn’t reflect the value of the property on reflection - it was quite far from the city, the place, although was nice was pretty basic and it was also really noisy at night time and early mornings - lots of lorries and deliveries outside the bedroom window. Other small annoyances such as requesting an iron multiples times but never receiving one - only a small issue but just add to the value for money aspect.
Really lovely apartment to stay in, very clean and had everything we needed! Alice also gave excellent and clear instructions and was on hand to help when we needed. Thank you!
Lively area and yet very quiet at night. Alice was very efficient in giving check in instructions.
Check in was very easy, nice one bedroom in a great area close to centro Madrid, walking distance, or easily accessible by public transportation. Highly recommend
very nice location, close to everywhere. the apartment was clean. the bed is comfortable, AC works good and silent. checkin very easy. can recommend this airbnb.
There are problems with discrimination because were we gay. Her maid lies, key doesn’t work. We no recomend this apartament.
I stayed 14 days and there was only two toilet papers also I just asked for 30 minutes late checkout and I really needed that but they strictly refused.
Everything went as expected. This was the second time I stayed at Waldorf Apartments and will definitely come back again!

We enjoyed our stay at Alice’s. The place was accurate to it’s description. The location was 10/10— very accesible to various metros and near supermarkets, coffee shops, and a park. Housekeeping (Raquel) was also very effective and warm. The hosts
answered all our questions right away and were helpful in giving information.
I'd definitely book again, the apartment was flawless,  the service was friendly and proactive and the value for money was amazing.
I have stayed at Alice’s apartments a few times now. It is on my top list of places to stay in Madrid. Always very clean and cozy.

Absolutely lovely! The place was clean beautiful and perfect for a holiday! Madrid streets are so beautiful to walk around! The park was around the corner, great to go in there! Lots of restaurants and really good food! I will stay again! Host was always great and helpful in every way! I 100% recommend this place!
The lofts are very cozy and look exactly like the pictures. The place is close to two metro stations and the neighborhood is pretty safe

Perfect location for a stay in Madrid, the center can be accessed with different types of public transportation. Near the apartment is a park where you can go running or do some other sports. All in all I can recommend this 100%

I had a wonderful stay at Alice’s apartment. She was always quick to respond to any questions or concerns I had. The apartment is so clean, in a great location and check in was very easy. I would love to come back!

I had an awesome stay at Alice’s! The apartment was very clean, spacious, and secure. Alice was very helpful and responsive with all requests or questions. I give this experience a 5 out of 5 stars! Thank you Alice for letting us stay over!

It's been truly convenient  joyful and definitely a great experience staying in Malasana neighborhood. It makes our trip in Madrid a really memorable one as we truly experienced like the locals. We wish to come back soon.
Really good location close to the Metro and bars, restaurants and shops. Great communication when we had any issues and arranged a taxi to the airport for us. Would stay again!

Our stay here was wonderful. The apartment is beautiful and very clean. We found the location to be great for our stay. We were well taken care of by the host, and their communication was superb. Fantastic stay all around, highly reccomend.
Great appartment and easy communication with Andrea! Let me check in an hour early, place was very clean, Netflix was a big bonus. Location very central - recommend!

Andrea’s place was very clean, tidy and comfortable. Good location, walking distance to everywhere !
Really enjoyed our stay and convenient pick up at the airport organised by the host / thanks!!

Very tidy and lovely AirBnb apartment equipped with everything you need. A very comfortable bed! Andrea is a great host and there when you need her. It’s in a great location, close to metro, restaurants and shops. It’s a perfect size for a couple looking to getaway. We had a great stay! Thank you!

The place is comfortable and comes as pictured. I stayed for two weeks and would have liked the cutlery/dishes to be a little more flushed out. A few more hangers in the closet would be nice as well. On that note, a backup set of bed linens would be a nice courtesy to leave for those staying for a while. You will likely enjoy your stay at this well kept, cute unit.
Andrea was really helpful, everything was as described and location is great. Would stay here again.

The apartment is really beautiful, just as in the pictures, a lot of sunlight coming thru the balcony doors. The location is amazing, you can feel the City vibe just stepping out to the balcony or to the street, very close to good restaurants and bars. I truly recommend this place, and the host was very helpful and communicative.

Perfectly located beautiful apartment.
Was very happy with it. And highly recommend it.

The apartment is very pretty and the location is perfect.
Easy and great communication with Andrea.
Very recommended!

The room description is accurate, the location is convenient even if not in the downtown area. You can go to the city center easily by metro or bus.
The pets were very cute and friendly and the hosts very friendly and helpful too.

Virginia’s place is in a great location and very comfortable and clean. She was nice enough to deliver us detergent when we hadn’t brought any, although it turned out the washing machine was broken during our one night stay.
All in all, next level hospitality and great location!
Virginia was a wonderful host and we very much enjoyed the space! Several great restaurants, shops and public transportation in the area.

This was a very comfortable place in a good location.    A nearby metro stop provided easy access to the rest of the city.    Plenty of cafes and restaurants were in the area. Virginia made the check-in process easy and quickly responded to the few questions we had.
She was an amazing host . The unit is clean and spacious , very well located . So close to everything

beautiful place thank you so much virginia for the hospitality and warm
welcome, a 5 start coming your way
Wonderful! Virginia was a fantastic host. Responsive and really friendly. Makes you feel right at home. The place is ideally located near the metro station so you can reach any place quickly.

Beautiful apartment with easy Check-in.  Virginia met us to show us the place and she was very lovely.  It was very clean and had modern features.  Only a 5 minute walk to tbe Metro that takes you straight to the center. I would definitely come back.

Great little place close to the Metro and shops in a quiet side street. We arrived a lot earlier than the online check-in time. Virginia was kind enough to greet us and let us in the apartment earlier so that we didn't miss too much of the sporting event we had come to see.
Thanks once again for your hospitality Virginia!

Great place to stay. Simple, clean accommodation. Lovely host who is very responsive and helpful.
Close to the airport, lots of restaurants very close by.
Would definitely stay again!!
Perfect place for a couple nights. Stayed here for one night after traveling elsewhere in Madrid/Spain due to proximity to airport which was a perfect plan.
Excellent value for money.  Comfortable apartment in convenient neighbourhood, with good transport links.  Virginia was lovely and helpful.

Virginia is an incredible host who made my Madrid trip truly special. Her warm welcome set the perfect tone. She’s an outstanding communicator, always quick to respond and incredibly helpful with thoughtful recommendations for local restaurants and sights. The house was impeccably clean, beautifully decorated, and had a cozy, welcoming vibe that made it feel like a true home. Everything was perfectly organized, from the well-equipped kitchen to the comfortable beds, ensuring a delightful stay.

Stayed here for 3 weeks while I was searching for a place to move to permanently in Madrid.
The neighborhood is great - lots of bars and restaurants just around the corner. The area has 3-4 metro stops, connecting you to different lines, so the area is great.
The apartment is a bit small, but I guess it's pretty normal for the center of Madrid. It had everything I needed - washing machine, dishwasher, airco and heating working very well, a great shower. The kitchen was pretty well equipped as well, so it was all great.
The big tv was also a plus, although you can't directly connect it to Netflix, but you can use an HDMI cable and connect another device.
The apartment is on the 6th floor, interior views, which also makes it very quiet. No worries, there's an elevator! Definitely recommend this place.
Marta's home was lovely, although a bit smaller than I expected. I was big enough for the three of us with the sleeper sofa, but it was a bit tight. The decor and space were homey and comfortable.
Great place, would definitely recommend. Stylish renovated place at a great location. Works good for home office as well due to the desk and good WiFi.

Nice apartment in a great location, definitely recommended. Clean, spacious, quiet, renovated place with stylish decoration. Very easy to communicate with Marta and the staff via WhatsApp to coordinate entrance. Lot's of cafes, little bars and restaurants around, and close to several metro stations. Excellent WiFi for home office.

Lovely and comfortable apartment. We had an amazing time here. It had everything we needed and we got to meet Marta who did a quick tour of the apartment so we knew where to find everything and how everything worked. This place is near bus and metro stops so it's pretty easy to get anywhere. The neighbourhood is very quiet and safe and you have plenty of restaurants, coffee shops, markets, and shops nearby. The lift is quite small so keep that in mind if you have a lot of luggage. You'll be in touch with Mint Stay for anything you need. The communication was very quick and efficient and the check-in and check-out process was pretty seamless.
We had a lovely stay there! Thank you so much!
Great location with supermarkets, bars and restaurants nearby. The place is very well equipped. Highly recommended.

The apartment provided us with everything we needed during our stay. The neighbourhood is lovely with various little shops and restaurants.
The host kept us well informed about check in and check out. We were able to ask questions during our stay and received a speedy reply.
my wife and I had a great time during the 3 weeks we stayed here. The place is clean and modern and it's in a great location. Lots of very good little restaurants and bars around.
This flat is perfectly located for the bars and restaurants on Calle Ponzano, and is very close to metro links too. The setup was great for working remotely, and the hosts very super responsive.
This Airbnb is such an amazing location, and the check-in process was very smooth. This is outside of the unit's control, but it was a little loud with construction.
Great location in Madrid, host was always very responsive and provided clear instructions.  Also place was very well maintained and clean.  Would not hesitate to stay there again.
Nicely updated apartment in a great location. It was very comfortable for a family of 7.

First of all the appartement is amazing. As big and as beautiful as the photos, large and comfortable. The decoration is pretty too! The appartement is in a good place too, close to restaurants, supermarket and shopping!
In addition, Emilio is such a great host, arranging, nice, and has a good reactivity.
Don’t hesitate to take this apartment

We stayed at the apartment with a group of nine women and it worked out perfectly. The apartment is ideally situated to explore different areas of Madrid on foot, but is also just next to metro station Tirso de Molina if you want to use public transport. The apartment is just as beautiful as the pictures show and there weren't any negative sides. Even with nine women in the apartment it was very quiet. Communicating with Emilio went smoothly and he gave us a lot of tips for restaurants and rooftop bars. I would certainly recommend using this apartment as a fall out place to discover the lovely city of Madrid.
Great apartment in a great location. Emi was a really good host and responded to any questions we had immediately

We loved this apartment , plenty of space , terrific air conditioning , very clean,  and the host was very accommodating with check-in and checkout. We will definitely consider staying here again when we return to Madrid!!
Large, clean, and in a great location. Awesome stay. The A/C was perfectly adequate even in the middle of the heatwave and everything worked as expected. Would love to stay here again.

Over all we really enjoyed Emilio's place! We got lucky finding this place just a couple weeks before heading on vacation after the other place we had rented canceled on us. Maybe a blessing, as this place was pretty awesome! Ton's of space compared to the other apartments we stayed at while in Spain. Very nicely decorated, and you can't beat the close location to the subway, and lots of food options. We only had one small hiccup with the water heater not working at one point, but he was quick to get some one out to fix it so we had hot water when we got back. Over all, great place!!!

This was my second time in Madrid and staying at one of Emilio’s properties again. The host was extremely responsive and made check in easy. The Airbnb was in a prime location and either walking distance or a quick cab ride away. Would definitely stay here again!
Amazing location, beautiful apartment, exactly like the photographs. We were 8 girls sharing and there was plenty of room.

Emi was very responsive , very considerate & flexible . Unfortunately, my niece wasn’t feeling well, Emi allowed us to check out later. The place was immaculate, perfect for a big family w/ the number of rooms available! Truly enjoyed our stay, we love the fact that we were able to walk to shopping areas, restaurants &  other landmarks! Highly recommend it & definitely rent it again!

Beautiful home, I thought it was a terrific location. The air conditioning worked fantastically. Emilio was super responsive and we got to check in a little bit early. I cannot say enough about this Airbnb, and would not hesitate to stay again and again!

This apartment in Madrid is big, with 4 rooms, and a large social area. All areas have A/C except 1 room that is adjacent to the social area and gets some A/C from there. Location is close to touristy areas, but apartment is silent at night.  Place is clean, but furniture is worn. In general a good stay.

Emilio's place was great! Clean, spacious, and close to lots of things. Also had great Metro access. I had a little trouble with the app to get inside — this didn't impact our check-in — but Emilio was very patient and helpful. Checkout was a breeze.
The kitchen was clean and supermarkets were right nearby for us to buy what we needed.

Lovely apartment. Spacious for our family of 8. Had difficulty with the air conditioning although it was user error and quickly rectified after communication with the host. Great location to tapa restaurants and sites. Highly recommend.
It was a very nice to stay! Very clean and comfortable and pretty, quiet neighbourhood, and a great view.

The pictures on Airbnb don’t do this apartment Justice!! This apartment is spacious, bright, clean and REALLY beautiful! The price is SO WORTH this stay! If we are ever in Madrid again, we will definitely be staying at María Jose’s apartment. So much better than we could have ever expected! María José is an excellent host with a beautiful property… we highly recommend any group or family traveling to Madrid to stay here!!

Simple, clean and satisfactory apartment well situated for a short bus or metro ride into the city centre. As two friends, we really appreciated not only our own bedrooms but also our own bathrooms making our stay really practical. Merci Maria José.

The apartment is extremely spacious, clean, comfortable and very well situated near the center of Madrid. The bathrooms and bedrooms contain everything you will need and are very comfortable. I highly recommend the apt and would rent again.

The place is amazing, right in the middle of one of the best areas of Madrid. Clean and cosy, beautiful terrace, you feel like in a dream. Eduardo was perfect and also responded immediately to any query or request from our side. Definitively the place to stay if you come to Madrid!

This is a wonderful wonderful apartment, it's bright and spacious. As for the pictures it's full of quirky things, it's the house of an artist and you can tell.   It has eveything you need and in a great location to discover amazing Madrid. We were there during the Xmas holidays and so we used the fireplace which was really lovely, cosy and warm. The bath tab is not suitable for two people as it is too small  but it is great for one person.  We highly recommand Eduardo's place to anyone wanting to visit this city. 5 stars *****

A special place with a lot of character and attention to detail.
The terrace is just amazing, offering privacy and a warm evening atmosphere. It makes you forget that you are in the middle of all the buzz in Madrid.

This place was the best Airbnb I’ve ever been too! I loved the area. There was a Mercado around the corner and I didn’t see any tourists but it had great restaurants and all
You would
Need. There are also metro stations and scooters a couple blocks away, with a fifteen minute commute to the center of things. Roni was a wonderful
Hostess and communicated quickly and recommended restaurants and even a masseuse . The apartment is gorgeous with her original Artwork all around making you feel like you are in a museum while
Also having the feel Of a well
Loved place where you can relax on comfortable couches, beds and a balcony. There was cross ventilation , quiet and even a bathtub with a window on top
Of it. I can’t recommend this place enough. I would definitely get this space again the next time I am in Madrid !

We just finished a 5 night stay at Roni's place and absolutely loved everything about it.
The location is ideal, in the heart of Chamberi, with coffee shops, bakeries, supermarkets, and restaurants (including the must try Peppe Fusco) all within a short walk.
The place itself has a wonderful open air feel to it, with a loft (that my teenage daughter loved), and outdoor rooftop patio that we spent all of our mornings and late evenings.
The place is probably ideally suited to either a couple of a family with smaller children.
Roni was incredible responsive to our needs. We had an unusual circumstance and she was able to accommodate us. The neighborhood is quite and lovely. it's a quick taxi ride away from all the action.

Roni’s place was absolutely lovely and was in an excellent location. Roni was very responsive. We had a bit of a challenge getting into the apartment, as it seemed like Evelyn (the person who met us) couldn’t hear the buzzer and took a while to come downstairs to let us in (we had to ask Roni a few times to tell her to come down). The place was accurately described and beautifully decorated, with lots of Roni’s own art on display. There is some room for improvement in terms of the cleanliness, but overall it was alright. Would definitely stay there again.
We loved staying here! Amazing space and patio - we will be back! Great communication as well - thank you!

Look no further, you have just found a very special gem in the heart of Madrid!  This Penthouse is extra special, filled with light, art, and special touches.  Roni, the host, is so friendly and responsive.  We hope to visit again one day!

Roni is a fine and responsive host. A great and understated feature is a sixth floor furnished open-air patio with a dining table and chairs and comfortable seating. Within two minutes of the apartment there are two full grocery stores. There are three excellent pastry shops nearly at the front door.
The nearest Metro station is a five-minute walk. It connects quickly to Madrid’s great museums. The neighborhood is residential but with all the commerce one would want to find.

A spectacular penthouse in a great neighborhood of Madrid. We stayed here to visit our daughter studying abroad in a program about a 20 minute walk from the apartment. It was perfect and even better than the photos!  The amenities are upscale and the art is whimsical and adds color and flare.  A great place for a couple or small family to stay for the week. I would stay again in a heartbeat.

Roni's place was absolutely perfect for our two week stay in Madrid. Plenty of space for our family, including loft area for teenage boy and private bedroom for tween girl.  Had everything we needed to feel at home - invaluable washer and dryer, all the needed kitchen supplies to enjoy dinner on the lovely terrace, and perfect location to grocery stores, bakeries, and metro stops.  We would love to come back someday!

We had a wonderful 5 night stay at the flat and would definitely stay again / recommend. The flat had everything we possibly needed. It was slightly more open plan than expected but was still cosy and very spacious for 3 people. Roni was very responsive and lovely to speak to, making the whole trip very easy :)

This place is an absolute gem! Right in the centre of one of the city’s most popular and most beautiful districts with great transport links. The apartment is stylish and impeccably clean and Jose made us feel incredibly welcome. Would recommend tenfold!

This appartment is an absolute gem.  It's very clean and stylish. The bed is very comfortable. The neighborhood is very nice, with lots of tapas and restaurants to choose from. Will definitely come back on my next trip to Madrid!

Excellent location in a lovely neighbourhood surrounded by rooftop bars and spots to grab tapas. Short walk away from La Latina metro station or bus stops. The room was cosy and just big enough for both of us to be comfortable. We spend most of the day out and about, so it was great to have a comfortable and safe place to sleep when we got back. Jose was very helpful!
This is a fantastic little apartment. The location was perfect, so close to everything and loads of nice restaurants. We would definitely stay here again 🙂

A lovely place in a wonderful location, beautifully decorated and impeccably clean. All the little touches really made it a special stay - there were tea cups and bags waiting for us when we arrived, a couple of coffee pods for the Nespresso machine, folded towels & spare essentials I’d usually expect to have to buy for myself. The bed was so comfortable.
I’d recommend this place to anyone!

Excellent stay. Safe and clean area of Madrid, close to everything. Perfect for your first stay especially if you want to be further from tourist traps but still close enough to the center not to walk far. Locals were super friendly in the area. The studio was clean and decorated so nicely! Had a minor issue with the hot water and Jose responded quickly to help out. Would love to stay again!

Jose's place was in a great location! There was a bunch of things to do in the area and it was very walkable. Unfortunately, the air conditioning and toaster did not work. I reached out to Jose but his instructions did not help to resolve the problems. Overall great price and location!
Great for a short stay, was exactly what we needed. Looked cute and felt very safe. Had a lovely time!

Cozy apartment, convenient check-in and pretty close to a supermarket
The apartment is adjacent to a bar, so it can be noisy at night, but that didn't bother us
Great location with easy access to metro, restaurants and anything you need. Clean and cosy apartment too. Highly recommended!

Such a stylish studio, very comfortable and clean. Looks just like the pictures. Nice natural light during the day but street light came through the windows at night. No problem if you have an eye mask. Noisy at night due to proximity to the street and the wonderful Madrid nightlife but we expected this. Just be aware. Great location, close to lots of great bars and restaurants and we were able to walk anywhere else. Would recommend.

Jose was a great host and let me drop my suitcase off in advance of the normal check-in time so I could explore the city without it while I waited. The space was beautiful and clean. Within walking distance to the great Sunday market in La Latina, and also various sites in the center of the city. Highly recommended! Thanks, Jose!

Everything functioned well! It was very pleasant that Jose met us in person even if we arrived at 1 am. Communication was good and Jose’s place was very freshly decorated and furnished. The location is very central and there are tons of restaurants close by. I can recommend this Airbnb for other couple travellers.

Hi, the location is perfect. The apartment was ok.
However, the host was not very interested in helping us in any way. For example, the host lives in the apartment next door, we kindly ask him if he would consider keeping our luggage for a few hours for us. He refused. We ended walking a few kilometres (some of it uphill) with our luggage, to finally find a location with “City lockers”..,.
Good thing we were able to manage on our own!
Again, location is ok and so is the apartment…..
Nice apartment in a great area. It’s a very turbulent street with bars which can give a lot of noise during the night.
The washroom is INSIDE the room, no seperation at all and the room isnt ventilated at all, so therefore it stinks and gets stuffy inside.

The apartment was great for a couple. It's small but cozy and neighborhood was amazing and close to a lot of main touristic points in Madrid.
The host was always available to answer our questions and was really quick in response.
We super recommend this apartment!

This place is great! Very well located, super clean and modern. This is an excellent choice if you want to stay in Madrid.
It’s a ground level, so expect some street noise.
I would definitely recommend this place and stay here again next time in Madrid.
Clean, comfortable, cozy, and close to food and other attractions. The neighborhood can get a bit loud, but with earplugs I was fine.

We had been a very nice trip in Madrid, your appartment was great and the location was perfect, thanks for everything !
We recommend your Air BnB 🤩💯
Wonderful little apartment in a great location. Jose was super helpful and checkin was painless. Such a perfect sanctuary, so clean and cool, the perfect escape from the summer heat!

The location of this Airbnb was spectacular. You are in the center of Madrid, access to amazing restaurants, access to different form of transportations which was amazing ! The Airbnb was extremely cleaned and offered amazing things including water & coffee. Communicating with Jose was amazing, fast response time and always willing to answer any questions. Truly amazing Airbnb, I would definitely return and recommend this Airbnb.

Jose was great and clear with instructions to check in. Really loved the place as it was walkable to many restaurants and Plaza Mayor. Loved peaceful vibe of this place. The interior design super aesthetic described same as pictures! Would definitely stay here again.
Right in the heart of the nightlife area. Gets very noisy at night but great location. You can walk almost to every location in the city centre.
Great place to stay in Madrid. Almost everything is walking distance. The apartment is so nice and clean. A perfect getaway!

This cool room was awesome! Fun decoration, clean, spacious, everything you needed, all in a fabulous, buzzing location. You'd be happy to live in this accommodation! Access was easy, by key pads, Jose gave timely, clear instructions. Plenty to do, see, walk, buy, eat and drink. Mini mart 5 min walk away, close to the metro.
Great place, nice and clean with responsive host. Place is in a great location just note it is in a bustling area so lots of noise at night.

Just perfect for what we need, close by to the busy area and and quiet during the sleeping hours.
Linen smell of softener, really cleaned and spotless place.
Jose is super quick communicating
Apartment was very cold and there was quite a lot of noise at night but fine if you are a deep sleeper, location was perfect

Jose war very helpful during all times and responded very quickly. We had a problem with the water in the bathroom, but Jose organized a plumber while we weren't home at the same day and when we returned everything was fixed.
The place is amazing. It is really close to the gran via and is in front of a train station!
The location is great but make sure you don’t have scaffolding and signs covering up the balcony like we did during the Day of the Dead week(November 1). Nice place and great communication.

A wonderful place for four gals to enjoy several days in Madrid. Within walking distance of everything we wanted to see. The Palace, Parada Museum, Retiro Park, Botanical Gardens and lots of fabulous restaurants. Definitely would stay there again.

Lovely apartment, ideally located in the centre of Madrid. Cosy warm during our visit, great restaurants nearby. Great communication from the hosts. Well recommended as a base to explore beautiful Madrid.

The place has a great location and access to public transportation. The flat is comfortable, and rooms are quiet despite being in a busy area. The team managing the property is responsive and helpful. There’s a cash-only fee for late check-in after 21:00 which I found a bit excessive.

The host was extremely responsive and helpful. The location is very centralized so you can walk to pretty much everything you need (Shopping, restaurants, gran via..... Everything else is less than a 10 minute cab ride. the apartment is very nice and cozy. We would eat breakfast in the plaza downstairs every morning. If you are from USA remember everything in Spain is a bit smaller but the apartment is extremely functional and well laid out. I recommend it 100%. This apartment is a gem.

If you’re looking for a clean, stylish, quiet, yet centrally located place to stay in Madrid, stop now and book this apartment. Some of our favorite things include: newly renovated and modern place with everything you need for a city stay, conveniently located to metro so getting around Madrid is a breeze and delightfully responsive and helpful hosts. The huge bonus? A dryer! We’ve been traveling for a while and we’re so grateful for a chance to wash and dry all our clothes, even in the winter when it can be cold and damp.  Truthfully, we were sad to go. Oh, and there’s a great pastry shop right around the corner! Again, book this place, you’ll be glad you did.

Convenient location and clean apartment. Our host was very communicative, accommodating and offered excellent advice for the neighborhood and traveling around. We recommend and would certainly stay here again!

the host is very communicative and the apartment is in a good location, close to the metro and there are lots of restaurants/shops around. having a washing machine etc was so useful. our host made the stay very pleasant and I appreciated all the little touches.
The great things about the apartment were close to the metro,  close to the airport and few supermarkets bear by.

We stayed here with 2 young kids at this lovely 2 bedroom apartment. Host communicated well, was waiting for us upon arrival, brought items that were damaged/missing from the unit in 2 days, and made our stay comfortable.
The unit is literally a 2-minute walk to the Metro (subway) station and conveniently gets you to downtown Madrid in about 30 minutes. 2 supermarkets and multiple fruits/vegetables stands within 5 minutes of walking. We had meals at 3 lovely neighborhood restaurants and they were the best ones out of all of our Madrid meals in terms of taste and value.
As we have a crawling baby, we mopped the floor upon entry and we were satisfied with the cleanliness of the floor.
We really enjoyed our stay and would stay again if we were to choose again.

The apartment was as described and the neighborhood was actually nicer than we expected. Lots of good places within walking distance and very well-connected. Gaby was also flexible with the check-in time, which was very helpful.

We had a great time here, it was perfectly located for us, close to the metro and easy to navigate. The host was helpful from start to finish and we couldn't have asked for more really! I travelled with two others and we have all said how good it was! Very happy we booked this place

Lovely apartment very well located and easy to access the rest of Madrid from here.
Hosts were so responsive throughout the stay. Very easy to deal with and I would love to come back!

Great apartment in a safe quiet area. 5 min walk two metro stations.  Metro line is the same line of most tourist attractions - 10 min ride to Sol/Gran Via - and major renfe stations.  The apartment itself close to a few super markets and shops, very modern and cozy.  Host very attentive and responds/comes if needed.  Overall great experience and will be back!

It was extremely nice. Not just the place was great for me and my family, the host was always super helpful,  dedicated and cared a lot about our stay, which made all the difference. When we asked her for help, she always responded promptly, even with tips about places to visit.
Nice and clean apartment, fully equipped. Close to metro. Maria is a great host, communication was always on a timely manner. Easy checking in and out.
Stayed at Maria’s place for a night before heading to the airport. It was clean and a perfect location for that. Taxi to the airport is very convenient.
The apartment was nice and convenient to the airport. However, location didn’t have much to do.
The three of us had a great time at Maria's place. It was exactly as described - very cost and comfortable. I would recommend to other travellers as well. :)

Super clean and great spot! I stayed there with my partner a day before we were leaving Madrid and it was perfect! Right near the airport. The host was also very friendly and responsive as well. Definitely recommend!
Great location, lots of nearby food and store options, near the airport. The place is  cozy and has everything you need to make you feel at home. I would recommend!
So good aparment to stay in madrid near the airport and stadium of atlético madrid, everything was perfectly clean and comfortable

Great location and nice place to be at. Very comfortable place with spices and pots to use for cooking! Very near by grocery store (3-5min walk). The metro was a 7-10 min walk which is convenient to use to take you to center of Madrid!

This place is excellent! It was very clean and cozy, the bed was very comfortable (and I travel a lot, so I know). New kitchen with everything you might need. Lots of grocery shops in the area. Nice experience, definitely recommend it!

Great apartment, very well equipped with everything that is needed and great attention to detail. Very clean and comfortable. Plenty of options in the neighbourhood to eat and restock. Great neighbourhood and very close to the airport, stadium etc. and the metro is close by.

When we ordered the place I wrote that I'm coming with a baby under the age of a year and I didn't get any crib.
Could be I needed to ask the owners but we got to there very late in night.
Excellent communication with host. Truly appreciate being able to leave bags before check in. Cleanliness was great. Love the safe neighborhood. Overall fantastic experience. We will stay here again
Perfect place to stay before a flight or after arriving to Madrid!!! Great location, super clean and really responsive hosts. Thank you for the great stay and hope to be back again soon 😁

This is a real gem - very cosy, beautiful, clean apartment. In a great location, central but away from the noise and crowds, was very good for us to walk and explore the city from here. Everything in the apartment is exactly like in the photos, all details are very well thought and you have everything you need for a comfortable stay - there are enough plates, glasses, cups, pots, salt and pepper and oil. A coffee machine and a juice maker. I felt amazing here and it’s the third flat i stayed in Madrid and the best. The bed is great, qualitative kitchen appliances and a beautiful TV. Communication with Begoña was great and she gave is all the needed instructions. We will definitely return here next time. I warmly recommend this flat!

The apartment has the greatest view of the Gran Via; I felt like in the top of the world when stayed there. It was very neat and  the apartment has everything a traveler needs. Check in went smooth and  communication was always timely. I would enjoy staying here one more time!
Great location with a great view. Host is great and very responsive. Bed is very squeeky in the room, needs to be fixed. Hard to fall asleep. Everything else is great. Recommended!
Very nice location and view from the apartment. Additional fee on check-in I would've liked to have been included in the booking price, so no surprise fees after.
The location of the apartment is amazing. It’s a little noisy at night, but doable. The host is super helpful with everything. We enjoyed our stay.
Wonderful host. Easy to get in. And always someone at the door after hours. The view was fabulous. We would definitely stay there again.

Dan’s place is very nice, close to el matadero a cultural place I love to visit when I’m in Madrid. Also a new massive shopping mall with gorgeous views of the area. A huge park to hang out and walk around and very save. As other have described perfect location to move around town.

This was a great place to stay, perfect for 2 people, it has everything that you’ll need. The room was very clean and was set up very nicely, had a modern feel to it. Also great location, everything was close by and never felt unsafe here. The host was very accommodating with check-in times and always responded very quickly!
Would recommend this place for anyone looking to have a good and simple stay in Madrid!
The place was very pretty. The metro was about 10 min walking and the bus stop 2 min. A bit further from the bus than expected. Everything else was good.
Dans place in Madrid was perfect! Check in was extremely easy and efficient and his extra efforts towards amenities did not go unnoticed!
Spent a couple of days in Dan’s cosy place. Had eve try ting I needed it a the location was nice. Had a great time!

Angel’s place is very nice!
It felt comforting, stylish and was a great central location, highly recommend!

The communication was very easy and courteous, same as check in. Location is great - you can reach every important sight by foot, but still it is very quiet. Furniture and decoration is chosen with love for detail, great vibe and energy of the apartment and a very comfortable bed, you can really calm down, relax and get your rest in this flat!

The best place in Madrid! The apartment was spacious and serene. A plus was the terrance and the gorgeous views of the city. Location was perfect- really close to amazing restaurants, cafes, metro, sights, theater. RUN don't walk to Madrid if you wanna stay here. The best. The BEST. We will be coming back for sure!! :)

Fantastic location and super and secure apartment which met our expectations. Especially the outdoor terrace which was a great bonus given the lovely weather- although shared we had it to ourselves. Can’t recommended it highly enough for a mini break in Madrid.
Beautiful apartment! Even better in person, love the terrace and decor. It was also in a great location for exploring the city. Highly recommend!

A lovely apartment so unique and quirky, furnished with care and creativity. Warm and inviting also very quiet and peaceful after a day exploring.
Most of Madrids to do list are within walking distance 10-25 mins. Lots of nice places to eat and drink at the top of the street.
Manuel communicated well and Nina who met us was friendly and punctual.
I would definitely stay again on my next trip to Madrid
Wonderful location in the heart of Madrid right next to a Metro Station. Great apartment and would highly recommend, loved it!

This property is an absolute gem. if you want to stay somewhere unique and central in Madrid it's the perfect location. Everything you want and need is nearby. The bed is supremely comfy and the views are amazing. can't wait to come back.

This booking was AMAZING. The apartment is so nice, superbly decorated and you just feel like you’re home. The shared patio had comforting feel. We were truly blown away by this booking and would stay here again and again. My only complaint is that I didn’t realize we would have to meet someone to check in; so we had to plan arrival time instead of just showing up whenever (after checkin time).
The home is right next to Plaza de Tirso de Molina and a subway stop (1 min walk). It’s a vibrant square that has several restaurants, an outdoor market, and Spain’s Got Talent filming!!!!! You are 5 minutes walking from arguably the best restaurants in all of Madrid.
If you want to be in an easy to reach rest place that’s super close to all the action downtown, stay here.

Great stay! The apartment is lovely and has a fantastic terrace. Communication with the host was easy. I'd absolutely consider this place again when I'm back in Madrid.
Thanks!

Such a characterful place right in the middle of all the sites to see. Host was really helpful. We felt right at home....views are great. Note that there are steps from the lift to the door and a spiral staircase the the apartment to the bedroom so if you
stuggle with stairs then this may not be the place for you. I couldn't see from the photos but there is a door on the bathroom
Fabulous, clean apartment and well-decorated, includes all kitchen supplies and even laundry soap!
Great flat, good communication, good host, the flat met the expectations, central and with amenities around, it was a very pleasant stay. I recommend.

Clean & functional Airbnb
Kitchen appliances were new and bathroom was really nice. Studio apartment, train station and supermarket nearby.
Dot cafe on the street was great
Additional cleaning and service fees were a little pricey

Very responsive hosts- responded quickly to any questions or issues I had.
Very clean and modern space- as pictured.
Flawless check-in and check-out process.
Would stay again!

I had a good stay at Dan's apartment. It it well furnished and well located.
As mentioned in the comments, it is on the ground floor, street side, however the street is quiet so it was not a problem at all.

Very clean and cozy! Check in and communication was perfect and easy. We found the place very clean and tidy.
Be aware that is on the ground floor on the road so in the weekend got noisy.
The flat is really nice - clean and cozy. It may be a bit noisy from outside, but for me it's ok. Recommended.
The place is very pristine and has a washer machine which is gold for backpackers! 10/10

The appartment is well located, a 5 minutes walk from Metro Delicias.
It is well equipped, clean but I found it pretty noisy as it is on a ground floor over the street and you can hear people walking and talking as they pass through.
Was a bit chilly, although it does have heating floors and we had a very cold weather.
Good communication, clean, and all you need is in there.
All comes down to how much you pay and what you get for it. I do find it reasonable...
I think a sound proof windows/doors will help to make it a better place to stay.
Couch was broken on arrival, but I'm sure they will quickly fix that and it was not a big deal for me as I was all day out.
The apartment is clean and nice. You get all the necessary information you need in advance, so you won’t have any problems.
This is a very convenient stay! Very easy to find and access. Close to Matadero which  is the place of my convention. Easy to call an Uber to pick up and drop off.

Dan's place was clean, the bed comfortable. It ticked all the boxes,  including good location, but being on the ground floor,  right on the street, meant the windows had to be whitened for privacy, which it made us feel slightly cooped up in a container or revamped garage. A rug or two and a real plant might increase the feel of  homely warmth. But we enjoyed visiting Madrid and Dan s accommodation served as a useful practical base with good WiFi.
Great apartment with a nice neighborhood and a real good subway connection to any place in town.  Great hosting! Muchas Gracias Celise!!

We definitely high recommend the place and the host team (thank you Celis, it was real pleasure to stay there). From the beginning, communication was easy and quick. Even unexpected situation with the flat just before our arrival have been solved without any stress for us and I’m very grateful again. The apartment was very clean,has everything you need for short comfort stay, snacks in the fridge was very nice accent after long journey. Keep it up!
Check-in and out was like child’s play, quiet and safe location, everything like in a apartment’s specification.

First time to Madrid and this ended up being a perfect place well within healthy walking distance of Sol, the sites, and nice restaurants, shopping and a park to work out in. Was perfect for our needs.
The host went out of their way to accomodate above and beyond what was included with the location and made sure we had everything we needed for our week stay.
Would highly recommend if you like to live in the more 'local' area of Madrid within walking distance of everything you want to see in the city at a more affordable price.
Well done Miguel!
The place is very comfortable and big. The location is close to metro station and lot of good bakeries and quite cheap shops. I recommend this place for every tourist!

A great find! Very responsive and helpful host. Aircon was a life saver considering how hot it can get in Madrid. Close to public transport and the grocery store. Friendly neighbours as well. We loved our stay :)

Great location, great place. It’s right in the centre of EVERYTHING. I’d say the apartment is quite small, but very well equipped if you plan on cooking. We didn’t because there were so many restaurants around. Bear in mind, there are restaurants below you so you’ll always get a whiff of delicious food when you open the door. Might put some folks off but we loved it. Never had to use transportation (except to and from the airport) because everything is within walking distance. You might spend a bit more in this compared to other properties but you’ll save in the long run thanks to the location.
Loved this stay! Great location, right in Plaza Mayor. Can’t get better than that. All shops and restaurants only a few mins away. Highly recommend!

Great apartment, with the perfect location in Plaza Mayor.  Although the square is busy, you are not able to hear a thing.   Hosts were very helpful from offering a taxi from the airport to arranging the ride back for us as well. Highly recommend!

The apartment was located centrally within walking distance of all the major attractions. A very well equipped kitchen. Very comfortable bed with nice bed linen and good towels. Sofa bed rather hard to sit on. Decorative order not as new as in the photos. Nevertheless good value.

I had an amazing stay at this Airbnb! The location was perfect—central, convenient, and surrounded by great restaurants and attractions. The apartment itself felt like home, with a cozy atmosphere and thoughtful touches throughout. From the comfortable bed to the well-equipped kitchen, everything was just right. The host was also friendly and responsive, adding to the overall great experience. I highly recommend this place for anyone looking for a clean, comfortable, and well-located stay! Would definitely come back.
The room was as described in the picture, clean and tidy. Pura was helpful and a nice host.
That was nice to stay at Puras home, had everything we needed. Airco in the room saved us during our stay

Carlos' modern, comfortable and stylish apartment is in a trendy, diverse neighborhood that is steps away from the Lavapies and San Antoni metro stops. It is  close to numerous restaurants, clubs, theaters,  supermarkets. It's a real jewel to have found. The apartment appears as advertised;  it's  large, sparkling clean, sun- lit and on the ground floor. It is very comfortable for a family or couples. The neighborhood is al soeasy to navigate. Lina, our local host, is friendly, communicative and provided lots of information on where to eat, sights to visit, etc. We highly recommend this apartment as a home base while in Madrid. It is very close to the Prado, Reina Sofia, Thyssen, Retiro Park and a major train station, Atocha. It's a great deal. We thank our hosts for a splendid and cozy place to stay in Madrid!

The house was very compact and convenient. The shopping center and train station was near us and we had a really nice stay there. One thing can be the outside can be loud at night time and it’s scary go out late night.
Though, the host was really nice and she took care of us well. I recommend it to friends group who is planning to travel Madrid.
We loved the place! Walking distance from the center of Madrid and close to several metro stations. They were able to accommodate us very last minute and we really appreciated it! 10/10 stay

The apartment is absolutely perfect. The location is superb, the apartment is big and very well equipped. We could walk to all main attractions and the public transport is two step away. Marta is a great host. Communication could not be easier. Would love to come back.

The hosts were a pleasure to deal with, flexible with our check in request and communication.
The beds were very comfortable, clean and warm. Full stocked kitchen available for cooking whatever your heart desires. Location was good and within 15 minutes of many hot spots on the city including Puerta Del Sol, Plaza Mayor and the famous markets. There are several great cafes and restaurants in the immediate area as well as a cool art gallery across the street. The only thing I have to mention is the need for a bit of maintenance to some of the details in the apartment. As some reviews have stated, the shower door is a very different design and maybe very narrow for some people.

What a great find! Perfect location, restaurants,bars and museums were all within walking distance.
Fabulous apartment, very true to the photos with tasteful decor. It was very comfortable and well equipped, we had everything we needed.
Marta was a very good communicator and welcomed us warmly and answered our questions promptly. She sent clear instructions and entrance was very easy.
Would definitely stay here again.

Great hosts. Really responsive. The apartment was spacious, clean and just like described.
Marta kept in touch with us, even arranged an airport pick up which was so helpful.
The location worked for us, really close, walking distance to most places but metro line was a few minutes walk if we needed it.
I would recommend

What a great few days in Marta Y Arturo’s apartment. Easily walkable from the centre of Madrid and really easy to find from both Metro stops. An excellent host who is very proactive and helpful, always available to answer questions and give great advice. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay here!
Marta Y Arturo are grear hosts. Place is nice and comfy. Only thing I would recommend to guests is to bring earplugs for easy night as street can be noisy.

During our stay in Madrid, Carlos and all stuff was really friendly and warm. We haven't faced any problem during our check-in, they gave us great information about transportation & local activities. The home was exactly what we expected from the photos.
This is a beautiful accommodation in Lavapies that is adjacent to some lively streets, but is very quietly situated. The apartment was clean and nicely decorated, we liked it a lot! Thanks!

Lovely apartment in the heart of Madrid, walkable attractions in every direction you go!
Comfy and clean modern apartment with lovely bedrooms, a stunning bathroom and a lovely kitchen area where you can sit and have a few drinks on the table chairs whilst the tv is on playing whatever you like as it’s got YouTube and Netflix etc…
Hosts will contact you and give you any help you need thank you for a lovely stay!

Excellent apartment. Some incidental street noise. Very clean, well equipped and comfortable beds. Apartment door is electronic and this is the first time we had used one and so we found it a bit tricky at first - but ok once we got used to it! Fantastic location for museums and galleries.

Our stay at Pilar’s place was very good. The place is in a great location very close to the city center. It is newly renovated and very nice inside. It is in a safe and secure location. Fast response times communicating with pilaf. Only suggestion would be a code entry or lockbox for more flexible check in. All in all a great stay!

Pilar's apartment was the perfect studio apartment space for myself an girlfriend for our three night stay in Madrid. The apartment it self was immaculately presented, very clean with everything you need. The wifi is also excellent. We also felt the apartment was very safe and secure. The local area has an abundance of coffee shops and bars, and plenty of brilliant vintage clothes shops. It is also only a short walk to the central tourist area of Madrid and Tribunal metro station.
We had a small confusion with the check out time, so I would recommend contacting Pilar to confirm the check in and check out times. However, our host was very apologetic and all was sorted in the end. Thank you for our stay Pilar

Great location. You stay really in the center of night life. Same time apartment is quit in the middle of the building. Fast internet. Specious shower. Short walk to local market and supermarkets. Host helped us with earlier check it which was very nice. Fast response to the messages. Would definitely stay again.
Great flat! Very clean and super well located ;) perfect for a few days in the city center of Madrid
Had a great stay. Cozy space as shown in the photos. Very central location in Malasaña close to lots of various points of interest. Would stay again
Amazing host. Was a very enjoyable experience and she was super nice and responsive to all of my needs.

Pilar is a great host.  Her communication is top notch and I had a great stay in her airbnb.  The one thing I’d say is be aware of no central air conditioning because it does get slightly hot at times, but I was able to deal with it just fine.  Thanks again!

I most definitely enjoyed my stay here!  It is the perfect place for anyone that is coming to visit Madrid, as it is very close walking distance to many of the major areas of Madrid, and very close to the metro. I will stay here again if I visit Madrid!
Great stay. Pilar was very helpful and gave me some recommendations of things to do! Would definately stay again!

very well equipped and spotlessly clean.
the bed was comfortable.
It is rather dark because it is on the ground floor of an interior patio.
the wooden staircase in the patio makes it noisy.

The place was as described in Airb&b
The place is small but if good for 2 if you need a place to sleep and take a shower and leave the place
One important thing is that the president of the condominium stopped and told us that is illegal being there because that building doesn’t allow rent apartment by days. Like a hotel.
The rest the place is good if you want spent few days in Madrid
The space was clean and the ambiance was calm. It was nice and central with at least two metros nearby and lots of vintage shops and good restayrants nearby
Amazing location! Very clean, has all you need for a great stay. Very thoughtful and nice host.
I was on business trip. Pablo always willing to help in the process and make the stay unforgettable .... he is the host that runs the extra mile

This apartment is in the greatest location! A less than 20-minute walk to everything. The apartment was very clean, had extra trash bags and toilet paper and a great view of the Gran Via. No washer inside the apartment and the patio door was a bit hard to close.
Great location, attractive space with a nice view from the balcony. Serviceable kitchenette and small bathroom maximize the livable space.

Thank you for the stay. It was a great flat with an wonderful breathtaking view. The flat was very central, so we reached everything so fast and easy. Metro, Bus and by foot, all simple.
Pablo and his assistent were always available and very friendly.
The flat was clean and had everything we needed, but it was definitely too small for 4 women. I think for 2 people it would be perfect.

Cosy appartment in the heart of Madrid with an amazing view on to the Gran Via.
The host replies really fast and is very kind.
The check in was also super easy.

great location with nice views and a nice host. unfortunately the unit only had 1 bathroom in the unit and another one was on a separate floor, not a private bathroom in the unit. this was misleading in the ad as it is described as "1.5 bath"

great flat
2 spaces seperated for confort and chill
Pablo had a great and fast communication
late checkout Will be appreciate

Very great apartment with a stunning view over Madrid from the balcony.
Everything important was available and the owners are available 24/7.
Thanks for that!

Could have been great if not for a couple of things.
The doors to the terrace were not locking properly, so we got cold air coming in at night.
When you book you receive a long message, threatening to send images of the security cameras to the police if you have guests or make parties.
We wanted to rest and didn’t party, but we were woken up by their workers outside our door at 8 am. The least they can do is let us rest after they ask the same from us.
For the rest, the apartment is good and the location is great.

Good stay, incredible location, just worth mentioning that the apartment was much smaller than expected. Definitely doable for 4 people but would be best for 2. Bathroom is also very tight but shower is excellent and balcony has stunning overview of gran viá. 5 star service from the host!
Love this location so much, so many attractions and such easy check in. I’ll love to revisit one day.
Fabulous location, very clean with a lovely view of the Gran Vía. Pablo was very communicative and helpful.
Centrally located space with panoramic views of the city of Madrid. Walking distance from lots of restaurants, bars, museums and plazas.  Easy access and self check in.
In general, a good spot! Bathroom is quite little, but the rest is ok. Terrase is stunning! Would recommend for couples, or couples + kids

Excellent Location!! Very easy to locate the property and easy steps to follow to enter the apartment.
Our stay was fabulous.

It is an absolutely stunning view. It’s in a very convenient location right on gran via. keep in mind madrid is a busy city and gran via is a very busy street so if you are a light sleeper bring earplugs or headphones. I think this air bnb is perfect for 2 people, it on the smaller side so more than that might not be comfortable.

We visited from the USA.  Amazing location on the Grand Via.  One of the favorite parts of our trip was buying food at a grocery store around the corner and then enjoying a lazy breakfast on the terrace.  We enjoyed the red city bus tour which stops less than a block away.  Pablo provided great recommendations in the area.  We walked to pretty much anything we wanted to do on our short stay.  One of our more peaceful stays despite the central location in the city!  Thanks again, Pablo!
Apartment is exactly like the photos. Central location walkable to all tourist attractions . Outstanding view from balcony. Overall excellent stay. Would definitely recommend. Thank you.
Great location! loved the balcony and views. The place is cute and perfect for a stay in Madrid. Very close to everything!

The location alone makes this place a great experience. Everything was just as it should have been. Easy to find, easy check in, clean unit just as described. Especially great for singles or couples. Note: The bathroom is in the bedroom which might be a consideration for some travelers.
If I ever get back to Madrid, I will not hesitate to stay in Pablos place again. Gracias Pablo!
Incredible central location! Pablo is super communicative and helpful. Beautiful apartment. Will be sure to return!

Pablo's apartment exceeded my expectations! The view from the balcony was more than spectacular. the apartment was clean and beautifully furnished. Pablo was responsive and helpful. we had a wonderful stay. I highly recommend Pablo's apartment!

We really enjoyed staying at Pablo’s place.  The accommodations were comfortable and the balcony gave us a spectacular view!  It was in the heart of the central area of Madrid.  We would stay there again

We really enjoyed our stay at Pablo’s beautiful apartment. It was just as described and was nice to have a separate bedroom and living room - we had plenty of space! The view from the balcony was amazing, it was really cool to see Gran Via from above. The location was perfect for us - everything was walkable and it is in a very central location. Pablo was extremely helpful, we were able to bring our luggage early before check in and he sent us recommendations of things to do/places to eat and was very responsive and courteous. I would recommend this apartment to anyone who wants to stay in the heart of Madrid :)
Great location; in the center of Gran Via and close to everything. The toilet is a bit small but the terrace is really great.

We had a wonderful stay. The location was perfect for getting around on foot. Everything you need is close by. The terrace was beautiful and the views were amazing. Host was quick in communication and even accommodated an early check-in. The elevators were very convenient! If we ever find ourselves in Madrid again, we’d love to stay here a second time.

The view of this spot is like nothing I have seen! Wow! The balcony makes this place! Located right in dowtown Madrid you have the most beautiful views of the city! We got a bottle of wine to end our night after going to a flamenco performance and drank it on the balcony it was magical! The place is a studio apartment for reference, a little tight for 4 people in one bathroom but for a short trip it definitely works! Pablo also helped me out! I left my kindle and the cleaning service saved it and I was able to get it back! So thankful for that and thankful for this great stay!
This apartment is in a great location! It’s sooo cute and described accurately. Pablo was very accommodating and super helpful when it came to checking in, needing help, and checking out!

The apartment is in the best location. I’ve been to Madrid before and this is the best location. Perfect for two to three people. Walking distance to all of the places you must see in Madrid! Pablo and Endry are very responsive and ready to answer any questions. Thank you for everything!
Pablo was a great host, all the instructions were clear and he was very responsive. The apartment was in a great location and easily accessible to public transit.

Comfortable, clean, and in a great location! The bathroom is very small and doesn’t offer much privacy as it has a sliding frosted glass door, but if you’re comfortable with that, it’s a great value for the location.

Location is amazing! Really central and everything you could need is nearby. Checkin and entering the building is done by an app, which is cool and feels very secure. However, it feels a bit impersonal as no one is there to greet you. I would definitely come back!

It certainly has a beatiful view though it is super tiny. Probably it is typical of apartment size in this area. The host communiated well and we were able to store luggage. I understand the storage limitations inside the house but it will be great to know what is where. We first thought there was no plates or bowls but we found them later in the TV stand. We definitely enjoyed the patio in the evening drinking wine.
Needed a spot just for one night and this was a great spot. Clean, good price, good location. Check in is pretty easy once you download the app.
Suítes You was perfect for our short stay in Madrid. Central place. They were very supportive and helpful. Definitely made our trip a better experience :)
The Suites you staff is amazing. We really enjoyed our stay in Madrid. The location is perfect right next to the sol station. I would recommend to anyone visiting Madrid!
Great place. Just as described. Centrally located and great for getting around. Would definitely recommend.

This apartment was so comfortable and had everything we needed! Great central location around the corner from the metro and lots of Spanish restaurants and grocery stores. Emi and Al were extremely responsive and helpful with any questions we had. Would recommend to anyone for short or longer stays!

Emilio's place is right at the Plaza de España, PRIME location. The apartment is compact yet with everything. We requested a stay on the same date of arrival of Madrid during holiday season. Emi responded super quickly and was able to clean/prepare the apartment very nicely on time. His communication is very quick and efficient. Loved the stay and could recommend to singles or couples!

This place is perfect for a weekend trip! It is super central and walking distance to everything you want to visit :) Emilio is a very responsive host and there to answer all questions that you might have. The only recommendation points is that the airco is a bit weak and there are currently some constructions in the building at the entrance which start in the morning. Thanks a lot Emilio for this great stay!

The house is very nice and welcoming. Located in the center, convenient for getting around on foot and close to the metro. Tasteful furnishings, well-functioning heating, large bathroom complete with every comfort. The only flaw is the general cleaning could be improved and treated with more attention.

Very good communication, responds really fast and had great recommendations of bars and restaurants. The location is ideal, not too far from anything, we walked by foot everywhere! Just a couple of small details which could have improved is locating the apartment, as the entrance is not where you would initially think. Also, providing something small such as coffee pods or sugar etc. for arrival would have also been massively appreciated. Overall, very good place to stay and I’d recommend it, thanks Emi! ☺️

Perfectly located for the busy Gran Via, the elegant Plaza de Espana whilst offering a quiet apartment in the interior of the building. The host is always good and prompt with communication and the key collection service is superb. The apartment itself is wonderful, making it feel instantly like a home from home. Every room has its own door so you never feel like you’re in one space. A wonderful and pleasurable stay.

Good place to stay at. The check in is supersmooth and I like the use of codes to get in to the building and room. The common area is great because it gives a lot of possibilities for cooking etc, also its well equipped. The host is quick in answering through the app when help is needed. Windows with good sunlight intake. All in all I was satisfied and would most likely book again.
it's a nice place close to the center. The bed is a bit small for 2 people

The check-in was a bit confusing. The contact was super friendly and always accommodating.
The apartment is recommendable, also because there is a parking lot.
For a last minute trip, worked out perfectly and has all the amenities and very nice shared spaces . Only the gym area disappointed.

The good news: the water pressure was strong and the location is good. The rest: a/c didn’t work and was not fixed despite complaints.  Bathroom door didn’t close which is problematic when 2 people are sharing the room. Bright flashing light all night from the wifi on the wall.
Very expensive for what it is. The worst bed I have slept in. I woke up with back pain everyday. Very small. Noisy neighbours

I stayed two weeks for a business trip in the area and the place was perfect. great host, clear instructions, easy to find, spacious, clean and comfortable. much better and cheaper than the hotels in the area. I'll definitely come back next time

An oasis of peace, style and design which was heavenly after spending time in busy and wonderful Madrid. The owners have done an outstanding job in renovating and decorating the apartments, making it a very special home away from home. I will definitely book this place again.
Very nice apartment, decorated with a great taste and attention to detail. Great location. The apartment is very comfortable and we loved our stay.
This apartment is even better than the photos - it is perfectly located,  beautiful and spacious with everything you’d need. Wish we could have stayed longer!

Beautiful, cosy apartment and very nicely decorated .  Excellent location , walking distance to many restaurants, bars and all the main attractions in Madrid .  Very friendly and professional hosts .  Thank you very much for everything.

Fantastic location, access to all museums, and parks, sightseeing venues with plenty of dining options.
Gorgeous apartment, tasteful blend of modern design with North African accents, wonderful collection of books on design as a bonus!
Mimi, our host was super friendly and helpful- we enjoyed meeting her!

Loved this place. Excellent location right in the heart of things, while also being very peaceful and quiet. We’d been travelling for a few weeks, so really appreciated coming to a place with a well set up kitchen where we could cook for ourselves. We’d definitely come back here.

Solid 4.5. Great Location. Cool and spacious apartment for two.
Only drawback is that the layout is long and deep, which is great for sleep since the bedroom is in the interior. However, there's only one after-the-fact AC unit, which had a tough time pushing cool air to the back of the apartment. So, the bedroom would get stuffy. The workaround was to keep the AC unit in the front on high with the ceiling fans running to try to push cool air to the back of the apartment. Mildly successful. Place a small AC unit in the back of the apartment and it is a five star.

The apartment is beautiful.  I would guess it must be about 1000 square feet, with ceilings of at least 11 feet.   Note:  The bedroom will be a bit warm as the air conditioning unit is located on the other side of the apartment.

This apartment is an absolute gem in Madrid. Conveniently located in just minutes away from a huge variety of amazing restaurants and wine bars. The apartment itself is very spacious and has all the necessary amenities. Don’t look no further!

Great apartment! The location is amazing and the apartment is really charming. Easy to get in the building and there is a fast elevator. There was some construction in the lobby of the building that began at around 8am which we could hear from our apartment, but nothing too significant. The communication was great and they were very patient when we accidentally clogged the kitchen sink and sent someone to fix it (totally our fault, not theirs). The bed was very comfortable and the apartment was very spacious. The street can get a little noisy on the weekends, but the bedroom is located at the back of the apartment so it doesn't matter too much. We had a fantastic stay. The kitchen and washing machine were so convenient. Totally recommend this place!

The place is very beautiful, spacious and centrally located. It  is in a quiet neighborhood next to restaurants, shops, art museums and cultural attractions. The host is very responsive and I highly recommend.
Lily was an excellent host. She was very responsive and flexible. The apartment is charming and the location is priceless. Walk to three major museums and to the center of town.

Nice and cozy place in an old house very close to a big park, old town, and many little shops and cafes. Host was super nice and responsive, apartment looked very nice, had plenty of fresh towels, cutlery and other necessities. Maybe a touch too expensive, although we booked it only two days in advance. Recommend

We absolutely loved our stay at this beautiful apartment with fabulous interior design and artworks.  There were just so many comfortable places to sit in different rooms.  The beds were comfortable, the amenities generous and spotlessly clean.  The kitchen had everything we needed. Location was fantastic in a funky area full of cafes and food shops and near to the museums.  We walked everywhere and the little side streets were vibrant with shops and restaurants. Despite the lively atmosphere on the streets, the apartment was quiet at night.  Highly recommend this great apartment.

Great place, very comfortable and homey, good existing character with a nicely designed fitout and a well curated mix of interesting furniture, art, objects, books etc all in a fantastic location. Loved it.

This is probably one of the best Airbnbs we have ever stayed in. Hosted in a 19th apartment in an historic neighborhood, just across a convent. But with a wonderfully beautiful modern update. The layout feels so cozy, making it filled with light and warm. Very thoughtful and well designed without being cheesy or driven by how it will look in photos.
And I just loved the neighborhood. Streets filled with history, and super central if you want to just walk around Madrid.
And to top it off, the hosts went above and beyond: they provided us with a blender right as we were arriving, and were extremely accommodating and helpful. I’m surprised I noticed it’s rare these days to have a personal touch with the hosts. They were super warm.
Nice place.  Very comfortable and a superb location.  We enjoyed our week.  Thank you!

A really lovely apartment right in the heart of Las Letras - there is even a quotation from Fuenteovejuna right outside the door in the pavement! I loved the art and the furniture in the apartment and it has a good size kitchen and eating area. A great centre for a cultural and foodie break in Madrid.

Home away from home!
Beautiful appartement, a real homely feeling and very well equipped with all you need in the kitchen. We had an amazing time and felt very cosy.
Then only improvement to make are in the bedding. We both felt the bedding could be improved as they were not confortable, both the mattress and the pillows.
Loved this apartment. Very cozy and well furnished. Host was very accommodating. Breakfast on the balcony people watching was my favorite.

This is a wonderful apartment and wonderful hosts. Everything was easy and we really appreciated having such a comfortable and beautiful refuge during a very hot week in Madrid. Would stay here again for sure.

Great place, nice neighbourhood, walking distance from major museums & parks, bars & restaurants, welcoming & responsive hosts, well appointed, friendly vibe, good daylight & fresh air, feels like living in Madrid!
A very well located flat, perfect for a short stay in Madrid. Raul is helpful and responded quickly to our requests.

Beautiful place in an amazing location, walking distance from restaurants, bars & sight seeing. We had difficulty figuring out how to use the keys but Raul always answered the phone immediately and was a huge help! Would definitely stay here again

The Airbnb looks a little different as shown on the pictures, so don’t expect to much. But the location of the Airbnb is amazing!  There is a lot to do in the area and you can easily reach everything from here. We would recommend it for a short stay. We had some issues with our keys. It was not possible to open the main entrance with the keys we got. Every time we wanted to enter our Airbnb we had to call a phone number to get in. Raul did sadly not answer any of our massage. We were not able to reach anyone during our stay.
The apartment was very tidy and of good size for four people. We liked the neighborhood very much and there were many really good restaurants. We would certainly rent this place again.

The listing is exactly as described, clean and very close to the bars and restaurants of Malasaña. The Host is responsive and cooperative.
Highly recommended!
Great apartment in a lively neighborhood. Walkable to metro, plus many restaurants and shops. Would rent again.

Raul’s apartment is in a super spot in Malasana.  The place was clean and spacious and Raul was a responsive host. We would definitely stay again. Plaza de Olavide 10 minutes away is a gorgeous oval with plenty of bars and restaurants to choose from and enjoy a tinto de verano.
Raul’s apartment was perfect for our stay in Madrid. It’s gorgeous inside and the neighborhood has great restaurants, coffee, and bars all right there. Will definitely be back!
Raul's place is very well located in the center of Madrid, with tons of restaurants and activity around. The place was quiet and as in the photos. Raul was very responsive and friendly!

Raul was a great host and very responsive. My friend and I had been in Spain for a while and were at the end of our trip and just wanted to relax and chill out for the end of our trip. Raul’s place was very comfortable.
Everything at the apartment was fine, the bedrooms and bathrooms looked like the photos and matched the description. The location is great as well- I really loved this area.
The only reason why I gave 4 and not 5 stars was just that the furniture was a bit outdated - there were lots of stains all over the sofa. Also the floor was pretty dusty and there were some crumbs in the kitchen - this could have been cleaner / nicer.
However for comfort and location it was a good find.
