I would highly recommend anyone visiting the area to check out Raul’s listing. He was quick to respond to any question i had and actively looked to make sure our stay went well. The place was clean and spacious enough for two people. Our heat worked great as the city got cold at night. Central location to a lot of great restaurants and tourist attractions. We enjoyed our stay.

Overall, the place is good for the price. Raul instructions were clear. Apartment was clean and size decent. Had trouble getting in a couple of times, both our fault. Raul did answer quickly. However, don’t forget your keys! If the WiFi goes down at the apartment you won’t be able to get in until they come open the door. Area not the best and complex seems empty. If you need a good price go for it! If you want an easy experience maybe a hotel is better.

Raul’s place was lovely, in a great area and clean and tidy. I would say the only thing missing was a big mirror and maybe a bit of coffee in the cupboard but that didn’t stop us from having a great experience. Would definitely come back!
A very cozy beautiful home. Everything was clean, new beds and linens. Great taste in decor. Location is excellent. We were very happy and will recommend to friends.
Perfect location, check in quick and easy, the unit has all you need. 5 stars to this place!

We stayed at Raul's place in Madrid for 4 nights.  A beautiful building in a fantastic location.  The apartment was very basic, could have done with a few home comforts, but very clean.  The communication from Raul was fantastic - an excellent host.  I would have given it 5 stars if a) the was a full length mirror, b) there were more spaces, like shelves or hooks, to put things in the shower rooms, and c) if there was coffee and sugar in the kitchen.  Other than that, we very much enjoyed staying at Raul's apartment - thank you!
We had a few problems with the wifi but the host was always available and sorted it out very quickly and to our complete satisfaction

Raul’s apartment was perfect for our stay in Madrid. Clean and spacious with comfortable beds and great shower facilities. Communication with Raul was straightforward and the check in process was clear and simple. The apartment was really well located with metro stops and great bars, restaurants and shops nearby and Gran Via, Plaza Major a 20 minute walk away.

Great location- super clean and comfortable. Raul was easy to contact. Only problem we had was there were not enough linens, towels or pillows provided for all five of us- there was only enough for four. That made it a bit uncomfortable.
Beautiful apartment! We enjoyed every second of it. Very well located and the terrace is amazing! Highly recommended!
A great experience. Fantastic appartment, location and service from the host. Can strongly recommend it!

We had an absolutely wonderful stay at this beautiful apartment. The location was perfect, our host was communicative, the apartment was spotless (and totally charming with lots of whimsy!), and the rooftop deck an oasis. We’d definitely return.

Alicia was fantastic, met us as planned outside the apartment, the apartment itself was beautiful just as we had hoped for and the location was perfect, if your looking for a great stay in the beautiful city of Madrid we highly recommend Alicia’s apartment, thanks again
We had an amazing vacation in this unique and beautiful penthouse apartment- very spacious inside and the two rooftop terraces were perfect!

Alicia’s place was fantastic with a prime location and an awesome top floor patio with a great view. Only slightly annoying thing is that the breaker would trip and the water heater would not work; nothing a quick flip of the switch couldn’t fix. Well worth it overall!

The balcony is the highlight of this property! I also loved the vibe and decor. Alicia was very responsive & when we had a plumbing issue (common with a historic building), she was very helpful. The apartment is bright with great natural lighting. The location is good for walking to most typical tourist spots. It was actually surprisingly quiet for sleeping given being in the city. We enjoyed the apartment and would recommend.
Alicia was absolutely wonderful and gave us so much information. The unit was absolutely amazing!! Highly recommended.
Great location right in the center of the city! Many tourist attractions are at a walking distance. Clean and spacious
We loved the place and the interior layout.  Raúl is a lovely host.  I recommend this apartment to anyone who wants to visit the center of Madrid.

Raul apartment is in a great location, walking distance to Madrid main attractions. The apartment is well kept with high speed internet WiFi, A/C and a small balcony. We will recommend this apartment to our friends and family.

The apartment was super clean, specially the rooms and the bathrooms (the most important parts).
It has 3 small balconies which is always nice to have some fresh air.
The location is probably the best part, amazing location.
If I’m ever in Madrid I’ll stay here again for sure!

The place was clean and quiet.  Perfect location and a sanctuary after the hot Madrid summer days.  We enjoyed the space after long days exploring the city on foot-very walkable.  We would stay again.

Amazing apartment to visit an amazing city!! Almost all the attractions are walking distance! We had a great time, great location and definitely we will be back to Madrid soon, and hopefully with great Raul as our host!!

This place is a gem in every way. Raul could not have been more attentive. The unit is impeccable and has everything you need and more. The location could not have been better and is close to many sights including shopping, and great restaurants in the area. Very safe and friendly . I would 100% return and stay with this Airbnb in a future trip to Madrid.

A lovely place to stay and a really good location. The man on reception gave us some great recommendations and talked us through the best places to go in Madrid. We were also able to keep our luggage in a locker until the evening after we checked out. Overall a fantastic weekend in Madrid
very nice place. just be aware that because of it s central location, it can be slightly noisy, but the place is very nice

Very helpful and easy communication with reception staff, clean and modern room in a great location of Madrid - an easy walk to central landmarks such as Plaza Mayor and Puerto del Sol. I would recommend to a friend travelling to Spain on a budget!

Good locatio, near to museum del Prado and city centar, excellent metro conection for the airport.
I recommend everyone to choose this because they really provide comfortable accommodation. :)

Easy access location close to most points of interest in Madrid. The room and bathroom are as advertised in the pictures, clean and furbished/designed with contemporary taste. Would recommend for shorter stays (i.e. 2-3 days) rather than week-long holidays. The front desk team is very friendly and helpful. A complementary storage service for luggage is available prior/post check-in.

Beautiful place, very clean, close from museums, staff was amazingly friendly and helpful.
The only downside of it for me was the noise coming from the street. Otherwise it was perfect. I do recommend .

The room was exactly as pictured, clean and perfect for my stay. No complaints about that at all. They also provide a locker if you need to leave your stuff after checking in which is great. I would def stay here again. Only thing was that, I wasn't able to get in to the building because the door code was not working  and it was late at night. I contacted the number that was provided and no one got back to me until the next day. I was only able to get in because someone else came from the inside and opened the door. It would be great to have someone available to help 24/7. If the door was working, checkin would have been 5 stars! They have fixed it since.

Love this place so much
The soap I wish they sold separately 😭
This room is spacious with the added pullout couch. Going in and out is super seamless
Don’t hesitate to book here. It’s a perfect room, very clean and comfortable. Easy check in. Perfect location. Everything was amazing.
Perfect for our short one night stay in Madrid. Was conveniently located next to the main train station as well as an easy walk to all the main attractions.
Good location to acssess main spots. The bed and bedding were fantastic. Host is very kind and i really enjoyed staying except noise until dawn and  no refrigerator.
The room was very nice and clean. The self check-in system is convenient and the reception is always responsive whenever I contacted them by chat. I would like to visit again!

Uma House is a great little hotel with a perfect location right in the middle of Madrid!! Very friendly workers and complimentary coffee during your stay! Highly Recommended staying here while in Madrid.

This place is great - amazing location, big comfy bed and clean modern bathroom. Easy check in and they have free lockers where you can leave your stuff when you check out so that you can explore Madrid
Uma Suites is perfect! We loved our stay and would highly recommend! Location is the best in Madrid! It’s Cute, cozy, clean, easy communication.
The stay was okay, communication and check-in were perfect. However the place wasn’t as clean as in photos. Overall, a great choice for a one night stay.

Great stay at Uma Suites. We had the opportunity to store our luggage in the lockers both before and after our stay which was really helpful. The hosts are very nice and helped us with printing tickets. Would definitely recommend!
Great apartment with good and equipment, superb location and amazing views on the Palacio Real. We recommend the place and would stay again!

Alfonso is a very kind host, he encountered our requests and was every time responsive when we contaced him. The apartment was very clean and in a perfect location. Forniture and facilities are totally new. The view from the terrace is amasing, especially during the sunset time. When we can back, we will book again here!

Alfonso’s place location was great with the metro Santo Domingo and Plaza España just a couple steps away. Being at the Gran Via, you also have many options for food and entertainment.
Alfonso is a great great host. the apartment is more beautiful than in the pics, the views of the palace is mesmerizing. The balcony was excellent to enjoy the bottle of wine that Alfonso offered us. I totally recommend Alfonso's place. excellent communication, and responds to all the needs.

An absolute amazing apartment with an awesome (sunset) view and perfect location. The communication with the host was also flawless!
Really recommend staying in this apartment when going to Madrid!

This apartment is in a fabulous location, walkable to multiple metro stops and many interesting spots. We really appreciated Alfonso’s flexibility even as our train was delayed and resulted in a very late arrival.

I can’t say enough good things about Alfonso and this property. The view of the Royal Palace and the Royal Cathedral right off your balcony at sunset is spectacular.  Alfonzo was great with all communication and the apartment is very new and clean. It is very quiet even though you were right in the middle of all of the activity.

Great apartment located in the heart of Madrid.  The apartment was clean, modern and beautifully appointed. Both Alfonso and Goio were excellent hosts answering all of our questions and providing great recommendations.  The location was great, within walking distance to all the sites. Would definitely recommend!

Alfonso's apartment is fantastic. It's located in one of the busiest area's of Madrid -- quite "touristy" -- but that's actually perfect because it's an easy walk to so many gorgeous neighborhoods, museums, shops and more.
Our family of 5 stayed for three nights and had a simply wonderful time.
Thank you Alfonso!

Alfonso’s apartment was perfect for our group.  The location was excellent and the apartment very clean, comfortable and well laid out.  We couldn’t have had a better location for a wonderful stay in Madrid. Thank you!

Excellent place for a city break!
Cannot imagine a better location.
The apartament with its view is simply superb. I recommend *****

One of the best airbnbs that I’ve stayed out. Super comfortable,  beautiful views and centrally located to everything. Alfonso was an exceptional host who worked with our tricky schedule to coordinate a flawless check in experience. Would highly recommend.

A clean and roomy apartment located with walking distance to most areas in central Madrid. Metro station nearby.
The tenth floor and a balcony to the southwest with a nice view over the city could be emphasized more. AC in all of the rooms and two clean bathrooms with hair dryer, shampoo, shower gel and body lotion.
Despite our late check-in Alfonso was flexible and there to greet us! 👍

We had an amazing stay at Alfonso’s place! The apartment was clean, spacious, and beautiful! It was centrally located and easy to get everywhere we needed to in Madrid. Would definitely stay here again!
Great location! Nearby to attractions and shoppings. So quiet for a  10th floor property with breath taking view. Recommend for everyone to visit Madrid!

Alfonso's apartment was a great choice for our stay at Madrid. The apartment is very nice, the building is safe and the location is perfect. Alfonso is a great host as well.I would recommend Alfonso' s apartment for a comfort stay at beautiful Madrid.
Excellent stay in a wonderful location! The apartment was well equipped and it was immaculate. I would definitely stay here again and give it my highest recommendation!

Great apartment in a perfect location for getting around Madrid. Gran Via is like Broadway in NYC - always crowds of people. Apartment nicely and simply decorated, no clutter, very clean, very comfortable beds. Taxi stand just around the corner near Hotel Mayorazgo made getting around very easy. Fantastic nearly sound proof windows made staying on a busy street no problem. We very much enjoyed our stay!

Wonderful apartment in the heart of it all on Gran Via!  In the same block as the major theaters and very easy walk to the Royal Palace, Parque de Oueste and Casa de Campo.   Very roomy, walkout balcony with beautiful views of the palace, Casa de Campo and even the mountains in the distance.  Extremely quiet despite being in a vibrant, busy area of the city.  Separate washer and dryer which was great for efficiency of doing laundry for the 6 of us  (ages 20-81) toward the end of our trip.  I highly recommend this apartment and would definitely choose to stay here again.
location is just great. you can walk around all main attractions. The view of palace is also great. and lots of restaurants are so close. you don't worry about where you need to go to get something.

Amazing spot!! My friends and I stayed here for 3 nights and absolutely loved it! The location was perfect and so centrally located. There’s so many restaurants, shops, and things to do nearby. There was a perfect amount of space for all of us exactly as described. We especially loved the balcony that had gorgeous views of the city. Alfonso was so responsive and made the check in process so smooth. He even left a bottle of wine for us to enjoy. Couldn’t have asked for a better place to stay during our first time in Madrid.
Alfonso’s place was great! It is centrally located and everything was accessible through walking or metro. Even though it’s located on a busy street, you can’t hear any noise. Very clean and modern.

Great stay overall. Alfonso was a good host and it was easy to communicate with him to get access to the space.
As for the space itself, it was as advertised and perfect for our group of 5. View from the apartment is stunning. Location was very central being on Gran Via and having the elevator was nice.
It is located in the center of Madrid.  There are a lot of stores nearby.  It is very spacious and big enough for 6 of us.  We all like it.

A great accommodation, brilliant location and excellent host.
Everything was above my expectations and would recommend this to anyone visiting the city.

This is a very nice apartment, well furnished and with a spectacular view. Great location for visiting the city. The host was kind and accommodating, with a quick response to everything we needed. Highly recommended.
Location, location,location as we say in England ! Amazingly central everywhere was within walking distance. The flat had brilliant views and was perfect for what we wanted.

My stay at Alfonso's apartment in Madrid was fantastic! The location on Gran Vía is absolutely perfect, right in the heart of the city. The apartment was spotless, luxurious, and incredibly well-organized—way better than the photos! Alfonso was super friendly, cooperative, and quick to assist with anything I needed. I highly recommend this place for anyone visiting Madrid!

We had a wonderful stay at Alfonso’s Airbnb! The apartment is centrally located, making it incredibly easy to explore the city on foot. It was very clean, spacious, and well-equipped to accommodate multiple people comfortably. The bathrooms were especially impressive—modern, spotless, and well-maintained.
Alfonso was a fantastic host—very responsible and responsive. He was there in person to hand over the keys and made sure to answer any questions we had, which made the check-in process smooth and stress-free. Would definitely stay here again!

Alfonso was a great host.   He met us upon arrival and made sure we had everything we needed for our stay.    The apartment was great - beds were comfortable and we had everything we needed.   The location was great - very walkable.   I would highly recommend and I look forward to my next stay!

We had a fantastic stay at this centrally located Airbnb in Madrid. The apartment was spotless, with everything we needed, including a washer and dryer, which was a huge plus for our family. The host was incredibly responsive and welcoming, and the check-in and orientation were seamless. We were able to walk everywhere from this ideal location, and the view from the bedrooms was absolutely beautiful. It was the perfect home base for exploring the city. We highly recommend it. Wonderful hospitality all around. ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

This place is amazing. Our taxi driver told us it was located in the richest part of Madrid and called it the "Golden Mine". The apartment is on the 6th floor and has a great view of Calle Velazquez. We were a group of 7 and we all felt we had plenty of room and didn't feel cramped at all. It's a very modern, clean, and comfortable apartment. Thank you Juan & Marina, my family and I had a great time! Would definitely recommend.

Place is nice.  Frustrated that we were offered early check in, we made plans accordingly, then early check in was taken away.   Frustrated no detergent, no paper towels and only two sets of keys when it’s a four bedroom unit.  Great location.  Very nice place.  A few small things would have to change to stay there again.
Huge space where 8 people can comfortably sleep, the service and the location was amazing, neighborhood has many delicious restaruants

This is the Best place to stay in Madrid if you like to feel like home, private, Confident and fully equipped place
5 Stars
Very Professional people and always aware about yours needs.
Thank You Juan & Marina’s

The best thing about the apartment was definitely the location. Walking distance to El Retiro and to so many nice restaurants! The apartment itself was nice and spacious but could definitely benefit from a fresh coat of paint. It was fairly clean, with some dust underneath the beds. The worst thing about the stay were the pillows! They were so uncomfortable we had to go out and buy some after the first night. We stayed for a week and definitely didn’t have enough towels so had to wash them mid week. Other than that we had a lovely time
We had an amazing time. Excellent location, responsive host and it matched perfectly the listing description. Highly recommended.
We have a wonderful stay!  Great location and walkable to many things.  Would stay again for sure.

Pros
Great location
Great Host
Cons
2 of 4 shower drainage was bad
Great accommodation, very clean and Rayo Vallecano stadium and Metro station is right in front of the accommodation

We loved the place, it's spacious, well-located, with good links to the main parts of the city and it's relatively quiet neighborhood. They were quite flexible with check-in and check-out times as well. We'll be using Olala next time we're in Madrid.
It was very clean and I liked the Tv and the neighbourhood that was in and around it, really good.

The apartment in Vallecas is very nice.  Located right across the Rayo Vallecano soccer stadium and the Portazgo Metro station. Located in an area where locals live and near supermarkets, restaurants, coffee shops.  it is only a 20 minute metro ride from Plaza del Sol ( about 3 miles) . It is convenient.  We were driving our own car and we were able to park nearby.  The only downside was that management forgot to send us the check in link before we arrived and it took us about 20 minutes to fill all the required information, in the street when it was 97 degrees. They also only provided towels for 4 people and we were 5 guest.  Other than that, we would come back to stay.

The apartment was amazing, close to everything g and it has a metro station next to it. It was clean, modern and beautiful. Communication was great! They even let us leave our bags somewhere else until check in time! Definitely recommend!!!!
The place was great and as shown in pictures. Spacious and great location. Easy check-in and check-out

The home was very clean and well-kept, and it had everything we needed for our stay. Julia was very helpful at the check-in. The location is a bit far from the city centre but it was perfectly suited to our needs. Highly recommended.
This apartment was clean, a perfect size, and in a great location. I had a wonderful time staying here.

This was a great stay! Very close to the metro line 2 with plenty of restaurants around for local eating.
Place was clean, quiet and secure :)

Very good value for the stay.
Clean and to the point.
Location is ideal to be somewhat removed from nightlife yet walking distance from anywhere in the center

Alexander was great, i arrived early so he let me leave the bags at the apartments while cleaning was in progress so i could explore locally hands free. place was perfect for my needs and closer to many great spots to have fun
The apartment is new, very clean, essential and small (as per the description) but functional and placed in a very good location in Madrid: very central but not overly touristic.

You can tell it is the kind of flat owned by a realstate company. Basic needs covered but appart from that, loveless decoration with hospital looking-like lights. Worst of all: Coffe machine wasn't working.  If you are on your 20's and only care about living in the center, then is a match though.
Perfect location if you are looking to spend some days in the city center.  There are lots of things to do and see in walkable distances. Great restaurants in the area.
Very convenient location, a bit loud when trying to sleep. Hot water for 2 showers  but had to wait 30 minutes for the water to heat back up.
We loved our stay at Romans place! It is in a great location and surrounded by lots of lovely restaurants and cafes! Would definitely recommend.
This place is very well located, closed to Puerta Del Sol and easy to walk to all the main attractions.

We stayed in Ramon’s flat as a group of 5 people and would recommend the apartment to any group of travelers, who are looking for a fun time in Madrid full of exploring and enjoying the city center completely on foot, as well as having a Metro station 500m away with an easy connection to the airport.
Ramon’s flat looked completely like advertised - the only thing that surprised us, was how centered it was in the pretty and lively city part Sol! You really couldn’t ask for a better location!
The place was clean and organized. The AC worked wonderfully. Great location, walking distance to restaurants.

Sergio is an excellent host. My room had an attached bathroom, balcony, and high ceilings. My stay was secure, comfortable, and fun.
Location cannot be beat
The place is very central, the room is quite big and has great light, and Sergio was super kind despite the language barrier ! :)
Everything went well. Pleasant stay overall. Location is great including the unit. Thanks so much for hosting!

Sergio was a good host; the room was very pleasant and well located. Due to our language differences, we usually communicated by text, which was fine. He responded quickly when I asked for something, but was otherwise not there, or was there quietly.  On the first morning, I said I thought the room was too cold, and he made it warmer.

Centrally located HAVEN in old part of Madrid.
Having been to Madrid in several occasions I feel now that I’ve found a home base:
- Hosts are very friendly and hospitable. Added few bits of specials to make you feel welcome and at home.
- Appartment is spacious, centrally located with access to most of the places in walking distance.
- Had easy access to lots of eateries both local & international.
When visiting Madrid look NO further.
BIG THANK YOU & Namaste to the hosts.

Lourdes, Roque, and Luke hosted us in this outstanding Madrid apartment. We stayed for a month and loved every minute. The apartment is very comfortable, and the appliances and fittings are excellent. It was helpful to have two full bathrooms, a rarity with one-bedroom apartments. The location is superb, close to Plaza Mayor and Puerta del Sol, easy distance to the Museum mile, El Retiro Park (great for running), Palacio Real, and even the Madrid Rio. We walked everywhere. The food scene in Madrid (and near the apartment) is incredible. We enjoyed visiting and buying groceries and produce at Anton Martin and went to most of the restaurant recommendations our hosts suggested. Their suggestions are excellent. We really can't say enough good things about this place. It would be our first choice for our next Madrid stay. We recommend it without any hesitation.

Lourdes and Roque were great hosts! They have a beautiful place in an ideal location. They reached out to us frequently to check on our stay and to see if we needed anything. Check in and check out were both very easy, and the location is the city is perfect. It is in the center of most attractions making everything very walkable. A great AirBnB in a great city. Thank you Lourdes and Roque!
The place was big enough for our family! Everything was so clean and comfortable :) the location location location !! It was so easy to access to everywhere with our toddler ! Thank you :)

The apartment is beautiful, just like the pictures, we loved the kitchen great size, the location is great, walkable distance from the main spots in the city. Also with a supermarket very close. The host very responsive and friendly, we loved our stay there and definitely we would like to go back.
It can be a little noise at night but we didn’t have any problem sleeping.
We recommend this place!!!
Excellent experience staying here, would definitely stay here again when in Madrid. Perfect location and very comfortable flat.

Great location, close to the gran via and sol metro station. Plenty of places to eat and visit. The apartment was really clean and the owner was great at communicating. We highly recommend this apartment for short and long term visits. Thank you so much for making our trip to Madrid enjoyable and comfortable! We can’t wait to return.

Very nice apartment, has everything you need! Great location! Totally recommend it!
Hosts were at disposal all the time!
Fantastic apartment in a central location. 5* Airbnb experience from check-in to check-out. Will stay here again.
Superb apartment! Located at a great location. Extremely smooth check in process and super easy and prompt communication with the hosts 👍🏼
Very clean apartment on a good location in Madrid. We definitely recommend this place and we will come back!
The location was great we could walk, take the metro, or grab a cab to anything and everything we wanted to do. Very comfortable and lovely accommodations!! We enjoyed the stay in Madrid.🙂
Right in the city center. Perfect if you’re in Madrid to shop and do touristy things. The apartment is great! Lots of natural light, clean, spacious. Exactly how it looks in the photos

Excellent location with easy access to many of the desirable neighborhoods. Check-in is done via an app and the host provided clear instructions. The rental was clean, functional and looked like the photos in the description. Would definitely stay here again.

Location is very central, host was feliable and very helpful allowing us to store our bags in the room even before it was ready. They were there towalk us step by step and coming in and out of room was a breeze.

Great space in the center of downtown Madrid. Walkable to most of the museums and monuments. Quiet despite being right off an incredibly busy street. My kids loved that there is a Real Madrid shop in the corner!
Great stay! clean apartment with all the amenities needed in the most central part of the city, close to the best restaurants, shops and city monuments. Responsive and proactive host. thank you :)

Nice flat, just steps from Gran Via and walkable to all the tourist spots in Madrid.
The space is suitable for 2- 3 people, however, the bathroom is small.
Would recommend most of all because of location.
Very cozy apartment and a perfect location next to the shopping centers and main attractions. Good kitchen amenities allow you to cook by yourself if you don't want to eat outside all the time.

What a great apartment, location & host! I couldn't have been happier with the accommodation - Alejandro was very responsive and provided recommendations in the local surrounds.
I would recommend Mu! on the same little laneway, excellent food and friendly staff.
Thanks Alejandro!
Good location, walking distance on lot of things, small for 4 persons but clean. Two nights of noisy neighbours late at night hours was a bit frustrating.
Alejandro’s place was wonderful! Close to so many attractions and very easy to access with the instructions he provides! A truly great experience!

This place exactly feels like home! There is everything that you need, it’s very clean and stylish in a Spanish way. Also it is quiet almost all the time. Elena is a great host! She responded me very fast and give me many tips living there! She speaks great english, there is no problem for communicating. Anyway, i have a great experience in her house! Great recommendation!
Elena is very kind and helpful, we couldn't have asked for a better host. Her place is very clean, it has everything you need for a short or long stay. The shower is amazing.

This place was so amazing! Close to metro station, our host was great and communicated amazingly! The flat felt like home straight away, very clean, cozy and just everything you need! Virginia, the lady who welcomed us, was super lovely!

We had a great time at Maria's place. We were traveling with a one year old and it was the perfect place to stay. The apartment was very clean and had MORE than enough to make our stay as comfortable as possible.

Lovely, comfortable apartment, spotlessly clean. Hosts were very kind, helpful and responsive. Excellent location, close to shops and metro, and I felt very safe. The kitchen had everything I needed to cook my meals. I highly recommend and I hope to stay there again soon! Many thanks to the hosts for a wonderful stay!

Viviana was a wonderful host during our stay! She provided great recommendations of restaurants and what to see while we were there. The apartment was in an ideal location, we were less than a 10 minute walk from anything we wanted to see. About 1 min from Plaza del Sol and Plaza Mayor. Viviana responded within the hour to any questions we had and was so nice to work with. The apartment was very clean and it was perfect for what we needed while we stayed in Madrid. We would definitely stay here again!

This apartment is in a superb location (very near to Plaza Mayor), and we were able to get to every place we wanted to visit by foot. The apartment, part of an interesting old building, is renovated, super cosy and had all the accomodations we needed for our trip. We are a young couple, on a 6 days trip, and the apartment was only a place to sleep and rest sometimes in the beginning of the afternoon, to avoid the hours of most intense heat (we are very thankfull to the apartment's air conditioner and fridge). We highly recommend this place!
Really nice location, the host was so nice and it is perfect for staying a weekend in Madrid.
Perfect location - in the heart of Madrid. Very quite property. You should find all what you need there. I would say that room is really small, but this is more than enough to spend the night.
Great communication from host, great location, a bit too small for our preference and for the price.
Viviana is a very nice host. The location was perfect and the communication was very smooth.
We had a such a wonderful stay and would recommend the place to others. The host was so helpful, place was cleanly and the location was great and close to the city centre.
Beautiful place and great location! Was able to walk to a lot of places from this place. Would definitely stay here again.
The place was too small and the furniture didnt fit the size of the room. One’s could hardly walk. Felt very uncomfortable.

Ive stayed at plenty of airbnbs and hotels. This one particularly stood out due to the exceptional host, Viviana. She answers within one minute, no exaggeration. She is extremely helpful, kind, and simply a wonderful host. The airbnb was beautiful, just like the pictures. It was perfect for my husband and I. a small studio, had space to layout our luggage in the floor. Kitchen with the essentials. beautiful bathroom with a nice shower. It’s small but not tiny, just PERFECT for solo or couple travelers. And the location is at the very heart of madrid. Walkable to Plaza Mayor, Puerta del Sol, Gran Vía (plaza callao) etc. I am saving this airbnb because I plan to stay here on our next visits to Madrid,  hopefully very soon!! Thank you again, Viviana.

Me and my wife have spent an amazing time in Madrid thanks to Viviana. She is an amazing guest and for sure I will come back to her apartment once I get back to Madrid. She told us a lot of places to visit, great places for our meal and very available during our stay.
Thank you very much Viviana

We really enjoyed staying in Viviana’s place.
The location is excellent (close to the Plaza Mayor), the beds are comfortable and the shower is good.
It’s perfect for anyone who plans to be out in Madrid for their stay and wants an apartment that’s easy to access.
Great stay - easy entrance. No frills, but an easy place to get up and go from!

Really beautiful location, apartment as described - perfect for a few nights for 2 - Netflix on tv is a nice touch for a quiet night in.
Can see how the keys and check in situation can be a little confusing but okay with a little patience.
I would recommend

Viviana was truly amazing. She was always present if we had questions. The place was close to everything: restaurants, bars and places to visit.
We had a wonderful time!
This was an incredible. The location is awesome being so close to plaza mayor makes this area so vibrant and walkable! Very clean and easy check in process! Would 100% stay here again!

Everything was very good about this apartment, very clean, right in the center but very quiet once inside and the host was very kind and left very good instructions. We even received some coffee, tea and water. Would 100% recommend and will definitely come back!

The location of this Airbnb can’t be beat. It’s right in the center of everything and you’re in Plaza Mayor in 30 seconds. Self check  in was a breeze. The place is very small, so it’s best for one person, but compared to what a hotel in the area would cost it’s a very good deal.
The space is beautifully done and in a great location! We felt very much at home and the beds and pillows were so comfortable. I will definitely stay here again in the future.

Location cannot be matched! Steps from Sol and Plaza Mayor.
The apartment was small but very clean and beds were comfortable.

Perfect and very cozy location for a short stay. Everything we wanted to see was right outside the apartment and within walking distance. We took the train from
Barcelona and had to only take a short taxi to this location where we were then able to walk everywhere. Host was friendly, prompt and offers recommendations. Would stay again!

This was a cozy and clean place. It was centrally located close to restaurants and nice attractions.
Sandra

Great location, quiet apartment and very good location. Cleaning was very good and had everything we needed for 5 nights.Host was quick to answer questions. I would recommend this place for a short stay in the city

The apartment is just amazing for the stay in Madrid, very central, close to many attractions and restaurants. Very clean and there is everything what can be necessary for the short stay. Also Viviana is very responsive host, she provided all the information as for self check-in and check-out. Definitely I would recommend this apartment and would like to return back when I’m in Madrid.

Lovely studio apt/room with hotel like amenities. A bit smaller than the picture but had everything and quite comfortable. Great central location. Very clean.
Courteous and cooperative host.
Overall highly recommended for 1-2 guests with less luggage.
Cozy, clean, and central stay! Viviana was an excellent host! She was extremely responsive and accommodating!

I had a wonderful time staying here! it was clean, nicely decorated,  and exactly as described.  It is a great location if you want to be in the central area of Madrid, super close to an amazing churros restaurant also! Loved staying here and highly recommend!

This was our first time in Madrid. This was an awesome stay and experience. Viviana was very responsive and helpful during our entire stay. The location was fantastic, near everything and walkable to so many places to eat and drink. Would definitely like to return for another trip. Thank you.

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay here!
We cannot emphasise enough the incredible location of this apartment- you’re in walking distance from almost everything.
We felt very safe staying here and Viviana was great with communication and recommendations.
The apartment is clean and has everything you need.
I’d highly suggest staying here if you’re planning a trip to Madrid.

Our stay was great! Viviana’s place was clean, walkable, and exactly as described. She was responsive, provided instruction as needed, and helped us store our bags a little after check-out on our last day. Definitely recommend.

We were for 4 days in Madrid, very good location ! Vívian was a Good Hostess..
Thank you!
Come Back soon!
We had a great time here! Perfect location, so walkable to all the major spots and the apartment was very clean.
A great small studio for couples to stay in. Studio is very clean and conveniently located near all amenities. Viviana was quick at responding to all messages. Great place.

Place was amazing! We really enjoyed the place. Everything super close, easy access to the iconic buildings.
I was traveling only with my daughter and we felt really good. We are already planning our next year trip to Madrid.

This place is perfectly located in the heart of Madrid, next to Plaza Mayor and some fantastic local spots! Viviana is super responsive and easy to communicate with. All in all, it's a fantastic choice for your next visit to Madrid!

Beautiful apartment in a very nice area. The decorating is incredible and made me feel right at home. Jorge is a great host, quick to respond and helpful whenever you need anything! Big plus that communication can be both in English as well as Spanish.

The apartment is completely new, modern and stylish. It’s not big but it’s perfect for one person or a couple. It has a terrace that gives a lot of “air” to the apartment. Jorge was very responsive and helpful too.

I can recommend staying in this apartment. Everything was in accordance with the offer.
The house was well-kept and equipped with everything necessary. Very good communication with the host.
We have had a good stay at Daniel’s apartment. It was very clean and the beds were super! Quiet neighborhood walking distance from the metro. It was perfect for our citytrip to Madrid.
all was perfect, there are a lot of parking spaces arround in case you need. there is pharmacy and all the stuffs
Excellent place to stay: quiet and very clean. We also enjoyed family pool time. Absolutely recommend it. The place is spacious and neat, and Daniel was very supportive.

My stay at Arancha's place was great. I had complete independence and privacy. The room looks exactly as it is shown in the pictures. The place is quite clean and cheerfully bright. The location was perfect for travelling through Spain given that it is 10 min walking distance from Atocha Station and El Retiro Park.
I’ve really enjoyed my stay at Arancha’s place, the studio has everything needed, the location is great and Arancha is very kind and helpful.
The most cozy and fantastic house in Spain I’ve ever lived. Everything was perfect! You can’t miss it if you would like to book an Airbnb!
This was the perfect location and the most stylish, clean apartment! We loved our stay. We only wished it had A/C but the temperature was still bearable - especially with the fans.
The apartment is beautiful, clean and very well located. The communication is also great as Dan always answers within a very short amount of time. Can 100% recommend!
This place was absolutely beautiful, spacious and clean. Close to restaurants and to the flea market that occurs on Sundays. Definitely recommend!
Location nice and local, very thin walls so its quite noisy but this is to be expected as the location is so good that everything is on your doorstep!! Dan was very responsive and helpful.

Dan sends out generic texts which are adequate but really doesn’t answer a personal request. For example, I was unsure if I could drive in the central part of Madrid (it’s controlled trying to reduce emissions) with my rental car and asked Dan but never got a response other than the canned this is a parking garage close by. Otherwise, it’s a nice property location. I don’t think the property has air conditioning but it wasn’t that hot with the fan running.

washer and dryer.  flat screen tv with netflix,  dishwasher, great showers and two full baths.  Furniture was comfortable.  Several things to do around the area.  You could walk to the National Museum and the Prado Museum.
Very nice flat/apartment, everything is very modern, has all Amenities you could need (besides AC but fans worked well). Would recommend for a nice stay in Madrid

Very spacious. Great location. It had every thing we needed. We messaged Marcos to get sheets for the sofa bed and he responded right away.
We will stay there again.

Nice, clean apartment, as described.  Worked well for our family of four.  Located close to a metro station for easy access to Madrid.  Poor water pressure in showers.  Never met the host, but self check-in was straight forward.

We enjoyed our stay in Madrid. The location of the apartment was great for getting around the city. There are plenty of restaurants near by. The apartment was clean and comfortable.  We had an issue where we needed to stay an additional night. The hosts were accommodating and quick to respond easing any worry of having to find new lodging.  We will definitely stay here again next time in Madrid.

The apartment was exactly as described. It was great to have 2 bathrooms for getting ready to start our day. Easily walkable to Plaza Mayor and Grand Palace. Neat and clean. Appreciated having a washer and dryer.

The apartment was very clean, and well equipped with everything, even detergents, toaster, and water heater!! The location is close to everything, right in the middle of the center and the neighborhood was calm and friendly. The apartment is spacious!

Spacious apartment, felt right at home. Location was outside of the main tourist attractions but totally walkable to them but with a more local feel. Only thing was 2 of the heaters didn’t work, but the apartment had enough of extra blankets. Apartment felt clean - bathroom, kitchen, linen. Would stay again.

We really enjoyed our stay! Our hosts were very helpful and quickly helped with anything we needed. The only 2 things that weren’t great were that the flat was a bit cold and the water pressure in the showers. Would definitely recommend the place for a short stay however!
A lovely apartment fully equipped in the centre of the town.Just 1 minute from the metro station! Everything was perfect!

Great location. Next to metro. Whole city center in walking range.
Great support from host.
In general apartment was clean, but some small details could be handled better.

We had a great stay at Oscar's apartment. Perfect location, right in the city center and walking distance from most of the places we wanted to visit. The place is super clean and the communication with the host was very smooth. I will certainly stay there again at my next visit to Madrid!
Great stay. We had some issues with the water, and the host came over to fix it immediately. Great location near the train station and a wide selection of restaurants.

Great place, and ideal location! You can walk around everywhere in the city center and there's a 24h supermarket right in front.
The apartment is comfy, very stylish and clean. And you don't hear noises from the street - the door to the little terrace is pretty soundproof.
Super responsive and helpful host. Would definitely stay here again.

We really enjoyed our stay in the apartment as everything went very smoothly.
Emilio answered all of our questions super fast and provided all the necessary information well in advance.
I can fully recommend both the host and the apartment :)
This is the best location you could ask for! Right in the middle of Madrid, where all the action is. The apartment was very quiet. The host was great at communicating. I would stay here again!
Only stayed one night. The street the apartment is on is a hit sketchy but the surrounding areas are great. Oscar was super helpful and communicative. Had a lovely stay.

We had a blast staying in Emilio's apartment, the place is exactly as it is shown on the pictures.
As the apartment is positioned in the very center of the city, everything can be reached on foot, bars, restaurants, clubs and more.
10/10 !
Wonderful in every way.  Location is perfect, close to center but quiet. Clean, comfortable and very quick and helpful communication with host. We would love to come back!

Beautiful flat in the most amazing location- walking distance to all the main attractions, many great restaurants in the area and felt so safe as two girls on our own! The flat itself was super clean, well equipped and very easy to find. We would definitely recommend it to anyone visiting Madrid!

Lovely, clean, spacious apartment in a fabulous, central area! Everything is in walking distance. The best market in Madrid Saint Michael Market (Mercado de San Miguel) is basically on your doorstep, along with the Plaza Mayor. Host were every attentive and could ask anything at anytime! Would recommend 10/10.

Thank you Emilio for a wonderful stay at your apartment in the center of Madrid. The location was great! Close to stores, metro and tourist sights. The apartment was beautifully decorated and was accurately depicted in the pictures and very comfortable for two people. The AC was great especially during the 100 degree weather we had during our stay. I definitely recommend Emilio’s place for your next vacation in Madrid !! Thank you and hopefully we can return some day and stay again at the apartment!!

Emi's flat in Madrid was in an unbeatable location. It was very close to Mercado de San Miguel, Plaza Mayor, and, of course, Chocolatería San Ginés. The building was well kept and clean (not to mention beautiful) and had a lift. The apartment had more than enough space for two plus boasting a washing machine and AC units. Emi's communication was excellent and very responsive. Picking up the keys, surprisingly, was no hassle and was done in under one minute, thanks to the detailed instructions and photographs sent before check-in. I would recommend this stay to others traveling. Thanks again!
I stayed for two nights and it was great! Check-in process was smooth, airbnb was as described and location was very close to popular attractions. Wish I stayed longer!

Oscar’s place was quaint and had beautiful touches. He was very attentive and quick to respond to all my messages. He is also very patient. We had a late flight arrival and he accommodated to meet and greet us.  I would stay in his place again if I ever travel back to Madrid.

Had a great weekend break. The Apartment was very clean and just as the pictures suggested. Was in a great location to explore the city from. Oscar was extremely helpful, responsive and gave some very good recommendations on where to eat. Highly recommend
A short stay but very worth it. Oscar and the team were very helpful. In a spot in Madrid. Highly recommend!

Great apartment right in the centre of Madrid with a lovely terrace. Everything was in walking distance for us. Check in was very easy with clear instructions. The apartment was as described and we would definitely like to return!

Madrid is a fabulous city and the location of the apartment was the best  / close to Plaza Mayor and many more attractions. Also and most importantly it was so quiet which is not easy to find in central Madrid. I would certainly stay there again when next visiting Madrid and would have no hesitation in recommending it to friends

This apartment is ideally situated in the atmospheric old part of the town and is in walking distance to many attractions . Surrounded by restaurants and yet it’s very quiet as it looks into an internal courtyard so possible to sleep with the windows open . Very spacious and well appointed it is just as it appears on the website . Communication with Emilio was easy . The pick up of the keys at the office was quite stressful but worked out at the end . Recommend

It was a cozy and nice house.  Above all, the location was very good.  The place where you receive the key for check-in is a bit far from your home, so it may be inconvenient if you have a lot of luggage.  However, the check-in process was not difficult.  If you are traveling to Madrid, I recommend it! ◡̈
Awesome location and the place of the Airbnb felt very cozy and clean. It was like we were living in Madrid. The host was communicative and helpful. I would book again in the future

The apartment was in a great location, close to all attractions. it was also very quiet, had a lift for our luggage and was very clean. It was a little annoying to have to collect the keys from another location, especially if arriving late. Some disappointing things: there was a small nespresso machine but no pods or milk; there was a washing machine but no powder and no instructions. The wash went for a few hours using hot water so my clothes shrank and dye ran. The iron didn't work. There wasn't even salt and pepper or oil. I know these are small things but it would make guests feel much more welcome. Otherwise we loved Madrid.

This is a great apartment in central Madrid. It’s close to multiple metro stations, and has a lovely balcony. I enjoyed my time here and would definitely book again. The host was very flexible and responsive.
The location was perfect! You're in between Sol and Gran Via. I love the character of the space and the cute, small patio area. Oscar was wonderful and helpful. Good bed and shower!

Apartment was clean and tidy.
Good spot to base out of when travelling around the city

Oscar is such a great host. From greeting us upon arrival, to local restaurant recommendations. He is super friendly, and responds quickly if you ever have any questions. Located at the city center of Madrid! Highly recommend staying here!
Great apartment, clean and beautiful design , perfect central location, wonderful responsive host , easy access, will definitely come back again when in Madrid

Firstly the good. Check in was very efficient and good. The apartment is exactly as described, very nice, comfortable and clean. Great location also in the middle of everything and close to the metro stop gran via.
The only downside was that on the one night we stayed there there was a big party upstairs going all night. As a result we were barely able to sleep. It was a Friday night so maybe this isn't normal but for us realistically it means we would not return.
I communicated this to Oscar the following morning and he was very sorry about it and said he had never heard of it happening before, so I guess we were just unlucky.
Other than the party upstairs this would have been a 5 star rental for sure.

This apartment was perfect for our stay in Madrid! Oscar and Fernando were very gracious hosts and were very quick to respond. The apartment was clean and had everything we needed. The location is fantastic, so walkable to most things in Madrid.
Good location for tourist attractions. Oscar was helpful during check in. Bed was a bit small but OK for a few nights.

We enjoyed our stay. It had simple amenities and was clean and tidy. Very good location which was central and easy to walk around and for sight seeing. We had to meet the host for check in.
Would recommend if looking for a convenient, simple short break in a good location.

We were fortunate enough to find Fernando’s place. You can’t beat the location, it was fantastic. Even though it was on a busy pedestrian street it was very quiet. The communication from our host was excellent. Walking distance to everything but still a short distance from the metro. Highly recommend.

This Airbnb is a guest favorite for a reason, and it   was one of the more hotel like Airbnb listings we have stayed at, particularly in Europe. That is not to say that it didn’t have character, but rather in the sense that it was extremely clean, safe, and well put together. We would not hesitate to stay here again!
Perfect location for a few days exploring Madrid. We could walk everywhere and easy access to the metro. Apartment was clean and as shown in pictures. We really enjoyed our stay!
Oscar’s place was in the perfect location. The apartment itself was spotless & looks exactly like the pictures. Would definitely recommend & visit again!

The location is excellent - right in the heart of central Madrid. Although the pedestrian street out front is very busy, the apartment is very quiet. Metro station is a very short distance away. Apartment was fresh and clean!

We loved our stay here. The location was in the heart of Madrid, but the home was very quiet and clean. Lots of wonderful amenities and recommendations! The AC worked great as well! The sofa bed was small and not very comfortable and I would not recommend for 2 people to sleep on it. Highly recommend this Airbnb for small groups or couples!

Pros :
1. The apartment is in a great location!
2. Building has an elevator
3. Easy check in through a web app
4. Apartment is cutely decorated
Cons:
1. Found a few cockroaches in the house during our stay.
2. No blanket available initially when I arrived. This was immediately given when I brought it to their attention.
3. The double bed is a bit small for 2 people .
The cons can easily be ignored because our experience in this apartment was good. If these small things can be worked out , this stay is a easy 5 stars 🌟

Great place for a few days to spend in Madrid. Loved the apartment . Very clean.
Only down fall is the bed it small. I was there solo and was ok for me but if a couple book , the bed is on the small side and would not work well for two

I was somewhat disappointed with my stay. The shower smelled like old water, my checkin was delayed a few minutes and even then the cleaning person wasn’t finished and insisted on staying a few minutes to clean, and the bed did not actually have a comforter or blanket on it.
The apartment is very clean and tidy. Host is also very responsive and helpful. The location is also very good and in close distance from subway station.
We had a great stay at Ivan's place. very nice apartment, exactly like the pictures. Location was excelent too. We will definitely stay again there when back to Madrid.
Really really love the place! Very nice location! Host responded really quickly :) would love to come again!
This place is exactly as in the pictures!! Iván is a súper-host!!! The apartment was very clean and stylish!!! Close to la Gran Vía!!! Would definitely stay here again!!!

The place is really nicely renovated and comfortable. The internet wasn’t stable enough for videos conference calls but great for browsing or watching netflix. Ivan was responsive and helpful throughout the whole stay.
Nice clean place in the middle of Madrid central city. Felt safe and had a great view of the city. Little hard to locate at first but once we found it was quite lovely.

If I can give this apartment 10 stars I would ! It is an incredible location with a couple of minutes to the station. Hosts were very friendly and communicative. Gave great food and activity options ! House was super homey and clean. Ideal apartment for 2 people ! Will definitely stay again when in Spain again ☺️
Beautiful location and such a friendly check in! Also right above the best pizza place in the world. Loved staying in the heart of everything.

The place was super clean, and on a walkable a distance from everything in the centre
Would have been great if there was a space to store our luggage until our flight time, But the host was very responsive, and he directed us to storage nearby

Great place to stay! Ivan was a great host, very friendly and fast responses when needed. Check in/out instructions were very clear. Apartment was spotless and very convenient. Location is very central and practical . Couldn’t recommend more!

We really enjoyed our stay here. The location was great, close to the metro and Gran Via. Iván was responsive and helpful and allowed us to check in early. The apartment was spacious and had everything we needed!
This place is center located, very close to main attractions. Ivan was very communicative and friendly.

Fernando and Maria were awesome hosts. The directions were perfect and they were there to greet us as we arrived. The apartment is lovely, well appointed, and the little terrace was a real treat. The kitchen had all the amenities we needed. It is very close to the sites we wanted to see. Very walkable. I highly recommend this apartment.

Lovely stay in this apartment that was well presented and very conveniently located (everything was walkable). Hosts were really friendly and welcomed us on check in and also messaged during our stay to see if we needed anything.

Great stay.  Fernando and Maria are wonderful hosts, very friendly and accommodating.  Provided local tips for restaurants and sites.  Apartment is clean and comfortable.  It is centrally located near Gran Via and Sol with lots to do yet quiet at night for sleeping.  Will come back!!
Loved the windows and terrace looking over the street below.  Everything was perfect.  Great place for 1 or 2 people.

We stayed for just over a week and loved the apartment as our base of operations. Our hosts were very kind, responsive and helpful. The area felt safe and bustling which made it fun to go out and wander around.
I would recommend using the Gran Via stop instead of the Sol stop because it's a downhill walk to the apartment and less crowded (usually).
If you're a light sleeper or not accustomed to staying in an apartment, I would bring ear plugs to help with sleeping.
we stayed there for 2 days. the location is very good. lots of restaurants around there. the hoster is very helpful.
The apartment had that cool city vibe.  Close to shopping and some site seeing. Also close to where you can grab a taxi to go other places in the city.

Ivan is a great host, he is super friendly, very responsive and incredibly helpful. The apartment is exactly as shown on the pictures and the location is ideal. It is walking distance from a lot of touristic spots and the metro and bus stations are very close as well.  We had a fantastic stay!
I came to Madrid for the gay pride and Ivan’s apartment has the best location with easy access to Gran Via and public transportation. On top of it Ivan was responsive and was always willing to help.
Great spot, loud at night but if you plan on staying out late it won't matter. Only issue was we had 5 guests and were only given 3 towels. Otherwise was great.

Loved our stay here! Centrally located within all the great neighborhoods, the apartment had everything we needed for our stay. Check in and security were user friendly and Marco was responsive and helpful.

Fantastic location in a vibrant neighborhood close to everything you need: restaurants, grocery stores, metro, train, etc. We really liked the app for checking in and gaining access to the apartment. Apartment was lovely and clean. Only possible negative - The building seems to have a number of rentals and we were kept up one night with the partying, so beware if you’re there on the weekend and want some quiet.

Marco is very communicative and ensures you have everything you need for your stay. The Airbnb was in a great location and was very comfortable for our group. The space is great for any group looking to visit Madrid!

Great location and great place to stay.
Communication with the host was fluid and accurate. Recommendations...
Great property with a modern entry / key feature. Facilities were excellent and the location is in the centre of Madrid.

Place is in a good location, very walkable.
Was disappointed with the cleanliness of the place , and sent photos to MIT upon check in, but received the response “thanks for letting us know, we will let our cleaning team know”
That’s it?
At the minimum, “apologies, we can send someone right away to clean up”
OR we even something helpful like,
“sorry about this, but we can’t send anyone to clean up, but if you look in X place there is some cleaning materials, you can use if you want to”
Lastly the place is in need of serious maintenance, bathrooms have no clips or anywhere to hang clothes, doors are broken, etc
Overall, we had an okay time, as we just decided to use the place to only sleep and did everything else outside.

Very clean , comfortable beds , great shower . Surrounding area wasn’t great but good location for Metro , Plaza Mayor , Puerta del Sol . Easy access through app. Only criticism, the kitchen was bare ! No oils , salt , pepper , water or foil/ wrap . Only used fridge and dishwasher. Carrefour was close by .

The location was great, walkable to Sol and Gran Via. We even walked to Atocha with our bags: 30 minutes or so but downhill! We liked the blackout blinds and air conditioning, so we slept well, too. Great place!

Everything as described, clear directions for check-in, easy to find, everything was quite clean, quite similar to the photos, Marco always behaved responsibly, attentive and friendly giving helpful instructions, the neighborhood is quite well located, private and quiet, excellent location.

I would not recommend MIT House to a friend. The in-app lock system is faulty and frequently left me locked out. There were moths all over the room as well. Upon checking out, MIT House accused me of stealing the coffee machine in the apartment even though I never touched it. They were extremely rude, and I had to call Airbnb Support to report their behavior.
We had a great stay, the location was ideal away from the noise of the center and yet so close. Great restaurant in the surroundings in fact the best pizza restaurant 2024 in Spain 2 blocks away 😍

Great place for a quick stay, it has what you need for 1-5 day stay. Madrid is a city to be outside so as a place to rest a recharge and hit the city is perfect. The only things that can be improved upon is the check in instructions, the apartment is located between floors so it does not have direct access with elevator so it can be challenging for some.
Overall a great place to stay and in a great location
It was a decent apartment and it looked exactly like the pictures. Pretty cozy, simple and straightforward.

Perfect location, very close to a lot of cozy squares.
The apartment itself was amazing, with a lovely balkony.

The apartment is located just a short walk from one of the plazas. I am about 7 months pregnant at this time and if it weren’t for the others I’m staying with I would likely not consider staying only because the building does not have elevators and there was no way I was able to carry my luggage 2 floors. The check in process was initially a little tricky because it’s app based but once you open the first door, going in and out is very easy and you don’t have to worry about losing keys because the key is on your phone.

The place was very nice and Marco was very responsive. It was close to a lot of good restaurants and very walkable to everything we wanted to do. Great for our two nights. The only thing is we did not realize that there was no elevator, and you cannot drag luggage up the stairs, you must carry it. So keep that in mind when booking if you have large luggage like we did.

If you’re visiting Madrid and want a perfectly-located, gorgeous, modern Airbnb. This is the one. It’s an amazing size (there were three of us), wonderfully spacious and breathable, and the app-controlled entry system was seamless.
This Airbnb played a role in the overall excellent experience we had in Madrid. Big thank you to Marco. We loved it!

Great location, nice apartment! Most of the touristic spots are from a walking distance, which makes everything easier. Check in might seem complicated (you have to download an app) but is actually easy, just make sure you have battery and internet on your phone!

This apartment in Madrid was perfect, it was spacious and comfortable. The apartment is very close to the metro and walking distance to many touristic locations. I would recommend this listing to everyone and would love to go back in the future

Great holiday had by the girls. The accommodation is in a really good place for waking too and from the centre as well as good restaurants but equally outside is not loud at night. Accommodation also looks like the pics.
We had a great time at Marco’s flat. It is had plenty of space for the four of us and was in a good location.

MIT house is extremely convenient for those wanting to explore old Madrid by foot.  We spent 3 days exploring the Royal Palace, Gardens, Cathedrals.  Plaza Mayor is an extremely convenient 10 min walk where you can have breakfast, lunch and dinner.  Coupled with the nearby Mercado San Miguel, we never even got close to sampling half the culinary delights it had to offer.

This apartment is wonderful and in one of the best and most local spots in Madrid's city center. It has a lot of space, very comfortable, and easy access with the app. The host was very responsive. Walking distance to the museums, but not touristy. Would definitely come back!
The bathrooms are uncomfortable, there is no way to put soap or shampoo. It needs handholds as it is not easy to climb
The apartment was located in the heart of the city! The view from balcony was amazing! Very clean apartment and helpful host!

The apartment was very clean and the surrounding areas were quiet, checking in and out was easy, the kitchen has all the necessary items, bathroom #1 door locker doesn’t work , you have to keep the TV, Netflix etc very low on volume otherwise they’ll knock at your door.
Overall 5 starts and recommeded.

We really enjoyed the location of the apartment, as well as the size of the apartment. It was really roomy and all the guest could enjoy their own space. The only downsides were that the walls were a bit outdated and you could feel that many people have been in there before. We also had some trouble with the check in procedure, but in the end it was very easy to use the digital lock. Overall we had a great stay and would recommend it to others.

Great place to visit Madrid, the only problem we had is that laundry machine was broken and could not be replaced on our stay. Please note that this apartment is on 2nd floor with narrow corridor and stairs.
Spend there a few days. Really nice and clean place. Easy to reach. Nice cafes and restaurants are close. Would come back!

The apartment is located in a quite spot of Madrid, but sites and public transportation is only a few minutes walk away.
The apartment works very well for 4 persons, would not recommend it for more people, as they would have to sleep in the living room.
The app needed to unluck the main door and the apartment door works well (but is slow), and it makes it possible for all persons staying in the apartment to have their own key.
Several grocery stores nearby.
Be aware that the initial "conditions" of the apartment are very limited - just enough to get you started. For example, toilet paper and dishwasher detergent were the first things we bought.
The apartment is more run down than the pictures suggest. Tiles in the kitchen are peeling off, faucets are falling apart, and drawers, closets, and cupboards are visibly "very used".
We had a great stay in Daniel’s apartment, which is stylish, well-equipped and spotless clean. The location is perfect with lots of cozy bars, shops and restaurants. We can definitely recommend it!
Great stay at this madflats property. Lovely apartment, tastefully decorated and with a great bathroom.

Our stay was absolutely fantastic - the apartment was in a great location, close to sights and shops and really good restaurants! The apartment was easy to access, the hosts made sure we arrived safely and easily. Inside the apartment was really clean, spacious and beautifully decorated. A 5 star stay ✨✨

Thank you. The apartment is great, nicely decorated, very clean. It has everything you need.
The apartment’s windows face inner yard, you don’t hear the noice from the street, although you can hear all the neighbours very well:) (watching the tv, talking…)
Super location, very easy check in, apartment looked as described and a very responsive and helpful host. What more could you ask for?
A very clean and well laid out apartment in a central and walkable area. Electronic key works well just make sure you read the instructions and check in prior to arrival.

We really enjoyed the flat and the neighbourhood it was in. Communication with Madflats was also very smooth and made our stay in Madrid all the more enjoyable. Would definitely recommend to loved ones and will even stay with Madflats again in a future trip to Madrid. Cheers!

The apartment was in a good location for walking to many of the attractions- Art galleries, the Royal Palace, Plaza Mayor and the botanical gardens.
The accommodation was very clean, spacious, light and well - equipped.
It was easily accessible with the electronic key. Daniel made the whole process easy , always responding promptly.

This was the perfect location for our quick stop in Madrid. It was centrally located and Daniel was super easy to work with.
The bathroom is a dream and we loved our time here!
We will definitely look forward to coming back for a longer visit.

Great location near metros, Atocha train station, restaurants, and major city landmarks. Has washer/dryer combo unit, full kitchen, oven, microwave, and a nice size restroom. All very comfortable for two people
Super cute, clean place with comfortable bed. Well located and cool neighborhood. Host was very communicative and check in was easy.

Nice clean place in Lavapies. Headed towards the center of Madrid, the location was great, however, near Lavapies itself was a bit of an unsavory area. The flat was clean and just like the pictures. Bed was comfortable and the place itself had all the amenities.

A great apartment in a residential building. Exactly as the pictures. The apartment does need a bit of a refresh as the walls are getting a bit scuffed.
The apartment has everything that you’ll need for your stay.
It’s a bit of a walk into the Gran Via area, but it’s easy enough (although it’s a steady incline from the apartment to the flatter walking areas).
As some others have mentioned, the apartment is near the Lavapies area which may seem a little hectic, but it’s fine.
This was our second time staying here and we had another nice stay. Very nice and clean! They were quick to respond to our request for extra linens and towels.

The place is newly renovated and is close to the metro and grocery store. You will need to take a car or public transportation to any of the sites since it is far away and straight up hill. We were disappointed that some of the basics were missing. We only had enough toilet paper for two nights, and there were no essentials in the kitchen like salt, sugar, oil, coffee or tea to get someone started.

It’s a very centrally located apartment on the fourth floor. Very safe area, and windows that open to a small grated balcony-like thing overlooking the streets. I slept well (which is rare for me), and I had a wonderful time.

Thank you so much for being a great host, the stay was phenomenal and the place was even nicer than we imagined. Everything was great, communication was great and the place is so clean and beautiful! Walking distance to everywhere you want to go in Madrid
Excellent location! Great apartment. Super clean. The host is really great and helpfull. Would absolutely recommend!

The apartment was quiet, clean and comfortable. The smartlock worked great. I was a little nervous about that but we were given a physical key just in case. That made me feel much better. It’s close to the metro, grocery store and some great cafes. Very comfortable beds :)

Great little apartment in Madrid. Had all we needed for a short stay. Daniel was responsive and helpful. Easy v check in.
15 or so min ( uphill ) Walk to St Anna sq area with best restaurants and bars.

We were in Madrid for a short stay. Walking distance to everything. The apartment provided a quiet environment away from main streets filled with noise.  The apartment felt like home. Clean, inviting and modern.
The place was perfect for our stay. Very satisfied with the apartment, very clean and owner has great communication.
Felt like home. Place was as shown on the pictures. Clean, central and calm in the evenings. Definitely will be staying again.
Our biggest regret was that of our 9 nights in Spain, we stayed here only the last night before an an early flight out of MAD. This is a very nice modern apartment in a charming older building.
Great place! Love it! And The hosts were very helpful with tips and suggestions. Check in was good and very easy. I will definitely stay there again. Great place!
Clean, modern, very comfortable!! Perfect location. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay and would love to stay here again.
Very accommodating host. The apartment is very modernized with everything needed for a comfy stay in Madrid.
Great place located walking distance from the city Center. The place is great, just as shown in the pictures. I’d like to thank Ana for being a great host and her hospitality.

This was an awesome Airbnb stay! Just was very communicative! It was nice having an elevator for luggage. Nice and clean! Location was great! Check in was easy. They allowed me to store my luggage which was helpful as we were flying out. I would highly recommend and would stay here again!!!

The place was very clean maybe too clean, the smell of bleach was a bit overpowering when first entering :)
Very functional and extremely well located, very close to the Pallazio. Decoration is a bit unpersonal, very AIrBnB cliché with lots of frames with messages in the kitchen, even the "But First Coffee" sign (see Family Guy S21E17).
It was perfect for our family stay of 3 persons (1 adult and 2 kids)

Nice place, very clean! However co host stopped responding after about 3 days of being here. Simply asked for a barber recommendation! Also said thank you for letting us stay and that I’ve done the checkout steps and got left on read. Other than that the place is perfect to stay ! Clean and cozy. The mini split in the living room didn’t work however, it was very cold in there.

Unbeatable location in Madrid! Well connected (metro station around the corner), a park two blocks away, grocery stores, many restaurants, shops, etc. Our host was always there we needed support. The apartment is cozy, modern and well illuminated. We will definitely come back!
If you hate bad smells, this is not the place to spend your days in Madrid. Also, very noisy neighbors.

The apartment is beautifully renovated and located, but unfortunately has an extremely unpleasant and overwhelming smell. Additionally, during our stay the water was shut off completely for multiple days and the host told me they had no connections to the building and had no insight to offer me.

We lucked out on finding this gem, it's in a great location in Madrid for exploring on foot or hopping on the metro, plenty of groceries and restaurants within walking distance, and it was wonderfully quiet given the proximity to everything. Very comfortable, quiet and clean, and a super responsive host. We love visiting Madrid and would happily stay here again.

The apartment is a great option for families as it has good space and the best location. We enjoyed our stay! Check in and check out we’re perfect as the team was always responsible, friendly and flexible.
Everything was okay, the apartment was good for a short stay. We were there with my family and had a good time.

All very good. Studio very much suitable for solo travellers or a couple for few days and as indicated previously. Fully very reasonably equipped, very clean, large shower, large bed, quiet neighbourhood and close to pretty much everything one would wish for, for immediate/daily needs. 5/7 walk to Puerta de Atocha ( Madrid's main train station and busy enough metro station offering many connections within 1 or 2 stops , all local commodities within 2 to 5 minutes walk ( supermarkets, chemist, tobacco, local shops, bars/tapas/terrace, an a further metro station).
Special thanks to Andres who has been very helpful , friendly, welcoming and communicative throughout from A to Z. On top of his game.
Extra Special : the bed in the studio is definitely extremelly comfortable and very much welcome after a tiring visit day !
Mucha Gracia.
Excellent! Great location close to Atocha train station and to Retiro park. The studio was stylish and  the bed very comfortable. Highly recommend!
