very quiet neighborhood,  though it is close to Atocha station, you can walk to Prado museum, very close to metro line 3. you have everything you will need for cleaning,  washing , cooking, ironing.  i was alone , and i felt very safe. the whole building is very clean, accurate, all neighbors were greeting and smiling. 😍

stayed for two weeks over Semana Santa. The check-in was smooth and adapted to our early arrival time. Much appreciated!
It's a modern flat, making the online images justice. Staying here, you'll probably enjoy the proximity to subway lines, Atocha Station and the easy access to other parts of town (there are several awesome, higher profile barrios nearby). Don't however miss out on the cozy cafés, bars and restaurants in the neighbourhood. It's a great part of town with that authentic "made for locals"-feel to it.
Hands down, this was a five star stay with five star service and communication from the host

It was ok. Quite small place.
I would remove the description saying that there is oil, salt and pepper in the kitchen.
I had a problem with the shower and all the water went out everywhere

Very well located and convenient apartment for couples or friends.
Smooth check in and check out.

Great location . Perfect apartment layout and security of having check in 24 hour security. Excellent communication.  Can be noisy outside especially with street cleaners early hours but you’ll get that in any city. Will be sure to come back

The location was excellent and the apartment very well equipped for a comfortable stay.
Antonio was always available and super responsive. The check in / check out was very smooth.
Recommend 100%!

Antonio's place was perfect for my husband and I on an 8-day visit to Madrid. We were able to walk everywhere we wanted to go, plus it's surrounded by great food and shopping. The bed was comfortable and the kitchenette had everything we needed to make breakfast and light dinners.

Great place, walking distance to many beautiful parts of Madrid - restaurants and cafes. Colòn Metro only a 5 minutes walk, well connected to transports.
The only down side if you are a light sleeper is the club downstairs than attracts noisy crowds throughout the night queuing under the window.

Great location! I would highly recommend it to my friends. It’s close enough to the city centre and walking distance to some of the landmarks, amazing restaurants. It’s a safe and clean area! Antonio was responsive and smooth and flexible check in.

With respect to the apartment and location, everything was fine. There was 24 hrs lobby, and the location is close to many touristic places, metro, tram, by feet, easy  to move, and full of restaurants.Unfortunately, there is a bar close by, and there is a night live every day. Windows are not good enough to isolated the noise, if you have a light sleep like me you are not going to rest well if noise is not an issue then is good. Another observation is that air conditioning is very old and noise, again impossible for a comfort rest, not recommended for warm weather.

Antonio’s place was just what we needed for our stay in Madrid. The apartment was clean and well equipped, the front desk was friendly and available 24/7. The area was great to stroll around, well connected and with multiple restaurants & coffee shops nearby.
Location was very good. However there was noise in the street all day long,  and the bed was very uncomfortable (ours was sunken in the middle). We reported it but nothing happened.

Perfect place to stay in Madrid. Close
to everything and walking distance to most sights. Close to all necessary transport links. Check in was seamless and the place had everything you could need. Very impressed. Would and will stay again!
We had a nice stay, the place was clean and as seen in the pictures. Bielka was wonderful, she helped us a lot and always answered the messages.

This stay was amazing, one of my favorites. The location was wonderful. Bielka was one of the most accommodating hosts i’ve ever stayed with and was very communicative and helpful the entire time (even coming to help when I accidentally locked myself out of the apartment and giving us a fan for the heat). 100% the best stay you can book in Madrid. Completely wonderful stay in a beautiful and clean apartment.
Bielka was a great host! Apartment has everything I wanted for a long stay. Will definitely take it again whenever I get back to Madrid.

The perfect little flat in Malasaña. Stayed there with a friend and we loved the neighborhood. The apartment had everything we needed—the bedroom wasn’t all that big but tons of storage so didn’t need much room. Check-in and communication throughout was friendly, helpful and easy!

The apartment was wonderful. Highlights include the shower with excellent water pressure, the well appointed kitchen, and the feeling of being in a home. Marta and Bjorn were extremely helpful. They are great hosts.
The only issue I would note is that there is no TV in the bedroom, only in the salon.

Everything was as advertised. Excellent location, classy and well stocked apartment, with a helpful host. It was particularly pleasant to be smack in the center of Madrid, in a popular neighbourhood, but not be bothered by any noise from outside.

We were met by Bjorn at arrival and departure. He was very friendly and helpful. The apartment was very clean, nicely decorated, cozy and quiet. The shower was excellent, the mattress a bit firm. The neighborhood was vibrant with easy access to restaurants, shops, transportation. The kitchen was well equipped and the Wi-Fi worked well. Overall an excellent place to stay.

We had an amazing stay at this beautiful apartment in the heart of Madrid! The location was perfect, just a short walk from Plaza Mayor, Puerta del Sol, and the Royal Palace. The apartment was spotless, stylishly decorated, and had everything we needed for a comfortable stay.
Our host, Marta, was incredibly friendly and helpful. They provided us with a warm welcome, showed us around the apartment.
The apartment itself was quiet, cozy. The bed was super comfortable, and the bathroom was modern and clean.
We would highly recommend this apartment to anyone visiting Madrid. It's a gem! Thank you, Marta, for making our stay in Madrid so special. We can't wait to come back!

Great stay! Very good, silent apartment with amazing service.
Thank you very much!

Great and clean space for a stay in Madrid! Pedro was very responsive and checked me in personally - the place is well equipped and I loved how cool it stays in summer without the AC! I would come back and stay again - loved it :) thanks Pedro! 🙂

A beautiful, well designed apartment in the heart of Madrid. Less than a minute walking to Sol or Gran Via, an easy walk to the Plaza Mayor. Delicious cafes and bars all around. This was a wonderful place to call home in Madrid.

Fantastic centrally located apartment with great AC (we laughed about it before we stayed there but boy was it nice as it was really hot outside).    We really appreciated the three bathrooms (there were three of us) and the location.   You are a few steps from lots of downtown Madrid!
Awesome place in the best location ever and described as is . Can't wait to come back . Thanks

Cleanest, nicest, best location, easiest check-in, most well maintained AirBnB we"ve ever rented in Europe. Towels were thick and clean, beds and linens comfortable and clean,  location right off Puerto Del Sol surrounded by great restaurants. Water pressure was excellent. Lighting and storage exceeded expectations. This didn't feel like a low budget Ikea furnished condo - high quality everything.
Wonderful place, central but quiet, clean and well maintained. Hosts were very kind and helpful to us!
Such a beautiful place! The location was amazing and the apartment was so clean. I recommend this 💯 percent!

This property is absolutely amazing! You cannot be the location, right in the heart of central Madrid and inside it feels like a luxury home. Super cold AC in all rooms, great balcony, beautiful decorated, incredible high speed internet plus each bedroom had its own bathroom. The host is very fast to respond to any requests. We were running low on toilet paper, I messaged him and within 20 minutes we had a case delivered to our front door. Cannot recommend this property enough. Thank you.
Nicest Airbnb I have ever stayed in. Apartment is large and spacious. If it wasn’t in such a good location I wouldn’t want to leave the whole time I was there!

This apartment is super comfortable, spacious, very well kept and in a great central location.
The owners respond very fast to the inquiries.
The place is very roomie, independent rooms, each one with its bathroom . Large closets.
Very well supplied kitchen and bathrooms.

The apartment was perfect. Most places you can go easy by walk.
The owner of the apartment was very friendly. I will take this apartment when I go to Madrid always!
Just gorgeous apartment. Comfortable and great location. The host was amazing. We loved our stay! Thank you!

Outstanding Airbnb rental:)) The apartment is located centrally, walkable distance to most attractions and shopping. Great restaurants nearby. Large clean apartment with strong AC. comfortable beds and clean linen. Everything I could ask for in a vacation rental.  Dani was amazingly responsive and went above and beyond to make sure or stay was comfortable. Would highly recommend!!
Loved this apartment. Perfect location. Very spacious and up to date. Hosts were outstanding - very responsive and flexible. Highly recommended

We had a wonderful week in Madrid
Dani and Pati was very attentive to all our requests
The apartment is spacious and beautiful
The location is right in the middle of everything- 15 min walking tops to everywhere

My family enjoyed Carmen and Dani’s place. We felt safe. We enjoyed being walking distance to restaurants and local attractions. The beds were very comfortable. The host were also very friendly and responsive. I highly recommend.

Loved the place. Family of 6 including elderly parents and we had a fabulous time. The apartment is so beautiful and comfortable while being incredibly central to all the attractions and restaurants. Loved the elevator which just required a few steps so going up and down was a breeze.

Absolutely gorgeous apartment, and the location was terrific!
My family and I had a lovely stay, walked almost everywhere!
The hosts were very responsive to any issues/ questions we had.
I’d recommend this property for anyone looking to visit Madrid!!

This was an apartment with a spacious living room, a nice kitchen, and clean everywhere.
It was actually better than we expected. The kids loved it, and this was a nice welcome for their first Europe trip. We arrived early morning and could not check in, but the host provided information about a nearby self-storage place at a reasonable price. The luggage storage place was a minute's walk from the apartment and it should be listed as one of the conveniences of the apartment.

The pictures don’t do it justice, this apartment felt luxurious and was massive!  It was a great place with powerful air conditioning where we could rest comfortably between sightseeing and the location was perfect, right in the center where everything was super walkable.  When you walk out the door there are tons of restaurants, bars and shops.  Despite being in the center it was also very quiet and peaceful inside.  There is an elevator to get to the 4th floor.  The beds were all very comfortable as were the couches.  There is the one room with the glass walls but there are curtains so you still have privacy.  Absolutely no complaints, would definitely stay here again and highly recommend!

This place is really nice as an apartment and very quiet for the location. Host was very responsive and overall, was an amazing place to stay.
However, we did find ourselves in restaurants and situations where it was clear, tourists were not welcome. Especially American tourists. The first night we were in Madrid, there was a Pro-Palastine rally where they were chanting anti American chants.

We had an absolutely fantastic time staying at Carmen’s place. From start to finish, everything exceeded our expectations. The communication with Carmen was smooth and prompt, making the booking process hassle-free. The location was perfect.

I would absolutely recommend this home! It is even larger than how it looks in the photos and beautifully decorated. I love that we each had our own separate bathroom. The host was very responsive and we were even able to check in early. The location was perfect! Everything we wanted to do in Madrid was within walking distance. Thank you for a perfect stay!

We stayed 6 friends for 2 nights and everything was great! The location is perfect for central madrid and everything is walking distance. The host was amazing, very responsive and always nice. Perfect place to stay in madrid, highly recommend!
Great apartment with walkable distances to lots of attractions such as Royal Palace, park Madrid and Basilica and many restaurants. Highly recommend.

The apartment was in the center of the city and very close to everything, including the train station which we used frequently. The apartment was just like the pictures and it accommodated 7 adults with plenty of room for everyone. It was unique and cozy. When I come back to Madrid, I will for sure stay here again. Thank you for everything!! I love you apartment ❤️!

This apartment was far more beautiful in person that in pictures!  It is centrally located and safe.  Despite the festivals and nightlife going on around us, the apartment was quiet.  There were 4 of us staying and we had plenty of room to spread out.  The elevator was a plus, especially since we had 1 person with limited mobility.  The owners were responsive and accommodating to our needs as well.  The air conditioning took some time to cool the place down, but I believe that was due to the heat wave that passed through while we were visiting (fans would have been a nice touch).  Overall, highly recommend and would stay here again!
I would absolutely stay at Carmen's flat again when mext I visitvMadrid. It was a 5 out of 5 in terms of size, cleaniness, comfort and location and it was great value for money

Fantastic location in the historic area. Walkable to sights and restaurants and easy access to subway lines that connect the city.  Cab ride to airport reasonable in cost and distance.   Beautifully decorated, very spacious apartment -very modern while at the same time maintaining the historic character.  Very spacious, quiet despite central location and nearby police station.  Responsive and friendly hosts.

We had a great time at Ivan´s place. The communication was super easy and quick and the place looks exactly like it does on the pictures. I would say even better as it has high ceiling and a modern minimal style. To be honest I️ rarely used public transportation because it was always convenient to just walk but when I️ needed to it was right there. There’s lots of restaurants and life around but in the flat itself it’s completely quiet. The neighbourhood is very conveniently located and although it’s a lively neighbourhood, the apartment is very quiet! Would absolutely recommend to stay there!

Excellent experience all around.
Incrediby central location for Madrid visitors with easy access to public transportation. The apartment was quite comfortable with a fully appointed kitchen as well as a squeaky clean bathroom. The owner was very friendly and helpful and gave me some of his local recommendations for grocery shopping, restaurants and bars. Even though the location may appear vibrant in a somewhat dense neighborhood, the interior orientation of the apartment proved to be very serene and quiet and made for perfect sleeping. Highly recommended.

It was okay. However the girl who comes every week to clean the apartment, is not doing her work properly. A lot of things were dirty, especially floor. On the other hand, this apartment was very accurate to the ad.

Our stay in Chueca was fantastic. The place is spacious, comfortable, and highly pleasant. The beds are very comfortable for our liking and the bedrooms a located so there is complete silence during rest hours. Great place to feel at home while in Madrid. Also, the hosting was flawless, welcoming us and orienting us to the place and the area. We felt supported at all times and knew the host would be reliable in case we needed anything. The place is centrally located so we were able to walk to most things we planned. Overall, an excellent place to stay in Madrid and we look forward to staying there in future trips to wonderful Spain.
Excellent communication, great location, apartment is beautiful and has everything you need. Feels like a home and would highly recommend it.

This place is amazing. Location is perfect and the apartment is beautiful and big. Highly recommend staying here and definitely staying here again next time I visit Madrid again. Miguel Angel was an amazing host and was always answering any questions we had.

The apartment of dreams! Every part of our stay at Miguel's apartment was perfect from start to finish. Not only is it a gorgeous place, the communication with the host was flawless. This is a real gem and we'll be sure to be coming back! :)

This was our very first time to Madrid and my family enjoyed this beautiful home of three bedrooms and 2.5 bathrooms. It was well designed and outfitted and the natural lighting in the main living area was wonderful. We very much appreciated the air conditioning and the layout of the home. We enjoyed making breakfast each morning and returning home each mid afternoon to cool off before returning to explore more of Madrid.

Excellent place and location.  It was very clean and exactly as described.  They went above and beyond to accommodate us when we arrived prior to stated checkin time.  I would highly recommend this property and would stay here again for my next time in Madrid.

Miguel Angel was a wonderful host! Super responsive and very accommodating! The apartment is very beautiful and open. Everything is in walking distance, the large market was right around the corner so it was easy to grab groceries. Looking forward to staying here again!

The accommodation was amazing and was just as great as the pictures. We were so appreciative of a fully air conditioned apartment during the 40 degree August heat! The location is a great base for walking to many of the famous attractions such as Gran Via and Puerta Del Sol. We found the Mercado de San Ildefonso a brilliant place to eat and less than 10 minutes walk away. Our only note is that we were not aware of Chueca’s claim to fame and there were a few establishments on our street and surrounding streets that are not really suitable for young children. Having said that, we thoroughly enjoyed our time in Madrid and in this amazing apartment.
Would stay here again! Great area, AC works perfect, nice size. Very responsive and helpful host.

Great place for group or big family to share. Great living-room and kitchen space. Good location. Also comfortable bed and pillow. Very comfortable apartment.
The only downside is we thought the apartment had 3 family bathroom, and 2 of them would be en-suite. But only one en-suite, and the third bathroom is only a toilet.
Bathroom could have been cleaner, also inside toilet there was storage for cleaning mops and dustpans with dust inside. We also missed that the apartment had kitchen towels. Overall great apartment and very happy with our stay!

Such a wonderful place to stay! We liked how spacious and well laid out the apartment is. Well equipped kitchen, great possibility to have lovely meals at home at a large family table. Three bedrooms gave us enough privacy to have some quiet time. Superb location with lots of restaurants and shops, easy to get to main museums. We would highly recommend this apartment to anyone who wants to explore Madrid and enjoy such a beautiful place to stay. Thank you Miguel Angel!

Our first time in Madrid, the place and location were PERFECT! Very safe neighborhood and we enjoyed how walkable it was. Restaurants, shops, grocery stores, bars, gyms, etc., everything is accessible. The place itself was nicely furnished and had more than enough room for all 4.5 of us. Very clean and matched pictures. Host was amazing and very proactive. We would definitely use again and if available, we highly recommend you book it!

Apartment was beautiful, clean and comfortable. We liked the location as it was centrally located and an easy walk to restaurants and El Retiro Park. The management company did a fantastic job - communication was great, accommodated our request for an early check in and check out was easiest experience we had in Spain!

Pablo Javier's place is perfect for a stay in Madrid, especially Lavapies. The location was great. It’s literally a 15-minute walk to Puerta del Sol but it’s also very central. To be honest I️ rarely used public transportation because it was always convenient to just walk but when I️ needed to it was right there.
There’s lots of restaurants and life down the street around but in the flat itself, it’s completely quiet.
PB's place is very clean and comfortable and has everything you could need. I️ would 100% recommend a stay here.
Nice flat with all practical amenities. Located in the heart of Lavapies, with no shortage of great places to eat and drink nearby. Easy check-in and check-out, and clear communication.

We stayed at Pablo’s apartment for 4 days/4 nights and it was perfect for our brief stay. It looks just like the photos and it’s in a great location. We were able to walk everywhere we wanted to go. Pablo and the Minty team were also very friendly and responsive to our messages. Just be aware that the apartment is a little bare bones - for instance, we could have used a few more towels and pillows, but otherwise it was perfect for a few days.

This is a beautiful, very comfortable apartment with everything you need for a great stay in one of the best neighborhoods in Madrid. I visit Madrid fairly often and I’ll definitely be booking here again.

Nice apartment in a very good location!
Check in was good and very responsive, just a little bit overpriced.

I loved the apartment. It is in Lavapiés. South of Puerta del Sol and east of La Latina. It has it's own culture and vibe. Loved it! From here i explored  Madrid.  Next to the apartment is a good big supermarket and metro station.. The apartment had everything I needed: nice kitchen, new bathroom plus great pressure of water, nice table to work on, lovely view on the street. So if you don't want to feel like a tourist and get a feel of the Real Madrid lifestyle while still enjoying your peace in a gorgeous clean, modern apartment.  I would highly recommend  it. It felt I was living there. The communication with Pablo was perfect and very quick. I can highly recommend it. Clean, modern, artsy, practical and  lovely area.

Great apartment in the Lavapies district of Madrid so lots of restaurants, bars culture and entertainment to chose from. Apartment was very clean and well equipped and communication with the host was easy and quick. Would happily return - highly recommended.

Excellent accommodation. Beautiful apartment, felt very cosy. Walking distance to lots of restaurants , metro and large supermarket. Excellent communication with host, very helpful with info eg how to arrange a taxi back to airport.
Would highly recommend this property.

I thoroughly enjoyed my stay here. The place was super clean and well decorated, which made me feel comfortable and at home. I worked remotely from here, and the wifi/internet worked excellent. It was in a great location close to Plaza Mayor as well all of the Golden Triangle of Art. I definitely recommend staying here when going to Madrid.
Tip - Bring an extra key ring. The ones they give you are super flimsy and the keys fall off easily. They charge up to 150 euros to replace any lost ones...
Cigarettes smell everywhere especially in the bedroom, if you are not smoker not recommended.. it was a very bad experience.. the apartment is nice as in the pictures the location is amazing..

The place was amazingly close to bars and restaurants. we had no trouble walking to the tourist attractions. The place was clean and Fernando greeted us. The balcony was very cute and the 24 hour carrefour (5 min walk) was the highlight of this accommodation! Lava pies is a very mixed neighbourhood and it’s always bustling.
The apartment was lovely, clean and walkable into the city centre. They were always responsive. Lots to do and see nearby. We had a great time!

Absolutely fabulous apartment. Amazing location, beautiful interior design with all amenities, exceptionally clean and super comfortable bedding and air conditioning. A little oasis in the middle of a colourful area, so easy to walk everywhere from amazing food  and bars to museums and parks. Hosts were super responsive and welcoming, this apartment is a gem, we would stay here again in a heart beat.

The apartment was fantastic and beautiful! It had everything we needed. Silva was amazing and met us upon check in and explained to us everything thoroughly. The balcony was gorgeous and the apartment was super spacious for two people. Netflix was available and the kitchen was well equipped however was missing basics (salt/pepper/oil) which was included in the listing. The mattress was just ok because it caved in. The apartment also had an elevator which was amazing and it was a walkable distance to restaurants, bars, supermarkets, metro. Highly recommend for the value and will hopefully be back again!
The apartment is very comfortable, clean and has great restaurants in the neighborhood. i highly recommend staying here.

My friend and I had a great stay at this airbnb. It is not in the most pretty area but it is close to everything which we liked.
Communication and check in was easy.
There is no speaker (unlike the pictures suggest) - so would recommend to bring a small one if you want to listen to music.
We had a great time and the place is perfectly fine but overall it felt a bit expensive for what it was.

Perfect location. Near two metros, several walkable museums and parks…had the best time. This apartment was very clean and cozy. I loved being able to have the windows open. From the living room, I enjoyed hearing the liveliness (not quiet) of the city, from the room at night, you can’t hear anything with the door closed… I left it open, I loved it!

good location, 2 m walk to metro, 10 m walk to plaza mayor, many markets and fast food places close by, room is as in the picture maybe a bit smaller,well cleaned, smart tv, hot water available at all times, no surprises. Jorge responded to our few messages immidiately. A few minor details would make it great.
Brilliant place for an even better price! Would highly recommend staying in Jorge's humble abode.

Great location and many places are within walk distance. Host is nice and communication is good.
The metal blinds cover about 80% of the window but not fully. The curtain is too thin to block the lights which affects sleep. This made it difficult to deal with jet lag. The pillow is not comfortable and the mattress is a little too soft to me but I understand that different people have different preference on bedding.

Great location, easy check-in. Would recommend.
Small remark - bathroom door could use some fixing, 'cause when you use them, it's like you're shaking the entire wall they're in.

Jorge’s accommodation was a beautiful and comfortable spot to stay while in Madrid. The bedding and bed were very comfortable. The place is clean and appealing in many ways. It is an ideal place for a short stay or a longer one as it has a perfect kitchenette that would allow you to do breakfast or small lunches. Jorge was also quick to respond to my messages. Gracias.
the place was amazing, host was very efficient with communication. the location was unbeatable for the price.
This is a great location with lots to see and explore within a 30 minute walk in any direction.
The apartment was pretty nice and Orlando is a really kind host. We enjoyed our stay in Madrid 🤗

The location is perfect, close to Metro and useful for getting to the airport and train station .
The place is close to everything, however, very quiet at night so anyone could get a good night sleep .
I would recommend this to anyone.

Orlando’s place is very well located, close to bars, restaurants, shops, downtown all the local attractions walkable distance, definitely will stay here in my next trips! The place is like an studio well equipped kitchen nice bathroom, everything you need! Orlando is helpful and instructed are clear!
Location was fantastic and we really enjoyed our time here! We had everything we needed for our stay. Orland was accommodating and provided all the amenities for a great stay.

Centrally located between everything you need to see and experience in Madrid. The apartment is equipped with all necessities. Small side note: bed is a bit narrow for 2 people. Good communication with Orlando and Carlos. Recommended
Perfect location at the centre of Madrid. Easy check in and good communication. The accomodation is very accurate.
Excellent location, nice apartment, and friendly/helpful host. Orlando let us check in early on short notice, which was a big help. Would recommend!
All was great with this stay! Great location, great apartment! Orlando was kind enough to allow me to drop my bags off prior to check in. All was really great! Thank you so much!
The apartment is nice! The door of the washing machine is broken but the machine works as long as you have the door shut. Keep in mind that you need to bring detergent!

The homey apartment is right in the middle of a bustling area full of stores, cafes, restaurants, bars, and clubs, yet is surprisingly quiet. It had everything I needed, was easy to access, and immediately felt like a home away from home. It is in the middle of the LGBTQ+ area of town, which was a bonus for me. The self check-in was extremely convenient, and Orlando was very quick to respond and helpful. I would definitely stay here again.

The location is excellent. The place has everything you need. It is a very old building with lots of character. However it is not well kept. The floors had a couple of nails sticking out and the washing machine’s door was broken. Also the washroom was not sparkling clean.
Great location!! Walking distance to many interest points around the city, coffee and food very convenient downstairs, safe area, perfect for chilling around the city centre.
Good location with quick access to the metro station. Orlando gave great instructions on how to get into the apartment, so the check-in was easy. We had a great time there. Thanks!

Pleasant stay in this clean cute apartment in a building catering tourists like us. Located so close to a lot of tourist spots, restaurants, coffee shops and stores.  Most are just a few steps away. One thing i noticed was that noises from the corridors outside our unit go through and we can hear commotions from other guests going in & out our floor. Even noises from the unit above us,   we were heavy sleepers so we didnt mind much.
Excellent location, very clean apartment with everything you need. Laura was very quick with communication. Would highly recommend!

Came back from dinner and found a large puddle in our luggage. A significant amount of the ceiling plaster had fallen and water was leaking from the ceiling. This severely disrupted our trip, though otherwise communication and location were good.
Everything was great! Laura is very responsive and helpful! Loved her place and will absolutely come back! Thanks!
Everything was perfect, the apartment was so clean and close to the center of Madrid, we had a good time there. Also the hosts are so kind, they helped us.
This is a great place to stay, very comfortable, great location. Super clean, we loved it.

Well located (3 min from Plaza Mayor), easy check in, good apartment with all the amenities (did not make use of the kitchen though).
Calm from the street but can sometimes be a bit noisy from people staying at the other apts in the building. However not really a problem since we stayed essentially to sleep.
In the end I recommend.

The apartment is in the very center of Madrid: you can easily reach all most famous spots.
The communication with the host is fast and I’ve got all the info that I need…

Apartment was exactly as described. Nice bunk bed for the kids. Easy access to the apartment with clear instructions from the host.
Walking distance to the rail station and most sites including restaurants.
Good value
Can recommend for a family.
The only thing was we had to be careful not to have long showers as the hot water ran out quick.
Although, my kids can sleep under the shower.
Thankyou Lago
Apartment was really clean and just as advertised. Location was really central and convenient. Enjoyed our stay.
Central location, spacious apartment. Only AC in the living area, one bedroom without window. Small shower and a bit dated. If you don’t mind that and mainly care about location; go for it

Ultimately a great place to stay. Walking distance to everything. Clean and very nice host. An FYI, our apartment was on the 4th floor and the elevator only fits two. So if you have an issue with stairs.
the appt is in the city centre. perfect if you are visiting madrid. Everything is at a walking distance. Will surely consider it again.

This house is amazing! When we arrived everything was just perfect.
It’s decorated with great taste, but above all, it is practical and comfortable.
Our children loved La Casa de los Sueños! it had plenty of wonders and spaces for them to discover and as a family (kids are 8 & 2) the stay is just as important as what the city has to offer.
We preferred not to rent a car and the house is not central, but for us it wasn’t an issue, taxis are not expensive in Madrid and they are quick to arrive when you call for them! … also Metro is super close and 20 min into town!
Communication with our host was great and they were very helpful and accommodating always.
I couldn’t recommend enough 💕 and we hope to visit again!
Gracias Belen & family x

Really great place that has everything you need especially if you’re a group of 5 or so and looking for great space. Would really recommend and Belen was very communicative. Whilst slightly further out from the central area, it’s only 15-20mins by taxi / uber

The house was wonderful. Very well appointed and clean. Belen was a terrific, responsive host. The home exceeded expectations and was an excellent base for our trip to Madrid.
Highly recommend!! Thank you Belen, for a lovely stay.

Staying at the Casa De Mi Sueños was the best part of our trip.   The house was so spacious and comfortable that we felt like we were at home.  I really liked the welcoming style of the house. It was easy to find parking on the street in front of the house.  The neighbor was very peaceful and quiet.  It was a short walk to the metro, and an easy ride to the center of Madrid.  I would totally stay here again the next time I was in Madrid.

Our family of 5 had a wonderful stay at this beautifully decorated home in Madrid. It was located just a five-minute walk from the Arturo Soria metro station. The home is in a quiet residential neighborhood across from a school where our kids even got to play soccer with some local children, which was such a fun experience for them.
The home itself is spacious, thoughtfully designed, and had everything we needed for a comfortable stay. We especially loved the children's rooms—cozy, fun, and filled with Spanish books. I even read a few stories to my child at bedtime.
We enjoyed a lovely walk to a nearby restaurant one evening, and the area felt very safe and family-friendly. The hosts were incredibly attentive and shared helpful details about the neighborhood, transportation, and places to visit.
Highly recommend this stay for families looking for a peaceful and authentic experience in Madrid.

This was our second stay at Belén's home, so enough said: we love Casa de los Sueños! Everything was as expected. Excellent host, the space was wonderful for our small family. Lots of amenities for the little ones. We love the location. Thank you Belén!!

Our five person family came to Madrid for a nearly two week vacation from the US. As one might expect, we spent a lot of time determining where to stay as that is important with a young family.
Cut to the chase, the house was amazing (clean, well designed and fit our family very well). As important, Belen was extremely responsive when a minor issue came up. The location was second to none, close enough to transit but removed enough to give our family space to unwind. Finally, there is plenty of green space within a short walk/drive (did I mention parking was very easy!) and some great restaurants as well.
If you are looking for a place to stay and you are traveling with a family, look no further!
Love everything!  Small but nothing missing!  In center city but no noise was heard!  Would return in a heartbeat

The apartment was beautifully furnished, like new, very clean, had everything we needed for a comfortable stay, and centrally located to all Madrid sights. The balconies were a lovely plus! Definitely a great place to stay!
Felix’s place was extremely well located and super clean.  He was very responsive with every question we had and very helpful.  The size of the apartment was perfect.

Nice apartment. Easy to walk around and a close by parking if you have a car and need to rent a parking space. The apartment was very clean and the windows worked really well to keep out the noise. It’s in a great location!
The place is so cute, location amazing can’t be better, 😢 the only problem is not elevator and is in the 3rd floor.
Amazing, centrally located apartment close to loads of bars & restaurants and the metro. Walking distance to all the main tourist attractions too. Would highly recommend staying at Felix's flat!
Thank you.  The apartment feels brand new and is in the perfect location for a tourist visit.  Thank you!
We had a fantastic few days in Madrid. The location couldn’t have been better and Felix was great help! Would defo go again ☺️
Great location, excellent accommodations.  Félix and the Minty team were very responsive and communicated well throughout our stay.

Host was very responsive and accommodating with letting us leave our luggage before check in.  Location was great and easy to find. Only thing that I would say is that the beds and pillows are both extremely uncomfortable and to bring your own paper towels and toilet paper as there was nothing in the apartment other than 1 roll of toilet paper on 4 guests.  The WiFi was also not the best. Otherwise we enjoyed our stay
Lovely place, clean, close to the Metro, and lots to do. One of the bedrooms is a bit noisy at night but other than that, perfect!
Great apartment. We had trouble connecting to the internet but  the problem was addressed and fixed within 24 hours.
Great location, close to everything, and very clean with great attention to detail. However, the hot water supply is limited and isn’t sufficient for more than two people to shower consecutively.
Very nice and clean place. Many activities to do nearby, and walkable distance to all the main attractions. Overall and amazing place!
Very well located, very clean and confortable house in the really center of Madrid. Highly recomanded for everything. Thanks a lot
Perfectly clean, well equipped and with a great living space, the apartment is just of the Mayor and for those who want to be in the heart of the bustle old Madrid.

Very spacious apartment. The 2 bathrooms were nice to have, esp. one attached to a bedroom. While the balconies were nice it, it is a crowded area and it was noisy. At night it was very difficult to sleep. Our hostess was very kind and helpful and overall a great spot.
Great location right off plaza mayor, walkable to the palace and prado museum.  The apartment looks  just like the pictures, and was very clean.

Botoneras is a fantastic place to stay for a small family. The location is central, accessible to all major attractions, and nearby to many delicious restaurants. The employee is friendly and responsive to our questions.

It was a nice place and they let us leave our luggage earlier, which was really nice.
Great location, good communication with the managing company.
Overall, the stay was nice.

Our stay would have been a 5-star review had it not been for the unresolved ceiling leak in one of the bedrooms that was present when we checked-in and was still there when we checked out 4 days later. We were informed of the condition on check-in and was informed it was going to be fixed within a day or 2 but there was no follow-up about it during our stay. Aside from this issue, our stay was delightful and the host(s) were very responsive and helpful with any concern that we had. We would definitely come back and recommend the place. Great location and had everything we needed.

This location was perfect! You are right at the heart of all the action! The apartment was clean and well stocked with the basics. The only 2 negatives which are not really negative is the washing machine is exceptionally loud and at night it is very loud outside, but it’s to be expected due to the location. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay. Bonus there is a grocery store right across the street!
Fantastic apartment. Central location. Walk to everything. We were there for Semana Santa and the processions went right past our balcony.

Location, location, location!  This unit has an outstanding location if you are interested in experiencing the mesones, markets, shopping and restaurants in or around Plaza Mayor.  We walked everywhere even though the subway station is an easy walk.  If you are looking for a super quiet place, this might not be for you, but if you want to experience the vibe of this area, the unit is perfect.  Every room has doors/balconies which makes it airy and full of light with the ability to close them of course making it fairly dark for sleeping.  You will not regret staying here!

You cannot ask for a better location. So many places that you can walk to or catch transportation to. Grocery store across the street was so very convenient. My complaints would be the rock hard pillows and having only 1 towel per person for the entire stay. The water heater would run out of hot water if all 5 of us showered at the same time of the day or night. In spite of the above mentioned I totally recommend staying here and would personally stay here again.
Great place overall, really ideal and  lose to the center, reccomended for family trip.
It was amazing, located in the center of everything! Had shops, food, drinks 5-10 minutes away walking. As well as a beautiful view. Definitely worth staying here!

The flat was very nice for a weekend break in Madrid, the host was very responsive and very flexible with check in and check out which was greatly appreciated.
The location was fantastic right by plaza mayor and very easy to get to.
The AC wasn’t very strong in the bedrooms which could be an issue for hotter months but was fine for our stay.
The kitchen is well equipped enough for making breakfast and they left some cleaning products too.

We stayed only one night at Pilar's place as we were only in Madrid for under 24 hours. It's location is ideal as it's between the airport and downtown. As other reviewers have said, it's not a big unit (it's an apartment that has been separated into two different units) - but it is well-equipped with everything you'll need and has modern decor. Pilar was a wonderful host - always available to help with any questions! Thanks for everything, Pilar!

The studio is superb, small but comfortable for 3/4 people, comfy bed and in a good location, metro it's less than 10 minutes walk. With connection to the airport.
The host its great and with really good communication either English or Spanish.
Will definitely recommend it and stay again when visiting Madrid.

Perfect place!! Clean, spacious, well decorated. check in was super easy and comms with the host was great. street parking available in the area.
100% would stay again and recommend 👌👌👌
Had a great night at this location. Easy to find and the check-in process was seemless. All around great location and great airbnb
We had a very nice time. We had to be in the area Hortaleza, so the apartment was located perfectly.

Overall great stay but I would say the neighbourhood is quite residential and not too much around. perfect for me as I had meetings nearby.
Host was very responsive and helpful

We had an amazing time i
and are truly grateful for the wonderful hospitality from our host. The stay was fantastic, and the location couldn’t have been better. Thank you for making our visit so enjoyable!
Very nice apartment in a quiet neighborhood with a great supermarket nearby. The hosts were also very attentive and helpful - I recommend!

Chamberi was a fabulous place to live for 3 weeks!! I loved it and the apartment was pretty and comfortable. If you like to cook, there are all kind of pots, pans, etc. to do so. Only thing that should be replaced is the juicer. The washer-dryer and dishwasher are new as well as oven. Great refrigerator also. I would definitely return to this apartment or one of the other Madrid Rental Flats' apartments.
Thanks,
Patricia L Burns
A wonderful little apartment.   Everything you could possibly need is provided, towels, hairdryer, coffee machine, etc.   The apartment is very clean.   We had a really lovely stay.

This was the best month of my life—I would absolutely stay here again if I come back to Madrid. Rosa was an incredibly gracious host. I was especially appreciative of the great air conditioning in the summer heat.
Best location, great design. I would definitely be staying again in this beautiful apartment with great hosts.

Great location, nearby everything!
The apartment was very good, everything what you need and a very cozy interior. Leon Y Victor are great host the communication went smooth.
The apartment was clean and well supplied.  Good location for restaurants, shopping, transportation.  Very nice stay.

Really central place for most of attractions in Madrid, right in the “hipster” area with lots of restaurants and bars. Great location, quiet, fully equipped, easy instruction to check-in/out, so i’m very haply with the house. Highly recommended!
Incredibly clean, smelled so nice, such a comfortable bed and shower, perfect location - all in all an incredible place and will definitely love to rebook when coming back to Madrid.

We really enjoyed our stay. The apartment was very clean, beautifully decorated and very easy to check in. So much to do in the area. We had to contact Javier about a few questions and he was very responsive. It was a bonus that there are 2 full bathrooms. The waterfall shower was nice and the water pressure was amazing. We would highly recommend this air bnb!

This was our second time staying at the Mante House. A smaller apartment, just for two, but the same quality as the bigger one. Great location near the metro and the Gran Via.
This one is on the first floor and we did hear people passing by early in the morning, likely on their way to the airport, but otherwise just as quiet.
We plan to stay here again and can't recommend it more. A great stay in a great location run by people who care.

This is a great place, in the best location, and the host was helpful and quick to respond to text messages.
Highly recommended!

The flat was greatly located and the hosts were always very responsive.   We were allowed to do an early check in and then they held or bags for us after check out until we were ready to go to the airport.   Highly recommendable!!

Nicely designed apartment with very good location. Very clean and roomy. Perfect for 2 persons to stay. Host and his colleagues are very helpful and responsive.
Just friendly reminder to open the windows when you cook as the hood is not very strong. Also there’s no elevator but 1 level walk up is no big issue.
Overall it has been a wonderful stay. It actually looks nicer and bigger than pictures especially for the living room. Highly recommend it and will definitely come back again for our next visit to Madrid !!

had an amazing stay here! the space was beautifully designed, good ac unit, amazing shower. location was great-walkable to all the main sites, tons of cute restaurants and bars nearby. would definitely stay here again !

Very comfortable place.  It has all you need to stay a few days.  Good Airconditioning, great shower, complete kitchen.  Modern and practical apartment.  Location Is very central, with many restaurants, bars, shopping, metro, bus, etc.
The apartment was immaculate and matched the description. Moreover, the hosts were very professional with explicit instructions, flexibility, and a positive attitude. 10/10!

Great apartment with beautiful renovations and upgrades! The bathroom was clean and had soap and shampoo for us to use. The sofa bed was also already set-up for us with clean sheets upon arrival which was very helpful. Great location, easy check-in process. Would stay here again.
Perfect place to stay in Madrid! For sure I will be back next time i visit the city.

Everything was perfect! The apartment was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. There’s no elevator, but it wasn’t a problem for us since we stayed on the first floor. Overall, a great stay - highly recommended!
Cecilia was very responsive and we smoothly coordinated my kind of late arrival. She prepared the room, the keys and everything went well. The negihborhood is oen my favs in Madrid!

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
My stay at Cecilia's apartment in Madrid was absolutely fantastic! Cecilia herself was incredibly friendly and welcoming, making me feel right at home from the moment I arrived. Not only did she provide excellent recommendations for places to visit and dine in the city, but her warmth and hospitality truly made my experience memorable.
The apartment itself was spotless and well-maintained, providing a comfortable and inviting atmosphere throughout my stay. I highly recommend Cecilia's apartment to anyone looking for a wonderful Airbnb experience in Madrid. Thank you, Cecilia, for your hospitality and for making my trip so enjoyable!

Cecilia’s place is clean and spacious.
The perfect location. The room has everything you needed for a short stay visit. Cecilia is an excellent host, responds to the messages right away and explains in details the directions to the apartment. I did not meet Cecilia, her daughter greeted us upon arrival, very nice and polite young woman. Gave us direction to the city and explained the apartment.
Would come again.

Great place to stay during your visit to Madrid. The location is excellent, near a metro station, in a busy neighbourhood with great night life and nice bars.
The flat is small but with all you will need, especially if you spend most of the day visiting the city, and you just need a place to rest during the night.
I definitely recommend it!

We’re stayed in this apartment for 6 nights and we loved it. It’s small, but enough for a couple or for solo travelers and has everything you need. The location is perfect, it takes 1 minute by feet to get to the nearest metro station. However we barely used public transportation because most of the attractions are within walkable distance. The neighborhood in Chueca is great, a lot of LGBTQ+ people, the level of acceptance of different people is 100. It was noisy at night as we live in the heart of nightlife, but it didn’t bother us.
I can totally recommend to stay in this place and will love to stay here again when visit Madrid.
Great host and location- it’s a busy place so a little noisy at night. Relied on a fan as there is no a/c.
The apartment was absolutely gorgeous and was in a very central location. Nicolás is a very communicative host and very helpful. I would definitely recommend this property.
The location is prime and walking distance to all the hopping spots. If you need to travel further, the metro is less than a block away. Totally worth it based on location alone! Highly recommend

Great deal and Nicolás is a very friendly man. This place is very clean and spacious. The shower runs out of hot water a bit quick but no complaints other than that.  Great balcony and great area for bars, clubs, and sooo many restaurants.

Nicolás’ flat is exactly as described on listing- in a great neighborhood, very central, and very convenient. He was incredibly responsive about the check in/check out process, and the flat had everything I needed. I would highly recommend staying here!

Nicolas was a great host. Very responsive and the communication was pleasant.
The apartment was located at the city centre. Everything was within walking distance. Shops, sightseeing, bars and restaurants were close by. The neighborhood was lively and full of energy.
The building was built in the 1800's so theres no elevator. The opening and locking of the doors were a little complicated but you'll get used to it.
It was clean and has the necessities you'll need for your stay. Would recommend! Thanks Nicolas!

Amazing location in the city centre of Madrid. Nicolas was very responsive and friendly.
I would definitely stay there again!
It was a good area, lots of stuff to do, and the place was nice and comfy!

Nicolás was a perfect! He was very responsive, friendly, and even went the extra mile to allow us to check in early. The apartment itself is very nice and comfortable. It is on a noisy street so perhaps bring some earplugs!

The apartment is very well located and that alone is worth staying. We were able to go everywhere on foot or via the different subway stations next door. The space accommodates two people well and has a good bed. The balcony facing the street is a charm. Our only complaints are: no AC and in the Madrid summer it gets a little tricky with just a fan. And the bathroom sink is not very good to use due to the marble on top. Other than that, I highly recommend.
A great place to be, the area is really good, close to most of the attractions. Nico is very responsive and the place is nice!
The host was really nice and available. The apartment is well kept and the location is really good. I recommend it.

Great location and great host. The apartment was very clean and comfortable. We had all the amenities we could require. The description matches reality. Almost everything was about 20 minutes away walking.

LOCATION LOCATION LOCATION.
Beautiful apartment perfect for a couple. Has what you need for your stay.
Nicolas was amazing and helpful. Def will stay there next time I’m in Madrid

All great for the price paid, considerably above expectations. Apartment size is good for 2 people, amazing location in Chueca, all really great. Nicolas is responsive at all times and that is also really important
As described and pictured, convenient location and Nicolas is a very responsive host - really enjoyed our time in Madrid

Nicolas is a very nice host, he allowed us to leave our bags in the appartment before check in. Excellent location, very central. The appartment is quite small, but cozy. It was very warm in the room, even without duvet. The only thing that was a problem for us is the size of the bed. Me and my partner are quite tall people, and bed is for one and a half, not double, so it was a bit tight. Despite that, eveything else was great!

This is a small flat in an amazing location. The staircase leading up to the apartment is gorgeous. The only downside was that the shelf above the sink is too low but it didn’t matter much for a short stay. You have to keep in mind that the apartment is older than brand new airbnbs but it was still very nice primarily because it was a good size and in a great location. And the host is very friendly as well.
gorgeous views from the studio along with a very nice and kind host ready to help out!
We had a really wonderful time in this property! The view of the square is amazing and Guadalupe was great to work with throughout it all.

We loved this apartment in the heart of Madrid. Beautiful view of Plaza Mayor and steps away from Mercado de San Miguel. We had Madrid locals over to the apartment and they were stunned by the size - huge by Madrid standards. Important to note, it is a 4th floor apartment with a couple of leading flights of stairs, and no elevator, so not for the faint of heart. Well worth it, though! We had a lovely stay.
Everything was wonderful! In a great location and Guadalupe was a great host even when we locked ourselves out, she came immediately to open the door! Highly recommend staying here!
A faultless stay in a beautiful apartment. Given the location and the quality, this was a steal!
Beautiful apartment in an amazing location. Extremely responsive to any question you may have and somewhere I would love to stay again.

Great apartment, clean, spacious and perfectly located.
Great time for a family of 6.

This apartment offers everything you could possibly want on your visit to Madrid. The views of the plaza are amazing! The location is central to everything and the rooms and amenities are top-notch. We would highly recommend this place to anyone!
Beautiful apartment in the heart of Madrid. Easy walk to restaurants and museums. We had a wonderful time.

This is literally the BEST location you can get with the best views. The AC is amazing and this place is super spacious for a group. Small downside is since it’s in the actual old plaza mayor building there are lots of stairs to take daily to get upstairs but we’ll worth it. Very good customer service as well.

Beautiful & spacious apartment in the heart of Madrid! It was just perfect for a long weekend with friends. The host is super helpful, even we when we forgot the house key at 5am, they helped right away. Highly recommend!

Fabulous apartment in an amazing location.
Everything is provided to ensure a comfortable stay.
Towels and holiday essentials provided such details make a difference.
Excellent hosts.
Highly recommended.

Great central location, beautiful views of Plaza Mayor, apartment was pristine clean. Monaro were very responsive to queries.
Lots of stairs to get to apartment as mentioned in other reviews so would not be suitable for everyone. But was a good workout for our group!
Our group of friends enjoyed our stay at this apartment immensely.
I would happily recommend this apartment for a stay in Madrid.

The apartment is amazing. It is in a great location surrounded by restaurants, the Plaza Mayor and the Mercado of San Miguel. You will never go hungry with all the available food options. It is also very close and walkable to many tourist locations like the Palacio Real, the Cathedral, the Gran Via and to the subway (5min walk). The apartment itself is very modern looking with every possible amenity. There are signs around the apartment that tells you how to work and find things like the cutlery. Thank god for the AC units on the bedrooms and living room. We stayed in Madrid while there was a heat wave of 103-105 degrees for 3 days. Only thing I would wish for is an elevator. There are a lot of stairs (6 flights) but the apartment itself makes you forget about them. I would definitely come back and stay here again.

The house was so clean and comfortable for the 12 of us i.e. 7 adults and 5 children.
There was a personal pin code to the house which makes it secured.
The hosts gave us clear instructions to the house.

We had a wonderful time staying within Playa Mayor. We were close to everything and especially loved getting fresh fruit from the Mercado de San Miguel. The restaurants along the roads were delicious and accommodating to 8 people. The only thing I think one needs to know when looking at this particular apartment is that you will walk 100 steps up to the apartment. It is worth the steps if you can physically walk them. We LOVED the apartment and location!
Also, the tap water was delicious!

The apartment was centrally located with lots to do at every hour of the day.  It had a great view of Plaza Mayor and is right next to El Mercado, which has great Tapas.  The house is on the “4th floor” but it’s really on three 6th or 7th floor. There are shops underneath the building and those floors aren’t counted. It was a mission to get up the 4th floor, but we made it fun.  If you have trouble going up stairs, this is definitely not a place for you.
The location is excellent! The apartment was large. The bathrooms were clean. I would stay there again anytime!

Thank you for a beautiful stay right off Plaza Mayor. In the middle of all of the action. Very responsive host when we had a heating issue and door knob issue. People were sent within the hour. Spotless and very spacious apartment. As mentioned there were numerous flights of stairs, which were fine for us, but might be an issue with others. Lots of bars and restaurants right outside the door.

Absolutely fantastic accommodation. Very central and literally everything within walking distance. Only TINEST setback is the flights of stairs up to the apartment but it adds to the experience if anything. Overall great service and very responsive hosts. 10/10.
We had a fantastic stay, the location was truly mind boggling. Just be careful of the noise alarms - even if you are not having a party (which is of course strictly prohibited).
Great little apartment for a couple , in a really cool part of Madrid but you can’t hear it from the place

Excellent clean and modern renovated place within an older historical building. The bed rise to the ceiling and you can pull it down for the night. The washroom is well equipped with great hairdryer, various amenities and even tissues and q-tips.

Tania's place is great: the location is central and a lot of the attractions can be reached by foot. It's very clean and exactly the right size for a person traveling alone (and would be ok for a couple). Tania and her mother in law were very nice and helpful, and let me store my luggage with them for a few hours after checkout.
The only downside: the apartment's window (and bed) is RIGHT next to the neighbor's door. I woke up every time the neighbor entered and exited the apartment, sometimes in the middle of the night. She also smokes outside her apartment and i had to sleep with the windows closed so the smoke won't get into the apartment.
But overall a very good experience!

Pros
- amazing optimization of a small place
- beautifully decorated, everything was new
- spotless, clean
- the most equipped Airbnb I’ve ever seen, it had literally everything
- great communication with host, extremely responsive
Cons
- no cons
100% recommended

We had a great stay. Tania and Maria were so kind and the apartment was ideal for two people wanting to explore the city!
We would definitely come back again :)
It’s a nice place that uses its space very well. The location is great - on a street that isn’t very busy but within a reasonable walk to a lot. Checking went fine despite a language barrier.
Excellent location! Super responsive host and modern accommodation, the space of the apartament was organized in a very good way.

Stayed at Tanias place for 4 nights and we had an absolutely amazing stay. Everything from check-in to check-out was fantastic. The apartment had everything and more that we needed - including a stocked fridge/cupboards/ and fresh fruit for us! It was an amazing stay for two of us, very cozy and in a great location walking distance to so many things. Couldn’t have been happier and would love to stay again if we come back to Madrid!

This was the perfect spot in Madrid - such a cute and safe neighbourhood with thrift shops and restaurants- walking distance to so many tourist attracts and close to a metro stop which made arriving from the airport so easy :)  so clean and modern would definitely stay again!

Loved Tania's airbnb. The apartment itself is definitely on the smaller side. As a solo traveler, I think it fit well, and having a kitchenette was useful. I think it would be a bit tight to have any more than 1 person here.
The area is pretty walkable, but also has convenient public transit nearby. The space is comfortable, and the rising bed is convenient for making the space feel bigger.

We enjoyed our stay at your place. Definitely worth coming back for. There were fast and clear instructions and communication and shampoo etc at arrival.
Only downside was the fact that the boiler was too small for a 6-person apartment leading to cold water as from the second person in the shower.
But in general, very nice stay!
Everything as seen in the pictures. Emelio is a great host, and always stand by for all your questions. Definetly Will book again!

A really unique space with big, thick, old fashioned walls on one side and ultra modern design inside. A great space to base yourself in Madrid - we were in the heart of everything and could easily pop in and out between trips. Emilio was very prompt and thorough in keeping us informed. Enjoy this space in Madrid.

We had originally booked another home but when we arrived in Madrid, the host stopped responding. We were stuck at the airport with no place to go and exhausted. I contacted various hosts.
Emilio was amazing. He responded quickly and allowed us to check in earlier.
The home was centrally located… within walking distance to everything…which was perfect. The only issue was that the property is in front of a bar and people hung outside drinking and eating until late hours of the night. Thank you, Emilio!!!
Lovely place with nice host! The water heater was having some problems at that time and the host help us to deal with it efficiently!
Really nice space in downtown. The location is just perfect. Emilio is always willing to help and to provide good recommendations of places to go! Highly recommended

Emilio’s place was very cool, interesting and comfortable. The design is totally unique and makes the best use of the space’s features. It’s such a fun place to hangout and come back to after a long day of exploring Madrid. It’s also next to so many sights, restaurants and shops that it would take several pages to list them all. A great place to start exploring from.
Hey the apartment is great!! all works well, very nice place and great location! Thank you!

Javier! Just thanks a ton for all you did. Madrid is an amazing city and with the stay at your house , the overall experience was simply excellent. Used quite frequently AirBnB and really never had such a smooth stay (zero complexity on check in, amazing treat with water and coffee available for free, and very nice house)!
Thanks once again!
Best,
Edoardo

Very easy access to the flat.
Very central.
One bedroom has no door.

The apartment was great and comfortable.
The location is very convenient but loud specially at nights, which is expected being in plaza del Sol.
Great location,  clean apartment of decent size. Javier is very responsive in answering questions, and the instructions for checkin is clear.  Great experience, highly recommended!

Pros: Great location and very responsive host. Bed was very comfortable. Soap quantity in bathroom and kitchen was sufficient. There were sufficient spare linens including bed sheets and towels.
Cons: AC and AC remote not functioning as expected. Spent a considerable amount of time trying to make the AC work on multiple days. the fragrance in the house was a little overpowering for me. There was water leaking from underneath the shower door. I have requested the host to have more toilet paper in the future.

This airbnb was exactly what we were looking for. If you're visiting Madrid, the location is central and walking distance to all of the shops, restaurants, landmarks, etc. The space was also clean and comfortable, with a beautiful view overlooking the square. The hosts even called us to make sure we got settled in okay and also to see if we needed anything. They also had great recommendations for things to do/see while in Madrid. Very friendly!! Highly recommend
This was an amazing stay! I was located in the perfect location, right next to the metro exit and in a perfect location to easily walk to all main attractions. Would definitely stay again!

We’ve been to Madrid several times and probably will be looking up this apartment for the next time. The location is unmatched. Sol is the heart of Madrid, and with windows looking over the square, you can’t be in a better spot. The home was clean and beautifully decorated. We also appreciated the responsiveness from the hosts and well as their attentiveness.

We really enjoyed the stay. The location of the flat is great, you can reach most of the places of interest by foot and there are many great restaurants and bars close by. One downside of the flat is that it is quite loud, but this didn’t bother us too much.
This is the most beautiful airbnb I have ever stayed in and the location is amazing. Could not have asked for a better experience! Seriously - it jaw dropping beautiful.
The apartment was clean and as described and shown in photos. Well equipped kitchen incl toaster and kettle, and bathroom was modern with a good hairdryer. Good value for money in a great location.
The apartment was super cute and the neighborhood was near everything. They were also very accommodating with check-in/check-out! Highly recommended!

The apartment is spacious for living area.
The location is very walkable to restaurants & shopping & historic sites.
Great location, good price for what you get, well furnished. Responsive host. Only downside is that the main room is not very well sound-isolated. I highly recommend.
Very central.  Well located to all aspects of Madrid. Secure and safe. Only downside was noise as on street level but common place throughout Madrid.

Great location and good value but it’s better for friends rather than 2 couples as one double bed is in the lounge area and both bathrooms are in this area also instead of en suite. It is quite noisy in Friday and Saturday nights but it’s not to bad on other nights.

Stayed 10+ days while working from home! Very spacious spot for 2! Nice apartment in a fun area of Madrid! I think working from home I would have preferred some more natural sunlight but it wasn’t bad. Thanks and hope to be back in the future
Great modern apartment, close to cafes, ground floor no stairs 👍a little noisy but to be expected, very big and great spot. Enjoyed our stay!!

Slept 6 fine. Nice laundry facilities.
Street level apartment - noise level was louder than expected. We were given #6 street number, but when waiting at the #6 door we realized we were at the wrong door...directions were unclear.
Cleaning lady showed up two hours early so we were rush to check out earlier than expected.
We had an amazing time! Great place to stay and near lots of places to walk. Beautiful place!

We totally recommend it! We had a great time in the apartment, it was clean, everything was working and exactly as described/shown in the photos. The beds were comfortable and the the shower had good water pressure. The hosts were always very nice and responsive. The location of the apartment is amazing very well served by restaurants, supermarkets, parking and metro station though is walking distance from all the attractions. We did everything on foot!
The only thing i should mention is that, because is a ground level apartment, sometimes we heard some noise from people passing on the street, but nothing that would prevent us from coming back!

Great location in the city. Easy communication and flexible check-in. Comfortable and met our needs.
On the ground floor with a bedroom to the street, so a light sleeper can definitely hear cars and people during the night.
Overall good experience.

This a really good department, we felt really comfy. The location is awesome, so close to main things to see and close to the metro (the closest is 5 min far).
Just the light went off 5 times in 2 days and the partly hot water went off.

Great home and great host! Carolyn was extremely helpful and was very responsive to any inquiries we had. She made sure  to reach out and keep us updated every step of the way and constantly followed up with us to make sure we had a great stay.

Definitely worth staying here.
It was a quick (~15 min) walk from gran via. The neighborhood itself is very charming. Cute bars all around and grocery/convenience stores within 10 mins walking if you need anything.
The apartment was great. It has everything you need. The water pressure in the showers was good (but hot water runs out fast). The beds, including sofa bed, were reasonably comfy. WiFi worked perfect. Super communicative hosts. Check-in and check-out were super easy.
The only downside is that it’s somewhat noisy at night, but Madrid is a major city - you can’t really escape that.
I enjoyed my stay here and would definitely repeat it the next time I’m in Madrid.

We had a good time at Carolyn's place.
The house was clean, the host was responsive, and the location is great.
Just one caveat - the house is not super comfortable for more than 4 guests since the 2nd bedroom does not have a door so lacks privacy.
Rest, everything else was great 😊

The apartment is very nice and comfortable! Location is very convenient, near shops and public transport.
jorge was very helpful and friendly, he’s a super host!
This apartment was beautiful and in a great location close to amazing food, coffee shops, and the centro! The host, Jorge was really helpful and everything was super smooth. Definitely recommend it!

This property is in a perfect location, close to the center and walking distance to several places. The street has the cutest bars and a delicious Brunch spot. The flat was clean and very comfortable.  The flat is on the 4th floor with an elevator, no air condition but with the windows open the flat remains cool. Be prepared to eat all of your meals out as the kitchen is not very well equipped with plates. Overall great experience and would definitely stay here again.

Overall it was a wonderful stay.
In this crazy warm weather it was very refreshing that each room has an air conditioning.
The location is also super nice, we found a local cafe for breakfast and it was close by Gran Via st.
We were short on toilet paper and kitchen paper towels, but did not hassle the owner and just bought some ourselves.
We enjoyed our stay at Jorge's airbnb. The check in was easy, the apartment was light and airy and very comfortable! We would stay at this airbnb again!
Everything was perfect, cleanliness, check in, and very well situated in the hart of Madrid. Totally recommended!
A beautiful apartment in the middle of everything, it has everything you need to enjoy your time in Madrid

Overall it was a great experience. Great location, modern apartment, walking distance from everything, spacious and beautiful.
Few small comments:
- Apartment door was very hard to open.
- There was a bit of noise coming from outside in one of the rooms.
- The host was a bit slow to answer.
Everything was very good, the house is very well located, modernly rehabilitated and with all the necessary facilities for a pleasant stay. Thank you, Jorge
Very friendly and great communication. Apartment was clean and in an ideal location. Would recommend to anyone!

Apartment was clean and very conveniently located. Within walking distance to all the main shops and access to great cafes and restaurants. Jorge was very flexible with the check in process. The listing notes dryer as an amenity but was unable to locate it in the unit.  Definitely recommend!

During my stay, the host was incredibly responsive, making the entire check-in process super easy. The apartment was fantastic, located in a prime area and exceptionally clean. I had a wonderful experience and would highly recommend this Airbnb!

This apartment was in a wonderful location near Atocha train station and the Reina Sofia museum. An interior apartment so it was quiet and away from the street cafe noise. It was a bit dark with no direct sunlight but manageable. Supermarkets were just minutes away and the apartment was served very conveniently by buses and  and a very close Metro stop.  I particularly liked the neighborhood - very central to everything yet very residential at the same time. Communication was excellent with Margarita.

The apartment was very comfortable, clean and cosy as stated on the description. Location was perfect close to restaurants, shops, train station, a very nice bakery across the building and most of all a local wet market 'Mercado' to buy fresh food. In my opinion, It's not necessary to explore Madrid Central by train, most places can be reached by foot that would be the best option 😊.
This apartments is also good for long stay and would recommend it. It's safe and quiet and communication was easy with Marisol and she ensures that your stay is comfortable 🤗. Thank you Marisol!

We loved this place! It was perfect for me and my partner. The subway and bus stop were very close and walkable to restaurants and grocery stores. Margarita was very kind and helpful with any questions we had.

Good location with many restaurants, cafes, and supermarkets in walking distance. Metro station is just 5 min walk.
Water pressure from the shower is not strong enough and hot water will run out quickly. Better to wait 30 min for the 2nd person to take shower.

Nice and clean apartment. Great communication. Offered everything we could have asked for.
It was a wonderful vacation!

Great Airbnb and central in Madrid with lots of grocery shops and businesses around. Please note that parking in the area is very expensive (it is Madrid :)). Also for parents of infants, the cot/crib for your baby CANNOT be booked in advanced (i.e., availability confirmed on the day the stay starts upon contacting the host). We had to rent a crib/cot from My Little Rider to be sure to have one.

Was great stay, spent two nights with friends.
Place is calm and peaceful. Close to public park, restaurants, and grocery.
Highly recommended.

We were staying for 3 nights before Boom festival, and the apartment was perfect for our needs, the area is a bit far from the center but very nice and we didn’t miss anything by being a bit far, we actually preferred it. :)

The location of the apartment is fantastic and offers a lot of possibilities, e.g. sightseeing, partying…
Daniel is a great host and makes the stay very easy. Communication and Check-In were perfect and everything worked well.
The Airbnb has everything you need if you want to explore Madrid, absolutely to suggest!
Daniel is extremely communicative, the flat is located in a central location nearby multiple metro lines, grocery stores as well as restaurants, shopping and night life.
It’s a place to live the fully Madrid experience! A little bit noisy, but easy to move around the city.

Amazing location! You should know a few things about this listing: people are in and out as there will be other guests. They may come home at 5am from partying and they may be loud :)
