Our room with the window smelled like smoke. this is hard to avoid because people in the complex blow smoke out of their windows and if the window is open, it will smell like smoke. when we arrived and the whole stay our room smelled of smoke.
Those were the cons, everything else about this place: great location, great host and communication, affordable, and again, a great location!!
Thank you Daniel and Marlon!

Daniel's place was great for the value. Him and Marlon were very communicative and super friendly. They provided us with information before our arrival and Marlon met us at the door for check-in. In regards to the place, it is a good deal for the place. Just to let you know it is smaller than your typical American room. It did not bother us as much as we were out for most of the day and only needed a place to sleep. Just a heads up that there is only one restroom in the apartment that is shared with other guests. So restroom wait times may be long if someone is showering. Other than that the place was clean, it had the necessary accommodations, and was close to public transportation. Would definitely recommend if visiting Madrid.

Unfortunately we had to leave the apartment the same day we checked in because of personal problems. Host was above understanding, he was extremely polite and he even gave us our money back. We will be back as soon as we can!

Daniel and Matteo were very nice hosts that always responded very quickly and in a very friendly manner. You could ask them everything and they were trying everything in their power to make your stay as pleasant as possible. The apartment was also gorgeous and above all the location of the place was just fantastic. In the whole area you can find top places to go for lunch dinner or simply a coffee. I would recommend this place to everybody who is on the search for something very central and with a great price-performance ratio!
Beautiful stay, fantastic hosts. I stayed as a solo female traveller and felt incredibly safe throughout my stay. The balcony view was my favourite feature!

This appartement was amazing! It was extremely clean and the hosts were super friendly and ready to answer all of our questions. The location is perfect because it is next to all the shops and lots of cool bars and restaurants!
I would definitely recommend it ;)
Daniel was super responsive and helpful throughout the whole stay. Very nice and nice place as it’s in a great area.

Very good stay, the location is very advantageous, close to the metro station, but not too close to the center, which means without quantities of noises. The room is clean, the roommates I met are also very generous and helpful.
I had an excellent stay with Daniel! The flat is well located - right in the middle of all things wonderful in Madrid, super clean and just what needed!

We had a good stay at Beky's place. Couple of young kids came to meet us and showed us in. They were very sweet. When we asked for an extra set of keys, they were immediately dropped off. I guess the only thing that we didn't realise that there were no windows out onto the street, they were all internal windows onto light wells. Having said that, there was enough light coming in and the apartment was quiet. Metro was only a short walk away.

The location is good. Easy access to the metro and not far from the center. It was quite difficult to find a free parking place, but we managed to do it in radius of 5-7 min walk. Big apartment, suitable for a big company. Beky’s a very responsive host and everything went well
Lovely stay here in a great area! Lots of amazing restaurants and easy to walk just about anywhere.

This apartment is so nice! A perfect peaceful place to call home for your stay. The neighborhood is very fun to stay in and walking distance to so many great parts of Madrid. Emilio was very helpful with all of our needs and always responded very quickly. Check in and out was a breeze which left us plenty of time to explore the city. Highly recommend!
Great apartment! Clean, great location, comes with everything you'd want. Only downside is that the keys need to be picked up ca 20 minute walk away. Would stay here again!
Amazing neighborhood location and incredibly clean throughout. Lift was fast and bedroom was quiet even on weekend nights. There’s even an oven! Easy check out as well.
Super cute and clean, better than the photos! Emilio and his team are great, quick to respond. It’s also in a great location!
Very much enjoyed this space. The light was my favorite part. It was so well appointed and I really felt at home.
A quaint stay in the heart of Gran Vía, Emilio’s location had great walkability to everything you will need during your time in Madrid. I highly recommend this location for anyone!

Location, location, location! It was perfect for site seeing and eating well in Madrid. There is an abundance of coffee shops, restaurants, and super markets nearby to make this an awesome home base.
The living area was cozy for relaxation or even preparing snacks. The bed was a bit too firm for our liking, but that’s just preference. Highly recommend!

Great apartment, as described; clean, comfortable and well equipped. Location is perfect with lots of bars & restaurants on the doorstep but not noisy inside. Sloping ceiling is quite low on one side of the bedroom, not a big issue but if you are v tall, worth noting! Good there is a lift for the 5th floor!

The apartment is very good. The second bedroom is a bit small but everything was clean and organized. I feel like they could have left a few amenities such as coffee, sugar dishwasher detergent, garbage bags, etc for all the days. The location is great, close to metro station and many restaurants and stores near by. I would stay there again and would recommend this place to friends and family going to Madrid.

Marco has the right balance of support and respecting your privacy. He is willing work with you to solve any issues that might arise and quick to provide support when you do have a request to make … not that you have to much of a need to anyways. The app was a great tool for navigating the apartment and surroundings and his description of the apartment was flawless and apt. My family had a great experience with this spot and we plan to be back soon. Thanks Marco
Well located if you go to Caja Magica. Place is nice and has an amazing huge terrace. We had a great stay. Good neighbourhood to discover if you like to explore other parts of Madrid!

If you are looking for a place with lots of character, this is not it. If you are looking for something clean, comfortable, and in a good location with ready access to transit, this place definitely fits the bill. The beds were comfortable. Good water pressure in the showers. The outdoor patio space was a bonus for sure.

MIT House was great! The apartment was clean and is better in person. The place fit our
family of 5 comfortably so that was great! The only downside is that if youre coming during the winter, it gets really hot in the apartment. We followed the instructions that was given for the thermostat and the host sent a technician to help but still it was extremely hot in the apartment especially at night so it was impossible to have a good nights rest. Other than that it was a great place to stay, a 15min uber/taxi ride to all the tourist sites and shopping. Thank you for having us, your place is gorgeous!

This was a very nice apartment at a reasonable price. We had 4 people in the unit and it was perfect. It's within walking distance to the metro and there is a grocery store nearby. The apartment was very clean and the amenities were as advertised, 10/10 would recommend.

Although the location is very good and the building as well as the apparement are both really nice, I found that the kitchen is really minimally equipped. No food at all such as a bottle of oil, vinegar, salt and pepper to avoid buying everything the very first day of our stay. This is the spirit of airBnB I believe otherwise I would go to hotel.

Although we had some troubles with the Aircondition, which was a bit slow at cooling down, we had a great stay me and my friends😃
Definitely recommend👍🏻

Great location and overall a pleasant stay. We were there during a heat wave, and the AC—controlled by the building—struggled to keep up, so it got quite warm. Still, the apartment was clean, spacious, and perfect for exploring Madrid.

The apartment is beautiful., with modern furniture, attention to finishing details, and cleanliness. It has a home away from home feeling. The apartment is in a residential neighborhood, but very alive and a short walk from everything. It was very easy to settle in and immediately find my way around, especially with the help of Ukio operational team. They promptly answer every request almost around the clock, including their recommendations and guidance on restaurants, cafes, printshops, supermarkets, and many more. All their recommendations are top quality! The check-in and cleaning services are so well organized and coordinated. I highly recommend staying with them as i will always do.

We enjoyed our stay. We would have liked advance notice of the enormous hole in the ceiling which we were told would be fixed during our stay which it wasn’t, but though it was very ugly, it didn’t affect our stay.
The kitchen was poorly equipped and tired but we were happy that utensils were brought over to us when we requested them. The beds were extremely comfortable and the location was excellent though. Overall a good place to stay

The stay was good.  The only thing is the parking . You need to figure out where to park since the property don’t provide a parking spot or street spot . So public parking close by around 34euros / night

The apartment is great, well located and the communication with Minty, the asset management company, Minty, was very good.
Attention though! If you have a car, or rent one, this location has a few public parking, but very EXPENSIVE ones. We paid 33EU per day!
Very good location, all big attractions are within walking distance. It’s very clean and spacious, the hosts are great. but the walls are quite thing so you can hear all the neighbours.
The stay was really nice. Good communication with the host and the flat had everything I needed for 1 month. The only downside is little light in the flat as the apartment is on the ground floor.

All good and meeting expectations. Neighborhood was quite, good communication. Although personal check-in is required, Ruth made it possible as I was arriving around midnight (extra fee as stated in the listing).

The apartment and the building itself is very new. It was clean and perfect fit for 2 persons. The wifi works perfectly fine. There is a supermarket 3 minutes from the apartment. But the apartment is 10 minutes away from metro station.
If you understand spanish, it will be easier for you to communicate. But Esther is very kind and response very quickly.

This immaculate studio apartment is self-contained and located in a modern, purpose-built building with a convenient lift that takes you straight to the door. The kitchen and bathroom are of the highest quality and are well-maintained. The property offers exceptional convenience, with a supermarket literally on the doorstep, along with various bars and restaurants. Additionally, the train station is just a 5-minute walk away. I highly recommend this property for its outstanding quality, convenience, and excellent value for money. It truly deserves the highest praise. A++++

The apartment was ok. The location was good. The communication with the host was not very efficient. Jorge responded my questions but with very vague information. We could not know the exact location of our booking and details of how to check- in until a few hours before the exact day of our arrival what caused a little discomfort.

The location was amazing, just off the main streets so it was quiet and good for sleeping. We had no need to use the metro as everything was walking distance. The apartment itself was clean and comfortable, we would stay again.
Great host lovely place would definitely stay again , fully recommend if you want to be near all the spots.

Well located apartment; close to many sights, restaurants and the metro. The accommodation was clean and easy to find. Jorge was responsive to any questions we had. Everything pretty much matched the listing, except for the bathroom. The pictures showed a bath, but we got a shower instead. It wasn’t a big deal for us though and we still had a great stay!
It was excellent location. Easy walking to almost all the famous places. Many restaurants and a lot of variety to choose from. We’re very happy with the place.

This is a very modern apartment with easy access to public transit, restaurants, shops, and grocery stores. Parking can be tricky, so if you are bringing a car, study Madrid parking regulations carefully. Generally, blue spaces are free overnight, but you must pay between 09:00 and 21:00. Do ensure that you lock your car every time you leave it. It is a safe area, but we arrived late at night and had a carjacker jump in our unlocked vehicle left unattended for only a few seconds. He was unsuccessful since we had the key, but just be careful to always lock the vehicle. Dani is a very communicative host and the self check in process was easy. The apartment itself is beautiful and close to the palace. I would definitely stay here again.

Excellent apartment with 4 large bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, a full kitchen and tons of space. I would recommend this apartment to any large group. The location was good with lots of restaurants, bars, and grocery stores. We were even able to find parking on the street overnight in the blue lines.
Daniel was a super responsive host and handled all situations with options and quickly! A huge thank you! With 12 people, it was great to all stay together and have someone help make it easy
A really great location and a wonderful flat. Great for a large family to explore Madrid with east access to the city centre via the Metro or walking.

A great apartment. Was very clean and well maintained. Bathrooms and rooms as described. Plenty of space. Many beds so great for a large family with kids or two families staying together. Great location with metro access within a block or two of walking. Several markets and restaurants right nearby. Air condition worked very well. Would absolutely stay there again if we were in Madrid.

Close to metro and shops, lift to take luggage up to first floor, good size rooms and comfortable beds, spotlessly clean and excellent communication from hosts. The only thing that could be improved is the air con which is a little slow and not super cold, but there were also fans in every room so we didn’t suffer!

Really well equipped place with all the necessary details. Very clean and cozy. Super close to a metro and quiet.
We stayed two families of 11 people in total - it was excellent!
Great location in heart of Malasaña, easy walk to shopping, food and metro. We only stayed one night but the bed was super comfy.
Fantastic stay. Excellent host and flexible check in. The location could not be in a better spot in Malasaña.

Great find. Felt very safe in this neighborhood. Location was perfect - you walk outside and there are great restaurants, bars and shops. Zella was very flexible and responsive and provided a clean space that made our trip very enjoyable!
Great little apartment in a funky part of Madrid. Everything you need for a short stay. The only thing that would make it better is air conditioning but the ceiling fan works well!

Zelia's place was perfect for my stay in Madrid as I used it to work and explore the city. The neighborhood is excellent, so that's an easy 5/5 on the location. Everything you need is right outside the front door (or at least within a couple blocks). If you like to walk, you can get to all the city center highlights from here. It's not the largest space, but it's laid out well, very functional, and I felt right at home. Big thanks to Zelia for being flexible and available to hand off the keys at check in even though I had some travel delays.
I had a wonderful stay in the apartment. it is clean and cosy and has all necessary amenities. The location is excellent. Most importantly the host is very friendly and helpful.

I had a excellent stay at Zelia’s place.  It is truly a hidden gem.  It is within walking distance of major streets, great restaurants, and shopping areas.  It’s very cozy and looked exactly like the pictures.  Zelia was extremely helpful, making sure check in went smoothly and providing  great suggestions for restaurants. I highly recommend Zelia’s place.

The apartment was great for a central stay in Madrid.  The apartment was quiet despite being right by tons of resturants and shops.  The bed was super comfy.  I loved all the nice decor touches and everything was very modern and clean.  Zelia was very responsive as well! Would recommend!
Zelia‘s place is in the heart of all the action in Madrid! The place itself is cozy. Zelia was also very understanding of me checking out 15 minutes late because I overslept! Will stay again.
The Airbnb was perfect and matched the description, making it ideal for one person. The host was super responsive and gave great recommendations for places to eat.

Zelia’s place is perfectly located in one of the coolest neighborhoods in Madrid. There’s always people around so it’s very lively, but the apartment itself is so quiet and it got everything you need. It’s small and cozy, just enough for one person (or a couple). The bed was so comfortable, it gets cozy and warm if you use the electrical heater in winter. Zelia was communicative and very kind.

Zelia’s place was very adorable and even though it was small, she made sure we had everything we needed for a great stay. We were pleasantly surprised at how quiet it was considering how busy the neighborhood was. It was a great location in the middle of Madrid. Lots of restaurants and bars.

Zelia’s place was perfect for my wife and I. Getting in was slightly confusing for us, but Zelia was super responsive and made our check in seamless. The place was clean and cozy, and tucked in the cutest neighborhood with plenty to do. Would recommend.
Great central location and the apartment was incredibly quiet given the bustling neighbourhood. Zelia was very direct and helpful with instructions. A great little base in Madrid!

This is a great flat (for 2 people) and a great location. Our flight was delayed and we didn’t land until the early hours and Antonio still met us to check in and was a great host. Nothing was too much trouble.
Would highly recommend.

Great place to stay!! It matches the pictures perfectly - not too big, but just what we needed for a few nights. It’s in a great area so we were able to walk around La Latina very easily, or get to the metro in just a few minutes’ walk. The host was very responsive & easy to work with!

It was an overall great stay, it is in the heart of the city. Communication was solid and they coordinated to meet me at the apartment for check-in the same time I arrived in the city.
It was such a great stay that the only bad thing I have to say is that the wi-fi could be faster. Thank you!

The location was really good and the host was very friendly however there were some issues.
The pictures are misleading and do not represent the apartment well. It is dated and there is little nature light. The wifi did not work for us. There were no duvet covers for the pull out bed. The mattress on the pull out bed was very thin. There was no soap in the bathroom which really is not hygienic.

Kike's place was great. We had lots of water and other things to enjoy during our stay. He was very responsive and even helped us secure tickets to a Champions League game. The apartment is really nice and everything was pretty easy to access.
Kike was very communicative and was able to remotely help with the laundry machine and any questions we had. It was unfortunate that we couldn't stay the whole time but Kike was helpful with our issue at the apartment. I would definitely recommend the apartment.

Great place in a great location! Kike was super helpful and considerate. Really appreciated the complimentary snacks, treats and fully stocked fridge with the essentials. Would recommend to anyone thinking of staying in Madrid and would definitely stay here again.

I was amazed and completely blown away by the Airbnb and host, Kike. Kike was very responsive and made sure to answer any questions I had. The location of the Airbnb itself was perfect. It was 10 minutes to the Gran Via. Everything surrounding the Airbnb was awesome too - bars, restaurants, galleries. The location was awesome! I appreciated the eggs, bread and oranges provided by Kike to make breakfast. If you are staying in Madrid, I highly recommend staying here!

Instead of writing a long essay about how amazing my stay was in this place, I'll just write that I have been in over 20 apartments in Madrid and this was the BEST!
Can't thank Kike enough for his amazing hospitality. Great place, great host, all the rest is up to you.

a great apartment with an even greater host. it's a very well equipped apartment with attention to every need and detail, I would say better than a stay at a 5 star hotel. the neighbourhood is very safe and calm even at night but still close to the center of madrid which makes it the perfect location. as for the host, he made sure everything was available to make the stay as comfortable as it can be. he was also easy to reach on the app and answered quickly. I will for sure be choosing this apartment again for my next stay. many thanks to Kike for making this trip memorable.

Amazing location and great apartment with all the amenities. Kike is an awesome host. Very responsive and helpful. I wish I could have stayed longer. I highly recommend staying here if you are visiting Madrid!

The host was thoughtful and easy to communicate with. The house had all the essentials and more for guests to use. The location couldn’t have been better. Instructions for the house and entry were very clear. It was a truly enjoyable stay that met my expectations.
The place was very clean. It has lots of extras around the apartment including the kitchen area and the bathroom.

Kike was an exceptional host, very communicative and friendly. The place was a very nice size and was well stocked with lots of amenities. Kike made it feel like you were right at home. Bed was super comfortable. Definitely recommend!

Very proactive and friendly host! Always available for answering questions and doubts. Got the cleaning done also in the middle of the stay. The location is great, very central. The road is narrow and does not let the apartment becoming too hot: I only turned on the A/C when Madrid was hitting 37-38 C! The only (known) downside was the smell of smoke which lasted even though the house has two air purifiers.

excellent option to stay in Madrid with a full equipped flat one block from metro station, supermarkets and restaurants .
amazing host very flexible and always attentive. recommended 100000%

The apartment was incredibly clean and comfortable, within walking distance to line 7 of the metro. it's a safe and quiet neighborhood, but with many places to eat and drink. The two sofa beds were very comfortable. The only negative was the lack of privacy in the apartment as neither room has a door. One bathroom was completely done in glass so everyone sitting in the living room can see you as you shower or go to the bathroom. We were happy to have the downstairs bathroom to use!
Very clean in a great neighborhood of Madrid. The hosts are responsive and allowed us to check-in early after a morning flight into the city.
We enjoyed our stay.  The apartment was very comfortable, clean and within walking distance of several metro stops.
We had an efficient extended stay here.  It was well stocked, easy to cook simple meals, and nice to have extra space to exercise with rugs.  Having our own laundry, washer and dryer, was ideal.

Very friendly and helpful host, clear detailed instructions and a lovely little place. I had to work so the kitchen table became my office and it worked out just fine. There is even a multi plug adapter at one of the electrical outlets.
I did some cooking and they have a great new fridge and new kitchen utensils and pans. The corner shop has lovely fruit and there are several supermarkets around.
I was surprised at how quiet it was given that the apartment is at street level and with a glass door. Overall a great place, I will definitely be back.

Loved everything about our stay. Only issue is that it’s on street level and the door is glass, so when people pass by, it can be a little unnerving. Also, in the downstairs area, there was a sewage smell coming from one of the holes in the ground that I covered with a pillow. Otherwise, we had a great time!

Excellent location and very modern apartment. Had a very nice stay.
The pictures show clearly, just be prepared for the clear glass swinging door leading to the main floor bathroom!
A really great place to stay in Madrid! So close to everything the city has to offer and in a really cool neighborhood!

Well located on a side street, but otherwise fairly close to the action. The apartment is nice, clean, and fairly quiet. I found it a good base to the neighbourhood and Madrid in general. The only downside is that there is not a lot of natural light in the place.
The apartment is just around the corner from one of together main arteries of Malasaña - very convenient location. The decor is nice and the space is cozy. Perfect for a solo traveler.

Excellent communication with the host. Very good location, in the middle of a very popular neighborhood, yet very calm. The apartment faces a small patio, and daylight is scarce. Modern and tasteful interior. We were very happy with our stay and have no complaints.
Great location. Very confortable place.  Has everthing needed to enjoy the apartment. It is exactly as shown in the pictures.  Well decorated, full of nice details.  Will be back here for sure

This a really beautiful and comfortable place to stay, and looks exactly like the pictures! The flat is spotlessly clean, and has everything you need - good water pressure in the shower, and great lighting. The area is lovely and you're close to lots of lovely restaurants, bars and vintage shops. Because it's an interior apartment it's still very quiet which is really nice, considering where it is.
My hosts were really accommodating and flexible and I would definitely stay again!
Nice place for some days. Clean and well maintained. It is an interior basement so no daily light, noise when people pass by in front
Great location, super friendly host. They waited for us though our flight got delayed. The place felt really cosy and just a 5 min walk away from supermarket and Tribunal station.
I had to go to Madrid for a wedding and decided to stay a little longer since I came from America. I had a great experience!

Amazing place and amazing host.
Will defiently come back and stay if I come back to Madrid. 10/10.

Great location, accessible to the Metro. Nice aerea and very safe.likw the place very much and We had everything we needed.
Thank you.

The location is the best, it is also very close to metro tribunal, the apartment is renovated, comfortable and clean. Check in was easy. I really recommend it.
The 2 windows faces the patio, there is not much light coming from outside but you will be out all day in Madrid :)

Honest summary of the stay:
- Amazing location/downtown, 5min walk to everything.
- Looks exactly like the pictures, no surprises.
- Was clean and very well kept, incl towels and sheets.
- Iron, washing machine and all other appliances were working perfectly.
- Check in/out was very smooth and flexible. (+/- 1hour)
- Owners are lovely, spoke English & Spanish, were very helpful and attentive.
- Neighboors are sweet and polite.
- Very calm at night, no busy street and noises.
Highly recommended for a hassle free, hotel-like experience. Will 100% book the same exact Airbnb next time i visit, wouldn't have it any other way!
Thank you guys for the lovely stay <33
Nice apartament, Just as describen. Pretty News. No natural light but mencioned. I had a very nice stay.

We had a very nice stay. The communication was great, the location was great and we felt very comfortable. The only thing I would criticise is that there is hardly any daylight in the flat. However, this is not a point of criticism as it is clearly described as such. Nevertheless - if you plan to spend a lot of time in the city, this flat in a super central location is the best place to stay. Anyone planning to spend a lot of time in the flat should be aware that there is little daylight.

This was an excellent stay in a very nice apartment. Honestly, the apartment is a bit better than in the photos because of the high ceilings that make it feel bigger and more spacious. They were kind enough to let me check in a bit early, which I greatly appreciated so I didn't have to haul my bags around the city. Highly recommend.

This place was great! Very clean and has everything you need, very close to the metro to get downtown, and a great bar right next door. Pablo was great with responding quick and helping us with whatever we needed! Would definitely recommend.
Really great host for a fantastic apartment in the centre of everything. Highly recommend Ronny’s place for a stylish stop over in Madrid. We will be back.
The place has great location and the price is quite reasonable. However, it could have been a bit cleaner.

Overall had a great stay here. The location is hard to beat, and the apartment is a good size. There were linens and towels provided, which was really convenient. Kitchen is small but has everything you need. At one point I had an issue with the wifi, and the host was helpful with troubleshooting.
Apartment is just as described. Javier was a great host and very helpful with anything I needed.

Great flat, very well appointed. Location is amazing, the neighbourhood is truly a jewel
Javier was welcoming and helpful, I would fully recommend this property

Javier's place is perfect for two to three people. We stayed there for a week and used the second bedroom to store our luggage.
+ perfect location: 3 minutes to a 24/7 supermarket and to the Metro station, a lot of cafes and bars nearby
+ lively multicultural neighbourhood but the appartement is quiet
+ charming and modern design, true to description
+ very clean
+ walking distance to Reina Sofia and Prado museums
+ friendly welcome
+ prompt and reliable communication

Javiers flat was the perfect place to stay. The neighbourhood is so vibrant and with the flat facing the way it is - we had a quiet and peaceful space in the centre of lavapies and the city. Lavapies was such a fun neighbourhood to stay in with so many bars and places to eat - we loved it. The flat was clean and comfortable and a perfect space for 2. There’s also a 24 hour supermarket just a min away and very well connected to trains metros and buses would definitely recommend 10/10
A well located small apartment in a cosmopolitan neighbourhood. Very close to the Metro and east walk to major museums/art galleries. Facilities and essential supplies were excellent.

Very cute appartment at a great price for a 2 bedroom unit. Liked the furnishings. Javier came to meet me for check-in and was very responsive. Loved his warm welcome and the list of recommendations he went through in person.
The place is in a very diverse neighborhood which we loved.
We were in Madrid during a 40C heatwave and the AC seemed a bit too weak to achieve a comfortable temperature at night. Some neighbors were also pretty noisy on at least one of the nights.
Overall I think the apartment was still very good value for money.

Javier is an amazing host, they gave us a great run down of the space and area. They were also extremely responsive and flexible. This place was beautiful and centrally located just as described. Thanks Javier!!!

We had a fantastic stay at Javier's place in Lava Pies! Very close to the high street with grocery markets and near lots of local restaurants. Everything was as described and clean and tidy. Would definitely recommend.

My friend and I stayed here for 5 nights. We arrived earlier and Javier was able to meet us which we are thankful for. The apartment is in a very lively area with access to metro, supermarket, cafes and restaurants. We were able to walk to museums and gardens from this location. The apartment was clean, comfortable and quiet and a great base to explore from.

Javier's house is super nice, it's clean, prettily decorated and has all the things we want. It's quite suitable for two people as it has two bedrooms. Moreover, it's close to railway station and most attractions, the location is perfect to explore the city.
i would definitely choose Javier's house again next time.
Great location. Very well appointed, clean and comfortable. Nice condo layout & everything worked. Hosts were very responsive & helpful. Thoroughly enjoyed our stay.
The flat is immaculate, well designed and nicely furnished.  The beds were very comfortable, kitchen well stocked and the location was ideal.  I highly recommend the flat without any reservation.

We absolutely loved our stay with Vanrays.  The unit was very clean, bright and spacious.  It was very comfortable for four people and we could have easily had 1-2 more people stay with us if we needed to.  Vanrays is extremely responsive to any questions.  The area is fantastic and in the center of town.  We highly recommend staying with Vanrays!
Amazing apartment, great location, everything even better than it looked! And super responsive communication with the host!
Stunning apartment, just as pictured! Great location, though lots of traffic the morning. Very responsive and friendly hosts. Would definitely check here first for next stay in Madrid.

I had a great time at Danu's place.
The apartment is very well located in the Lavapies neighborhood.
I stayed there the first few days after I moved to Madrid
The host was very welcoming, very helpful with many issues I faced while settling in a new country. We also had the opportunity to have some fun in the bars and restaurants around.

Ammar was a great host.  He waited for us at the apartment so patiently (our plane was delayed and we got lost a bit on our way there).  His place offered all we needed. There was a Carrefour and a couple of small fruit places down the street for any supplies we wanted. It was easy to walk to most areas from Ammar’s apartment.  Ammar kept checking in to see if we needed anything .

The apartment is very clean and perfectly localised in Madrid.
Ammar is very nice and accommodating.
Thanks for everything.
The apartment was very well stocked and felt so clean and calming when we got in. Ammar was very accommodating and gave us some great suggestions for our time in Madrid. Overall nice stay!
Ammars place is so cute! He was very communicative throughout the whole process. The AC kept the apartment very cool despite hot temperatures in the summer. Would definitely come back!

This is an EXCELLENT apartment! We had been traveling throughout Europe for a few weeks and this was the best apartment we stayed in. Juan was very responsive and helpful from the beginning to the end! The apartment was also very CLEAN and comfortable. We had everything we needed and the location was fantastic. The neighbourhood was great because we felt safe even when we came home late at night. It also had a very festive vibe! People were friendly and everything was easy access. There was a mini supermarket right below the apartment and a small cafe right next to the building. I highly recommend Juan’s place and would certainly go back the next time I visit Spain. Thank you, Juan and Ammar! I really appreciate your hospitality!

Thisapartment is close to all the attractions and spotlessly clean. Amman met us for the check-in and explained everything in the apartment. He answered all our questions promptly and is very conscientious as a host. He gave great suggestions for restaurants and we were quite pleased.

You don't need to think twice about booking this awesome apartment. Even my local friends recommend this beautiful home :)
This apartment is located near cafes, restaurants, supermarkets, tourist attractions etc (I never once took the train or bus!). It was so clean, had everything I needed and I was sad when it was time to leave.
Ammar was an amazing host, definitely 1 of the best hosts I've ever met! He was so accommodative (waiting for us when we missed our check in timing and allowing us to leave our luggages behind after checking out), always there whenever we needed him, and so ever patient :)
Thank you so much for making our Madrid trip a beautiful and memorable one Ammar!
Ammar went out of his way to provide directions and meet us at his apartment. He explained all the features of the apartment completely. Wonderful host and apartment - thank you Ammar!
You can book Ammar’s place without hesitation. He is very nice, flexible, will be available anytime if you need anything. Excellent communication. Very cozy and cleqn apartment. Very recommended.

Ammar’s place was great! Very close to restaurants and site seeing.
You can walk to everything which was great. You don’t need a car. The accommodations were spotless. Ammar was very response and available if we had any questions.
Highly recommend.

I loved staying in this place. I was so close to everything in Madrid that I didn't even have to use the metro once. The apartment is beautiful and very comfortable, everything works the way it should: shower, washing machine, air-conditioning, internet, etc. A plus was Ammar's kindness. Many places I have stayed, I don't even meet the host which is fine, but in this case Ammar explained everything to me in person and I was able to ask him for very specific recommendations. I really recommend this place. When I come back to Madrid, I will stay there again for sure.
Thank you Ammar for hosting us , stay was good , comfortable and walkable to many sightseeing places . We loved Madrid 👍🏻

A great place to stay. Easy walking distance to all the key sites. Situated in a lively, bubbly part of town. Ammar is an excellent and very helpful host. Highly recommended for a Madrid break to be remembered.
Great place. Walkable to local restaurants and bars but with that comes noise which was a bit loud but not too bad.

We had such a great stay at Ammar’s place! It was in a great location and Ammar gave us so many wonderful recommendations. We also had to do some work while there and the wifi was excellent. Would recommend to friends!

I’m an older woman who was traveling alone and Ammar helped me out in so many ways. I’m not usually a “high maintenance” guest, but traveling alone in a country where I don’t speak the language was more difficult than I expected. I am so appreciative of ammar’s hospitality. He was very kind and helpful.

Ammar was such an incredible host-friendly, very responsive and super helpful with recommendations for the area! I loved his apartment-it was spotless, check-in was easy and Ammar was flexible with check-in time which I greatly appreciated. I felt right at home and loved the small touches such as the welcome chocolates; I only wish I had stayed there longer! This was by far one of my best Airbnb experiences. The apartment is located in a fantastic neighborhood with lots of great restaurants, in walking distance from the major sights. I would definitely stay here for a future trip!

Ammar and Juan were excellent hosts! The place was spacious and we felt right at home for our several days in Madrid! The apartment was very close to train stations and local spots, so getting around was great!
This was my second time staying at this place.  Very easy and quiet.  Walkable to a lot of restaurants and shopping.  It is also very quiet for Madrid.

The hosts were fantastic - even allowing us to drop our bags at the Airbnb prior to check in after we landed from an early morning flight. They were very responsive throughout our stay, provided local recommendations, and helped us pre-book a taxi for our flight home!
The place itself was also very clean and accurate to the photos. Everything was walkable from the apartment, but the place was still nice and quiet in the evenings despite the central location. I would highly recommend!

Good location and well-equipped, clean space. Juan (& Rocco) met us for check-in and followed up with good local restaurant recommendations. Convenient to walk to all the major sites. The bed didn’t meet our expectations for comfort, but that was the only issue - the rest of the stay was great. Lavapiés is an interesting neighborhood which gives the opportunity to see more than just the touristy side of Madrid.
Clean and calm apartment in a great location. Ammar was very communicative and had great recommendations. Would stay here again!
We had a great stay. The apartment is central and clean. Ammar was a very kind and helpful host with lots of great recommendations. Thank you!

Great place and Ammar is a wonderful host.  Although our stay was brief, we were able to walk to the top attractions.  The apartment is super clean and has all of the amenities we required.  Thanks again Ammar for the great place and hospitality!

Ammar was very flexible and always available to answer any questions. The place was clean and as described, we had no issues during our stay. There was a blackout in the city during which we couldn’t reach him so he slipped in a note to ensure we are okay.  He even helped with a list of recommendations for Madrid. Would definitely recommend this place.

Ammar was a wonderful host. He met us personally and showed us around the apartment, he provided excellent suggestions for restaurants and activities, plus a delightful bottle of wine on arrival. This apartment is located within easy walking distance of hundreds of wonderful restaurants, lots of grocery stores and many of the historic sites of Madrid. The local transit system was excellent and easily accessible. This was a wonderful location for Madrid sightseeing.
Ammar was a great host! Location is walkable to main areas. Had all we needed for our 3 night stay!

Great studio flat in a great location! The flat was really clean, everything worked and had a lovely view over a small garden. Check-in and out was easy and the host was friendly. I’ll definitely use this place again.

We had a really pleasant stay at Jorge’s studio. It is smaller but well equipped. The location was great and it was really quiet at night. It is also very light. Jorge was there for whatever we needed and he responded quickly. Definitely recommend!

Wonderful place in a great neighborhood.  Loved staying here. only challenge was the  room door had no key and it was a new experience for me. All in all Nelli assured me of safety and I got it. plus the house has cameras. Also if you have a lot or a heavy luggage,  take note in advance that there is no elevator currently, the house is in the 3rd floor.
I was there for five days and since I was looking for a place to crash after coming back from the office, it was perfect for me. Very clean and quiet, couldn't ask for more. Thank you very much!
It's a great ratio between price and quality, the neighbourhood is very cosy and silent. Nelli is very responsive and caring host.
Great place with a great location. Host can be a little unresponsive and hard to get a hold of but it was never a major issue.

Thomas was a great landlord and was always helpful and kind. Our stay here was great and in one of the best neighborhoods of Madrid. It is a great apartment for active people with the lofted beds and in a hillier part of town. Overall great stay.

Super good airbnb! The price is perfect, and the location is a quick walk to the metro that can get you into the center city in less than 15 minutes. Lorenzo responded to my questions within 10 minutes always and was overall very helpful. Super clean. Would stay here again!
Great Stay at Lorenzo's appartement. Very reactive, and friendly. The apartment was completely renovated - very cute, clean and handy. Loved my stay there.
The apartment is spotlessly clean and nice! It has all you need and is extremely comfy. Not very close to city center but is well communicated by subway. Great value for price. Thanks Lorenzo!

Lorenzo is a lovely host. He made sure we had a nice stay and was very responsive. The studio is modern but very cosy and homey. Kitchen fully equipped with everything we needed. Bathroom was big and spotless. It is not near town but you can easily access town by metro or bus (stops within 5min walk).

The flat is very clean and modern with a lovely bathroom
The apartment is located in the outskirts of Madrid within 5-10 minute walk from the metro
The bed is very firm so worth noting
I feel like it was good value for what we paid

The studio was beautiful and exactly as you see in the pictures. It was lovely and very clean, couldn’t find any issues with the place the whole time we were there with more amenities than we needed. Lorenzo was a great host and quick to reply to any messages or any issues which we had. The location has easy access as it’s a five minute walk to the metro. The place is great value for money and would highly recommend to anyone looking to visit Madrid.

The place is even better than the description and photos. The owner and his assistant are great people. The property is very clean, and nice.
In addition to all the service, we forgot our key inside, got locked out. Lorenzo came in person, and made efforts to locate the key. He was so apologetic as if it’s his fault. It was us who forgot the key. You have everything, coffee, nice Nexpresso machine, washer/dryer with soup, etc.
He is responsive to all messages and questions.
The place is nicely accessible, 7 minutes walk to the subway station. Only 5 minute trip by subway to Centro and all its attraction and history. I would definitely choose this place and owner if I visit Madrid again.

Lorenzo’s place was great.  Just like the pictures.  The apartment is in a residential area, but the Metro is close by and it was easy to into the center of Madrid.   Unfortunately,  we were only there for two nights.
Good place to stay only 10 minutes walk from the metro and a bus stop right outside. Supermarkets 5 minutes walk away for groceries. Would stay again.
Perfect location in the center of Madrid. Everything was clean, communication with the hosts was very good and fast. We were very satisfied. Thank you 🙂

I definitely recommend Noe’s place, just the professionalism in how they managed making our check in very simple and clear,  to the clean and cute, boutique place, the great location really made the stay very enjoyable. We 100% recommend this place and will definitely be coming back! Muchos gracias

We had a great stay at Noè's apartment. It's in a great location, very close to El Retiro park and some amazing museums. Lots of great cafes around too which is an added bonus!
Highly recommended!

Great be apartment for short stay!
Ideally located - you can get a train or bus from the airport straight to Atocha station in less the 30 mins and the apartment is a 10 min walk. It's also ideally located to see lots of central attractions. There is also a handy supermarket a few doors down.
We really enjoyed our stay and will definitely book again when we return to Madrid.

Enjoyed Madrid if even for a day! Lots of places to eat and so much to explore. Marta was great at communicating on how to get into the apartment and even sent me info on taxi service. Cute & clean place to stay! Definitely recommend staying here!
Great location to explore the city. The apartment was super clean. Also the hosts were super responsive and friendly 👍

We really liked the location of the apartment it was very convenient in terms of commuting. The place was very nice and I was able to prepare for my baby’s meals with no issue.
We had a bit of trouble with the check in, because we didn’t understand the location of the apartment once we were inside the building. We also struggled a with the device to open the front door from the apartment, I don’t know if it was not working or if we just didn’t knew how to use it.
Other than that, our stay was very pleasant and fun!
Thank you !

Joses apartment was very stylish and sparkling clean. The communication was perfect. Strongly recommend!
Thanks for everything.

This place is worth every penny, as someone who is a neat freak.  Jose's place was spotless.  Also, if you are someone who values their privacy, that's what you are going to get; you leave with them, but it feels like you have the apartment all to yourself. They only show up when you need them and ad someone who is not a big talker; I was left alone, but when o feel like talking, they are always there.  I would strongly recommend this place if you are short of cash but still need an excellent place to stay.

Jose has a beautiful place that’s quiet and conveniently located to all that Madrid has to offer. The apartment is spacious, clean and very peaceful. He was very informative and recommended all of the sights and great spots to get food. I would definitely recommend staying here and returning in the near future.

I had a wonderful 10-day stay at Jose’s place. Jose and his mother were absolutely amazing hosts—so warm, kind, and welcoming. Jose was very helpful throughout my stay and made sure I had everything I needed. The space was comfortable, and I felt completely at home the entire time. I truly appreciated their hospitality and would gladly stay here again. Highly recommend!

The location and apartment was perfect!  It was spacious and pretty.  The building is a former palace dating from 16th century so it’s quite special.  Javier left us a nice little welcome basket of treats which was a welcome touch.  The beds are comfy, the towels are fluffy and white, the balconies are great and the air flow is good.  I loved the neighborhood!

We had a lovely stay at Javier’s apartment. The space was well equipped and very clean. Javier came to meet and greet us on arrival, talked us through the running of the apartment and made suggestions for things to do and places to go. Communication was excellent throughout. We would recommend you stay there when you holiday in Madrid.
Great place. Great neighborhood that feels a lot less touristy than many of the other centro spots. Beautiful home with personality. Highly recommended!

Beautiful apartment in a central location overlooking El Palacio Real. Absolutely spectacular.  The apartment has everything needed for a comfortable stay. The beds are super comfy and the kitchen/laundry are spacious and great for cooking or just hanging out. All in all a magical apartment 💕

Lovely, stylish, and well equipped  apartment in a great part of old Madrid.  Javier is a great host, was easy to communicate with and couldn’t have been more helpful with both arrival and departure times! Tops my list of great places to stay in Madrid!

This really is an awesome place, with an awesome location and a great host. Just be wary in case you have limited mobility since there are stairs
to navigate but if you can handle that I am unable to imagine a place that is more authentic and hospitable. The location is above stunning, you really are close to everything while the street noise is nil.
In summary, my best AirBnb experience ever.

This was the first time I had booked and Airbnb so was a little nervous about how it work out. I was meeting a Canadian friend who had done the Camino walk so we both arrived at different times with different modes of travel. Javier could not have been more helpful before, during after our stay. The apartment is well equipped, my friend was able to do all her washing after the walk ! I would not hesitate to recommend this
accommodation and I would certainly return.
This 18th century apartment was a treat!  Amazing history and great renovation updates for todays living. Awesome place.

I loved every inch of this apartment. The apartment is beautiful, me and my partner  had a great time. the apartment is very spacious and counts with everything for you to feel like home. Javier is a great hoster. He made my stay in the apartment very smooth and pleasant. If I come back to Madrid, I'll definitely contact Javier.

I can’t even begin to describe the magic of this place. Absolutely incredible design, super comfortable, and in a beautiful, central area with a ton of lovely restaurants in historic views. Javier was incredibly helpful and responsive. I highly recommend it.

This was a wonderful place to base our Madrid visit. The place was conveniently located, very clean, well-appointed, and quite charming. It was roomy, and decorated nicely. The master bed was very comfortable. Javier was an excellent host. Lots of restaurants close by as well as a small grocery store. We would highly recommend this place.

Our stay was great! It felt like home. It’s a great place to use to explore the city, cook a few meals, relax, and use as a base to explore day trips to Toledo or other areas. We would absolutely recommend and stay here again when in Madrid!

Loved meeting Javier and experiencing this amazing Airbnb! Such a conveniently located spot within walking distance to amazing tapas restaurants, bars, shopping, museums, you name it.
Javier gave us some awesome and thorough recommendations and was extremely responsive to all questions or needs. He made sure we were taken care of and felt at home in this very beautiful spot.
Can’t recommend a stay here more - even on a very rainy day (our first day in Madrid!) it was the perfect place to watch the rain and enjoy some local food and wine we had picked up.
Great location! Javier was great and helped us with our luggage. He gave us a great run down of what to see and the locations of different restaurants he recommended.
Great place in a convenient location.  Javier was very helpful and communicative.  Would absolutely stay again.

Our stay at this apartment was truly delightful. The location is excellent, offering convenience and accessibility. Javier, our Airbnb host, was fantastic, ensuring our experience was enjoyable and hassle-free. My wife, mother-in-law and I had a wonderful time.
We were 3 adults with two bedrooms and two full bathrooms. There was a lot of room to move and spread out. It was an ideal place for our needs.

We had an outstanding stay at Javier's apartment in Madrid and would strongly recommend it to anyone visiting Spain. The apartment is spacious, offering comfort that perfectly suits a couple, and easily accommodates three guests, as our son joined us for a few nights. Set in a fantastic neighborhood brimming with excellent non-touristic restaurants, it's conveniently located near public transport and other Madrid attractions. Javier, our host, was superb! He was flexible with our early arrival and provided stellar recommendations. Engaging and friendly, he was wonderful to converse with throughout our stay. I can't recommend Javier's place enough!

Fantastic stay at this Airbnb. Jble.vier met us at the apartment for the move-in and explained the very interesting history of this very old building....which has been nicely remodeled and is exceptionally comfortable. Everything a traveler needs is provided.
The apartment is very large, one bedroom is upstairs and one on the main level. The apartment is kind of "bohemian" in style with a lot of character.
The area is very quiet and about 5-10 minutes walk to restaurants and shops and about 15 minutes walk to the nearest metro stop. I liked the La Latina area a lot.
I would stay there again in an instant! You will love it, too.

Javier was an excellent host and I would eagerly choose to stay here again. We had an early flight arrival and Javier allowed us to have an earlier check-in. The beds were quite comfortable and the amenities met all of our needs. The location was perfectly situated to put us close to metro, buses and great places to enjoy food and drink, and still feel tucked away from the busier  activity.  There is, of course, the late night fun and revelry on the weekend, but that never prevented us from sleeping well. Javier took time to walk us through a city map and share his recommendations, which was very helpful. An overall terrific experience!

The apartment was turn key furnished including ice,
all laundry supplies and meal condiments. Very organized!
Lovely seperate spaces inside with individual A/C units. Very comfotable for all.

Our stay in Javier's Airbnb was fantastic! The apartment oozed charm with its exposed beams and hardwood floors. The location was unbeatable - quiet yet just a short walk away from major attractions like the Royal Palace. Javier was incredibly welcoming and helpful, always ready with local tips. This cozy, centrally-located apartment was the ideal base for exploring Madrid’s vibrant culture. Highly recommended!

Javier's apartment is beautiful and interesting. The kitchen is well stocked for cooking and the beds were very comfortable. The neighborhood is lovely. We walked everywhere and enjoyed our stay. Javier was very helpful for check in to check out.

This place was a quiet spot in an otherwise very busy, bustling city.  The La Latina neighborhood was hands down the perfect place to stay and come home to this apartment. Appreciated the authentic history and feel of the apartment. Javier is friendly, informative, warm and most importantly very responsive! This is the place to stay in Madrid!

very clean home and quiet neighborhood, friendly and responsive host, great location, it's walkable, and easy access to metro or bus stations. The building has historical significance and therefore does not have an elevator, very useful and considerable amenities like a straightener, and clean dishes
Comfortable and large space, all amenities. Quiet street near restaurants, shopping and metro. Historical building too!

Javier is a wonderful and professional host. He responded expediently every time I contacted him. He had many recommendations and useful information for us, even letting us know in real time about the goings-on in Madrid. Javier’s place is spacious and beautiful and was the perfect place for me to recover after having surgery. My husband and I felt right at home.

It takes your breath away.
Best place. Best hostess. Best value.
As a superhost, I have never given such a high rating to anyone.
Best place: A very private and beautiful apartment and work of art.. literally. It takes your breath away. In the midst of the coveted Centro. Walking distance from plazas Sol, San Miguel, and Mayor

Best Hostess: Cristina is an amazing person, and an effective and available hostess. Her presence matches the beauty of this apARTment.
Best value: It will now be my permanent stay in Madrid. Do not think twice. Get it now.

Our stay was lovely and the apARTment was beautifully designed, very clean and comfortable for our 10 day stay. Monte is an outstanding airbnb host! She is very helpful, caring, kind and responsive. Monte also gave us great info and recommendations. The area is very central and walking distance to many cultural sites, shopping and stores. We highly recommend the Iberian Ham experience with Alberto at the shop his family has owned since 1909 - a 10+++ and the day in the country with Paul and Ian! Our favorite tapas place is Restaurante Cedron which is a nice walk away. All in all a fabulous time!!

This is an amazing apartment! The owner has done a fantastic job of blending the “old with the new”. Their attention to detail was “spot on” and we found ourselves discovering new “vignettes” in the apartment and common areas. The host met us at the door and was very responsive and the location couldn’t have been any better. In fact, it’s just steps away from one of the oldest plazas in Madrid where tour guides stop with their groups to point out the significance. We would definitely stay there again and will certainly recommend it to all of our friends.

Monte's place was a beautiful and wonderful to stay in right in center of historical Madrid. All tourist attractions were nearby and did not have to walk a lot. The apartment was beautifully decorated and very artistic. Much better than any hotel stay. It had lot of space also with complete separate bedroom and living room.
Very enjoyable stay.
We had a great stay at this apartment in Madrid.  It’s in a great location near the Palace and the central food market and Plaza Mayor. Highly recommend!

A wonderful location and relaxing apartment. Everything was comfortable. The area felt safe, quiet, and close to many interesting and sites. First time in Spain for us— we thought Madrid was fabulous!
Maria was a great host and helped us a lot for any of our requests. We loved the neighbourhood.

Amazing, neat and clean place with great response. Totally satisfied with the arrangement and quick response.
Thank you so much ❤️❤️
Host were very nice and helpful, just as the place itself. Easy check in, clear instructions.
We stayed for 2 nights and this was a very convenient location. Very safe and great communication from host. Would stay again. Thanks!
It was good time to be in Madrid. Thank you so much for perfect hosting! Appreciate you guiding for everything and very friendly atmosphere! 5 star host and it’s apartment! I wish you the best!
Maria was very helpful with everything, and she was super kind throughout our stay. The place itself was also very nice and held our group of 5 perfectly. Would definitely stay here again!

Our stay in this apartment was really good, we spent a few days in this location and it was a clean apartment with every equipments described in the description
The place is very well located with quick access by metro to the different main attractions of Madrid
Thank you Mahdrid apartments for your help during our trip
See you !

We spent a wonderful time in Maria’s place.
It’s nicely decorated, clean and well equipped.
The location is perfect (Principe Pio metro station 5min, several groceries, restaurants, …), it is possible to reach mostly every historical/touristic places of Madrid by foot.
One of the best points is that the place stays cool even during summer (we had 36-37 degrees).
I recommend it 100%!

Wonderful hosts who went above and beyond to be helpful and welcoming. This place is as described, very comfortable and in a great location near to several public transport links. I’d stay there again no hesitation! Thank you for being so kind Maria 😊

The Airbnb was very well located in Madrid to discover the city. We were 5 friends and it was good for us, maybe just a bit noisy as located on ground floor so hearing a bit the street. Communication was easy and I recommend the Airbnb if you would like to visit Madrid with some friends :)

The place is very well located, close to main places in Madrid such as Plaza España, Palacio Real, among others.. the apartment was easy to find and everything was very clean and organized. Definitely good value for the money.
Perfect airbnb accommodation. Clean, in the city, good price, with kitchen. We were absolutely satisfied.
A lovely place to stay for 2-4 people. Lovely and clean. Host has great communication. Everything was spot on!

The photos don't do this loft justice, it truly surpassed our expectations. It was super clean and cozy. The neighborhood is lovely and peaceful with everything you need nearby and you can take the metro or bus towards the center. Thank you for a great stay!
Nice place, but the place it is not a 5 stars place. Maybe it was in the past and will be again in the future. Small details makes the difference(furniture, towels etc)
Perfect location, fast communication. Very clean and cozily furnished. Everything went  uncomplicated. Highly recommended!
Honestly it was a good experience. We found no trouble getting around and the location was convenient. Very cute place to stay in Madrid.

The apartment was awesome very well located , clean , and confortable they provide everything for a very nice stay I will definitely come back again the , host was alway answering all my questions five start for you thank you very much

The appartment was perfect and the location was great, it's 10 min far away from the metro station that can take you to the main city locations. I definitely recommend this appartement and will definitly revisited it if I'm in Madrid!

Maria defines Superhost! Superfast friendly communication, resolving any issues (albeit, I had very few).
The apartment is near grocery stores/ restaurants and less than half a kilometer away to Madrid's metro. From there, you can go anywhere.
The quiet safe apartment was perfect for the five days of sightseeing Madrid.
Thank You Maria for a WONDERFUL STAY!

Maria and Jorge‘s place is a great base for exploring Madrid! It has everything you need, is a nice layout and very well located.
We had a great time! Enough space for all of us and the kitchen was well equipped so we were able to cook in the evening. Super markets, bakeries and really nice cafés plus cervezerias dotted around and easy to walk to the busy center of Madrid bit sleep well as it’s calm at night time.
The only downside was not being able to leave luggage for the day after checkout. The hosts were super helpful and guided us to a public locker at a nearby train station which disrupted the day but all in all, we loved our stay! Thanks for hosting us!

Maria y Jorge were a very kind and fast hosts.
Place are incredible, close to 2 metro stations, and many convenience setores close. House is exactly the same of pictures and definitely i recommend this place.
5 stars because there is no option about 6 stars

My experience at Ignacio's place was amazing. The apartment was exactly as advertised, clean and convenient. It is located in the center of Madrid, but it's quiet and close to amazing restaurants, stores, etc. The communication with the host was on point, and they were able to assist me with all of my requests.
Ignacio will be more than your host; his warm and caring personality will make you feel comfortable and cared for. I cannot recommend this apartment enough!! Gracias por todo

Ignacio’s place is fantastic -spotless, extremely comfortable bed and sofa bed, spacious, stylish bathroom and very quiet. It is also in a great location with numerous and varied restaurants and attractions in walking distance. Ignacio couldn’t have been more welcoming, hospitable and helpful. He provided lots of local recommendations and he always responded promptly to any messages. Highly recommended…gracias por todo 🙏😊

Great apartment, newly renovated, modern, quiet and clean. The host was awesome, with great recommendations for area restaurants. The location is ideal, near the metro and near many restaurants. The neighbourhood is residential with groceries close by, including two fruit shops on the same block. There’s also a park nearby where families and people with their dogs gather. I very much recommend Ignacio’s place and the neighbourhood! Retiro park is a few metro stops away as are the tourist areas.

Ignacio was a superb host with lots of recommendations and also very responsive to any queries. Nothing was too much trouble. The apartment was lovely and very clean and in a great location. Highly recommend this apartment. We thoroughly enjoyed our time there.

Ignacio is an incredibly friendly, flexible and responsive host. It felt like visiting family.
Whenever I had to contact him with a question about the flat or the neighbourhood—or simply needed some recommendations about where to find the best places to go out—he responded immediately with great suggestions.
Minty, who are administrating the flat, are an extra bonus.
The place itself is amazing with a great and clean neighbourhood and lots of options to go for groceries, shopping, a coffee, ice cream or a relaxing walk in the park. Madrid's city centre is also super easily to reach from there.
It was a pity the time went by so quickly.

Maria and Jorge's airbnb was exactly as described and very clean. Has a nice bathroom with a large shower (4 towels provided), dishwasher, oven, microwave, and clothes washer. The size is just enough room for 4 people especially if you are going to be out exploring all day! Comfy beds and good wifi as well. It was about 10 mins walk to metro and about 5 mins walk to nearby bus stations. They provided clear instructions on how to check in and out! We felt safe in the building as there is 2 locked doors you have to go through to get to the apartment. Would recommend!

Great spot for vacation stay. 1 or 2 people
Is also best price for location to Serrano area

I had an amazing stay at this apartment in the Salamanca district! The location was perfect – just a 10-minute walk to Retiro Park, with plenty of great restaurants, bars, and shops nearby. The apartment itself was newly renovated, clean, and had everything I needed for a comfortable stay. The host was incredibly responsive and provided helpful recommendations for exploring the area. I loved how quiet and peaceful the neighborhood was, yet still close to everything I wanted to see. I will definitely be coming back!
Ignacio’s place was perfect for our long weekend in Madrid! He is a fantastic host and we really appreciated his recommendations in the local area! The apartment was perfect and we love Salamanca!

This is our second time in Madrid. We decided that we want to experience Madrid as locals do and in addition to visit sites like the Prado museum. We selected to stay in the affluent area of Salamanca, in a neighborhood where locals live. Ignacio’s place gave us all this and more. We enjoyed having coffee and pastry in the cafe downstairs and the non-tourist restaurants that Ignacio recommended to us. He and his team were very accommodating, very communicative like our own private concierge. The place was very clean, functional, and in peaceful side street off a main Street in Salamanca. We recommend staying in Ignacio’s place and experience Madrid the right way.

Nacho was a great host, responded to any questions at any time. Was extremely helpful. Minty were also great and gave clear instructions and made the stay very easy for us. Location is great, lots to do near the area and walking distance to the metro. Would stay here again especially with such a good host, highly recommend :)
The place was extremely clean and modern. Isidoro was an excellent host. He was always quick to respond to my messages and provided extremely detailed instructions for the self check in process.
Isidoro has a really easy way to check-in here and everything inside was perfect, cosy, had all the right equipment and everything up to 100% standards. Thank you!
A great place located in a prospect neighborhood. I was able to walk everywhere. Isodoro was very communicative to our needs and everything went very smoothly. Nice stay!

One of the cleanest airbnbs i have ever stayed in.
Really beautiful, great shower, nice interior, easy check-in. I would stay there again.

Perfect apartment for a solo traveler! Everything was as shown in the pictures. Very clean, very put together. AC works great, fantastic water pressure in the shower, coffee is available as well. It's located close to the city center, but far enough away for a quiet night sleep. Check in and check out were easy. I loved everything about my stay! I would definitely stay here again!

A great little spot close to the center with lots of small coffee shops and bars in the area. The unit was smaller than expected but otherwise accurate to the photos. Everything was very neat and tidy, bath products were provided, and check-in/check-out was super simple. Great communication and great spot for a single person or couple.

Great place if you’re traveling solo or for a couple. The room is comfortable and very clean. I also felt very safe walking around the area. Metro is a ten minute walk and it was easy to get to the apartment from the airport. You can also walk to Puerta del Sol in about 20 minutes. Isidoro was very proactive about sending instructions and making sure I know how to get in and do my check- out. I only stayed one night on arrival to Madrid but I would stay here again

Ideal place for two people who like to explore by foot, local to many things.
Isodoro was very reactive and his instructions were very clear!
Great stay, would recommend.
We had a very comfortable stay! It had everything we needed for a short stay. Great location and lively neighborhood.

Small space but perfect if spending your time exploring the city.
Communication couldn’t have been better. Apartment looked new. Bed was very comfortable.

Enjoyed my stay this flat as it’s in my old barrio, so I love being able to stay here whenever visiting Madrid. The place is as described. The entire building seems to be Airbnbs but definitely not the craziness one would expect. It truly was a relaxing stay. I’d love to give a major shoutout to the lovely woman who cleans and maintains all the apartments. She definitely made the stay even more pleasant. I’m sad I didn’t ask for her name

This is a great spot if you have a stop over in Madrid! Looks just like the pictures. It’s quite small, so might be tight for 2 people, but it was perfect for me. It’s very walkable to the city center.
The only thing I’ll caution against is if you have large luggage. I broke quite the sweat dragging my heavy luggage up the stairs, even though it’s only on the first floor.
Otherwise, great option!

We loved our stay. The apartment is easy to access, on a quiet street, and is beautifully decorated. It looks just like the pics, and the bed was so comfy! The AC worked great and Isodoro was responsive and helpful during our stay.  Check in was easy, and the host sent excellent, detailed instructions on how to get to the apartment from the airport. The area is walkable, and has lots of food options around. I would definitely stay here again!
It was great staying at Isidoro’s apartment. He was so helpful with everything. Everywhere was clean and looked exactly like in the pictures. Totally recommend this place!

Great experience staying at Isidoro's place. We arrived to Madrid early in the morning and were able to leave our bags in the building and even check in early. Place was very cute, AC worked well, and we got to watch Netflix! Isidoro left very clear instructions on how to check in and was responsive and kind throughout. Def recommend staying here!!

The location is good,place is nice and well located. Host is very responsive.
Check in instructions were clear.
The place has everything for couple days in Madrid.
I recommend the place.Thank you.

Perfect apartment to stay in madrid.
Really close to everything. The apartment has everything u need to. And Isodoro was really nice and helping during all the way.
I recommend 100%

I came in instructions were easy to follow. Even though no elevator it’s only one flat up so that shouldn’t be an issue. It felt very cozy the bed was very comfortable a lot of pillows. The bathroom was very clean many towels available. Sadly I got sick upon my arrival so the fact that I was able to feel comfortable and rest in the room means it’s really good. Maybe not as much sun light as the image but it’s still bright once you open the windows it’s not dark at all. The bathroom opens a light as soon as you walk by it which is nice at night. He has complimentary water for you.

The place is exactly as described and shown in photos. Check in was easy and host was responding to messages really quickly. It was very clean and bed extremely comfortable, which I particularly appreciated. I would definitely stay again when I go back to Madrid!
Isidore had a lively place that is close to city center and restaurants. I would definitely recommend it!

Wow, what a wonderful Airbnb! The neighbourhood was cool, safe, and not touristy at all, but I was able to walk everywhere I wanted to go. There were some excellent restaurants nearby. The flat was cute and clean and contained everything I needed. I had the best sleep! I was extremely impressed by the host's excellent communication and responsiveness. Isidoro went above and beyond to share helpful public transit options for me unasked when they found out I was arriving from another city by bus. Check-in was smooth. I loved my stay and would definitely come back next time I'm in Madrid. Highly recommended!
Fantastic stay. Apartment was extremely clean and host was highly responsive. He even let me store my luggage past the checkout time. Absolutely would stay again.

The apartment building was secure, the accommodations were as listed, and the apartment was clean. If you have mobility issues, the stairs to get to the apartment would be difficult to navigate as there is not a lift. The nearest metro stop is only a few blocks away which made it easy to get around the city. Highly recommend. :)

Pro:
-It was located close to all the main touristic attractions yet the neighborhood was quiet and calm. We were able to sleep in without any issues.
-It's the perfect size for 2 inviduals if you just need a place to sleep.
-The apartment was clean and organized.
-Instructions to get in were easy to follow. We didn't have any conflicts to find and enter the apartment.
Con (Minor suggestions)
-We wished they had a bathroom rug and hand towel because we needed to use ours instead.
-No napkins available.
-Hard to carry our big suitcases up the stairs.

Pictures are accurate. Flat is cute, charming, and very clean.
Instructions were clear and it was easy to get to.
And host was very nice.
A great place to stay!

Very nice place.
The appartement is well located to visit downtown. It is close to nice restaurants and metro.
It is also clean and the host is very responsive. I highly recommend Isodoro’s place.

Great location in a great neighborhood, the air bnb exactly matched the photos posted. Isidoro was responsive and gave clear instructions on our stay and how to get in. Super close to the Plaza de Mayor, Historic sites, restaurants, tourist attractions  and shopping. A bonus was being close to the train station for excursions. The location is perfect if you want to stay in a quiet area, need simple accommodations and we found it very walkable to our destinations. Thank you for having us!
Had a great stay here! Very accessible to tourist spots by walking or public transit. Very clean and well maintained.

Very helpfull, and friendly.
The apartment was clean and modern.
i recommend to everybody.

This apartment is a short walk from the centre of Madrid.
Very easy to find. On a quiet street.
It's spotlessly clean.
Highly recommended for a short stay in Madrid.
Great place if you’re looking to stay in Madrid. Isidoro does a great job with communication. I would recommend.

everything you need in an adorable and comfortable space. host was very helpful and communicative. and the spot is walkable to nightlife bars and restaurants. always felt safe. really enjoyed my stay. Thank you.
We stayed at Javier’s place for almost a month and had a great experience. The home was cozy and very centrally located. The hosts were very responsive.
