We loved Agustina’s place. Everything was perfect. Great communication and flexible. We would definitely stay here again. We recommend this place. Thank you for everything.

The apartment is clean and situated in a great area. The pictures show the room correctly. I can recommend this apartment for staying in Madrid. What you must know is that there is only one bathroom and there can be a few different guests in the apartment at the same time. There is no key to lock the room. The contact with Daniel was easy and I quickly got answers to my questions.

very clean apartment, nice room with big comfortable bed, cool windows with great view onto plaza de olavide, shutters and windows can also be closed for total darkness/silence if need be.  Location is surrounded with things to do, see, eat, and drink, and it's a pleasure to walk anywhere or just sit in the plaza

Daniel is super friendly and always available for anything. He always watched our bags for free after check out for free and that was really much appreciated. Location in great, it’s well connected and eve Uber has cheap prices as it’s in the center. It was out first time in a shared space apartment but everything was smooth. Recommended!

Had a lovely stay at the place. Very clean apartment, has a great kitchen. Amazing location, really friendly atmosphere. If internet fails, you get quite a lot of help in figuring out your way around the city from the host. Lastly, you get to start the day with some very good coffee, if that’s your thing!

One of the nicest experiences I ever had! I highly recommend this place, and their hosts were amazing :)
We also appreciated their recommendations about places to go around the city.

Super location and house is super clean!!!!!
And Daniel very kind!!
I will come back again!

Great place to stay! Very spacious, kitchen stocked well, nice decor, desks to work if needed. Isabel is very responsive and quick to help with anything I needed the entire stay, she went above and beyond to help me. The location is great depending on what you’re looking for. Just a 5 minute walk to a metro station that’s 15 minutes to the center of the city. A beautiful park just a couple minute walk away to run, bike, picnic, etc. in. Highly recommend!
The place is more than wonderful and she helped me with anything I needed to get anywhere and I hope to go back there again 🌺🌺

Nuria’s place is beautiful! They responded back super quick and were very easygoing to communicate with. It’s in a perfect location with great shops, restaurants, and tourist attractions nearby. Would 100% stay here again!

From the moment we met our host and how warm and friendly he was, to opening the door to our private entrance, to the high-end appliances and furniture, the two balconettes, the tall ceilings, the beauty, THAT walk-in closet, oh and THAT shower head.
I NEVER wanted to leave. My husband and decided we would move in if we could.
Such a 5-star experience. It was PERFECT. I could stay there a month.

Rogue and Luke are excellent hosts. A surprise awaited us in the fridge - a bottle of cava and a tasty cookie. The apartment was elegant, clean and fully equipped with a kitchen and bathroom. There is a comfortable bed in the bedroom and a sofa bed in the living room. It has a practical location. All sights and attractions could be visited on foot (except for the football stadium). We really appreciated that they helped us get tickets for the football game, which made our son very happy.
If we return to Madrid, we will definitely stay there again.

Everything was better than perfect, but I have to be honest - the continuous bus noises (it is like a bus terminus) 24/7 in the street outside the apartment makes for serious sleep deprivation. For that reason we cannot recommend this apartment. It hurts to say this as the apartment was great, but the noise was unaceptable.
We had a fabulous stay. The unit was absolutely beautiful.      This place is in the heart of Madrid near everything. Thank you Nuria’s Team for making us fill at home. We definitely will return.

Great Location! We walked everywhere , very close to Plaza Mayor and Mercado de San Miguel.
The apartment very clean and lovley (only a bit noisy) - everything was great!

we had a hiccup upon check in. the host didnt respond and we had to wait approximately 30 minutes before someone showed up with keys. no one answered the door, even next door which is a shop owned by the host, there was a sign saying they had moved so i walked to the new address to also find the place closed. i went back to the apartment to find that my sister and kids had been let in. apparently, the host lost his cell phone and was not aware we were at the apartment.
other than the above mentioned situation, everything else was perfect. we loved the place. the kitchen and bathrooms were fully equipped with soap and shampoo. linens were clean. there was even laundry detergent and we did laundry during our stay. the shower is fabulous! the closet was roomy. the host left us a bottleof wine, milk, water, cheesecake and coffee. best airbnb ever!

The place was absolutely amazing! The location was impeccable, it was easy to walk to the main attractions. We felt right at home since everything was clean and the apartment was equipped with everything imaginable. The hosts were responsive and helpful. Highly recommend this place!
Place is immaculate and modern. Close to everything. Highly recommended. Friendly and helpful host. Thank you for the bottle of wine/water and the milk.

We absolutely loved our stay here! The apartment itself is beautiful, spacious, and clean. The location was spectacular - we explored the area every day and were not short on restaurants to try and plazas to explore. Our hosts were extremely hospitable as well. We would highly recommended to stay here!

Nurias place is one of the best Air Bnbs I have stayed in. We were a family of 4 and it was a big place really comfortable for us. They gave us 2 key sets which was really helpful. everything was spotlessly clean and kitchen was fully stocked. Will highly recommend this place for families.

Our stay was fabulous! Location was great, lots of sites within walking distance and our host was very helpful. We also went to the wine shop that the host owns and had a terrific time wine tasting and meeting other people both local and tourists. The aparemt has everything you need and is an excellent find! I would come back to Nurias place every time I am in Madrid!

We loved our stay in Madrid. Clean and comfortable. Thoughtful touches on arrival with wine & cheesecake. Easy to access and walking distance to landmarks & food.
We did have a bit of road noise with the construction & traffic overnight which is something we are not used to but would be fine if you’re a deep sleeper.
Would definitely stay again.
Thanks!

It’s a very cozy and convenient place near to a metro station and surrounded with lots of good food. Although the house might be small, it’s has everything a house need. Definitely recommend to stay here when visit madrid again! The host Sergio is very helpful as well! Highly recommend this place to everyone.
We stayed here twice in a two week trip and the apartment and host were great both times. We will book here again when we go back to Madrid.

It was a wonderful start to our trip through Spain. All communication was through Roque and he was so helpful from the moment we booked answering our questions. The space was exactly what we needed as a family of four (pack and play was provided with mattress) and a great location 5 min walk to Plaza Mayor and Sol.
We had a small hiccup with the AC not working when we arrived and Roque and his team were quick to bring a technician in and over a high powered fan as a temporary solution- we thought that was a true testament to the care he and his team offered our entire stay. Once it was fixed it worked great! Would definitely recommend to anyone looking a great centralized location!

Everything was wonderful with the apartment – we truly enjoyed our stay!
As a small suggestion for improvement, we recommend checking the sofa bed, as it’s not very comfortable and seems to be a bit worn.
Aside from that, everything else was perfect. Thank you again for your hospitality!

The radiators didn't work
We were freezing
After asking around 2. AM they gave us two portable heathers
From the very morning of the second day, we didn't have electricity till the afternoon
In they are just telling us to put ourselves in danger but somehow playing with electricity
Last night I asked if we could stay till 2 PM and they said of course, that’s fine
But, it was like a war, and they came in at 12 and repeatedly said let me in
Let me in
Then they called and said you need to pay an extra fee

Plenty of space for a family of 4. Double bedroom. Twin bedroom. And a comfortable sofa bed in the lounge. The kitchen is basic but serves the purpose. Really close to the palace and palace gardens which were stunning. Would happily stay again if ever in Madrid.

We really enjoyed our stay in Madrid and Javier’s place made it very comfortable and convenient.
It was close to to the center and our exercions. The beds were comfortable and the air conditioning was a must! The elevator was also conviennent with bringing all luggage to the apartment.

The apartment was lovely and perfect for a group of 3. Plenty of space and nice and clean. The apartment was central and right beside Palacio Real de Madrid so the view was also nice. I would definitely stay here again when I come back to Madrid!

Ideal apartment for a city break to Madrid. Central location with a supermarket and cafe right next door. The apartment was spotless. If we ever return to Madrid we would stay here again. A home from home
This is a very well maintained cozy apartment located on a 5th floor. Matches the description and host is very responsive. Walking distance to Principe Pio and Plaza de España.

The place is nice and clean. Not much natural light as the only window looks to the neighboring building and I'd suggest you leave the window open as it can get a bit stuffy in the room. It is fairly small but we were out in Madrid the whole time and only used it for sleeping so I can't comment on whether the space will be sufficient if you plan to spend more time inside. There is a lovely little park right outside the building where you can have your morning coffee if you're a smoker. It is half an hour walk from the city centre (uphill) so if you plan to visit the northern part of the city you will probably need to use public transport. The front door got jammed a few times, luckily some of the neighbors were around and the fix seemed to be yanking it a couple of times. Overall good experience I'd say the place is slightly overpriced for the size and location though.
Everything matched the description, the location is really good and the host was extremely friendly, helpful and responsive.

Our stay was great. The host was really responsive about check in. We needed to extend our stay by one day and he responded straight away. We were also able to check in early and were informed about this the day before. Clean apartment and easy to walk to the centre (we hardly took the metro at all mainly walked, it’s around 15-20 minutes to the centre). Good value for money.
It was a great stay at a wonderful house. The host is super helpful and nice. It was a single room with a single bed that was very comfortable. 5/5 would recommend to solo traveller on short stays.

Excellent place to stay in Madrid!
Cristina is very nice and accesible, she was always in touch and asking if I needed anything, she kindly offered to suggest restaurants or anything for my trip.
Her apartment is new and lovely. Extremely clean and ordered,
The room she offered, has a good size and is confortable. I loved the blinds, they come down automatically and the room gets really dark, the neighbourhood is silent at night so I could have very restful and peaceful nights. It had a good and convenient space closet for my things.
The private bathroom is also of a very good size and spotless clean.
She also offered a great space in the fridge for my things (more of half of it). The place has a pool for the warm season.
I definitely recommend staying at her place and for sure will be back on any other trip to Madrid.

It was a pleasure staying at Cristina, I felt right at home! She’s was very helpful in providing tips and recommendations of where to eat and places to visit. I had a great stay and would highly recommend staying at her place any time.

Christina is a great host. Can recommend the place.  You can reach the city centre super easy by train. Also recommend you to at least once walk through the neighborhood. Be aware that the pool has no sunbeds :D

This booking was absolutely perfect for my business trip to Madrid. Cristina was such a lovely and kind host - so easy to communicate. Her place is just perfect!!!
The building is new and her taste for decoration is high end and nice, the place has a real good vibe.
Perfectly clean, pretty quiet (non-negligible for Madrid) and well located (3min walk from the metro) and safe to walk even late at night.
The room is comfy and has a desk which was very useful and internet works perfectly.
I would definitely choose Cristina’s apartment if I have to go again to Madrid. You can go with closed eyes and Cristina is one of the coolest and kindest host I’ve ever met. She will make sure that you feel like at home and provide real good recommendations ✨

Cristina is a wonderful host. Friendly and responsive to questions and requests. The home itself is very homy and tidy. The place is very close to a subway station, and just a 5-minute walk will take you to many food options.
I would recommend this place to anyone visiting Madrid.

The apartment is lovely and very spacious, but the best part was the location. La Latina is a great neighborhood with good (and not overpriced) restaurants, flamenco shows, and a neighborhood feel (more quiet). But it’s still walking distance to the palace & Cathedrals. The only downside was having to wait nearly 30 minutes to get keys & enter the unit after our agreed upon checkin time. But otherwise I’d recommend it!

Beautiful location with lots to do within walking distance! Pretty central in the city with a major metro station less than 10 mins walk away. Ramon was very responsive and helpful! Will definitely be staying anytime we’re in Madrid

Maritza was very flexible with the check in time as I had a late flight. The flat is only 10 minutes away from the airport by Uber and everything was as described, the bathroom and bedroom very clean. I only briefly met Maritza but she is welcoming and friendly. Would definitely recommend.

Maritza was so kind and helpful - I’m glad I chose to stay at her lovely home before heading to the airport (which is conveniently very close from her location). Thank you so much for hosting me and making sure my stay was comfortable! :)

Ideal place so close to the airport so I was able to get there for 6am using Uber. Maritza is a kind, lovely host and helped me try to find organic food nearby and gave me help with everything. Would highly recommend
Not far from Madrid Barajas Airport. Enjoyed my stay and would definitely book this cozy apartment again. Recommend warmly!

Maritza's apartment is relatively close to the airport T1 terminal, 10mins by car or roughly 40mins by bus with one change required. Maritza was very friendly, welcoming and easy to talk to, despite the fact my Spanish isn't great. I found the bed very comfortable. The place was very clean and I'd definitely return again!

It was a quiet and clean room in a quiet and clean building in a quiet neighborhood close to the airport. She was responsive and gave me local recommendations for food and how to get to the airport. She was very welcoming and very nice. Her home and the bedroom and bathroom were squeaky clean and simple. Good value for a night.

Wonderful place! So comfortable and great communication with the host. I arrived at 12am because of my flight and only needed to stay there until my flight the following day but it was very lovely. Edwin (Maritzas friend) was there and he was so kind. He gave me water and at 4am when I had headache he gave me ibuprofen. I feel very blessed to have chosen this Airbnb and stayed here for the night before taking my flight the next day. Thank you for your kindness and the great stay 🙏🏻💖
I had a very pleasant stay at Maritza's place. It's very personable and helpful. It was lovely chatting  with her. My room was spacious, clean, and cozy. I will be happy to come back!
It was a very nice stay. Maritza was a very warm and nice host and the place was very clean. I enjoyed a lot staying at her place.
Maritza was a wonderful host! Very helpful and the space was very clean. Love it and would stay again!
Maritza is a great and welcoming host. Very friendly and kind. I needed a place to sleep to catch a connecting flight and everything was clean and organized. I would stay there again in a heartbeat!
Nice and clean place, had comfy bed and private bathroom. Very friendly host. Would come again! :)

I needed a bed for the night before my next flight the next day. The place had easy access from the airport (two buses but easy to commute) and the bed was the beeeest I had since long time!
Thanks Maritza :)

Maritza is friendly and responsive. Place was clean and comfortable. Check in was easy.
Great place to stay when traveling to from airport or train station.

Wonderful quick stay. I was just passing through so only stayed one quick night, but it was very pleasant and I will likely stay again in the future. She wasn’t there to check me in, but a lovely gentleman made me feel very comfortable and taken care of. Thanks!

Came back for a second time it's a great spot to rest at before or after a flight. Close to the airport and to any other public transportation, Maritza is great and very welcoming. Room with private bathroom, all very clean comfy and with good energy, always the most important thing ! Thank you Maritza !|

This room was a perfect stay for my early flight the next morning. Maritza's home was clean and peaceful. She also had extra blankets and slippers which were a plus! The drive was only 5 mins from the airport.
The apartment is located close to 2 metro stations and it's 5 min bus ride to Atocha rail station.

A cozy apartment in a central part of the city, very close to a metro station and plenty of things to do within walking distance.  The host was patient with my broken spanish and provided me a lot of good suggestions on things to do around Madrid.

small renovated cosy flat with very friendly, helpfull owner. Make sure you can cope with souterrain , there is only one small window to open, in the kitchen. it's small but for some few days in Madrid more than enough. the bed was in good shape and hard enough, width less 2m.
For me it was quiet enough to sleep, my love was fighting in the night with the voices of the neighborhood.
the surrounding is perfect, not too much traffic, but all the bus lines are there. but nearly everything is in walking sight. shops and cafés are just in sight.

It was a pleasure staying at Gerard's place. Everything was perfect and Gerard was very helpful giving many pieces of advice on how to get to the apartment and what to do during our stay.
Super recommended!

Gerard’s apartment was in an amazing location in Madrid! So close to the metro, so close to the core, and so close to the river parks! Overall, we had an amazing stay. We recommend staying with Gerard if you are coming by train, or are wanting to experience the main city centre of Madrid.
Good location, short walk to attractions, also close to the train station. Tidy, and had everything you need.

Great location right next to 2 metro lines and several busses. Nice and quiet neighborhood. Fully equipped apartment. Great Wi-Fi and really nice hosts.
Only downsides were that the bed was a little bit small and the apartment was in a semi basement and had tiny windows that were too high to open, other than that everything else was great!

We had a pleasant stay in Madrid, the appartment is easy to find in good area with connection to city center (between metro stations Acacias and Embajadores). Byron gave us keys on our arrival, explained everything and the flat was like on the photos, tidy and neat. I would recommend it to everyone. Cheers.

what a lovely time! The neighborhood where the air bnb is situated is central and the view from the balcony is stunning. The wifi is fast and the living room is cozy. Would definitely recommend this spot for a stay in Madrid!
Quite small but very good structured apartment. Fantastic terrace. Paula supported us in a very good way whenever we had any issue. A very good apartment that we can really recommend.

The apartment is located in a wonderful spot close to all great restaurants, museums and Retiro Park. The apartment was super clean and equipped with all you need to cook, chill or work. The terraces open to beautiful views of Madrid. Paula was super helpful and responsive. We loved our stay and will definitely come back .

We absolutely loved our stay here! Paula was a great host and her place was full of character. Not to mention the stunning views from the two patios! The neighborhood is bustling but not too crazy. Lots of great things to do.
Wonderful and cozy apartment with beautiful terrace! Great location! Super friendly and welcomy hosts! It was a pleasure to stay at this place. Highly recommend😊

This place was so beautiful and pleasant to stay.the location is perfect for everything around Madrid.walking distance to plenty of restaurants and bars and the metro. I would definitely stay here again next year when I come back to Spain.

Location is great and communication with hosts Also great. I had issues with shower which Lola attempted to correct by calling the repairman while we were there,  but it was not fixed, Because of this I don’t think I would stay here again. Hosts are great though!!

I spent a few months at the apartment and I couldn’t have asked for a better stay!! Lola was always so friendly and willing to help out, give recommendations, or bring by more towels if needed. The location was perfect, it is very easy to get around in Madrid, and having the metro stop so close to the apartment made it that much better. The apartment itself was super cozy, with all of the essentials stocked up in case you are wanting to cook. The bedroom and bathroom were very spacious with ample storage. Another plus was the balcony- It was huge! And the grocery store right next to the building!!! Overall, great host and a really nice apartment/ building. Would love to stay here again when I am back in Madrid. ❤️❤️
Lola’s flat was perfectly situated in the desirable Salamanca district. It was well connected but quite and discrete. I’d highly recommend !

Lola’s apartment is wonderful.  Very centrally located, surrounded with restaurants and bars, and very safe neighborhood.  Very spacious 8th floor balcony/terrace with great view.  No need to look further.  You have found your Madrid stay…. Great communications with the hosts too.

It was cosy and well located. It was a quick business trip so didn't have the chance to explore the neighborhood and Lola's tips, but kept them for my next travel to Madrid. that was a very nice detail! thanks!

We had a fantastic stay in a clean and comfortable apartment. We enjoyed the terrace. The place is in a very nice neighbourhood full of activity.
In short: a place to stay when you visit Madrid.

The balcony was very comfortable, the washing machine was also located outside which made it less noisy when we were inside. The appartement was comfortable. The pool was a 10/10, although it’s busy because the whole building uses it. The building itself is a little old and tacky but with 3 elevators we arrived at our own appartement fast. Also good contact with the owners and before leaving for our flight we could leave our luggage downstairs.
Host was very responsive and provided a must see list for me. The apartment was beautiful and all amenities including instant coffee and kitchenette were great!

This place was great. It was in such a wonderful location, you’re around 20 min to the airport and walking distance to many cafes and restaurants
The building has lockers and washing machines
Bob and his team thought of everything for the apartment. The Polaroid camera was sooo fun for the kids and so we’re the bunk beds
We loved our stay

Everything you need in an apartment. The attention to detail was there to really help you enjoy the time in Madrid. Walking distance to most places. Great location. Would not hesitate in recommending xx
Great location and responsive host! Great place to stay if you’re going to be just there to sleep - the living room was converted into another bed when we were there.
Spacious apartment located close to the metro and the bus station with easy access to Madrid centre. It is well supplied and very comfortable.
It was a wonderful, cozy place to stay in Madrid for 2 weeks, where we felt at home. We had everything we needed for cooking, cleaning, and laundry. Lucia and her assistants are nice and helpful.

An excellent host for a dream location! I was there for work, but it felt like being on holiday thanks to Fatima's warm welcome and truly exceptional hosting. From the moment I arrived, Fatima went above and beyond to ensure my stay was comfortable and enjoyable. Her attention to detail, local recommendations, and genuine hospitality made me feel right at home. The accommodations were pristine, and the location couldn't have been better. Whether you're visiting for business or leisure, you can expect an unforgettable experience with Fatima as your host. Highly recommended!

Fatima's place is absolutely beautiful. It is filled with charm and soul and feels like a home. It has a beautiful collection of art and possessions from across the world. However, it does not feel like a show home, it is it is spacious and comfortable and homely and has all the amenities needed for a short and long term stay. There is also a gorgeous outdoor patio at the front which is walled so it is private and very peaceful.
The neighbourhood is peaceful with tree lined quiet streets. There are lovely local cafes and restaurants around as well as a metro station less than a 10 minute walk from the place. The metro takes less than 30 minutes to get to the centre of Madrid.Fatima was so helpful and kind from start to finish. We travelled with a cat and Fatima kindly prepared a litter tray and scratching post for the cat before we arrived. She was also super responsive any time we messaged with questions and gave lovely local recommendations.

Fátima’s home was everything we could have asked for and more. She was incredibly accommodating, gracious, and made us feel right at home. We were looking for a long term apartment during this stay, and it honestly would not have been possible without Fátima’s kindness and flexibility. The home itself was very cozy and well loved. My cat especially loved all the shelves :) Could not recommend more!

Fatima’s house is beautiful and full of interesting cultural books and items. Very comfortable, everything we needed for our 2 week stay.
Fatima was lovely, caring and a very interesting lady!

Diego was a very friendly and hospitable host. We arrived after a long journey and we were greeted by a rare and phenomenal view (unfindable anywhere else). We walked into a very inviting and comfortable atmosphere. What an unforgettable experience; We highly recommend this penthouse.
Diego and Odi are helpful and excellent people. Thats great property and excellent views to the city.Highly recommended.

This was one of the best experiences we've had at an Airbnb!!!
The host was extremely supportive, very prompt to answer and the house was impeccable! Extremely clean and very warm as there was everything you needed. The house even had an option of dining at home and having a cook make a special meal for you! The view is breathtaking, sunsets and sunrises at the highest building in the area, amazing! The place was very close to everything, walked everywhere, close to the best touristic places and so we didn't need a car. Really worth the pay, reccomend it to everyone that wants a high-end, yet homey pleasant stay at Madrid. Thank you Diego and Odi!

AMAZING apartment! This is probably the best airbnb experience that I have ever had! Words can describe how amazing this place is and how amazing Diego and his team are. Diego is a fantastic host, he pays really close attention to the details and he makes sure that you have an amazing time. He helped us with local recommendations and he satisfied all of our requests and more. In addition, he was extremely proactive at checking in with us and making sure that we had everything we needed at all times.
Furthermore, Diego's team is amazing as well, she took really good care of me and my family, made our stay really comfortable and made it feel just like home.
If you are visiting Madrid and you can stay here I would highly suggest you do, you will have the best vacations ever, and you are not going to want to leave.
We can't wait to come back!

One of the best Airbnbs we've ever stayed in; breathtaking, unparalleled views, gorgeous decor, impeccable cleanliness, and the best location in Madrid. It's impossible to return to Madrid without staying at this apartment. Diego is an attentive host; very kind and always available. Odi is the person in charge of cleaning and cooking, and she's simply fantastic. Five stars for this experience, which we'll definitely repeat.
The apartment was very nice. The location is also perfect with the metro station two minutes away. Also many restaurants and things to do. We really enjoyed it

The apartment was in a great location, close to the metro , super market and restaurants. It worked well for my main need, which was to have a place to sleep for two nights. The bathroom was small, but manageable. Overall, the stay was fine for a short trip and the location made it very convenient.

The Airbnb was better than expected. We got there quite late and Cristina stayed up to let us in. She was very welcoming. The home was very comfortable and clean. One of my favorite things was actually the ceiling fan in the bedroom😅because it’s hard to stay cool in the Madrid summer heat.
It was very peaceful place to live. Moreover cristinia was very attentive and helpful.She helps me to find a good place to eat nearby

everything was absolutely perfect, the bedroom and bathroom were spotless, the bed was comfortable, shower has excellent water pressure! there's a massive park for walking nearby, and plenty of places to eat and buy groceries. only €12 Uber to the airport. it was a really good place to stay before my flight. 😊

Cristina was very nice and helpful! Her apartment was spotless and close to the airport. I stayed overnight to catch an early flight, but I felt very much at home in the short period I stayed. The bed in the bedroom was very comfortable and was able to rest well. Thank you Cristina! I will come back.

I had an overnight layover in Madrid before a trip to the states. I did not want to have to stay on the airport floor. Luckily, Cristina’s place was a short Uber ride away from the airport. She stayed up so late waiting for me too! As well as recommending what was the easiest form of transportation to get to where I needed to be.
Her space was so clean and comfortable. You can tell she really thought about all of the little things. It made my long trip so much more doable. If I have another layover in madrid I will definitely come back!

I stayed only for a night, but this was a great place, especially if planning to travel to other locations, since it’s really near to the airport.
Also, Cristina was really friendly and the place felt just like home, 100% recommend.
Cristina is a superstar.  The nicest room in Madrid and close to the airport.  This is my second stay because I enjoy it so much.

Cristina was a great host. She worked with us as we had to checkin late due to a delayed flight.
She was very helpful throughout our stay and she responded quickly to inquiries.
Her place is very today and has cool dog to the boot. I would like to stay here again

we only stayed for one night during connection, Cristina was very understanding for our late arrival.
the place was spotless extra clean
and comfortable
higely recommended
Cristina was very kind and supportive during my stay. The place is lovely and I felt like at home. Definitely I would stay again.
Cristina was a lovely host. She mande us feel at home and everything was perfect. I definitely recommend staying at her place.

Excellent room with private bath. Cristina has been an excellent host.
Valdebebas is a modern district, well connected with parking and all facilities needed.

I had an incredible stay at Cristina’s place! The space was spotless, beautifully decorated, and had all the amenities I needed for a comfortable stay. The location was perfectly close to restaurants, and Cristina gave me great dinner recommendations.
Cristina was an exceptional host, and super pet-friendly.
Thank you, Cristina.

Cristina place is ideal for catching early morning flight in MAD airport.
Uber/ Bolt is around €11-17 to airport.
She greeted us when we checked in.
The surrounding area is new and plenty of supermarket. So nice to buy souvenirs before leaving Spain.
The room and bathroom are clean. Bathroom is private but not attached with room. Coffee machine is equipped.
Definitely stay again if we come back.
Cristina was extremely responsive and very friendly. Place is very nice, clean and would come back definitely! :)

It was a great pleasure to stay with José and Asun! They were very nice and warm and helpful, even invited me to have lznch with them. I felt very comfortable at there place, it is a beautiful, calm place where I could live and work very well! Thank you!

The room is great. Everything is like on the picture. It's great that you have your own bathroom. It's very clean. The hosts are the best, very helpful and communicative. I had great time. High recommendation for this accommodation. 👍

José and Asun are really wonderful people. It was such a blessing to have been able to stay with them, and improve my Spanish by having loads of conversations and hearing their stories.
I felt comfortable straight away, and liked having my own bathroom, small balcony space, and being able to use the kitchen.
The space is really clean and well located - the surrounding neighbourhood felt safe and it’s well connected with nearby metro stations. There are also lots of shops and cafes!
It was a lovely stay and I would absolutely return! :)

José and Asun, first of all: thank you so much for all the love, attention, fun and hospitality!
Staying at Asun and José their house is like staying at your favourite aunt and uncle. They are the most welcoming people I have met, not exaggerating. I felt at home and taken care of. Staying with them is like a warm bath. The room is cosy and comfortable, the bathroom new, stylish and spotless. The neighbourhood is very much madrid, men and women look beautiful, having lunch on every corner of the street. Conclusion: I'm coming back, in the first place for Asun and José.
Much love

Thank you José for a great experience staying in your home! You were always kind and helpful from arriving, throughout the stay. The apartment has a perfect location, it's spacious as has all one needs. Room was just great. If you want to meet local people and spend also some time with your hosts, this is the perfect place in Madrid, I highly recommend!
Very good place to stay. has everything you need and more. the shower and the bathroom were spotless and very nice to use. I will definetaly come back

Great Location.
Place was clean and very comfortable.
Very comfortable and large shower.
There are no external windows in the living room and almost no natural light.
High standard for linens.
Felipe who checked us in was very responsive, but did not get back to us with answers for some of the questions (living room tv didn't work).
There is no bagage dropoff option, but therenos a very convenient locker storage around the corner.
Very clean, great location! Jorge was very helpful when we needed to flex and stay an extra day and although our flat wasn’t available made it super easy to move from one to the other.
The apartment is in a great location close to everything. A great cafe for coffee a few doors down ( Syra coffee) and a great Chinese restaurant in the same street. A comfortable apartment.
Clean apartment, comfortable, quiet, It’s not my favorite neighborhood in Madrid but it is great for tourists that want to get on foot everywhere, location is super centro
the only negative aspect of the flat is that the windows are parallel with the street. Fortunately, the outside is cold and I did not need to open the windows frequently
Jesus is an excellent host , his apartment is in the best possible location , it is clean and comfortable . I would recommend this accomodation

It took us a little while to find the right building when We first arrived but after that everything went smoothly. You could not get a better location, and the Apartment is decorated with a good esthetic eye. The bathroom was practically for the guests only as the host has his own toilet. In the kitchen you find all you need. The is no work desk in the room but I was able to work in the living room those days I had to use My computer. Jesús is a super friendly and relaxed host. I felt like being at home and will for sure return here when coming Back to Madrid!

We were able to book Emilio’s place with short notice (after another listing did not work out). Emilio was very responsive. Everything was as described in the listing. It was convenient having separate rooms and bathrooms. I also enjoyed the design and character of the apartment. Thanks again for allowing us to stay with short notice.
Fantastic stay! The apartment was great and Emilio was very responsive. Will definitely stay again during my next trip to Madrid!
Thanks for hosting us, we had a great time in Madrid. The place met our needs while in the area, it was clean, comfortable and conveniently located.

We really enjoyed our time at Emilio’s place. It’s a lovely apartment and we felt so comfortable and safe. It’s in a great neighborhood - we were able to walk almost everywhere and everything you might need is nearby. Emilio was very responsive and available when we had questions. A really nice experience while visiting Madrid.
Stayed at Dobohome’s for 2 nights. Perfect for what I needed. Absolutely clean and responsive host. I would definitely stay here again!
The place is amazing. The bed is super comfortable and the flat is very modern. I’d definitely come back.

Claudia’s apartment, while small, offers everything one needs for a pleasant stint in Madrid. The location is excellent - easy access to Metro and plenty of great shops and restaurants around. There’s also a 24-hour large supermarket nearby if needed. The neighborhood surrounding the apartment offers a great taste of the international/multi-cultural side of Madrid and the local shops and markets are vibrant and the restaurant variety offers an intoxicating blend all over the world.
Perfect for a single traveler or a couple who don’t mind being close proximity all the time, Claudia’s apartment comes recommended. As for Claudia - she’s great! Very proactive and helpful, and she always responded quickly. I very much enjoyed my stay and would be happy to come back.

We really enjoyed our stay here in Claudia's apartment in Lavapies.
After a very long flight it was a very quiet place to rest, ready to explore the sights.
Claudia was very responsive and patient with our requests for an earlier check in, after we'd had some personal difficulty with our own technology.
The apartment is within walking distance from Atocha station and many of the other beautiful sites of Madrid, making it a perfect place to stay.

The pictures of the apartment are true and communication with the host was easy! we thought the location of the apartment was really good! if there was a minus, the apartment was a bit cold and all the sounds of the street could be heard inside.

Patrícia was very helpfull
everything was clean when we did the check in
the apartment is 20min on foot from the city center so you are a well located
we enjoyed it very much

The host is friendly, check-in process is super easy.
The location is very good, interior is nice. It’s clean and you have everything you need (except for maybe a kettle but there’s a small pot). Tall people can find the bed a bit short. There are 2 beds, but it doesn’t help much since they aren’t connected among each other.

We only spent one night at Patricia’s studio, and arrived very late, but it was a very nice place to stay. The neighborhood is very great, and Patricia gave us very clear instructions about the check-in procedure, everything went fluently even at that late time at night. Though we didn’t meet her, but she was very kind and careful in communication. The studio is a bit tiny, the bathroom could be slightly bigger, but in general it was a lovely and neat place.
The place was clean and looked exactly as the pictures. Peaceful neighborhood and super well located. Patricia was very clear with the check-in process and how to get to the studio, highly recommend!

This stay is good for two people who are not staying in Madrid long term and is conveniently located very close to the Atocha train station and Atocha area with lots to do. Only negative was it was Madrid in July and the A/C would not blow cold air so we had to sleep with all the windows wide open just to make it bearable enough to sleep which was okay for our one night but unexpected. Other than that no real issues with this stay.
Very friendly host! The place is located right in the center and is very close to all museums and restaurants.
Very tiny place with everything possible you need for the comfort and most importantly during the summer in Madrid with great AC. Also near at most attractions in the city.
I only stayed here for a quick night before I flew out of Madrid, but location was perfect for traveling since it’s right next to Atocha! Great little place. I would definitely stay here again.
We had a great stay! The apartment ist a good home base for some wonderful days in Madrid and Patricia was a wonderful host with a very quick response time in case of any questions
Everything was great but the apartment was bit small. Perfect for one person. The host is very responsive and kind. Thanks!

A great stay at Raul's place. We appreciated how clean and well-equipped the apartment was, there's everything you need for a really comfortable stay. The location is perfect, in a neighborhood with a lot to do, but still quiet enough to have a good rest. Would rebook in the future.

Amazing apartment and Raul is an amazing host! The location of the apartment is great and you can almost walk to every sightseeing spot, restaurant or bar. The communication with Raul was super nice, easy and very helpful. Would absolutely recommend!

Raul's flat was a perfect location.  Having the keys in a lock box made it easy to get in.  The 2 bedroom and 2 bathroom was a HUGE plus.  It was clean and  fresh with all the necessities of home.  The Metro was nearby with plenty of dining options within walking distance.  We thoroughly enjoyed Raul's flat and would highly recommend staying here.  Thanks again Raul.

We had a great stay in this apartment in Madrid! It was very clean, well kept, and had everything we needed for a comfortable stay. The location was very central and walkable to many of the main sights and attractions. Would recommend
Fabulous stay in Madrid - the unit is in a great location and we walked everywhere. It is really quiet inside - really could not fault the stay or Raul’s hosting

All I have to say is Rauls place is a must if you are visiting Madrid! In the heart of La Latina you are footsteps away from bars, restaurants and supermarkets! Lots to do. The airbnb itself was super clean, everything was working perfectly. Very clean. Showers were very powerful and hot! Bed was comfortable too. Having a fan in all the rooms helped keep the place cool.

A beautiful well maintained spacious apartment. The location is perfect, plenty of restaurants and bars around. Small shops also. Walkable distance to Plaza Mayor. The place was really clean. Very quiet and nice to sleep, comfortable bed. I would definitely recommend this place for families or couples.

This is a great flat.Very well designed with no clutter , comfortable beds and great showers. Very well located in La Latina ..near a great market and lots of places to eat . Metro just 10 minutes away and an easy walk. We liked it all and would recommend to others wanting to stay in Madrid.
Beautiful, spacious property in an excellent location. Walking distance to all main attractions in the city. Beautiful restaurants nearby. Definitely would recommend!

We all loved the Airbnb. There were four adults staying and there was plenty of space for eating and relaxing. It was just as described.
The location was so convenient. La Latina is loaded with restaurants and places to see, and the Airbnb is right next to the Sam Fransisco cathedral, that is worth the visit. Everything was so walkable and easy, but there were also buses right near by as well as a metro stop.
Raul was great at communicating and even helped me book a taxi for my parents departure. We were really happy and hope to book with Raul again in the future.

My friend and I had a wonderful stay and really enjoyed the modern layout, great beds and two bathrooms. The location is also a walkable distance to Plaza Mayor and a Hop On Hop Off bus stop. We found it very central but relatively quiet with great restaurants and grocery stores. A Flamenco venue located around the Plaza Mayor is also in walking distance. We would highly recommend the ground floor apartment and the host is excellent.

Raul was a great host and everything was set up for us when we arrived. The location was perfect as it was away from the main tourist areas, so it was nice and quiet, but close enough to walk to everything. We would definitely stay again given the chance.

Great location and great place.  The appartement is really big.  The place could get a little hot sometimes since there is ceiling fans to cool it off.  The neighborhood was super calm.  Would stay there again.

Great place in a central location. Very easy to navigate and had many activities and food options near by. Raul was quick to respond. Raul’s place was very clean. Only wish there was air conditioning since the summers in Spain are very hot but otherwise was a wonderful stay!

This location is as good as it gets in Madrid. Ground floor, just off the busy streets. Walk to Plaza Mayor, Gran Via and all the local spots. The bedrooms are separate and private. The condition is new.
A/C would be a nice addition.
The apartment was very nice – spacious, with two separate bedrooms, and very clean. We had a great time, felt comfortable, and we’re satisfied.
Great location. Clean apartment. Liked our stay but a few additions could enhance stay. No little extras like coffee or sugar was provided. Bathroom is adequate but very small.

The apartment is beautiful and location is just perfect. The Retiro Park is 2 steps away and location is surrounding by great restaurants, market and bus and metro stops, so it's perfect.
Communication with the hosts is very efficient and they are willing to help in every level.

Bathroom is a little small but the apartment was great, adequately supplied, very clean with an excellent location, many shops, restaurants and supermarkets nearby. Easy commute within Madrid. Excellent and responsive host, we had an issue with the water heater and they fixed it immediately. Would definitely stay here again on our next trip.

We loved staying at Maria Teresa’s.  The location near Retiro park is fantastic.  The bathroom is overall small but the shower was good.  Guests need to carefully read the key section; a connected cell phone is needed to enter the building.  It would be helpful if that was highlighted and not assumed.  Our overall experience was excellent and we would definitely book there again.

I book this apartment for my stay in Madrid. Pilar's was a great host. Communication was great and their place was in best location 15 min walking to city center.
Clean and beautiful, just as advertised! Would recommend to anyone who is visiting Madrid City. He provided very detailed check-in and out processes which benefited the stay! Great value considering the overall unit, location, and free parking space! Would definitely visit again.

We were on a long trip, so this spacious modern apartment was a treat. Pilar arranged for Carlos to meet us. He helped us park, then showed us the apartment. Extra touches included a very good wine as a  welcome gift. The neighborhood was very quiet and residential.  The Prado was only a 16 minute walk away.  Restaurants, supermarkets, and a metro station were nearby.

We enjoyed our stay at Pilar Y Dani’s place.  We were met at the apartment and shown the garage for parking as well as the apartment.  The place is super clean and uncluttered.  It is an easy walk to the museums, park, and the palace.  We enjoyed the local area around the apartment as well.  The hosts were very responsive and provided great suggestions on places to visit as well as restaurants.  We would love to stay here again when we get the chance to visit Madrid again.

Fantastic place in Atosha, Madrid.  Very quiet in the apartment and we walked everywhere, although for some the northern areas of the city centre may be a bit far for some. Communication was excellent.  Shower was a highlight.  Definitely recommend.
Pilar was amazing! She came and met me outside right on time and showed me the parking, the apartment, places to eat and the amazing gym around the corner. very happy 😊

We had a wonderful stay. The location is a reasonable walk to the Reina Sofia, the river park (great splash pad and playgrounds for kids/beautiful running), Retiro Park, and The Prado. The apartment itself is gorgeous and even though it's urban, very quiet. Pilar and Dani were very responsive and helpful. The only thing I would say is if you have small children, it might be a tad stressful. Ours are 5 and 8 and we still worried about them accidentally breaking some of the gorgeous glass/porcelain art/lamps. If you don't have kids: enjoy because it's impeccably decorated.

The place is really nice. It does have a clear glass in the living room were light bleeds in at night from the outside the room which we didn't like. The front door wouldn't lock from the inside while we were there. The bathroom door didn't have a lock. If those few things are addressed it's a pretty good place. Location was excellent!

Really nice place and well organised to check in and check out.
Incredibly nice the owner let us park the car after check out.
Pilar was very responsive and a great host .  Flexible on check in and out.   Great place for a family, very clean and exactly as described.

Great apartment in a very well-located area of Madrid. The apartment was exactly as described in the advert and the hosts were very responsive. The apartment itself is within walking distance of almost all major attractions and the metro is a 5 minute walk away. Would definitely recommend and would absolutely stay here again. Thanks to Pilar Y Dani.

We had a great 3 days in Madrid for our family if 4.  Enjoyed our stay at Pilar Y Dani's place. 15 min walk to Atocha Metro/Train Station and many neighborhoods.  Beds were comfortable. AC was great. Felt very safe.  Would recommend!

We have had a great stay at Pilar and Dani’s place.
The only thing we have to note is that there is not a lot of daylight in the apartment.
The rest of the apartment was perfect, would definitely recommend the place.
Great location, 10 min walk to Atocha train station, 5-10 min walk to Sofia Reina museum.  1 bedroom with open floor plan.  Pool was great as it was very hot in Madrid during our stay.

I stayed here for 3 nights primarily but loved it so much I booked an extra night the host is responsive and the cleaning ladies are so sweet as well as very flexible check in as soon as I got here at 11am my room was ready I would love to return again very soon!

Jonathan’s place is great - very clean and new! Location is very central, you can walk all the center of Madrid easily. The Lavapies neighborhood is pleasant with lots of cafes and bars nearby. Overall a great trip and a great stay - thanx Jonathan!

The listing was just as in the pictures... Jonathan met us in person to hand over the keys... he left us a wine bottle which was a very nice gesture
.
.. he was very prompt in replying to msgs...
over all good experience

Jonathan’s place was worth what we paid and more. Very nice apartment with oven, microwave, dish washer and clothes washer. Was a 2-5 minute walk from closest transit stop and within 30 minute walk around the entire inner city perimeter. Jonathan was the best host that I have had. He is super responsive and really helps navigate the city l, as well as transporting needs. I appreciated the face to face meeting as well. He really cares.

We loved our stay at Jonathan’s apartment. It was very well set up to stay for a few days and was quiet at the back of the building.
It is walking distance to all the historical sights and other places of interest. So close to wonderful tapas bars and restaurants.
The area of Lavapies is very multicultural with lots of Middle Eastern and African food places.
Would definitely stay again.

Jonathan has been very helpful and responsive throughout our stay. The apartment is close to public transport and supermarkets. It was clean and matched the description. Great value for money.
Highly recommend to book your stay..
Place is very clean and quiet. Jonathan left us a bottle of red wine, that was very sweet of him

Jonathan was a great host, very communicative and thoughtful. The apartment is located in a nice spot, close to many coffee shops, butcher shops, parks and gyms.  I'd definitely recommend this stay at Jonathan's.
So nice! I will come back for sure!! everything was nice and clean, i love this apartmend and madrid.
Great location and walkable to various points of interest such as Plaza Mayor and a supermarket. His place was spacious and had everything you need!
The place was very near the main streets. It only takes 10-minutes walk. We did not face any problem
I enjoyed my stay here. I managed to walk to and from tourist spots within 10-15 mins. The bed was comfortable as well as apartment being modern with clean. I recommend this place !

A wonderful modern place to stay! The location is amazing being able to walk to pretty much every tourist spot Madrid has to offer! Only a 5 minute walk from the subway station so super nice when walking with luggage. The place itself is super big with tall ceilings and very modern. The shower was incredible and HUGE for Europe! Only complaint is directly outside the door there are some sketchy people and we saw a lot of police our first night. We were never bothered but just be high caution, walk 5 minutes down the street and everything felt good. Very responsive host with very good directions and recommendations! He truly cares about his guests
We enjoyed our stay at Jonathan’s place, the location made it easy to walk everywhere. The accomodation was clean and comfortable, we would come back :)
Nice and clean apartment with great breakfastrestaurants in the neighbourhood. Everything in walking distance  (Palace, Sol, Gran Via, Rastro) and nearby the metro. The wine was a nice touch!

Very nice flat! Super clean and perhaps even better than the pics. The area is nice too although there are  some dodgy people in the local square . All in all recommended though and the host reassured me there have never been issues.

Excellent stay at Jonathan’s.
Didn’t consider staying anywhere else when we knew we weren’t returning to Madrid.
Our 2nd stay at Jonathan’s and it was just how we remembered it.
Would not hesitate to stay again if we find ourselves back in Madrid 🩵
Jonathan was a great host, always responsive and accommodating. The apartment was clean and contained great amenities.

We had a great stay at Jonathan’s place. He was friendly and welcoming and the apartment was perfect. It was easy to walk and explore the city with plenty of restaurants and cafes close by. Thanks Jonathan!

Great location and wonderful apartment .   Host was very responsive and helpful. Minor problems were handled expeditiously. Instructions on using the Nespresso machine and initial start up of stove top would be helpful in the future.  A little more silverware and a can opener would be nice.  With that said it was still an excellent 3-week stay.

This place has a great location! Very close to Atocha (absolutely walking distance). Has a great design and use of space. We stayed four people and had a very good time, feeling comfortable (not always happening in Europe we're space can be limited in rentals). Only observation is that staircase looks smaller in pictures than it really is, so take into account it's a bit steep. Really loved this place!

Excellent location, great place to stay everything close and walking distance. Little noisy after night clubs close, but all big cities has it
Highly recommend
Very responsive and quick. The place is very clean, in a great location that is in the middle of everything; plaza Mayor, port de la Sol, and many more. We loved it and would definitely recommend.
loved it here. Great accommodation and location in the heart of Sol. recommended if you want to be right in the heart of the neighbourhood. perfect host.
Great location. Neighborhood can be noisy (including late at night) but the walls were thick so noise was never a problem. Building was a little bit old and we needed maintenance to come a few times.
We enjoyed staying at Sergio y Juan Carlos's place. The location was great, the place was clean and the host was responsive. Thank you so much!

Fantastic location right by the Palace with loads of beautiful cafes and restaurants nearby.
The apartment was spacious with two lovely double bedrooms both with large ensuite bathrooms.
I would definitely recommend.
this is a wonderful located place to stay. the place is clean and confortable. we will be back!

very flexible and responsive host, the airBnB is clean and close to the supermarket, a few restaurants and the metro station.
We were satisfied with the apartment, only thing you must be aware of is opening all windows when you leave the home in order for the air to circulate through. The air can get a bit stuffy otherwise.
Thank you for accommodating us.

This place was beautiful! Huge windows, modern decor, and most importantly…clean! It was in a great location and walkable to cafes and grocery stores and overall felt like a safe neighborhood. The house has the basics and we only truly spent the night there while spending the rest of the day out and about so can’t speak much on the kitchen utilities, but the house as a whole was worth it. The owners are also very helpful and responsive to any questions you might have before or during your stay!
Thank you!
Great stay in Barrio Salamanca. Really recommended if you want to stay in the key neighbourhood of Madrid
Wonderful place to stay with restaurants and access to the subway system. We really enjoyed it. Thanks!
We loved our stay here. It was super clean, comfortable, well-furnished, conveniently located, easy to find, etc. Would definitely stay here again.

What an amazing stay! From the location to their beautiful apartment and off course, lovely Madrid .. we couldn’t be anymore satisfied and happy with our stay! Thank you so much, you made Madrid memorable for us! Definitely we will return soon!
It’s a simple apartment, but was very comfortable and quiet. All the appliances are tucked away in the shelves

The location of the aptartment is impecable, everything you need is in walking distance - even the Bernabeu (and hour walk but flat). Of course you can get there by the metro as the sol station is 3 minuts away. Marta was proactive in reaching out, super responsive, the apt was super clean, everything was perfect for us (2 parents and 3 kids 13,10, and 6)
It was a pleasure to stay in the comfortable apartment in the heart of the most beautiful city in the world.
Great place, incredible location in the midst of everything, hosts were very responsive and shared valuable insights. Fully recommend the place!!!
Unbeatable location and beautiful apartment. Host were very responsive and proactive. elevator made everything easier. good air conditioning.

this is a very well equipped and comfortable apartment just 5 minutes away from Sol.   It was great to have a lift.   the hosts were very good communicators and flexible about check in.  there's is a place to store luggage right next door, so convenient.   We would be very happy to stay there again
The apartment is newly renovated, clean and in great location. If you are coming to spend time outside, as we did for the x-mas markets, it is ideal for overnight.

It was a very good experience; it was small but comfortable. It was very easy to access, and everything was ready at my arrival. I recommend this place for those that want to walk Madrid, metro and train stations are very close facilitating the mobility. It is surrounded by nice restaurants and interesting places. It is perfect for 2 people.

Great host. Very clean and livable apartment. Great location due to its proximity to sites of significance within the city. Only drawback was the relatively poor sound isolation from the street and neighbors, which resulted in somewhat frequent disturbances of sleep.
Great appartment on the fringes on Sol and the Plaza Square. walking distance to great local spots and restaurants. Would definitely recommend and would stay again if coming back to Madrid.

Loved the place. Plenty of room and right near so much. It was easy to get around and then walk back if I needed to grab something. Loved the area quiet enough but also not far. Very clean and the bed was super comfortable.

Amazing location, cozy apartment. However since the location is around city, its quite loud during the night.
Also 140cm bed for 2ppl, quie small.
Very good location, nice and clean apartment. Raul was very friendly and the communication was great. I highly recommend!

Apartment is as described and perfect for a weekend in Madrid. Noise from the road can get a little loud but that’s to be expected considering the very relevant and central location. Only negative comment was the odd smell within the apartment on arrival that took a few days to clear.
Raul was very responsive and helpful Everything went smooth from check in to check out the apartment is  clean and well located near everything you need I’ll come back for sure
Raul’s place was in a great downtown location, close to lots of important sites (i.e. the Prado) and was a perfect size for 2 people. Raul was extremely communicative and helpful. Highly recommended
The place was excellent. Lots of things to do in the area. Host was very helpful and accommodating. Very well located.

Very good host and very friendly. It felt like being at home. She told me about places I could visit and even gave me a metro card to use for the train. The dog Hugo was cool too. Would definitely recommend this place if you just want to rent a room to yourself
The visit definitely exceeded my expectations. The location was ideal as we were right in front of the metro. Everything was clean. Great stay

Emilio’s place was amazing and located in the center of Madrid, therefore getting to all the tourists attractions and amazing restaurants was so easy and convenient. The communication and attentiveness was great! Overall, my stay was spectacular!

This was a great place, My kids and i stayed here for 2 weeks and the host and the apartment were great, they were there for any issues that came up and everything was resolved quickly. I highly recommend you stay her as well. If you want to see all of Madrid while walking everywhere, this is the place to be.

Location was awesome.
Biggest issue I had with the place was two security cameras INSIDE the Airbnb. They covered the camera so that the host could not visually see us but there was no guarantee they could not listen to our conversations. Felt like a real violation of privacy. If the cameras were not inside the Airbnb I would have given this place 4/5
Amazing place and great neighborhood the building and appartement are very clean you have everything you might need around. I recommend staying at Alvaro’s place

Alvaro is a great host who checked in on me before the trip, to make sure he knew my plans so he could make sure things were ready for my stay.
The apartment is in a great location, with easy access to transportation and attractions (parks, markets). The neighborhood itself is beautiful and has a great variety of food restaurants close by.

Amazing place to stay! Location is prime, close to everything you need to be close to. Loved having a doorman and elevator.
The apartment is very comfortable and has its charm. When I go back I’m staying here again!
The location is great, with a lot of restaurant, cafe options near by. The bed was comfortable.

Alvaro’s place is exactly as described and in a great location! Easy access to transportation, shops, restaurants, etc. Alvaro was very timely in all communications even though he was on vacation during our stay.
We enjoyed two nights at Alvaro's place. Great location in Barrio Salamanca. Just as shown in the photos.

A 3rd floor apartment in a large apartment block. Alvaro’s place is located in the Goya district of Madrid, a very pleasant area with up-market shops, a good range of restaurants, and with good bus/metro links to the historic centre. The apartment is comfortable for a couple, and has a concierge at the entrance. A good base from which to explore a great city.

We had a great stay at Alvaro‘s place.  The location was perfect. Transportation was close by as well as being able to walk to a variety of places.  We would stay at Alvaro’s again if we visit Madrid.
The flat was perfect for a city scape, unmatchable location, Alvaro was a great host!

We had a pleasant stay at Esther’s place. The location was very good.  The apartment was perfect for our 5 days stay in Madrid.  Was able to prepare dinner and do laundry.  Lots of restaurants choices around the area too.

Esther's place is in a great location, near public transportation, Atocha and Retiro. It is well represented in the description and is good value for money. A good option to spend a few days in Madrid!
This was a great spot in the heart of Madrid.  Lots of places to walk to as well as easy cab access to venture further from the apartment.  Super clean and very responsive host.

The location is just perfect . we enjoyed our stay there . near to all monuments . just by walking around you discover all the must see spots .
I highly recommend.

Had an issue with boiler. Not hot water on arrival. Host messaged me back instantly and had it fixed within the day. Other than that great location and stay. Would recommend to anyone travelling to Madrid. The metro is literally outside the front door
amazing stay one a/c wasn't working on one room but owner helped fixed it. thank you for everything!

Large flat with a terrace in a very central location in Madrid. Two double beds with comfy mattresses, lounge with TV, large bathroom and basic kitchen. Excellent for a short stay in Madrid. Be aware that you will have to check-in through an external link and upload identification - it was a bit nerve-wracking giving that much information not through Airbnb, but it turned out to be legit and fine. Apparently Madrid requires it - seems unnecessarily intrusive.

Very great apartment, with beautiful views. 20min walk from main strip in city centre, Lidl and local shops right on the doorstep.
Host was amazing, we couldn’t figure out how to turn on the hot water for the shower and they had a maintenance man with us within half an hour!! Couldn’t recommend more, excellent host will definitely stay with them again!

A well maintained and modern apartment in Madrid. Communication with the host was quick and clear. A nice bathroom with a big shower. Only two downsides were the lack of dishes (only 4 glasses, 4 plates, 4 spoons etc.), and the two double beds were quite small for 2 adult people. But I can definitely recommend
very very nice place, located in a nice area and is very easy to get around. Only downside is that at times you can smell the drains which isnt pleasant. would recommend!
Great apartment with an amazing location! Host was very responsive and helpful. Walkable to everything and very close to the opera metro. Thank you for a great stay!
The apartment was really clean, The neighbourhood was quiet, metro station very close. Check in quick and contact with Jorge without any problem. I can recommend this place in Madrid.

Place is great . Large and clean
Location its little fur from a center of city to walk
Kitchen is good only need little more staff .
Communication is grest. Thank you
the appointment is good only problem was they only gave us 3 towels for 3 people also the bedroom sheets were stained

we would be looking to come back to Noel's place again at some point in the future. apartment is located in quite neighbourhood with great public transport connections to the city centre. each room has air con and it has been well needed in this heat. it's perfect place to stay and explore Madrid
This is a very nice apartment (well-laid out, comfortable, and clean) in a popular area near numerous attractions.

Lovely place and very central!
Would def recommend this.
The lady who cleaned the place was very lovely and helpful :)
The apartment was exactly as described. Very nice location, walking distance from a lot of restaurants. The host was very responsive and helped us during our trip. Highly recommended.

Perfecto!  Great location and everything you need for a stay in Madrid.  I would not recommend 2 adults sleep in one bed. It would have been too small for my husband and I (coming from USA). Loved our stay and will be back if in Madrid!

Snova's property is extremely well located and a perfect choice when traveling with a group requiring three bedrooms. Despite being located in the heart of the action the noise from outside is barely noticeable.
The patio is a very nice option and the electric retractable awning makes it comfortable even in the Summer heat.
Note that one cannot drive right up too the building, but it is an easy 2 - 3 min walk from the street and an underground parking garage.

Location, location, location!!  Also, really appreciate having a restroom and air conditioning in each room as well.  Fernanda was very responsive when we had a minor issue checking in.  Would definitely book again when in Madrid.
This place was incredible. Very good location and the apartment was very clean and updated. We specially enjoyed the outdoor terrace.

The flat is beautiful, super clean, it has everything you need and more. The host is very friendly and a great communicator. we truly recommend it and, if I ever come back to Madrid, I would definitely go to the same flat.
Excellent place and attention! Impeccable location and Snova was always easy to contact and super helpful. Will come back!

The place is located really close to everything, kind of like downtown location, me and my family are used to walk and go to places by foot, so for us it was great.  Great amenities and response from the host, Fernanda is super friendly and attentive, making sure you are doing ok or if you need something. Will be back for sure.

This was a beautiful apartment in a very nice location for seeing the city and a patio that enhanced our experience! It was nice having three bedrooms and three bathrooms as well as air conditioning (Madrid was hot!). It was easy to walk to plenty of things in the area so we had a great time. The host was very communicative too.

The place was very clean, thoughtfully designed, and modern. The balcony was a great bonus, providing extra space to relax. Having three bathrooms was especially convenient for our family of five. The host was responsive and helpful throughout our stay.
There were only two minor inconveniences. First, the check-in process was a bit complicated. Second, the apartment is located within a shopping plaza that locks its gates between 9 PM and 8 AM. On the day of check-out, we were instructed to leave the key in the mailbox, but our e-card did not work at the moment. Thankfully, a local gentleman happened to open the door for us—otherwise, we might have missed our flight. Unfortunately, this detail wasn’t clearly explained in the property description.

This was by far the best stay of our Airbnb on my family eurotrip. Location is prime, next to Plaza mayor, close to restaurants and convinience stores made it really easy for my family to settle in as soon as we arrived. The actual apartment was beautiful and comfortable for my family of 6 and the host made sure to leave us with recommendation and ecen a little gift upon arrival. Only down side was trying to locate this place at check in since it is located on a street where no uber can access so i would recommend to carefully read at check-in instructions which are pretty clear. 5/5 this is a great option for anyone visiting madrid.

I know it might sound cliche, but it's all about location, location, location. And Ivan's place is in an excellent location! Just a few minutes walk to the Royal Palace and many other landmarks. It's also very clean and has all the utensils we could wish for. It's also a huge place for 2 people, but that didn't bother us at all. Quite to the contrary, we fully enjoyed it. Overall a great way to experience Madrid.

A wonderful stay in this lovely apartment. It was exactly as described. Clean and beautifully designed.  In a great area - easily walkable to all the major sights.  All in all a thoroughly enjoyable experience

This is such an amazing place to stay. It is not only comfortable and practical but extremely fun and stylish. We just absolutely loved it. The location is also pretty much ideal as you can easily walk everywhere and there are countless eateries and shops everywhere. I would definitely recommend this place to anyone looking for a comfortable and memorable stay in Madrid.

Great location, close to the Madrid palace and walkable to many restaurants, shopping, points of interest, etc in downtown.
The apartment is very spacious, private and in a peaceful location.
The host was very responsive and also gave us good recommendations when we had specific questions.
I really enjoyed my stay! 5 stars all the way! Couldn’t be happier! I plan on coming again next month

We had a great time at Antonio's place. The appartment is comfortable, so are the beds! The kitchen is modern and well equipped.
the metro station is super close, and the appartment is walling distance from Retiro Park.
There is a restaurant downstairs in which people watch football games...it can get noisy in the evenings but not late at night.
Even knowing this, I would gladly go back to this appartment!

It was a great stay! The place is new and everything was spotless! The area was quiet and everything was nearby! The host was amazingly nice and was very polite and VERY accommodating. It is worth noting that The apartment is small, but definitely well equipped with everything that you'd need. I'd love to stay there again.

The apartment was perfectly situated and convenient to everywhere we needed to be for our short stay. It was clean and well-stocked of amenities. What was truly fantastic though was the communication with Alvaro. Our flight was unexpectedly bumped to much later than anticipated, very late into the the night. In spite of this, Alvaro was meeting us out front with the warmest smile and welcome when we finally arrived.
Amazingly beautiful. One of the most beautifully furnished places I've stayed at that is also centrally located. Loved my stay and wished it was longer. Thank you for the amazing time.

Fantastic location and lots to do and eat and see in walking distance! I was a little confused about the description because I thought there were two bedrooms but it was one bedroom with bunk beds and a pullout in the living room area. Could have been my mistake when reading. Host was very responsive and was available at check in.
Julia was patient and waited for me despite my flight arriving at midnight. Replied all questions, and overall the aribnb was in great condition.

We had the perfect stay at Julia’s. The location couldn’t be better, just a few minutes’ walk to both the long-distance train station and the local metro. All the major sights are easily accessible by foot, a short bus ride, or a couple of metro stops. The apartment itself is beautiful: clean, bright, spacious, and very comfortable. The kitchen was well equipped, and we had everything we needed for our stay. Supermarkets are close by, and the neighborhood felt safe and convenient. Julia was a lovely and responsive host. Highly recommend to anyone visiting Madrid!
Raul's place is super clean, spacious and has everything you need. The location is excellent too. Thank you for a lovely stay!
Raul was very friendly and the apartment was excellent! location is perfect and it's quite and easy check-in
Very clean and well decorated apartment in central Madrid. Good AC and comfortable bed which was great in the summer heat.
The location was perfect, close to everything, lots of walkable spots, and easy to catch a taxi or call an Uber. I definitely would recommend staying here.

A beautiful and sparkling clean place in a great neighbourhood of Madrid. Somehow the location manages to be right in the middle of the action with an array of bars and restaurants just seconds away, yet really quiet and peaceful. Would absolutely recommend staying here, and our host Raul was very friendly and responsive. My only issue is that I wish I had booked much longer!
Lovely apartment in a fantastic location. Neighbours were a bit noisy at points but overall fine. Raul was very responsive and we loved our stay. Thank you!
Very nice apartment in a top location in Madrid with all facilities required for a city stay. Raul was really fast in answering and always very nice.
Very nice place and centric, we walked to all the top attractions in Madrid. Many restaurants, bars and supermarkets close by.

Our Madrid unit was in a perfect location (we walked everywhere).
It was clean, secure and easy to get in (we arrived 3:00am)
Raul’s place was just as described, very clean and walking distance from entertainment. The only negative was that the neighbors were noise late at night. Other than that we loved our stay.
