Good value for the money. The place is spotless and has all ammenities. Not to mention it is in an ideal location. Everything is in walking distace. Perfect for a place to crash, reload and then start exploring again. Raul was available as indicated via Airbnb, the instructions and infos were clear, detailed, exactly what was needed.

Awesome and cozy place, right in the middle of everything.
Thank you Raul for everything, we felt at home.

Clever use of space. Neat, modern and confortable. The location is superb.
You are in the middle of everything and yet the apartment is quiet. Loved it
Great place for a short stay in Madrid. Central enough to walk everywhere. Only note is the neighbors upstairs are loud during sleeping hours.

Apartment was very close to lots of attractions and restaurants. Modern open concept space, however the refrigerator was very loud which would make it difficult to sleep if you’re sensitive to noise. We had a short stay, so overall it fit our needs and the host checked in with us and was friendly.
The place is exactly like it looks in the pictures. Clean and decent. The location is very good

The apartment was clean, well organized and beautiful. It was located on a very great location so that I could easily walked ant landmark of thr city. Raul is a great host and very communicative and helpful. Would definitely recommend.
Overall it was great, the place had a great location and it was just as announced. Definitely recommend.

The perfect pied de terre for a super short city stay. Super compact, this studio apartment had more amenities than some of the larger ones we have rented. We weren't accustomed to the soft mattress and firm pillows, but accept it may be a cultural difference. It was clean and we enjoyed our stay.
The location suited our needs perfectly. We walked to galleries and museums, shops. Loved the special qualities of the historic literary quarter, its unique creative boutiques, modern bakeries, tapas, restaurants, architecture.
This business owns many properties, and have specific protocols. They use automated messaging a lot more than others, which can be unuseful and draining if you're managing data on an overseas SIM. They then followed up with a solicitation to rent another place.
A small issue, as international travellers we experienced some confusion gaining entry using a combination of pressing doorbells and internet links. We attribute this to AirBnB translation AI.

Convenient place to stay to visit the center of the city. Some tools to eat there, but nothing to cook. Really clean. Nice decorations in the room even though there was no window (but no surprise, it was written in the description 😌). Free cofee and snacks that were appreciated.

The description for this accommodation was accurate. The price matched the value, and was centrally located. It is accessible to several metro stops, great food, options, and a quaint area. If you’re looking for a budget accommodation, this is the spot! I returned here after my first, stay, and would book it again.

The area was amazing, right in the heart of Madrid.
I would also say that the room looked better in reality than in photos and it was clean.
We also had free snacks which was really nice!
Overall, a great experience :)

The room matched the description perfectly. It wasn't noisy at all, in fact I had no trouble catching sleep. The main attractions of Madrid's city center are all a few minutes away, but in spite of this the area is quite and safe by night. There are free coffee and snacks, which were very much appreciated. Definitely recommended.
best location ! very comfortable room with all the basics. the pillowcases smelled dirty and the sheets were not cotton (polyester) so was hot but otherwise a great Airbnb for the price.

The location was fantastic.
Minutes from Puerto Del Sol right in the centre of the city. Really easy to find and great check in instructions.
Raul was really fast and friendly with his communications.
Great frills free accommodation.
Highly recommend
Great location. Easy to find. It was very quiet for being next to the Puerta del Sol.

Everything as described. The location is as central as possible - which was ideal for our purposes - to explore Madrid. P.S. Please note, if you have heavy luggage, that this is the second floor without an elevator.

For the third time, I booked for Raul and Alma's place in Calle del Carmen in Sol last minute. They were so nice to accommodate me and let me check in very early than the expected time. Thank you for everything! 😊
Great place, clean and spacious, situated in a sketchy area but it has a lot of shops, restaurants and bars around it.
Alex’a place was as described and seen on photos. The unit was very nice and clean. I would stay there again! Host was very communicative and responsive at all times.

I stayed at this accommodation and here's my review: The interior is beautifully decorated, and the three entrance doors provide a sense of security.
However, there are a few drawbacks: no kettle in the Apartment, no shampoo or body wash provided, and finding a parking space was very challenging.
We loved our stay! Location was excellent only a few mins to the train into the tourist areas of Madrid. Hosts went above and beyond to help us get into the apartment with all our baggage.

Martin and his partner were extremely friendly and helpful hosts. We were met at check in and showed around the place, what keys were for what etc. Martin dropped us off to our event and did everything possible to make this as smooth as possible. There is a supermarket 30 seconds walk down the road that has everything from fresh food to snacks to any amenities. I cannot recommend staying here enough, if watching tennis at the Caja Magica, this place should be top of your list.
Martin was a great host, very responsive and very friendly. Place was as it was portrayed, would definitely come back and recommend!

This apartment is fantastic. Such a lovely place to stay. We are going back again in a weeks time for a few nights. The response time is amazing. Truly amazing. My wife and I can’t pick any fault with this.
Great location, newer Airbnb with working AC and comfortable bed. Communication a bit challenging with the language barrier but overall a decent stay.

Lovely apartment in a convenient location.  Close to metro and walking distance to many attractions. Apartment was clean and spacious with plenty of storage space and fully equipped kitchen. Quiet building and apartment with outdoor space.  Apartment was exactly as described.  Host was responsive and helpful both accommodating our timing and with helpful tips. Would stay again!
Apartment is nice, beds and sheets not ver comfortable. Location is pretty good with train station close with Mall inside.

Great place in the very center of Madrid. Very convenient location for those who aim to visit all the main sightseeings. The apartment was very calm and cozy despite having some bars on the street (windows do not look at the street). The flat itself has a lot of light, very clean and stylish. The communication with the nicest host was on top. Definitely recommend this place 10/10

We had a great time staying at Tiago’s place. The accommodation is clean, quiet, secure and safe. The Chueca area is very vibrant and diverse and it is easy to access all main attractions from the apartment. Tiago is friendly and responsive. We will definitely be back.

Fantastic apartment! A place like home, it has all the things you need , kitchen has new appliances , utensils and washing up cleaning stuff, the bedroom is very nice , king size bed and very comfy to sleep on, they provided 2 warm duvet , one for the sofa bed , the bathroom is very clean and has like a walk in shower, complete with shampoo gel , hair dryer and towels,.
There is a convenience store opposite the apartment which is really good for the basic stuff you need, Buses 1 min away goes to around Madrid good for sightseeing and can take you back using same bus number. Metro only 6 mins away that goes round Madrid.
I would definitely recommend and stay here again.
Toni the guy that run the apartment is very friendly , good communicator and look after you with anything that you need.

Check-in was easy and convenient for our needs and the apartment was very nice and clean with all the amenities we required. I would recommend people to stay here and would come back again if I'm in Madrid.
Extremely responsive and detailed host. The location was perfect for our plans and the space itself has everything you need, including an amazing closet.
Another great stay here and we're grateful for the quick help when we needed it too! As always I recommend staying here!

The accommodation looked exactly like the photos and was clean. The location was great, there were bus stops right outside the apartment and we could easily get everywhere. Communication was clear and Toni was helpful and friendly.

Had a great stay at Goitirre’s place. Apartment is very nice and just as described with easy connection to the center of Madrid.
Tony was very responsive and helpful as well - offering flexible check in and check out times.
Would definitely stay here again!

Great communication with the host. Very helpful in showing the apartment and helpful in suggesting the tourist spots. The apartment was also very clean, comfortable and located in a very nice neighbourhood, with easy bus and metro access. The apartment is also located on ground floor which makes it very convenient.

I had an enjoyable stay. Great amenities and within walking distance to buses and the metro. Lots of supermarkets, bars and restaurants.
It was great to get into Cuatro Caminos, Gran Vía and other areas in Madrid. Very clean and Toni was a good host.

Maria the host was a super nice lady, who always respond immediately, though sometimes I texted very early or late due to my schedule. She’s always helping me asap, which makes me feel more than just home. She made my first time Airbnb experience amazing, I would definitely book with her again:)

This apartment is cute. If you're a solo traveller or a couple youll enjoy this place. It's a perfect vibe for a city break.
Decor was great and had everything I needed.
If I return to madrid id consider staying here each visit.
Maria was very attentive to everything I needed and came round when I needed help.
There is a local park minutes away too

María and Carlos were wonderful hosts. Available for any needs I had with my fur baby.
Super accommodating and welcoming for my lengthy stay in their Airbnb.
Would recommend and stay at their place anytime.
Cozy  place for if you’re out and about in Madrid. Well located,  lots of amenities and the nearby park is great.  Maria is so responsive!
Carlos and Maria are great hosts! The apartment was well appointed and very clean. Location was good and close to beautiful parks.

The apartment is great, however, the place is smaller than you appreciate in the photos. The AC is at the living room and will not cold the bedrooms. It is in a fourth floor, with no elevator. The host was great, very nice and she will communicate fine. The location is very good. Close to all the major attractions.
Great flat! Newly renovated and in the back of the building so not noisy. I really enjoyed my stay and would be back here again!

We had a bit of a rough start with check-in as there was some miscommunication and we had to wait outside a bit in the rain, but once we were in they were super helpful and apologetic. They wanted to make things right and gave us vouchers for a touristic attraction. That was super thoughtful and they didn’t have to do that. We really enjoyed it. The place is lovely just like the pictures. The elevator was out of service most of our trip but it is only one flight up the stairs so it was not inconvenient at all. We would recommend this place as it was centrally located and very clean. The hosts definitely go out of their way to make things right. Very appreciated.
Good location, feels like everything is up to 30 minutes walk. The place as described and has all you need.

This airbnb was great for a short stay. Super clean, safe and in a good area with lots in walking distance. The only thing I will say is the street numbers are confusing, there are several 33’s within the same block so it took a while to find the door. When I sent the host a photo of a door to confirm it was the right one he said “if you’re at the right address it is!” It was not the right door but other than that it was good.

I had a great stay in Madrid! The place is very well located, with easy access to public transport, shops, and a supermarket just around the corner. The area felt safe, and getting around was simple. Inside, it was comfortable and well-kept, making it easy to relax after a day of exploring. Would definitely recommend for both short and longer stays.

María was very friendly and responded quickly to whatever I asked her while I stayed there.
The flat is located in the heart of Madrid. You can go to any attractions
ns on, foot. There was everything that we wanted; shampoo, conditioner, hair dryer, air conditioning, utensils, etc.
Additionally, I was so happy that there was a lift!
I highly recommend this place, thank you for all your help!
Gracias ☺️

If you wanna stay in the central of Madrid and be close to everywhere this is a great place to stay very cozy and private.
as soon as you get out it just buzzing everywhere around you but the great things was we couldn’t hear anything at night time inside our apartment so it was easy to sleep at night time.
Maria was a great host and very helpful.

Thank you very much ! Very nice place with a touch of design and very well located in Madrid !
I truly recommend Julia’s place

Had a really lovely stay at Julia’s in Madrid! A beautiful apartment in a great location, really walkable and lots of great spots nearly. Julia was really responsive, we will definitely be back next time we are in Madrid! Thanks 🤍

We absolutely loved our stay here! In a beautiful location just a short walk from loads of attractions. It was super easy to locate from the airport (just a 30 minute metro journey) and was a great airbnb that served us well! One of the more equipped airbnbs I’ve been in before (lots of kitchen appliances and spare towels, etc).
Great stay at Julia's beautiful and amazingly located flat. In one of the most lively and animated parts of Madrid yet on a quiet street.

This was our first Airbnb and I have to say we was very impressed with the whole service.
Julie's apartment is lovely, well equipped and spotlessly clean. The location is amazing under 5 minutes from the metro station and local restaurants and shops.
Happily stay again.
Julia’s place was pristine and incredibly suited to our needs , due to its proximity to everything from shops , bars and landmarks. Would highly recommend if spending a long weekend in Madrid
The apartment was clean, stylish and well set-up. The street is not the quietest but otherwise the area and access to other parts of Madrid is ideal for a short visit.

The accommodation matches the photos. The location is also convenient. The alley can be a little scary at night, but the streetlights are good and it was safer than I thought. :-) Julia is also very kind. On New Year's Day, I accidentally left my key and got locked out, but Julia was a responsible host who actively took care of it (I would also like to thank the manager who brought me the key). She was the best host for me, who is not familiar with Airbnb. The accommodation was also very cozy. !!
Julia is super nice and very helpful. The that is exactly like the picture and quite near to metro station. Totally recommend
A beautiful, well set up apartment in a good location for visiting Madrid. Just be okay with having no air con but there are ceiling fans. Responsive and friendly host! Would recommend :)

This was my first time in Madrid and Julia’s place was the best. Everything we wanted to do was 30 minutes or less away walking. We had so much fun people watching from our balcony at night. Julia responded to all of our questions and needs. Also, super random but had amazing water pressure haha. Highly recommend this place.

Very nice place, marched the description and the photos. The beds are really comfortable and clean.
Over all the host was really good and friendly, he let us stay longer in the apartment after check-in because we had the flight later in the day. Also good value for money.
The metro station Ventilla is nearby, so the apartment is in zone A of Madrid. I recommend also the 10 journey tickets Metrobus for traveling in Madrid (the tourist pass is more expensive per day, and you probably won't make so many separate trips per day).
Pedro was very helpful since the moment we got to the apartment. Don’t let the building confuse you it might look old; but the actual apartment it’s completely renovated. Very nice place. Thanks

Pedro's place was great! He was extremely responsive and kind. The accommodation was in a good location with easy access to public transport.
We definitely recommend!

Pedro’s place is very close to accessible transportation. It’s in a quiet neighborhood  and close to the 4 towers building with lots of great eating places. The A/C works great and the bedrooms worked well for our party of 5 people. Going up the stairs with all the luggages was the hardest part even if he warned us about it, we didn’t realize how narrow the steps are! Overall,  we enjoyed our stay and  Pedro is such as gracious host!

We were a group of four in town for a conference, that was close to this apartment. To go into the city center you can conveniently take public transport (around 15 min.). Pedro was very nice, helpful with everything and always available. Would definitely recommend staying here, it was a very clean and neat apartment that provided everything we needed.
Airbnb was as describe but neighbours are not happy with taking in the apartment or coming up the stairs in groups.

Good neighborhood, comfortable loft/studio on street level which is great when hauling luggage, but may be a bit noisy at night.
A great alternative for hotel, well equipped with complete kitchenette and washer/dryer. Modern and new.

The spot was the perfect location to a visit to Chamberí. There were so many great bars and restaurants nearby. the space was immaculate and even came with a cleaning kit which was nice. Don't make the mistake I made by doing a load of laundry so to time your stay will be perfect.

I was so happy with the apartment. Great location, spotless bathroom & kitchen, very comfortable bed. Just like any other comments, the apartment being on the ground floor and looking at the main road does make it a bit loud at night, but apart from this I didn’t have any issues. Would definitely recommend!

The place is centrally located within a walking distance to Gran Via, it's clean and good enough for couples spending most of their time outside. The only problem is that being located at the 4th floor which might be cumbersome at times especially if you have big luggage or returning late at night after long day of walking. apart from that, all is well.

This was one of my favorite stays in Madrid. So clean with a beautiful balcony and views of the palace. Amazing shower and spacious room. Centrally located, easily walkable to amazing restaurants and famous spots.
Host was amazing at communication. Check in was a breeze and they were able to hold my luggage for a few hours after checkout. Great spot! Highly recommend!!

Such a a great little set up. Spacious room and bathroom. had everything we needed for our stay in Madrid, did use the social area but kitted out with everything you need. Great location and beautiful views.

The surrounding was very nice and very much in the center. The view at the palace and the wide area behind was fantastic.
I wanted to give 5 stars, and I think the room deserves it. I only missed a little more warm feeling in the interior. But whole room, location and host are close to 5 stars

The place is well located and was super clean. I walked all around Madrid, transport was not needed at all! Host is very helpful and responds within seconds (specially during check-in, tks for that). The place is comfortable and has all you need.

Our stay at Paola's Airbnb was fantastic, thanks in large part to the warm hospitality of her boyfriend. He made us feel right at home, offering valuable guidance on navigating the area. A big thanks to both Paola and her boyfriend for making our stay so comfortable and enjoyable!

Nice place to stay, cozy area with a lot of grocery stores, restaurants. Near metro station and bus. host with quick response, kitchen supplies were perfect, everybody was very friendly. Pretty much recommended

This place is one of the best options in the area by far.
Paola is a great Host, very responsive and kind.
It is well located, clean, private and in a safe area.
I will definitely go back!
A very nice apartment in a great location. An excrllent base for a stay in Madrid.

The apartment has a truly excellent location, in a wealthy part of the city with many shops and restaurants. It is also very silent and beds are comfortable. We definitely enjoyed the stay. Just keep care that late checkin may require extra fee.

Montaber's cozy apartment is nestled between Madrid's famous Velazquez and Serrano streets. It's a posh quarter with plenty of restaurants, shops, and beautiful buildings. The location is irreprochable and couldn't be better.
The flat itself is also great. It has all the amenities you might need for a short, or long stay. Three of us stayed there and it never felt too too small or cluttered.
The host provided clear instructions on how to get there and wa just on time for our check in.
I would highly recommend this apartment for anyone looking for a quiet holiday in Madrid, away from the bustle of the center at night, but also just 20 minutes on foot away from just about anywhere you'd want to be. From Sol and the Plaza Mayor, to Retiro which is just 15 minutes walking away.

Very unpleasant hosts, the most terrible welcoming I ever had experience,
The apartment was nice , no blankets were provided, we froze at night and had to cover with extra clothing. When it was time for check out the host wasn’t available she said that she will text me on where to leave the key and she never texted. When I tried to call and Text on the time of check out she never responded on WhatsAp or here on the app. We lost the our train and had to get new tickets.
She responded at 13:30 after I already dropped the keys in the mailbox because we couldn’t wait any longer. When check out is on 11:00 am!
Had a great time! Apartment is in an upper-class part of the city but was located well for metro/bus movements. Mostly was quiet and the host was great! Would stay again.

Pierre Paul was an amazing host! He was very responsive and very clearly wrote out the house rules. He does not ask for anything out of the normal and the apartment has everything you need for a stay. It is in an amazing area with many restaurants, supermarkets, and train/bus stops just a short walk away.

I had an excellent stay at Pierre Paul's appartement. I was here for a conference at the CSIC campus which was very close to his place. The city center is also easy to reach with buses or by foot (about 50 minutes). The bathroom is a bit dark and the kitchen is small but it is sufficient for a short stay. The check-in and check-out was very easy. Thank you !

Had a great stay at this lovely flat! Super helpful and friendly host - easy to check in and out, helpful tips on what to do, and very responsive. The flat was clean and had everything we needed, and it's in a very handy location near station&metro. Thanks again for the great stay!

The place is actually even nice than in the pictures. It is all very tasteful with great attention to details. It doesn't feel like a cold airbnb but a cosy home you want to stay and get cosy at. The beds are comfy, showers are great, and the kitchen has all the amenities you need so you don't have to buy everything from scratch. Great place!

The apartment was very comfortable and a great size, it was big and spacious. The hosts were excellent, Melisa was super helpful and accommodating. The stove top was tricky at first but once we learned how to use it, it was easy. (We’re used to gas stoves not electric.) One thing we’d suggest, because we have nothing negative to say, is having a microwave would add to the convenience of the kitchen. We’d definitely stay here again, thank you!

This place was in a perfect location close to so many historical sites within walking distance. It is a block away from the metro and shopping mall.
The apartment had everything we needed to enjoy our stay and be comfortable. We saw all the sights during the day and had a time of rejuvenation at night at the apartment.

Melisa the co-host was great! She was always readily available for whenever I needed her. The metro station was just about 2 minutes walking distance and it made it easy to get around to the touristy areas. I would recommend her place! There was no air conditioner but they had plenty of fans that helped with the heat of Madrid in August. I would come back because of how convenient the location is!

We loved our stay at the apartment. The location was brilliant. A short walk from the Plaza and Palace as well as being in the train/metro station within minutes of leaving the front door.
A couple of local supermarkets within a really short distance, as is a lovely little pizzeria.
If you’re into running/walking you are right near the start of the best urban trail I’ve been lucky enough to run on and this one follows the river for miles.
The apartment was also genuinely lovely to be in and was perfect for a family of 4! We had a great time!

Really great stay in Madrid ! It is even a bit roomier than in the photos I would say. We were able to access amazing dinners, museums, parks, etc by 10 minutes walking. Also the metro is across the street making it easy access.
Had a lovely stay at Seo's apartment. Clean, modern, and comfortable. Situated in a great neighborhood (Principe Pio) and exactly what I was looking for. Communication was seamless. Thank you, Seo!

Everything was great.
Location is right across a metro station, very easy to get around.
Only things to keep in mind when booking:
Master bathroom has clear window to the living area.
Basement room and bathroom smell humid.

The apartment has a chill boho vibe.  It was comfortable and there were plenty of dishes. If you have mobility issues or heavy luggage, be aware the second bedroom is downstairs. The neighborhood felt safe. I liked the location. It  is close to a market, the palace , public transportation. It is also a short easy walk away from park with the Egyptian temple and stunning sunset views.

The apartment is located in the real middle of the centre, super close to Grand Via for shopping, one street parallel from the biggest party street, but still very quite and silent without any kind of disturbing notice. In the close surrounding there are plenty restaurants, bars and clubs.
Our host was very helpful especially with a free late check-out.
Fran Y Marta's  flat combines its excellent location with a behind the scenes attitude. I loved it

My stay here was amazing. The picture didn't match the unit I stayed in but it had all the amenities I was expecting. It was a quite neighborhood and was safe to walk at night. It's also 5 mins walk from the public transit, and close to a grocery store. I'm really happy that I stayed here on my work trip. Thank you for hosting me, Jacinto.

Very happy with my stay. The apartment is located in a quiet area, there is a grocery store nearby, so it was convenient to buy food there. Logistically, it is a short metro ride to the center. Me and my sister enjoyed our visit to the Zoo and Aquarium, you can walk there, it is pretty close. The apartment was clean, we appreciated the coffee left for us by the hosts and decided to get the same coffee maker machine when get home.
Thanks for hosting, It was a great place. It won’t be the last with Alfonso & Guillermo’s.

The airbnb is located in a a prime area of Madrid. The two bedrooms were also excellent sized. The only issue was the wifi which did not reach either bedroom adequately and only usable in the living room. I have communicated this to the owners who state they will work on it. Otherwise than wifi, this is a good find.
Amazing find, we would definitely stay again when we come back to Madrid. Location was fantastic and neighbourhood felt safe.  Communication was fantastic and huge thank you for hosting us x

We were happy with the location. It was literally a few steps away from Gran Via. Great sleep quality since the bedrooms were at the back of the apartment despite being near the center. Nice restaurants nearby. Place would be cozier if there were more pillows both in the living room and bedrooms.
Thank you for our early check-in too. Much appreciated.

Nice apartment with really good location. Communication with them was fine. It would be easier to have self check-in but still that part was also fine.
The apartment was clean and we could find there everything what is needed.

Great apartment in a very good location. Just off Gran Via with nearby stops for metro and the hop on hop off buses. Despite the central location it was very quiet being on the fourth floor. Inside the apartment was very clean and comfortable and the mattresses were wonderful. Really the apartment could not have been better.

Location, location, location! If you're looking for a place just off the Gran Via in Madrid, but quite calm (and silent in the bedrooms, which overlook an interior courtyard, not the street, then this is it. The place is clean , spacious and comfortable with air conditioning that can be adjusted in three zone (living room/kitchen and the two bedrooms). All interactions with the Pantala team were rapid and helpful.

The location is truly the best part about this Airbnb, is close to stores, supermarket, restaurants and public transportation.
The apartment was clean- even though the walls had a lot of marks on them.
If I may, there's a lot of coming and going in the building, which doesn't feel that secure when you have your belongings inside. But I guess it's normal in a building full of tourists in the heart of Madrid.
I would definitely recommend this apartment!

Amazing place in the heart of Madrid Center. Walking distance to Gran Via, shops, restaurants and Metro stations. Highly recommended for families/groups of 5-6. Place is very spacious, incredibly quiet and easy to access. Will definitely look for it when coming back to Madrid.
Felipe is the most responsive host I´ve ever had in AirBnB. I left the keys in and got his support all the way.

Felipe’s place was clean,  comfortable, and spacious for a small family. We had everything we needed, and Felipe went out of his way to provide us with an early check-in during our short stay. It’s located within walking distance to major attractions while being private and quiet during the evening. I would recommend it!
This apartment is in a great location, very close to the Royal Palace of Madrid. There is a long corridor in the apartment, which I have never lived in before and I like it very much.

Felipe was incredible as was the apt--  super clean , amenities, rennovated. Felipe was always immediately responsivie and helpful and a super nice guy. You can tell he takes a lot of pride in making sure everything is just right. Highly recommend, will definitely stay there again-- Thanks Felipe!

Felipe’s place was an absolute gem. The location is absolutely unbeatable - mere steps away from the royal palace and all the best shopping in Madrid! The place was perfectly spacious for our group of 5, and everything was spotless and cleanly upon our arrival. Finding a quality Airbnb that is available on a one-night basis instead of a two-night minimum is usually extremely difficult, but Felipe’s home was a perfect fit! If we are ever back in Madrid I am confident I will be staying at this Airbnb again, and would 100% recommend this stay to anyone who is considering visiting Madrid. :)

This AirBNB is well-equipped with everything you might need. It is very spacious, has been thoughtfully renovated with nice bathrooms, and happily for Spain, has an ample amount of hot water for showers. It is conveniently located to the metro and many attractions in Madrid.
The place was centrally located with great restaurants nearby, walkable to all attractions, had a grocery store just up the street. Perfect for two couples.
Awesome place to live, The aircon was really good so we stayed cool and it had all the amenities needed, so comfortable and beautiful
Great place! Aircon very welcome, and the location is top notch. Host helpful and easy to get a hold of!

We had a wonderful stay. Paula was helpful and responsive. We accidentally locked ourselves out of the flat and she had someone there in 10 minutes to get us back in. Great location and a very beautifully decorated home. We would stay there again 👍😊

Just incredible. Very specious place with all amenities. Cafe and restaurant nearby are really good. Definitely going to stay here in future.
Felt like home!
Our favorite part of the space was the location,  it had walkable access to all the areas we wanted to see yet removed from busy city streets. Would stay here again!
I loved the place, very quiet and clean and I felt like home. Great host! Thank you Paula. I'm looking forward to coming back again.
We were here for the weekend and it was all you need for a short stay. Our airbnb got cancelled and we booked this one very last minute and had no problem. Thank you!!
We had a wonderful stay. The place is in the centre and close to everything. The home was very clean and welcoming.

Lovely neighborhood and really easy and friendly communication with the booking team. The place was a little smaller than we expected and unfortunately a bit noisier than we thought as located just above a bar. Overall this was a good apartment for a one night stay :)

Needs parking directions, this is a city central location and parking is not clear.  Check-in assistant was cheerful and friendly, but his English skills were not sufficient to deal with parking.  the washing machine did not work, a repairman came, it worked for an hour, then did not work.  the "breakfast" is a joke, no location, no seating, take and go street food.  Requested a shorter stay due to the disappointing conditions, they refused.  Had to use Ab&b help to resolve the problem.  nice location, could be fine with a little attention from the operators.
Perfect location, welcoming staff, willing to help and guide anytime, tasty breakfast. Best place in Madrid💗

The place was very clean but tiny, it was safe but noisy during the night, the breakfast was perfect.
Thank you very much .

Good value, nice and communicative host. Good location, there were a couple of imperfect things like the AC motor leaking water but it’s as described. Not much space for a living room but it was perfect to sleep in when visiting the city

Had a wonderful stay in this very centrally located airbnb. The space was large enough for 3 people to be comfortable. All amenities you can think of (decent blowdryer, iron, laundry detergent etc). Gabby gave us a warm welcome.
Lovely little apartment that suits a couple. We loved the area that has a beautiful green space and cafes at the front door

Maribel and Carlos were excellent hosts. They were very communicative and easy to get in touch with, and the place was very comfortable. It’s a nice, quiet neighborhood that’s very proximate to a lot of good restaurants and things to do. Would definitely recommend!

Manuel was super friendly and helpful. He had very clear communication and was very responsive. The first few days, there was a building connection error with the Wifi and Manuel organised the company to come and fix it and communicated with me the entire process. The space was beautiful and clean, just as the photos listed. The bed, although small, was super comfy and there were a range of pillows and towels accessible. Metro and Supermarket, both less than a 15 minute walk and get into the city in around 50 minutes by the Metro. The only thing I would voice is that in the Winter it gets really cold and the there is no heating so prepare to layer up. Manuel was a pleasant host.
Wonderful stay in a great location with a super friendly and communicative host. Would definitely stay again!

Great location, very easy to walk to various tourist locations and super close to public transport. We didn't have any issues with noise either despite it being in such a popular area. The place itself was as described and comfortable. It was nice having a washer available during our stay too. Thanks for the great stay!

Amazing stay and is located perfectly in the middle of everything! There are so many things to do within 10 minutes of walking. Amazing hosts who were very responsive! Being from the South (USA), they showed amazing hospitality!

Great location of the place, really quiet despite being in the very centre of Madrid. Had some minor issues with towels and bedsheets at the beginning, but it was resolved very quickly. The owners communicated well before and during our stay.
Was just what we need for the time we were going to stay in Madrid, nice place closed to all amenities, closed to very interesting places.
Our family had a wonderful stay at Maria's beautiful apartment. We had everything we needed. María promptly responded to our questions. It was perfect for our family.

My son and I had a nice stay at this apartment near Sol. It was very easy for us to get around on public transportation and there were lots of food options nearby. It was easy to keep the space a comfortable temperature. There is a large refrigerator and a washing machine and drying rack. There was some construction going on in the building but the workers were nice and generally the noise was not a problem during sleeping hours. The apartment has everything you will need!
My family and I spent two nights in Rafael's place. The location was incredible, we had plenty of space, and Rafael was an excellent host. We hope to come back!
Perfect place to stay if you have event in Gran Via. It is just 3 to 5 minutes walk and also near to Carrifour and IKEA.

The apartment is located close to the metro station el sol, despite it is a busy aérea the apartment is quiet, it is convenient to walk around the touristic places around.  Easy check-in, the apartment was good for a group of 6.

The Apartment was nice in a very good location.
The host was always available and very friendly.
The Bathroom was not very clean and neither the bedsheets. But anyway functional and acceptable.
I felt the place was as good as it looked in the photos and we paid a lot for one night. The beds were comfortable and location was good.

Rafael was a great host. The location was perfect. I wish it was a bit more modern. I do know that he addressed the air conditioning issue without me even mentioning it to him to he is very proactive.

Great place for a short stay in Madrid, nice calm neighbourhood close to many of the best restaurants and bars as well as shopping and the retiro park. Everything is modern and functional. WiFi and smart tv work great. The host was prompt and very helpful. Very recommendable.
Great location, walkable around and very accessible.  As shown in the photos, I recommend it only for a couple or solo travelers since it’s small, just one space . Oscar was always responsive.
Great stay at this wonderful apartment. Oscar was very responsive and made sure we had everything we needed.

Cozy and well situated, surrounded by restaurants and Coffee shops, walking distance to park and major transportation hubs. Tucked  away from main the street offering peace and quiet. Unfortunately, the place needs a major facelift and a better cleaning crew. We found multiple hair strands on the bed sheets, pillows, in the shower and bathroom sink. We winded up having to buy a new sheets, pillow covers and towels before sleeping in. The floor seemed to have been cleaned but hard to tell whether its stickiness was due to quality of the cleaning product used. One cannot miss the multiple dark stains on the couch, a simple throw on would have made us overlook the couch’s shabby state. adequate supply of toilet paper or single use water bottle were not provided. Host seams to be on the stingy side.
Very smooth and easy stay. Oscar’s made sure I had everything I needed. Wonderful host, and wonderful stay!

Oscar’s place is simply amazing. Not only is it beautiful - with great decor, extremely clean and organized -, it has everything you need, from kitchen utensils to a washing machine. Also, it’s walkable distance to the park, to the metro and easy access to the city center.
I’d definitely stay there again.
We were 6. Great place we loved it. The room near the street a bit noisy but all in all is great. Easy to access by public transport, a lot of bars and restaurant in walkable distance. 5 star.

The flat is ok, the entrance door is a bit strange as it's a glass door with a curtain. During the weekend there is a lot of noise until early in the morning so if your a light sleeper I would not recommend this place.
Communication with the host was very good.

The place was roomy, large showers and bathrooms and great size bedrooms. It had everything we needed and was clean and comfortable. The location was perfect and within walking distance to Gran Via and all the shops! The metro is one block away and easy to use to get around Madrid. We had a great time.

Excellent host who responded to our requests in a timely manner with fantastic local recommendations for dining! The location of the apartment is amazing, literally on the Plaza Mayor. It was surprisingly quiet given its location.
Host was flexible and allowed us to leave our luggage at the apartment early before check in on the day we arrived from out of the country, which was much appreciated.
There is not a lot of common or shared space in the apartment other than a small area with a tv and 2 person couch — but that was not an issue for us since we were always out seeing the city when not sleeping.
I would stay here again without hesitation and the price was a good value.
Muchas Gracias!

Great location in the heart of Plaza Mayor. Easy walking access to restaurants and sites. It is a compact home yet provides space to spread out w three bedrooms and 1.5 bathrooms. Clean place which is of upmost importance. Enjoyed our stay.

This is an amazing apartment for those wanting to go to Madrid. Everything from the check-in to the checkout, everything was painless. The location of the apartment is awesome! It’s close to everything and the location was awesome! Anyone going to Madrid, I’d highly recommend this apartment to make you feel at home. Begoña was super helpful and very kind. Overall, great deal.

We loved the place. Incredible spot in Madrid. It is small (as the listing describes), but the location is worth it. You get to experience the historic part of the city. Would definitely stay there again.
Tastefully decorated , warm and cozy apartment I. The heart of Plaza Mayor. Couldn’t find a better location! Hosts were responsive as well. Highly recommend !

Great location right in the center of town. Lots to do and very walkable. Didn’t have to go too far to get a taxi or Uber.  The palace was an easy 15 minute ish walk and Grand Via was about a 15 - 20 minute walk. Also very doable.
this is in the perfect location. the unit is small as described (especially the shower) but we did not have any issues with it. very happy with our decision to stay here!
Very convenient location, right on Plaza Mayor. our booking was last minute and the host was very responsive when we arranged for check in
The place was in a great place, the host was great, and it had everything you need at an airbnb. The only downside I would say is the place was a little bit narrow but it’s spacious!
Location is awesome. The apartment is small - but it’s a historic building. Loved our stay.

The place was clean, our host was super responsive and was always available when I had a question. She was so quick to get back to me. My kids loved this place as they each got their own room. Yes the place is small but it was perfect for my family and had everything we needed. The use of space is great and we really enjoyed it. Great location but very busy!

Carmen's place is exactly as she described it.  It is centrally located to everything.  As described, the place is small but it is very comfortable.  The whole place is very clean and the bathrooms are like new. We really enjoyed staying here.  Even thought it's very busy outside, inside it is very quite.  The A/C and hot water works perfectly.  The kitchen has everything you need.  We were very comfortable and really enjoyed our time in Madrid.  Also, Cherie met us there and did a great job explaining everything.  Thank you Carmen!!

I thoroughly enjoyed my stay at Anettes  place. She was incredibly accommodating, and her property was equipped with an impressive range of amenities. Without a doubt, I wholeheartedly recommend this accommodation – a fantastic experience overall! Many thanks for your hospitality.

Perfect location. Beautiful space. And Anette was a wonderful host with lots of lovely, thoughtful touches — water, beer, coffee, a helpful list of recommendations — in the apartment. I’d stay here again.
What a great little apartment for a couple! Anette greeted us with a warm welcome.  Great location and very clean apartment. Would definitely come back and stay here again
Amazing area!! Perfect for walking and metro. Clean house and host was very sweet. My favorite Airbnb location in Spain.
Anette is the best host ever!  The place was exactly as described.  Location is great and the restaurants around it are delicious.  Thank you for everything!

Anette was very kind and allowed an early check-in and the place was just as described, clean and stocked with all the amenities one would need. It’s also very close to many great restaurants and walking distance to Plaza Mayor and Royal Palace of Madrid. I had an amazing stay, thanks Anette!

Fell in love with this small, but very comfortable apartment, felt ourselves right as at home
LaLatina is a perfect neighborhood you can reach all the Madrid landmarks by walking for 10-20 minutes
Annetes instructions and apartments photos was very helpful for restaurants selection and especially for “Lock&befree”luggage storing service
Would definitely stay there again in our next Madrid visit

This was a perfect little place to stay for a few days while exploring the city, small, but perfectly suitable for a couple. The super easy access to the metro was a huge plus and made getting around really easy. Bed was comfortable, place was clean, host was great and easy to get ahold of, would definitely stay again.
Cute little apartment next to La Latina metro station. The host was great and very responsive. The apartment was clean and looked like the pictures. Thank you!!
Anette was just lovely to work with.  The space is exactly as described and the best location to where we wanted to be.  Would stay there again.

Annette is very sweet and responsive. The apartment is small but we were out most of the time so it was fine. Really good location to the Metro so it was easy to get to everywhere. The heating was very good. I would stay again.

Very cute place! Small but well appointed. Comfortable bed. Neighborhood was very interesting.
Annette was very charming and helpful.

The location of the apartment is very central and very close to the metro as well as the bus stops. There are a lot of good food options and supermarkets nearby as well. The space is good enough for 2 who are staying for a few days in Madrid.
Anette, the host was very responsive and the instructions on the listing as well as during the stay were very clear.
Would highly recommend to anyone visiting Madrid to stay here!

Host was great, easy to communicate, and approachable. Welcomed us in person, gave us a quick tour and offered some good dining recommendations. Location was perfect and lots to do in the area. Would book again when in Madrid.

Wonderful spot for a visit to Madrid. The apartment is small as advertised but well equipped and has everything you need. The elevator made trekking up and down stairs with suitcases very easy, and the AC was welcome after walking around in the heat all day. The neighborhood is really quaint and there is so much to do within mere steps of the apartment. Annette was a fantastic host, kind and responsive and helpful. Would highly recommend.

This is an excellent place to stay.  It is very close to main touristic attractions without having to deal with herds of tourists and tourist traps. The neighborhood keeps a local atmosphere and is very nice. You will find lots of amazing food options at great prices.  Also, the host is very kind and helpful. Highly recommended!

Anette’s apartment was clean, centrally located, and comfortable. Perfect for two people, and had everything we needed for our stay! Highly recommend, and good air conditioning was appreciated after being in the heat all day!

Annette was super responsive and clear with communicating throughout the entire process. The apartment was really well located next to the metro and we were able to walk to everywhere in the city from our home base. The apartment was nice and quiet, perfect to recharge the batteries for the next days adventure. Would 100% come back and stay again.

Roy was very responsive and had great customer service.  I had to update my reservation 3 times and each time he was not only flexible but understanding. The flat was in a perfect location for our needs and though there was no A/C, the fan did the job on keeping us cool. The studio flat was not to small but it was the perfect size to accommodate us. Overall- perfecto!!!

Perfect independent flat for a stay in Madrid! The flat is very well located very close to metro and bus with a short walk to the main station,  this is extremely convient. The hosts where very quick to respond with friendly and helpful information. The flat has all the utilities needed with super cold and hot water for both summer cooling off or winter warming up. The flat does get quite hot but they have provided fans which work well.  I would happily stay again!

Roy’s place was clean and as described.
Close to train station and bus terminal so easy for transportation into city or elsewhere.
Would recommend.

Everything was great! We enjoyed our stay. The apartment was very clean and had everything for a comfortable stay! The apartment is very close to the metro which makes transportation very easy. We would definitely recommend it!

This is a lovely apartment in a great location.  It has a beautiful view of the city from the living room, and everything was in working order.  The apartment is a bit run down, and could use some renovations, but overall it was very good.  It is much smaller than depicted in the photos, it's really a studio apartment that has been partitioned by a glass screen to make it one bedroom.  It said it had cleaning products and cooking basics, but besides two Nespresso capsules I couldn't find anything else.  It has a washer and not capsules of detergent, which was really inconvenient because I had to buy a 24 capsule bag (the smallest the sold), just to do a load of laundry.  How inconvenient can it be for the host to provide a couple of capsules per stay?  Small things like that make the apartment not as attractive.  The location is great, metro right outside, and within walking distance of Plaza de Espana.
Great place and responsive host. The views are immaculate and the place was very clean upon arrival. Metro is almost next door and it is in a centric location.
The view was amazing and the apartment was beautiful. It is very close to the subway line so it was very easy to get around the city. Would definitely stay here again!

We had a great stay in Madrid and Ignacios apartment was ideal, very close to the metro and within minutes we were where we wanted to be.
Plenty of places to eat and shops all around the apartment.
Great place, great host, easy to enter, and area felt safe. Clean, and Nice and spacious overall, except for shower.. a bit too cramped for our group. Other than that no complaints.

Quiet street right close to the metro and many stores and only 20 minutes walk to and from the stadium for Real Madrid.
Space was clean, lots of room for sleeping, and Ignacio was responsive and had very clear instructions for checking in and out.
Would recommend for a nice quiet stay near the city center.

The apartment was ok, a bit smaller than imagined.
Cleanliness was ok but could be improved. It had a weird smell. It smelt like old smoke and all our clothes smelt like smoke after the weekend.
Location was great though! Close to restaurants and public transport.

The apartment is brand new and tastefully decorated. It boasts a fully equipped kitchen and offers ample storage space. It was impeccably clean and well-organized. Additionally, its location is fantastic, within easy walking distance of all major tourist attractions.

Beautiful place and great location. steps away from Gran Via.  Very quiet, comfortable beds. only thing was that the app used to unlock the doors would sometimes lose signal and would be a bit tough to open the doors quickly.
A very nice spotless apartment, well located and fairly easy to find. Once you get the hang of the app to open the doors, it’s a lovely place to stay.

Lovely apartment, exactly as described. Comfortable beds, nice and quiet area despite being in a very central and brilliant location. Would highly recommend staying here. Had a bit of a problem with the check in/getting into the apartment but it got sorted.

Apatrtment was in good condition. There was no hot water during our stay and we had to call to get the guest code. This was especially hard because we were coming in with data only eSIMs and expecting to get a guest code before arriving as promised

The unit is in a prime location near the center of Madrid.  Accessing the unit takes a few steps but was otherwise great.  It was clean and MIT provided many extra towels and sheets.  Overall a good stay

For the price you pay, this is an amazing place to stay in the North of Madrid. Very easy to walk to many locations and centrally located if you need to go further out.
The actual apartment was spotlessly clean, the bed was super comfy and the air con is easy to use and set to the perfect temperature.
Great place, well decorated, clean, with lots of details. Will repeat again. Centrally located.
Excellent host, always available for us. The apartment is in an excellent location near the Santiago Bernabéu stadium. Apartment in excellent condition and very clean. Highly recommended!

Lovely apartment, exactly as described. The flat was very clean and spacious. Lots of coffee shops and bakeries close by.
Would definitely recommend and stay again. Dobohomes were easy to communicate with and always quick at responding.
Inexpensive but well-furnished and open spot perfect for couples, in a great location within walking distance to restaurants, shops, sights, gyms, coffee shops, etc.
Great location. Great host. Looks exactly like the pictures. I really enjoyed my stay and would return in the future.

Great space. Comfortable and clean. Beautiful rooms, balconies, great bathrooms. Quiet at night. Lots of conveniences like having a washer. Location was okay, there were restaurants and grocery stores near by. Using the metro which is close by to get to tourist attractions was helpful. The only thing we didn’t like about this booking was that we had to upload all of our information like passports etc into another (sketchy) app that we weren’t familiar with. We didn’t realize that we wouldn’t be able to check in without this until it was too late.

This apartment has everything you need. The amenities are modern, and very accommodating. Great location from Gran Via, and right next to the metro. One of the best apartments I’ve stayed at. Beautiful skyline view of the city as well.
This is our second time staying here.  The view is spectacular and the accommodations pristine and modern.  Susa was in contact with us 24/7 and was very helpful. A+

This is my second time staying at Susa's apartment. It is going to be my go-to apartment whenever I come to Madrid. It's brand new, modern, has amazing views, an amazing kitchen and bathroom (all new fixtures). Everything is high-end. The building has a friendly doorman too. There is a parking garage next door. It is located in the best part of the city, walkable to pretty much anywhere (and next to several different metro stations if you prefer that). Very safe and extremely comfortable and upscale. Love this place. I wish I lived there permanently!

We had a wonderful stay at this apartment in Madrid. The unit was very clean, comfortable, and quiet. The apartment has a beautiful view of the city! The location was great as it was close to the major sites and had easy access to public transportation. The owner was very communicative and accommodating.
Thank you for a very enjoyable stay.

This apartment has become one of my go-to in Madrid, and for good reason! It’s stylish, comfortable, and perfectly located. Susa is an exceptional host who remembers every detail from my past stays, making me feel right at home each time. If you’re looking for the best place in Madrid, this is it!

Had an amazing stay at Susana's place! The apartment was spotlessly clean, beautifully decorated, and had a stunning view of the palace. The location was perfect, and the entire experience was seamless. Susana was a fantastic host—very responsive and attentive to all our needs. Highly recommend this place for anyone visiting Madrid.

We had a great stay at Maria’s. The view was amazing. We were very close to the Malasaña neighborhood while being outside the noise. The apartment was very clean and the bed was comfortable. The highlight for us was the water pressure in the shower.
I was able to work full time with no wifi issues. We would definitely stay again and would recommend the apartment.

Beatriz was a great host and always responded quickly to any issues we had. Although the neighbourhood was a little noisy at night, the neighbours were very friendly and we felt at home. Would really recommend staying here as it’s close to lots of shops and supermarkets and it’s a really nice apartment.

Jorge’s apartment is a great location and has great amenities! It was a very comfortable stay for two, and it allowed us to work from home very comfortably as well. The location is in Gran Via, close to MANY restaurants and shops and with a couple metro stops as well. Great experience!

This is the few places that it looks better in person than in the website. The modern and clean decorations, along with the recessed lighting, created a nice ambiance. The kitchen was well-equipped, and the large dining tables were convenient. The location is in perfect to explore the city with a lot of cafes and restaurants nearby. It is walking distance to all major attractions. The two bathrooms are very clean and well maintained with heated towels racks. Washer/dryers combo comes in handy for longer stays. It will be great if laundry detergent is provided for the guests.  Overall, we had a pleasant stay at this Airbnb.

We had a lovely stay at this apartment.  The location is steps away from Gran Via and walkable to shopping, restaurants, and sites.  The apartment was clean and equipped with all the amenities.  We had an issue with the lock in the door, and the property management company was responsive and sent someone out to fix the door.  We had a great stay here and would recommend others to stay here for their visit to Madrid.

Excellent location for exploring Madrid. We were 2 couples staying and having 2 bathrooms was great.
The checkin famil was very brief and not adequate info shared, but Zenhia was very responsive to our questions. Once those issues were sorted we enjoyed the apartment. Zenhia was very accommodating in allowing us an early checkin with our luggage.

The apartment is located beautifully, right in the center. Everything is in walking distance. The apartment was clean, although there are some stains on the sofa and on the wall. The communication was excellent as every question was quickly answered through our contact person via app.
Would definitely recommend.

We stayed only 1 night. Ana was quite responsive but there were problems with the online check-in. There is no 'limehouse' sign on the front door so it was a little tricky to find. The front door code did not match the apt code as we were told so we were locked out for a while. I also asked that the sofa bed would be made up as there were three of us but it was not. There was an extra duvet and pillow but finding it entailed more messages. the apartment itself is fine if a little tired maybe. Location is excellent.

Javier’s place is cozy and made us feel like home. Very good location. It’s close to the Metro Station Esperanza , grocery stores and fruit stand. Javier is very thoughtful. We rented three Airbnbs in Spain and he was the only one who left coffee, tea, salt, etc. Javier’s kitchen is well equipped which let us save some money eating out. We enjoyed our stay there. I highly recommend this place.

Best location in the heart of Madrid. Next to La Gran Via and Plaza Sol. AC is great!!! Tons of bars, restaurants, shopping, metro stations, you name it all at your doorstep. Will for sure stay again. Highly recommended.

A trip of a lifetime with lifelong friends celebrating birthdays and good times in one of the great cities of the world. This trip was made all the better by this wonderfully located, clean, comfortable and spacious Airbnb. Our hosts were fantastic and I recommend this place to anyone traveling or spending time in Madrid. 5-Stars!!

Everything was clean and fine. His mom greeted and lived with us and she was super kind and sweet. Although sometimes the language barrier was a problem she always tried her best and we had a couple of laughs together :)
Would recommend👍
It was very lovely, both Carlos and his mom were very kind. We don’t speak spanish, but we were still able to communicate. Our arrival was flexible, the apartment was very close to the metro station.

It’s a very basic apartament but it does the job to give you an affordable place to sleep. We were out all days anyway. 2 min walk to a subway station and buses.
Carlos’s mom is a sweetheart. She does not speak English but what are the translating apps for? She gave us space and privacy. She was very quiet in the mornings making sure not to wake us up.
All in all it was a good choice for us.
Really good place! Incredible location and the apartment was very stylish. Would definitely return. The hosts were also really helpful and accommodating!
Everything was perfect! The appartement was clean and very cozy. Mr. Takanivi was very helpful and responded quickly. The place is very well equipped. It was an excellent stay!
Great location and place. Communication and check in without any problem. Only issue is the mould in the bedroom and bathroom.
We've had a nice and pleasant stay! Convinient location. Takanivi is super responsive and helpful!

We stay in Airbnb all year round - by far our favorite one . Gorgeous interior design and powerful AC ! Great shower pressure . No street noise . We loved  it - about 5 min walk from various metro stops.

Cozy apartment equipped with all the necessary comforts for staying in Madrid.
The strategic position near the center and close to the metro stops make it easily accessible and convenient for getting around the city, even walking.
Susana was extremely generous and available for any request.
I would definitely come back staying in her apartment as soon as I will be in Madrid again.

Stunning apartment and excellent location. Very peaceful but also right in the centre with loads of bars and restaurants.
Absolutely spotless and has everything you’d need.
Good communication.
Would highly recommend this place.

Great location, quiet, strong wifi, smart tv. Walking distance to restaurants s and shops. Its a nice walk either south to Retiro or north to Bernabeu. A little dark but perfect for my needs since I need peace and quiet to sleep!

Fiorella was a very responsive and kind host. The apartment is very well laid out and well equipped, the location is also great. The bed comfortable. The photos represent the space and furnishings well. The listing does say that it’s a lower level “bajo” unit, we did not realize until we arrived that the windows let in basically no natural light. It is a dark apartment and that did take away from a more pleasant stay. I think this could be suitable for students, quick stays, or guests who plan to use it primarily for sleeping since it is so dark, that can be positive for some.

Cute place, Won’t go into details, but Maria went above and beyond as a host. She was very caring and sweet and made us feel right as home. She was fast to fix issues and help out with extra things if needed. 10/10 Host

We had a very pleasant stay at Maria’s place. The place is cozy, comfortable, quiet and very clean. Maria is a wonderful host and made us fell right at home. Communicating with her was easy and she allowed for us to check in a bit earlier, since the place was already available. The kitchen is fully equipped, the bed is very comfortable, and the shower is really good and warm. The washer and dryer was a great plus. It has supermarkets nearby and restaurants. There’s a metro station not far away, and there’s also a bus station with a bus that takes you to the city center. It’s was a good neighborhood to walk our dog. We didn’t have a car but we noticed that there were many parking spots in the street. We highly recommend!

Maria was a life saver when we were let down by another booking. She waited for us at 11 pm on Friday night to arrive at her place and was very welcoming and kind. The studio was very clean, nicely decorated and cosy as per description and was enough for our need of somewhere to sleep for 2 nights in Madrid.
We greatly enjoyed our stay! Maria was so responsive and the flat was well equipped for our stay!

Great host !
She responds very quickly, and she is very polite and friendly !
Instructions were clear and easy.
The place was clean and cozy, we had everything we needed !

This apartment was exactly as you see in the photos, and was spotlessly clean and fresh. Great location near to all amenities and within a 15 minutes walk to city centre.
Marta is an excellent host and is very responsive to all our inquiries. Would strongly recommend apartment to other visitors to Madrid.

Excellent apartment to stay at, very easy to get to, only five minutes from the metro. We were able to check in with keyless entry without any issues. I will definitely pick this apartment to stay at the next time and will highly recommend it to other others.
Perfect place for our family of four. Great restaurants recommended by Marta. Close to metro in a fun area of madrid. Super clean and well cared for apartment. A wonderful place to stay.
In the heart of the La Latina but in the quiet street which makes apartment very cozy and lovely for the families. Very clean and equipped with all you need for the long stay.
Beautiful spacious apartment, well equipped with everything you need for a longer stay. Location is perfect, close to the metro and city center. We had a great stay.
We had a fantastic stay great apartment lively neighbourhood lots to do first time in Madrid and will definitely visit again.
Really nice apartment in a very good location. Lots of bars, restaurants and coffee shops in close proximity. Also the metro is about a 2 min walk away which is ideal.

A very comfortable home within walking distance to Plaza Mayor and to metro services with plenty of nice restaurants and bars in the vicinity.
Marta and Enrique were very responsive and the check in and check out instructions were easy to follow.
An ideal place to stay for a city break in Madrid.

The hosts were wonderful, very welcoming and kind. They gave great advice on what to do and see during our week of holiday in Madrid.
Thank you for a lovely stay! We would like to return.
it was a lovely stay in Madrid, Vincente and his wife are very accommodating and welcoming  and the place was too clean and calm, they provide us with everything we need...
Very beautiful and spacious apartment in a lively neighbourhood of Madrid. We immediately felt at home. Excellent welcoming by the hosts.

From the street to the entrance to the apartment…wow! So beautiful and spacious with everything we needed and more, a true home away from home. We were met on arrival and shown all the essentials then left to explore Madrid. The apartment is in a fantastic location, quiet but with bars, eateries and shops so close by. Such a comfortable bed, excellent shower and enough coffee pods to get us through six nights! Our favourite apartment on our trip, could have easily just moved in permanently.

Everyone we interacted with whether by phone or at checkin was very helpful.  When we arrived, he immediately told us that the refrigerator was not working and he would be working to get someone in.  Sadly he was not able to do that. Nonetheless he kept us informed and  he reimbursed us for the purchase of ice.  Because of his response to the issue, we still gave him a 5-star rating. We would stay again.

Beautiful apartment, lovely area, everything you need is around the corner. Walking distance to major sites and also to very local not turistic area of lavapies.
Highly recommended!

The apartment was well located and walkable to the many local attractions, restaurants and shops. The apartment was comfortable and well laid out, and also had lots of natural light. The host was super responsive and easy to communicate with. Highly recommend
The apartment was beautiful and spacious. Within walking distance of lots of attractions and restaurants. Would highly recommend!

The flat was super clean. Comfy bed. Great location and very close to main attractions. The apartment has all the amenities you need. One thing I would say is the hot water may be a hit and miss(evening and morning). The apartment is divided into 3 other airbnbs which may be the reason why. Other than that we had such a lovely stay  :)

The apartment is modern clean, clutter free and welcoming. The bed is comfortable and the kitchen is functional and well supplied with utensils, pots and pans and a variety of coffee making options. Location is excellent, most of central Madrid is an easy walk (including the Prado, Royal Palace and Plaza Espana). The street the apartment is on is semi pedestrianised, meaning while your taxi can drop you at the door, there is no traffic noise. Generally the street is quiet. Communication was proactive and clear. Very much enjoyed our stay.

We loved our stay in this apartment for our three days in Madrid. Alan was super helpful and met us as we pulled in. He helped us figure out the best way to get there from the airport (Madrid taxis are awesome and easy).
Apartment was just what we wanted and needed. Peaceful and relaxing. A great place to come back to after walking around the city all day.
The area near Lava Pies was perfect for us. Older part of town and full of life but still chill.
Would stay here again on our next trip back to Madrid. So mid to enjoy
We loved our stay here! The apartment was beautiful, location was great and the hosts were extremely responsive. 10/10 would recommend
Wonderful place to stay with everything you need. Very cozy and felt right at home. Great AC, comfy bed, charming old building. Excellent hosts and would gladly stay again!
Beautiful, spotless apartment that stayed cool in the hot Madrid summer. The hosts were very helpful and quick to reply. Highly recommend!

We loved it! the room for 4 people was very comfy, had a fridge, washing machine, microwave, plates, stove and a table to eat. Located close to mini grocery stores si you get your food cooked. Very clean and secure.
Check in and out was super simple. Location was great and the owner had reached out personally and offered late check out. Overall really recommend this place. Place was super modern and clean
The space was everything and more that we wanted for our stay in Madrid. Would definitely rent again!
Blanca and Jose were quick to respond and to resolve a technological problem with the locking system. Their Airbnb is ideal for six adult guests, immaculate and centrally located.

The place is perfect for a family or a group of friends. If you have a baby, make sure to specify you want a crib and pay that extra fee or otherwise you won’t get the mattress, but they were nice enough about it

Montaber was very responsive and overall a helpful host. The place was bright and clean. We did have some trouble checking in due to miscommunication on check-in hourse, but Montaber was quick to respond.

We had a great time at Anaisable's place.  The apartment has been thoughtfully renovated - comfortable beds, great showers and very functional kitchen with all the necessary appliances.  Ana went out of her way to order a new, thinner blanket for us as we would rather sleep without air conditioning, and it arrived within the same day.  The location is easily accessible as it is adjacent to a metro stop, and within a 5-min walk there are a lot of shops.  A good supermarket is right downstairs within the same building.  All in all I would highly recommend this place for your next visit in Madrid.

The apartment is comfortable, clean and well equipped. Anaisabel was friendly and helpful, and very responsive to our questions. The location is safe, central - brilliant, with easy access to the metro, directly above a great little supermarket, and a nice walk (or run!) to Retiro park. And the pool - it is a real treasure, especially in the height of the Madrid summer! Muchas gracias!
This was the best I've stayed in.  A beautiful apartment. Convenient for everything. Madrid is special, as were our hosts. Thank you so much. We shall return. x

This was a wonderful stay. We were there for 10 days with the purpose of moving her daughter to Madrid for a year.  the grocery store and Metro stop right outside the apartment was fantastic and Isabella was able to accommodate  our very early arrival. She gave us a great list of restaurant recommendations and we tried a couple and they were very good. The neighborhood was very walkable. She also gave us a list of recommendations for finding things to get our daughter set up in her apartment.  Would highly recommend this apartment!

We had a truly top-notch stay at Ana's charming apartment! It's clear she's thought of everything, as the place is fully stocked with all the essentials (and then some!). Ana herself was a fantastic host, always quick to respond and offer great advice.
We were so impressed by how clean everything was, especially the well-equipped kitchen.
The location is incredibly convenient; you can literally step out and grab a taxi, or hop on the metro which is just moments away.
The AC was a huge bonus during Madrid's heatwave, making our evenings so comfortable.
With a grocery store next door and countless bars and restaurants within a short stroll, it's the perfect base. We felt wonderfully at ease throughout our entire visit.

We really enjoyed out stay in Madrid. This apartment is so central - didn't really need to use the metro which is so close - we walked everywhere - supermarket, shops just around the corner - very lively area with lots of pubs & restaurants close by - the apartment was very clean & big enough for 2 people - exactly as shown in the pictures . The shower is great & there was loads of hot water every day. The bed could do with some blankets but we did find some light throws in the living room. There is no lift & we had to drag our luggage up 2 flights of winding staircase but my husband was able to manage it! I would stay here again if I return to Madrid .

This is a lovely flat - small, but perfectly formed. It is decorated and furnished with style and good taste. It is very well equipped.
It is in Las Letras - in my opinion the nicest barrio of Madrid - historic and full of great bars, cafes and restaurants. Easy walk from most of central Madrid. The flat is in one of the quietest streets, so you get the best of both worlds - lively and interesting local life, but a peaceful refuge in the flat.
This is a great place in a great neighborhood, but the going to a separate locker location to get the keys on the way in was cumbersome and caused confusion on our part.
We absolutely love this LA apartment. It’s brand new and super clean. On Gran Via, but there was no noise at all! Window blinds for good sleep. Beautiful view! We can recommend it.

We enjoyed our time in Madrid and loved our stay at Monaro Apartments. It was perfect for what we had planned. Its location is great because it’s near restaurants, stores, within walking distance of the train station, and close to everything you’ll need for your trip. I stayed with my parents, who are 65, and it was also good for them. The apartment was comfortable for the three of us. The only thing I would change is the check-in time (even though you can check in earlier for an additional fee) because many people take overnight flights and arrive early in the morning. But other than that, we loved it. Thank you so much!
Nice and clean place and check in was easy.  The apt had a weird smell tho in the bathroom other than that it was fine.

I had a fantastic experience at this apartment in Madrid. The place was exactly as described, clean, comfortable, and well equipped with everything I needed for my stay. The location was perfect, with easy access to public transport, shops, and great local restaurants. Check-in and check-out were smooth, and communication with the host was quick and friendly. I would definitely recommend this apartment to anyone visiting Madrid and would be happy to stay here again!

Amazing accommodation in a great location, loads of restaurants in walking distance. Tiny apartment but was big enough for 2 people, I wouldn't recommend for more. We used the sofa bed and it was really comfortable. Would stay again

Smaller than expected but a great place right in the middle of the city
Will book again

We had a great time in Madrid staying at Diego’s apartment. It was very clean, bright and cozy with new furniture, we felt very comfortable. The area is nice and close to lots of restaurants. I would definitely recommend it!!

We loved everything about this place, it was perfect for our stay in Madrid. Great location, very clean and great hosts.
Highly recommended, we look forward to returning.
Everything was just perfect! Location is great, walkable, lots of great restaurants around. Helpful and responsive hosts. Hoping to be back!
