Everything was absolutely perfect! Natalia was an amazing host and helped every step of the way. We had a wonderful time with the exception of getting a flu 🤒
Thanks so much Diego and Natalia for opening up your beautiful home to us!

We thank the responsive and helpful team of the host for our comfortable stay. The apartment is very clean and the location is great.
We highly recommend it.
Very nice apartment on a very quiet but well located neighborhood, Natalia is very helpful and responsive at all times , we had a great time with no problems at all , definitely will be back.

Amazing apartment. Location is great - 1 min to the nearest metro. It was very clean, spacious and perfect for 4 people. There are everything you need in the kitchen as well. Right across the street is a nice sushi restaurant and grocery store.

Apt as described, in a great location. Host even let us check in early. Would have been nice to have some basic kitchen necessities - hand soap, hand towel, dish soap, paper towels, nespresso pods for coffeemaker.  Also, host met us upon arrival and we had to sign additional contract along with passport verification upon arrival. Have not experienced that before in an Air BNB. Overall, good stay, but annoyed at having to buy the above kitchen necessities for a short stay.
They were very accommodating and had a beautiful and clean place. I loved staying here and enjoying the views from the balcony. I would definitely recommend this place for others.
Really enjoyed the place. Great location, not cheap but reasonable pricing, beautiful decor. Beds were comfortable and linens were clean. Spacious and tastefully modern.

Very spacious apartment with central location. Very clean, the beds were comfortable and everything worked. Only feedback would be it would be nice to have some cleaning spray and washing up liquid. Also some tea and coffee as none was available and we had to buy some for our 3 day stay. Also the sink in the bathroom off the kitchen/dining area did not drain properly. Other than these minor details, we really enjoyed our stay and would highly recommend.

Fantastic spacious apartment in popular and walkable area of Madrid.  Very busy areas right outside but the bedrooms were quiet.   kitchen and bathrooms were fully equipped.  host was accommodating and flexible with our schedule.  great for families (even with small children)
Mayra and her family were absolutely wonderful, they made us feel at home, their house is spotless clean and we enjoy it thoroughly.
Mayra and her family were absolutely incredible hosts. We felt right at home and were so happy to stay with them. I would highly recommend staying with them if you’re in Madrid

We had a fantastic stay with Mayra and her wonderful family! They were incredibly welcoming, and the room was exactly as described. Very comfortable in a peaceful corner of Madrid. We look forward to coming back!

The apartment is in an excellent location - you immediately exit onto one of the busiest streets in Madrid. At the same time, the apartment itself is very quiet.
The downside is that it is an attic with a very low ceiling. You can stand up to your full height only in the very center of the room. You have to be very careful because there is a high chance of hitting your head on a wooden beam. The drain in the shower stall is faulty - when using the sink, the water begins to rise with a very unpleasant odor. I hope this problem can be resolved.

Right in the center of Gran Via, very worth it. The apartment was clean and well maintained.
I recommend it
We can really recommend this property. Comfortable, modern and clean. Great location, close to metro and supermarkets. Eugenio is the perfect host. Always responded very quickly.

Loved my stay here - very accessible location!...adorable spot for coffee & a bite just outside the entrance!
Would recommend.
Thank you!

Well equipped apartment with new furniture TV and kitchen machines situated in an very quiet central area.
Maria is a very responsive host, ready to answer questions and giving valuable advices in no time.
I strongly recommend this apartment for short or long term accommodations in Madrid.

The place was clean and cozy. Close to the center, near bus and metro stations.
Lots of supermarkets and playground near )

Amazing stay in downtown Madrid! The apartment was perfect access to the train and all that the Plaza Mayor had to offer! Host was very responsive and helpful at all times. Noises area so we were glad that the building kept out most of it. It was a super great little sanctuary highly recommend.
Such a cute apartment, with just tough space. Perfect location, great communication, and easy check-in and check-out. Thanks for having us!

Exceptional location as  apartment is basically across the street from Plaza Mayor.  Hosts are extremely communicative, both before and during your visit.  Everything was easy.  Apartment itself is fantastic for a family of 2-3 people I'd say, but can do 4 with bunkbeds.  I'd stay here again in a heartbeat.

The apartment was spotless and located in a great area. Everything was walking distance. The host was kind and so helpful. She let us check in earlier so we did not have to lug around our bags. We are thankful for her flexibility. The apartment looks exactly like the pics and it is even cuter in person. The beds are comfy and the lines were impeccably clean and they were hotel quality. We really felt at home in this flat. Highly recommend.
Great location we were able to walk to a lot of fun restaurants and shops. Everything else was a short Cab ride away. Really enjoyed our stay.
Lovely apartment as described.  Restaurants nearby and train station.  Walkable to attractions and the main area but away from hustle and bustle.  We enjoyed our stay and would recommend .
A comfortable little apartment in an excellent location! The apartment had everything we needed for our stay. Definitely recommend to anyone travelling to Madrid! 😊

This apartment is outstanding. The location is perfect . I could not think of a better place to stay in Madrid. It is in center of everything yet very quiet . The museums are all a short walk away. Attiq is also very pleasant and an excellent host.
Bill from Colorado

Julien was very communicative in terms of check in time as we arrived at 6AM to Madrid and were able to check in slightly early. Place was clean and perfectly located for a quick stop in Madrid. Would recommend and stay in the future.

A perfect place to stay in the heart of Madrid! Very walkable to all attractions and shops. Everything you need and/or want in Madrid is within a 15 minute walk! Construction right out the windows was a tad noisy, but overall for being in the heart of a city the noise was very minimal! Would definitely recommend, please keep in mind you have to go up lots of stairs.
Great neighborhood to stay in, right by the Anton Martin market and other great shops and places to eat. Not far from the metro for easy access to the city!

Julian made sure that we felt like home. He responded fast to my messsages and reccomended some local places. Everything was to my satisfaction. The flat is beautifully designed. I felt as if I were a local. From the flat all the major museums are within a 10 minute walking distance. Definitely recommend. When I come back to visit Madrid, definitely would like to stay here again.
The apartment was in a great location.   The space was nice.   The owner was helpful and responsive.   The amenities (sheets, pillows, towels) could have been better.

Beautiful home in a wonderful location. Check in was easy and our host was so accommodating he even let us check in early! Communication was amazing and our host did an amazing job to make sure we arrived safely. Keys are stored in a lockbox at a separate location, but this was only a 5 minute walk from the air bnb and we only had to leave the keys on the table for checkout. Would 100% stay here again!

Great space, very, very easy to walk to the main sites and great for local restaurants, bars, tapas!! We really appreciated the location!
Room was great, bed firm, building and area quiet! Even though it was close to everything. The room air conditioning was an added bonus!!!
We really enjoyed our time at Attiq’s place!!
Really enjoyed our stay. Apartment was in a great location, clean, and spacious for 2 people. Attiq was a great host.
We really enjoyed our stay! The apartment is located on the ground floor of a very quiet area. It was modern and extremely clean. Host was friendly and flexible.
Clean,cozy well furnished place. Bed was super comfy and the modern shower I liked a lot as well. absolutely to recommend!

Nice apartment with supermarket and many restaurants nearby.
Easily accessible by UBER.
Good internet connection.
I would love to come back.

We stayed for 3 nights. The place is a great studio, nice and clean bathroom, comfortable bed and a fully functional kitchen.
We chose the location since our niece who studies in Madrid stays close by.
- The place was very clean and furnished tastefully.
- The bathroom was clean and liked the fully enclosed shower area
- The metro station is close by and you can hail a cab easily on the main road
Overall a great place to stay.

Marcos and Beatriz were wonderful hosts! Beatriz was in communication right from the beginning and on hand for any questions or queries. She had recommendations for coffee shops and breakfast nearby which was great! Check- in was seamless and they even tried to facilitate a slightly earlier check in which I very much appreciated. The apartment was spotlessly clean and very well appointed. It had everything I needed for my short stay. The location suited me and my place of work. It is incredibly convenient to travel to the Airport and there is easy access to the wonderful public transport of Madrid. One thing to note- although it might be clear from photos- the studio apartment does not have windows, and therefore not a lot of natural day light. It is at street level and the only light is through the opaque front door.

Hosts are kind people who are making sure you feel comfortable and have everything you need.
Preety good location and neighborhood.
Place was clean and everything in it is new.

Location location location. It’s a small apartment with a tiny kitchen, but the bedroom and bathroom are a nice size. The kitchen makes cooking meals a bit challenging, especially for more than 1 person. Otherwise, the space has everything you need as a base!
Great place & communication from host. Price is inline with the value you get. The only drawback is the check in time. I think 5pm is not reasonnable. Everything else would not disappoint you. Cheers
All you can ask for and more. The amenities like coffee and tea were details that won me over. Very peaceful and the best neighborhood
The place was clean and overall in good condition. It was smaller than what the pictures showed. The hot water in the shower runs out.

I was so happy with the place. Everything was good. The place was beautiful and clean. Communication, check in and check out were super easy. Very close to metro station. When I go back to Madrid, I will probably stay there again.

I had a great stay and was very happy with my trip. It was in the heart of Madrid near supermarkets and Madrid life. The apartment was very modern and clean and smelt good. The size was perfect and would definitely recommend it to friends. Finding information in Numa was very effective and easy to get in touch.
Very responsive host. They provided all the instructions i needed to check in without having to ask. Nice neighbourhood, very close to the Metro. Great value for the price in my opinion
Tricky extra step for check-in but it was totally worth it. Access was simple and straightforward. Classic Madrid neighborhood feel.
Very friendly welcome of the host. A little internet access problem was solved within few seconds. I really enjoyed my stay.

Perfect location! Lots to do around, supermarkets, small stores, metro, bus - all great. We only stayed for one night and were mostly out and about, so the location was what stood out the most. Nieves was very accommodating, helpful and quick to respond. Even though there isn't a working kitchen, there is a microwave, a fridge, dishes and a few other appliances so that was great. Beds were comfortable and everything was clean. Overall, happy with this stay! Thank you, Nieves!

We really enjoyed our stay at this centrally-located apartment! Great location with easy walking to museums, etc. it was great having two separate bedrooms, each with their own private bath. And the king-size mattress in the larger bedroom was super comfortable! A little bit dusty, but overall in good condition.

Highly recommend this place! It was clean and super nice facilities! Easy to get around, and AP Madrid's communication was great! Super clear and easy to follow instructions. Will be looking at staying here again when back in Madrid!

It eas an amazing experience in the center of Madrid. It takes 5 minutes by walking to go to Prado museum. 10 minutes to lot of places. In the same street there is a metro station Anton Martin, which it takes 3 stations to go Gran Via. Amazing. Place was great, very clean. Little bit loud because of the other apartments but in general it was fantastic. Location was best of the best.

The location was chosen because it was in the Barrio de letras which contained literary history. Its closeness to achoa station was convenient as well as the Sofia Reina museum. We got to see the location of Cervantes house, Picasso’s guernica and a concert at the Alphonse 13 botanical gardens.  This was crammed into 27 hours.

We traveled with our two teenage daughters and this place was perfect for us. Metro is close by as well as nice restaurants and small stores.
It’s located in a quiet neighborhood and Juan Jose was responsive. In fact, we had an early arrival and he was very helpful and checked us in earlier.
Everything went great. Highly recommend it for tourists visiting Madrid.

Apparently a brand new and modern apartment, equipped with everything you need. Centrally located in the city, a short distance from the beautiful Retiro Park. Within walking distance of a number of Madrid's attractions. Quiet place (mid-town). Shops, bakeries, bars, and eateries in the surrounding area

The modern apartment was close to the metro which made travel easy. There was a great choice of shopping, bars and restaurants within easy walking distance . Juan and the other hosts were very responsive and helpful and also made some great restaurant recommendations. I would definitely stay in this apartment if I returned to Madrid. Excellent experience

The apartment is in a stunning location in central Madrid with the Retiro Park and the Prado within walking distance. The Metro was very close by. It was very stylish and well designed. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay there.

We enjoyed our st y in Juan José s place, the location is perfect, easy and safe to walk around in the park night.
The apartment is nice, super well equipped, and very clean.

We loved our stay at the apartment. We were in Madrid during a crazy summer heat wave. The apartment stayed cool and comfortable the whole time due to the radiant floor cooling system, which we loved.
The location is beautiful. It is in a more upscale neighborhood with wonderful places to eat, walk, and shop and very close to Subway. The apartment beds were so comfortable. I had the best sleep there! We absolutely loved the design and flow of the space. Very modern and very comfortable! Loved coming back to the apartment after sightseeing. We hope to return again.
Pablo was very helpful. The place looked exactly the way it was described. Amazing location. Would recommend.

Very good place and easy to arrive at. Inside the house I didn't have to buy anything, it has a very well-equipped kitchen and bathroom with everything I needed. the bed and shower are extremely good, very comfortable, and clean. it has a good security system and it is close to local places to eat, coffee shops, supermarkets, a pharmacy, and the metro station. this place offers air conditioning and very good internet. Highly recommended.

I was completely unsatisfied with this Airbnb. Firstly, it opens directly on to the street, which was not mentioned on the site. Also, the fact that the key was digital is completely inefficient as many times I had to try for 20 minutes for the key to work. The area of the Airbnb is unsafe at night, and quite scary to walk. The actual Airbnb was fine and equipped, but I would not recommend this Airbnb as the location was not optimal at all.

David’s place was great. It’s very central to everything. Perfect for the 3 of us. It’s cosy. The only thing is that it’s the 6th floor. It doesn’t get easier, but on the plus size I got all my daily steps in lol 😂

It was a really nice place to stay, very cosy with a lot of details what made it feel like home. It has everything that you would need for a short or long stay.
The owner is very nice and clear.
I recommend it!

The house was at a great location and we thoroughly enjoyed the amenities it offered. The only downside for someone with mobility issues is that the house is at the sixth floor with no elevator and the ceiling is very low as the flat is at the roof and someone needs to be careful when walking inside. The location was great we didn’t need to take any public transport we could walk everywhere!

Maria is an amazing host! I enjoyed the time I spent
She’s very sweet and makes you feel right at home
The place was beautiful, perfect for 1-2 persons. I would definitely recommend this accommodation, city centre is a 10 minutes walk and from there on everything is nearby.

We had a lovely stay , the place was very clean and did meet my all my needs, the neighborhood is very cool. Helena was very nice and answers all our doubts.
We will return to this place, very soon
Thank you Enrique your place in very nice.

A couple of issues on arrival that could have been avoided if the apartment had been checked thoroughly but resolved the next day. A good central apartment and true to the description and photos.
Blackout curtains don't function due to being on the same curtain pole instead of using two.
In the description states easy access to the first floor from the entrance. 16 steps are not easy access especially guests with reduced mobility or like me with heavy suitcases. Please correct your description.
Apartment recommendable for a stay in Madrid.

The apartment was clean and had everything that we needed. Most importantly, it was well located in the city with easy access to everything. Would def recommend this apartment for 2 people who want to take advantage of all that Madrid has to offer.

We enjoyed our stay in Enrique’s chueca apartment. We had everything we need and the location is perfect for seeing the tourist areas while living around locals.
We greatly appreciated the ability to check in early so that we were able to go directly from the airport to the apartment. Also, our host arranged for a taxi to take us to the airport at the end of our stay.

The apartment was exactly as described. The location is excellent and close to shops and restaurants. The host was very responsive to anything that we needed. My favorite things were the location, great AC, and comfortable bed.

I had a wonderful stay at Yessica’s place! The apartment was exactly as described—spotlessly clean, well-equipped, and thoughtfully decorated. The location was perfect for exploring the city and everything we needed was easily accessible.
I’d highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a central location. I hope to return soon!
The place is very clean and beautiful, perfect location. The truth is that we really enjoyed our stay and the truth is that if we return to Madrid we would like to come back here again.

Great stay. Really close to a metro station to get around Madrid very easily. Walkable towards places like Gran Via/Checua/Malasaña too.
Room big enough for two with plenty of storage space. Bathroom is great too.
Great place, close to everything. Eduardo has been very nice and has helped through the process. 100% recommendable

Yessica has a wonderful flat, well furnished and very clean. The way she communicated proactively and was really caring about our stay made our trip very pleasant. It's rare to find hosts as caring as Yessica is with her guests! Everything in a flat is well thought and made so that you only think about enjoying your time inside and in the city. Thank you so much!

If you have a light sleep, you might get annoyed by the noise from the outside. It was not a big problem for us, except for one day when it was very loud. Apart from that, I loved the place and the location. A place I would book again in the future.

It's a super apartment in a great, lively location in the heart of Madrid, in Malasaña! Everything is close and easy to reach, even on foot.
The apartment is exactly what it looks like, well-equipped and cozy. And don't be afraid of the possible noise (if there is any), because the windows are really soundproof. Claudia and Sofia are super-responsive, and the communication is super-easy with them. Absolutely recommended!

We had a lovely stay! The apartment is located in a beautiful and very central area, which made it easy to explore the city. Everything we needed was nearby. The place was comfortable and just as described. Overall, highly recommended!
I enjoyed my stay so much that I extended for another 6 days! The place remained just as comfortable, clean, and convenient. The host was responsive and accommodating throughout. Highly recommended!
Great Location, the shower of the bathroom is very small the rest of the apartment is great and the location is prime!
Great location and very clean apartment. The street can be quite noisy, especially on weekends. Bring earplugs and you will sleep fine.

We enjoyed our stay! Place is amazing and location is great. As we arrived earlier to Sevilla, owners made it possible for us to check in before the time - communication with them was super clear and we got all responses quickly. Recommendation is 10/10 for everything!
We had a really nice stay - the place was super clean and modern and there is plenty to do around (in a walkable distance too). Does get a bit loud from local restaurants though but nothing too bad.
A lovely stay at Gestion’s apartment! The place is so chic & beautifully decorated, and walking distance to everything you need. Would happily come again

This was the second time staying at Gestion’s place and it was just as wonderful as the first time. The home was clean and comfortable. The location is walkable to many restaurants and tourist locations. Communication is 10/10 with Gestion and he was very helpful planning this visit. This home has become a favorite for me and will always be my number one choice when visiting my favorite city!
Marcos was great and super responsive! The place was exactly as described. Photos were accurate and everything was clean. Good location in Madrid and very walkable overall

The location is fantastic. Right across from a carrefour express. Close walking distance from sites, restaurants, and bars. The apartment was so cozy and comfortable. Check in and check out were easy. Highly recommend staying here when you are in Madrid!

Parje’s smart apartment is the perfect place for a girls weekend in Madrid. Very clean and spacious. The smart apartment amenities like being able to lock the door from your cellphone is very convenient. Clara the co-host is also very responsive and kind. 10/10 recommend!
The communication with the owner, the apartment and also its location were absolutely great. I would definitely recommend staying there :)

Our experience at the flat was wonderful, the house has excellent conditions and a cozy decoration. It has the necessary utensils if you need to cook something, a practical washer/dryer, and two separate bathrooms. Its location is fantastic, a few meters from the Prosperidad metro station, bus stops, supermarkets, restaurants, cafes, in short, everything you could need just a few steps away. The host of the apartment was always available when we needed her, very friendly and helpful. If you are planning a trip to Madrid, this is definitely an excellent option for your accommodation.
Great apartment well located near Prosperidad metro. Quick and easy to get anywhere in Madrid. Clara was very pleasant to work with.

The apartment is great! It's in a really good neighborhood, really close to a metro stop, and around the corner from a Lidl grocery store. It's about 30 minutes from the city-center by metro and fifteen minutes by car to the airport (thirty minutes by metro).

Ok place to stay for a night or two. When I arrived, walls throughout apartment are marked up, front doorknob broken inside, glass on kitchen backsplash cracked, hair on bed and shower floors, shower didn’t drain. I only came for a soccer game and left, probably wouldn’t have wanted to stay longer. I did appreciate the accommodations for the luggage hold and responsive host. That was very helpful.

Thank you, Parje and Clara, for being such thoughtful hosts. We truly appreciated the warm welcome and comfortable stay—it was a lovely beginning to our time in Spain. We’d happily stay again and definitely recommend your home to other travelers.
Lovely stay behind Grand Via but very quiet. The apartment was really clean and easy to access. You can easily walk to the Palace and loads of restaurants.
Good location with a spacious kitchen Ns nice studio. The host communicated well in the check in and check out . It was a pleasant experience staying there.
This was a great stay! The apartment was clean and had everything we needed for a 2-night stay. The location was great- walking distance to many spots and close to the metro. Glad we found this spot!
The Airbnb was perfect. Everything was in walking distance. It was clean and included all the necessary amenities. Highly recommend!

Great accommodation near Santiago Bernabeu. Easy and clear instructions for room access were provided the day before arrival. The room and shared areas were very clean.
The host was friendly and readily available via text message.
Restaurants, amenities, and public transport to the city centre are all within walking distance.
The neighbours were respectful, though the room's sound insulation could be improved. However, this was not a major issue for a short stay, and I would definitely come back again.
Great place ! Easy check in and very communicative staff. The rooms are great and has everything you would need.

We had a wonderful stay! The listing is within walking distance of many local restaurants and shops. It's not a very touristy part of town, which made it perfect for us. If you want the tourist attractions, it is within a couple minutes walk of a metro station.
Unit was clean and comfy. Beds were perfectly soft.
Thanks so much for a great stay and perfect place from which to explore Madrid!
Eliana and Diego’s apartment is super clean, has a great inventory and is in a super perfect location! Very comfortable stay with a fantastic view of the Supreme Court of Spain!

The apartment was overall very good and clean. Everything we needed was available, and nothing was missing. There were a few minor inconveniences, but Elina handled them promptly and professionally – much appreciated! The location was excellent, and since I was traveling with two children, the area felt safe and family-friendly. I can warmly recommend this place!

We had a fantastic long weekend at Eliana’s place. The location is amazing, next to Chueca and Salamanca in an apartment with amazing views. Fully stocked kitchen and a nice big bathroom. Eliana was incredible, very responsive and helpful. The check-in was easy although we got in very late. Highly recommended. Thank you Eliana for an amazing stay!

Amazing location with fantastic views. Centric and lots to do in the area. The property was clean and easy to access, as well as secured. The host was super responsive and provided additional fans during the heat wave. I was extremely happy with the place and I highly recommend it.

Ricardo's apartment is in a great location. We enjoyed our stay there. Everything needed to get us started was there, such as coffee pods, bathroom soap, even a washer and clothes line. Ricardo was very accommodating and helpful in every way.

Loveddd this apartment. Definitely will rebook in the future next time I’m in Madrid. The place was super spacious and clean, had pamphlets of things to do in Madrid, the building was superrrrr peaceful and my favorite part was how flexible the check in time was and how quick he would respond. The bedrooms had AC which is a plus especially in the summer. The area surrounding was so lovely and easy to get around, our days were always filled with something new. They ever provided complementary wine !!! Super sweet hosts. 10/10 always

Ricardo’s place is in a beautiful part of Madrid, really close to Retiro park and beautiful shopping streets and restaurants.
Apartment was dated and didn’t have a microwave or toaster which was difficult with small children. But was a good price and was functional for what we needed in Madrid! Thanks Ricardo.
Ibiza is my favorate barrio in Madrid.  The apartment has all we needed.  Ricardo is extremely helpful.

My stay was great. The location is really good if you go to Madrid for a short stay. Retiro park is very close. There are lots of restaurants and shops near by. In terms of public transport is very good as well.

Great location and hospitality!
Note the flat doesn’t have windows looking on a street only in internal narrow courtyards.
place was ok but a bit cramped. Looks better in pictures. Overall value is good for the location

The apartment is very well located, walking distance to museums, interesting places, restaurants and shopping. It is well fitted with all a tourist would need. Ricardo communicates very easy and fast and he is flexible as much as possible regarding checking in and out.

I highly recommend Rodrigo's place is by far one of the best Airbnb I have stayed at also I would like to point out that his staff is extremely helpful and the communication was super easy with a prompt response!
My experience was beautiful! I had such a fantastic time and felt right at home. I recommend staying at this apartment if ever visiting Madrid. The host and staff were kind and friendly.

Just as advertised and has everything you need for a few days in the city. Great location for walking to famous landmarks or to hop on the metro. Host was communicative and answered questions. Would happily stay here again!
Great location, near the tube and walkable distance to SOL. Decoration wonderful as well, 10/10.
An apartment in the city center, but very quiet at night with no unnecessary noise. Restaurants, the metro, and markets are within walking distance. Highly recommended!

It's a beautiful space in a great location. Mind you, it's not a private apartment; it's built for hosting guests. Thus, it feels like a hotel room, and its tiny kitchenette that neatly hides behind closet doors only emphasises that feeling.
That being said, it's immaculately made, very cosy, stylish, squeaky clean, and ideally located on a quiet street, almost hidden in the middle of a busy district, 5 minutes away from the King's palace and an abundance of restaurants.
The host is helpful, professional and responsive. I would definitely book again.
The apartment is exactly like presented on photos: bright, comfortable and with nice view! Loved staying here, long for coming back!
Beautiful modern and comfortable condo in the heart of Madrid with gorgeous views from the 16th floor windows. Comfortably sleeps four! We would come back anytime to this beautiful apartment.
An exceptional apartment! Exactly as described. Beautiful views and very well served by public transportation. The host Susa was a delight to work with.

Susa’s apartment was top notch, from the space to the amenities to the view! It was less than 20 min walk to the Gran Via area, beautiful park nearby for our toddler, and lots of restaurant options nearby. Susa was quick with her response and thoughtful, she had a carton of milk for our toddler ready in the fridge. The linen, bedding and towels were plush and so soft.. so much so that we are looking into purchasing the towels for our home. It’s the little things. Thank you for being such a great host. We would definitely stay here again.
Perfect location, and great views of the city! Comfortable apartment - would definitely stay there again :)

We had a great stay in Susana's apartment: it was all perfect : centrally located, very nice and clean, fabulous view, good communication with Susana. We will certainly come back when we are in Madrid!

We had a great stay in Susana's apartment. The apartment indeed deserves a 5 star rating. We have stayed in many Airbnb apartments in our travels and this apartment of Susana I would say is one of the best so far. In my opinion, there is nothing to complain about. The location was great, the apartment was very clean, the bed was very comfortable, 24-hour security, very nice view from the apartment, very spacious, few steps walk to the nearest Metro station, a big department store with supermarket few minutes walk away, a really convenient location. Definitely will be our first choice when we look for a place to stay the next time we are in Madrid.
Thoroughly enjoyed our stay. Susana was very responsive and even set up a taxi to pick us up from the airport. Highly recommend!
Apartment was nice and in a good location. It is close to metro station. Only thing I didn't like was the bed. It was small and firm. Definitely not for 2 people.

It was a very nice stay at their place, the photos were exactly how you will find at the apartment.
There are 2 big supermarkets nearby and 3 minutes walk to Estrecho Station.
Will definitely stay again!
Gabriel’s place was beautiful, clean, and in an excellent central location. He was very responsive, even accommodating a last-minute early check-in. I highly recommend booking for a stay.

This place was perfect especially for an extended stay! It was close to grocery stores, restaurants, the metro, and lots of sights! Very walkable and lots of things to do close by. The place itself is super spacious and clean and everything mentioned was provided. Gabriel was always very responsive too!
Marta's place is in the heart of Madrid. We could not have asked for better accommodations or location. I would absolutely consider staying here again!

Great location. Central to everything.
Size of the place is huge.
Great stay.

What a wonderful stay I had in this lovely abode! Its very nicely decorated and having all that space for the three of us was just such a treat as compared to hotel rooms. You can literally feel the hustle and bustle of the streets while in the comfort of your apartment. Excellent location. I did wish there was a bath in the spacious bathroom though. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay! Thank you Marta!

Beautiful and comfortable apartment in a great location. Slightly noisy but we slept well. Bedding was great, really helpful suggestions by the property manager and overall a great experience staying there.

Great accommodation  for our family of 3. We loved this central location right opposite to the Mercado De San Miguel and the Mayor Plaza. Very convenient to hang out,  get good food or see a show around town. There is a Starbucks adjacent to the building and they open at 8am! Home has all essential amenities including a washer-dryer. We would definitely be back here next November.
Apartment is clean and modern, nicely decorated, great bathroom. The location is as central as you can be, which also means the street can be a bit loud at night. Overall a great stay. Thanks!

We had a great trip! The apartment was in a great location, right across from Mercado San Miguel (amazing food hall, highly recommend) and walking distance to Plaza De Sol and many other attractions.  Full bath with washer/dryer so we could pack the minimum and just refresh. We’d definitely stay again!
This Airbnb was perfect for us! It is very very central, next to Plaza Mayor and we loved the San Miguel Mercado. Very chic apartment!

The apartment is absolutely beautiful and located in the most perfect location in Madrid! The famous market was across the street and there were many walkable activities around the area. Marta was a wonderful host and gave clear instructions on how to access the apartment. I would definitely stay here again!

This apartment in Madrid was extremely spacious, stylish, and playfully designed, making for a unique and comfortable stay. Its location was excellent, with plenty of attractions and great restaurants within walking distance. While the hosting team initially felt a bit impersonal (automated messages, etc), they were responsive and took care of any needs quickly. I’d be happy to stay here again!

This may have been the best place I’ve stayed!  I loved the colors and decor - very unique. It’s close to Plaza Mayor and Gran Via, along with a lot of other things. The streets around it are a little noisy, but it’s still worth the stay!  Communication was  great, and check-in was super easy. There are lots of detailed instructions about the apartment, along with lots of recommendations on where to eat. Check-out was easy too. Five out of five stars!!

This apartment is an absolutely perfect place to stay in Madrid. The apartment has everything you could need and is beautifully decorated. The location is perfect for exploring Madrid. Starbucks and Market across the street. Highly recommend eating dinner at the market.

We loved staying at Marta and Arturo’s place. The instruction were very clear and made the process smoother. They were very friendly and even provided us with local recommendations. Definitely recommend!

I stayed with Duke Host in Madrid and had a great experience. The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The location was very convenient, making it easy to explore the city. Communication with the host was smooth and friendly, which made everything even better. I really enjoyed my stay and would definitely recommend Duke Host to anyone visiting Madrid.

We had a wonderful one-month stay in the apartment. The location was fantastic, the apartment was very clean, and the high-speed Wifi plus office upstairs with a computer monitor was so nice to have. We also really loved having a large shower with good water pressure. Despite the small size, the apartment felt bright and the space was well-utilized in terms of layout and storage.
Isabel is super nice! She picked me up downstairs and help me carry my things, I appreciate her help a lot. The room was clean and looked like in pics. I had a very great time staying there

The owner and housekeepers responded promptly and enthusiastically. I was very happy to stay in this room. The room was clean, quiet and comfortable, perfectly in line with the description, and even bigger than it looked in the photo.Will def live again. 100% recommend!

We had the most wonderful stay at Isabel and Sole’s apartment in Madrid. Their hospitality is truly extraordinary – from the moment we arrived, we felt incredibly welcomed. After a long day of travel, being greeted with warm smiles, fresh coffee, cold water, and an impressive selection of chocolates was just what we needed. It’s those thoughtful touches that make all the difference.
The apartment is spotless, beautifully maintained, and every little detail has been carefully thought through. You can tell a lot of love and care goes into hosting here. It’s also in a perfect location – super convenient for getting to both the city centre and the airport, which made everything so easy.
And we can’t forget to mention their adorable dog – such a sweet presence that added even more charm to our stay!
Thank you, ladies, for such a special experience. We would absolutely love to return and stay again. Highly, highly recommended!

Isabel and Sole are wonderful hosts who made me feel right at home. While the AC unit made it difficult to open the window and let in natural light, they kindly let me use additional amenities not listed, including a bright terrace with outdoor seating. Overall, a great experience. The apartment is well located, with grocery stores, the metro, and buses all within a five-minute walk. The room is comfortable and well-kept, and the shared spaces are thoughtfully organized and tidy.

Fernando was an exceptional host! His communication was prompt, and his local tips were great. The place was immaculate, stylishly decorated, and well-equipped. Perfect location—peaceful yet close to local attractions. Highly recommend and will definitely return. Thanks, Fernando!

I had an excellent stay! Fernando was friendly and responsive, the space was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The location was convenient and close to everything I needed. I’d happily stay here again and highly recommend it!

We had a fantastic stay at Fernando’s loft. The space is beautifully designed and comfortable. Everything was spotless and thoughtfully arranged, making it easy to feel right at home 😊 Fernando is an excellent host-warm, responsive and attentive to every detail. The location was also ideal, with great local spots just a short walk away. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a charming and hassle-free stay!😊

Great modern place outside the downtown. Has good transportation - bus, metro, renfe, 2 stations from the airport.
Loft is modern, ideal for a couple, theoretically + kid on the couch.
Host Fernando is easy to reach via phone, very helpful in case of issues.
Important: when you google the address, there are two locations - the correct one, close to transport, and the wrong one, 2km away. Don’t make my mistake… :)
We had a great stay at this beautifully decorated, cozy Airbnb in a lovely neighborhood. We felt at home. Thanks to Fernando for his kindness and help. Highly recommended!

We had a nice stay at Emilio’s airbnb. The check in process was great and the website with the codes worked great to open the doors. This Airbnb also has an elevator which was a welcome reprieve from all the stairs we’ve done on our Euro trip 😅. The host Emilio was responsive during hours listed. We also had a few issues with the AC in the Airbnb not cooling well overnight and the fuse tripping a few times which caused us to lose electricity in the apartment. Easy fix but just annoying. Hopefully the hosts are able to fix this issue. Overall a nice stay!

At the heart of Salamanca neighborhood, it is a recently renovated flat with everything we needed as a family. Amazing decoration, very spacious. Hopefully we will come back and will definitely recommend to family and friends!

Great location in Salamanca,  everything is close by great restaurants, grocery stores, etc.  Apartment was in perfect condition, modern and very clean.  Would definitely stay again.  Host met me on time to let me in the apt, easy check in.

Our stay at this Airbnb was amazing! The location was ideal, close to major shops and restaurants yet still peaceful and quiet for a relaxing stay. The check-in process was slightly confusing due to the auto-translated instructions, but once we figured it out, we were pleasantly surprised by how easy the digital process was. The attention to detail and thoughtful touches throughout the unit made it feel like a high-end hotel experience rather than a typical Airbnb. The well-appointed clean space and beautiful decor added to the overall ambiance. The only issue we faced was a slow-draining sink in the master bathroom, but all other amenities, including water pressure, were excellent. While there was no view from the apartment, the trade-off was a quiet and private atmosphere. Communication with the host seemed automated, which made it difficult to retrieve a forgotten item after check-out. However, this didn't overshadow the fact this was one of the best Airbnb stays we've experienced.

Great value for your money, well designed, safe neighborhood with different shopping options, coffee places, grocery stores and local restaurants. Easy Uber pick up location footsteps of the apt or you can choose to take a nice walk to el Retiro park . The place is located on the 5th Floor no views but lots of windows and natural light that comes in. Beds are comfortable I will only suggest to get softer pillows. The inside of the apt has modern and comfortable furniture which created a great vibe to hang out and rest.

Everything deserve 5 stars 🌟 and more 🥰
Pablo is a great host and the appartement is very good 😊 and very good location.
Good price and good place, I will back ahah for sure to visit Madrid.
Hala Madrid😍

This is nice flat and really comfortable
Nice area and everything you need there’s in the apartment
I really recommend that place
Definitely I will back for more
Thanks

Pablo was a great host consistently making sure our stay was a good as possible! The room was as expected and Pablo accommodated our check in time! The location was peaceful and close to transit! Pablo was proactive in making sure our needs were met!

Very accurate description. Well appointed apartment with great parking. However it was quite noisy from 6am. It is located away from the city centre but it is easy to get a train or bus with just a short walk.
The air con system is not brilliant, keeps a constant 24-25:degrees which was too warm for us, and there is no way to make it cooler. But, great value and very responsive host, so would recommend. Certainly a better option than having to drive in a very busy city!

All as described, as this was our second time at this place (same building different flat). The flat was clean, however we found some ants in the living room. Last year the underfloor cooling system worked perfectly, but in this flat we struggled with the hot weather. It doesn’t seem that the cooling system was working properly (as last year we found the same outdoor temperature and was nice inside). Having a secure parking place is amazing and there’s plenty of places where you can get some food (supermarket is just 50m way and mercado de s leopoldo is a must go).
Everything was great! Luis was very responsive and helpful with any questions. The location is also great- right in the middle of a lot or restaurants and stores.
We had a delayed with our flights and Luis was comprehensive and let us come in later , the place was just like the pictures it was very clean. The location is great and there’s lots to do.

Lovely apartment in a great location in Madrid- there were loads of shops and restaurants very close by. The space was very clean and beautifully decorated and fit 6 of us comfortably. Would highly recommend!

A fun, and eclectic place to stay. The only drawback was that both bathrooms were upstairs. The apartment was clean and had everything you needed for a good stay. Luis was responsive and was a good host making sure we had accurate descriptions of what to do once we got there. I would recommend staying there just knowing that the apartment layout is a little funky.
very good location, bonus with two bathrooms and a washing machine. Luis was very responsive and all in all a great place to stay.
Great apartment, excellent host. If I was back in Madrid, I’d be happy to stay at this place every day of the week and twice on Sunday.

Pablo’s place was cozy, clean,quiet and there are many stores nearby to get necessities. Pablo was also very helpful and communicative asking if everything was to our liking. Everything happened as agreed upon, and we will definitely be coming back.
Fast and stable internet connection.
Highly recommend.

The place is located in a good area, the place was comfortable, but it had a very large fault, the air conditioning never served me, I contacted Pablo and he told me to follow the instructions, but he never cooled the apartment, at a temperature of 90 c it was very uncomfortable to sleep.

Very clean and nice place. The host very helpful since the beginning. We stayed for 5 days and enjoyed the place. Even if in the north of the city , 7 min walk to the metro.
Graçias Pablo
all good other than rug was dirty and air conditioner system was inefficient as it did not cool the apartment to desired temperature.

The place is what it says, so no issues there. However the place is bit cramped for 4 adults. If you are a couple with very young kids, it’s a great place. The place had everything you needed and the location is great with free parking (although the place js just too tight to park). Had a good stay with all required things.
always responsive and helpful. couldn't have asked for a better host. definitely recommend. Great location as well, plenty of places to eat and things to do. the Host also provided a great guide!

I used this apartment to extend our stay in Madrid due to a medical emergency, and the apartment was at walking distance from the hospital.
It was clean, convenient, and it includes everything as explained in the post.

Pedro’s place was perfect for our group of 3. Bed and pull out bed were extremely comfortable, plus blackout shades gave a great nights sleep. Well appointed kitchen. The apartment was in a quiet area conveniently located next to markets, taverns, and parks. Easy metro access to get to the city center, but we often walked since the weather was great. We also really appreciated and relied heavily on Pedro’s recommendations based on our excellent experiences with them. The list was diverse and sent us to many different neighborhoods. Pedro’s place felt like home. I would definitely book again. Thank you for sharing your space!

A great apartment, an easy walk to the centre. The balcony was a plus. Very clean apartment, responsive host. Well stocked kitchen with plenty of cooking equipment and cutlery etc. A great base for a couple of nights exploring the city.

Great location, 20 min walking to the city center, and surrounded by lots of bus and train stops. The area is quiet, nice and lots of places to eat :)
The place is small but cozy and enough for 2 persons. It was a bit cold on the bedroom and kitchen because the heating was only in the living room. But the rest is more than perfect.

We were greeted in the apartment by the very friendly host who checked us in and gave us some recommendations for things to do and see in the area. She was also in contact during our stay to check if we had everything we needed and were happy with the apartment.
The apartment was very centrally located - many stores, restaurants and bars in the area, and it is just around the corner from the Reina Sofia. Despite all of the nearby amenities, the apartment was in a very quiet area. When we were in Madrid the temperature was around 35C (~95F) so the air conditioning was most welcome! Although there is only A/C in the living room it did help to keep the apartment overall quite cool.
Would highly recommend it as a base to explore the city and would happy stay here again!
I stayed at Doris's place for 2 nights while attending a concert at the stadium. The place is neat and has everything you need. It's also close to public transport and shops .

The place is very good for the  cost. The location is great  It is also very quiet  there is a store within two minutes walk which is very convenient  The place is a bit tight. A bit dark as there’s no windows but the main door is transparent, so it brings in decent light. The toilet has a little bit of issue as the flush continued  to run water but it works. The host was very gracious to let me check out at 1 PM.  Overall great experience.

Rodrigo needs to highlight the huge amount of closet space - something I was concerned about since we were there during the rainy season: 3 big closets; 2 with drawers all with wooden hangers and shelf space!!
I lived in Madrid so I know this location is prime for public transportation; walkability; shopping; dining but not noisy. Panderia right across the street was a delightful +. Unit spotlessly clean and all inquires answered quickly and thoughtfully.
Rodrigo even let us store our luggage on the property when we had 1/2 day to tour before we needed to leave for the airport!
There is a reason many reviewers have said they will return to this location and now I am one of them. Probably one of the very best Airbnbs I have ever stayed at in Europe.

Great place to stay, good for 3 people. Very pretty apartment, clean with great amenities and very well located (a block away from Gran Vía). The bed and furniture was great, closet space was a plus. We ran out of soap and toilet paper, but still did not make our experience less pleasant.

Very clean and practical flat, with everything needed for a comfortable stay. The location is unbeatable, near all commodities. Self check-in is very easy ans Rodrigo was always responsive. Warmly recommended!
We had an amazing time there.Beautiful and modern we loved! The owners were very friendly and made sure we were comfortable.thank you !

We stayed in the apartment for 3 nights, and would highly recommend it! Very clean, nice calm neighborhood and walkable distance to the central streets, the host is very responsive and friendly, and the description of this accommodation fully corresponds to the one published here. It is very easy to check in with all the instructions provided, and once again thank you for being perfect hosts! ❤️
An amazing place for our family of 4 people to stay during our visit to Madrid. The location is ideal, very easy to major attractions. The host was very responsive.

This place was perfect for what we were looking for: a peaceful place to rest after sightseeing all day, great location to walk to main attractions, and basics to cook some meals.
There’s a train station 4 mins away walking and from there many of Madrid’s main attractions are less than 30 mins (either walking or by train).

I stayed here with my husband, our two kids (9 and 11 y/o) and we were very comfortable.

We arrived late in the evening, it was raining heavily and there was a storm. We were in contact all the time with Fran and Isabelle, who provided us with quick access to the apartment. Everything was clean and nice. Thanks for the helpful guide!

Clean appt.
Lots of space for my family of 5
Nice art
Has the right kitchen stuff but not cluttered.
Would definitely stay there again
Very nice place, clean, well located. I truly recommend. The host is very nice and organized.

We could stay very comfortably and safely. The apartment is clean and new, there are many equipments that make our stay better! It’s located near the metro, so access to the center of city or anywhere we wanted to go Thank you :)
The stay was very nice and the host was very accommodating. Located conveniently near the metro . The limited amount of hot water was our only issue, but it was 5 girls so…..

The apt was exactly as pictured - clean and comfortable.   We had some trouble with the AC but the host was responsive and helped us resolve the problem.  He checked in several times to make sure all was going well.  The showers have great water pressure and hot water.
The location is perfect. Very short walk to the metro and bus stop. The apartment is very modern, spotless and very comfortable.
Awesome apartment. Perfect location. Simple check in. Host was really kind to let us check out late as my girlfriend was really sick. Muchas gracias 🙏

My partner and I came for a weekend getaway in Madrid and Edgar’s place what exactly what we needed! Enough space for the two of us, great location and all the amenities we needed. Definitely worth it! We’ll be back!

Very nice place to stay at with a lot to do in the area and central to a lot of surrounding places to see! Check in was a little rough due to language barrier and miss communication of time. We were told we could check in at 10 am, but didn’t check in until 12:30. Host was under the impression we were leaving luggage and then coming back to check in at 12, but we were under the impression we could check in at 10 am. A lady was the one who let us into the place after cleaning, not host. She did not speak english so it was a little hard to communicate regarding the issue but everything was figured out in the end! Still a great place to stay and would recommend!

Great location, the host was very responsive and the place is bigger than it looks in the photos.
On the ground floor there are two clubs so I’d recommend bringing hear plugs especially during weekends.

Great stay, I needed somewhere to unpack my bags and arrange some things from some time on the road and it was perfect, felt like home! Check in was smooth, he was already at the apartment and helped me with my bags, also came on checkout to help! 5 stars.
Great place and host. Well worth having extra space for kids. Several supermarkets nearby. Windows eliminated all street noise.
Jason is a great and responsive host, thanks so much for having us. Everything clearly matched the pictures and very comfortable apartment to be in after a long day of walking.

This is my favorite accommodation during my trip to Spain. It is located 1 minute walk from the subway station, and the accommodation is very clean and beautiful. The host is also very friendly. I recommend this accommodation to you.

We had initially booked a different apartment but due to an issue there was a last minute change of location. Jeison kept us updated and the new location was very close to bars and restaurants, and the metro; the apartment was in good condition and clean. Someone met us when we arrived and leaving instructions were clear and easy.

We had a wonderful stay at Jason’s unit. The unit is bright, modern, clean and one of the best we’ve ever been in.  Despite overlooking a major street, the apartment is quiet, thanks to the double patio doors. The windows had room darkening shades which blocked off the light for a good nights sleep. However, we could have used more blankets. The kitchen was well stocked: coffee maker, coffee pods, kettle and toaster. With groceries nearby, we made our breakfast every day before heading out for the day.  We also made use of the convenience of having a washer and dryer. The unit is extremely well located - walkable to the major highlights and nearby grocery store and restaurants, in addition it was within walking distance to the train.  The unit has everything to make your stay perfect.  The unit has a large dining room and living room to accommodate 3 people - we were not cramped.  We would definitely recommend his place.

Great Airbnb with 2 rooms accommodating 3 guests. Very centrally located and walkable to most places in Madrid for a tourist.
However, we had to wait outside our airbnb for the host for about 30 mins in order to check-in. Slow responsiveness for check-in and check-out just spoils the overall experience. Also, the heating works great but that’s not a reason to not provide proper blankets and only give thin sheets. If these couple of things are sorted out then this could most definitely be a great choice
Stayed here for three days to enjoy the city of Madrid, perfect location, very clean, added bonus with noise blocking shutters for the windows for when we did not want to stay up as late as the city!

We had a perfect stay at Chloe’s apartment!
The location was ideal for our short stay, close to Gran Via and many restaurants nearby.
Would definitely recommend
Thank you
Modern and clean apartment conveniently located with short walk to Prosperidad metro station.  Comfortable beds and plenty of hot water and air conditioning--must have in the summer in Madrid.
Good promise running this place. Comfortable mattresses and everything is in good order. Had no problem at all. Thank you!!

Really good place,fairly new but everything was almost perfect.
Thank you Doris for being a nice host.

A good base for a few days in Madrid. Good internet, was able to be on video calls for hours with no issue. Noise was a bit of an issue at night. Both from outside on the street and through the walls to other units. Check-in time was not listed accurately (told it was at 3pm and not noon on the day of arrival).
Angel was a fantastic host. His place is beautiful and an easy walk to restaurants, shops and sites. I would absolutely stay here again.

This is truly the dream home for tourists. It looks even better than the pictures! It’s located at a very convenient location near the Royal Palace of Madrid, walking instance to almost everything - tons of restaurants, shops, tourist spots nearby. 5 minutes walk to the metro. Even better its actually in a very quiet street away from the noises. The apartment feels luxury, very stylish and clean. There is washer and elevator in the building. I wish I could stay here longer. Would definitely recommend it in a heartbeat. It’s probably one of the best Airbnbs I’ve ever stayed.
We stayed one week at Angels place. We enjoyed it a lot. Everything was perfect and we liked the neighborhood. Everything can be reached by walking. We definitely can recommend it.
Upstairs smelled of sewage. Host didn’t offer refund. A few guests bought hotels and some slept on the couch.

Mike’s property was exactly as described.
Easy to find. A little bit of walking from the Metro station, but gives you the opportunity to familiarise yourself with the area.
Very prompt to respond without delays. Area calm and peacefully, and not far from convenient facilities to shop and eat.
For young people the perfect place and my grandchildren loved it. A bit too many stairs for me as my bones are not longer as they used to be, but all the same, I enjoyed our stay at Mike’s place. I’m sure you’ll love it as well.
Mike it’s a great Host!!!! Wish him all the best on his business, and certainly consider to book again if I ever come back to Madrid.

We had a good stay. It was close to bus stops and good communication. The home is a bit more outdated than the photos and feels more like a dorm room than a home. But it has what is needed. Not all bathrooms had hand soap and only one roll of toilet paper was provided per bathroom which seemed minimal considering it hosts large groups.
Ana’s AirBnb was amazing for visiting Madrid for the first time. The place had everything you need and the location was perfect. Would absolutely stay here again.
Very good location, very kind and professional hosts. Despite being on a fairly busy road, the inside remains very quiet.

I am so happy that I was able to call this apartment my home for 3 months. Although small, it was perfect for my sister and I! It is in a great location with lots of restaurants, cafes, and a grocery store right around the corner. There is no proper AC so just keep that in mind if you are visiting during summer months, however, there are fans and a large window that can be opened. The hosts were lovely and greeted us at the door. They were very responsive from when I booked this place to the day I left. I highly recommend and I hope to come back and live here again one day :)

Apartment 2G was excellent, and we enjoyed our stay very much. Walking distance to literally hundreds of restaurants, cafes, bars, and clubs in Sol, Chueca, Gran Via, and Callao. A short ride on metro or bus to Salamanca, Retiro Park, and the Botanic Garden. The apartment was roomy and comfortable for two, and half the price of staying in any hotel on Gran Via. We will be back.
Can’t beat the location, for a short visit it’s a good place to stay. I would recommend it for two people. You get what you pay.

The airbnb is VERY well located, near everything. Nice neighborhood, with good coffeehouses, bars and restaurants.
The apartment was exactly like the photos, a little small, but very functional and comfortable.
Elisabet is kind and friendly. I recommend this place.

Central location in a very vibrant area. Surrounded by bars and restaurants and walking distance from most tourist attractions. Ramon was very helpful with check in process, and the apartment was spotless. Thank you.
Condo in the middle of everything, but in a friendly-looking alley. Very well kept, sparkling clean. Lots of things to do/see few hundred meters from you. Highly recommended
Centrally located and practical apartment close to the metro, with a responsive and communicative host.

Jluis was a great a great host, very communicative and attentive with my needs. Place was great, enjoyed hanging out in the living room after work. Was my first time in Madrid and it really left a good impression. Thank you again Jluis!
Jluis was extremely helpful and responsive with all my questions and concerns. We cannot be more thankful for making our stay simple and easy. Best night I’ve had in weeks!
Great location, clean place. Easy to get with several subways stations near by and the Royal Theater next door. Just a minor hiccup with the access code that the host addressed in reasonable time.

Very good location that is walkable to the main attractions with lots of restaurants nearby! It is peaceful and quiet though not a lot of lighting gets into the room during the day and at night the curtains are thin but we didn’t mind that much. Ramon was very responsive and kind to let us drop our luggage before check-in time!
Would recommend adding a curtain to the kitchen window as the other homes can see inside so you can't be doing laundry or cooking without clothes on. Location was great. Would stay again.

Excellent location and beautiful apartment.
Not recommended with children as the neighbor is sensitive to noise.
Felt like a brand new apartment and very close to the airport, transport and the conference I was attending.  Supermarkets located right across the street!

Meets the description, very clean and nice location.
We just had an issue with the power cut for maintenance, which made the home entry and wifi at times difficult. I believe that’s specific to maintenance in the building.
The air conditioning was also not heating up very well, but it could be due to the very cold week in Madrid.
Everything else was great and we had a pleasant stay.
Thanks!

This place is really beautiful and clean. The neighborhood is very safe and comfortable. There is also a lot of supermarket and restaurant in front of the building. 10 mins walking to Santiago Bernabeu Stadium. Highly recommended.
It was a pleasant place.  it has fulfilled  all our expectations. We definitely recommend it.
The shower was cold sometimes. Check in was not flexibel. But was very good. We enjoy and recomend.

The host Ricardo is friendly and made me feel very comfortable from the start. The place is easy to find and well located. It's also as you see it in pictures. Ricardo was proactive with his communication and flexible with check in.  He also helped me out when I needed to leave a few things in Madrid for a few days. Recommended.

This is a lovely apartment is a great area of Madrid. It is very close to metro lines with several grocery stores nearby. There is a wonderful local resturant next door that does great breakfasts as well as wine in the evening. Marta is great with commincation and always willing to help.

Loved Marta’s spot! It had great lighting, privacy, great locations, food & shopping nearby. Marta was extremely helpful after we landed, I’m so overly appreciative of her & her place!! Felt like a homey place to be!! Thank you again for sharing your space with us!!!

Great stay, we would definitely stay again. The apartment is super close to the Chamartin train station where you can get a train to anywhere. The noise from the unit next door traveled extremely easy, but that was minor. Also, the sofa bed was ok.  It was spotless and super clean with all the things you could need. Gracias!

The apartment is much more appealing in real life than in the photos: the pictures give off a cold impression, but in reality, there is a cozy, warm light, and the heating is excellent. The bed appeared to be very comfortable to me. People outside in the street start making noise around eight in the morning, so if you like to sleep in, earplugs are a must. Yamila was extremely kind and approved a late check-out since there were no further incoming guests. Huge thanks for the hospitality!

Thank you for allowing us to stay in your beautiful apartment.
The apartment was perfect for our needs and was close to station and metro.
There was a little miss - communication on my part, as although we were 2 persons, we were not a couple. We contacted the host on arrival, requesting linen etc for the pull out sofa. The host responded quickly, and by the time we had eaten at a local restaurant next door, the problem was rectified.
We would recommend this accommodation, as a place to stay in Madrid.
Vanessa was a great host! house wad fantastic and it is a nice area would definitelly stay again :):)
Unbeatable location, walkable pretty much everywhere. The studio is simple, yet clean and airy, A/C, washing machine - it was perfect for the 5 days spent in Madrid. I definitely recommend it.
Highly recommend! Juan’s place is in a great location, close to restaurants, sightseeing, etc. The apartment was exactly as described and has everything you need. I would definitely stay here again!
Juan’s home was located in perfect distance to everything we wanted to catch in the city. He’s was very kind, flexible, and accommodating to our needs which helped a lot in the experience!

The apartment was in a nice condition, clean and had everything inside. Very good location, we could get everywhere by walk. Juan was very responsive and friendly. We also had issue with the hairdryer and it was resolved very quickly with Juan providing us a new one. Very pleasant stay, recommend it 100%.

Could not have asked for a better location. Juan was super responsive and had good recommendations for the area. Easy walk to multiple metros and parks. Once we figured the locking system we were good.

First of all big thanks to the hosts, they could not have been a more friendly and helpful to us!!!
We found the apartment to be great, appeared to be recently renovated, and everything was as clean as can be.
The location was perfect - residential neighborhood, with plenty of grocery stores, local bars and restaurants within a few minutes walking.
There are also 2 subway/metro stations within 5-10 min walking that will take you to the center of Madrid, if you want to visit museums or other sites. There were a few bus stops even closer as well, but we did not use buses during our stay.
I would definitely stay here again, and would recommend this to anyone looking for a nice place to stay in Madrid!!!

It’s a nice place overall. The room was fine, and the kitchen and bathroom were okay, it really just depends on who else is staying there at the same time. The best part is definitely how close it is to the metro 👌
I would go again if available on my next trip 🙏

This place was comfortable and large enough for our group of three. It was also clean and the host was very kind and let us check in early. The only downside is that it is relatively far from the metro stop.

Perfect location. Close to everything but also very quiet.
Rafael was a great host and helped us out with a few issues during our stay.
Definitely recommend staying here!
A very comfortable stay. I'd absolutely stay here again! Rafael is attentive, accommodating, communicates fast and really well. Absolutely no complaints. Thank you!

Rafael was very responsive about our arrival and departure and gave recommendations on transportation to/from airport to Airbnb location as well as restaurant/bar recs. His place was perfect for our quick trip where it was close to the metro and easy to navigate!

We had a great stay in this Air Bnb. The apartment was beautiful, clean, and exactly as described. The location was perfect for exploring the city as it is 10 minutes away from the center. The host was incredibly friendly and welcoming, and made everything super easy. Would definitely recommend and stay again!
We enjoyed being able walk everywhere or catch the Metro.The bed was very comfortable and it was very quiet at night..
Loved every bit of it. It was clean and proper. The check in was super smooth as well.

Love love love the apartment. It is in the PERFECT location. Ground floor which is a plus. Just a hiccup finding the place. Their door is next to 31, it’s the door just up from the door that says 31.
They were very helpful and checked us in. The apartment is Close to lots of cafes and restaurants. We love Tiki Taco!! I would absolutely come back in the future.

Really beautiful apartment, in a easy to get around location.
Any questions we had were very quickly answered!

Our employees were very happy with the stay! Thank you for everything!
See you next time:)
We really enjoyed our stay at this apartment. Everything was good, hosts were very friendly and helpful. If we return to Madrid again we will definitely stay here the second time too. Thank you)

It doesn’t get more central than this. The place is just like in the pictures. Very comfortable. They have also graciously allowed us a late check out as our flight was in the early evening. It is a busy area but it was quiet at night.

Loved our stay with Ana! Ana and Jorge are incredibly responsive and the place was in pristine condition. Clean, quiet, everything you would need for your stay. Very close to the attractions and would come back again!

Very nice hosts, clean apartement in a very good located/busy area. Therefore it can be a bit noisy at night due to the apartement beeing on the ground floor next to the street. Otherwise we had a very nice time there.
The place was exactly like the photos and was very nice to stay in. It was also located in the centre of Madrid so we were able to walk everywhere, very friendly hosts too :)

Nice apartment, everything is great except the noises in late night.
Jorge is a good caring host, after meeting in person to handover the keys, you are presented a welcome cake! A little coffee machine with plenty capsules for your stay. Very lovely little apartment, very clean and well arty decorated, well equipped kitchen and bathroom, all 100 percent.
The only issue is the noise in late night, this apartment is on ground floor and by the front gate of a small building complex with 40+ apartments, there is a metal gate door so you hear every banging when people come in and out. It’s also by a small street but lots people and cars passing by. Especially every night at just over 2am, a rubbish truck came to tip the rubbish bins outside, I felt I was smashed by the bins and ran over by the truck, we stayed 4 nights so felt a little used to these noises in the last day or two.
Great place to stay at, very peaceful and close to city center, a lot of things to do around and great hosts!

Ana is the nicest host I have had in along time the apartment was great
Walking distance to centro, conveniently located close to metro station .
The place was okay, although the photos that are listed make the apartment seem twice as big as it is in reality.

Great location. Very spacious. Very clean.
The bar downstairs was very loud at night and woke us up. There were a few communication issues with passport photos but communication about location, check in/out, and other logistics was great.
We wish there were more towels provided for guests.
Raul's place is extremely close to several attractions. its extremely walkable and there are great attractions in and around. i will be recommending to my friends and family.
Raul's home was clean and convenient. The apartment was accessible and walkable to many local places.

The place looked brand new and had everything you could possibly need. We felt super comfortable and secure in the apartment, it had black out blinds from outside which were useful when we were out in the city or during the night.
We chose this location because we wanted a walkable distance to the stadium and to the city centre. And it was great, the metro is just 5 min away.

This is my second time staying here, and it is a great place to live—spacious apartments! Only the detergents are lacking. There were not enough for the entire stay, and there was only dishwashing detergent once.

Residencial Príncipe De Vergara is an excellent Airbnb option for anyone looking for a clean and well-located apartment in Madrid. If you value a quiet environment, independence, and being close to everything without staying in the touristy center, this is a great choice.
Bear in mind that the apartment is located on the ground floor, so you’ll likely need to keep the external metal shutters closed most of the time for privacy.
Really nice place, exactly how the pictures was. Apartment was huge and in a nice place. Restaurants and bars everywhere. Real Madrid stadium 10 mins walk. Would definitely be using again.

Very spacious apartment. There’s not much sun coming in since it’s situated on the ground floor and there’s only two windows in the entire place, but other than that it was very nice! Also there’s a supermarket within 3 mins of walking which was very convenient!

This is my second time in the residence, and each time I visit Madrid I hope the premises is available. I had a great stay and the place is beautiful. The owner is responsive and friendly. Each time I may have a question they respond really fast. The heating is great and kept us warm with also extra sheets. The area is nice and close to the center.
Great place to stay and the location was amazing right off of Gran Via, would definitely recommend to friends.

Apartment was as described. The windows don’t really let any light in but we knew that when we booked so it wasn’t a surprise. It was a good value place to stay for the location and size. There was a slight drain smell in the kitchen.

Excellent place to stay. Very close to the park. Centro is just in the other side of the park (approx 30min walk).
Nice restaurants, cafes, bars in the area.
Maria was very helpful and responsive.
WiFi is a little spotty, but reasonable for limited stays.
Perfect location, clean, super helpful and responsive host, super quiet at night and well air conditioned.

This listing was great, perfect location with an easy check in and little to no hassle getting to room. Clean space with a comfortable sleeping situation and an even better bathroom. I would for sure stay here again, thank you Alfonso & Guillermo!

We had a nice stay in Madrid. The apartment was nice, but the way the bathroom is positioned wasn't great since from one side you can not lock the door. The terrace was awesome, and the view of the city was beautiful. The cleanliness of the place wasn't the best since we found some stains on the pillows and blankets. The host was quite responsive and helpful. Overall a nice experience, worth the price.
J place is a great to relax and enjoy the area around his place, there are restaurants, supermarkets, coffee shops, fruits shops that you can get anytime thanks so much for everything…

Fantastic apartment! It’s much bigger than photos can show. Everything is new and perfect! Kitchen has all the appliances one can imagine! Great service! Many bars and restaurants round the place.
After stay we forgot some medicine in the fridge and the host helped us immediately with the despatch. Thank you very much.
