Great new apartment with everything you need in a small 1 bedroom + kitchen with dishwasher (even detergent), Nespresso machine (with capsules!) + bath (with towel warmer).
Great communication and open 24 hours!
And great access with same code to front door as to apartment.
And a rooftop deck with nice views.
Will come back..👍

I had a great stay at Jose Maria's place. It was clean, cozy, and well kept. The location was a great spot in La Chueca with plenty of restaurants and shops within close walking distance. I would not hesitate to stay there again.

Excellent apartment in a quiet neighbourhood. It has everything you need for a short or a long stay. There is a supermarket next door. Easy and quick to get to the center using the metro.
Fran and Isabel are great hosts.

We had a good stay. The room is clean and convenient to shops and public transportation. The bed is pretty small for two people, and it's really not comfy. The communication with the host was a bit weird at first, but it was still good overall.
Big, clean and modern apartment in a great neighborhood. On a main street but remained very quiet at all times. Highly recommend!
Great apartment, very well located in Chamberi. Particularly liked that there was a working space and spacious living room and kitchen.
This is spacious apartment in a lovely walkable neighborhood. Metro lines are nearby to explore Madrid. Definitely would recommend.

It was the second time I stayed in this apartment, and I would come back again. I love the area and the apartment is great. Particularly appreciated the work space so that I could work while on my trip.

It is a very cozy apartment as shown in the pictures. Close to markets, shops and metro stations. It is at the ground floor and you can hear everything happens in the street but bedroom is at the back so it was OK for sleeping. The hot water has nice pressure. Compared to Madrid accommodation prices, it is more on the affordable side. Thanks for hosting.
Great small cozy flat. Ideal if you are staying over for a few days. Not too far away from the center.

My room was more expensive than my roommates, I do not why.
A great place to stay!

We had a great experience at Alicia’s apartment!
She’s kind and willing to help at any time!
Everything was clean.
Close to bus and metro station.

The apartment was clean and close to our required amenities. Getting in and out was easy, and the space was quite private and isolated. I loved the location as it was close to family that we were visiting. Alicia was very friendly and provided us with clear instructions.

The check in process is very fast and easy. I could even leave my luggage before my check in.
The only minor problem is the shower that is broken.

We always stay near delicias but this was the first time we came across Alicia’s listing. So far this has been one of our favourite, so we hope we can continue to book it for our yearly trip. She was always fast to respond and sorted out any issues we may have. Everything was clean and the room felt spacious.

We really enjoyed staying in this loft.
It was beautifully decorated, clean, and very comfortable. The space had everything we needed, including a well-equipped kitchen and strong AC, which was a huge plus during the summer heat. It was a peaceful and relaxing place to come back to after a long day, and the host was friendly and responsive, making check-in easy.
That said, the location was the main downside for us. While the neighborhood itself was quiet and felt safe, it’s very hilly, and the walk to the metro or main areas felt long and physically demanding, especially in the high temperatures we weren’t used to.
Overall, we loved the loft itself and would recommend it to others, especially if you’re okay with a steep walk in the heat or plan to use taxis or a car.

Antonio and his wife are really nice and hospitable, responsive to guests’ needs. The guest room is very cosy and clean and has an air conditioner. The flat is located close to the Atocha station, the supermarket Carrefour is on the same street, just a few houses from the flat. I highly recommend this place!
The house are always arranged tidy and cleanly. Antonio is friendly and helpful to us. He introduce his house very carefully and clearly. We have a comfortable and pleasant stay in Madrid.

Spotlessly clean room with access to immaculate bathroom and kitchen. Air conditioning worked perfect and Antonio and his family were very welcoming. Right next to supermarkets and metro station! Great location.

Antonio’s place is well organised a clean. We felt very comfortable there and nice access to kitchen although we barely used it in the end. Slept like a baby there.
totally recommend!

Absolutely perfect place to stay for the price it’s listed. The location is great and so many things are walking distance. We stayed in July when it was very hot but there was a nice fan that helped so much. Would recommend!

Good location. To get to the room itself, we had to walk through a hostel-style dormitory which was not listed. The bathrooms were very clean however in two of the bathrooms the lights did not work, and would flick on and off every 20 seconds

The location of the room is ideal for tourists. Many of Madrid's top attractions are within walking distance, making it a fantastic place to stay for anyone looking to explore the city. The shared toilets are always kept clean, even though they serve 13 bedrooms.
Being in the heart of Madrid, there is some noise from the street, but honestly, considering the price, it's not an issue.
One detail missing from the description: to access the room, you need to pass through another room where other guests may be.

Had a great stay at Pau’s place for the month of August.
Sometimes it got too hot in the apartment but there is a small fan that helps with the heat.
Bathroom was a bit small and the draining system isn’t the best but it does the job. It’s easy to park near the apartment and it looked exactly like the pictures. Pau was very quick to respond and helpful whenever I needed something.

I enjoyed my stay with Pau! The place was clean, cozy, and I felt right at home. It is slightly noisy but I am from a city myself and am not bothered by the sounds of cards driving by or school children passing

Great location and comfortable accommodation for my stay in Madrid. I would highly recommend to anyone visiting the city. The apartment is located in a great neighborhood and within walking distance to anything that you’d want to do. Great stay!
Very nice place.  Centrally located near everything.  Most of all, the communication was really good.   If you visit Madrid, I would definitely recommend

Very nice modern apartment in a great location. Outside can get a bit noisy, but the doors/windows block out most  noise. There was plenty of hot water for four people (not sure why this is an issue for others). To make it perfect, maybe include more than two wine glasses and have a little more cultery. Enjoyed our stay overall. Recommend.

Great location. Communication needs to be better. We never received timely response to our questions. It looked like they never understood our questions and respond to it. All their messages were standard.
Few things we noticed that you can improve.
1) Washing machine is there. There is no dryer.
2) Wireless was very choppy, it didn’t work at all
3) No toothpaste / brush & Conditioner
4) It very hot yesterday, air conditioning could not be controlled at all
5) No continuous hot water on the 1st day, it got better the next 2 days

The apartment is located in a lovely area, it's well equipped with everything you need and very clean. The windows work great against noise from outside, but you definitely hear the neighbors (also Airbnb) from above quite a lot.

Host was friendly and gave local recommendations! House was modern and nice and fit four people! We enjoyed our stay here and were close to a metro stop. Host in the beginning was a bit long to respond but after that they communicated well!
Place live up to the name - it was exclusive AirBnb. Clean, fancy, access via app, no need of physical key or check in.
The location was great ! Close to subway stations, grocery, restaurants. The apartment was a great size, very comfortable.
Gonzalo’s place was very nice, clean and close to great spots and public transit. He was very responsive during check in and we had no issues.
The airbnb was great! Close to a street where we could easily catch the bus, very accessible in the first floor and size was perfect. Wonderful option.
Awesome place. Surely will come back. Bárbara and her staff are very kind and attentive. Thanks!

Bárbara and Paul's place is amazing! I felt like I was sleeping in a spaceship from the 1960s. For some reason, the movie Solaris kept running through my mind. The apartment is unlike anywhere I've ever stayed in my life. Bárbara is a fantastic host, and I was to separately thank her for making my stay so comfortable. I highly recommend this Airbnb to everyone! 🙂

Maria's place was great, location was perfect, walk to the Metro, shops and restaurants at the doorstep and still a super quiet area.
The pool was a bonus. The apartment is clean and tidy and as pictured.
Communication was easy and Maria was lovely.

Miguel and his team were super helpful and always got back to me quickly. When I had a package coming late, he actually offered to help me get it even after I checked out - that's pretty rare.
Check-in was seamless and the apartment had great AC, which was perfect for the heat. Really comfortable place to crash after long days exploring the city.
The place wasn't clean when I arrived because of a scheduling issue, but once I mentioned it they came the next day to fix it. They also brought some snacks and local treats as an apology and gave me a partial refund, which I wasn't expecting. Honestly, Miguel turned a frustrating situation around pretty fast.
La Latina is an amazing area - I could walk everywhere I wanted to go. Tons of great bars and restaurants right around the corner, and easy to get to all the main sights.
Had one issue but Miguel handled it really well. Would definitely stay again.
Nice apartment very well located. All perfect except the AC which was not really functioning. The owner will take care and fix it. But not so warm for our stay so not a big problem.

This was a very nice surprise. The apartment was in a perfect location, extremely clean and quiet. Everything in the place worked well. AC was cold and nice and the bedrooms also have ceiling fan, which was appreciate it for the hot Madrid’s weather in this summer. Hosts were helpful and responsive and always in touch. We would definitely try to book again in our next trip!
The location is amazing.  the apartment is right next to Plaza Mayor and easily walkable to all major attractions.

Gustavo is an amazing host - very prompt response and accommodating. One of the best hosts I've experienced within any of the Airbnb properties we've stayed at. Thank you for a wonderful stay, Gustavo!

It is a cozy unit that fits 2 person exactly. The distance to the Mercadona is just 2 mins walk away and there is 2 different Metro stops that is 3-5 mins walk.
The neighbourhood is nice as it is not really central located but it will be quiet and good place to sleep in during the night. :)

Noemi's accommodation was the best base you could wish for if you want to explore Madrid.
We had a wonderful stay in the apartment. It was spotless, clean, exactly as described and equipped with both a dishwasher and washing machine which was important to us as we were traveling Spain for an extended period of time. My personal favorite are the windows in the old building that allow a view of the small, green square in front of the house. Thanks to the shutters and their size, you never feel cut off from the world, but you can still have privacy when you need to.
Our host was very friendly and accommodating, and her personal recommendations in the city are definitely worth a visit. The public transport connections are numerous and within easy walking distance, we were able to reach various museums, exhibitions and locations in the city center and other districts very comfortably.
Dear Noemi, thank you for having us!

It’s a peaceful neighborhood, where you can find all kind of services, and near public transportation and more lively neighborhoods without the noise. The host attended very soon a detail on the bathroom. Everything was ok.

We had a great stay in Madrid. The apartment is located near the bull fight arena with a great subway network right
In front of you. You can discover city beautifully from this place. The place
Itself is clean, the host was nice and friendly and we had a perfect stay.
Isabel was super helpful and always accommodate to our needs! Place was exactly as advertised! Highly recommended!

Well situated, very good transportation alternatives (metro), Near central Madrid.
Lots of restaurants near by

Gorgeous place to stay in Madrid, lovely quiet and friendly neighbourhood. The apartment is so comfortable and clean with everything you need. I slept so well in the bed!
We would definitely stay again.
Javier was so friendly and responsive to communication too.

We were very comfortable in Javier's newly furnished flat and enjoyed the fact that there were 3 double bedrooms each with ample storage, and 2 bathrooms with large showers. The kitchen was fully fitted with electrical appliances such as a coffee machine, dishwasher, washing machine and an air fryer. Situated in a quiet residential area with shops, cafés and restaurants, and bus stops within a short walking distance.

This was a great place to stay in Madrid. It’s out of the city center but close enough to easily walk in. A really quiet neighborhood that felt like you weren’t in a tourist center. The apartment is perfect for up to six or even eight people, and has everything you need. Javier was so welcoming and a great communicator. He was always available and helpful. If you are a vegetarian, or looking for a vegetarian food, check out Sana on the main boulevard, close by.
We highly recommend this Airbnb!
Great stay at Javi’s place, he was very proactive with communication. Being a bigger group the space fit for our needs perfectly. Gracias Javi!

Apartment is in a great location for access to Real Madrid stadium, and a fairly short taxi into central Madrid.
The apartment is much larger than expected and very nice, the only thing that could make it better is if a few things were attended to - loose tap, tiling grout needs cleaning in places etc. overall very good though

Thank you. I had a wonderful time at your place.
Regards
Alfredo Suárez
Great place to stay, near to the metro, save neighborhood, lots of restaurants and 2  supermarkets
Great location! Great view but because of the view it was a bit noisy during the night. Everything else was superb! Had fun
Excellent location. I was able to walk to most of my destinations. I would stay here again.

The apartment was located in the heart of Madrid with a beatiful view. All the main hot spots were easy to reach and there were countless restaurants and cafés nearby.
The room itself was very clean and felt inviting. The host answered very quick to my messages and was helpful at all times.
Can highly recommend!

Airbnb was the perfect amount of space for the 5 of us. Three large bedrooms and two really nice bathrooms were great. Kitchen had everything we needed including a nice big table for eating. There was also an area with a couch and chair (with tv) for extra seating. Location was great, close to restaurants, grocery stores and metro. Communication with host was easy and he was very responsive. Would highly recommend staying here.

The apartment is very comfortable and clean with everything that you need.
Also, you can’t beat the location, so many things to do and restaurants around.
We really enjoyed our stay.

The apartment itself is absolutely lovely—beautifully designed, comfortable, and in a perfect location. Once inside, it exceeded expectations.
However, during our stay, there was significant construction work with workmen right outside our window and drilling starting as early as 7:45 AM. While building work is sometimes unavoidable, the level of disruption was quite high. When we mentioned it to the management company, their response was quite dismissive, simply saying they couldn't control what the neighbors do. While that may be true, a more thoughtful response would have been appreciated.
Access wasn’t the easiest because of remotely activated access codes. We had requested early luggage drop-off and gaining access was a bit tricky

The accommodation absolutely met our expectations. The coordination was smooth and easy. The very central location is an ideal base for exploring Madrid. Thank you for hosting us. We would book the accommodation again!
It is a nice place close to public transport.there are markets nearby. Clean and nice place with all kitchen stuff. I enjoyed
We had a wonderful stay, great location, easy walk to the bus or metro. Matches the photos, clean and modern.

We stayed at this place for our 5 day trip to Madrid. It was perfect! Only a few minutes walk from El Carmen Metro station which made the whole city very accessible. The airbnb itself is accessed via an app which is good and easy to use. We enjoyed the layout of the airbnb and the whole apartment was comfy. The only thing it lacked was a few cooking basics such as salt and pepper, oil etc … that in my opinion would make the airbnb even better. Thanks for a lovely stay

I stayed with my mam in Abel’s place for four days and it was perfect. The apartment was only a very short walk from metro and there is a lot of commerce in the surroundings such as restaurants, supermarkets and convenience stores . Also the flat was very  very very clean with all the basic amenities you can need in a trip. Definitely, I recommend this place to family and friends, and it will be my first option if I am back to Madrid. Great value for money!!

Very nice place, very well located, close to everything.
I recommend this place 10000%

The host is very responsive and willing to help when needed. The place is large with lots of potential, however more attention is needed in the air quality in the furthest two bedrooms and bathroom as there are serious concerns about a prolonged musty smell in these areas. Typically signals underlying moisture issues.

Lovely place, very nice host, great price. If I had to improve something it would just be the location as it is a little out of town and I ended up having to get quite a few Ubers/ metro. But a great distance between airport, bernabeau and city centre. Would highly recommend!
Great loft, small but you have everything you need for your holidays, it is not too far from the Gran Via, the metro station is at 7 minutes walk

The apartment was jut like on the pictures , and the balcony was a big plus. It was really clean, the bed was comfortable. Carlos responded to our messages really quickly. I would recommend this to others. It was really easy to access from the city. Had a lot of shops nearby. The area was surprisingly quiet.
verry cozy place, for the price is a really good deal. The place come with pretty much everything you need.

We had a perfect stay in Madrid at Carlos’s apartment. The apartment was very clean, easy to access and just like the pictures.
Lili was very fast to reply and made sure to inform us on construction taking place at the metro station and where to get the bus into the centre of Madrid.
The area was very walkable to local shops which is a bonus.
Overall perfect place for such a good price, would definitely recommend and return. :)

The accommodation is in a great location, with several metro lines within walking distance, close to the center of Madrid, and the Santiago Bernabéu Stadium is also within walking distance.
The app-based check-in is fantastic, so we didn't have to worry about our arrival time.
The accommodation is perfect, the sofa bed is comfortable for sleeping, and the furniture is very modern.
Good location a little further from the centre, but handy for 3 metro stations. As described with nice sunny outside area. lots of shops and  places to eat within 10 min walk.
Cozy and quiet apartment at a good location with easy check in and out. All as described. Longer stay next time…
very modern and cozy apartment with a terrace, amazingly comfortable bed, very helpful and kind host...near the metro station, I will be happy to return to the same place
It was a very clean place and clear instructions on how to get in. It was exactly as  described and loved the restaurants recommendation given by host. Definitely worth every penny.

We loved our stay here - right in the heart of the city, we enjoyed having such an accessible home base while we discovered the incredible nightlife and atmosphere of Madrid! Would definitely stay again.
We have stayed here for the second time in a row, everything was even more comfortable, because we are familiar with all features.
If you have to go to Madrid, the apartment is a nice place to stay. Apartment is fully equipped and perfect for extended stays.

Apartment was spotless and had plenty of space for a family. We were so at ease in this space! The beds and sofa bed were very comfortable for sleeping. Very accessible to center and tourist areas by taxi and ride share--we didn't get a chance to use transit, but there is a station minutes away by foot. There was on-site support most of the day. Note that you will need to purchase paper towels as they were not provided. Check in directions weren't as specific as I'd have liked at first (this host manages many properties and you can tell). But once we got the info specific to our unit, it was very easy. All in all a good value. Would recommend for families, especially--there is a playground outside and a pharmacy across the street.

The apartment is just as it looks in the photo's. Was nice to have the balcony although it didn't get a lot of sun due to the overhang of the balcony upstairs, this would not be an issue in the height of summer.
It is very near the metro and an easy journey into the centre. The location is pleasant but more of a business district so not a lot of cafe's or restaurants and what there was were on a busy road.
Everything is very new, don't think the oven has ever been used! Possibly because of lack of baking tray or any oven proof dishes. Otherwise fairly well equipped.
Our booking was for a week and only two dishwasher tablets were provided and one bin sac despite them advising you empty the rubbish every day.
Arrived before 10pm feel that the 50 Euro charge for late check in is quite steep.
However having said all that a good base for exploring Madrid.

Very clean and seems recently updated. Only just very sparse on towels, no paper towels or top sheet in the beds. The neighborhood is a bit rougher also, but safe enough if you know how to keep your wits about you. Only 10 min walk to the metro Nueva Numancia on the 1 line. Good local fruit and veg markets. I would stay again!

The place was great for my family.
From the reviews I was a little worried about the neighborhood, but it was absolutely fine.
I’m wondering if people thought it was something to comment about only because it has many immigrants, which for me is not an issue as I come from a city where we were all immigrants. Thought the neighborhood was safe, there’s a good Dominican restaurant three blocks away.
The only issue I had was the sink in the bathroom, I did not know how to open it, so I would go use the kitchen sink.
Thank you for a great apartment!

The flat was very clean, with a good air conditioning system and well equipped with everything we needed. The view was nice, and the location was great — everything was within a 10-minute walk. Overall, a very comfortable stay!
Luis' place was perfect for my two day stay in NYC. Luis was extremely helpful and the stay was perfect. Location is perfect and the little balcony was great. Highly highly recommend!

Cosy apartment with everything you need for a short break in almost the centre of town. We loved the comfort and having the flat at the back meant it was quiet at night, even though plenty of lovely bars.

Great location in Lavapies and easy to walk around the city and to Retiro park. Santiago was a lovely host who gave us really good instructions to check in, welcomed us warmly, and gave us advice about the area (and specific recommendations about record shops when I asked about that) - he booked a taxi to the airport for us too.  A great host. The apartment is compact, but really well equipped and with nice decor and was a great place to feel like a local. I would happily stay at Santiago's place again.

We had a truly amazing time staying at Santiago's apartment. It's a charming and cozy hideaway in a great  location with lots of atmosphere... Tons of bars,  restaurants, stores  and very close to transportation , although the apartment itself is quite and very private..The place is beautifully decorated and features all the "little things" that make one feel at home. Santiago is incredibly kind and helpful . He  is also an interesting, fun and warm person and we we feel like we actually made a friend in Madrid . I can not say enough good things about our stay at "the nest". I highly recommend staying here for an exceptional and unforgettable time. Thanks again , Santiago!!!

Rosario is a super host, very hospitable, kind and responsive.
We stayed in the beautifully renovated loft for three weeks and felt right at home.
The loft has everything you need and is a quick journey to central Madrid. You are also minutes away from the stunning Parque Forestal Adulto Suarez which gives you a beautiful hike opportunity.
I highly recommend this loft and Rosario.
Thank you for everything.
Fantastic place, very cosy and Rosario was an excellent communicator. would fully recommend to any couple or solo traveller looking for a base to see Madrid.

Rosario’s place was even better than the pictures. She was so helpful with recommendations, instructions on how to get to the place, itineraries for places to go in Madrid, and she was very generous with stocking the fridge with goods which was so kind. The place is gorgeous, we loved our stay here.
This is a really good room! Both the house owner and her daughter are kind and cute! The house offers everything like shampoo, towel, etc.
Good location, clean home! Host is always responsive. I only spent a night sleeping but I had a good night sleep… thank you! Gracias ❤️

Had the best time with Javiera, she's always ready to help and to make you feel welcome.
Since the very beginning I felt at home and really appreciate this feeling of safe and quiet place for me
Wish I'd stay more and hope to come back.
Lots of love.

The room is very nice.  Brend new , location is perfect close to the MTR,  close to every thing and the supermarket. The landlord is very nice. Wait for us to check in before her work and  we were early checkin , also she is very beautiful , 5 star 👏

We arrived earlier than check-in time and the host allowed us to drop us our bags. The host was very responsive. The apartment is close to the train station. It on the first floor, so don't have to worry about moving your bags up a flight of stairs. The area was quiet and we didn't notice any disturbance during our stay. The apartment was spacious and accommodated a group of 6 well. I'll definitely consider staying here again in the future.

great place and great location! Alejandra, the hostess, was always attentive and responsive, no issues at all.  we will def stay here again next time we are in Madrid.  location is great, easy to get on Metro and go anywhere including to the airport!

We had a great stay at Alejandra’s place. The apartment was very clean and perfect for a weekend trip to Madrid.
There is a subway station and a supermarket close by the apartment which is very convenient.
We would definitely come back.
We stayed for one night before our flight next day. Place was comfortable and easy to find. Paolo was very responsive and helpful.

Centrally located with easy access to the heart of Malasańa. It's a top floor apartment with a terrace, private bedroom, upper loft, and a pull out couch. There are four flights of stairs so entering and exiting will keep you fit. We really enjoyed the apartment and its location is prime. I would recommend and stay here again.

We had a wonderful stay here! Lovely  place in the heart of Madrid. The hosts were very responsive to small issues and made sure we were the most comfortable possible during our stay with them. Thank you

The apartment was in a great area of town. We enjoyed the lovely terrace and it fit our family wonderfully for our week in Madrid. The host was very responsive when we asked questions or needed anything.
The location is so nice to be able to walk to hundreds of restaurants and is so accessible to the Metro. Being right next to the Royal Palace was a plus as well. We always felt safe and really enjoyed our stay.
Would recommend. We stayed as a girls group and found the apartment to have everything we needed. Great location, very quiet. One thing to know, there are a lot of stairs up to the apartment.

We really enjoyed staying here. The apartment is spacious for the three of us — the living room is cozy and roomy, and the kitchen is clean and fully equipped with everything you need. The bathroom is also large and comfortable.
There’s a smart TV where you can log into your own Netflix account if you’d like.
We loved having coffee on the balcony — it was very pleasant, comfortable, and fun.
The apartment is very close to the Opera metro station and within walking distance of the city center.
We really enjoyed sitting at the many restaurants in the neighborhood and having a beer or a glass of white wine in the evenings.
In short — it was amazing, we had a great time, and Emilio is a wonderful and fantastic host.

My children and I had a great time at Emilio’s apartment. The apartment is within walking distance to a number of attractions. It was a bonus that the area around the apartment is very lively and an attraction in and of itself. It is a lot of fun in the evening here.
The four of us found the apartment comfortable. We were in Madrid in a very hot stretch of June and were happy to find that the A/C worked well. It was essential!
Excellent host and location. Exactly as described. Perfect for our family. Beds were not super comfortable but fine for our 3 night stay. Happy to have stayed at this apartment!
The stay was amazing for 2 nights, the location is great and the apartment is very spacious with all the cooking equipment that we needed for a wonderful valentines with friends

Very spacious and beautifully renovated apartment in one of the best neighborhoods in Madrid.  The view of Retiro Park from the large patio is a big plus.  There are a bunch of restaurants and shops within walking distance and the metro station is a very short walk.  The apartment itself is very tastefully and comfortably decorated. The bedrooms are spacious and the bathrooms are clean and modern. The kitchen is fully equipped.  The communication with the host was excellent.  I visit Madrid often and would happily stay in this beautiful apartment again!

The host was always attentive and very flexible (they allowed me a late check-out free of charge). I had already booked my stay with Dobo House and it was always a positive experience. 100% recommended
For long term stay this was the perfect choice! Great apartment, good communication and overall would always go again!

Beautiful full size apartment walking distance to most attractions. Bea’s place was perfectly clean and came fully equipped with everything you can imagine (washing machine, detergent pods, hair dryer, body wash, Nespresso machine with two Nespresso pods). This area of Madrid was perfect, we were very satisfied with our stay.

beautiful apartment made us feel at home
the host was so helpful with everything including early check in which was very kind, we would strongly recommend this apartment to anyone and hosts were helpful and always on hand for any queries
thankyou

We enjoyed our stay which was close to where are granddaughter lives!  Accommodations were exactly what we were looking for, close to so many restaurants and other places we could walk too.  Also, when we had questions, Bea answered within 30 minutes.

Firstly. The hosts are amazing and cannot fault them one bit!
Unfortunately we didn’t have the best of luck. No hot water on the second day and electricity blip on the last day meaning no power at all but couldn’t fault the hosts. They responded ASAP both times, even by 0700am. Got maintenance round quickly and wanted to do everything they could to get it fixed asap.
Otherwise good little stay. Place is a little smaller than I thought and the shower is randomly in the bedroom haha. However they have such good detail on the little things: kitchen utensils, cooking oil pods, cleaning products, shampoo etc. All little things to help out extra when staying with wanting to cook etc indoors.
Easy to find, and perfect walking distance to what you need. Just out the way of the main centre. For the convenience and price, recommended!
our hosts could not have been more helpful.The power cut was a very eventful day but Nacho walked for 2 hours to make sure we could get into our apartment.
Thank you for accommodating a flexible check in. Apartment is on the ground floor in a fun vibrant neighborhood La Latina. It was impeccably clean too! Great hosts
We enjoyed our stay! It was in a great location and it was great value for money. The place was clean. I would highly reccommend. Hosts were great at communicating and friendly.

We had a wonderful stay! The apartment was spotless, beautifully presented, and exactly as pictured. The location was perfect—close to lots of Tapas bars and walkable to a lot of the main tourist attractions, yet quiet enough for a good night’s sleep. The host was friendly, responsive, and made check-in and check-out really easy.
It doesn’t have air con but they have two high speed ceiling fans that circulate the air and we were comfortable.
I would happily stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting Madrid! ❤️
It was a beautiful place, excellent location. I recommend very much the place to anyone trying to enjoy Madrid
Nice apartment with an extremely good location for staying in Madrid. Amir was quick to respond whenever we had a question or issue. Would happily stay again.

We stayed there for a week and were overall very satisfied with the room – except that the bed was a bit small. The location is super central, so you can easily reach everything on foot. Amir was very easy to reach, helpful, and friendly. We were even able to check in earlier than planned.

Flat was just as described. Everything was clean and the kitchen was well equipped with the basics for cooking and making coffee
I can highly recommend this apartment and would book again!
Everything about the unit and neighborhood was spot on. Unfortunately the last evening wifi was dropping. Javier though was very responsive and troubleshooted the cause. Overall a good stay.

Javier’s place was exactly what we were looking for, a comfortable, clean and spacious place to sleep that would be a walking distance from restaurants and major highways/avenues.
The place was very clean, exactly what the pictures show, and equipped with exactly what we needed. There is a nice closet space that can hold a lot of clothes or items if needed that definitely came in handy.
Major tourist attractions/spots were always a short Uber ride away, which was a great plus. Nearby you could easily find ATMs, restaurants, coffee shops, super markets or convenience stores, all within a few minutes of walking.
Javier himself is a GREAT host, we were a little lost in the middle of an unexpected national blackout during our stay and he showed up with some candles so we could use them if needed.
Great stay!!

Great place to stay, it may be a bit difficult to find parking however but they were quick to resolve this with a little bit of information about parking and car parks in the area, so we had no problems there at all. Super clean place, very spacious and the sofa bed is great! Got a good nights sleep every night. Great at communicating and all around 10/10 space and 10/10 hosts. Area is nice and quiet too, even late night on weekends!
This place is perfect to spend some days while visiting madrid, it has everything you need and the hosts are always available for any questions.
Simple communication and easy to access. The apartment is a little noisy from the other neighbours, but otherwise a great place to stay to explore Madrid.

Susan's house was perfect for our holiday. We were a group of four and the house met all our needs. It's cozy, modern and equipped with all what you need from a huge TV with Netflix up to the wine bottle opener. The beds were comfortable and the towels were new and soft. The house is in an excellent location near two metro lines and is surrounded by a range of restaurants, coffee shops and shops. Susana was an excellent host with great communication skills, she was very responsive and was flexible in the check-out time. She even met us during check-in which was nice instead of the usual automated check-in process. I also loved that in Susan's check-out message, she advice you not to throw any leftovers, as they will donate it afterwards which is very efficient as well. Definitely recommended for your Madrid trip.

The place is great and close to the main area of Madrid and the host is excellent person she always show whenever you need any support even if it’s not related to the apartment.
Finally, I highly recommend the place if you want to rest your mind

The flat was really excellent! The location is city center, the beds extremely comfortable, and the flat was spotless clean. Everything we needed was available in the apartment. The host is Susana was very responsive, friendly and easy to communicate with. I highly recommend it!
Great appartement in Malasaña. It was very easy with our baby and the stroller since it’s on the ground floor. Appartement is very clean and the location is great.

This is a great apartment in a terrific walkable location, close to everything and very accessible to public transportation.  Comfortable space and well appointed.  Susan’s was most helpful to us. We lived Madrid and would happily stay here again!
Rafael and Susana were great! We really enjoyed our stay as a family with teenagers and a 1 year old. Would love to go back.
The apartment is in the heart of city, and next to transit. We walked everywhere and had a blast. Hosts were quick to reply to messages!

Good as a base in Madrid, well connected by metro and a park nearby. The flat is modern, well equipped and has self controlled heating for the colder nights. I liked the keyless entry system and although there were some problems with the main entrance of the building, these were fixed promptly. The host is professional and has an always available helpline that works very well. Instructions and communication are clear and helpful.

We stayed at this airbnb for a month. Everything went easily and our conversations with Antonio were good and he responded very quickly. Antonio helped us with the different public transportations and with everything we needed. The appartment was just like the photos and the weekly cleaning service was included to the price - that was really nice! Also the airbnb was located well, there was lots of stores, big park at the walking distance, metro station and buss stops were close. Over all we had a Lovely stay and we can recommend this to you, because it was in safe neighbourhood too! Best regards, Alisa and Jemina

Enrique and Javier were phenomenal! They helped me with some dumb questions, answered very quickly, and were very kind through it all. One thing I will add, too, is the hot water would run out around ten to fifteen minutes in the shower. For just myself, that was fine. For groups larger than one, expect shorter showers! Otherwise, fantastic spot to visit!!
Everything was as described.  Linens were high quality, everything was of the best quality. Nice patio to relax...would do it again!

Location, location, location… this apartment is located in the best neighborhood in Salamanca hands down. You also have everything you need in less than a 5 block radius (gym, grocery store 24/7, metro station, bike-sharing hub, plenty of restaurants and coffee shops. The scenery around the neighborhood is wonderful, and is also extremely safe.
The Hosts Ana and Mar, are extremely attentive and accommodated me with an early Check in.
The apartment was very clean.
The bed and pillows weren’t that comfortable to me, but everyone is different.

A nice and clean apartment in a good area, easy to get to places even by walking. The amenities were great and the check-in easy and without any hassle. Host was also responsive and friendly, highly recommend this place!

Fantastic place to stay as a family.  Located close to shops and restaurants and walking distance to many others. Host very responsive to any queires or questions we had. Can be a bit noisy with people coming and going but nothing that bothered us.

Amazing stay – highly recommend!
This place was perfect! Great location, super close to restaurants and sightseeing, so it was easy to get around.
The decor is beautiful, and you can tell a lot of thought went into every detail. It was clean, comfy, and had everything we needed to feel at home.
Check-in was a breeze, and the owner was so responsive and helpful the whole time.
Would 100% stay here again!

The location was fantastic and the property looked just like the photos, which we really appreciated. However, the place could have been cleaner — we noticed hair and dust on the counters, floors, and even the upstairs bed upon arriving to the apartment. Overall, it was a convenient stay with a great location, and communication with Marc was excellent.

Loved staying at Gian’s, everything was perfect. The place looked great and had lots of services, and an amazing shower. The area as well is great and with lots of restaurants around and a 24/7 Carrefour. Walkable distance from the center, although uphill (like everything in Madrid hahahaha). Gian is a great person and very friendly, he let me stay a bit after the check-out to wait for my brother who had to arrive. 10/10 experience.
Gian responds very fast and helped me a lot the house is very comfortable and in a good location. Would recommend!!

Amazing stay. The apartment is perfectly located for shopping, dining, nightlife and getting around the city. Ben was a very kind and attentive host. Wouldn’t hesitate to recommend and return for our next stay.

Alicia is a very kind lady, and she took good care of every guest.
the room is cozy, clean, warm and quiet.
it was nice, too that Alicia will prepare breakfast for guests, making it like real home.
though it was just a short stay in Madrid with her this time, I enjoyed very much. ☺️

Alicia was a super nice host...She took very good care of me...She made me feel at home...It was a pleasure staying in her home...She showed me how to get around Madrid..She took me shopping for warmer clothes and for a Spainsh tradition of having a hot chocolate drink with churris..very tasty and delicious...Over all She is a fantastic host...made me feel at home.. She made feel like family...Very very nice lady..

I had a great stay! The location is excellent – very close to all the main attractions, which made it super convenient to explore the city. Adriana is wonderful – a great communicator and always ready to help whenever I needed anything. I really appreciated her support throughout my stay. I would definitely recommend this place to anyone visiting!

No words! Absolutely an amazing place to stay! check in was super easy and quick! the room was spotless and literally so clean!! such a big room as well. i like the building location, close walk to the metro and easy to find things to do around! Will definitely be back
This place is good for what it is. The fire alarm went off 3 times during our sleep and that was annoying! Overall, not bad for a night
Like many old buildings the layout is not ideal. It would be better if bedrooms were to rear and away from street noise.

The apartment was very comfortable for our group of 5 people.  The location is great to explore Madrid by foot.  The AC was excellent during a very hot summer weather.  The host was very attentive and easy to communicate.

It's a nice place. Johanna is a politely and great person. Although do not have. aself-checkin locks, she sent to Elena to give us the physical keys.
Great Bathroom & balcony.
I recommend this place with closed eyes.
Nearest to the Barajas Airport (8 min).

Great stay.  Loved this new apartment.  It was very clean, with everything needed.  Great access to metro and busses.  Walkable too.  Access to great supermarkets. Great host that communicates well and punctually.

Beautiful place. Well designed and comfortable. Area is quiet and located right next a bus stop for convenience. Is a bit further away from the tourist attractions but a quick bus or Uber and you’re there quicker. Would highly recommend.

Perfect location, just two metro stops from Huertas area.
The neighborhood is very quiet and cozy. The apartment is spotless, everything is new and has everything you need.
I think is perfect for two guest, no more!

Nice hotel conveniently placed close to metro line 1 Pacifico and M30. Quiet residential area with few shops and not many bars. Beautiful and clean room with new furniture and plenty of kitchenware. Very awkward view as other guests of the hotel can directly see in your bathroom or toilets depending on your apparemment.... Had to take a shower with the curtains and doors closed to block the view.
Fire alarms went off twice early in the morning. No services in the hotel, no laundry or room service.

We‘ve had a very pleasant stay here for a extended weekend. The apartment was exactly as advertised and was spacious enough for the thee of us. The metro connection to the center was very fast and easy.

hot shower and cool AC makes us relaxed in summer.
elevator moves the luggages to different floors.
Daniel is very kind to keep our luggages for several hours, which provided us sufficient time to move them out.
absolutely fantastic, we were near the shops, the shopping mall, public transport, fantastic 1 bed property, loved the area...😁😁

I booked a stay at Rosa's listing on short notice, and the experience turned out to be very positive. Rosa was prompt in her communication, providing detailed information about what to expect during my stay. It’s important for guests to carefully follow her instructions, as they are well thought out and contribute to a smooth check-in process and a hassle-free stay.
Although I didn’t conduct extensive research on the local area, I found it to be fantastic and conveniently located near many things. The apartment itself was well-equipped with everything necessary for a comfortable stay, and it had an appealing aesthetic. As a visitor from the USA, my only initial challenge was figuring out how to operate the door, but it became easier to manage once I got the hang of it.
Laura's property was perfect for my needs. She was a great, communicative host, who provided a great location. it was close to markets and cafes and was peaceful at night. Thanks again!
Great location! Super responsive host. They allowed us to drop our bags off before our check in time so we could enjoy the museums

I was given the wrong code to open the key box and when I messaged them it took a while to get a response and they gave the wrong code again. Luckily we managed to figure out the right code and get into the apartment.
The key stays in the lockbox overnight which is right on the street so feels a little bit insecure but we had no problems.
It looked like the photos but a bit worn down.

If you’re looking for a place to rest your head while you explore Madrid this place will definitely do the trick. The host is very responsive and kind. The place is in need of a little maintenance but nothing serious. But overall it was a good experience.

Wonderful stay in this Airbnb! The appartment was perfectly matching the pictures and description, and located in one of Madrid's nicest neighbourhoods, Malasana. This area is full of cafés / restaurants and close to most touristic points by walking distance. Thanks Laura for welcoming us in your well-decorated, clean and quiet oasis in the very center of Madrid. Would definitely recommend and come back!

Laura and her family were exceptional hosts who were kind and extremely accommodating.
The unit is simply better and larger than photos can capture. The accumulation of detail and beauty in the unique design leaves a stunning impression. It is unlike anything I have ever stayed in. I have already recommended it to many friends.
Location is central but peaceful with coffee shops and more just around the corner.

We loved our stay at Laura's place! The location was incredible, the home was comfortable and Laura's list of recommendations was extremely helpful. Laura and Mike were always responsive and we felt well taken care of. We can't wait to go back! THANK YOU!!!!

Laura was extremely helpful with any questions or requests. The place was amazing and in a great location. Easily walkable to most places you would want to go. All of the rooms were spectacular and the whole home is gorgeous and of high quality. I would definitely stay here again when visiting Madrid.

Gorgeous apartment with ample space and great natural light. The classical design accents elevated the atmosphere, and the three enormous porches were the true highlight.
In terms of amenities, the AC was powerful and a welcome escape from the heat. The beds, however, were quite firm and may not suit those who prefer a softer mattress. The apartment is also sparsely decorated, giving it more of a short-term rental feel than that of a lived-in home.
Communication with the host was smooth, and they were always quick to respond. The location is unbeatable—right in the middle of everything. It is touristy and pricey, with a bit of a Times Square vibe thanks to people in costumes offering paid photos, though much more beautiful and relaxed than New York’s version.
Overall, I would absolutely book again.

Place looks just like the photos! Space looks very moderate and comfortable! Prime location to restaurants and shopping. 3 private terraces were a huge plus! Our 2 kids (3&4) loved their stay there! Highly recommend!

I enjoyed my stay and was very happy with how clean everything was! it was cozy and felt right at home. Host was super commutative and proactive and answers almost immediately so you be in good hands!
The room is nice and clean and just like in the photos. The location is great. The host is very responsive to communications. Would recommend!

It was very nice stay. Daniel was always helpful, even let us stayed 1 hour longer, since we needed it.
You got a lot of good bars, pubs and restauratns with very attractive prices.
Metro is close by with good connections, also markets, and little shops are just around the corner.
Very nice stay for that price, perfect for city break.
Very nice room, very good towels and bed sheets, it’s like a hotel but very comfortable for 1 or 2 people

The apartment is exactly as described. Very close to the Metro and a number of supermarkets.
Very clean, very modern apartment, with plenty of ammenties close by.
Perfect for what we needed, bed nice and comfortable, bathroom very clean. Apartment was spotless on arrival

This place is in a great location; lots of tapas bars, restaurants, and shopping. The apartment is well appointed with a clothes washing machine. You can easily walk to all the sights in Madrid and this location has two Metro stops nearby.
I like the location, the room itself is very cozy, for its price it's not bad, everything you need is there, the staff helps with everything
Ming’s apartment is great. She’s been very helpful and I loved the fact that she was flexible as our flights were changing.

Everything was wonderful—we really liked the place! The room is just like the photos: small, but we were able to open our luggage comfortably, which was great.
The bathroom was very nice, and Angelica was absolutely wonderful. The location was also very convenient.
The only thing I would suggest is to consider changing the bed sheets, as they were a bit itchy.
Overall, it was a pleasant stay—perfect for someone who just needs a comfortable place to sleep and shower after a long day of walking and activities.

I stayed at Angelica's for just a night but it well worth as I gained a friend! Yes, that is how good she was at conversing and making me feel right at home from the very start! The place was absolutely spot on in terms of the location, access and comfort; and additionally the kindness that she had to keep my luggage over and beyond my checkout time plus the enthusiasm with which she loved my art and love for music and food with her recommendations were fabulous! Will definitely stay again when visiting Madrid!

Angelica is a wonderful host! Very friendly and kind! Everything was perfect, we were here during a heatwave and we had a great fan in our room, so it wasn’t hot in the room at all. The apartment is close to everything.
We enjoyed our stay. Host very kind and helpful. Modern design apartament. very clean. Good communication.

Great place!
Very comfy, clean and lovely.
The host answered quickly and always helpful.
I loved my stay in this place. ♥️
We needed a place to stay for a very early flight in the morning and it is great for that purpose! The house is very clean and the neighbourhood is great!
This is a great to the point Airbnb we only stayed two days between flight and it worked out for us being near the airport. We actually walked there was an under 30 min walk.

I had a fantastic stay at this apartment! The design was sleek, and everything was super clean. The furniture was really comfortable, and the place had all the amenities you could need. The location is unbeatable—surrounded by amazing restaurants. Dakota was also very communicative and made everything easy. We’ll definitely be back soon!
This is a great option in Malasaña! Beautiful apartment and very well located, well appointed and maintained. Slightly on the pricier side but otherwise really great.

Actually not a 5 star place:  a 6 star place, maybe 7!  One of my best AirBnB stays ever.  Everything new and perfect, just like the photos, and really very high quality.  Incredibly responsive host who knew the area well and made sure all our needs were addressed, especially important for an American visiting Spain.  The apt. is truly insulated from  noise but surrounded by great nightlife, restaurants, cafes, a true residential area which is very much alive, but step a few units into St. Lucia from either side and it's suddenly quiet.

This is a charming ground-floor apartment located in a lively neighborhood of Madrid full of very good tapas restaurants and many interesting vintage shops.  The host, who met us at the apartment for check-in, provided four laminated pages of useful information about the neighborhood and was very responsive when we had questions during our stay.  The space was squeaky clean and had all the comforts of home, including very comfortable beds, great lighting and a washer and dryer.   We would definitely stay here again.

The apartment was great -- absolutely pristine, spacious, and well located in Lavapies. The elevator was very helpful and there were no steps between the street front door and apartment which was helpful for some members of our group. The air conditioning worked very well in each bedroom and main living area. We appreciated the quick responses from Emilio as we needed help figuring the electronic keying system on the front door but there were also physical keys provided once inside the apartment to give reassurance. Lots of activity just outside the main door, 24 hour grocery store and Metro station one block away. We will definitely hope to return to this location on our visits to family in the area. Thank you Emilio and team for an excellent experience!

We really enjoyed our time in this apartment. Has a great location, close to the metro and bus stations that will take you to the city center, close to the Santiago Bernabeu and paseo de la castellana. The apartment has everything you need and is really comfortable, the check in process couldn’t be easier. I definitely recommend this place if you are looking for a quite place close to the city.

5 Stars
We had a wonderful stay with Welcomer Group! The apartment was clean, modern, and fully equipped for a comfortable experience. The online check-in process was easy and efficient, and the instructions provided made everything simple.
The team was always responsive and helpful — thank you for assisting us with everything we asked for during our stay, it truly made a difference. We also appreciated the clear guidance on how to access the building and apartment, and the little touches like the extra linens and towels under the bed.
The information posted behind the bedroom door was a nice detail and very helpful in understanding how everything worked in the apartment and building.
Highly recommend Welcomer Group for anyone visiting the city. We’ll definitely book with them again!

Central located. Easily walkable to the Centre (Puerta de Sol, around 15 mins) and surrounding tourist sights. The place was nice, comfortable, and clean. Communication throughout our stay was great! Please be aware the apartment is located in an area where it seems you have to practice regular precaution in any big city.  We never had any issues and felt safe, something to keep in mind. Having said that, I would still recommend the place!
Francisco was a great host. Very proactive,  flexible and very responsive. The apartment is within walking distance of many major tourist attractions. I would definitely stay here again!

Really good host—very receptive and fast responses. The accommodation is okay. It's a bit small and if you are allergic to dust you may have some reactions to the upper loft/bed area. However, it was very clean and the amenities were good. There is no body wash/shampoo/conditioner so you should make sure to pack it.
The location is really central and great. The neighborhood around it is always lively. There seems to be a lot of men though so if you are a girl, I would just be more careful.
The host again was great. We were able to check in early and check out was easy
Nice location and spacious! Located in the city center, you can walk to everywhere. However it is noisy during the day and at night…due to the thin wall.
Absolutely wonderful hosts. I highly recommend them. They are kind, patient and very understanding. If you are from America, STOP, say yes to this one!
Clean place but quite tiny. Cumbersome check in process which involved filling in a form through an app and signing contract which I don’t think should be in case of 3 day tourist stay.

Excellent place, would stay again, quiet place, very clean, everything is brand new. The area is full of great restaurants specially the Alcaravea right in front of it. Metro is just in the corner but we never used it as many things to do are at a close walking distance. There’s a big park Arque Oriente ~8 minutes away where you can go running. There’s a gym that has enough to do a good workout. The pool in the rooftop is small but clean. The only thing that can be improved is the internet, signal comes and goes in places but I’m sure the owner will make it good in no time.
The apartment is beautiful and in an amazing location. The team’s communication was excellent. It was a bit smaller than I expected, but overall everything was wonderful.
Big thanks to Carmen for organizing such an easy way to get to the flat. Very cozy place, the perfect location. Perfect for 2 people to stay in Madrid. Definitely will come back
Raul is very responsive and was a great host! The flat itself is located very close to the train station and about a 15-25 minute walk to most all of the tourist spots.
This was one of the nicest airbnb apartments I have ever stayed in. Beautifully designed and furnished, in perfect condition, in a  fantastic location. 10/10

Location is superb. 8 mins downhill to Gran Via! Near Primark. Travelled with 2 kids aged 4 & 1. Nearby supermarket, convenience stores!
There’s 2 nearby cafes just beside the apartment and serve really good coffee and breakfast!
Host was responsive and very helpful. Look no further! This place is lovely, period!
The place was amazing .. cozy..very comfortable ..huge TV..close to metro ..shops..calm neighborhood..we enjoyed every minute at this flat..for my next trip to Madrid I know where I'll be staying
Very nice Airbnb. Despite there being no Wi-Fi and no Masmovil signal, I still recommend it

I had a fantastic stay at this studio in Madrid! The place is spotless, beautifully decorated in a modern style, and thoughtfully equipped with everything you might need—including a Nespresso machine with coffee capsules, which was a great touch. It’s in a quiet neighborhood but still within walking distance to the supermarket, metro, and IFEMA, making it both peaceful and convenient. The host was amazing—outstanding communication and very quick to respond to any questions I had. Overall, this apartment was the perfect stay, and I would absolutely recommend it to anyone visiting Madrid.

Alejandro is a great host. Our co-cost Ranya allowed us to leave our luggage early and was very responsive. The apartment is brand-new and looked the same as the photos. The location is very convenient and Ranya always provides us everything we needed. Thank you for hosting us.
